10.1002/aepp.70091.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper investigates how lenders' costs of funds affect agricultural loan interest rates. We use a matched sample of US farm‐loan data and lender‐specific cost of funds, and a farm fixed effects design, to estimate pass‐through, conditioning on borrower characteristics. We find modest average pass‐through of funding costs to farm loan interest rates, with meaningful differences across lender types and local market conditions. Our findings suggest that borrower characteristics and common macroeconomic trends remain central to agricultural loan pricing, but lender business models and local credit market structure also shape how changes in funding costs affect farm borrowing costs.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70091.abstract_zh: 本文研究了贷款机构的资金成本如何影响农业贷款利率。我们利用美国农场贷款数据与贷款机构特定资金成本的匹配样本，并采用农场固定效应模型，在控制借款人特征的情况下估计传导效应。研究发现，资金成本向农场贷款利率的平均传导程度较为温和，且在不同贷款机构类型和当地市场条件下存在显著差异。我们的结果表明，借款人特征和共同宏观经济趋势仍是农业贷款定价的核心因素，但贷款机构的商业模式和当地信贷市场结构同样影响着资金成本变化对农场借贷成本的作用路径。

10.1002/aepp.70097.abstract: ABSTRACT To increase farmer adoption of green practices, the EU Common Agricultural Policy includes both mandatory (conditionality) and voluntary instruments (eco‐schemes–ECS– and more demanding, multi‐annual agri‐environment‐climate measures –AECM–). Building on the experiment of Barreiro‐Hurle et al. (2023), which focused on eco‐schemes, this paper analyses farmers' stated willingness to voluntarily adopt AECM. Using a framed experiment with 600 farmers in Spain, Germany, and Poland, we compared two policy interventions—higher mandatory environmental requirements and an equivalent reduction in income linked to CAP direct payments—and varied their intensity. Higher mandatory environmental requirements and an equivalent income reduction reduce the willingness to voluntarily adopt AECM. We also find a positive conditional association between the intensity of ECS adoption and the willingness to adopt AECM, suggesting potential spillover effects. We further show that behavioral factors, particularly perceived fairness of compensation, environmental concern, confidence in the environmental program, and CAP entitlement, explain substantially more variation in willingness to adopt AECM than standard structural and socio‐demographic characteristics (farm and farmer features). These results have implications for the upcoming envisaged CAP green architecture.
10.1002/aepp.70097.abstract_zh: 摘要 为提升农民对绿色实践的采纳率，欧盟共同农业政策同时包含强制性（条件性）与自愿性工具（生态计划——ECS——以及要求更高、多年期的农业环境气候措施——AECM）。本文基于Barreiro‐Hurle等人（2023）聚焦生态计划的实验研究，进一步分析农民自愿采纳AECM的陈述意愿。通过对西班牙、德国和波兰600名农民开展框架实验，我们比较了两种政策干预——提高强制性环境要求与等额削减CAP直接支付相关的收入——并调整其强度。结果表明，更高的强制性环境要求与等额收入削减均会降低农民自愿采纳AECM的意愿。同时，我们发现ECS采纳强度与AECM采纳意愿之间存在正向条件关联，暗示潜在溢出效应。进一步分析显示，行为因素（尤其是补偿公平感知、环境关切、对环保项目的信心及CAP权益认知）对AECM采纳意愿的解释力显著高于标准的结构性与社会人口特征（农场与农民属性）。这些发现对即将实施的CAP绿色架构具有政策启示。

10.1002/aepp.70098.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Growing demand for healthier beverages is driving innovation in the wine sector, with dealcoholized wine emerging as a promising alternative. However, little is known about the contextual conditions under which consumers would choose dealcoholized wine, particularly in countries with strong wine traditions. To fill this gap, this work examines how situational factors and information treatments influence consumers' willingness to switch from traditional to dealcoholized wine in Italy and Croatia, two countries with different wine consumption traditions. Using a vignette‐based experiment administered to 1600 wine consumers, this study analyses how consumption context and product information affect the likelihood of choosing dealcoholized wine over conventional alternatives. The results show that, although conventional wine remains the preferred option under standard conditions, the likelihood of switching to dealcoholized wine increases when a driving constraint is introduced. Informational treatments significantly affect choices in Italy, whereas Croatian consumers appear to respond more to functional constraints than to calorie or health messages. The findings have implications for producers and policymakers seeking to promote dealcoholized wines.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70098.abstract_zh: 对更健康饮料的需求增长正推动葡萄酒行业创新，无醇葡萄酒正成为一种有前景的替代选择。然而，关于消费者在何种情境条件下会选择无醇葡萄酒，尤其是在具有深厚葡萄酒传统的国家，目前仍知之甚少。为填补这一空白，本研究考察了情境因素和信息处理如何影响意大利和克罗地亚（两个具有不同葡萄酒消费传统的国家）消费者从传统葡萄酒转向无醇葡萄酒的意愿。通过对1600名葡萄酒消费者进行基于情境实验的分析，本研究探讨了消费情境和产品信息如何影响选择无醇葡萄酒而非传统替代品的可能性。结果表明，尽管传统葡萄酒在标准条件下仍是首选，但当引入驾驶限制条件时，转向无醇葡萄酒的可能性增加。信息处理显著影响意大利消费者的选择，而克罗地亚消费者似乎对功能性限制的反应强于对卡路里或健康信息的反应。这些发现对寻求推广无醇葡萄酒的生产商和政策制定者具有启示意义。
10.1002/aepp.70098.title: Promoting Healthier Drinking: Evidence From a Vignette Experiment on Contextual and Informational Drivers of Dealcoholized Wine Choices
10.1002/aepp.70098.title_zh: 促进健康饮酒：情境与信息因素对无醇葡萄酒选择影响的场景实验证据

10.1002/aepp.70099.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study examines the ecosystem benefits of expanding hemp cultivation by assessing its impact on crop diversity. Using scenario‐based simulations and fixed‐effect panel regressions with county‐level data in Kentucky, we find that increased hemp acreage tends to enhance crop diversity, improving water quality and bird diversity. While agricultural policies aimed at small‐scale farmers align with improving farm profitability, broader ecological benefits may remain limited unless they reach a sufficient scale. Our findings suggest that hemp‐induced crop diversification can generate measurable non‐market economic benefits through improvements in water quality and bird diversity, highlighting the need for practical and proactive policy measures that promote smallholder participation.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70099.abstract_zh: 本研究通过评估工业大麻种植对作物多样性的影响，探讨其带来的生态系统效益。基于肯塔基州县级数据的场景模拟与固定效应面板回归分析发现，工业大麻种植面积的增加倾向于提升作物多样性，进而改善水质与鸟类多样性。尽管面向小规模农户的农业政策与提升农场盈利能力的目标相契合，但若未达到足够规模，其更广泛的生态效益可能仍十分有限。研究结果表明，工业大麻引致的作物多样化可通过水质改善与鸟类多样性提升产生可量化的非市场经济效益，这凸显了制定切实可行且积极主动的政策措施以促进小农户参与的必要性。
10.1002/aepp.70099.title: Hemp Cultivation and Crop Diversification: Implications for Ecosystem Services in Kentucky
10.1002/aepp.70099.title_zh: 大麻种植与作物多样化：对肯塔基州生态系统服务的影响

10.1002/aepp.70100.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This article examines whether Latin American countries are keeping pace with global trends in trade agreement depth or falling behind. Using 681 agreements (1970–2019), we develop the Depth Index of Trade Agreements (DITA) to weight provisions endogenously through factor analysis based on co‐occurrence patterns. Results show that the Pacific Alliance and Central America lag one decade behind North American standards, whereas South America and the Caribbean lag by two to three decades. Partner selection is critical: countries negotiating extensively with developed partners tend to incorporate similar provisions into South–South agreements, suggesting North–South spillover effects. These findings suggest that regional lag reflects policy choices rather than inherent constraints.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70100.abstract_zh: 本文考察拉丁美洲国家在全球贸易协定深度趋势中是同步跟进还是落后。基于681项协定（1970-2019年），我们通过因子分析依据条款共现模式内生性加权，构建了贸易协定深度指数（DITA）。结果显示，太平洋联盟和中美洲落后于北美标准约十年，而南美洲和加勒比地区则落后二至三十年。合作伙伴选择至关重要：与发达国家进行广泛谈判的国家，倾向于将类似条款纳入南南协定中，这表明存在南北溢出效应。这些发现表明，区域滞后反映的是政策选择而非固有约束。
10.1002/aepp.70100.title: Keeping Pace or Falling Behind? The Depth of Latin American Trade Agreements
10.1002/aepp.70100.title_zh: 保持同步还是落后？拉丁美洲贸易协定的深度

10.1002/aepp.70101.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>How food prices affect diet quality is an important question to design policies that can improve the nutrition and health of all Americans. This study investigates the association between food‐at‐home diet quality and aggregate food prices to understand if price movements compromise nutrition, and where price‐based policies could be an effective tool to improve population health. Using detailed household purchase data from 2015 to 2018, our findings suggest three insights. First, consumers make substitutions that largely preserve their given level of diet quality, though that level remains poor relative to recommendations for health. Second, we find minimal evidence of heterogeneous responsiveness to prices by diet quality or sociodemographic characteristics. Third, we find evidence that the substitutions consumers make in their protein choices when prices rise increase the healthfulness of their food baskets. Taken together, our study suggests that encouraging healthier diets probably requires more than pricing policies but that price‐based policies targeted at protein may be more effective than other food groups. That we fail to find evidence of differential responsiveness of diet quality to prices suggests that universal (untargeted) policies can be recommended to improve diets across the population.</jats:p>
                  <jats:p>
                    <jats:bold>JEL Classification:</jats:bold>
                    D12, I12, Q18
                  </jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70101.abstract_zh: 食品价格如何影响膳食质量，是设计改善全体美国人营养与健康政策的关键问题。本研究探究家庭食品膳食质量与总体食品价格之间的关联，以理解价格波动是否损害营养状况，以及基于价格的政策能否成为改善人口健康的有效工具。利用2015年至2018年的详细家庭购买数据，我们的发现揭示了三个要点。首先，消费者进行的替代行为大体上维持了其既有的膳食质量水平，尽管该水平相对于健康建议而言仍然较差。其次，我们几乎没有发现膳食质量或社会人口特征对价格存在异质性响应程度的证据。第三，我们发现证据表明，当价格上涨时，消费者在蛋白质选择上进行的替代行为提高了其食品篮子的健康程度。综合来看，我们的研究表明，鼓励更健康的膳食可能不仅需要定价政策，但针对蛋白质的基于价格的政策可能比其他食品类别更有效。我们未能发现膳食质量对价格存在差异化响应程度的证据，这表明可以推荐普遍性（非针对性）政策来改善全体人口的膳食。
10.1002/aepp.70101.title: What Happens to Diet Quality When Food Prices Rise? Revealed Preference From National Household Scanner Data, 2015–2018

10.1002/aepp.70102.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>China's accession to the World Trade Organization in 2001 reshaped global trade, reducing U.S. demand for Mexican manufactured goods and weakening Mexico's manufacturing employment. This study estimates how this trade‐induced decline affected migration and employment decisions among rural Mexicans. Using individual‐level panel data from the Mexican National Rural Household Survey (ENHRUM) and a long‐difference framework, we instrument manufacturing employment with regional exposure to Chinese import competition. Results show that a 10‐percentage‐point decline in manufacturing employment increased the probability of U.S. migration by 24 percentage points and U.S. nonagricultural employment by 17 points, with no significant effects on agricultural employment.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70102.abstract_zh: 2001年中国加入世界贸易组织重塑了全球贸易格局，导致美国对墨西哥制成品的需求下降，进而削弱了墨西哥制造业的就业水平。本研究旨在估算这一贸易冲击引发的制造业就业萎缩对墨西哥农村人口迁移及就业决策的影响。基于墨西哥国家农村家庭调查（ENHRUM）的个体层面面板数据，采用长期差分框架，以各地区对中国进口竞争的暴露度作为制造业就业的工具变量。结果表明：制造业就业率每下降10个百分点，农村人口迁移至美国的概率增加24个百分点，在美国从事非农就业的概率上升17个百分点，而对农业就业未产生显著影响。
10.1002/aepp.70102.title: Chinese Trade Competition and Rural Mexican Migration
10.1002/aepp.70102.title_zh: 中国贸易竞争与墨西哥农村移民

10.1002/aepp.70103.abstract: ABSTRACT Large ad hoc assistance programs have returned to U.S. farm policy since 2017, operating alongside a more developed safety net built around federally subsidized crop insurance, Title I commodity programs, and standing disaster assistance. This paper reviews the renewed use of ad hoc assistance, documents its recent scale using USDA data, and examines its implications for producers and policy design. Repeated ad hoc programs may create expectations of future support while leaving uncertainty about timing, eligibility, and payment formulas. They also raise questions about crop insurance incentives, targeting, transparency, taxpayer exposure, and coordination across safety‐net tools.
10.1002/aepp.70103.abstract_zh: 摘要 自2017年以来，美国农业政策中重新出现了大规模临时援助计划，这些计划与围绕联邦补贴作物保险、第一标题商品计划及常设灾害援助构建的更为完善的安全网并行运作。本文回顾了临时援助的重新启用情况，利用美国农业部数据记录了其近期规模，并探讨了其对生产者及政策设计的影响。反复实施的临时计划可能形成对未来支持的预期，同时却在时间安排、资格认定及支付公式方面留下不确定性。此外，这些计划还引发了关于作物保险激励、目标定位、透明度、纳税人风险敞口以及安全网工具间协调性的问题。

10.1002/aepp.70103.title_zh: 临时项目，持久问题：美国农业安全网中的临时援助

10.1002/aepp.70104.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Some rural counties remain dependent on agricultural or manufacturing jobs, but an increasing proportion have diversified economics. Rural counties also differ in their abilities to commute to an urban market characterized by higher wages and labor productivity. National changes in immigration and trade policies have had heterogeneous effects on rural labor markets, with counties dependent on agriculture or food processing facing rising input costs and shrinking international output markets. Increased commuting will help some rural communities adapt, while more remote counties will face outmigration, population loss, and reduced capacity to sustain public services.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70104.abstract_zh: 摘要：部分农村县仍依赖农业或制造业就业，但越来越多的农村县已实现经济多元化。不同农村县在通勤至工资水平与劳动生产率更高的城市市场的能力方面也存在差异。国家移民与贸易政策的变化对农村劳动力市场产生了异质性影响，依赖农业或食品加工业的县面临投入成本上升与国际产出市场萎缩的双重压力。通勤便利性的提升将有助于部分农村社区适应变化，而更为偏远的县则将面临人口外迁、规模缩减以及公共服务维持能力下降的困境。
10.1002/aepp.70104.title: Rural Labor Supply and Economic Opportunities: Commuting, Migration, Tariffs, and Immigration
10.1002/aepp.70104.title_zh: 农村劳动力供给与经济机会：通勤、迁移、关税与移民

10.1002/aepp.70105.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We examine the impact of US–China trade policy announcements on corn and soybean markets. Using time‐series models, our results show that prospective tariff announcements significantly increased implied volatility (IV), especially during the 2018–2019 trade war. Our results show that corn and soybean markets responded to both countries' announcements. We observe the strongest volatility impacts at the 90% and 95% strikes. Our results indicate that higher IV raised hedging costs for producers, further constricting farm margins– a 7.5% rise in IV increased soybean option premiums by approximately 3.75%. These findings highlight the financial burden imposed by trade policy uncertainty beyond its impact on commodity prices.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70105.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文研究了美中贸易政策公告对玉米和大豆市场的影响。基于时间序列模型，我们的结果表明，预期关税公告显著提高了隐含波动率（IV），尤其是在2018–2019年贸易战期间。研究显示，玉米和大豆市场对两国的公告均有反应。我们在90%和95%执行价处观察到最强的波动率影响。结果指出，更高的隐含波动率提高了生产者的对冲成本，进一步压缩了农场利润——隐含波动率每上升7.5%，大豆期权溢价约增加3.75%。这些发现凸显了贸易政策不确定性在影响商品价格之外所带来的财务负担。
10.1002/aepp.70105.title: The Cost of Uncertainty: US–China Tariff Effects on Agricultural Commodity Markets
10.1002/aepp.70105.title_zh: 不确定性的代价：美中关税对农产品市场的影响

10.1002/aepp.70106.abstract: ABSTRACT Since 2014, the number of schools offering universal free meals to all enrolled children without requiring annual meal applications has increased meaningfully. Using USDA's Purchase to Plate Crosswalk, a difference‐in‐differences framework, and a nationwide consumer panel, the effect of universal‐free‐meal exposure on the diet quality of food‐at‐home purchases is assessed in terms of the Healthy Eating Index (HEI). Consistent with earlier findings, households exposed to universal free meals reduce grocery spending by over 6%. There is no deleterious overall effect of universal‐free‐meal exposure on the diet quality of food‐at‐home purchases as measured by the HEI.
10.1002/aepp.70106.abstract_zh: 摘要 自2014年以来，无需年度餐食申请即可向所有在校儿童提供免费餐食的学校数量显著增加。本研究利用美国农业部的"从采购到餐盘"数据转换工具、双重差分框架以及全国消费者面板数据，以健康饮食指数（HEI）为衡量标准，评估了普及免费餐食政策对家庭食品购买中居家饮食质量的影响。与早期研究结果一致，受普及免费餐食政策影响的家庭，其食品杂货支出减少了6%以上。以HEI为衡量指标，普及免费餐食政策对居家食品购买的整体饮食质量并未产生不利影响。
10.1002/aepp.70106.title: Do Universal Free School Meals Improve the Dietary Quality of Food‐At‐Home Purchases?
10.1002/aepp.70106.title_zh: 全民免费校餐能否改善家庭食品购买的膳食质量？

10.1002/aepp.70107.abstract: ABSTRACT Gene editing (GE) is gaining momentum worldwide, but limited data on UK farmers' preferences hinders our understanding of its potential impact amid deregulation debates. Based on a survey of 200 English arable farmers, we employ a Latent Class Analysis and Multinomial Logit regressions to investigate current preferences for GE crops. The analysis reveals a high willingness of adoption, outlines three preference profiles, including eager, wary, and hesitant adopters, and identify factors influencing such preferences. Results spot a possible substitution effect among GE crops and agricultural insurance, and suggest farmers may adopt GE in response to growing public demand for sustainable practices.
10.1002/aepp.70107.abstract_zh: 摘要 基因编辑技术在全球范围内发展迅速，但关于英国农民偏好的数据有限，这阻碍了我们在放松管制辩论中理解其潜在影响。基于对200名英格兰耕地农民的调查，我们采用潜在类别分析和多项逻辑回归模型，研究当前对基因编辑作物的偏好。分析显示农民采用意愿较高，勾勒出三种偏好类型，包括积极采纳者、谨慎采纳者和犹豫采纳者，并识别出影响这些偏好的因素。结果揭示了基因编辑作物与农业保险之间可能存在的替代效应，并表明农民可能因公众对可持续实践日益增长的需求而采纳基因编辑技术。
10.1002/aepp.70107.title: Farmers' Preferences for Gene Editing Crops and Influencing Factors
10.1002/aepp.70107.title_zh: 农民对基因编辑作物的偏好及其影响因素

10.1002/aepp.70108.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the relationship between participation in the EU Rural Development Program and the economic performance of Italian olive farms using a finite‐mixture model with inverse‐probability‐weighted regression adjustment. Based on 2010–2022 FADN panel data, it estimates heterogeneous treatment effects while correcting for selection bias. Results suggest that RDP participation is associated with higher net income, by about EUR 280/ha on average. Two farm clusters emerge, also reflecting different typologies of rural development program measure packages: family‐run farms in disadvantaged areas are often associated with agro‐climatic environmental commitments and related packages and gain about €265/ha. By contrast, more profitable and labor‐intensive farms are more frequently linked to less adopted measures and benefit only marginally. A Monte Carlo simulation assesses the estimator's performance under a controlled data‐generating process. The study highlights the need to account for structural heterogeneity in policy evaluation and supports data‐driven rural development strategies.
10.1002/aepp.70108.abstract_zh: 本文采用有限混合模型与逆概率加权回归调整方法，探究欧盟农村发展计划参与对意大利橄榄农场经济绩效的影响。基于2010-2022年FADN面板数据，在纠正选择偏差的同时估计异质性处理效应。结果表明，参与农村发展计划与净收入提升相关，平均每公顷约增加280欧元。研究识别出两类农场集群，分别对应不同的农村发展计划措施组合类型：位于欠发达地区的家庭经营农场通常与农业气候环境承诺及相关措施包相关联，每公顷增收约265欧元；而利润更高、劳动密集型的农场则更多与采用率较低的措施相关，仅获得边际收益。通过蒙特卡洛模拟在受控数据生成过程中评估了估计量的表现。本研究强调政策评估中需考虑结构性异质性，并为数据驱动的农村发展战略提供支撑。
10.1002/aepp.70108.title:
Differentiated Impacts of
                    EU
                    Rural Development Measures: A Finite Mixture Evaluation of Italian Olive Farms
10.1002/aepp.70108.title_zh: 欧盟农村发展措施的差异化影响：意大利橄榄农场的有限混合评估

10.1002/aepp.70109.abstract: ABSTRACT We conducted two framed field economic experiments with citrus farmers in Florida, United States and soybean farmers in Argentina to investigate their willingness to coordinate pest and weed management efforts. Despite the contrast between these two agricultural contexts, we find striking behavioral commonalities. In both countries, farmers display aversion to strategic uncertainty, rely heavily on beliefs about their neighbors' actions when deciding whether to participate, and systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low. These common findings across such different settings suggest that the underlying mechanisms are not context‐specific but instead reflect more general features of decision‐making under strategic interdependence, lending support to the external validity of our findings. The results highlight key psychological and economic barriers to cooperation and offer policy‐relevant insights for designing interventions to enhance participation in voluntary area‐wide pest management programs. While voluntary coordination can enhance pest management effectiveness and be pareto‐optimal, the success of the collective action depends on overcoming farmers' reluctance to participate. The evidence that farmers systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low highlights a key behavioral barrier that can lead to coordination failures. Interventions that mitigate strategic uncertainty and build trust among participants—such as targeted subsidies or technical assistance—could encourage participation among farmers who would otherwise be unwilling to engage in coordinated efforts. Beyond the immediate application to pest and weed resistance management, our findings contribute to a broader understanding of cooperative behavior among farmers in the presence of strategic uncertainty.
10.1002/aepp.70109.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们与美国佛罗里达州柑橘种植户及阿根廷大豆种植户合作开展了两项框架田野经济实验，旨在探究农户参与病虫害与杂草协同治理的意愿。尽管两国农业情境存在显著差异，但研究发现惊人的行为共性：两国农户均表现出对战略不确定性的规避倾向，其参与决策高度依赖对邻居行为的信念，且即便机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功的概率。这些跨情境的共性发现表明，潜在机制并非情境特异性，而是反映了战略依存条件下决策的普遍特征，从而支持了研究结论的外部有效性。研究结果揭示了阻碍合作的关键心理与经济壁垒，为设计提升自愿性区域病虫害协同治理项目参与度的干预措施提供了政策启示。尽管自愿协同能提升病虫害治理效率并实现帕累托最优，但集体行动的成功取决于能否克服农户的参与惰性。农户在机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功概率的证据，凸显了导致协同失灵的关键行为障碍。通过定向补贴或技术援助等缓解战略不确定性、建立参与者信任的干预措施，可促使原本不愿参与协同行动的农户加入。除直接应用于病虫害抗性治理外，本研究还为理解战略不确定性下农户合作行为提供了更广泛的理论视角。
10.1002/aepp.70109.title: Voluntary Collective Action to Address Growing Agricultural Challenges in Two Countries: Experimental Insights and Commonalities
10.1002/aepp.70109.title_zh: 两国应对日益严峻农业挑战的自愿集体行动：实验洞见与共性

10.1002/aepp.70110.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Federally subsidized crop insurance is a cornerstone of U.S. farm risk management, yet policies with the greatest share of participation only trigger indemnities after losses exceed 15%. Supplemental insurance was introduced to cover part of this deductible, but participation remains largely unchanged. Using 1,005,245 sub‐county aggregated insurance observations and applying novel calibration and simulation methods, we show that low participation in supplemental coverage limits risk reduction potential. While basic insurance provides a foundation, adding supplemental policies meaningfully improves downside risk reduction and income transfer. Although these gains involve higher premiums, a benefit‐per‐premium analysis still favors broader use. These results reflect potential program impacts conditional on adoption, recognizing that actual participation depends on farmer preferences, risk perceptions, and institutional constraints.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70110.abstract_zh: 联邦补贴作物保险是美国农业风险管理的基石，但参与率最高的保单仅在损失超过15%后才触发赔付。补充保险旨在覆盖部分免赔额，但参与率基本未变。利用1,005,245个次县级汇总保险观测数据，并应用新型校准与模拟方法，我们发现补充保险的低参与率限制了风险降低潜力。虽然基础保险提供了保障基础，但增加补充保单能显著改善下行风险降低和收入转移效果。尽管这些收益伴随更高保费，但每单位保费收益分析仍支持更广泛使用。这些结果反映了在采用条件下的潜在项目影响，同时认识到实际参与取决于农户偏好、风险感知和制度约束。
10.1002/aepp.70110.title: Low Participation and Risk Reduction Potential of Supplemental Crop Insurance in the United States
10.1002/aepp.70110.title_zh: 美国补充性农作物保险的低参与率与风险降低潜力

10.1002/aepp.70111.abstract: ABSTRACT Biosecurity trade restrictions are commonly framed as preventive measures, yet in many settings they function primarily as policies of delay: they impose immediate market costs while only postponing the arrival of biological risks. This paper evaluates that intertemporal tradeoff using the 2024–2025 US suspension of live cattle imports from Mexico in response to the northward spread of New World Screwworm (NWS). We estimate a vector autoregression (VAR) using monthly data from 2004 to 2025 to characterize pre‐ban dynamics in feeder cattle prices, Mexican import volumes, fed cattle prices, and feed costs, and construct counterfactual forecasts for prices and trade flows absent the border closures. Translating these costs into a simple break‐even framework shows that under an annual endemic‐loss assumption of $10 billion, each additional month of border closure would need to delay endemic NWS establishment by approximately 4 months to be welfare improving.
10.1002/aepp.70111.abstract_zh: 摘要 生物安全贸易限制通常被视为预防性措施，但在许多情境下，它们主要发挥延迟政策的作用：这些限制在施加即时市场成本的同时，仅能推迟生物风险的到来。本文利用2024-2025年美国因新世界螺旋蝇（NWS）向北蔓延而暂停从墨西哥进口活牛的案例，评估了这一跨期权衡。我们基于2004年至2025年的月度数据，估计了一个向量自回归（VAR）模型，以刻画禁运前架子牛价格、墨西哥进口量、育肥牛价格及饲料成本之间的动态关系，并构建了无边境关闭情形下价格与贸易流的反事实预测。将这些成本转化为简单的盈亏平衡框架后显示，在每年10亿美元的地方性损失假设下，边境关闭每延长一个月，需将NWS地方性建立推迟约4个月，才能实现福利改善。

10.1002/aepp.70111.title_zh: 推迟不可避免之事？美国螺旋蝇检疫封锁与架子牛市场动态

10.1002/aepp.70112.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Using an enhanced Computable General Equilibrium (CGE) model (GTAP‐BIO), this study assesses how the expansion in demand for Electric Vehicles (EVs) and the reduction in exports of agricultural products induced by trade disputes negatively affect US agriculture. It then evaluates the extent to which producing Sustainable Aviation Fuels (SAFs) from corn and soybeans could mitigate these effects. Results show that EV expansion reduces gasoline demand, suppresses corn production, lowers farm incomes, and generates idled capacity, including increases in uncultivated cropland. Export tariffs further amplify these effects. Expansion in SAF produced from corn and soybean could partially limit these consequences.</jats:p>
10.1002/aepp.70112.abstract_zh: 摘要：本研究采用增强型可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型（GTAP-BIO），评估电动汽车（EV）需求扩张及贸易争端导致的农产品出口减少对美国农业的负面影响，并进一步分析利用玉米和大豆生产可持续航空燃料（SAFs）在多大程度上能够缓解这些影响。结果表明，电动汽车扩张降低了汽油需求，抑制了玉米生产，减少了农业收入，并导致产能闲置，包括未耕种农田面积的增加。出口关税进一步放大了这些效应。扩大以玉米和大豆为原料的可持续航空燃料生产可在一定程度上限制上述后果。

10.1002/aepp.70114.abstract: ABSTRACT This study analyzed post‐COVID‐19 trends in food prices in Brazil and projected changes through 2026. Time series from the 2017/2018 Household Budget Survey, the National System of Consumer Price Indexes, and the Continuous National Household Sample Survey were analyzed using Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) models. Between 2018 and 2024, prices of ultra‐processed food products (UPFP) decreased by 16%, while unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients increased, narrowing the price gap. The nominal prices of food groups rose more than nominal household income between 2018 and 2024, particularly for unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients. Projections indicate that UPFP will remain the cheapest group by 2026, reinforcing barriers to healthy diets and supporting tax policies.
10.1002/aepp.70114.abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究分析了巴西在新冠疫情后的食品价格趋势，并预测了截至2026年的变化。研究利用2017/2018年家庭预算调查、国家消费者价格指数体系以及连续全国住户抽样调查的时间序列数据，采用季节性自回归积分滑动平均模型（SARIMA）进行分析。2018年至2024年间，超加工食品（UPFP）价格下降了16%，而未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料的价格则有所上涨，从而缩小了价格差距。2018年至2024年间，各类食品的名义价格涨幅超过了名义家庭收入，尤其是未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料。预测显示，到2026年，超加工食品仍将是最便宜的类别，这加剧了健康饮食的障碍，并为税收政策提供了支持依据。

10.1002/ajae.70084.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We introduce a fully nonparametric estimator to estimate willingness to pay (WTP) using contingent valuation (CV) data. Traditional methods such as the probit model are used because of their roots in utility theory as well as their ease to implement. However, they are limited by their reliance on strict parametric assumptions, such as linearity and the requirement that the researcher pre‐select important covariates. While these methods are widely used, they may fail to capture complex relationships, particularly in situations involving nonlinearity or interactions among variables. This paper introduces Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) as a flexible, nonparametric way to estimate WTP from CV studies. Using a simulation study, we demonstrate that BART is competitive with traditional models under strict data‐generating assumptions. When the underlying data‐generating process is more complex, BART outperforms traditional models and even other machine‐learning models. Moreover, BART automatically incorporates individual heterogeneity into estimation, making it more informative than traditional nonparametric estimators. We illustrate the breadth of the model's benefits with an empirical application estimating WTP to develop an Invasive Species Rapid Response Fund in the Hawaiian Islands. We find WTP distributional differences along the margins of gender, age, and income. We also construct willingness to pay curves out of Monte Carlo Markov Chain (MCMC) draws and calculate posterior means and credible intervals using empirical cumulative distribution functions (CDFs). We find these WTP to be lower than those from the probit. Future natural extensions of BART make this method a compelling alternative for estimating WTP in CV experiments.</jats:p>
10.1002/ajae.70084.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种完全非参数估计方法，利用条件价值评估（CV）数据来估计支付意愿（WTP）。传统方法如probit模型因其植根于效用理论且易于实施而被广泛使用。然而，这些方法受限于严格的参数假设，例如线性关系以及研究者需预先选择重要协变量的要求。尽管这些方法应用广泛，但在涉及非线性或变量间交互作用的复杂情境中，可能无法捕捉真实关系。本文引入贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）作为一种灵活的非参数方法，用于从CV研究中估计WTP。通过模拟研究，我们证明在严格的数据生成假设下，BART与传统模型表现相当。当底层数据生成过程更为复杂时，BART优于传统模型甚至其他机器学习模型。此外，BART自动将个体异质性纳入估计，使其比传统非参数估计器更具信息量。我们通过一项实证应用展示了该模型的广泛优势，该应用估计了夏威夷群岛建立入侵物种快速响应基金的支付意愿。研究发现，WTP在性别、年龄和收入边际上存在分布差异。我们还利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）抽样构建了支付意愿曲线，并通过经验累积分布函数（CDFs）计算后验均值和可信区间。结果显示，这些WTP估计值低于probit模型的结果。BART未来的自然扩展使其成为CV实验中估计WTP的有力替代方法。
10.1002/ajae.70084.title: Not just a random forest: Using Bayesian additive regression trees to estimate willingness to pay to protect critical habitat
10.1002/ajae.70084.title_zh: 不仅仅是随机森林：使用贝叶斯加性回归树估计保护关键栖息地的支付意愿

10.1002/ajae.70085.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper examines the causal effects of a school feeding program on maternal empowerment and household consumption in rural China. Exploiting the staggered implementation of the Student Nutrition Improvement Program, we find that the program significantly reduces maternal time spent on housework, improves maternal labor market performance, and enhances maternal decision‐making power within nuclear households. The augmented bargaining power translates into shifts in household consumption toward female‐prioritized goods, including more nutritious foods, clothing, and housework‐related appliances. However, these positive effects on maternal empowerment are diminished in multigenerational families, where grandparents can assist with childcare responsibilities.</jats:p>
10.1002/ajae.70085.abstract_zh: 本文考察了学校供餐计划对中国农村地区女性赋权及家庭消费的因果效应。利用学生营养改善计划的分阶段实施，我们发现该计划显著减少了母亲的家务劳动时间，改善了母亲在劳动力市场的表现，并增强了母亲在核心家庭中的决策权。这种议价能力的提升促使家庭消费转向女性优先商品，包括更营养的食品、衣物及家务相关电器。然而，在多代同堂的家庭中，由于祖父母可协助承担育儿责任，这些对女性赋权的积极影响有所减弱。

10.1002/ajae.70086.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Lifting smallholder farmers out of poverty depends largely on boosting their agricultural operating incomes, a persistent challenge despite numerous efforts. This study evaluates the impact of China's “E‐Commerce into the Countryside” (ECC) program—the first and largest e‐commerce initiative in the developing world—on both the level and distribution of smallholders' farm earnings. Employing a quasi‐experimental design, we find that the ECC program significantly increases household per capita agricultural operating income. We show that this gain is driven by expanded market access through online sales, which facilitate income growth via three primary mechanisms: operational scale expansion, higher output prices, and a shift toward high‐value‐added crops. However, these benefits are unevenly distributed. The program also widens the income gap among smallholders, a disparity largely attributable to pre‐existing differences in human, productive, and digital capital. Our findings highlight that e‐commerce policies, while potent for income generation, require complementary measures to mitigate disparities that arise from heterogeneous initial endowments.</jats:p>
10.1002/ajae.70086.abstract_zh: 摘要：使小农户摆脱贫困在很大程度上取决于提高其农业经营收入，尽管付出了诸多努力，这仍是一项长期挑战。本研究评估了中国"电子商务进农村"（ECC）计划——发展中国家首个也是规模最大的电子商务举措——对小农户农业收入水平及分布的影响。采用准实验设计，我们发现ECC计划显著提高了家庭人均农业经营收入。研究表明，这一增长源于通过在线销售扩大市场准入，并通过三种主要机制促进收入增长：经营规模扩大、产出价格提高以及向高附加值作物转型。然而，这些收益的分配并不均衡。该计划还扩大了小农户之间的收入差距，这种差距在很大程度上可归因于人力资本、生产资本和数字资本的既有差异。我们的研究结果表明，电子商务政策虽能有效促进收入增长，但需要配套措施来缓解因初始禀赋异质性而产生的差距。

10.1002/jae.70069.abstract: ABSTRACT Peer influence on effort devoted to some activity is often studied when effort is unobserved, and the researcher instead observes an outcome that combines effort with other shocks. For instance, in education, achievement measures such as GPA reflect both effort and idiosyncratic GPA shocks. We propose an alternative approach that circumvents this approximation. Our framework distinguishes unobserved shocks to GPA that do not affect effort from preference shocks that do affect effort levels. We show that peer effects estimates obtained using our approach can differ significantly from classical estimates (where effort is approximated) if the network includes isolated students. Applying our approach to data on high school students in the United States, we find that peer effect estimates relying on GPA as a proxy for effort are 40% lower than those obtained using our approach.
10.1002/jae.70069.abstract_zh: 摘要 当努力程度不可观测，而研究者仅能观察到结合了努力与其他冲击的最终结果时，关于同伴效应对某项活动投入程度的影响研究往往面临挑战。例如在教育领域，GPA等学业成就指标既反映努力程度，也包含个体特有的GPA冲击。本文提出一种规避此类近似处理的新方法。我们的分析框架将不影响努力程度的不可观测GPA冲击与确实影响努力水平的偏好冲击进行区分。研究表明，当社交网络中存在孤立学生时，采用本方法获得的同伴效应估计值可能与经典方法（将努力程度近似处理）存在显著差异。通过将本方法应用于美国高中生数据，我们发现，以GPA作为努力程度代理变量的同伴效应估计值，比采用本方法获得的估计值低40%。

10.1002/jae.70073.abstract: ABSTRACT We estimate the first time‐varying, county‐level index of housing supply elasticities across the United States, using a structural vector autoregression model with sign restrictions to identify the effect of a positive demand shock. This index reveals four features of the supply curve in different local housing markets. First, supply elasticities are low, on average, generating faster price growth than housing unit growth for most of the country. Second, there is significant variation in elasticities across counties, both urban and rural. Third, elasticities have declined in more counties than they have risen over time, particularly in large urban markets. Fourth, these new estimates predict housing quantity growth better than previous models in the literature.
10.1002/jae.70073.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们利用带有符号约束的结构向量自回归模型识别正向需求冲击效应，首次估算了美国各县级住房供给弹性的时变指数。该指数揭示了不同地方住房市场供给曲线的四个特征：第一，平均而言供给弹性较低，导致全国大部分地区房价增速快于住房单元增速；第二，城乡各县之间的弹性存在显著差异；第三，随时间推移，弹性下降的县数量多于上升的县，尤其是在大型城市市场；第四，相较于文献中的既有模型，这些新估计值能更准确地预测住房数量增长。
10.1002/jae.70073.title: Housing Supply Elasticities: A Structural Vector Autoregression Approach

10.1002/jae.70074.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We analyse fiscal policy in resource‐rich economies using a novel Bayesian regime‐switching panel model. The identified regimes capture pro‐ or countercyclical fiscal behaviour by allowing regime‐specific shifts in the average fiscal stance, while the switches between the regimes have the interpretation of changes in fiscal policy. Applying the model to a panel of sixteen oil‐producing economies, we show that fiscal policy has alternated between a procyclical and countercyclical regime multiple times over the sample. Furthermore, we find that fiscal policy is more volatile in the procyclical regime and that the probability of being in the procyclical regime is higher for OPEC countries than for non‐OPEC countries. We also show that following either an increase or decrease in oil revenues, the growth in government expenditures is mostly increasing, suggesting an upward bias in expenditures in oil‐producing countries. These are new findings in the literature.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70074.abstract_zh: 摘要：我们采用一种新颖的贝叶斯体制转换面板模型，分析了资源丰富经济体的财政政策。通过允许平均财政立场发生体制特定转变，识别出的体制捕捉了顺周期或逆周期的财政行为，而体制间的转换则被解释为财政政策的变化。将该模型应用于由16个石油生产经济体组成的面板数据，我们发现在样本期内，财政政策多次在顺周期与逆周期体制之间交替。此外，我们发现顺周期体制下的财政政策波动性更大，且石油输出国组织（OPEC）国家处于顺周期体制的概率高于非OPEC国家。我们还表明，无论石油收入增加还是减少，政府支出的增长大多呈上升趋势，这暗示石油生产国存在支出向上偏倚。这些是文献中的新发现。
10.1002/jae.70074.title: Fiscal Policy Regimes in Resource‐Rich Economies
10.1002/jae.70074.title_zh: 资源丰富经济体的财政政策体制

10.1002/jae.70075.abstract: ABSTRACT Lévy processes are widely used in financial modeling due to their ability to capture discontinuities and heavy tails, which are common in high‐frequency asset return data. However, parameter estimation remains a challenge when associated likelihoods are unavailable or costly to compute. We propose a fast and accurate method for Lévy parameter estimation using the neural Bayes estimation (NBE) framework—a simulation‐based, likelihood‐free approach that leverages permutation‐invariant neural networks to approximate Bayes estimators. We contribute new theoretical results, showing that NBE results in consistent estimators whose risk converges to that of the Bayes estimator under mild conditions. Moreover, through extensive simulations across several Lévy models, we show that NBE outperforms traditional methods in both accuracy and runtime, while also enabling two complementary approaches to uncertainty quantification. We illustrate our approach on a challenging high‐frequency cryptocurrency return dataset, where the method captures evolving parameter dynamics and delivers reliable and interpretable inference at a fraction of the computational cost of traditional methods. We investigate nearly a decade of high‐frequency Bitcoin returns, requiring less than one minute to estimate parameters under the proposed approach.
10.1002/jae.70075.abstract_zh: 摘要 莱维过程因其能够捕捉高频资产收益数据中常见的间断性和厚尾特征，在金融建模中得到广泛应用。然而，当相关似然函数不可用或计算成本高昂时，参数估计仍面临挑战。我们提出了一种基于神经贝叶斯估计（NBE）框架的快速精确莱维参数估计方法——这是一种基于模拟的无似然方法，利用置换不变神经网络来近似贝叶斯估计量。我们贡献了新的理论成果，证明在温和条件下，NBE可得到一致估计量，其风险收敛至贝叶斯估计量的风险水平。此外，通过针对多个莱维模型的大量模拟实验，我们表明NBE在精度和运行时间上均优于传统方法，同时还能实现两种互补的不确定性量化方法。我们以具有挑战性的高频加密货币收益数据集为例进行方法验证，该方法能够捕捉动态变化的参数特征，并以传统方法计算成本的一小部分提供可靠且可解释的推断。我们研究了近十年高频比特币收益数据，在提出的方法下，参数估计耗时不足一分钟。
10.1002/jae.70075.title: Fast Likelihood‐Free Parameter Estimation for Lévy Processes
10.1002/jae.70075.title_zh: 莱维过程的快速无似然参数估计

10.1002/jae.70076.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study proposes specification tests for interference structure in causal inference with spillovers. We focus on experimental settings in which the treatment assignment mechanism is known. To test whether a given exposure mapping adequately summarizes the true interference structure, we develop conditional randomization tests by utilizing the hierarchical relationship between the null and alternative exposure mappings. When there are multiple candidate exposure mappings of interest, we propose a sequential specification testing procedure that controls the false discovery rate. Through extensive simulation exercises, we demonstrate that our tests have desirable size properties and satisfactory power. To illustrate the proposed methods, we revisit two existing social network experiments: One on farmers' insurance adoption and another on anti‐conflict education programs.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70076.abstract_zh: 本研究针对存在溢出效应的因果推断中的干扰结构，提出了设定检验方法。我们聚焦于处理分配机制已知的实验场景。为检验给定的暴露映射是否充分概括了真实的干扰结构，我们利用零假设与备择假设暴露映射之间的层级关系，开发了条件随机化检验。当存在多个感兴趣的候选暴露映射时，我们提出了一种序贯设定检验程序，该程序能够控制错误发现率。通过大量模拟实验，我们证明所提出的检验具有理想的尺度性质与令人满意的检验功效。为说明所提方法的应用，我们重新审视了两项现有社交网络实验：一项关于农民保险采纳行为，另一项关于反冲突教育项目。
10.1002/jae.70076.title: Conditional Randomization Tests for the Specification of Interference Structure
10.1002/jae.70076.title_zh: 干扰结构设定的条件随机化检验

10.1002/jae.70077.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper proposes a simple smooth specification test for the propensity score in the spirit of Neyman (1937). We derive a particular restriction on the propensity score and construct the specification test based on it. Using the density‐weighting method, we transform the original specification testing problem into a test of the joint significance of the generalized Fourier coefficients. We propose a novel projection method to eliminate the parameter estimation effect arising from estimating unknown nuisance parameters. The proposed test is shown to follow a standard  distribution under the null hypothesis and to possess nontrivial asymptotic power against local alternatives that converge to the null at the parametric rate , where  is the sample size. To enhance the practical applicability of the procedure, we further introduce a data‐driven selection method for determining the testing order, enabling automatic selection based on the observed data. Compared to existing methods, our test does not suffer from the “curse of dimensionality” faced by Shaikh et al. (2009); at the same time, our test is both asymptotically pivotal and more computationally efficient than that of Sant'Anna and Song (2019). Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed test yields satisfactory empirical size and power. Compared with previous tests, our test exhibits comparable overall performance and delivers clear improvements in some cases, especially for high‐frequency alternatives. Two empirical applications further illustrate the practical applicability of our proposal, examining propensity score specifications in the Soviet 156 Program and the US Job Corps Program.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70077.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于Neyman（1937）思想的倾向得分平滑设定检验方法。我们推导出倾向得分的一个特定约束条件，并据此构建设定检验。通过密度加权方法，将原始设定检验问题转化为广义傅里叶系数联合显著性检验。我们提出一种新颖的投影方法，以消除未知冗余参数估计带来的参数估计效应。所提出的检验在原假设下服从标准分布，并对以参数速率收敛于原假设的局部备择假设具有非平凡渐近功效（其中为样本量）。为增强方法的实际应用性，我们进一步引入数据驱动的检验阶数选择方法，实现基于观测数据的自动选择。与现有方法相比，本检验不存在Shaikh等（2009）面临的"维度灾难"问题；同时，本检验既具有渐近枢轴性质，又比Sant'Anna和Song（2019）的方法计算效率更高。大量模拟表明，所提检验具有令人满意的经验水平和功效。与以往检验相比，本检验在整体表现上相当，并在某些情形下（尤其是高频备择假设）展现出明显改进。两项实证应用（苏联156工程和美国职业训练团项目）进一步验证了本方法的实际适用性。
10.1002/jae.70077.title: A Smooth Specification Test for the Propensity Score
10.1002/jae.70077.title_zh: 倾向得分的平滑设定检验

10.1002/jae.70078.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>How do labor market institutions shape the transmission of government spending shocks and macroeconomic volatility? We develop a theoretical model in which labor market institutions affect fiscal transmission through their effect on wage rigidity, job separation, and matching frictions. We estimate an interacted panel vector autoregressive model for 16 OECD economies and study how macroeconomic responses to government spending shocks vary with institutional labor market characteristics. In line with our theoretical predictions, we show that institutions that stabilize employment and wages tend to reduce output volatility and attenuate the response of output and employment to government spending shocks.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70078.abstract_zh: 劳动力市场制度如何影响政府支出冲击的传导机制及宏观经济波动？我们构建了一个理论模型，其中劳动力市场制度通过影响工资刚性、岗位分离和匹配摩擦来作用于财政传导机制。基于16个OECD经济体的交互面板向量自回归模型估计，我们研究了宏观经济对政府支出冲击的反应如何随劳动力市场制度特征而变化。与理论预测一致，我们发现稳定就业和工资的制度倾向于降低产出波动，并削弱产出和就业对政府支出冲击的反应。
10.1002/jae.70078.title: Labor Market Institutions, Fiscal Multipliers, and Macroeconomic Volatility
10.1002/jae.70078.title_zh: 劳动力市场制度、财政乘数与宏观经济波动

10.1002/jae.70079.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper explores the existence of network externalities in link formation games of incomplete information. It extends the structural estimation method in Leung (2015) to games where links are undirected and proposals are only partially observed. We provide an econometric characterization of the proposed two‐step estimator and document its performance through a simulation exercise. When the estimation method is applied to data on risk‐sharing arrangements in a Tanzanian village, results indicate that indirect connections matter.
10.1002/jae.70079.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文探讨了不完全信息链接形成博弈中网络外部性的存在性。我们将Leung（2015）的结构估计方法扩展至链接无向且提议仅部分可观测的博弈场景。我们提出了所设计的两步估计量的计量经济学特征，并通过模拟实验验证其性能。将该估计方法应用于坦桑尼亚某村庄风险分担安排的数据后，结果表明间接连接具有显著影响。
10.1002/jae.70079.title: Estimating Network Externalities in Undirected Link Formation Games
10.1002/jae.70079.title_zh: 无向链接形成博弈中的网络外部性估计

10.1002/jae.70080.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>While existing work shows COVID‐19 stay‐at‐home (SAH) policies decreased mobility on average, we lack evidence regarding heterogeneity in policy effectiveness across US counties. To uncover potential heterogeneity, we implement a novel two‐stage approach. First, we employ recent advances in synthetic control estimation and inference to obtain and bound both time‐average and county‐specific treatment effects. Next, we use a local linear forest to explain observed heterogeneity using county‐level predictors. This procedure reveals substantial variation in policy effectiveness and identifies predictors of policy effectiveness which can be used to target future SAH policies.</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70080.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>现有研究表明，新冠疫情居家令政策平均降低了人口流动性，但关于该政策在美国各县间有效性的异质性证据尚不充分。为揭示潜在异质性，我们采用了一种新颖的两阶段方法。首先，利用合成控制估计与推断的最新进展，获取并界定了时间平均效应及县级特定处理效应的边界。其次，通过局部线性森林模型，运用县级预测变量解释观测到的异质性。该流程揭示了政策有效性的显著差异，并识别出可用于未来居家令政策精准施策的预测变量。</jats:p>
10.1002/jae.70080.title: Deniers and Compliers: Unpacking the Heterogeneous Effectiveness of U.S. Stay‐at‐Home Mandates During the COVID‐19 Pandemic
10.1002/jae.70080.title_zh: 否认者与遵从者：解析美国COVID-19疫情期间居家令的异质性效果

10.1002/jae.70081.abstract: ABSTRACT We propose a method to identify the anticipated components of macroeconomic shocks in a structural VAR. We include empirical forecasts about each time series in the VAR. This introduces enough linear restrictions to identify every structural shock and to further decompose each one into “news” and “surprise” shocks. We estimate a VAR on U.S. time series using forecast data from the SPF, CBO, Federal Reserve, and asset prices. Unanticipated fiscal stimulus and monetary policy shocks have typical effects that match existing evidence. In our news‐surprise decomposition, we find that news drives around one quarter of U.S. business cycle volatility. News explains a larger share of the variance due to fiscal shocks than for monetary policy shocks. Finally, we use the news structure of the shocks to estimate counterfactual policy rules, and compare the ability of fiscal and monetary policy to moderate output and inflation. We find that coordinated fiscal and monetary policy are substantially more effective than either individually.

10.1007/s00148-026-01185-9.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Recent literature provides evidence of inter-generational correlation regarding gender-stereotypical behavior in the labor market. There are two potential explanations for this pattern: selection and causality. Relying on identification through second moments, we reveal a striking result among female adolescents in Germany and Australia. The apparent positive correlation between mothers and daughters is entirely driven by selection, suggesting that sticky gender norms are responsible for persistent gender segregation in the labor market. Most surprisingly, we find that causality operates in the opposite direction, suggesting that the mother holding a non-stereotypical job may have an ambiguous effect on the daughter’s occupational choice. Our findings have important implications for policymakers and identify new directions for future research. We highlight the need to investigate the mechanisms of transmission further to design policies that are successful at closing the remaining gaps. Our findings also suggest that policies designed to foster balanced gender compositions may fall short of achieving the desired inter-generational spillovers unless fundamental shifts in underlying gender norms occur.</jats:p>

<jats:p>近期文献提供了劳动力市场中性别刻板行为代际相关性的证据。这一现象存在两种可能的解释：选择效应与因果效应。基于二阶矩识别方法，我们在德国和澳大利亚的青春期女性中揭示了一个惊人结果：母女之间看似正向的相关性完全由选择效应驱动，表明僵化的性别规范是导致劳动力市场持续性别隔离的根源。最令人意外的是，我们发现因果效应呈反向作用，这意味着母亲从事非刻板职业可能对女儿的职业选择产生模糊影响。这一发现对政策制定者具有重要启示，并为未来研究指明了新方向。我们强调需进一步探究传递机制，以设计能有效弥合现存差距的政策。研究结果同时表明，除非根本性的性别规范发生转变，否则旨在促进性别平衡构成的政策可能难以实现预期的代际溢出效应。</jats:p>

10.1007/s00148-026-01186-8.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Exploiting cohort and spatial variation in exposure to India’s Universal Immunization Program (UIP), I estimate the program’s effects on child mortality and educational attainment. The results show that UIP exposure reduced infant mortality by 0.4 percentage points and under-five mortality by 0.5 percentage points. While the program clearly improved child survival, its effects on educational outcomes were mixed, reflecting changes in the composition of surviving children. UIP exposure reduced primary school completion but increased secondary school completion. The negative effect at lower levels of schooling may reflect lower average health among marginal surviving children or a quantity–quality trade-off arising from unanticipated improvements in child survival. In contrast, the positive effect on secondary schooling may reflect improved health and human capital among children further from the margin of survival.</jats:p>

<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    This paper develops a tractable model of wishful thinking that captures both the benefits and costs of optimistic biased beliefs and the behaviors they induce. Building on Bratcha and Brown (2012) and Caplin and Leahy (2019), we propose a two-stage framework in which a decision maker selects actions and belief structures under uncertainty, balancing subjective utility against the cost of departing from prior beliefs. The cost is formalized using a
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$\phi $$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:mi>ϕ</mml:mi>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    -divergence–based belief distortion function, encompassing measures such as Kullback–Leibler, reverse Kullback-Leibler, and Pearson
                    <jats:inline-formula>
                      <jats:alternatives>
                        <jats:tex-math>$$\chi ^2$$</jats:tex-math>
                        <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
                          <mml:msup>
                            <mml:mi>χ</mml:mi>
                            <mml:mn>2</mml:mn>
                          </mml:msup>
                        </mml:math>
                      </jats:alternatives>
                    </jats:inline-formula>
                    distances. Our contributions are threefold: (i) we characterize optimal beliefs, showing they twist prior probabilities toward high-utility states across a broad class of divergences; (ii) we link WT behavior to risk-seeking actions via convex risk measures; and (iii) we introduce cognitive censoring and cognitive emergence, capturing extreme beliefs. Methodologically, the model provides new insights into how optimistic beliefs reshape decision-making, extending the theoretical foundations of WT and opening avenues for future research.
                  </jats:p>
10.1007/s00199-026-01726-z.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个易于处理的愿望思维模型，同时捕捉了乐观偏差信念及其所引发行为的收益与成本。在Bratcha与Brown（2012）以及Caplin与Leahy（2019）的研究基础上，我们提出了一个两阶段框架：决策者在不确定性下选择行动与信念结构，在主观效用与偏离先验信念的成本之间进行权衡。该成本通过基于ϕ-散度的信念扭曲函数形式化，涵盖Kullback-Leibler散度、逆Kullback-Leibler散度以及Pearson χ²距离等度量。我们的贡献有三方面：（i）刻画了最优信念的特征，表明在广泛的散度类别中，最优信念会将先验概率向高效用状态扭曲；（ii）通过凸风险度量将愿望思维行为与风险寻求行动联系起来；（iii）引入认知审查与认知涌现概念，捕捉极端信念。在方法论上，该模型为乐观信念如何重塑决策提供了新见解，拓展了愿望思维的理论基础，并为未来研究开辟了方向。

10.1007/s00199-026-01732-1.abstract: Abstract We analyze competition in service markets with unit demand prone to adverse selection, such as secured lending and car insurance markets. Incumbent firms learn their customers’ types over time and can price discriminate accordingly. We prove existence of a unique set of mixed strategy equilibria where firms randomize prices over a bounded continuous support. Incumbents earn positive rents. Increased competition through firm entry does not benefit customers if firms know portfolio compositions of competitors. If firms only possess information regarding the aggregate industry client composition, horizontal mergers may reduce industry rents, a finding with implications for competition policy in information-intensive industries.

10.1007/s00199-026-01734-z.abstract: Abstract In many expert–decision maker settings, information is richer than the language used to convey it. Motivated by this communication friction, we study Bayesian persuasion when the sender is constrained to use k messages. We show that the sender’s value is given by a k -point analogue of concavification, which we call k -concavification. An optimal information structure can be chosen with affinely independent posterior support, allowing the problem to be reduced to a lower-dimensional persuasion problem and then solved by standard concavification. We derive a tight bound on the value of communication capacity that applies to general persuasion games: the gain from a $$(k+1)$$ ( k + 1 ) st message is at most $$2/(k-1)$$ 2 / ( k - 1 ) times the value attainable with k messages. Finally, we solve a class of belief-threshold games in which the receiver chooses between a safe default and several risky actions, the sender gets zero from the default and the same positive payoff from any risky action, and a risky action is taken only when the corresponding posterior probability exceeds a threshold. We characterize the optimal coarse information structure, derive comparative statics in the prior and the threshold, and extend the analysis to heterogeneous thresholds and heterogeneous sender values across risky actions.
10.1007/s00199-026-01734-z.abstract_zh: 摘要 在许多专家与决策者互动的场景中，信息本身比用于传递信息的语言更为丰富。受这种沟通摩擦的启发，我们研究了当发送者被限制使用k条消息时的贝叶斯说服问题。我们证明，发送者的价值由凹化概念的k点对应物给出，我们称之为k-凹化。最优信息结构可以选择具有仿射独立后验支撑的形式，从而将问题简化为低维说服问题，并通过标准凹化方法求解。我们推导了适用于一般说服博弈的沟通容量价值的紧界：第(k+1)条消息带来的增益最多为k条消息可实现价值的2/(k-1)倍。最后，我们求解了一类信念阈值博弈，其中接收者在安全默认选项与多个风险行动之间进行选择，发送者从默认选项中获得零收益，从任何风险行动中获得相同的正收益，且仅当相应的后验概率超过阈值时才采取风险行动。我们刻画了最优粗糙信息结构，推导了关于先验和阈值的比较静态分析，并将分析扩展至风险行动具有异质性阈值和异质性发送者价值的情形。

10.1007/s00355-026-01666-6.abstract: We study the problem of aggregating individual preferences into a collective ranking without ties (a linear order) over a finite set of alternatives. We introduce a framework that constructs such rankings from supermajority rules, defined by a threshold parameter $$\alpha \in \left[ 1/2,1\right) $$ . For each $$\alpha $$ , we consider the binary relation of defeats from pairwise comparisons and apply two closure operations—the transitive closure and the Suzumura-consistent closure—to eliminate cycles. We then study the sets of linear orders that respect these relations; that is, linear orders that preserve all strict defeats while extending them to a complete ranking. To avoid the arbitrariness of fixing a single $$\alpha $$ , we take the intersection across all $$\alpha $$ . This yields two sets of linear orders: the T-order set (from the transitive closure) and the S-order set (from the Suzumura-consistent closure), both always nonempty, the former is a subset of the latter, and jointly capturing the full spectrum of supermajority rules. We show that this perspective unifies prominent methods: the Schulze method coincides with the T-order set, the Split Cycle method with the S-order set, and every outcome of the Ranked Pairs method lies within the S-order set. Moreover, every linear order in the S-order set satisfies the extended Condorcet criterion and the strong Pareto principle. Our results thus place these methods within a common supermajority-based framework and clarify their relationships.
10.1007/s00355-026-01666-6.abstract_zh: 本文研究如何将个体偏好聚合为有限备选方案集合上的无并列集体排序（线性序）。我们提出一个基于超多数规则构建此类排序的框架，该规则由阈值参数 $$\alpha \in \left[ 1/2,1\right) $$ 定义。对于每个 $$\alpha $$，我们考虑两两比较中产生的击败二元关系，并应用两种闭包运算——传递闭包和铃村一致闭包——以消除循环。随后，我们研究尊重这些关系的线性序集合；即，在保留所有严格击败关系的同时将其扩展为完整排序的线性序。为避免固定单一 $$\alpha $$ 的任意性，我们取所有 $$\alpha $$ 的交集。由此得到两组线性序：T-序集（来自传递闭包）和S-序集（来自铃村一致闭包），两者均非空，前者为后者的子集，且共同涵盖超多数规则的完整谱系。我们证明，这一视角统一了多种主流方法：Schulze方法等同于T-序集，Split Cycle方法等同于S-序集，而Ranked Pairs方法的每个结果均属于S-序集。此外，S-序集中的每个线性序均满足扩展的孔多塞准则与强帕累托原则。因此，我们的研究将这些方法置于统一的超多数规则框架下，并厘清了它们之间的关联。

10.1007/s00355-026-01667-5.abstract: Abstract We use laboratory experiments to analyze decentralized decision-making in one-sided matching markets. We find that subjects tend to make decisions in line with most theoretical models, as their offering and accepting decisions are mainly guided by the objective of improving upon the status quo. In consequence, markets move towards satisfying blocking pairs making the number of remaining blocking pairs diminish and the aggregate payoffs increase over time. Overall, the theoretical solutions of absorbing sets and stable matchings to the roommate problem are supported by the experimental results. However, not all matchings in an absorbing set have the same power of attraction in the experimental laboratory. The theoretical property of P-stability refines absorbing sets as predictors of final outcomes.
10.1007/s00355-026-01667-5.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们通过实验室实验分析单边匹配市场中的分散决策。研究发现，受试者的决策行为与多数理论模型一致，其提议与接受决策主要受改善现状这一目标驱动。因此，市场会逐步消除阻碍配对，使剩余阻碍配对数量随时间递减，总收益随之增长。总体而言，室友问题中吸收集与稳定匹配的理论解得到了实验结果的验证。然而，实验室中吸收集内的不同匹配并非具有同等吸引力。理论上的P稳定性性质可进一步将吸收集精炼为最终结果的预测指标。

<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    In March 2020, Luxembourg became the first country to make public transport free. We use this unique setting to evaluate the policy’s impact on transport emissions using a synthetic difference-in-differences framework. We use spatial emissions data to construct a panel of NUTS 2 regions in the EU from 2016 to 2022. We estimate an average reduction of 5.9% in road transport CO
                    <jats:sub>2</jats:sub>
                    and overall road transport GHG emissions, with larger effects for NO
                    <jats:sub>x</jats:sub>
                    . These findings are robust against confounding shifts in working from home and commuting patterns, vehicle fleet electrification, and the localized effects of the COVID-19 pandemic. Complementary event-study evidence from automatic traffic counters and air quality stations through 2023 corroborates our findings and suggests larger effects on weekends.
                  </jats:p>
10.1007/s10640-026-01090-5.abstract_zh: 2020年3月，卢森堡成为首个实现公共交通免费化的国家。我们利用这一独特政策场景，采用合成双重差分框架评估该政策对交通排放的影响。通过使用空间排放数据，我们构建了2016至2022年欧盟NUTS 2区域的面板数据。研究发现，该政策使道路交通二氧化碳及整体道路交通温室气体排放平均降低5.9%，对氮氧化物的减排效果更为显著。这些结论在控制居家办公与通勤模式变化、车辆电动化进程以及新冠疫情局部影响等混杂因素后依然稳健。基于2023年自动交通计数器与空气质量监测站的补充事件研究证据进一步佐证了我们的发现，并表明该政策在周末的减排效应更为显著。

<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Using BoardEx (2000–2017), we create a dynamic network connecting firms and board directors in the United States. We use the Environmental Protection Agency’s Toxics Release Inventory to measure environmental performance at the director and firm-level. We first examine how candidates’ environmental performance and networks affect their probability to be appointed to the board. We find that firms are likely to appoint influential directors with good environmental records and similar characteristics. We then show that directors’ past environmental records affect their current firm’s chemical releases. We address endogeneity concerns related to directors’ appointments and firms’ environmental performance by modeling directors’ network formation.</jats:p>

<jats:p>本文利用BoardEx数据库（2000–2017年），构建了一个连接美国企业与董事会成员的动态网络。我们采用美国环境保护署的有毒物质排放清单，从董事与企业两个层面衡量环境绩效。首先，我们考察候选人的环境绩效及其社会网络如何影响其被任命为董事会成员的概率。研究发现，企业倾向于任命具有良好环境记录且特征相似的影响力董事。其次，我们证明董事过往的环境记录会对其当前任职企业的化学品排放量产生影响。通过构建董事网络形成模型，我们解决了董事任命与企业环境绩效相关的内生性问题。</jats:p>

<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We estimate the impact of catastrophic wildfires on suicide. Leveraging an eight-year panel of county-by-month restricted-use mortality data for California, we find that catastrophic wildfires that destroy at least 2% of a county’s housing stock cause a 47% increase in the suicide rate (roughly nine excess suicides) in the six-month aftermath of an event. Exploring sources of heterogeneity, effects are largely driven by men. Mechanisms are explored and suggest that suicide results from the loss of property and direct loss of life, rather than smoke exposure. 10.1007/s10797-026-09976-2.abstract: Abstract We propose a novel measure of fiscal policy divergence based on public budget data. First, we quantify policy similarity across municipalities based on the cosine similarity of their budget allocations, showing strong correlations with geographic proximity and differences in socio-demographic characteristics. Next, we predict budget similarity out-of-sample using a flexible machine-learning model trained on pairwise differences in local characteristics, defining fiscal divergence as the municipality-year average absolute prediction error. In an empirical application to 8000 Italian municipalities (2000–2015), we show that electoral-cycle patterns are concentrated on the expenditure side of the budget: expenditure divergence is lower in pre-electoral years than in election years, whereas revenue divergence follows a different and less stable pattern.

<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>The digitalisation of tax payments is a growing policy priority in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in Africa, where revenue mobilisation remains a challenge. This study examines the impact of digital tax payments on compliance, leveraging a 2021 zero-cash-handling mandate in Eswatini. Using administrative tax data, we evaluate two key questions: (i) how voluntary adoption of digital payments affects compliance and (ii) the impact of mandating digital tax payments. We employ a staggered difference-in-differences (DiD) approach for voluntary adoption and a treatment-intensity DiD strategy to assess the mandate’s effects. Voluntary adoption significantly improves compliance, reducing late payments by 19–20% points (25–30 per cent reduction) and increasing payment accuracy (paying the tax liability in full) by 5.6% points (20 per cent), but for strictly digital payments only. Effects on tax amounts paid are less consistent, but the fully controlled broad-digital specification implies an increase of approximately 32%. The mandate, by contrast, eliminated cash payments and is associated with an approximately 17% increase in tax paid on average. While companies pay more taxes, they also worsen their payment accuracy, while individuals are more likely to pay their tax liabilities in full after adoption. These findings highlight distinct compliance patterns between voluntary adopters and those compelled by enforcement. The results underscore the importance of designing digital tax policies that account for taxpayer heterogeneity and behavioural responses to maximise compliance gains.</jats:p>
10.1007/s10797-026-09982-4.abstract_zh: 税收数字化是低收入和中等收入国家日益重要的政策优先事项，尤其是在收入动员仍面临挑战的非洲。本研究利用斯威士兰2021年实施的零现金处理指令，考察数字税务支付对合规行为的影响。通过行政税收数据，我们评估两个关键问题：（i）自愿采用数字支付如何影响合规性；（ii）强制推行数字税务支付的影响。我们采用交错双重差分法分析自愿采用行为，并运用处理强度双重差分策略评估强制指令的效果。自愿采用显著改善合规性：严格数字支付方式使逾期付款减少19-20个百分点（降幅25-30%），全额缴纳税款准确率提高5.6个百分点（增幅20%）。但对纳税金额的影响一致性较弱，全面控制的广义数字支付模型显示增幅约为32%。相比之下，强制指令完全消除了现金支付，平均纳税额增加约17%。企业虽缴纳更多税款，但支付准确率下降；而个人在采用后更可能全额缴纳税款。这些发现揭示了自愿采用者与强制执行者之间的差异化合规模式。研究结果强调，设计数字税务政策需考虑纳税人异质性和行为反应，以最大化合规收益。

10.1007/s10797-026-09988-y.abstract: Abstract Richard Musgrave et al.’s “Distribution of Tax Payments by Income Groups” (1951) provided the first postwar estimates of the distribution of the fiscal burden, concluding the tax system was not as progressive as statutory rates suggested. Drawing from original archival material, we reconstruct the intellectual context of Musgrave’s study, the methodological debates it gave rise to, and assess its legacy in public finance. The study’s legacy is examined through the rise of econometric estimation, applied general equilibrium modeling, and microdata-based approaches, as well as its influence on policy institutions in the USA and abroad. Despite major advances in data and modeling, we argue that key issues raised by Musgrave—particularly the definition of the income basis and the incidence of the corporate income tax—remain unresolved. The enduring lack of consensus on a uniquely best method highlights both the empirical and normative challenges at the heart of distributional analysis and explains the study’s continued relevance in contemporary debates on taxation and income inequality.
10.1007/s10797-026-09988-y.abstract_zh: 理查德·马斯格雷夫等人于1951年发表的《按收入群体划分的税收负担分配》提供了战后首批财政负担分配估算，结论表明税收制度并未如法定税率所示那般具有累进性。基于原始档案材料，我们重构了马斯格雷夫研究的学术背景、由此引发的方法论争论，并评估了其在公共财政领域的学术遗产。通过计量经济学估计、应用一般均衡建模、基于微观数据的方法的兴起，以及该研究对美国及海外政策机构的影响，我们审视了其学术遗产。尽管数据与建模技术取得重大进展，我们认为马斯格雷夫提出的关键问题——特别是收入基础的定义与企业所得税的归宿——仍未得到解决。对唯一最优方法长期缺乏共识，凸显了分配分析核心的经验与规范挑战，也解释了该研究在当代税收与收入不平等辩论中持续具有相关性的原因。

10.1007/s10887-026-09268-8.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    A central question in economics is how talent is allocated across elite professions and whether access is shaped by family ties or by open, standardized systems of selection. We study these questions in Western classical composition, a setting in which family background historically influenced entry through both inherited skill and inherited privilege, and where rich biographical records make it possible to trace selection over multiple centuries. Using data on more than 16,000 composers from 450 CE to the present, we identify dynastic ties from
                    <jats:italic>Grove Music Online</jats:italic>
                    and measure prominence by biographical entry length. Dynastic composers are 15–21 percent less prominent than non-dynasts, conditional on country and birth cohort, and this discount is driven by descendants: founders perform about as well as non-dynasts, while descendants perform significantly worse. Archival manuscript evidence from the
                    <jats:italic>Répertoire International des Sources Musicales</jats:italic>
                    yields similar results, suggesting that the pattern is not an artifact of editorial selection. In the twentieth century, however, the dynasty discount reverses, consistent with the transition from informal, family-based entry to more standardized selection through conservatory training. Consistent with this interpretation, dynasts are less likely to have formal training mentioned in their biographies, more likely to be described as advancing through family connections, and face a smaller dynasty discount in regions and periods with conservatories. Taken together, the findings suggest that expanded access to standardized training can weaken inherited advantage, reshape elite formation, and improve talent allocation, with broader implications for long-run innovation and economic performance.
                  </jats:p>
10.1007/s10887-026-09268-8.abstract_zh: 经济学的一个核心问题是，人才如何在精英职业中分配，以及这种分配是由家族关系还是开放、标准化的选拔体系所塑造。我们以西方古典音乐创作为背景研究这些问题，在这一领域中，家族背景历来通过继承的技能和继承的特权影响从业者的进入，而丰富的传记记录使我们能够追溯跨越多个世纪的选拔过程。利用从公元450年至今超过16,000名作曲家的数据，我们从《格罗夫音乐在线》中识别出家族纽带，并通过传记条目长度衡量其知名度。在控制国家和出生队列的条件下，家族作曲家比非家族作曲家的知名度低15%至21%，这一折扣主要由后代驱动：创始人的表现与非家族作曲家相当，而后代的表现则显著更差。来自《国际音乐文献资源总目》的档案手稿证据得出了类似结果，表明这一模式并非编辑选择的产物。然而，在20世纪，家族折扣发生了逆转，这与从非正式的、基于家族的进入方式向通过音乐学院培训进行更标准化选拔的转变相一致。与这一解释一致的是，家族作曲家在其传记中提及正式培训的可能性较低，更可能被描述为通过家族关系晋升，并且在有音乐学院存在的地区和时期面临较小的家族折扣。综合来看，这些发现表明，扩大标准化培训的获取渠道可以削弱继承优势，重塑精英形成，并改善人才分配，这对长期创新和经济表现具有更广泛的意义。

10.1007/s11127-026-01423-4.abstract: Abstract Few mafia traditions have endured as long or been shared as widely as the pizzo . The pizzo was and is a customary payment collected from clients by Italian mafias in exchange for private protection. The value of the pizzo was vulnerable to two sources of dissipation. First, excess competition for clients from other mafiosi . Second, evasive behavior from clients themselves. I argue that Italian mafias created de facto property rights to limit those losses. To limit competition, mafias in Italy defined client ownership via territorial delineation. To limit opportunism by clients, mafias tailored pizzo terms in proportion to clients’ latitude for opportunism. Historical evidence from New York mafias and Italy’s retailing and construction industries supports my thesis.
10.1007/s11127-026-01423-4.abstract_zh: 摘要 在众多黑手党传统中，鲜有像"保护费"（pizzo）这样历史悠久且广泛流传的习俗。保护费历来是意大利黑手党向客户收取的惯例性款项，作为提供私人保护的交换。保护费的价值面临两种损耗来源：其一，其他黑手党成员对客户的过度竞争；其二，客户自身的规避行为。本文认为，意大利黑手党通过创设事实上的产权制度来限制这些损失。为限制竞争，意大利黑手党通过地域划分界定客户所有权；为限制客户的投机行为，黑手党根据客户投机空间的大小量身定制保护费条款。来自纽约黑手党的历史证据以及意大利零售业和建筑业的数据均支持本文论点。

<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>How does district magnitude affect the quality of political representation? The Condorcet Jury Theorem (CJT) predicts that majority decisions improve with group size when members vote independently and are more likely than not to be correct. We test whether this aggregation mechanism applies to political decisions by examining whether larger legislative delegations better reflect constituent preferences. Nominal district magnitude often overstates the number of independent decision-makers because of party discipline. We therefore introduce effective district magnitude as a measure that more accurately captures the number of independently voting politicians within a constituency. Using 263 Swiss referenda (1992–2024) matched to parliamentary decisions, we find that the probability that a majority of a district’s delegation aligns with the preferences of its constituents increases with (effective) district magnitude, consistent with the CJT. The CJT aggregation mechanism closely predicts delegation-constituency congruence only for effective, not nominal, district magnitude. Our results provide empirical evidence that the CJT applies to representative democracies. They also show how party discipline limits the advantages of larger districts.</jats:p>
10.1007/s11127-026-01426-1.abstract_zh: 选区规模如何影响政治代表质量？孔多塞陪审团定理（CJT）预测，当成员独立投票且正确概率超过50%时，多数决策的质量随群体规模增大而提升。我们通过考察更大规模的立法代表团是否更能反映选民偏好，检验这一聚合机制是否适用于政治决策。由于政党纪律的存在，名义选区规模往往高估独立决策者的数量。为此，我们引入有效选区规模这一指标，以更准确地衡量选区内独立投票政治家的实际数量。通过将1992-2024年间263项瑞士公投结果与议会决策进行匹配，本研究发现：选区代表团多数意见与选民偏好一致的概率随（有效）选区规模扩大而上升，这与CJT的预测一致。CJT聚合机制仅在有效选区规模（而非名义选区规模）下能精确预测代表团与选民的偏好一致性。本研究为CJT适用于代议制民主提供了实证证据，同时揭示了政党纪律如何限制大选区优势。

10.1007/s11127-026-01427-0.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Ranked choice voting (RCV) is one of the fastest-growing electoral reforms in the United States, yet few scholars have considered the degree to which RCV could be improved with a different elimination procedure. This paper examines RCV with three different elimination procedures: plurality elimination, negative plurality elimination, and Borda elimination. After some analytical observations, we examine how often RCV with each of these procedures violates three criteria separately: the Condorcet winner criterion, independence of eliminated alternatives, and monotonicity using data from RCV elections in the United States as well as simulated data from the Impartial Culture condition with some trailing rankings removed. Our results show that while there are few differences in US election data, Borda elimination consistently outperforms the traditional plurality elimination by a statistically significant amount in our simulations. Nevertheless, the magnitude of those difference are often small.</jats:p>
10.1007/s11127-026-01427-0.abstract_zh: 排序选择投票（RCV）是美国发展最快的选举改革之一，但鲜有学者探讨通过不同淘汰程序改进RCV的可能性。本文研究了三种淘汰程序下的RCV：简单多数淘汰、反向多数淘汰和波达淘汰。在分析性观察之后，我们分别检验了每种程序下的RCV违反三项标准的频率：孔多塞胜者准则、淘汰替代方案独立性以及单调性。研究数据来自美国RCV选举的实际数据，以及移除部分尾部排名的“公正文化”条件模拟数据。结果表明，尽管在美国选举数据中差异较小，但在模拟中，波达淘汰在统计上显著优于传统简单多数淘汰。不过，这些差异的幅度通常较小。

<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We examine the effect of media freedom on public expenditure efficiency using a panel of 134 advanced and developing countries from 1994 to 2016. Our findings provide robust evidence that greater media freedom significantly enhances government spending efficiency. This effect is more pronounced in countries with higher levels of democracy, per capita income, human capital, internet access, and strong fiscal rules. Furthermore, we show that media freedom primarily influences efficiency through reduced corruption, increased transparency and accountability in the public sector, and stronger electoral competition. These results underscore the vital role of media freedom in fostering good governance and efficient public resource allocation, particularly in a context where press freedom is declining and fiscal constraints are tightening.</jats:p>
10.1007/s11127-026-01433-2.abstract_zh: 我们利用1994年至2016年间134个发达与发展中国家的面板数据，考察了媒体自由对公共支出效率的影响。研究结果提供了稳健证据，表明更高的媒体自由显著提升了政府支出效率。这一效应在民主水平、人均收入、人力资本、互联网接入程度较高以及财政规则严格的国家更为显著。此外，我们证明媒体自由主要通过减少腐败、提升公共部门透明度与问责制、以及增强选举竞争来影响效率。这些结果凸显了媒体自由在促进善治与公共资源高效配置中的关键作用，尤其是在新闻自由持续衰退、财政约束日益收紧的背景下。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113105.abstract: Mean grocery spending by Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) households peaks at benefit receipt and declines thereafter. Using novel shopping receipt data with observed trip-level tender information across a range of retailers, store formats, and shopping channels, we examine whether households partially smooth grocery spending over the benefit cycle through substitution across payment sources and whether the effects of benefit receipt vary across the grocery spending distribution. We find evidence of smoothing at the extensive margin through modest increases in non-SNAP-funded shopping trips. Distributional analyses reveal more pronounced spending cycles at higher grocery spending quantiles along with suggestive evidence of weaker substitution toward non-SNAP-funded payment sources.

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113113.abstract: Short-term reversal appears to have weakened in international equity markets because standard measures mix firm-specific and industry-wide returns. When evaluated relative to industry peers, the reversal persists. Using data from 64 countries, the conventional strategy delivers negligible returns, whereas an industry-adjusted strategy earns 0.53% per month with a Sharpe ratio of 0.74. The effect reflects the reversal of firm-specific shocks masked by persistent industry components. A regret-based signal captures the same industry-relative variation, adding no incremental return. Reversal did not disappear; it was mismeasured.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113113.abstract_zh: 短期反转效应在国际股票市场中似乎有所减弱，这是因为标准指标混淆了公司特定回报与行业整体回报。当以行业同行作为基准进行评估时，反转效应依然存在。基于64个国家的数据，传统策略带来的回报微乎其微，而经行业调整后的策略每月可获得0.53%的收益，夏普比率为0.74。这一效应反映了被持续性行业成分掩盖的公司特定冲击的反转。基于遗憾的信号捕捉到了相同的行业相对变化，但并未带来额外回报。反转效应并未消失，而是被错误衡量了。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113121.abstract: Researchers often include unit-specific (e.g., state-specific) trends in difference-in-differences (DiD) specifications. Under standard DiD assumptions, these specifications still yield consistent estimates of dynamic treatment effects (i.e., separate effects for each post-treatment time period) but the pooled post-treatment coefficient is not consistent for the average treatment effect. This single coefficient is a weighted average of the dynamic coefficients, but some weights are often negative. This occurs even without a staggered rollout of treatment. Instead of estimating a pooled coefficient, researchers can estimate the average treatment effect as the mean of the dynamic effects. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113121.abstract_zh: 研究者常在双重差分（DiD）设定中纳入单位特定（如州特定）趋势。在标准DiD假设下，这些设定仍能得出动态处理效应（即每个处理后期对应的独立效应）的一致估计，但合并处理后期系数并非平均处理效应的一致估计量。该单一系数是动态系数的加权平均值，但部分权重常为负值——即便在非交错式处理推行情况下亦如此。研究者可通过计算动态效应均值来估计平均处理效应，而非采用合并系数。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113124.abstract: This note studies a pure fertility-timing reform in a three-period OLG model. Holding completed fertility fixed, shifting births from middle age to youth raises the balanced-growth factor if N > 1 , lowers it if N < 1 , and leaves it unchanged if N = 1 . The same positive balanced-growth root λ determines cohort growth, the cohort ratio, and the steady-state PAYG support ratio λ 2 + λ . Thus the long-run support-ratio effect, and under an exogenous wage the pension-benefit effect, are positive in growing populations and negative in shrinking ones.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113124.abstract_zh: 本文在三期OLG模型中研究了一项纯粹的生育时机改革。在保持终身生育率不变的前提下，将生育行为从中年阶段提前至青年阶段，若N>1则会提高平衡增长因子，若N<1则会降低该因子，若N=1则保持不变。相同的正平衡增长根λ决定了队列增长、队列比率以及稳态现收现付制抚养比λ²+λ。因此，长期抚养比效应以及在外生工资条件下的养老金待遇效应，在人口增长型社会中为正，在人口收缩型社会中为负。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113125.abstract: Does proximity to the natal family protect women against intimate partner violence (IPV)? Leveraging Uzbekistan as a natural laboratory and an original list experiment among 835 married women, we find that women near their parents show a list-experiment prevalence estimate of 9.4% and no detectable reporting gap, whereas those far from their parents report only 8.5% in direct surveys, against a list-experiment estimate of 36.2%. Standard surveys do not merely undercount these victims — they invert the ranking of risk, making the most vulnerable women appear the safest. A parallel attitude experiment supports neither preference falsification nor cultural selection.
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113125.abstract_zh: 靠近原生家庭能否保护女性免受亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）侵害？以乌兹别克斯坦为自然实验场，通过对835名已婚女性开展原始列表实验，我们发现：与父母同住的女性在列表实验中遭受暴力的估计比例为9.4%，且未发现可检测的报告偏差；而远离父母的女性在直接调查中仅报告8.5%的暴力发生率，但列表实验估计值却高达36.2%。传统调查不仅低估了这些受害者的数量——更彻底颠倒了风险排序，使最脆弱的女性反而显得最安全。平行态度实验的结果既不支持偏好伪装假说，也不支持文化选择假说。

10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113144.abstract: A representative chooses policy on behalf of a group with heterogeneous preferences. Group members differ in voice (their salience to the representative). The representative maximizes perceived welfare based on a voice-weighted signal. The resulting policy distortion is proportional to the covariance between voice and preferences. When agents choose voice effort endogenously, equilibrium voice is U-shaped (quadratic in distance between preferences and policy). The equilibrium distortion is approximately one-third of a standard deviation times the skewness coefficient. It is non-zero only when the preference distribution is skewed. Combining the voice-weighted signal with a random sample can reduce the expected welfare loss. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
10.1016/j.econlet.2026.113144.abstract_zh: 一位代表代表一个偏好异质性的群体制定政策。群体成员在话语权（即其对代表的重要性）上存在差异。代表基于话语权加权的信号最大化感知福利。由此产生的政策扭曲与话语权和偏好之间的协方差成正比。当代理人内生地选择话语努力时，均衡话语呈U形（即偏好与政策距离的二次函数）。均衡扭曲约为标准差的三分之一乘以偏度系数。只有当偏好分布呈偏态时，该扭曲才非零。将话语权加权信号与随机样本相结合，可以减少预期福利损失。

10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101773.abstract: This paper examines how acute pollution exposure in historical London (1892–1919) affected child health. I proxy acute, extreme pollution exposure using daily data on fog events, which reflect meteorological conditions where pollution emitted in the city was not dispersed across space leading to a sharp spike in pollution. I also use rich individual-level data on child health drawn from the Queen Charlotte Hospital, a maternity hospital, and the Foundling Hospital, an orphanage. I find no effect of pollution exposure at birth on birth or growth outcomes or on upper respiratory morbidity. However, exposure on the day of birth had persistent effects on health, increasing mortality risk in childhood and adolescence from respiratory diseases and raising incidence, prevalence and sickness duration of influenza and measles. There was no persistent effect of in utero and postnatal pollution exposures. These mixed results show that extreme pollution at birth had lasting impacts on specific, but also limited, dimensions of child health.
10.1016/j.eeh.2026.101773.abstract_zh: 本文研究了历史时期伦敦（1892-1919年）急性污染暴露对儿童健康的影响。我利用每日雾天事件数据作为急性极端污染暴露的代理变量——这些雾天反映了城市排放的污染物因无法扩散而导致污染浓度急剧飙升的气象条件。同时，我采用来自夏洛特女王医院（一家妇产医院）和弃婴医院（一家孤儿院）的丰富个体层面儿童健康数据。研究发现，出生时的污染暴露对出生结局、生长发育指标或上呼吸道疾病发病率无显著影响。然而，出生当日的污染暴露对健康产生了持续性影响：它增加了儿童期及青少年期因呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡风险，并提高了流感与麻疹的发病率、患病率及病程持续时间。宫内暴露和产后暴露则未发现持续性影响。这些混合结果表明，出生时的极端污染暴露对儿童健康的特定维度（但范围有限）产生了持久影响。
