10.1080/00036846.2026.2691243.abstract: This study explores the relationship between green factory certification and corporate cash holdings. The results show that certified firms tend to increase their cash holdings. Further analyses reveal that green factory certification promotes green investment by firms, thereby increasing their cash holdings. In addition, the positive association between green factory certification and cash holdings is more pronounced among firms with weaker green innovation foundations and greater financing constraints, jointly supporting the precautionary motive for cash holdings. Moreover, this association is concentrated in firms operating in poor information environments, where the signalling benefits of certification are not effectively transmitted to stakeholders, thereby prompting cash holdings. Our analysis of the economic consequences reveals that the increased cash holdings from certification damage firm value. This negative effect manifests primarily in poor information environments. Overall, the study indicates that in poor information environments, green factory policies drive firms to hoard cash on the basis of the precautionary motive, thereby harming firm value. These findings offer vital insights for effectively implementing certification-related environmental policies, and highlight the need to improve information environments alongside advancing green factory initiatives to mitigate the potentially negative effects of such policies.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2691243.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了绿色工厂认证与企业现金持有之间的关系。结果表明，获得认证的企业倾向于增加现金持有量。进一步分析发现，绿色工厂认证通过促进企业绿色投资，进而提高了其现金持有水平。此外，在绿色创新基础较弱和融资约束较大的企业中，绿色工厂认证与现金持有之间的正向关联更为显著，这共同支持了现金持有的预防性动机。同时，这种关联集中于信息环境较差的企业，在这些企业中，认证的信号传递效应未能有效传达给利益相关者，从而促使企业增加现金持有。对经济后果的分析显示，认证带来的现金持有增加损害了企业价值，且这一负面效应主要出现在信息环境较差的企业中。总体而言，研究表明，在信息环境较差的背景下，绿色工厂政策促使企业基于预防性动机囤积现金，进而损害企业价值。这些发现为有效实施认证相关的环境政策提供了重要启示，并强调在推进绿色工厂建设的同时，需要改善信息环境，以缓解此类政策可能带来的负面影响。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2691243.title: When green signals encounter information smog: green factory certification and corporate cash holdings
10.1080/00036846.2026.2691243.title_zh: 当绿色信号遭遇信息雾霾：绿色工厂认证与企业现金持有

10.1080/00036846.2026.2692007.abstract: This paper proposes a new adaptive Markov regime-switching copula (A-MRS-Copula) model based on the realized covariance measures to enhance the prediction accuracy of portfolio risk of China’ s new energy and financial markets. More specifically, the model relaxes the static transition probability condition of the traditional MRS-Copula model, allowing the copula parameters to vary adaptively based on high-frequency dependence information between assets. Furthermore, given the leverage effect prevalent in financial markets, we employ realized semicovariances as proxies for intraday dependencies in our modelling process. This approach improves the ability of the model to capture asset leverage effect and accurately depict dynamic dependence. Empirical results show that the A-MRS-Copula model exhibits statistically significant improvement in forecasting portfolio risk in new energy markets and other markets. Finally, robustness tests confirm that the new model outperforms the MRS-Copula model in terms of different data, copula function settings, prediction evaluation methods and rolling window.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692007.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于已实现协方差测度的新型自适应马尔可夫机制转换Copula（A-MRS-Copula）模型，旨在提升中国新能源与金融市场投资组合风险的预测精度。具体而言，该模型放宽了传统MRS-Copula模型的静态转移概率条件，允许Copula参数根据资产间高频依赖信息进行自适应调整。此外，针对金融市场普遍存在的杠杆效应，我们在建模过程中采用已实现半协方差作为日内依赖关系的代理变量，从而增强模型捕捉资产杠杆效应与准确刻画动态依赖结构的能力。实证结果表明，A-MRS-Copula模型在新能源市场与其他市场的投资组合风险预测中具有统计显著的改进效果。最后，稳健性检验证实，该新模型在不同数据、Copula函数设定、预测评估方法及滚动窗口条件下均优于MRS-Copula模型。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692007.title: Can realized covariance measure improve VaR forecasting of China’s new energy and financial markets? ——Evidence from the A-MRS-Copula model
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692007.title_zh: 实现协方差能否改进中国新能源与金融市场的VaR预测？——来自A-MRS-Copula模型的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2692010.abstract: Investigating the dynamic linkage between international crude oil prices and stock markets is crucial for mitigating cross-market systemic risks. Based on weekly data from 11 January 2002, to 13 October 2023, this paper develops an integrated analytical framework combining wavelet decomposition, DCC-GARCH, and quantile time-frequency spillover methods to systematically examine the oil – stock nexus. The main findings are as follows: First, the correlation between oil prices and stock returns exhibits significant frequency dependence. In the short term, the correlation is positive, whereas it turns negative in the long term. Second, the relationship between oil price changes and stock markets varies with the underlying drivers of oil price shocks. Demand-driven oil price increases are primarily associated with positive correlations, whereas supply-driven increases are more often associated with negative correlations. Third, VIX is positively associated with market co-movement, while GPR shows the opposite effect. Fourth, the correlation between oil prices and U.S. stocks is stronger than that between oil prices and Chinese stocks, possibly reflecting China’s policy interventions and differences in market structure. Moreover, the U.S. stock market is the primary source of global risk spillovers, while the Chinese stock market is primarily a net receiver of risk.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692010.abstract_zh: 探究国际原油价格与股票市场之间的动态关联对于缓解跨市场系统性风险至关重要。基于2002年1月11日至2023年10月13日的周度数据，本文构建了融合小波分解、DCC-GARCH模型及分位数时频溢出方法的综合分析框架，系统考察了石油-股票市场的关联机制。主要发现如下：第一，油价与股票收益的相关性呈现显著频率依赖性。短期表现为正相关，而长期则转为负相关。第二，油价变动与股票市场的关系随油价冲击的驱动因素不同而存在差异。需求驱动的油价上涨主要伴随正相关，而供给驱动的油价上涨则更多呈现负相关。第三，VIX指数与市场联动性呈正相关，而GPR指数则呈现相反效应。第四，油价与美国股市的相关性强于其与中国股市的相关性，这或可归因于中国的政策干预及市场结构差异。此外，美国股市是全球风险溢出的主要来源，而中国股市则主要扮演风险净接收者的角色。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692010.title: Dynamic linkage and risk transmission mechanisms between crude oil and China – U.S. stock markets: a multi-scale perspective
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692010.title_zh: 原油与中美股市的动态联动及风险传导机制：多尺度视角

10.1080/00036846.2026.2692030.abstract: This study develops a multi-layer local Gaussian correlation network approach to examine crisis-specific commodity – inflation linkages across the G7 and E7 economies. The empirical results show that mean inflation correlations between the E7 and G7 are lower than within-group correlations, suggesting differences in inflation co-movements between advanced and emerging economies. Energy – inflation linkages are generally stronger than both cross-country inflation linkages and agricultural commodity – inflation associations, with all correlations rising noticeably during major global crises. These patterns also display clear quantile heterogeneity. At the low inflation quantile, commodity – inflation linkages are relatively broad-based across the G7 and E7 economies, whereas they become denser and more concentrated at higher inflation quantiles. Major crises also reshape the network structure in distinct ways. The 2008 crisis is marked by the central role of agricultural commodities, the COVID-19 pandemic by a more balanced energy – agriculture pattern, and the 2022 Russia – Ukraine war by the prominence of the Russia – natural gas linkage. Overall, the results suggest that commodity – inflation linkages are shaped jointly by inflation regimes, commodity characteristics, and crisis-specific structural shocks. The findings also provide useful implications for policymakers in designing tailored response strategies that take account of quantile-dependent risks and event-driven vulnerabilities in global commodity markets.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692030.abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一种多层局部高斯相关网络方法，以考察G7与E7经济体中危机特定的大宗商品与通胀之间的关联。实证结果表明，E7与G7之间的平均通胀相关性低于组内相关性，这表明发达经济体与新兴经济体在通胀联动方面存在差异。能源与通胀的关联普遍强于跨国通胀关联以及农产品与通胀的关联，且所有相关性在全球重大危机期间均显著上升。这些模式还呈现出明显的分位数异质性。在低通胀分位数下，大宗商品与通胀的关联在G7与E7经济体中相对广泛，而在高通胀分位数下，这些关联变得更加密集和集中。重大危机也以不同方式重塑了网络结构。2008年危机以农产品为核心角色为特征，新冠疫情则表现为更为平衡的能源-农产品模式，而2022年俄乌战争则凸显了俄罗斯-天然气关联的重要性。总体而言，结果表明大宗商品与通胀的关联由通胀机制、大宗商品特性以及危机特定的结构性冲击共同塑造。这些发现也为政策制定者设计考虑分位数依赖风险与全球大宗商品市场事件驱动脆弱性的定制化应对策略提供了有益启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692030.title: International transmission of inflation in the commodity market during crises: evidence based on a multi-layer local Gaussian correlation network
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692030.title_zh: 危机期间商品市场通胀的国际传导：基于多层局部高斯相关网络的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2692646.title: How education matches occupation: modelling the structure of skill-job alignment
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692646.title_zh: 教育如何匹配职业：技能-职位匹配结构的建模

10.1080/00036846.2026.2692647.abstract: This paper takes China’s Yangtze River Delta region as a case study. Building upon Ellison, Gläeser, and Kerr (2007), it constructs an industrial agglomeration index and employs a more scientifically rigorous spatial econometric methodology to systematically examine the impact of synergistic agglomeration between manufacturing and business services on two-way foreign direct investment (FDI), along with its heterogeneity. Research confirms that, overall, the separate agglomeration of manufacturing and productive services significantly inhibits outward foreign direct investment (OFDI), whereas synergistic agglomeration exerts a positive effect on OFDI, with no significant impact on inward foreign direct investment (IFDI). The synergistic agglomeration of manufacturing and productive services primarily influences OFDI through the degree of government intervention and the sophistication of the labour market. The impact of manufacturing and productive services agglomeration on bilateral FDI exhibits significant heterogeneity across geographical location, transport conditions, urban political status, historical openness, and clan culture. By examining the relationship between manufacturing and productive services agglomeration and two-way FDI, this study bridges the interaction between industrial agglomeration and urban openness, offering insights for economic policy formulation at the meso-level.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692647.abstract_zh: 本文以中国长三角地区为案例，在Ellison、Gläeser与Kerr（2007）研究基础上构建产业集聚指数，并采用更具科学严谨性的空间计量方法，系统考察制造业与商务服务业协同集聚对双向外商直接投资（FDI）的影响及其异质性。研究证实：整体而言，制造业与生产性服务业的单独集聚显著抑制对外直接投资（OFDI），而协同集聚则对OFDI产生正向促进作用，但对内向直接投资（IFDI）无显著影响。制造业与生产性服务业的协同集聚主要通过政府干预程度与劳动力市场成熟度影响OFDI。制造业与生产性服务业集聚对双向FDI的影响在地理区位、交通条件、城市政治地位、历史开放度及宗族文化层面呈现显著异质性。通过剖析制造业与生产性服务业集聚同双向FDI的关系，本研究架起了产业集聚与城市开放性的互动桥梁，为中观层面经济政策制定提供启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692647.title: A study on the impact of manufacturing and productive services agglomeration on two-way foreign direct investment: based on spatial econometric models
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692647.title_zh: 制造业与生产性服务业集聚对双向外商直接投资的影响研究：基于空间计量模型

10.1080/00036846.2026.2692648.title: Digital government, policy synergy, and export resilience of enterprises
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692648.title_zh: 数字政府、政策协同与企业出口韧性

10.1080/00036846.2026.2692649.abstract: This study provides city-level causal evidence on the economic effects of data trading infrastructure. Treating the staggered establishment of data trading platforms (DTPs) across Chinese cities between 2014 and 2023 as a quasi-natural experiment, we estimate a multi-period difference-in-differences model using a balanced panel of 298 prefecture-level cities from 2000 to 2023. The baseline estimate indicates that DTP establishment increases night-time light intensity – our primary proxy for urban economic vitality – by 3.610 units, robust across all sensitivity specifications. Event-study analysis validates parallel trends, and a randomization-inference placebo test yields an empirical p-value below 0.001. A Bartik instrumental variable strategy produces a 2SLS estimate of 9.421 (p < 0.05), which we interpret as complementary given a moderately relevant first stage (F = 2.71). Mechanism tests reveal that DTPs promote innovation and digital economy employment. A dose–response analysis shows that each additional year of platform operation increases vitality by 0.876 units on average, but the marginal effect turns negative in cities with below-median internet penetration. These findings establish that DTPs can serve as effective institutional vehicles for data factor marketization, but their economic returns are contingent on complementary digital infrastructure investments.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692649.abstract_zh: 本研究提供了关于数据交易基础设施经济效应的城市级因果证据。将2014年至2023年间中国各城市数据交易平台（DTPs）的错时设立视为准自然实验，利用2000年至2023年298个地级市的平衡面板数据，估计了多期双重差分模型。基准估计表明，DTP设立使夜间灯光强度（我们衡量城市经济活力的主要代理变量）增加3.610个单位，该结果在所有敏感性检验中均保持稳健。事件研究分析验证了平行趋势假设，随机化推断安慰剂检验得到的经验p值低于0.001。巴蒂克工具变量策略产生的两阶段最小二乘估计值为9.421（p < 0.05），鉴于第一阶段中度相关（F = 2.71），我们将其视为互补性证据。机制检验揭示，DTP促进了创新和数字经济就业。剂量-反应分析显示，平台每多运营一年，经济活力平均增加0.876个单位，但在互联网普及率低于中位数的城市，边际效应转为负值。这些发现表明，DTP可作为数据要素市场化的有效制度载体，但其经济回报依赖于互补性数字基础设施投资。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692649.title: Data trading platforms and urban economic vitality: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692649.title_zh: 数据交易平台与城市经济活力：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2692650.title_zh: 金融科技如何促进新质生产力的发展：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2692651.abstract_zh: 一、气候变化正从根本上重塑人类生活的物理基础，极端高温事件的频率、强度和持续时间显著增加（Calvin等...）
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692651.title: The impact of extreme heat on rural household development capability: evidence from the China Health and Nutrition Survey
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692651.title_zh: 极端高温对农村家庭发展能力的影响：基于中国健康与营养调查的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2692652.abstract: Integrated urban–rural development (IURD) is an essential requirement for China’s modernization. As a key driver of IURD, urban renewal plays a vital role; therefore, assessing its impact on this process is of great significance. Using panel data from 274 prefecture-level and above cities in China covering 2007–2022, we construct composite indices via the entropy method and employ a two-way fixed-effects model to examine how urban renewal affects IURD. The findings indicate that (1) Urban renewal significantly promotes IURD, a result that remains robust across a battery of robustness checks. (2) The impact of urban renewal on IURD varies across geographic accessibility, urban hierarchy and city size. (3) Urban renewal not only directly influences IURD but also exerts indirect effects by facilitating population mobility and curbing urban sprawl. This study supplements theoretical mechanisms and empirical evidence regarding the impact of urban renewal on IURD, providing policy implications for advancing IURD.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692652.abstract_zh: 城乡融合发展是中国式现代化的必然要求。城市更新作为城乡融合发展的关键驱动力，评估其对这一进程的影响具有重要意义。基于2007—2022年中国274个地级及以上城市的面板数据，采用熵值法构建综合指数，并运用双向固定效应模型考察城市更新对城乡融合发展的影响。研究发现：（1）城市更新显著促进城乡融合发展，该结果在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。（2）城市更新对城乡融合发展的影响因地理可达性、城市等级和城市规模而异。（3）城市更新不仅直接影响城乡融合发展，还通过促进人口流动和抑制城市蔓延产生间接效应。本研究补充了城市更新影响城乡融合发展的理论机制与实证证据，为推进城乡融合发展提供了政策启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692652.title: From urban renewal to urban–rural renewal: exploring new paths for integrated urban–rural development in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2692652.title_zh: 从城市更新到城乡更新：探索中国城乡融合发展的新路径

10.1080/00036846.2026.2693164.abstract: Global trade has shifted from the traditional exchange of finished goods to the widespread integration of global value chains (GVCs). The expansion of GVCs has important implications for both developed and developing economies. We construct a framework to explain how GVC participation affects GDP per capita and how these effects differ across countries at different income levels by analysing types of GVC activities and the mediating role of total factor productivity (TFP). We use advanced econometric methods, including fixed-effects models, two-stage least squares estimators, system generalized method of moments estimators, and fixed-effects quantile regression, to provide detailed insights into the differential effects of GVC participation. Our results show that the impact of GVC participation on economic growth varies by income level. For low-income countries, backward GVC participation significantly affects GDP per capita, while forward GVC participation has significant effects only for upper-middle- and high-income countries. We also find that TFP mediates the impact of GVC participation on GDP per capita.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2693164.abstract_zh: 全球贸易已从传统的成品交换转向全球价值链（GVC）的广泛整合。全球价值链的扩张对发达经济体和发展中经济体均具有重要影响。我们构建了一个分析框架，通过考察全球价值链活动的类型以及全要素生产率（TFP）的中介作用，阐释全球价值链参与如何影响人均GDP，以及这种影响在不同收入水平国家间的差异。我们采用先进的计量经济学方法，包括固定效应模型、两阶段最小二乘估计量、系统广义矩估计量以及固定效应分位数回归，以深入揭示全球价值链参与效应的异质性。研究结果表明，全球价值链参与对经济增长的影响因收入水平而异。对于低收入国家，后向全球价值链参与对人均GDP具有显著影响；而前向全球价值链参与仅对中高收入和高收入国家产生显著效应。我们还发现，全要素生产率在全球价值链参与对人均GDP的影响中发挥中介作用。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2693164.title: How do countries benefit from participating in the global value chain? A comprehensive panel analysis of heterogeneity in GVC impacts
10.1080/00036846.2026.2693164.title_zh: 各国如何从参与全球价值链中获益？GVC影响异质性的综合面板分析

10.1080/00036846.2026.2694556.title: The price of lock-in: early termination fees versus monthly fees in telecom bundles
10.1080/00036846.2026.2694556.title_zh: 锁定成本：电信套餐中的提前解约费与月费

10.1080/00036846.2026.2694560.abstract: This study examines the impact of China’s Long-Term Care Insurance (LTCI) policy on women’s entrepreneurship. Using data from the China Family Panel Studies over 2012–2020, we implement a staggered difference-in-differences design to estimate the causal effect of LTCI pilot implementation on women’s entrepreneurship. We find that LTCI significantly increases women’s likelihood of becoming entrepreneurs, with larger effects among households with lower wealth and those in which older family members are in poorer health. lowering young women’s perceived exposure to future risks and easing the caregiving demands they face within the family, thereby strengthening both their willingness and ability to engage in entrepreneurial activity. We further explore spillover effects on intrahousehold allocation and intergenerational outcomes. LTCI not only promotes women’s entrepreneurship but also narrows gender income disparities and improves children’s cognitive and non-cognitive development. Overall, our findings provide policy-relevant evidence for strengthening long-term care institutions and for designing complementary policies that advance women’s economic participation and gender equality.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2694560.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国长期护理保险政策对女性创业的影响。基于2012-2020年中国家庭追踪调查数据，我们采用交错双重差分法估计长期护理保险试点实施对女性创业的因果效应。研究发现，长期护理保险显著提升了女性成为创业者的概率，这一效应在低财富家庭及家中老年成员健康状况较差的群体中更为显著。该政策通过降低年轻女性对未来风险的感知暴露度、缓解其家庭照护负担，从而增强了她们参与创业活动的意愿与能力。我们进一步探讨了该政策对家庭内部资源配置及代际结果的溢出效应：长期护理保险不仅促进了女性创业，还缩小了性别收入差距，并改善了子女的认知与非认知能力发展。总体而言，本研究为完善长期照护制度、设计促进女性经济参与及性别平等的配套政策提供了具有政策参考价值的实证依据。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2694560.title: Hidden support: long-term care insurance and women’s entrepreneurship
10.1080/00036846.2026.2694560.title_zh: 隐性支持：长期护理保险与女性创业

10.1080/00036846.2026.2694566.abstract: This paper examines how Philippine households organize their energy use in response to weather and price shocks. It develops a dual-margin framework that distinguishes between the extensive margin of energy portfolio adoption and the intensive margin of energy share allocation. The extensive margin is estimated using a multinomial probit model, while the intensive margin is estimated using a fractional multinomial logit model. Results show that mixed portfolios remain the dominant form of household energy use across income levels, locations, and electricity supply conditions. Weather shocks increase the need for energy services, but affordability and supply constraints determine whether households remain anchored in modern energy or shift towards greater reliance on traditional sources. Electricity serves as a modern energy anchor for high-income, urban, and supply-unconstrained households, while solid fuels serve as a fallback for low-income, rural, and supply-constrained households. The findings suggest that household energy transitions should not be understood as a simple movement up the energy ladder, but rather as adjustments to energy portfolios in response to weather shocks and affordability and supply reliability constraints. Thus, policies should focus on reliable, modern energy access, protection of affordability during weather- and price-related shocks, and differentiated support for vulnerable households.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2694566.abstract_zh: 本文考察了菲律宾家庭如何应对天气与价格冲击来组织其能源使用。研究构建了一个双边际分析框架，区分了能源组合采用的广延边际与能源份额分配的集约边际。广延边际采用多项概率模型进行估计，集约边际则采用分数多项逻辑模型进行估计。结果表明，混合能源组合仍是不同收入水平、地理位置和电力供应条件下家庭能源使用的主导形式。天气冲击增加了能源服务需求，但可负担性与供应约束决定了家庭是继续依赖现代能源，还是转向更多使用传统能源。电力作为高收入、城市及无供应约束家庭的现代能源锚点，而固体燃料则成为低收入、农村及供应受限家庭的备用选择。研究结论表明，家庭能源转型不应被简单理解为沿能源阶梯的线性攀升，而是家庭根据天气冲击、可负担性与供应可靠性约束对能源组合进行的动态调整。因此，政策应聚焦于可靠的现代能源接入、在天气与价格相关冲击期间保障可负担性，并对脆弱家庭提供差异化支持。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2694566.title: Beyond the energy ladder: household energy portfolios under weather and price shocks in the Philippines
10.1080/00036846.2026.2694566.title_zh: 超越能源阶梯：菲律宾天气与价格冲击下的家庭能源组合

10.1080/00036846.2026.2695407.abstract: This study examines how negative performance feedback is associated with real earnings management (REM) and how firm-level market power conditions that relationship. Building on the behavioural theory of the firm and threat-rigidity theory, we argue that performance shortfalls direct organizational attention towards responses that are immediate, proximate, and risk-acceptable. REM fits this behavioural profile because it can alter reported outcomes through real operating decisions while remaining less directly visible than many accounting choices or illegal actions. Using 23,629 firm-year observations for publicly listed U.S. firms from 1992 to 2018, we find that larger performance shortfalls are associated with higher REM. We also find that this relationship weakens as market power increases. Additional analyses support a cautious interpretation: the evidence is more consistent with shortfall-driven opportunistic REM than with a purely strategic or efficiency-enhancing explanation, although standard REM proxies do not directly identify managerial intent. The findings contribute to applied research on firm behaviour under performance pressure by showing that market power can alter the way firms respond to adverse feedback through real operating decisions.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695407.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了负面绩效反馈如何影响真实盈余管理（REM），以及企业层面的市场势力如何调节这一关系。基于企业行为理论与威胁-刚性理论，我们提出：绩效缺口会将组织注意力导向即时、直接且风险可接受的应对措施。真实盈余管理符合这一行为特征——它通过实际经营决策改变报告业绩，同时相较于诸多会计选择或违法行为具有更低的直接可见性。基于1992年至2018年间美国上市公司23,629个公司-年度观测值，本研究发现：绩效缺口越大，真实盈余管理程度越高；市场势力越强，该正向关联越弱。进一步分析支持审慎解读：证据更倾向于表明绩效缺口驱动机会主义型真实盈余管理，而非纯粹战略或效率提升型解释——尽管标准真实盈余管理代理变量无法直接识别管理层意图。本研究通过揭示市场势力如何改变企业通过实际经营决策应对负面反馈的方式，为绩效压力下企业行为的应用研究提供了新见解。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695407.title: The inconvenient truth of problemistic search: real earnings management
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695407.title_zh: 问题搜索的不便真相：真实盈余管理

10.1080/00036846.2026.2695408.abstract: We study whether economic narratives extracted from financial news predict crude oil returns. Using 1.22 million articles from The Wall Street Journal spanning from 1986 to 2022, we apply seeded latent Dirichlet allocation (sLDA) to measure 14 time-varying narrative topics. The empirical results show that narrative topics, including war narratives, outperform traditional predictive models in forecasting crude oil returns. The results remain robust after controlling for standard macroeconomic variables, financial market variables, and uncertainty measures. In addition, we identify the economic mechanisms through which narrative economics contributes to crude oil predictability. Specifically, narrative topics operate by affecting real economic activity, uncertainty, and crude oil supply shocks.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695408.abstract_zh: 本文研究从财经新闻中提取的经济叙事是否能够预测原油收益。基于1986年至2022年间《华尔街日报》的122万篇文章，我们采用种子潜在狄利克雷分配（sLDA）方法，测度了14个时变叙事主题。实证结果表明，包括战争叙事在内的叙事主题在预测原油收益方面优于传统预测模型。在控制标准宏观经济变量、金融市场变量及不确定性指标后，该结果依然稳健。此外，我们识别了叙事经济学对原油可预测性产生影响的经济机制：具体而言，叙事主题通过影响实际经济活动、不确定性及原油供给冲击发挥作用。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695408.title: Narrative topics and oil

10.1080/00036846.2026.2695410.abstract: Using longitudinal Young Lives data from Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, India, we examine the effect of noncognitive skills on cognitive abilities at the onset of adolescence and later adolescence, and address endogeneity by using siblings’ noncognitive traits and primary caregiver well-being as imperfectly excluded instruments for the focal child’s noncognitive abilities. Our results suggest that agency improves mathematical ability at the onset of adolescence, indicating a sensitive period of development. No similar effect on language abilities at the same stage indicates domain-specificity of agency effects. Self-efficacy has no effect on cognitive outcomes at either stage. We are unable to reject the null that agency and self-efficacy have no effect on cognitive abilities in later adolescence. Agency effects are concentrated among boys, consistent with theories of gender-specific socialization.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695410.abstract_zh: 利用印度安得拉邦和特伦甘纳邦的纵向青年数据，我们考察了非认知技能对青春期初期及后期认知能力的影响，并通过将兄弟姐妹的非认知特征及主要照料者福祉作为焦点儿童非认知能力的不完全排除工具变量来处理内生性问题。研究结果表明，自主性在青春期初期能提升数学能力，这表明存在一个敏感发展期。同一阶段未发现对语言能力有类似影响，说明自主性效应具有领域特异性。自我效能感在两个阶段均未对认知结果产生显著影响。我们无法拒绝自主性与自我效能感对青春期后期认知能力无影响的零假设。自主性效应集中于男孩群体，这与性别社会化理论一致。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695410.title: Dynamic complementarity between noncognitive and cognitive skills: evidence from adolescent development in India
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695410.title_zh: 非认知技能与认知技能之间的动态互补性：来自印度青少年发展的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2695446.abstract: Educational expectations play an important role in adolescents’ cognitive development and human capital accumulation. Using four waves of the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS) from 2010, 2014, 2018, and 2022, this article examines how parental educational expectations, children’s own educational expectations, and parent–child educational expectation discrepancies relate to adolescents’ cognitive ability. We find that both parental and children’s own educational expectations are positively associated with cognitive ability. However, relative to aligned expectations, discrepancies in either direction, whether parental educational expectations exceed or fall below children’s expectations, are associated with significantly lower cognitive ability among adolescents. Mechanism analyses suggest that discrepancies in either direction are associated with more frequent parent–child conflict. Upward-biased discrepancies are associated with lower adolescent academic self-efficacy, whereas downward-biased discrepancies are associated with lower parental homework involvement. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that these negative associations are stronger among students in regular class tracks, students from low-income households, students with less-educated parents, and rural students. Further analysis suggests that consistently high and aligned expectations correspond to the highest cognitive ability. These findings highlight the potential importance of expectation alignment within families and suggest that disadvantaged rural and low-income groups may warrant particular attention in educational policy design.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695446.abstract_zh: 教育期望在青少年认知发展与人力资本积累中扮演重要角色。本文基于2010年、2014年、2018年和2022年四期中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）数据，考察父母教育期望、子女自身教育期望及亲子教育期望差异与青少年认知能力的关系。研究发现：父母教育期望与子女自身教育期望均与认知能力呈正相关。然而，相较于期望一致的情形，无论父母期望高于还是低于子女期望，期望偏差均与青少年认知能力显著降低相关。机制分析表明，双向期望偏差均与更频繁的亲子冲突相关；向上偏差与青少年学业自我效能感降低相关，而向下偏差则与父母作业辅导参与度降低相关。异质性分析显示，上述负向关联在普通班学生、低收入家庭学生、父母受教育程度较低的学生及农村学生中更为显著。进一步分析表明，持续且一致的较高期望对应最高水平的认知能力。这些发现凸显了家庭内部期望一致性的潜在重要性，并提示教育政策设计应特别关注处于弱势地位的农村与低收入群体。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695446.title: The association between parent–child discrepancies in educational expectations and adolescents’ cognitive ability
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695446.title_zh: 亲子教育期望差异与青少年认知能力的关联

10.1080/00036846.2026.2695914.title: Who uses mobile payment apps in developing countries? Literacy, education, and the role of trust
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695914.title_zh: 发展中国家谁在使用移动支付应用？识字率、教育与信任的作用

10.1080/00036846.2026.2695915.abstract: Under policy incentives, the digital transformation of the traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) industry has emerged as a critical pathway for overcoming structural upgrading bottlenecks and fostering end-to-end collaborative development. Drawing on panel data from 75 listed TCM manufacturing firms in China from 2015 to 2023, this study examines the impact of digital investment on supply chain resilience in TCM leading firms and explores the mediating role of dual-chain coupling between the capital chain and talent chain. Fixed-effects models, Sobel-Goodman mediation tests, and instrumental variable (2SLS) estimation are employed to test the proposed relationships. The results reveal that digital investment significantly enhances supply chain resilience, and that dual-chain coupling serves as the core transmission mechanism, accounting for over 90% of the total effect. These results offer theoretical insights and practical guidance for TCM enterprises seeking to optimize digital strategies, strengthen supply chain resilience, and achieve sustainable and innovation-driven growth.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695915.abstract_zh: 在政策激励下，中医药行业数字化转型已成为突破结构性升级瓶颈、推动全链条协同发展的关键路径。本研究基于2015-2023年中国75家上市中医药制造企业面板数据，考察数字投资对中医药龙头企业供应链韧性的影响，并探究资金链与人才链双链耦合的中介作用。采用固定效应模型、Sobel-Goodman中介效应检验及工具变量两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）对假设关系进行验证。结果表明：数字投资显著提升供应链韧性，且双链耦合构成核心传导机制，其解释力占总效应的90%以上。该研究为中医药企业优化数字战略、强化供应链韧性及实现可持续创新增长提供了理论启示与实践指导。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695915.title: Unpacking the link between digital investment and supply chain resilience: a dual-chain coupling perspective in TCM enterprises
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695915.title_zh: 数字投资与供应链韧性的关系解析：中医药企业的双链耦合视角

10.1080/00036846.2026.2695916.title: Capital market liberalization and corporate employment: evidence from the Stock Connect scheme in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695916.title_zh: 资本市场开放与企业就业：来自中国沪深港通机制的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2695917.title_zh: 银行业中的人工智能：谁胜出、谁等待及其重要性

10.1080/00036846.2026.2695918.title: Entrepreneurial spirit and digital technology innovation in private enterprises : evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695918.title_zh: 企业家精神与民营企业数字技术创新：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2695920.abstract: This paper examines whether public data openness affects insider trading behaviour and profitability. Utilizing China’s staggered municipal launch of open government data (OGD) platforms and a stacked difference-in-differences design, we find that public data openness reduces insider trading profitability. Mechanism tests reveal that OGD platforms operate through an information channel by enriching the firm-level information environment, specifically increasing analyst coverage, narrowing bid-ask spreads, and reducing stock price synchronicity. Further analyses show that OGD platforms compress insider trading on both the extensive margin (reducing overall trading likelihood) and the intensive margin (lowering the probability of trade success conditional on trading). Cross-sectional tests show that this deterrent effect is more pronounced for firms with weaker corporate governance and those located in regions with superior digital infrastructure. These findings offer insights for policymakers that public data infrastructure generates positive externalities for financial market integrity.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695920.abstract_zh: 本文考察公共数据开放是否影响内幕交易行为及其盈利性。利用中国各城市分阶段启动政府数据开放平台的自然实验，结合堆叠双重差分模型，我们发现公共数据开放降低了内幕交易盈利水平。机制检验表明，政府数据开放平台通过信息渠道发挥作用——通过丰富企业层面的信息环境，具体表现为增加分析师关注度、缩小买卖价差以及降低股价同步性。进一步分析显示，政府数据开放平台从广延边际（降低整体交易可能性）和集约边际（降低既定交易条件下的成功概率）两个维度压缩内幕交易。截面检验表明，这种抑制效应在公司治理较弱的企业以及位于数字基础设施更优地区的企业中更为显著。这些发现为政策制定者提供了启示：公共数据基础设施能够为金融市场诚信建设产生正向外部性。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695920.title: Does public data openness curb insider trading? Evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695920.title_zh: 公共数据开放是否抑制了内幕交易？来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2695923.title_zh: 金融结构市场化、双重创新与新质生产力：社会融资结构的增量证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2695924.title: The impact of the belt and road initiative on debt risk in participating countries
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695924.title_zh: 一带一路倡议对参与国债务风险的影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2695927.abstract: Fiscal sustainability, closely linked to government solvency, is essential for public financing and, consequently, for ensuring the normal functioning of economic activity. In the context of rising global debt levels and higher borrowing costs, as recently highlighted by the International Monetary Fund, this paper examines the sustainability of fiscal policy across the world economy using a combination of estimation methods and tests. Adopting an approach that integrates panel data with time-series analysis for a sample of 38 countries over the past half-century, the initial conclusion is that global fiscal policy has been sustainable. However, a country-by-country analysis reveals a more nuanced reality. According to the ranking proposed in this paper, slightly more than two-thirds of the countries can be classified as exhibiting either unsustainable fiscal policies (Level C) or partial sustainability with potential risks (Level B) over the 1974–2023 period. The remainder of the sample shows evidence of fiscal sustainability (Level A); however, even within this level, the strength of this relationship varies considerably across countries, highlighting substantial heterogeneity in fiscal sustainability. By providing a comprehensive cross-country assessment based on a relatively long time series using rigorous applied techniques, this paper offers timely and policy-relevant insights for both academics and policymakers.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695927.abstract_zh: 财政可持续性与政府偿付能力密切相关，是公共融资的基础，进而保障经济活动的正常运转。在全球债务水平攀升、借贷成本上升的背景下（国际货币基金组织近期已强调此问题），本文综合运用多种估计方法与检验手段，考察全球经济体的财政政策可持续性。通过将面板数据与时间序列分析相结合，对过去半个世纪38个国家的样本进行研究，初步结论显示全球财政政策总体具有可持续性。然而，国别分析揭示了更为复杂的现实。根据本文提出的分级体系，在1974-2023年期间，略超三分之二的国家可归类为不可持续的财政政策（C级）或存在潜在风险的局部可持续性（B级）。其余样本国家呈现财政可持续性证据（A级），但即便在这一层级内，各国可持续性关系的强度也存在显著差异，凸显财政可持续性的高度异质性。本文基于较长时序数据，运用严谨的应用技术方法提供全面的跨国评估，为学术界和政策制定者提供了具有时效性和政策参考价值的洞见。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695927.title: Fiscal sustainability in the world economy: evidence from panel and time-series analysis of 38 countries over half a century
10.1080/00036846.2026.2695927.title_zh: 世界经济中的财政可持续性：基于38个国家半个世纪面板与时间序列分析的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2696480.title: Asymmetric effects of monetary policy uncertainty on BRICS stock markets, cryptocurrencies, and oil markets: a multiscale perspective based on frequency and quantile frameworks
10.1080/00036846.2026.2696480.title_zh: 基于频率与分位数框架的多尺度视角下货币政策不确定性对金砖国家股市、加密货币及石油市场的非对称效应

10.1080/00036846.2026.2696483.abstract: Institutional opening has emerged as a significant policy instrument for shaping long-term investment decisions, particularly when the marginal effects of factor-based opening become less pronounced and foreign investment becomes increasingly sensitive to the institutional environment and policy expectations. This paper treats the establishment of a pilot free trade zone (FTZ) in a region with relatively weak institutional foundations as a quasi-natural experiment. Using provincial panel data from 2008 to 2022, this study applies the synthetic control method and the synthetic difference-in-differences method to test the impact of FTZ policies on the total investment of foreign-invested enterprises. The results show that FTZ policies significantly increased the total investment of foreign-invested enterprises in the treated province, with an average policy effect of approximately 34.4%. Further analysis indicates that this effect is primarily reflected in the growth in medium- and long-term investment arrangements rather than increases in current capital inflows alone. This finding suggests that institutional opening can promote foreign investment by enhancing investors’ expectations regarding institutional stability and policy predictability. Comparisons across regions also indicate that the effect is stronger in regions with relatively weak institutional foundations, whereas the marginal effect is smaller in regions with more developed institutional conditions.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2696483.abstract_zh: 制度型开放已成为塑造长期投资决策的重要政策工具，尤其是在要素型开放的边际效应逐渐减弱、外资对制度环境与政策预期日益敏感的背景下。本文将自由贸易试验区在制度基础相对薄弱地区的设立视为准自然实验，利用2008—2022年省级面板数据，采用合成控制法和合成双重差分法检验自贸区政策对外商投资企业投资总额的影响。结果表明，自贸区政策显著提升了处理省份外商投资企业的投资总额，平均政策效应约为34.4%。进一步分析显示，这一效应主要体现在中长期投资安排的增长，而非当期资本流入的增加。这一发现表明，制度型开放能够通过增强投资者对制度稳定性和政策可预期性的预期来促进外商投资。跨区域比较也显示，在制度基础相对薄弱的地区，该效应更为显著，而在制度条件较为完善的地区，边际效应较小。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2696483.title: Institutional opening and foreign investment commitment: evidence from China’s Free Trade Zones
10.1080/00036846.2026.2696483.title_zh: 制度型开放与外商投资承诺：来自中国自贸区的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2697060.title: Compact space, connected city: the impact of urban compactness on basic public service accessibility
10.1080/00036846.2026.2697060.title_zh: 紧凑空间，连通城市：城市紧凑度对基本公共服务可达性的影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2697061.abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between functional specialization (FS) in global value chains (GVCs) and wages. Drawing on the GVC theory and intellectual monopoly capitalism theory, both highlighting asymmetries in international production and knowledge networks, it is postulated that FS in fabrication and FS in research and development (R&D) have differentiated effects on the evolution of wages. To test this hypothesis, we embed measures of FS in a structural wage regression and estimate the relationship for 25 EU countries over the period 2003–2022. We find some evidence for this hypothesis, notably a negative association between FS in fabrication and wages. Furthermore, we obtain partial confirmation of the expected patterns in our instrumental variable regressions, although the findings are not fully robust across all specifications.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2697061.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了全球价值链（GVC）中的功能专业化（FS）与工资之间的关系。基于全球价值链理论与智力垄断资本主义理论（两者均强调国际生产与知识网络中的不对称性），本文提出假设：制造功能专业化与研发（R&D）功能专业化对工资演变具有差异化影响。为验证该假设，我们将功能专业化指标嵌入结构性工资回归模型，并对2003-2022年间25个欧盟国家进行估计。研究结果部分支持该假设，尤其发现制造功能专业化与工资呈负相关关系。此外，工具变量回归虽部分验证了预期模式，但该结论在所有模型设定中并非完全稳健。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2697061.title: Functional specialization and wages in Europe
10.1080/00036846.2026.2697061.title_zh: 欧洲的功能专业化与工资

10.1080/00036846.2026.2697062.abstract: This paper investigates whether healthcare access affects educational achievement, exploiting the staggered ACA Medicaid expansion. Using county-level panel data on ACT scores, insurance coverage, and health indicators for 2012–2024, I find that Medicaid expansion raised county-level ACT composite scores by 0.50 to 0.85 points (about 0.22 standard deviations in the controlled specification). A Callaway and Sant’anna heterogeneity-robust estimator yields a simple aggregated ATT of 0.79, indicating the result is not an artefact of forbidden comparisons, and an event study is consistent with parallel pre-trends, with effects building to approximately 1.3 points by 6 years that I read as a suggestive long-run trajectory. The estimate attenuates and loses significance under within-region and within-division comparison and under relative-magnitude pre-trend violations, so I interpret it as suggestive of a causal effect under the design’s identifying assumptions rather than a firmly established magnitude. A supplementary instrumental-variables specification is consistent in sign but imprecise. A selection test does not detect changes in test participation, and channel analysis finds that observable health and economic indicators do not meaningfully mediate the effect, leaving the mechanism an open question for future research with individual-level data.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2697062.abstract_zh: 本文利用《平价医疗法案》下各州分阶段实施的医疗补助扩展政策，探究医疗可及性是否影响教育成就。基于2012–2024年县级面板数据（涵盖ACT成绩、保险覆盖率及健康指标），研究发现医疗补助扩展使县级ACT综合成绩提升0.50至0.85分（在控制规范中约为0.22个标准差）。采用Callaway与Sant'anna提出的异质性稳健估计量，得到简单汇总的平均处理效应（ATT）为0.79，表明该结果并非由禁止性比较造成的人为现象；事件研究支持平行趋势假设，且效应在6年内累积至约1.3分，可视为长期趋势的提示性证据。在区域内部及分区内部比较中，以及相对幅度事前趋势违反条件下，估计值减弱并失去显著性，因此本文将其解读为在设计识别假设下具有因果效应的提示性证据，而非确凿的效应量级。辅助工具变量估计在符号上一致但精度不足。选择检验未发现考试参与率变化，渠道分析表明可观测的健康与经济指标并未显著中介该效应，其作用机制有待未来基于个体层面数据的研究进一步探索。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2697062.title: Healthcare access and human capital: evidence from Medicaid expansion
10.1080/00036846.2026.2697062.title_zh: 医疗可及性与人力资本：来自医疗补助扩展的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2697063.title: Government-endorsed voluntary regulation and debt financing cost: evidence from China’s green factory certification
10.1080/00036846.2026.2697063.title_zh: 政府支持的志愿性监管与债务融资成本：来自中国绿色工厂认证的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2698026.abstract: Bilateral investment treaties (BITs) are widely acknowledged as instruments for attracting inward foreign direct investment (IFDI), yet their effectiveness remains contested. By using a sample of 64 countries along the Belt and Road Initiative, this study employs the Quadratic Assignment Procedure to analyse the impact of BITs on IFDI and further explores how these effects vary across IFDI subnetworks with distinct structural characteristics. Our analysis yields three key findings. First, the effect of BITs on IFDI declined over time – it was strong between 2012 and 2016 but weakened after 2017 due to the emergence of alternative institutions and evolving geopolitical factors. Second, the impact of formal BIT protections is prominent in low-cohesion networks. However, in high-cohesion systems, densely connected networks rely more on informal enforcement mechanisms. Third, strong expropriation clauses enhance investment, whereas investor-state dispute settlement provisions have a limited effect. These results indicate that policymakers should pursue targeted BIT strategies, prioritizing partners with central network positions or those embedded in highly active, low-cohesion communities; furthermore, a pronounced focus on strengthening substantive protections over indiscriminate treaty expansion is suggested. By linking clause-level treaty designs to network characteristics, this study contributes to a more nuanced understanding of heterogeneous IFDI outcomes.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698026.abstract_zh: 双边投资条约（BITs）被广泛视为吸引外商直接投资（IFDI）的工具，但其有效性仍存争议。本研究以"一带一路"倡议沿线64个国家为样本，采用二次指派程序分析BITs对IFDI的影响，并进一步探讨这些效应如何随具有不同结构特征的IFDI子网络而变化。分析得出三项关键发现：第一，BITs对IFDI的影响随时间递减——2012年至2016年间效应显著，但2017年后因替代性制度兴起及地缘政治因素演变而减弱；第二，正式BIT保护机制在低凝聚力网络中作用突出，但在高凝聚力系统中，密集关联网络更依赖非正式执行机制；第三，强有力的征收条款能促进投资，而投资者-国家争端解决条款效果有限。这些结果表明，政策制定者应采取针对性BIT策略，优先选择处于网络中心位置或嵌入高活跃度、低凝聚力社群中的伙伴国；同时建议重点强化实质性保护条款而非盲目扩大条约范围。通过将条款级条约设计与网络特征相联系，本研究有助于更细致地理解IFDI的异质性结果。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698026.title: Connecting the dots: how bilateral investment treaty networks influence inward foreign direct investment
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698026.title_zh: 连接点：双边投资条约网络如何影响内向外国直接投资

10.1080/00036846.2026.2698030.abstract: This study examines whether voluntary environmental regulations enhance corporate carbon information disclosure (CID), an underexplored issue in carbon governance. Based on Chinese A-share listed firms from 2010 to 2023, we use green factory certification as a quasi-natural experiment and employ a multi-period difference-in-differences approach. Data were obtained from the CSMAR and CNRDS databases. The final sample consists of 4,966 firms, yielding 40,953 firm-year observations. Results show that certification significantly improves firms’ CID. Mechanism tests reveal three channels: stronger managerial and organizational green awareness, increased investor and media attention, and promoted green investment and innovation. Heterogeneity tests indicate the effect is stronger for firms in non-high-carbon industries, non-key-polluting firms, those in regions with cash incentives and those in areas with weaker low-carbon regulation. Certified firms that receive environmental penalties do not improve CID, verifying the effectiveness of post-certification dynamic monitoring. Furthermore, certification promotes both symbolic and substantive disclosure, reduces greenwashing and cuts real carbon emissions, supporting a ‘talk-and-walk’ governance effect. Certified firms also generate positive spillover effects, motivating industry peers, city peers and downstream supply-chain customers to enhance CID. This study offers causal evidence for voluntary environmental regulation in carbon governance and implications for incentivizing credible carbon disclosure.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698030.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨自愿性环境规制是否能够提升企业碳信息披露水平，这是碳治理领域中尚未充分探究的问题。基于2010年至2023年中国A股上市公司数据，以绿色工厂认证作为准自然实验，采用多期双重差分法进行分析。数据来源于CSMAR和CNRDS数据库，最终样本包含4,966家企业，共计40,953个公司-年度观测值。结果表明，认证显著提升了企业的碳信息披露水平。机制检验揭示了三条路径：管理层与组织绿色意识的增强、投资者与媒体关注度的提升，以及绿色投资与创新的促进。异质性检验显示，在非高碳行业企业、非重点污染企业、位于现金激励政策地区以及低碳规制较弱地区的企业中，该效应更为显著。获得认证但受到环境处罚的企业并未改善碳信息披露，这验证了认证后动态监管的有效性。此外，认证同时促进了象征性披露与实质性披露，减少了“漂绿”行为，并降低了实际碳排放，支持了“言行一致”的治理效应。获得认证的企业还产生了正向溢出效应，激励同行业企业、同城市企业以及下游供应链客户提升碳信息披露水平。本研究为自愿性环境规制在碳治理中的因果效应提供了证据，并对激励可信碳信息披露具有政策启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698030.title: Voluntary environmental regulation and carbon information disclosure: evidence from the green factory certification in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698030.title_zh: 自愿性环境规制与碳信息披露：来自中国绿色工厂认证的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2698031.abstract: Digital transformation is a central policy priority, yet its benefits remain unevenly distributed across individuals and countries. Digital inequalities are multidimensional, encompassing both objective aspects, such as access, use, and outcomes, and subjective dimensions, including perceptions, motivation, and behaviours. This article examines the factors associated with individuals’ perceptions of the importance of digitalization, using data from Eurobarometer 99.1. The analysis focuses on socio-demographic characteristics, internet use, attitudinal variables related to digital policies, and the national context. Binary and multilevel logistic regression models are employed to account for both individual and country-level influences. The findings show that perceptions of digitalization are more strongly associated with individual factors than with cross-country differences. Socio-economic characteristics are relevant, with education and income positively associated with the perceived importance of digitalization, while age shows a negative association. Attitudinal variables related to digital education, access, and infrastructure display significant associations. At the country level, the share of individuals with basic digital skills (DESI) is positively associated with the perceived importance of digitalization and explains part of the variation between countries. This study contributes to the literature on digital inequalities by focusing on attitudes towards digitalization and by highlighting the interplay between individual and contextual factors.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698031.abstract_zh: 数字化转型是核心政策重点，但其收益在个体和国家间仍分布不均。数字不平等具有多维性，既涵盖接入、使用和结果等客观层面，也包含认知、动机和行为等主观维度。本文利用欧洲晴雨表99.1数据，考察与个体对数字化重要性认知相关的因素。分析聚焦于社会人口特征、互联网使用、与数字政策相关的态度变量以及国家背景。采用二元和多层次逻辑回归模型来同时考虑个体和国家层面的影响。研究结果表明，与跨国差异相比，个体因素与数字化认知的关联更为显著。社会经济特征具有相关性：教育程度和收入与数字化重要性认知呈正相关，而年龄则呈负相关。与数字教育、接入和基础设施相关的态度变量表现出显著关联。在国家层面，具备基础数字技能的人口比例（DESI）与数字化重要性认知呈正相关，并解释了部分国家间差异。本研究通过聚焦数字化态度并强调个体与情境因素的相互作用，为数字不平等文献做出贡献。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698031.title: Perceived importance of digitalization in the European Union: a multilevel analysis of individual and country-level determinants
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698031.title_zh: 欧盟数字化感知重要性：个体与国家层面决定因素的多层次分析

10.1080/00036846.2026.2698856.abstract: The ‘Broadband China’ policy, a series of digital infrastructure modernization projects starting in 2014, greatly expanded and improved local Internet access. This study utilizes the 2011–2016 firm-level data in a staggered difference-in-differences model to examine the energy efficiency gain from the policy. The findings show that the policy-covered enterprises reduced their energy intensity by 2.34% more than their uncovered counterparts, comprising 11.2% of the total Five-Year-Plan target in the sample period. This effect was more pronounced among firms in manufacturing, in eastern and central regions, in non-resource-based cities and among non-state-owned or large-scale firms. Mechanism analysis indicates that the policy reduces energy consumption and emissions by enhancing managerial efficiency and stimulating green innovation. This study shows that digital infrastructure promotes firms’ low-carbon transitions and also advances corporate social responsibility and sustainable development.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698856.abstract_zh: 宽带中国”政策是自2014年起实施的一系列数字基础设施现代化项目，显著扩大并改善了地方互联网接入。本研究利用2011-2016年企业层面数据，采用交错双重差分模型，考察该政策带来的能效提升效应。研究发现，受政策覆盖的企业能源强度比未覆盖企业多降低2.34%，占样本期内整个五年计划目标的11.2%。这一效应在制造业企业、东部和中部地区、非资源型城市以及非国有或大型企业中更为显著。机制分析表明，该政策通过提升管理效率和激发绿色创新来降低能源消耗与排放。本研究显示，数字基础设施不仅推动企业低碳转型，还促进了企业社会责任与可持续发展。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698856.title: Digital superhighways to sustainability: the impact of large-scale digital infrastructure construction on firms’ energy efficiency
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698856.title_zh: 数字高速公路通向可持续发展：大规模数字基础设施建设对企业能源效率的影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2698857.abstract: This study develops a global stochastic computable general equilibrium (CGE) model to evaluate trigger mechanisms and coverage rates for an international joint grain reserve among China, Japan, and South Korea. Framing the reserve as a cooperative risk-sharing institution with public-good characteristics, it links release-rule design to incentive compatibility and institutional sustainability. Unlike prior studies emphasizing reserve size and contribution rules, we examine how release triggers interact with probabilistic shock distributions. We compare VaR-based triggers at 70–95% confidence levels with uniform thresholds of 2.5–20% under 500 correlated productivity-shock paths. Results show that VaR-based triggers generate consistent welfare gains, risk reduction, and complete Pareto improvements. Uniform triggers produce more asymmetric outcomes; at the 10% threshold, Japan and South Korea benefit while China incurs welfare losses. For VaR designs, the optimal coverage rate is approximately 75%, since increasing coverage to 100% brings only marginal additional gains. Excessively aggressive trigger–coverage combinations can weaken performance by accelerating reserve depletion under extreme shocks. Overall, an 80% VaR trigger with 75–100% coverage provides the strongest stabilization effect and more balanced welfare distribution, supporting voluntary participation and long-term cooperation
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698857.abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个全球随机可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，以评估中日韩三国国际联合粮食储备的触发机制与覆盖率。通过将粮食储备界定为具有公共品属性的合作型风险分担制度，本研究将释放规则设计与激励相容性及制度可持续性相关联。与以往侧重储备规模与出资规则的研究不同，我们重点考察释放触发机制如何与概率性冲击分布相互作用。在500条关联生产率冲击路径下，我们比较了置信水平70%-95%的VaR触发机制与2.5%-20%的统一阈值触发机制。结果表明：VaR触发机制能产生持续福利改善、风险降低及完全帕累托改进；统一阈值触发机制则呈现更显著的非对称效应——在10%阈值下，日韩两国获益而中国遭受福利损失。就VaR设计而言，最优覆盖率约为75%，因将覆盖率提升至100%仅带来边际增益。过度激进的触发-覆盖率组合可能因极端冲击下加速储备消耗而削弱绩效。总体而言，80% VaR触发机制配合75%-100%覆盖率能实现最强稳定效应与更均衡的福利分配，从而支撑自愿参与与长期合作。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698857.title: Rethinking release rules for international grain reserves under production risk
10.1080/00036846.2026.2698857.title_zh: 生产风险下国际粮食储备释放规则的再思考

文章标题：智能制造与企业创新：来自中国的证据  
作者：Zhidong Tan, Fei Li, Xujia Zong, Haoxiang Wen, Yuhong Yang
