10.1080/00036846.2026.2699060.title: Correction

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699430.abstract: We study setups where the winner of a qualifying Tullock contest can participate in a subsequent sport competition where their relative performance depends on initial efforts at the qualifying stage. If the qualifying contest is staged in favour of a team, the cheating team always sees its qualifying probability improve. The effect on investments, however, is non-monotonic: for mild levels of cheating, the higher likelihood of qualifying for the subsequent competition strengthens the cheating team’s incentives to invest, raising its effort above the unbiased benchmark; for intense levels of cheating, the near-certainty of qualifying eliminates the incentive to compete for the local prize, and the cheating team drastically cuts its investments. The rival team, on the other hand, always reduces its equilibrium effort as corruption becomes more intense. The cheating player has incentives to carry out illegal activities since his payoff increases in cheating. In such corrupt qualifiers, the champion tends to be the cheating player, and the representative from this qualifying group in the subsequent competition will perform worse if corruption is intense.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699430.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种赛制：在资格赛阶段通过Tullock竞赛胜出的队伍，可参与后续体育赛事，而该队伍在后续赛事中的相对表现取决于其在资格赛阶段的初始努力。若资格赛存在偏向某支队伍的舞弊行为，则该作弊队伍进入资格赛的概率始终会提高。然而，舞弊对投资的影响呈现非单调性：在轻度舞弊水平下，进入后续赛事概率的提升会增强作弊队伍的投资激励，使其努力水平高于无偏基准；在重度舞弊水平下，近乎确定的晋级资格消除了争夺本地奖项的激励，导致作弊队伍大幅削减投资。另一方面，随着腐败程度加剧，对手队伍始终会降低其均衡努力水平。由于作弊者的收益随舞弊程度增加而上升，其具有实施非法行为的激励。在此类腐败资格赛中，冠军往往由作弊队伍获得，且若腐败程度严重，该资格赛群体在后续赛事中的代表队伍表现将更差。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699430.title: The dire consequences of a corrupt sport contest
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699430.title_zh: 腐败体育竞赛的严重后果

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699431.abstract: This study examines the impact of exogenous institutional shocks on economic development by investigating the establishment of treaty ports in late Qing China (1840–1910). Forced open under unequal treaties imposed by foreign powers, these ports provide a quasi-natural experiment to identify the causal effects of openness on industrialization. We construct a novel county-level panel dataset from multiple historical archives, covering 1,752 counties with information on treaty port status, firm establishments, and firm scale measured by capital investment and industrial employment. Employing a staggered difference-in-differences (DiD) approach, we find that treaty port establishment significantly promoted firm agglomeration, as well as capital and labour accumulation. Mechanism analysis suggests that treaty ports spurred industrialization by expanding international trade, strengthening institutional control through foreign concessions, and building human capital through new-style schools. Heterogeneity analysis reveals stronger effects in light industries, for firms with foreign and private capital, and in coastal ports. Our findings suggest that treaty ports created the institutional and commercial gateways through which modern industry entered China.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699431.abstract_zh: 本研究通过考察晚清时期（1840–1910年）通商口岸的设立，探讨外生制度冲击对经济发展的影响。这些口岸在外国列强强加的不平等条约下被迫开放，为识别开放对工业化的因果效应提供了准自然实验。我们基于多个历史档案构建了一个全新的县级面板数据集，涵盖1752个县，包含通商口岸状态、企业设立情况以及以资本投资和工业就业衡量的企业规模等信息。采用交错双重差分法，我们发现通商口岸的设立显著促进了企业集聚以及资本和劳动力的积累。机制分析表明，通商口岸通过扩大国际贸易、通过外国租界加强制度控制以及通过新式学堂积累人力资本，推动了工业化进程。异质性分析显示，通商口岸对轻工业、外资和私营企业以及沿海口岸的影响更为显著。我们的研究结果表明，通商口岸创造了制度与商业门户，现代工业正是通过这些门户进入中国。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699431.title: Gateways to growth: the impact of ports on China’s early industrial development
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699431.title_zh: 增长的门户：港口对中国早期工业发展的影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699435.abstract: This study addresses the research gap regarding how government-led industrial policies catalyse micro-level technological transformation in emerging markets. Drawing on the resource-based view and the knowledge-based view, we empirically investigate the impact of intelligent manufacturing projects on corporate artificial intelligence innovation applications. Using a comprehensive sample of A-share listed companies in China from 2010 to 2023, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences framework and a double machine learning approach to ensure methodological robustness and mitigate high-dimensional selection bias. The findings reveal that the implementation of intelligent manufacturing projects significantly enhances artificial intelligence innovation levels within firms, with a 28.85% improvement compared with the average level. Mechanism analysis indicates that this promoting effect operates through the enhancement of data element utilization, the facilitation of cross-domain knowledge integration, and the expansion of research and development investment. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that the impact is more pronounced in non-state-owned enterprises, firms with higher degrees of digital transformation, and those in high-tech industries. This research clarifies the causal pathways of policy-driven innovation and offers practical guidance for the precise promotion of intelligent manufacturing initiatives and the efficient implementation of corporate transformation.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699435.abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于政府主导的产业政策如何在新兴市场中催化微观层面技术变革这一研究空白。基于资源基础观与知识基础观，我们实证考察了智能制造项目对企业人工智能创新应用的影响。利用2010至2023年中国A股上市公司综合样本，采用交错双重差分框架与双机器学习方法，以确保方法稳健性并缓解高维选择偏差。研究发现，智能制造项目的实施显著提升了企业人工智能创新水平，相较于平均水平改善幅度达28.85%。机制分析表明，这一促进效应通过提升数据要素利用率、促进跨领域知识整合以及扩大研发投入三条路径实现。异质性分析进一步显示，该影响在非国有企业、数字化转型程度较高的企业以及高技术产业中更为显著。本研究厘清了政策驱动创新的因果路径，为精准推进智能制造举措及高效实施企业转型提供了实践指导。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699435.title: Driving corporate artificial intelligence applications: evidence from intelligent manufacturing projects
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699435.title_zh: 驱动企业人工智能应用：来自智能制造项目的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699444.abstract: Promoting green innovation agglomeration (GIA) is essential for achieving a sustainable industrial transformation, strengthening resource efficiency and advancing the low-carbon progression. However, the role of eco-industrial demonstration parks (EIDPs) in fostering GIA remains insufficiently explored. Using panel data from 297 prefecture-level cities in China for the period 2000–2022, this study systematically examines the impact of EIDPs on GIA. The empirical results show that (1) EIDPs significantly promote GIA, a conclusion that maintains its validity through robustness and endogeneity checks. (2) Heterogeneity checks indicate that the EIDPs’ effect is more evident among cities possessing high government governance capacity, high environmental preference, and high market spillover level. (3) A mechanism analysis reveals that EIDPs enhance GIA by improving green technology diversity, innovation factors’ allocation efficiency and external media coverage. Such outcomes enrich research on EIDPs and GIA and provide policy insights for optimizing EIDPs’ governance, improving green innovation resource allocation, and accelerating the formation of regionally coordinated green innovation systems.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699444.abstract_zh: 促进绿色创新集聚是实现可持续产业转型、增强资源效率以及推动低碳进程的关键。然而，生态工业示范园区在培育绿色创新集聚方面的作用尚未得到充分探讨。本研究利用2000—2022年中国297个地级市的面板数据，系统考察了生态工业示范园区对绿色创新集聚的影响。实证结果表明：（1）生态工业示范园区显著促进了绿色创新集聚，该结论在稳健性检验和内生性检验中依然成立；（2）异质性检验显示，生态工业示范园区的效应在政府治理能力高、环境偏好强以及市场溢出水平高的城市中更为显著；（3）机制分析揭示，生态工业示范园区通过提升绿色技术多样性、创新要素配置效率以及外部媒体关注度来增强绿色创新集聚。这些成果丰富了关于生态工业示范园区与绿色创新集聚的研究，并为优化生态工业示范园区治理、改善绿色创新资源配置以及加速形成区域协调的绿色创新体系提供了政策启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699444.title: National eco-industrial demonstration parks and green innovation agglomeration: Evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699444.title_zh: 国家生态工业示范园区与绿色创新集聚：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699452.abstract: Using the full text of invention patents filed by Chinese listed firms, we construct a firm-level innovation-quality index by pre-training and fine-tuning a deep learning language model, and link this measure to National Tax Survey records and disclosed supplier – customer dyads. From a value-chain coordination perspective, we examine bilateral labour-demand spillovers associated with focal firms’ innovation-quality upgrading. The results show that innovation-quality upgrading at focal firms significantly increases labour demand among upstream and downstream suppliers. A one-standard-deviation increase in innovation quality raises upstream and downstream employment by 0.84% and 0.77%, respectively. This study also employs a shift-share instrumental variable (SSIV) design to address potential endogeneity. Mechanism analyses identify two channels: an output-demand channel, whereby innovation quality raises productivity, profitability, and product quality, expanding input demand and downstream market demand; and a trade-credit channel, whereby improved innovation credentials strengthen reputation and balance-sheet capacity, enabling trade credit and guarantees that relax partners’ financing constraints and stimulate hiring. This study provides managers and policymakers with insights into how high-quality innovation stabilizes employment.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699452.abstract_zh: 本文利用中国上市公司发明专利申请全文，通过预训练与微调深度学习语言模型构建企业层面创新质量指数，并将该指标与全国税收调查记录及公开的供应商-客户配对数据进行关联。从价值链协调视角出发，我们考察了焦点企业创新质量提升对双边劳动力需求的溢出效应。研究发现，焦点企业创新质量升级显著增加了上下游供应商的劳动力需求：创新质量每提高一个标准差，上游和下游就业分别增长0.84%和0.77%。本研究还采用份额转移工具变量（SSIV）设计以应对潜在内生性问题。机制分析识别出两条传导路径：一是产出需求渠道——创新质量通过提升生产率、盈利能力和产品质量，扩大投入需求与下游市场需求；二是贸易信贷渠道——创新资质的改善增强了企业声誉与资产负债表能力，使其能够提供贸易信贷与担保，从而缓解合作伙伴的融资约束并刺激雇佣行为。本研究为管理者与政策制定者提供了高质量创新如何稳定就业的实践启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699452.title: High-quality innovation, supply-chain spillovers, and firm-level employment
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699452.title_zh: 高质量创新、供应链溢出与企业层面就业

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699940.abstract: This paper examines whether the opening of the China-Europe Railway Express (CRE) affects firms’ cross-regional investment. Using subsidiary-level data of Chinese listed firms from 2003 to 2020, we construct a firm-destination city-year panel and find that CRE openings significantly increase firms’ subsidiary establishment in connected cities. Mechanism analyses suggest that the CRE promotes firms’ cross-regional investment primarily by improving access to European markets and enhancing cross-border supply-chain efficiency. The effect is stronger for export-oriented firms and is more pronounced in coastal cities and cargo-origin hub cities with higher logistical importance. Evidence from textual classification of subsidiary business scopes further shows that the CRE has a stronger effect on embedded-oriented subsidiaries engaged in production, R&D, and manufacturing than on transit-oriented subsidiaries engaged in trading, logistics, and warehousing. Moreover, the investment response is amplified in cities with stronger industrial agglomeration and higher levels of marketization, highlighting the role of local absorptive capacity. Overall, this paper provides firm-level evidence that cross-border transport infrastructure can reshape firms’ spatial organization layout, and that the related investment exhibits certain features of organizational embeddedness rather than being limited to transit functions.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699940.abstract_zh: 本文考察中欧班列（CRE）开通是否影响企业跨区域投资。基于2003-2020年中国上市公司子公司层面数据，构建企业-目的地城市-年度面板数据后发现，中欧班列开通显著增加了企业在沿线城市的子公司设立数量。机制分析表明，中欧班列主要通过改善欧洲市场准入和提升跨境供应链效率促进企业跨区域投资。该效应在出口导向型企业中更为显著，且在物流重要性更高的沿海城市和货源枢纽城市表现更突出。基于子公司经营范围文本分类的证据进一步显示，相较于从事贸易、物流和仓储的转运导向型子公司，中欧班列对从事生产、研发和制造的嵌入导向型子公司具有更强的促进作用。此外，在产业集聚程度更高、市场化水平更强的城市，企业投资响应更为显著，凸显了地方吸收能力的关键作用。总体而言，本文提供了跨境交通基础设施能够重塑企业空间组织布局的微观证据，并揭示相关投资呈现组织嵌入性特征而非局限于转运功能。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699940.title: Does the China-Europe Railway Express attract cross-regional investment? Evidence from Chinese firms
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699940.title_zh: 中欧班列是否吸引了跨区域投资？来自中国企业的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699942.abstract: Accelerating the advancement of new quality productivity (Newprod) has emerged as an essential strategic imperative for nations to navigate global competition and strengthen their capacity for sustainable development. Building on this premise, this study employs data from 280 cities spanning the period from 2009 to 2022 and takes national-level new areas as a representative example to rigorously examine whether location-oriented policy contributes to the advancement of Newprod. The robustness of the findings is verified through multidimensional sensitivity analyses. Empirical results demonstrate that the creation of new areas substantially enhances Newprod, operating through the positive moderating effects of government led technology investment and regional marketization levels. Furthermore, mechanism testing confirms that the policy accelerates Newprod by driving tertiary industry agglomeration while concurrently suppressing traditional manufacturing agglomeration. Further analysis reveals significant structural variations in policy effectiveness. From a spatial configuration standpoint, the single city development model demonstrates superior performance compared to the dual city collaborative model. From an administrative hierarchy perspective, policy impacts are more significant in cities with elevated administrative status.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699942.abstract_zh: 加速发展新质生产力已成为各国应对全球竞争、增强可持续发展能力的重要战略选择。基于此，本研究利用2009—2022年280个城市的面板数据，以国家级新区为典型代表，严谨考察了区位导向型政策是否有助于推动新质生产力发展，并通过多维敏感性分析验证了研究结果的稳健性。实证结果表明，新区的设立显著提升了新质生产力水平，其作用机制在于政府主导的科技投入与区域市场化水平发挥了正向调节效应。进一步机制检验证实，该政策通过驱动第三产业集聚、同时抑制传统制造业集聚的路径加速了新质生产力发展。深入分析发现，政策效应存在显著的结构性差异：从空间布局看，单城发展模式的效果优于双城协同模式；从行政层级看，政策在行政级别较高的城市中影响更为显著。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699942.title: The role of location-oriented policy in promoting the development of new quality productivity in regions
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699942.title_zh: 区位导向政策在促进区域新质生产力发展中的作用

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699943.abstract: In the minimum wage literature, much of the focus has been on the effects of minimum wage changes on employment, wages, earnings of labour market participants, and income. However, through its influence on parents’ income, time allocation, and capacity for health investment, a change in minimum wage can also affect child health. In this study, I examine the effect of the minimum wage introduced by the 1966 Fair Labor Standards Act on child health. The study uses intergenerational survey data from US households in the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) and employs a difference-in-differences research design. The results show that the introduction of a minimum wage increases the likelihood of a healthy childhood. The effect is not homogeneous across states; it is stronger in states without prior minimum wage policies, where the Act represented a larger shock. The results further reveal significant gender heterogeneity, indicating that the health improvement effect of the minimum wage policy is substantially stronger for girls than for boys. The findings are robust to a range of additional validation exercises, including event-study specifications, spillover analyses, and placebo tests.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699943.abstract_zh: 在最低工资文献中，研究重点多集中于最低工资变动对就业、工资、劳动力市场参与者收入及总体收入的影响。然而，最低工资变动通过影响父母的收入、时间分配及健康投资能力，也可能对儿童健康产生作用。本研究考察了1966年《公平劳动标准法》引入的最低工资制度对儿童健康的影响。研究采用美国收入动态追踪调查（PSID）中的跨代际家庭数据，并运用双重差分研究设计。结果表明，最低工资的引入提高了儿童拥有健康童年的可能性。该效应在各州间并非同质：在未实施过最低工资政策的州（该法案带来的冲击更大）中，效应更为显著。结果进一步揭示了显著的性别异质性，表明最低工资政策对女孩的健康改善效应明显强于男孩。上述发现在一系列额外验证测试中保持稳健，包括事件研究设定、溢出效应分析及安慰剂检验。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699943.title: Minimum wage and child health: Evidence from the 1966 Fair Labor Standards Act
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699943.title_zh: 最低工资与儿童健康：来自1966年《公平劳动标准法》的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699944.abstract: This study examines the moderating effect of the minimum wage on the relationship between industrial robots and labour mobility in China. Using provincial-industrial panel data from 2006–2019, combining China’s industrial database and IFR robot data, we analyse patterns of labour mobility at both regional and industry levels. To ensure the robustness of the results, we discuss potential collinearity between robot penetration and the minimum wage, as well as the persistence of the relation of the baseline results. Our findings reveal that the minimum wage negatively moderates the positive effect of robots on regional labour mobility while amplifying their impact on inter-industry labour reallocation. Heterogeneity analysis shows these effects are stronger in regions with lower education levels and higher employment rates. Although the minimum wage exhibits no significant lagged effects on regional labour mobility, it demonstrates persistent effects on industrial labour mobility. Long-term analysis further indicates that the minimum wage amplifies robots’ negative influence on regional labour flows while enhancing industrial labour reallocation. These findings suggest the need for coordinated policies that consider both automation trends and regional labour market characteristics when setting the minimum wage.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699944.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了最低工资对中国工业机器人影响劳动力流动的调节效应。基于2006-2019年省级-行业面板数据，结合中国工业数据库与国际机器人联合会（IFR）机器人数据，我们从区域和行业两个层面分析了劳动力流动模式。为确保结果稳健性，我们探讨了机器人渗透率与最低工资之间可能存在的多重共线性问题，以及基准结果关系的持续性。研究发现：最低工资对机器人促进区域劳动力流动的正向效应具有负向调节作用，同时强化了机器人对跨行业劳动力再配置的影响。异质性分析表明，在受教育水平较低、就业率较高的地区，上述调节效应更为显著。尽管最低工资对区域劳动力流动未呈现显著滞后效应，但其对行业间劳动力流动具有持续影响。长期分析进一步显示，最低工资会放大机器人对区域劳动力流动的抑制作用，同时增强行业间劳动力再配置效应。这些发现表明，在制定最低工资标准时，需要统筹考虑自动化发展趋势与区域劳动力市场特征，实施协调性政策。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699944.title: Beyond substitution: the moderating effect of the minimum wage on robot-labour dynamics in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699944.title_zh: 超越替代：最低工资对中国机器人-劳动力动态关系的调节效应

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699945.abstract: Supplier concentration can enhance resource integration efficiency, but it may also increase dependency risks. Therefore, concerning inventory management, which supply chain structure is more advantageous: diversification or centralization? We utilize data from publicly listed firms in China from 2010 to 2024 to empirically examine the impact of supplier concentration on firms’ lean inventory and its potential mechanisms. The results indicate that supplier concentration generally has a positive effect on firms in promoting lean inventory, thereby supporting the theoretical assumptions dominated by transaction cost economics and embeddedness theory. In addition, from the perspectives of information flow, production flow, and capital flow, we verify that supplier concentration promotes lean inventory in firms by reducing coordination costs, alleviating financing constraints, and enhancing total factor productivity. Focusing on the resource dependence theory, we find that corporate strategy, R&D innovation, and regional marketization of firms amplify the positive effect of supplier concentration on lean inventory. Finally, analysis of segmented inventory type data indicates that supplier concentration significantly drives lean practices in raw materials and work-in-progress inventory, while its impact on lean practices related to finished goods inventory is limited.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699945.abstract_zh: 供应商集中度能够提升资源整合效率，但也可能增加依赖风险。因此，在库存管理方面，供应链结构究竟是多元化还是集中化更具优势？我们利用2010至2024年中国上市公司数据，实证检验供应商集中度对企业精益库存的影响及其潜在机制。结果表明，供应商集中度总体上对企业推进精益库存具有正向效应，从而支持了以交易成本经济学和嵌入性理论为主导的理论假设。此外，从信息流、生产流和资金流视角出发，我们验证了供应商集中度通过降低协调成本、缓解融资约束以及提升全要素生产率来促进企业精益库存。基于资源依赖理论，我们发现企业战略、研发创新及区域市场化程度会放大供应商集中度对精益库存的正向效应。最后，对细分库存类型数据的分析表明，供应商集中度显著推动了原材料和在制品库存的精益实践，但对产成品库存精益实践的影响有限。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699945.title: Concentrating or dispersing? The impact of supplier concentration on lean inventory
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699945.title_zh: 集中还是分散？供应商集中度对精益库存的影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2699948.abstract: We use causal forests to examine how public utility broadband providers are associated with broadband adoption and local market structure across 194 counties in Tennessee and Iowa, 38 of which have a public utility broadband provider. Public provider presence is associated with an average 6% point higher broadband adoption share, lower private-carrier market shares, and lower measured market concentration, though the latter partly reflects the mechanical effect of an additional provider on the concentration index. The estimated adoption difference is largest in lower-income and urban counties and in counties where public providers have greater geographic reach and offer lower prices. Given the cross-sectional design, limited number of treated counties, and the observable income imbalance between treated and untreated counties, we interpret these results as a transparent, explicitly associational account of structured heterogeneity in broadband outcomes rather than as causal estimates; sensitivity analyses indicate that the income heterogeneity patterns are not driven solely by the observable selection margin.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699948.abstract_zh: 我们采用因果森林方法，考察公共事业宽带提供商如何与田纳西州和爱荷华州194个县的宽带普及率及本地市场结构相关联，其中38个县拥有公共事业宽带提供商。公共提供商的存在与宽带普及率平均高出6个百分点、私营运营商市场份额降低以及市场集中度下降相关——尽管后者部分反映了新增提供商对集中度指数的机械性影响。宽带普及率差异在低收入县、城市县以及公共提供商地理覆盖范围更广、定价更低的县中最为显著。鉴于本研究采用横截面设计、受处理县数量有限，且受处理县与未受处理县之间存在可观测的收入不平衡，我们将这些结果解读为对宽带结果中结构化异质性的透明、明确关联性描述，而非因果估计；敏感性分析表明，收入异质性模式并非仅由可观测的选择性边界驱动。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699948.title: Making connections: access and market competition with public broadband
10.1080/00036846.2026.2699948.title_zh: 建立连接：公共宽带接入与市场竞争

10.1080/00036846.2026.2701281.title: Steering cities towards net-zero: unravelling the causal impact of green fiscal policy on urban decarbonization in China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701281.title_zh: 引导城市迈向净零排放：揭示绿色财政政策对中国城市脱碳的因果影响

10.1080/00036846.2026.2701282.abstract: Against the backdrop of deepening global climate governance and China’s advancing dual carbon goals, climate risk disclosure has gradually emerged as an important institutional arrangement for firms to respond to climate change and accelerate green transformation. Using a sample of China’s A-share listed firms from 2016 to 2024, this study systematically investigates how climate risk disclosure affects corporate green innovation and explores its underlying mechanisms. The empirical results show that climate risk disclosure exerts a significant positive effect on corporate green innovation. Mechanism analyses confirm the existence of internal resource reallocation channels. Specifically, climate risk disclosure increases firms’ R&D investment and crowds out speculative financial asset holdings. Furthermore, heterogeneity analyses demonstrate that the facilitating effect is more pronounced for firms with severe natural disaster exposure, weaker regional environmental regulation, lower traditional core business risk, higher institutional ownership and less severe financial constraints. These findings enrich the literature on the relationship between climate risk disclosure and corporate green innovation while providing targeted policy and managerial implications for policymakers and firm executives to advance environmental sustainability.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701282.abstract_zh: 在全球气候治理持续深化与中国"双碳"目标稳步推进的背景下，气候风险披露逐渐成为企业应对气候变化、加速绿色转型的重要制度安排。本研究以2016-2024年中国A股上市公司为样本，系统考察气候风险披露对企业绿色创新的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，气候风险披露对企业绿色创新具有显著正向影响。机制分析证实了内部资源再配置渠道的存在：气候风险披露既增加了企业研发投入，又挤出了投机性金融资产持有。进一步异质性分析显示，在自然灾害暴露程度较高、地区环境规制较弱、传统核心业务风险较低、机构投资者持股比例较高以及融资约束程度较轻的企业中，气候风险披露的促进效应更为显著。这些发现丰富了气候风险披露与企业绿色创新关系的文献体系，同时为政策制定者与企业高管推进环境可持续发展提供了针对性的政策启示与管理建议。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701282.title: Does climate risk disclosure promote corporate green innovation? The role of internal resource reallocation
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701282.title_zh: 气候风险披露是否促进企业绿色创新？内部资源再配置的作用

10.1080/00036846.2026.2701284.abstract: While digital innovation (DI) is viewed as a key driver of industrial decarbonization, its environmental impact remains contested. The growing energy demand may induce Jevons-type rebound effects, challenging the sustainability of digital transition. Moving beyond linear and static perspectives, this study integrates dynamic capability theory with the technique-composition-scale framework to examine the nonlinear relationship between DI and carbon emissions (CE). Using panel data from Chinese A-share listed manufacturing firms from 2014 to 2021, the results reveal a robust U-shaped relationship: DI reduces CE in the early stage but increases it after further expansion. This pattern is more pronounced among younger firms and firms in low-energy-intensity sectors. External environmental regulation intensity steepens the curve by accelerating stage transitions, whereas corporate green investment scale acts as an internal buffer, flattening the curve and marginally shifting the turning point rightward. These findings provide stage-adaptive implications for balancing digital transformation with carbon reduction.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701284.abstract_zh: 尽管数字创新被视为工业脱碳的关键驱动力，但其环境影响仍存在争议。日益增长的能源需求可能引发杰文斯型反弹效应，对数字转型的可持续性构成挑战。本研究突破线性与静态视角，将动态能力理论与技术-构成-规模框架相结合，考察数字创新与碳排放之间的非线性关系。基于2014-2021年中国A股制造业上市公司面板数据，结果揭示出稳健的U型关系：数字创新在初期阶段降低碳排放，但进一步扩张后反而增加碳排放。这一模式在年轻企业及低能源强度行业的企业中更为显著。外部环境规制强度通过加速阶段转换使曲线更陡峭，而企业绿色投资规模作为内部缓冲机制则使曲线趋于平缓，并将拐点轻微右移。这些发现为平衡数字化转型与碳减排提供了阶段适应性启示。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701284.title: Digital enabler or carbon culprit? The U-shaped trajectory of digital innovation on carbon emissions
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701284.title_zh: 数字赋能还是碳排元凶？数字创新对碳排放的U型轨迹

10.1080/00036846.2026.2701302.title: Key equipment and technology imports and firm productivity
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701302.title_zh: 关键设备与技术进口与企业生产率

10.1080/00036846.2026.2701325.abstract: This study aims to investigate whether and how industrial internet platform (IIP) adoption translates digital connectivity into measurable green productivity gains at the firm level. Utilizing a comprehensive sample of listed companies in China’s renewable energy sector spanning from 2008 to 2024, we specify a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) model to empirically test the relationship between IIP access and corporate green total factor productivity (GTFP). Our findings demonstrate that IIP adoption significantly enhances GTFP, remaining robust across multiple sensitivity tests. Mechanism analyses reveal that this enhancement is driven primarily by data network effects and digital-first innovation strategies. Furthermore, cross-sectional analyses indicate that the positive impact is more pronounced in firms characterized by lower labour intensity, higher market competition, and lower asset specificity. Based on these findings, we suggest that management should strategically integrate IIP into their internal operations. IIP providers should develop and embed real-time carbon monitoring tools to lower technical barriers for adoption. Policymakers should shift from generic subsidies to targeted interventions, offering specific fiscal incentives to alleviate the high transition costs faced by firms with rigid asset structures.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701325.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探究工业互联网平台（IIP）的采用是否以及如何将数字互联转化为企业层面可测度的绿色生产力提升。基于2008至2024年中国可再生能源行业上市公司的综合样本，我们构建了交错双重差分（DID）模型，实证检验IIP接入与企业绿色全要素生产率（GTFP）之间的关系。研究结果表明，IIP采用显著提升了GTFP，该结论在多项敏感性检验中保持稳健。机制分析揭示，这一提升主要源于数据网络效应与数字优先创新战略。进一步异质性分析显示，在劳动密集度较低、市场竞争程度较高及资产专用性较低的企业中，IIP的积极影响更为显著。基于上述发现，我们建议管理层应将IIP战略性地融入内部运营；IIP提供商应开发并嵌入实时碳监测工具以降低采用技术门槛；政策制定者应从普惠式补贴转向精准干预，通过提供针对性财政激励措施，缓解资产结构僵化企业面临的高额转型成本。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701325.title: Industrial internet and green total factor productivity: evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in China’s renewable energy industry
10.1080/00036846.2026.2701325.title_zh: 工业互联网与绿色全要素生产率：来自中国可再生能源行业准自然实验的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2702112.title: Data trading platforms and corporate information disclosure quality: evidence from China
10.1080/00036846.2026.2702112.title_zh: 数据交易平台与企业信息披露质量：来自中国的证据

10.1080/00036846.2026.2702114.abstract: This study explores the high- and low-volatility spillover effects and portfolio allocation from a frequency-domain perspective across the stock, bond, forex, gold, and oil markets. Specifically, we decompose realized volatility into high- and low-volatility regimes and analyse volatility spillovers from both short- and long-term components using the TVP-VAR frequency connectedness approach. In addition, we employ four portfolio strategies to evaluate cumulative returns and hedging effectiveness. This results reveal significant differences in spillover effects between high- and low-volatility networks: short-term spillovers dominate in high-volatility networks, whereas long-term spillovers are the main contributors in low-volatility networks. Furthermore, the portfolio constructed using the minimum connectedness approach (MCoP) exhibits the highest cumulative returns, whereas the minimum variance portfolio (MVP) and risk parity portfolio (RPP) achieve stronger hedging effectiveness. Overall, this study highlights the importance of jointly considering volatility intensity and time-frequency characteristics when assessing cross-market risk transmission and designing portfolio strategies.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2702114.abstract_zh: 本研究从频域视角探讨了股票、债券、外汇、黄金及石油市场间的高、低波动溢出效应与资产配置策略。具体而言，我们将已实现波动率分解为高波动与低波动状态，并采用TVP-VAR频域关联方法，从短期与长期成分两个维度分析波动溢出效应。此外，我们运用四种投资组合策略评估累计收益与对冲有效性。研究结果显示，高波动与低波动网络中的溢出效应存在显著差异：高波动网络中短期溢出占主导地位，而低波动网络中长期溢出为主要贡献因素。进一步发现，基于最小关联法构建的投资组合（MCoP）具有最高的累计收益，而最小方差组合（MVP）与风险平价组合（RPP）则展现出更强的对冲有效性。总体而言，本研究强调了在评估跨市场风险传导与设计投资组合策略时，需同时考虑波动强度与时间-频率特征的重要性。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2702114.title: Financial market high-low volatility spillover and portfolio allocation: a time frequency analysis
10.1080/00036846.2026.2702114.title_zh: 金融市场高低波动溢出与投资组合配置：时频分析

10.1080/00036846.2026.2703828.title_zh: 碳价格与企业创新资源的错配

10.1080/00036846.2026.2703829.abstract: This article analyses the notion of Ecological Rationality in the context of decision making under uncertainty. It suggests that constructivist approaches, namely constructivist rationality, are not adapted to solve problems faced in the real ecological environments, which imply large world problems and intractability. The complexity of the decision problems imply search and information costs and thus heuristics, as exhibited by human decision makers might be optimal. It is suggested that inverse S-shaped probability weighting as exhibited by most decision makers might be optimal when facing real world environments. It is shown that the maximum entropy approach can be used to model such kind of behaviour as an approximation to the inverse S-shaped probability weighting. It is argued that this approach is ecologically rational and that such a heuristic can be used to treat financial and econometric decision problems and be a calibrated to decision-makers ambiguity aversion.
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703829.abstract_zh: 本文分析了不确定性决策背景下“生态理性”的概念。研究指出，建构主义方法（即建构理性）并不适用于解决真实生态环境中的问题，这类问题涉及“大世界”困境与不可解性。决策问题的复杂性意味着搜索成本与信息成本的存在，因此人类决策者所展现的启发式策略可能具有最优性。研究表明，多数决策者表现出的反S形概率权重在真实环境决策中可能具有最优性。本文论证了最大熵方法可作为反S形概率权重的近似模型来模拟此类行为，并指出该路径具有生态理性特征，可应用于金融与计量经济决策问题，同时能校准决策者的模糊厌恶倾向。
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703829.title: Ecological rationality and the maximum entropy heuristic
10.1080/00036846.2026.2703829.title_zh: 生态理性与最大熵启发式

10.1086/733049.abstract: Many workers are evaluated on their ability to engage with customers. We measure the impact of gender-based customer discrimination on the productivity of online sales agents in sub-Saharan Africa. Using a novel framework that randomly varies the gender of names presented to customers without changing worker behavior, we find the assignment of a female-sounding name leads to 50 percent fewer purchases. Customers also lag in responding, are less expressive, and avoid discussing purchases. We show similar results for customers around the world and across workers. Removing customer bias, we find women would be more productive than their male coworkers.
10.1086/733049.abstract_zh: 许多工人的工作表现取决于其与客户互动的能力。本研究衡量了基于性别的客户歧视对撒哈拉以南非洲地区在线销售代理生产率的影响。通过采用一种新颖的实验框架——在不改变工人实际行为的前提下，随机向客户展示不同性别的姓名——我们发现，使用女性化姓名会导致购买量减少50%。客户不仅回复延迟、表达更不积极，还会回避讨论购买事宜。全球范围内的客户及不同工人群体均呈现类似结果。若消除客户偏见，女性工人的生产率将高于其男性同事。
10.1086/733049.title: Customer Discrimination in the Workplace: Evidence from Online Sales
10.1086/733049.title_zh: 职场中的顾客歧视：来自在线销售的证据

10.1086/733051.abstract: We characterize the joint evolution of cross-sectional inequality in earnings, other sources of income and consumption across generations in the U.S. To account for cross-sectional dispersion, we estimate a model of intergenerational persistence and separately identify the influences of parental factors and of idiosyncratic life-cycle components. We find evidence of family persistence in earnings, consumption and saving behaviours, and marital sorting patterns. However, the quantitative contribution of idiosyncratic heterogeneity to cross-sectional inequality is significantly larger than parental effects. Our estimates imply that intergenerational persistence is not high enough to induce further large increases in inequality over time and across generations.
10.1086/733051.abstract_zh: 本文刻画了美国跨代际收入、其他收入来源及消费截面不平等性的联合演变特征。为解释截面离散程度，我们构建了代际持续性模型，并分别识别了父母因素与个体生命周期异质性成分的影响。研究发现，收入、消费与储蓄行为存在家族持续性特征，同时婚姻匹配模式亦呈现代际传递性。然而，个体异质性对截面不平等的量化贡献显著大于父母效应。我们的估计表明，代际持续性尚未达到足以引发跨时期与跨代际不平等进一步大幅加剧的程度。
10.1086/733051.title: Consumption and Income Inequality across Generations
10.1086/733051.title_zh: 代际消费与收入不平等

10.1086/733225.title: Instrumental Variables with Unordered Treatments: Theory and Evidence from          Returns to Fields of Study
10.1086/733225.title_zh: 无序处理工具变量：理论及基于专业回报的实证证据

10.1086/733226.abstract: We analyze trends in labor-market returns to psychological traits using data from half a million Finnish men from 2001 to 2015. Cognitive skills' value declined, while noncognitive skills' value increased. Our novel findings show that extraversion drives this rise, while conscientiousness remains stable. Extraversion's rising returns are most pronounced for lower earners and those on the employment margin. These traits predict different labor market paths: extraversion predicts lower education and more work experience, while cognitive ability and conscientiousness lead to higher education and high-paying jobs.
10.1086/733226.abstract_zh: 我们利用2001年至2015年50万芬兰男性的数据，分析了劳动力市场对心理特质的回报趋势。认知技能的价值下降，而非认知技能的价值上升。我们的新发现表明，外向性推动了这一上升趋势，而尽责性则保持稳定。外向性回报率的上升在低收入者和就业边缘人群中最为显著。这些特质预测了不同的劳动力市场路径：外向性预示着较低的教育水平和更多的工作经验，而认知能力和尽责性则导向更高的教育水平和高薪工作。
10.1086/733226.title: Beyond IQ: The Rising Value of Extraversion
10.1086/733226.title_zh: 超越智商：外向性的价值上升

10.1086/733490.abstract: Using Danish registry data linked to the Labor Force Survey, we provide the first rigorous evidence with external validity on the hours-career nexus (positive association between hours and career success). Guided by three theories (human capital; rat race; tournament), we unpack the hours-career nexus through examining: the differential effect of hours in the present firm and elsewhere; hours relative to peers’ hours; standard vs. evening/night/weekend hours; and the importance of sustaining long hours. Supplemented by the time use survey, we show the gender gap in hours and career success is due mostly to gendered division of labor in household production.
10.1086/733490.abstract_zh: 利用丹麦登记数据与劳动力调查的关联，我们首次提供了关于工时与职业发展关联（即工时与职业成功之间的正相关关系）且具有外部效度的严谨证据。基于三种理论（人力资本理论、竞争性工作理论、锦标赛理论），我们通过以下维度解析工时与职业发展的关联：当前企业内工时与其他企业工时的差异化效应；工时相对于同行的相对水平；标准工时与晚间/夜间/周末工时的差异；以及持续超长工时的重要性。结合时间使用调查数据，我们揭示工时与职业成功中的性别差异主要源于家庭生产中的性别分工。
10.1086/733490.title: Working Hours, Top Management Appointments, and Gender: Evidence from Linked Employer-Employee Data
10.1086/733490.title_zh: 工作时间、高管任命与性别：基于雇主-雇员匹配数据的证据

10.1086/733493.abstract: Using full count US census data, we study the impact of early twentieth-century state-industry-specific minimum wage laws that primarily targeted female employees. Our triple-difference estimates suggest a null impact of the minimum wage laws, potentially reflecting disemployment effects and the positive selection bias of the workers remaining in the labor force. When comparing county-industry trends between counties straddling state borders, female employment is lower by around 3.1% in affected county-industry cells. We further investigate the implications for own-wage elasticity of labor demand as a function of cross-industry concentration, the channels of substitution between men and women, and heterogeneity by marital status.
10.1086/733493.abstract_zh: 利用美国人口普查全量数据，本文研究了20世纪初主要针对女性雇员的州-行业特定最低工资法的影响。三重差分估计结果表明，最低工资法的影响为零，这可能反映了就业抑制效应以及留在劳动力队伍中的工人存在的正向选择偏差。通过比较州界两侧县-行业层面的趋势，受影响县-行业单元的女性就业率下降约3.1%。我们进一步探讨了劳动力需求的自工资弹性如何随跨行业集中度变化、男女替代渠道以及婚姻状况异质性。
10.1086/733493.title: The Economics of Gender-Specific Minimum Wage Legislation
10.1086/733493.title_zh: 性别特定最低工资立法的经济学分析

10.1086/733494.title: Does Monitoring Change Teacher Pedagogy and Student Outcomes?
10.1086/733494.title_zh: 监督是否改变了教师教学法和学生成果？

10.1086/734087.abstract: Firstborns, on average, complete more education than laterborns. We study whether individuals’ endowments measured by genetic information amplify this effect. Our familyfixed effects approach allows exploiting exogenous variation in birth order and genetic endowments among 14,850 siblings in the UK Biobank. We find that those with higher genetic endowments benefit disproportionately more from being firstborn compared to those with lower endowments, providing a clean example of how nature and nurture interact in producing human capital. Since parental investments are a dominant channel driving birth order effects, our results are consistent with complementarity between endowments and investments in human capital formation.
10.1086/734087.abstract_zh: 平均而言，头胎子女比后生子女完成更多教育。我们研究以遗传信息衡量的个体禀赋是否会放大这一效应。通过采用家庭固定效应方法，我们利用英国生物银行中14,850名兄弟姐妹在出生顺序和遗传禀赋上的外生变异进行分析。研究发现，与低遗传禀赋者相比，高遗传禀赋者从作为头胎子女中获得的收益显著更大——这为先天禀赋与后天培养如何相互作用以形成人力资本提供了清晰例证。由于父母投资是驱动出生顺序效应的主导渠道，我们的结果与禀赋与人力资本形成投资之间的互补性假说一致。
10.1086/734087.title: Gene-Environment Complementarity in Educational Attainment
10.1086/734087.title_zh: 教育成就中的基因-环境互补性

10.1086/738415.title_zh: COVID-19、危机与女性资源控制：来自墨西哥的证据

10.1086/738579.title_zh: 利比里亚阅读表现提升的理解：探究文本的核心作用

10.1086/738610.title: Workplace Attributes and Women’s Labor Supply Decisions: Evidence from a          Randomized Experiment
10.1086/738610.title_zh: 工作场所属性与女性劳动供给决策：来自随机实验的证据

10.1086/739049.abstract: This paper investigates the marriage market returns to female education by examining the resources transferred from the groom to the bride and her family at the time of marriage, known as the bride price, as well as the husband’s imputed permanent income as an additional source of returns. The study exploits a school reform in Egypt that reduced the number of years required to complete primary education from six to five, creating exogenous variations in the timing of treatment across schools due to its staggered roll-out. To address identification issues, an instrumental variable estimator combined with a Two-Way Fixed Effects (TWFE) model at the birth year and primary school levels is employed. The findings reveal that the estimated return on a bride’s compulsory education is over three times higher in bride price and 20% higher in the husband’s imputed permanent income compared to those without compulsory education. These substantial marriage market returns outweigh labor market returns at the extensive margin of employment. Further empirical evidence suggests that higher female education potentially signals positive outcomes in terms of home production and child-rearing in Egypt, while educational assortative mating also appears to be an important mechanism.
10.1086/739049.abstract_zh: 本文通过考察婚礼上新郎向新娘及其家庭转移的资源（即彩礼），以及丈夫的估算永久收入作为额外回报来源，探究女性教育的婚姻市场回报。研究利用埃及一项将小学教育年限从六年缩短至五年的学校改革，该改革因分阶段推行而在不同学校间产生了外生的处理时间差异。为解决识别问题，本研究采用工具变量估计法，并结合出生年份和小学层面的双向固定效应模型。结果显示，与未接受义务教育的女性相比，接受义务教育的女性在彩礼方面的估计回报高出三倍以上，在丈夫估算永久收入方面的回报高出20%。这些显著的婚姻市场回报在就业的广延边际上超过了劳动力市场回报。进一步的实证证据表明，在埃及，更高的女性教育水平可能在家务劳动和育儿方面传递积极信号，同时教育同型婚配也是一个重要机制。

10.1086/739150.abstract: We conducted a randomized experiment to study the impacts of a summer learning camp and the language of instruction on education outcomes. The program, covering social studies and mathematics, provided additional high-quality learning time for 4th and 5th graders in Malawi. The program significantly increased test scores in social studies and mathematics (0.24–0.36 standard deviations). We find suggestive evidence that the impact on test scores in social studies was greater for students instructed in Chichewa, the local language, than for those instructed in English. However, we find no such evidence of differential impacts on test scores in mathematics by the language of instruction.
10.1086/739150.abstract_zh: 我们开展了一项随机实验，研究暑期学习营及教学语言对教育成果的影响。该项目涵盖社会研究和数学课程，为马拉维四、五年级学生提供了额外的高质量学习时间。实验结果显示，该项目显著提升了学生在社会研究和数学方面的测试成绩（效应量为0.24–0.36个标准差）。我们初步发现，以当地语言奇契瓦语授课的学生在社会研究测试成绩上的提升幅度大于以英语授课的学生。然而，在数学测试成绩方面，未发现教学语言导致差异化影响的证据。

10.1086/739610.abstract: Balanced experimental designs, in which the number of treatment and control units are the same, do not maximize power subject to a cost constraint when treatment units are more expensive than control ones. Despite this, such balanced designs are the norm in economics. This paper describes methods to optimally choose the number of treatment and control clusters, and the number of units within treatment and control clusters, allowing for full flexibility. We use three archetypal examples from the development literature to illustrate the magnitude of the power gains, which lie between 7.9 and 19.0 percentage points.
10.1086/739610.abstract_zh: 当处理组单位成本高于对照组时，平衡实验设计（即处理组与对照组单位数量相等）在成本约束下无法实现统计功效最大化。然而，此类平衡设计仍是经济学研究的常态。本文提出在完全灵活条件下，最优选择处理组与对照组集群数量及其内部单位数量的方法。我们采用发展经济学文献中的三个典型案例，展示统计功效的提升幅度介于7.9至19.0个百分点之间。

10.1086/740223.abstract: We state a sufficient condition under which choice data alone suffices to identify consumer preferences when choices are not fully informed. Suppose that: (i) the data generating process is a search model in which the attribute hidden to consumers is observed by the econometrician; (ii) if a consumer searches good j, she also searches goods which are better than j in terms of the non-hidden component of utility; and (iii) consumers choose the good that maximizes overall utility among searched goods. Canonical models will be biased: the value of the hidden attribute will be understated because consumers will be unresponsive to variation in the attribute for goods that they do not search. Under the conditions above and additional mild restrictions, an alternative method of recovering preferences using cross derivatives of choice probabilities succeeds regardless of the search protocol and is thus robust to whether consumers are informed. The approach nests several standard models, including full information. Our methods suggest natural tests for full information and can be used to forecast how consumers will respond to additional information. We verify in a lab experiment that our approach succeeds in recovering preferences when consumers engage in costly search.
10.1086/740223.abstract_zh: 我们给出一个充分条件，在此条件下，当消费者选择并非完全知情时，仅凭选择数据即可识别消费者偏好。假设：（i）数据生成过程是一个搜索模型，其中消费者未观察到的属性被计量经济学家观察到；（ii）若消费者搜索商品j，则她也会搜索在效用的非隐藏成分方面优于j的商品；（iii）消费者在已搜索商品中选择总效用最大化的商品。经典模型将存在偏误：隐藏属性的价值会被低估，因为消费者对未搜索商品的属性变化无反应。在上述条件及额外温和限制下，一种利用选择概率的交叉导数来恢复偏好的替代方法，无论搜索协议如何均能成功，因此对消费者是否知情具有稳健性。该方法涵盖包括完全信息在内的若干标准模型。我们的方法为完全信息提供了自然检验，并可预测消费者如何响应额外信息。我们通过实验室实验验证，当消费者进行有成本搜索时，该方法能成功恢复其偏好。

10.1086/741602.abstract: Policy makers frequently champion information provision about carbon impact on the premise that consumers are willing to mitigate their emissions but are poorly informed about how to do so. We empirically test this argument and reject it. We collect an extensive new dataset and find both large misperceptions of the carbon impact of different consumption behaviors and clear preferences for mitigation. Yet, in two separate experiments, we show that correcting beliefs has no effect on consumption in large representative samples. Our null results are well-powered and informative, as we target information for maximal impact. These results call into question the potential of correcting carbon footprint misperceptions as a tool to fight climate change.
10.1086/741602.abstract_zh: 政策制定者常以消费者愿意减少碳排放但缺乏相关知识为前提，主张提供碳影响信息。我们通过实证检验了这一论点并予以否定。通过收集大量新数据集，我们发现消费者对不同消费行为的碳影响存在严重认知偏差，同时具有明确的减排偏好。然而，在两项独立实验中，我们证明纠正认知偏差对大规模代表性样本的消费行为并无影响。我们的零结果具有充分统计效力且富有信息量，因为所提供的信息针对的是最大影响目标。这些结果对将纠正碳足迹认知偏差作为应对气候变化工具的有效性提出了质疑。

10.1086/741830.abstract: We estimate the effect of competition on incumbent firm pricing by using high frequency price data and the precise geographic location for all gas stations in California. Using an event study design, we find that the entry of a new station is associated with a 2.5 cent decrease in prices at incumbent stores, which equates to a 7% reduction in estimated retail markups. The effects are immediate, persistent, and show no sign of deterrence or limit pricing behavior. In contrast, nearby exit results in precisely estimated null effects on prices with no evidence of predatory pricing in the lead up to the station departure. The results are consistent across all fuel blends and dissipate with station distance. Finally, we explore the asymmetric effects, showing that the difference cannot be attributed to difference in branding, proximity to highway, or data quality idiosyncrasies, although we find suggestive evidence that exit tends to happen in more competitive markets and amongst less heavily trafficked stations.
10.1086/741830.abstract_zh: 我们利用高频价格数据和加利福尼亚州所有加油站的精确地理位置，估算了竞争对现有企业定价的影响。通过事件研究设计，我们发现新加油站的进入导致现有门店价格下降2.5美分，相当于零售加价幅度减少7%。这种影响是即时且持久的，没有表现出任何威慑或限制性定价行为的迹象。相比之下，附近加油站的退出对价格产生了精确估计的零效应，且在退出前未发现掠夺性定价的证据。所有燃料混合物的结果均一致，并随距离增加而减弱。最后，我们探讨了非对称效应，表明这种差异不能归因于品牌差异、高速公路邻近性或数据质量特性，尽管我们发现了暗示性证据，即退出往往发生在竞争更激烈的市场以及交通流量较少的加油站中。

10.1086/742939.abstract: This paper utilizes wealth shocks from winning lottery prizes to examine the causal effect of financial resources on fertility. We employ extensive panels of administrative data encompassing over 0.4 million lottery winners in Taiwan and implement a triple-differences design. Our analyses reveal that a substantial lottery win can significantly increase fertility, the implied wealth elasticity of which is around 0.06. Moreover, the primary channel through which fertility increases is by prompting first births among previously childless individuals. Finally, our analysis reveals that approximately 25% of the total fertility effect stems from increased marriage rates following a lottery win.
10.1086/742939.abstract_zh: 本文利用中奖彩票带来的财富冲击，考察金融资源对生育率的因果效应。我们采用涵盖台湾地区超过40万彩票中奖者的广泛行政数据面板，并实施三重差分设计。分析表明，大额彩票中奖能显著提高生育率，其隐含的财富弹性约为0.06。此外，生育率提升的主要渠道是促使此前无子女的个体生育头胎。最后，我们的分析揭示，约25%的总生育效应源于中奖后结婚率的上升。

10.1086/742941.abstract: Using multiple administrative data sources from Norway, we examine how firm performance changes after entrepreneurs become parents.Female-owned businesses experience a substantial decline in profits, steadily decreasing to 30% below baseline ten years post-childbirth.In contrast, male-owned businesses show no decline, often growing in revenues and costs after childbirth.The profit decline for female-owned firms is most pronounced among highly capable entrepreneurs, women who are majority owners, and those with working spouses.Entrepreneurial effort is key to performance, and our findings suggest that time demands from childbirth and childcare are a significant determinant of the decline in firm profits.
10.1086/742941.abstract_zh: 利用挪威的多项行政数据来源，我们考察了企业家成为父母后企业绩效的变化。女性拥有的企业在利润上出现显著下降，产后十年内利润持续下滑至基准水平的30%。相比之下，男性拥有的企业未出现下降，且在产后收入和成本往往有所增长。女性企业利润下降在能力较强的企业家、女性占多数股权的所有者以及配偶有工作的群体中最为明显。创业努力是绩效的关键因素，我们的研究结果表明，生育和育儿的时间需求是导致企业利润下降的重要决定因素。

10.1086/743072.abstract: This paper examines the impact of immigration on natives' social trust in the context of China's mass internal migration. Combining individual-level information on social trust and county-level information on immigration rate, we employ the instrumental variable strategy and find that immigration has a significant negative impact on trust among native residents. The impact of immigration on trust is more salient for trust in weak ties than trust in strong ties, and from a compositional perspective, the impact of low-skilled immigrants is more salient than that of high-skilled immigrants. Additional analyses suggest that better public services can buffer the impact of immigration on trust, implying a key role in public policy.
10.1086/743072.abstract_zh: 本文以中国大规模内部人口迁移为背景，考察移民对本地居民社会信任的影响。通过结合个体层面的社会信任数据与县级层面的移民率信息，采用工具变量策略发现：移民对本地居民的社会信任具有显著的负向影响。从信任类型来看，移民对弱关系信任的冲击强于强关系信任；从移民结构来看，低技能移民的影响比高技能移民更为显著。进一步分析表明，更优质的公共服务能够缓冲移民对信任的冲击，这揭示了公共政策在此过程中的关键作用。

10.1093/ej/ueag064.abstract: Abstract Reducing gender-specific commuting barriers in developing countries can have heterogeneous effects on women’s labor outcomes. We study a program that offers free bus rides for women in several Indian states (the Pink Slip program) using a synthetic difference-in-differences approach to examine impacts on transportation expenditures, time use, and labor supply. We find that the program substantially reduces bus-related expenditures. However, when considering all women together, we find no significant changes in travel time, household production, or labor supply. Beneath these aggregate effects, responses vary sharply by employment, marital status, and education. Unmarried women employed prior to the policy increase labor supply, while married women with low and medium levels of education reallocate time away from paid work toward household chores. Overall employment rates remain unchanged in the short run, highlighting that reducing commuting costs does not uniformly improve women’s labor market outcomes.
10.1093/ej/ueag064.abstract_zh: 摘要：在发展中国家，减少针对性别差异的通勤障碍可能对女性的劳动结果产生异质性影响。我们利用合成双重差分法，研究印度多个邦实施的女性免费公交乘车计划（“粉红票”计划），分析其对交通支出、时间利用和劳动供给的影响。研究发现，该计划显著降低了与公交相关的支出。然而，从全体女性来看，通勤时间、家务生产或劳动供给并未发生显著变化。在这些总体效应之下，不同群体的反应因就业状况、婚姻状况和教育水平而存在显著差异。政策实施前已有工作的未婚女性增加了劳动供给，而中低教育水平的已婚女性则将时间从有偿工作转向家务劳动。总体就业率在短期内保持不变，这表明降低通勤成本并不能一致地改善女性的劳动力市场结果。

10.1093/ej/ueag070.abstract: This Special Issue of The Economic Journal brings together papers at the frontier of dynamic, spatial and heterogeneous-agent structural modelling for the study of climate change and climate policy. These models are designed to be consistent with the fundamentals of climate science and to be calibrated and/or taken to the data. In this respect, Eftekhari, Folini, Friedl, Kubler, Scheidegger and Schenk contribute a methodological paper to the Issue, developing efficient climate emulators that can be embedded within economic models of climate change. Centring on the link between climate change and inequality, the papers in the Issue span different, and often complementary, dimensions of heterogeneity in the effects of climate change and various mitigation policies, most notably carbon taxes. Taken together, they show that the distributional consequences of climate action depend crucially on where a policy is implemented, how markets transmit shocks across regions and countries, and which households or regions are most exposed through income, wealth, consumption baskets, production structures or demographic characteristics.
10.1093/ej/ueag070.abstract_zh: 《经济学期刊》本期特刊汇集了运用动态、空间及异质性主体结构模型研究气候变化与气候政策的前沿论文。这些模型旨在与气候科学基本原理保持一致，并经过校准和/或实证数据验证。基于此，Eftekhari、Folini、Friedl、Kubler、Scheidegger与Schenk为本期特刊贡献了一篇方法论论文，开发了可嵌入气候变化经济模型的高效气候模拟器。围绕气候变化与不平等之间的关联，本期论文涵盖了气候变化及各类减缓政策（尤其是碳税）影响中不同且常具互补性的异质性维度。综合来看，这些研究表明：气候行动分配效应的关键取决于政策实施地点、市场如何跨区域和国家传导冲击，以及哪些家庭或地区通过收入、财富、消费篮子、生产结构或人口特征面临最大风险。

10.1093/ej/ueag078.abstract: Abstract Rising polarisation heightens concerns about politicising regulatory agencies, prompting reassessment of the accountability–independence trade-off. We study whether perceived out-group oversight affects trust in regulation and market behaviour. Using US television transcripts, we show that media link agencies with presidents. We then conduct a field experiment (N=5,566) using a case where the EPA endorsed antibiotic spraying on citrus crops during both Trump’s and Biden’s presidencies. Holding science constant, out-group oversight reduces support for spraying by 26%, lowers trust in EPA’s evaluation, and increases donations to an opposing NGO by 15%. In an obfuscated follow-up, citrus demand is unchanged, but effects differ by consumption habits.
10.1093/ej/ueag078.abstract_zh: 摘要 日益加剧的政治极化引发了对监管机构政治化的担忧，促使人们重新审视问责与独立之间的权衡。本文研究了感知到的外群体监督是否会影响公众对监管的信任及市场行为。通过分析美国电视新闻转录文本，我们发现媒体常将监管机构与总统关联。随后，我们以美国环保署（EPA）在特朗普和拜登总统任期内均批准在柑橘作物上喷洒抗生素的案例为基础，开展了一项实地实验（样本量N=5,566）。在保持科学依据不变的情况下，外群体监督使受访者对喷洒措施的支持率下降26%，对EPA评估的信任度降低，并向反对该措施的NGO捐款增加15%。在一项隐蔽的后续实验中，柑橘需求未发生显著变化，但不同消费习惯群体的反应存在差异。
10.1093/ej/ueag078.title: Politics of Food: An Experiment on Trust in Expert Regulation and Economic Costs of Political Polarisation

10.1093/ej/ueag079.abstract: Abstract The well-known cashless-limiting result in Woodford (1998) has become the theoretical foundation for a large body of work that treats the costs and benefits of holding money as irrelevant for monetary transmission. I reexamine this result and find that it relies on a peculiar credit-market structure consisting of perfectly competitive, zero-interest deferred payment arrangements. I show that the result breaks down when the microstructure is generalized to allow for an endogenous interest rate and market power in credit intermediation. The tenuousness of this influential result should give pause to the widespread practice of basing monetary policy advice on models without money.
10.1093/ej/ueag079.abstract_zh: 摘要 伍德福德（1998）中著名的无现金限制性结论已成为大量研究的理论基础，这些研究将持有货币的成本与收益视为与货币政策传导无关。本文重新审视了这一结论，发现其依赖于一种特殊的信贷市场结构，即完全竞争、零利率的延期支付安排。研究表明，当微观结构被推广至允许内生利率和信贷中介市场势力时，该结论不再成立。这一具有影响力的结论的脆弱性，应当让广泛基于无货币模型提供货币政策建议的做法有所反思。

onetary Economics

10.1093/ej/ueag080.abstract: Abstract Consider the transition out of a stagnant Malthusian system spearheaded by high-human-capital people. Individuals with a stronger preference for offspring quality may be the first to escape the Malthusian regime and adopt modern fertility behaviours (Galor and Moav 2002). To test this hypothesis, we examine the relationship between family size and human capital among academics in Northern Europe in the two centuries before the Industrial Revolution. We measure the human capital of academics using a novel approach based on their publications. We find that scholars with a higher number of publications than the median shifted from having more siblings to having fewer siblings in the first half of the 18th century. Estimating the parameters of an evolutionary growth model by indirect inference, we show how Malthusian constraints initially led the high human capital families to reproduce more, before being endogenously replaced by Beckerian constraints with a tradeoff between child quality and quantity. Our results support an extension of Galor and Moav’s (2002) approach, in which the decline of Malthusian constraints is linked to the accumulation of human capital during the 18th century.
10.1093/ej/ueag080.abstract_zh: 摘要 考虑一个由高人力资本个体引领的、摆脱停滞马尔萨斯体系的转型过程。对后代质量有更强偏好的个体可能率先脱离马尔萨斯体制，并采纳现代生育行为（Galor and Moav 2002）。为检验这一假说，我们考察了工业革命前两个世纪北欧学者家庭规模与人力资本之间的关系。我们采用基于学者出版物的创新方法衡量其人力资本。研究发现，在18世纪上半叶，出版数量高于中位数的学者从拥有更多兄弟姐妹转变为拥有更少兄弟姐妹。通过间接推断法估计演化增长模型参数，我们展示了马尔萨斯约束最初如何导致高人力资本家庭生育更多子女，随后被内生的贝克尔约束（子女质量与数量权衡）所取代。我们的研究结果支持对Galor and Moav（2002）理论的拓展，即马尔萨斯约束的衰退与18世纪人力资本的积累密切相关。
10.1093/ej/ueag080.title: The Emergence of the Child Quantity-Quality Tradeoff - insights from early modern academics
10.1093/ej/ueag080.title_zh: 儿童数量与质量权衡的出现——来自近代早期学术界的洞见

10.1093/ej/ueag081.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Ten years of idiosyncratic variation in school closure dates for all secondary schools in England are combined with administrative records of educational and criminal trajectories linked at the individual level to study the impact of the school schedule on the dynamics of youth crime. When school is not in session, students commit more property offences, more serious violent offences and fewer minor violent offences. Increased thefts, robberies and violent assaults drive these effects. This is novel evidence of strong multiple crime effects that arise from the protective factor of schooling and which affect not only the incidence of violence, but also its severity and its targets.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag081.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文利用英格兰所有中学十年间因特殊原因导致的停课日期变化，结合个体层面关联的教育与犯罪轨迹行政记录，研究学校作息安排对青少年犯罪动态的影响。当学校停课时，学生实施的财产犯罪、严重暴力犯罪增加，而轻微暴力犯罪减少。盗窃、抢劫和暴力袭击的增加是导致这些效应的主要原因。本研究首次提供了强有力的多重犯罪效应证据，这些效应源于学校教育的保护性因素，不仅影响暴力犯罪的发生率，还影响其严重程度及目标对象。
10.1093/ej/ueag081.title: Youth Crime and Delinquency In And Out Of School
10.1093/ej/ueag081.title_zh: 青少年犯罪与逃学及在校行为

10.1093/ej/ueag082.abstract: Abstract I combine newly digitized data on confidence votes, party switches, and tax returns of Italian MPs from 2001 to 2022 to study how tenure-dependent benefits influence politicians’ behaviour and government stability. Using a difference-in-discontinuities design, I find that a tenure requirement for parliamentary pensions introduced in 2008 increased confidence votes for the government, switches to majority parties, and legislative effort. Consistent with agency model predictions, the policy discouraged internal party defiance that could jeopardize reelection chances and pension eligibility for a second term. Tenure requirements increase government stability but also strengthen party control, with ambiguous effects on voters’ welfare.
10.1093/ej/ueag082.abstract_zh: 摘要 我整合了2001年至2022年意大利议员的信任投票、政党转换及纳税申报新数字化数据，研究任期相关福利如何影响政治人物行为与政府稳定性。通过断点回归差分设计，我发现2008年引入的议会养老金任期要求增加了对政府的信任投票、向多数党转换的比例以及立法努力。与委托代理模型预测一致，该政策抑制了可能危及连任机会及第二任期养老金资格的内部政党反抗。任期要求提升了政府稳定性，但也强化了政党控制，对选民福利产生模糊影响。
10.1093/ej/ueag082.title: The Impact of Tenure-Dependent Benefits on Government Stability
10.1093/ej/ueag082.title_zh: 任期相关福利对政府稳定性的影响

10.1093/ej/ueag084.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We examine child mental health treatment surrounding three school milestones in Taiwan: Middle school entry, high stakes testing for high school entrance, and college entrance exams. Using age cutoffs for school entry, we compare August-born to September-born children since the August-born reach each milestone one year earlier. Comparing adjacent cohorts of children born in the same month yields similar estimates. We find that entry into middle school increases mental health prescribing of antidepressant, anti-anxiety, and antipsychotic medications. Use of psychiatric medications falls sharply following high-stakes tests. Effects are stronger in counties where parents and children have higher educational aspirations.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag084.abstract_zh: 我们考察了台湾地区三个学校关键节点前后的儿童心理健康治疗情况：初中入学、高中入学高利害考试以及大学入学考试。利用入学年龄截止日期，我们比较了八月出生与九月出生的儿童，因为八月出生的儿童在每个关键节点上比九月出生的儿童早一年。对同月出生的相邻队列进行比较，得出了相似的估计结果。我们发现，进入初中增加了抗抑郁药、抗焦虑药和抗精神病药等精神药物的处方量。高利害考试后，精神药物的使用量急剧下降。在父母和子女教育期望更高的县市，这种效应更为显著。
10.1093/ej/ueag084.title: School milestones impact child mental health in Taiwan
10.1093/ej/ueag084.title_zh: 台湾学龄里程碑对儿童心理健康的影响

10.1093/ej/ueag085.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper develops a framework for monetary policy normalization in which liquidity conditions shape aggregate demand through a liquidity channel. The model implies that central bank balance sheet operations can stabilize demand even away from the zero lower bound, making reserves an independent policy instrument alongside interest rates. Optimal balance sheet size therefore depends not only on private reserve demand, but also on fiscal interactions and liquidity management. Following shocks that generate a liquidity trap, optimal policy expands reserves at the lower bound, initiates quantitative tightening before rate liftoff, and normalizes rates and reserves together, clarifying balance sheets’ stabilization role.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag085.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个货币政策正常化框架，其中流动性状况通过流动性渠道影响总需求。模型表明，即使远离零利率下限，央行资产负债表操作也能稳定需求，使准备金与利率并列为独立政策工具。因此，最优资产负债表规模不仅取决于私人准备金需求，还受财政互动与流动性管理的影响。在引发流动性陷阱的冲击发生后，最优政策在零利率下限扩大准备金，在加息启动前实施量化紧缩，并同步推进利率与准备金正常化，从而阐明资产负债表的稳定作用。
10.1093/ej/ueag085.title: Managing Monetary Policy Normalization

10.1093/ej/ueag086.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study the relationship between interpersonal trust and political stability in democratic countries. Using an annual country-level panel dataset covering six decades, we find that recessions are more likely to cause political turnover in countries with lower levels of generalised interpersonal trust. The effect is present in democracies and not autocracies, for turnovers occurring through regular procedures and not coups, and during regularly scheduled election years. We find an analogous connection between trust and leader turnover during recessions when looking across sub-national regions in Europe, across counties in the United States, and across individuals in U.S. counties. Our results highlight the crucial role of generalised trust in ensuring political stability during times of economic turmoil.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag086.abstract_zh: 我们研究了民主国家中人际信任与政治稳定性之间的关系。利用涵盖六十年间的年度国家层面面板数据，我们发现，在普遍人际信任水平较低的国家，经济衰退更易引发政治更迭。这一效应存在于民主国家而非专制国家，体现在通过常规程序而非政变实现的更迭中，且发生在定期选举年份。在考察欧洲次国家区域、美国各县以及美国各县个体层面时，我们发现了经济衰退期间信任与领导人更迭之间的类似关联。我们的研究结果凸显了普遍信任在经济动荡时期确保政治稳定性的关键作用。
10.1093/ej/ueag086.title: Trust and Democracy: Political Stability in Times of Economic Crisis
10.1093/ej/ueag086.title_zh: 信任与民主：经济危机时期的政治稳定

10.1093/ej/ueag087.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Dispute resolution in low-income countries is typically done by either a costly and slow formal court or an informal institution without state-sanctioned enforcement powers. Can access to justice be increased by combining the best aspects of formal and informal institutions? We evaluate the effects of “Village Courts” (VCs) in rural Bangladesh using a large-scale field experiment. The introduction of VCs more than doubles the share of disputes resolved in state-sanctioned courts, but an informal institution called shalish remains dominant. There is some substitution from shalish to VCs, but congestion in higher-level courts, village social dynamics, and economic activity remain unaffected.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag087.abstract_zh: 低收入国家的纠纷解决通常依赖成本高昂且效率低下的正式法院，或缺乏国家强制执行力保障的非正式机构。能否通过融合正式与非正式机构的最佳特性来提升司法可及性？我们通过一项大规模实地实验，评估了孟加拉国农村地区"村级法院"（VCs）的实施效果。村级法院的引入使国家认可法院解决的纠纷比例提升了一倍以上，但名为"沙利什"的非正式机构仍占据主导地位。虽然存在从沙利什向村级法院的部分替代效应，但上级法院的案件积压、村庄社会动态及经济活动均未受到显著影响。
10.1093/ej/ueag087.title: Formalizing Dispute Resolution: Effects of Village Courts in Bangladesh

10.1093/ej/ueag088.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Restrictive immigration policies can force organisations to alter their workforce composition, with unclear effects on organisational performance. We study the effects of the 2016 Brexit referendum, which reduced the share of EU-nationality nurses in English hospitals. Using administrative patient-level data and a continuous difference-in-differences design, exploiting hospitals’ pre-referendum exposure, we estimate the causal impact of a negative labour supply shock on care quality. Hospitals with higher pre-referendum EU nurse shares experienced higher post-referendum emergency patient mortality, equivalent to 1,238 additional deaths annually in the three years after the referendum. Consistent with theoretical predictions, hospitals responded to labour shortages by relaxing hiring standards: foreign nurses recruited after the referendum were appointed to lower salary grades, suggesting lower skills and experience.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag088.abstract_zh: 限制性移民政策可能迫使组织改变其劳动力构成，但对组织绩效的影响尚不明确。我们研究了2016年英国脱欧公投的影响，该公投减少了英国医院中欧盟籍护士的比例。利用行政层面的患者数据以及连续双重差分设计，通过分析医院在公投前的暴露程度，我们估算了负面劳动力供给冲击对护理质量的因果影响。公投前欧盟护士比例较高的医院，在公投后急诊患者死亡率更高，相当于公投后三年内每年额外增加1238例死亡。与理论预测一致，医院通过放宽招聘标准来应对劳动力短缺：公投后招聘的外籍护士被分配到较低的薪资等级，这表明其技能和经验较低。
10.1093/ej/ueag088.title: Immigration, Workforce Composition, and Organisational Performance: The Effect of Brexit on NHS Hospital Quality
10.1093/ej/ueag088.title_zh: 移民、劳动力构成与组织绩效：英国脱欧对NHS医院质量的影响

10.1093/ej/ueag089.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We construct a continuous-time, monetary model with frictional goods and labour markets to revisit the long-run relationship between inflation and unemployment. By endogenising the value of consumers’ outside options and market power in accordance with standard consumer search theory, we generate novel predictions for the slope of the long-run Phillips curve, optimal monetary policy, and outcomes at the frictionless limit. The relationship between inflation and unemployment is non-monotone and, at low inflation rates, an increase in inflation reduces unemployment. The Friedman rule is suboptimal when firms’ average bargaining power across markets is low. Markups and markdowns vanish as frictions disappear.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag089.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含商品市场与劳动力市场摩擦的连续时间货币模型，重新审视通胀与失业之间的长期关系。通过依据标准消费者搜寻理论内生化消费者外部选择价值与市场势力，我们为长期菲利普斯曲线的斜率、最优货币政策以及无摩擦极限下的均衡结果提出了新的理论预测。通胀与失业之间的关系呈现非单调特征：在低通胀水平下，通胀上升会降低失业率。当企业在各市场的平均议价能力较低时，弗里德曼规则并非最优。随着摩擦消失，加成率与折价率趋于零。

10.1093/ej/ueag090.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study how an agent evaluates an action when she observes a sample of its outcomes rather than its outcome-generating distribution. We propose a model where the agent’s estimated value for the action is a convex combination of her average utility over the sample outcomes and an ex ante utility reflecting her prior information. The weight put on the average utility increases with sample size, reflecting the inferential advantages of larger samples. The model nests certain forms of Bayesian behaviour and, more generally, identifies parameters quantifying departures from Bayesian updating, such as conservatism and the Law of Small Numbers.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag090.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>本文研究当代理人观察到某行动的结果样本而非其结果生成分布时，如何评估该行动。我们提出一个模型，其中代理人对该行动的估计价值是样本结果平均效用与反映其先验信息的事前效用的凸组合。平均效用的权重随样本量增加而增加，这反映了更大样本的推断优势。该模型涵盖了某些形式的贝叶斯行为，并更一般地识别出量化偏离贝叶斯更新的参数，例如保守主义和小数定律。</jats:p>

10.1093/ej/ueag091.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Social norms that are costly for individuals are held in place because of social pressure to conform. Historical examples include duelling in Europe and footbinding in China; contemporary examples include female genital cutting and wasteful consumption. Such norms exhibit varied dynamics. Some collapse after staying unchanged for centuries, while others erode gradually. Still others escalate gradually before collapsing. This paper develops a theoretical framework that explains these patterns in terms of different forces of social influence and lends itself to empirical estimation. The analysis can guide the design of policies aimed at mitigating or eliminating costly norms, and shows that some interventions can be counterproductive.</jats:p>
10.1093/ej/ueag091.abstract_zh: 摘要：对个体而言代价高昂的社会规范之所以得以维系，是因为存在要求遵从的社会压力。历史上的例子包括欧洲的决斗和中国的缠足；当代的例子则包括女性割礼和浪费性消费。此类规范呈现出不同的演变动态：有些在历经数百年不变后突然瓦解，有些则逐渐消解，还有些在崩溃前会逐步升级。本文构建了一个理论框架，通过不同的社会影响力机制解释这些模式，并适用于实证估计。该分析可为旨在减轻或消除代价高昂规范的政策设计提供指导，同时表明某些干预措施可能适得其反。
10.1093/ej/ueag091.title: The dynamics of costly norms

10.1093/ej/ueag094.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Climate change is predicted to have large and heterogeneous impacts on agricultural yields. I use a model of production, consumption, and trade of 24 crops between 271 regions across sub-Saharan Africa to simulate the effects of climate change and explore how trade mediates these effects. I estimate a continent-wide welfare loss equivalent to 2.4% of GDP using median yield changes across 5 climate models, with country-level losses up to 60% of GDP in the worst model. The continent-wide welfare loss is 19% smaller with lower trade costs and over 7 times larger if trade flows are capped at current levels.</jats:p>

<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Agriculture accounts for 11 per cent of EU greenhouse gas emissions, yet sectoral emissions have stagnated over the past two decades. This paper evaluates carbon pricing in EU agriculture by integrating stochastic yield variability into the CAPRI model. We assess how different carbon price levels affect emissions and outcome uncertainty. Results show that carbon pricing reduces emissions, and higher price levels are associated with lower uncertainty in policy outcomes. While expected results remain similar to deterministic simulations, stochastic modeling reveals greater regional and sectoral heterogeneity. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for production risk when designing agricultural climate policies.</jats:p>

10.1093/erae/jbag012.abstract: Abstract We analyze alternative agricultural carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM) designs across three dimensions (participating countries, emission intensity, and carbon price). We find that an agricultural CBAM by the European Union (or an expanded climate club consisting of the EU and other countries) has minor global agricultural GHG emission implications but protects the most emission intensive domestic production. Nevertheless, having a larger climate club imposing CBAM tariffs and applying exporters’ emission intensities are more effective in lowering global emissions. Compared to national carbon prices, harmonized carbon prices at climate club level can reduce trade disruptions while attaining similar emission reduction outcomes.
10.1093/erae/jbag012.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们从三个维度（参与国、排放强度与碳价格）分析了农业碳边境调节机制（CBAM）的不同设计方案。研究发现，欧盟（或由欧盟及其他国家组成的扩大化气候俱乐部）实施的农业CBAM对全球农业温室气体排放影响较小，但能保护国内排放强度最高的生产活动。然而，由更大规模的气候俱乐部征收CBAM关税并采用出口国排放强度的方案，在降低全球排放方面更为有效。相较于各国自主设定的碳价格，在气候俱乐部层面实施统一的碳价格可在实现相近减排效果的同时减少贸易扭曲。

10.1093/jeea/jvag037.abstract: Abstract This paper develops a novel method to estimate inequality within a country based on what the country imports. If preferences are non-homothetic, rich and poor individuals of a country have different consumption profiles. Imports can thus inform about the income distribution in a country. The global availability of trade data allows us to estimate inequality using a single transparent and comparable method for a large sample of countries over time. Compared to conventional data, we feature an especially good coverage of developing countries. We provide a number of robustness checks and cross-validation exercises that show the good performance of our method.
10.1093/jeea/jvag037.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于国家进口数据估算国内不平等程度的新方法。若偏好具有非位似性，一国富人与穷人的消费结构将呈现差异。因此，进口数据可揭示该国的收入分配状况。利用全球可获取的贸易数据，我们能够通过单一透明且可比的方法，对大量国家在时间序列上的不平等程度进行估算。与传统数据相比，本方法对发展中国家的覆盖尤为充分。我们通过多项稳健性检验与交叉验证，证实了该方法具有良好的表现。

10.1093/jeea/jvag038.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper empirically examines the idea that the increasing return to college is reducing intergenerational mobility by differentially impacting the investments in children by parents across education groups. A larger return to college will create stronger incentives to invest in children by parents with more education, if educated parents have a comparative advantage in producing human capital in children. Given the importance of a two-parent household on childhood development, marital status is a critical investment decision that parents consider. Relative to less-educated mothers, the analysis shows that educated mothers in states with a larger increase in the return to education are more likely to be married, less likely to divorce, have a more educated spouse, and own more valuable houses. Their children also have relatively higher test scores in 8th grade and rates of college completion. These results are consistent with the increasing return to college differentially affecting the incentives for parental investments in children, which in turn, creates greater disparities in childhood conditions and reduces intergenerational mobility in education.</jats:p>
10.1093/jeea/jvag038.abstract_zh: 本文实证检验了如下观点：大学教育回报率的上升正通过不同教育背景父母对子女投资行为的差异化影响，降低代际流动性。若受教育程度较高的父母在子女人力资本培育方面具有比较优势，则更高的大学教育回报将激励其增加对子女的投资。鉴于双亲家庭对儿童发展的重要性，婚姻状况是父母考虑的关键投资决策。分析表明，相较于低学历母亲，在受教育回报率增幅较大的州，高学历母亲更可能处于已婚状态、离婚概率更低、配偶受教育程度更高、且拥有更高价值的房产。其子女在八年级的学业测试成绩及大学完成率也相对更高。这些结果印证了大学教育回报率上升会差异化影响父母对子女的投资激励，进而加剧儿童成长环境的不平等，并削弱教育代际流动性。

10.1093/jeea/jvag039.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Political polarization is a growing concern in many countries. Are mass protests merely a sign of increasing cleavages, or do they polarize societies? In this paper, we estimate the impact of Nazi marches in 1932 Hamburg, using granular data from 622 voting precincts during 6 elections. We show propaganda can persuade – but it does by raising the share of areas with high levels of Nazi support. Importantly, marches can also backfire, repelling voters. Thus, protest marches lead to polarization. These effects diffused through social networks, measured as contagion patterns across neighborhoods from the 1918 Spanish flu outbreak. The electoral effects of social spillovers are of similar importance as direct exposure, and grow over time.</jats:p>
10.1093/jeea/jvag039.abstract_zh: 政治极化是许多国家日益严峻的问题。大规模抗议仅仅是社会裂痕加剧的表现，还是会导致社会极化？本文利用1932年汉堡622个投票区在6次选举中的微观数据，估算了纳粹游行的影响。研究表明，宣传具有说服力——但这是通过提高纳粹支持率较高地区的占比来实现的。重要的是，游行也可能适得其反，使选民产生排斥。因此，抗议游行导致了极化。这些效应通过社会网络扩散，以1918年西班牙流感爆发期间社区间的传染模式为衡量标准。社会溢出效应对选举的影响与直接接触同等重要，且随时间推移而增强。
10.1093/jeea/jvag039.title: Going Viral: Protests and Polarization in 1932 Hamburg,
10.1093/jeea/jvag039.title_zh: 病毒式传播：1932年汉堡的抗议与极化

10.1093/jeea/jvag040.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Can markets discipline socially costly misbehavior abroad? We explore the market penalty associated with major human rights violations—specifically, the assassination of mining activists, a context where formal legal recourse is rare and events often do not involve counterparties. We show that firms featured in media coverage of these incidents experience significant, negative abnormal stock returns. Whereas reactions to related forms of corporate misconduct may be transitory or muted, we find that the market responses are both substantial and persistent, with a median 10-day loss exceeding USD 100 million. Since formal legal sanction is exceedingly rare, we consider the role of market penalties. We highlight three mechanisms that are consistent with reputational costs: (1) Media attention magnifies the market response. (2) Information-sensitive institutional investors systematically divest following assassination events. (3) Events reduce future trade, leading to a 19% decline in new contracts with counterparties. Despite these costs, events persist. We find that assassinations increase with dependence on mining royalties, suggesting that local rents sustain conflict despite market pressure. Thus, reputational sanctions may be significant—even in weakly institutionalized settings—yet may not fully deter misbehavior when local and global incentives diverge.</jats:p>
10.1093/jeea/jvag040.abstract_zh: 市场能否约束企业在海外的高成本不当行为？我们探讨了与重大人权侵犯相关的市场惩罚——具体而言，即针对采矿活动人士的暗杀事件。在此类情境下，正式法律救济极为罕见，且事件往往不涉及交易对手。研究表明，媒体报道中提及这些事件的企业会经历显著且负面的异常股票回报。尽管针对相关形式的企业不当行为的市场反应可能是短暂或微弱的，但我们发现市场反应既显著又持久，其中位10天损失超过1亿美元。由于正式法律制裁极为罕见，我们考察了市场惩罚的作用。我们强调了与声誉成本一致的三种机制：（1）媒体关注放大了市场反应；（2）信息敏感的机构投资者在暗杀事件后系统性地撤资；（3）事件减少了未来交易，导致与新交易对手的合同数量下降19%。尽管存在这些成本，事件仍持续发生。我们发现，暗杀事件随对采矿特许权使用费的依赖程度增加而增加，这表明尽管存在市场压力，地方租金仍维持冲突。因此，声誉制裁可能意义重大——即使在制度薄弱的环境中——但当地方与全球激励不一致时，可能无法完全遏制不当行为。
10.1093/jeea/jvag040.title: The Value of Names: Civil Society, Information, and Governing Multinationals,
10.1093/jeea/jvag040.title_zh: 名称的价值：公民社会、信息与跨国公司的治理

10.1093/jeea/jvag041.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study how political parties engage in political targeting of resources by coordinating politicians across multiple levels of government. We combine thousands of election outcomes from the Indian state of West Bengal with 300 million payments from a welfare scheme jointly controlled by state and local governments. We show that the state government gives disproportionate funding to co-partisan local councils, which target payments to raise votes for national candidates. Welfare payments are diverted to reward local councilors who successfully deliver votes, and to recruit opposition councilors. The ruling party recruits candidates only where it lacks a majority, systematically expanding its control.</jats:p>
10.1093/jeea/jvag041.abstract_zh: 我们研究了政党如何通过协调多级政府中的政治家来实施政治资源定向。我们将印度西孟加拉邦数千个选举结果与一项由邦政府和地方政府共同控制的福利计划中3亿笔支付记录相结合。研究显示，邦政府向同党地方议会提供不成比例的资金，这些资金被用于定向支付以提升国家层面候选人的得票率。福利支付被挪用，用于奖励成功拉票的地方议员，并招募反对党议员。执政党仅在未获得多数席位的地方招募候选人，从而系统性地扩大其控制范围。
10.1093/jeea/jvag041.title: Party Organizations and Complementary Political Control,
10.1093/jeea/jvag041.title_zh: 党组织与互补性政治控制

10.1093/jeea/jvag042.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper studies how large firms’ synchronized lumpy investments endogenously shape an economy’s fragility to negative TFP shocks. I develop a heterogeneous-firm real business cycle model that matches the empirical interest rate elasticities of investment for both large and small firms. In the model, large firms’ lumpy investments become persistently synchronized due to their low sensitivity to general equilibrium effects, generating investment surges. Following these surges, TFP-induced recessions are particularly severe, and the semi-elasticity of aggregate investment drops significantly, consistent with the data.</jats:p>
10.1093/jeea/jvag042.abstract_zh: 本文研究大型企业同步化的大额投资如何内生地塑造经济对负向全要素生产率冲击的脆弱性。我构建了一个异质性企业真实商业周期模型，该模型与大型和小型企业投资的经验利率弹性相匹配。在该模型中，大型企业的大额投资由于对一般均衡效应的敏感性较低而持续同步化，从而产生投资激增。在这些激增之后，全要素生产率引发的衰退尤为严重，且总投资的半弹性显著下降，这与数据一致。
