10.1093/qje/qjag030.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper uses labor force surveys from 160 countries to build a new microdatabase on hours worked covering 97% of the world population in cross section. We also construct time series spanning over 20 years in 86 countries. Hours worked per adult slightly decline with GDP per capita but are weakly correlated with development overall. Hours worked by the young (aged 15-19) and elderly (aged 60+) fall with development, driven entirely by growing school attendance and public pension coverage. Hours worked among prime-age adults (aged 20-59) are stable with development but undergo a great gender reshuffling: falling male hours per worker have been exactly offset by increases in female labor force participation in many countries. Labor income taxes are strongly negatively related to hours worked across countries. This correlation is attenuated when controlling for social spending and disappears when further controlling for working hours regulations. Both social spending and working hours regulations are associated with lower hours worked.</jats:p>
10.1093/qje/qjag030.abstract_zh: 本文利用来自160个国家的劳动力调查，构建了一个覆盖全球97%人口横截面数据的新工作时长微观数据库。我们还构建了86个国家超过20年的时间序列数据。成年人平均工作时长随人均GDP略有下降，但与整体发展水平的关联较弱。青年（15-19岁）和老年（60岁以上）人群的工作时长随发展水平下降，这完全由入学率和公共养老金覆盖率的提高所驱动。壮年（20-59岁）人群的工作时长随发展水平保持稳定，但经历了显著的性别重组：在许多国家，男性人均工作时长的下降恰好被女性劳动参与率的上升所抵消。跨国数据显示，劳动所得税与工作时长呈显著负相关。在控制社会支出后，这种相关性减弱；进一步控制工作时长法规后，相关性消失。社会支出和工作时长法规均与较低的工作时长相关。
10.1093/qje/qjag030.title: Global Working Hours

10.1093/qje/qjag031.abstract: Abstract We test for stereotyping—the exaggeration of representative traits—in a high-stakes economic environment. Using both surveys administered among undergraduates at the Ohio State University and large-scale nationally representative data, we measure how US freshmen perceive the relationship between college majors and occupations. We show that students greatly overestimate the likelihood that majors lead to their representative jobs (e.g., counselor for psychology, journalist for journalism). Using an implicit association test, we show that students associate majors with their representative careers and that these associations strongly predict belief biases, in line with a stereotyping mechanism. A simple equilibrium model of the labor market predicts that stereotyping reduces welfare by increasing misallocation, which correlational evidence on job/major mismatch corroborates. In a field experiment, we test a light-touch policy to reduce stereotyping and find significant effects on students’ intentions about what to study as well as the classes and majors they enroll in.
10.1093/qje/qjag031.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们检验了高 stakes 经济环境中的刻板印象——即对代表性特征的夸大。通过俄亥俄州立大学本科生调查及大规模全国代表性数据，我们测量了美国新生对大学专业与职业之间关系的认知。研究表明，学生极大高估了专业导向其代表性职业的可能性（例如心理学专业对应咨询师、新闻学专业对应记者）。通过内隐联想测试，我们发现学生将专业与其代表性职业相关联，且这些关联强烈预测信念偏差，这与刻板印象机制一致。一个简单的劳动力市场均衡模型预测，刻板印象通过加剧资源错配降低社会福利，而关于职业/专业错配的相关证据证实了这一点。在实地实验中，我们测试了一项轻触式政策以减少刻板印象，发现该政策对学生学习意向、所选课程及专业注册产生了显著影响。
10.1093/qje/qjag031.title: What Jobs Come to Mind? Stereotypes About Fields of Study

10.1093/qje/qjag033.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We explore the mechanics of empathy. We show that information about an outgroup can activate and magnify empathy when presented in conjunction with an experience simulating their struggles. This response increases the willingness to help the struggling group. We provide evidence for this effect in an immersive virtual reality experiment where participants (“witnesses”) experience a simulation of the struggle of unauthorized migrants (“protagonists”), then replicate these results in a series of controlled lab experiments. We show that information enhances the witnesses’ empathetic response and drives them to engage in more prosocial behavior when it increases their perceived interpersonal similarity, or relatability to the protagonist — an effect we trace to attention: eye-tracking data reveals that information provision concentrates witnesses’ gaze on the struggles of the protagonist instead of searching through peripheral elements of the scene. Conversely, only information packages that strengthen perceived relatability — an effect that can vary across subgroups with heterogeneous attributes — magnify empathy. Together, our evidence suggests that the ability to put oneself in the shoes of another person or group can be enhanced by activating empathy through simple, targeted, information provision.</jats:p>
10.1093/qje/qjag033.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了共情的运作机制。研究表明，当关于外群体的信息与模拟其困境的体验相结合时，能够激活并放大共情。这种反应会提升帮助困境群体的意愿。我们通过一项沉浸式虚拟现实实验为这一效应提供了证据——参与者（“见证者”）体验了未经授权移民（“主角”）困境的模拟场景，随后在一系列受控实验室实验中复现了这些结果。我们发现，当信息增强了见证者感知到的人际相似性或与主角的关联性时，信息会强化见证者的共情反应，并促使他们采取更多亲社会行为——我们将这一效应归因于注意力：眼动追踪数据显示，信息提供将见证者的目光集中在主角的困境上，而非搜索场景中的外围元素。相反，只有那些能够增强感知关联性的信息包——这一效应可能因具有异质性特征的子群体而异——才会放大共情。综合来看，我们的证据表明，通过简单、有针对性的信息提供激活共情，可以增强个体设身处地理解他人或群体的能力。
10.1093/qje/qjag033.title: In their Shoes: Empathy Through Information
10.1093/qje/qjag033.title_zh: 感同身受：信息中的共情

10.1093/qje/qjag034.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>If unions raise worker wages, who pays? We provide a comprehensive assessment of firm responses to increased unionization, using changes in the tax deductibility of union dues in Norway as a quasi-exogenous source of variation in firm-level union density. In the average private sector firm, higher union density raises labor costs and leads firms to contract employment and production, lowering profits without increasing the labor share. The incidence is shared: consumers bear part of the cost through higher prices, shareholders through lower profits, and the remainder is offset by productivity improvements. The total wage bill falls, with losses concentrated among less-attached “outsider” workers. Firm responses vary systematically by the degree of market competition. In manufacturing, where firms operate in less competitive product and labor markets, the response is reversed: the average firm expands employment and production, reduces labor markdowns, and does not experience profit declines. Instead, higher labor costs are largely passed on to consumers through higher prices, with the remainder offset by productivity gains. Workers benefit as both wages and employment rise. These patterns suggest that unions can offset employer monopsony power and that firm responses–and therefore who ultimately bears the cost-depend importantly on market structure. Overall, unionization in this setting primarily redistributes from consumers rather than shareholders and has effects that differ sharply across firms, including a reallocation toward larger and more productive firms. We rationalize these patterns using a partial-equilibrium model of union bargaining with product- and labor-market power.</jats:p>
10.1093/qje/qjag034.abstract_zh: 如果工会提高工人工资，谁来买单？我们利用挪威工会会费税收抵扣政策的变化作为企业层面工会密度的准外生变动来源，对企业应对工会化程度提高的反应进行了全面评估。在一般私营企业中，工会密度上升会提高劳动力成本，导致企业收缩就业和生产规模，在降低利润的同时并未提高劳动份额。成本负担由多方分摊：消费者通过更高价格承担部分成本，股东通过更低利润承担部分，其余部分则被生产率提升所抵消。总工资支出下降，损失主要集中在关联度较低的“外部”工人群体。企业反应因市场竞争程度不同而呈现系统性差异。在制造业中，由于企业面临竞争程度较低的产品和劳动力市场，其反应截然相反：一般企业会扩大就业和生产规模，降低劳动力市场垄断压价能力，且利润并未下降。相反，更高的劳动力成本主要通过提高价格转嫁给消费者，其余部分被生产率提升所抵消。工人因工资和就业同时上升而获益。这些模式表明，工会能够抵消雇主的买方垄断势力，而企业反应——进而最终由谁承担成本——关键取决于市场结构。总体而言，在此背景下工会化主要实现从消费者而非股东的收入再分配，且对不同企业的影响差异显著，包括资源向规模更大、生产率更高的企业重新配置。我们通过一个包含产品市场与劳动力市场势力的工会谈判局部均衡模型对这些模式进行了合理化解释。

10.1093/restud/rdag063.abstract: Abstract We study the role of public risk-sharing in markets where firms face substantial cost uncertainty, focusing on public reinsurance in health insurance. We develop a model where insurers internalize cost uncertainty through risk charges that raise effective marginal costs, and create a role for reinsurance. Public reinsurance lowers both expected costs and cost volatility, particularly for smaller insurers, reducing prices and enhancing competition. Using an event study of staggered state-level reinsurance programs, we show that public reinsurance leads insurers to lower prices and private reinsurance purchases, benefiting financially constrained insurers the most. Structural estimates indicate that risk charges account for a substantial share of the premium-cost wedge, and highlight public reinsurance's comparative advantage over premium subsidies by providing risk protection and enhancing competition. Our results underscore the importance of accounting for firms’ risk exposure in policy design and provide a general framework for understanding public risk-sharing policies.
10.1093/restud/rdag063.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究企业在面临巨大成本不确定性时公共风险分担的作用，重点关注健康保险中的公共再保险。我们构建了一个模型，其中保险公司通过风险费用将成本不确定性内部化，从而提高有效边际成本，并为再保险创造了空间。公共再保险降低了预期成本和成本波动性，尤其对小型保险公司而言，从而降低了价格并增强了竞争。利用各州分阶段实施再保险计划的事件研究法，我们发现公共再保险促使保险公司降低价格并减少私人再保险购买，对财务受限的保险公司影响最大。结构估计表明，风险费用在保费与成本差额中占很大比重，并凸显了公共再保险相较于保费补贴的比较优势，因为它能提供风险保护并增强竞争。我们的研究结果强调了在政策设计中考虑企业风险暴露的重要性，并为理解公共风险分担政策提供了一个通用框架。

10.1093/restud/rdag065.abstract: Abstract I develop a unified theoretical framework with schools and residential choices to study the welfare consequences of public schools’ switching from the traditional neighborhood assignment to the deferred acceptance mechanism. I find that when families receive higher priorities at neighborhood schools, the deferred acceptance mechanism creates higher aggregate or utilitarian welfare than neighborhood assignment. Under a common school ranking assumption, I also show that the deferred acceptance creates higher aggregate welfare with neighborhood priorities than without them.
10.1093/restud/rdag065.abstract_zh: 摘要 我构建了一个包含学校与居住选择的统一理论框架，用以研究公立学校从传统学区分配转向延迟接受机制所产生的福利影响。研究发现，当家庭在学区学校获得更高优先级时，延迟接受机制相较于学区分配能带来更高的总体或功利主义福利。在共同学校排名假设下，我还证明，相较于无学区优先级的情形，带有学区优先级的延迟接受机制能创造更高的总体福利。

10.1093/restud/rdag068.abstract: Abstract I propose a model of skill-replacing routine-biased technological change (SR-RBTC). In this model, technology substitutes for the use of skill in routine tasks, in contrast to standard RBTC models, which assume that technology replaces the workers themselves. The SR-RBTC model explains three key trends that are inconsistent with standard RBTC models: 1) why specifically middle wages declined even though workers in routine occupations are dispersed across the entire bottom half of the wage distribution, 2) why middle wages stopped declining while technological change continued, and 3) why there is no substantial decline in the average wage of workers in routine occupations. I derive two new testable predictions from the model: a decrease in the return to skill and a decrease in skill level in routine occupations. I use an interactive fixed-effects model to confirm both predictions. Since SR-RBTC violates the ignorability assumption required by standard decomposition methods, I introduce a “skewness decomposition” to show that SR-RBTC is the main driver of bottom-half inequality trends.
10.1093/restud/rdag068.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出了一种技能替代型常规偏向技术变革（SR-RBTC）模型。在该模型中，技术替代了常规任务中的技能使用，这与标准RBTC模型（假设技术替代工人本身）形成对比。SR-RBTC模型解释了与标准RBTC模型不一致的三个关键趋势：1）尽管常规职业中的工人分散于整个工资分布下半部分，但为何中位数工资却出现下降；2）为何在技术变革持续进行的情况下，中位数工资停止下降；3）为何常规职业工人的平均工资未出现显著下降。基于该模型，我推导出两个可检验的新预测：常规职业中技能回报率下降以及技能水平下降。通过交互固定效应模型，我验证了这两个预测。由于SR-RBTC违反了标准分解方法所需的可忽略性假设，我引入了一种“偏度分解”方法，证明SR-RBTC是下半部分工资不平等趋势的主要驱动因素。
10.1093/restud/rdag068.title: Skill-Replacing Technology and Bottom-Half Inequality
10.1093/restud/rdag068.title_zh: 技能替代型技术与底层收入不平等

10.1093/restud/rdag070.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We introduce a survey instrument to measure earnings risk allowing for the possibility of quitting or being fired from the current job. We find these transitions to be the key drivers of subjective risk. A link with administrative data provides multiple credibility checks and reveals that subjective earnings risk varies systematically across the population. It is also many times smaller than traditional estimates even when conditioning richly on demographics and job history. We show that subjective earnings risk can help explain why many hold limited liquid assets.</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag070.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>我们引入了一种调查工具，用于衡量允许当前工作辞职或被解雇可能性的收入风险。我们发现，这些工作转换是主观风险的关键驱动因素。通过与行政数据的关联，我们进行了多项可信度检验，并揭示出主观收入风险在人群中存在系统性差异。即使在对人口统计特征和工作历史进行丰富条件控制后，主观收入风险仍远小于传统估计值。我们证明，主观收入风险有助于解释为何许多人持有有限的流动资产。</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag070.title: Subjective Earnings Risk

10.1093/restud/rdag071.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper studies the impact of income-based criminal punishments on crime. In Finland, speeding tickets become income-dependent if the driver’s speed exceeds the speeding limit by more than 20 km/h, leading to a substantial jump in the size of the speeding ticket. Contrary to predictions of a traditional Becker model, individuals do not bunch below the fine hike. Instead, the speeding distributions are smooth at the cutoff. However, I demonstrate that the size of the realized speeding ticket has sizable, but short-lived, impacts on reoffending. I use a regression discontinuity design to show that fines that are, on average, 200 euros larger decrease reoffending by 15 percent in the following six months. The drop in reoffending is driven by high-income individuals facing the highest fine at the cutoff. I estimate that a fixed fine hike that matches the current deterrence effect would raise the fine increase faced by the bottom income quartile by about 300% at the cutoff, relative to the increase they face under the current income-based schedule. My empirical results are consistent with an explanation that people operate under information frictions. To illustrate this, I construct a Becker model with misperception and learning that can explain all the empirical findings.</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag071.abstract_zh: 本文研究了基于收入的刑事处罚对犯罪的影响。在芬兰，当驾驶员超速超过限速20公里/小时以上时，罚单金额与收入挂钩，导致罚款数额大幅跃升。与传统贝克尔模型的预测相反，个体并未在罚款激增点以下聚集，超速分布在该临界点处平滑。然而，本文证明实际罚单金额对再犯行为具有显著但短暂的影响。利用断点回归设计，本文发现平均高出200欧元的罚款使随后六个月的再犯率降低15%。再犯率的下降主要由临界点处面临最高罚款的高收入群体驱动。本文估算，若采用固定罚款增幅以匹配当前威慑效果，则相对于现行基于收入的罚款方案，底层收入四分位群体在临界点面临的罚款增幅将提高约300%。实证结果与个体存在信息摩擦的解释一致。为阐明这一点，本文构建了包含认知偏差与学习机制的贝克尔模型，该模型能够解释所有实证发现。
10.1093/restud/rdag071.title: How Do People React to Income-Based Fines? Evidence from Speeding Tickets Discontinuities
10.1093/restud/rdag071.title_zh: 人们如何应对基于收入的罚款？来自超速罚单断点回归的证据

10.1093/restud/rdag074.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In a data economy, transactions of goods and services generate data, which is stored, traded and depreciates. How are the economics of this economy different from traditional production economies? How do these differences matter for measurement of GDP, firm values, depreciation rates, welfare and externalities? We incorporate active experimentation and data as an intangible asset to devise a tractable recursive representation of the data economy. The model rationalizes why apps are often “free” and why even non-digital economic activity might be greater than GDP suggests. Calibrating the model using a combination of macroeconomic and financial moments suggests that the mis-measurement in U.S. GDP due to missing value of data has been as high as 6% in 2018.</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag074.abstract_zh: 在数据经济中，商品和服务的交易会产生数据，这些数据被存储、交易并发生折旧。这种经济体的经济学原理与传统生产经济体有何不同？这些差异如何影响GDP、企业价值、折旧率、福利和外部性的衡量？我们将主动实验和数据作为无形资产纳入考量，构建了一个易于处理的数据经济递归表示模型。该模型解释了为何应用程序通常“免费”，以及为何即使是非数字经济活动也可能大于GDP所显示的水平。通过结合宏观经济和金融时刻对模型进行校准，结果表明，由于数据价值缺失，2018年美国GDP的测量误差高达6%。
10.1093/restud/rdag074.title: A Model of the Data Economy

10.1093/restud/rdag075.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study structural change in production networks for intermediate inputs (inputoutput network) and new capital (investment network). For each network, we document that the share of output produced by services (relative to goods) is rising over time. While the relative prices of services that produce intermediates and consumption are rising, we find that the relative price of services that produce investment is falling over time. We then develop a multi-sector growth model to study these trends and their implications for economic growth. To match the relative price trends, inputs to intermediates production are complements and inputs to investment production are substitutes. Hence, structural change endogenously reallocates resources to the slowest growing intermediates producers and the fastest growing investment producers. Growth accounting exercises reveal that investment-specific technical change accounts for an increasing share of U.S. aggregate growth, with 20% of aggregate growth since 2000 due to investment structural change. Growth projections from our model show that structural change within investment networks alone can offset stagnating or declining growth in other sectors due to Baumol’s cost disease.</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag075.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文研究了中间投入品生产网络（投入产出网络）与新资本生产网络（投资网络）中的结构变迁。针对每个网络，我们记录到服务业（相对于商品）的产出份额随时间推移而上升。尽管生产中间品和消费品的服务业相对价格在上升，但我们发现生产投资品的服务业相对价格却在下降。随后，我们构建了一个多部门增长模型来研究这些趋势及其对经济增长的影响。为匹配相对价格趋势，中间品生产的投入要素具有互补性，而投资品生产的投入要素具有替代性。因此，结构变迁内生地将资源重新配置给增长最慢的中间品生产部门与增长最快的投资品生产部门。增长核算分析表明，投资专用型技术变革在美国总体增长中的占比持续上升，自2000年以来总体增长的20%归因于投资结构变迁。模型增长预测显示，仅投资网络内部的结构变迁即可抵消因鲍莫尔成本病导致的其他部门增长停滞或下降的影响。
10.1093/restud/rdag075.title: Structural Change in Production Networks and Economic Growth
10.1093/restud/rdag075.title_zh: 生产网络中的结构变化与经济增长

10.1093/restud/rdag076.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We conduct an experimental analysis of selective disclosure in communication. In the model, an informed sender aims to influence a receiver by disclosing verifiable evidence that is selected from a larger pool of available evidence. Our experimental design leverages this model’s rich comparative statics, allowing us to systematically quantify the effects of selection relative to concealment. Our findings confirm the key qualitative predictions of the theory, suggesting that selection, rather than concealment, is often the dominant distortion in communication. We also identify deviations from the theory: Some senders are “deception averse” and overcommunicate relative to predictions; receivers respond too optimistically to both concealed and selected evidence, with errors of similar magnitude. Yet selection generates greater overall distortion in receiver behavior because it is far more prevalent than concealment.</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag076.abstract_zh: 我们针对沟通中的选择性披露进行了实验分析。在该模型中，掌握信息的发送者旨在通过披露从更大可用证据池中筛选出的可验证证据来影响接收者。我们的实验设计利用了该模型丰富的比较静态分析特性，从而能够系统量化选择相对于隐瞒的影响。研究结果证实了理论的关键定性预测，表明在沟通中，选择而非隐瞒往往是主导性扭曲。同时，我们也发现了与理论的偏离：部分发送者存在“欺骗厌恶”倾向，其沟通程度高于理论预测；接收者对隐瞒和选择证据的反应均过于乐观，且误差幅度相近。然而，由于选择比隐瞒更为普遍，它在接收者行为中造成了更大的整体扭曲。
10.1093/restud/rdag076.title: The Selective Disclosure of Evidence: An Experiment
10.1093/restud/rdag076.title_zh: 证据的选择性披露：一项实验

10.1093/restud/rdag077.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We show that the formalization of representativeness (Kahneman and Tversky (1972)) developed by Gennaioli and Shleifer (2010) features an intrinsic connection between uncertainty and overreaction. In the time series domain, we develop this connection in a smooth version of Diagnostic Expectations (DE), where overreaction varies smoothly with uncertainty. Intuitively, under smoothness, lower uncertainty leaves less room for representativeness to distort beliefs. Smooth DE provides a joint, parsimonious micro-foundation for key features of survey data: overreaction to news, stronger overreaction at longer horizons, overconfidence in subjective uncertainty, and a new stylized fact documented here—overreaction intensifies with higher uncertainty. An analytical Real Business Cycle model with Smooth DE accounts for survey overreaction and overconfidence, as well as three salient business cycle properties: asymmetry, countercyclical macro volatility, and countercyclical micro volatility.</jats:p>
10.1093/restud/rdag077.abstract_zh: 我们证明，由Gennaioli和Shleifer（2010）发展的代表性启发式形式化（Kahneman和Tversky（1972））具有不确定性与过度反应之间的内在联系。在时间序列领域，我们通过平滑版本的诊断预期（DE）来发展这一联系，其中过度反应随不确定性平滑变化。直观而言，在平滑条件下，较低的不确定性为代表性启发式扭曲信念留下了更少空间。平滑DE为调查数据的关键特征提供了简洁统一的微观基础：对新闻的过度反应、更长预测期限下更强的过度反应、主观不确定性中的过度自信，以及本文记录的新典型事实——过度反应随不确定性升高而加剧。基于平滑DE的分析性真实商业周期模型不仅解释了调查中的过度反应与过度自信，还解释了三个显著的商业周期特征：非对称性、逆周期的宏观波动性以及逆周期的微观波动性。
10.1093/restud/rdag077.title: Smooth Diagnostic Expectations

10.1093/rfs/hhaf079.title: Macroeconomic Expectations and Credit Card Spending
10.1093/rfs/hhaf079.title_zh: 宏观经济预期与信用卡支出

10.1093/rfs/hhag013.abstract: Abstract A core responsibility of the Federal Reserve is to ensure financial stability by acting as the lender of last resort through its Discount Window (DW). The DW, however, has not been effective because its usage is stigmatized. In this paper, we use theory and experiments to study how such stigma can be cured. We find that behavioral inertia makes it difficult to fix a stigmatized DW, but adding a new backstop facility can help mitigate stigma. These results are consistent with the Federal Reserve’s experience. (JEL E58, G01, C92)
10.1093/rfs/hhag013.abstract_zh: 摘要 美联储的一项核心职责是通过贴现窗口（DW）作为最后贷款人，以维护金融稳定。然而，由于使用贴现窗口存在污名化问题，其有效性受到制约。本文通过理论与实验研究，探讨如何消除此类污名。我们发现，行为惯性使得修复污名化的贴现窗口困难重重，但增设新的后备融资工具有助于缓解污名化。这些结论与美联储的实际经验相符。（JEL E58, G01, C92）
10.1093/rfs/hhag013.title: Can Discount Window Stigma Be Cured? An Experimental Investigation
10.1093/rfs/hhag013.title_zh: 贴现窗口污名能被消除吗？一项实验研究

10.1093/rfs/hhag023.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study privatization and corporate ownership in transportation infrastructure, focusing on global airports. Privatization in general does not improve performance. However, private equity (PE) ownership has strong and persistent positive effects on efficiency, volume, and quality, with positive externalities for the local economy. We address selection using close auctions where PE and non-PE firms bid. PE funds expand physical capacity and encourage larger planes while adding low-cost carriers and international routes. They are especially effective in countries with more corruption or state-owned flag carriers. In contrast, the poorer performance of non-PE acquirers may reflect private benefits and historical state ties. (JEL G32, G38, L32, R42, H54)</jats:p>
10.1093/rfs/hhag023.abstract_zh: 摘要：我们研究了交通基础设施中的私有化与企业所有权问题，重点关注全球机场。总体而言，私有化并未改善绩效。然而，私募股权（PE）所有权对效率、运量及质量产生了显著且持久的积极影响，并对当地经济带来正外部性。我们利用PE与非PE企业竞标的封闭式拍卖来处理选择性问题。PE基金扩大物理容量、鼓励使用更大机型，同时引入低成本航空公司和国际航线。在腐败程度较高或存在国有旗舰航空公司的国家，PE的效果尤为显著。相比之下，非PE收购方的较差表现可能反映了私人收益与历史国有关联。（JEL G32, G38, L32, R42, H54）

10.1093/rfs/hhag056.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>There are two major institutional investors in the syndicated loan market: collateralized loan obligations (CLOs) and loan mutual funds. CLOs are closed-end funds while loan funds are open-end funds that issue claims that are redeemable on demand. In this paper, we examine whether CLOs provide arbitrage capital that contributes to the resilience of loan funds. We find that CLOs act as shock absorbers, providing liquidity through par-building trades when loan funds experience large outflows. However, CLO-provided liquidity is limited to par build–eligible loans, leading to potential flow-induced fire sales among par build–ineligible loans. (JEL G23, G38</jats:p>
10.1093/rfs/hhag056.abstract_zh: 银团贷款市场中有两类主要机构投资者：担保贷款凭证（CLOs）和贷款共同基金。CLO属于封闭式基金，而贷款基金属于开放式基金，其发行的份额可随时赎回。本文研究CLO是否提供套利资本以增强贷款基金的韧性。我们发现，当贷款基金遭遇大规模资金外流时，CLO通过平价建仓交易提供流动性，起到缓冲器作用。然而，CLO提供的流动性仅限于符合平价建仓条件的贷款，这可能导致不符合条件的贷款因资金外流而被迫折价抛售。（JEL分类号：G23, G38）

10.1093/rfs/hhag058.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Government intervention in the financial market through its own trading fundamentally changes the market’s structure, function, and outcome. I develop a general equilibrium framework to study the impact of government trading on investor welfare. I show that with incompleteness and information asymmetry, the market equilibrium is in general suboptimal, and government intervention can potentially improve investor welfare even with no additional information. However, the actual welfare impact of government intervention is sensitive to the details of the economy and the policy design. Popular policy targets such as price stability, market liquidity, and informational efficiency can have different welfare implications.</jats:p>
10.1093/rfs/hhag058.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>政府通过自身交易对金融市场进行干预，从根本上改变了市场的结构、功能与结果。本文构建了一个一般均衡框架，研究政府交易对投资者福利的影响。研究表明，在市场不完备且存在信息不对称的情况下，市场均衡通常并非最优，即便政府不掌握额外信息，其干预也可能改善投资者福利。然而，政府干预的实际福利效应高度依赖于经济体的具体特征及政策设计。诸如价格稳定、市场流动性和信息效率等常见政策目标，可能对福利产生截然不同的影响。</jats:p>
10.1093/rfs/hhag058.title: Government Intervention in the Financial Market
10.1093/rfs/hhag058.title_zh: 政府对金融市场的干预

10.1093/rfs/hhag059.abstract: Abstract We show that positive flows to active mutual funds with high recent returns partially reverse at longer horizons. This outcome is robust across a broad range of alternative specifications. Reversal occurs from greater outflows associated with high prior returns, not reduced inflows. We test theories to explain the reversal: investment life cycles, tax loss selling, and a behavioral “disappointment” hypothesis based on investors’ overreaction to positive returns. While both tax loss selling and short investor life cycles can contribute, the evidence supports a role for investor disappointment, whereby investors redeem their capital when return performance fails to meet expectations. (JEL G10, G23)
10.1093/rfs/hhag059.abstract_zh: 摘要 我们证明，近期回报率较高的主动型共同基金的正向资金流入在较长时期内会出现部分逆转。这一结果在多种替代性设定下均保持稳健。逆转源于高前期回报带来的更大规模资金流出，而非流入减少。我们检验了三种解释逆转的理论：投资生命周期、税收损失出售以及基于投资者对正回报过度反应的行为"失望"假说。尽管税收损失出售和较短的投资生命周期均可能发挥作用，但证据支持投资者失望假说的作用，即当回报表现未达预期时，投资者会赎回其资本。（JEL G10, G23）
10.1093/rfs/hhag059.title: Mutual Fund Flows at Long Horizons
10.1093/rfs/hhag059.title_zh: 长期视角下的共同基金资金流动

10.1093/rfs/hhag060.abstract: Abstract We study the interaction between firms, which can invest in green technologies, and a government, which can impose emission caps but has limited commitment power. Investment in green technologies generates innovation spillovers, reducing the cost of further investments. Spillovers generate intertemporal strategic complementarities between firms and government, and equilibrium multiplicity. In a “green equilibrium”, firms, anticipating caps, invest in green technologies, which reduces the cost of further investment, making the government willing to cap emissions. In a “brown equilibrium”, firms, anticipating no caps, don’t invest, so green technologies remain costly and the government gives up on emission caps. (JEL Q54, Q55, Q58, H23, O33)
10.1093/rfs/hhag060.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究企业（可投资于绿色技术）与政府（可设定排放上限但承诺能力有限）之间的互动。绿色技术投资产生创新溢出效应，降低后续投资成本。溢出效应引发企业与政府间的跨期战略互补性，导致多重均衡。在"绿色均衡"中，企业预期政府将设定排放上限而投资绿色技术，这降低了后续投资成本，促使政府愿意实施排放上限。在"棕色均衡"中，企业预期政府不会设定排放上限而不进行投资，导致绿色技术成本居高不下，政府放弃排放上限政策。（JEL分类号：Q54, Q55, Q58, H23, O33）
10.1093/rfs/hhag060.title: Emission Caps and Investment in Green Technologies
10.1093/rfs/hhag060.title_zh: 排放上限与绿色技术投资

10.1093/rfs/hhag061.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Numerous trading strategies examined in options research exhibit remarkably high mean returns and Sharpe ratios. We show some of these seemingly “good deals” are due to look-ahead biases. These biases stem from using information unavailable at the portfolio formation time to filter out observations suspected of being noisy or erroneous. Our results suggest that elevated Sharpe ratios may serve as potential indicators of such look-ahead biases. Furthermore, deviating from previous literature findings, we show that illiquidity is not strongly priced in stock options and that only a small set of stock characteristics are in fact associated with option expected returns. (JEL G12, G14, G17)</jats:p>
10.1093/rfs/hhag061.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>期权研究中检验的众多交易策略呈现出异常高的平均收益率和夏普比率。我们表明，其中一些看似“划算的交易”源于前瞻性偏差。这些偏差源于在投资组合形成时使用了不可获取的信息，以筛选出疑似存在噪声或错误的观测值。我们的结果表明，高夏普比率可能成为此类前瞻性偏差的潜在指标。此外，与以往文献发现不同，我们证明流动性不足在股票期权中并未被强定价，且实际上只有少数股票特征与期权预期收益率相关。（JEL G12, G14, G17）</jats:p>
10.1093/rfs/hhag061.title: Too Good to Be True: Look-Ahead Bias in Empirical Options Research
10.1093/rfs/hhag061.title_zh: 过于美好而难以置信：实证期权研究中的前瞻性偏差

10.1093/rfs/hhag063.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We build a novel data set of time-stamped corporate decarbonization commitments—green pledges—for U.S. public firms by classifying news articles with large language models and human validation. Firms announcing green pledges tend to be larger and browner than other firms, both within and across industries. Green pledges significantly raise stock prices, consistent with a reduction in the carbon premium, and predict sizable declines in future carbon emissions and emission intensities. These effects tend to be strongest for firms in brown industries. Green pledges thus appear credible, convey relevant new information to investors, and provide meaningful financial incentives to decarbonize. (JEL G14, G32, Q54, Q56)</jats:p>
10.1093/rfs/hhag063.abstract_zh: 我们通过结合大语言模型分类与人工验证，构建了一个包含美国上市公司脱碳承诺（绿色承诺）时间戳信息的新数据集。发布绿色承诺的企业往往规模更大且碳排放强度更高，这一特征在行业内部及跨行业间均成立。绿色承诺显著推高股价，这与碳溢价降低的预期一致，并预示着未来碳排放总量及排放强度将大幅下降。上述效应在棕色行业企业中最为显著。因此，绿色承诺具有可信度，能向投资者传递相关新信息，并为脱碳行为提供切实的经济激励。（JEL G14, G32, Q54, Q56）
10.1093/rfs/hhag063.title: Corporate Green Pledges

10.1093/rfs/hhag064.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly consuming and producing huge amounts of data. We propose a social learning model of AI, emphasizing a data-AI feedback loop: data quality affects AI productivity, which influences AI adoption and, consequently, the composition (AI versus human-generated) and quality of future data. Calibrated to evidence on synthetic training loops, the model predicts hump-shaped labor dynamics—short-term displacement that partially reverses as data quality deteriorates. A Grossman–Stiglitz-style externality emerges: AI adopters free-ride on the human-generated actions that supply the novel information on which AI itself relies. In a competitive market, AI should be taxed to correct the data-quality externality; a concentrated AI industry overcorrects, making a subsidy optimal. (JEL O33, D62, D83, J24)</jats:p>
10.1093/rfs/hhag064.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能正日益消耗并产生海量数据。我们提出一个AI的社会学习模型，强调数据与AI之间的反馈循环：数据质量影响AI的生产力，进而影响AI的采用，并最终决定未来数据的构成（AI生成与人类生成）及其质量。基于合成训练循环的证据进行校准后，该模型预测劳动力动态呈驼峰形——短期替代效应会随着数据质量恶化而部分逆转。一种格罗斯曼-斯蒂格利茨式外部性由此产生：AI采用者搭便车利用人类生成的行为，而这些行为提供了AI自身所依赖的新信息。在竞争市场中，应对AI征税以纠正数据质量外部性；而集中的AI行业则会过度纠正，使得补贴成为最优选择。（JEL O33, D62, D83, J24）
10.1093/rfs/hhag064.title: Generative AI and Data Quality: Implications for Productivity, Labor Displacement, and Policy
10.1093/rfs/hhag064.title_zh: 生成式人工智能与数据质量：对生产率、劳动力替代及政策的影响

10.1093/rfs/hhag065.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Traditionally, fund managers cast votes on behalf of fund investors. Recently, there is a shift toward “pass-through voting,” with funds offering investors a choice: delegate votes to the fund or vote themselves. We develop a framework to study the implications of voting choice. While it helps reflect heterogeneous investor preferences, it also shapes the informational content of the vote, and these forces can conflict. When interests are aligned, voting choice improves information aggregation and investor welfare. With preference heterogeneity or costly information, however, it can make investors worse off by weakening informed. (JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, K22)</jats:p>
10.1093/rfs/hhag065.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>传统上，基金经理代表基金投资者行使投票权。近期，一种“穿透式投票”模式逐渐兴起，基金为投资者提供选择：将投票权委托给基金，或自行投票。我们构建了一个分析框架，研究投票选择权的影响。这一机制既能反映投资者异质性偏好，也会塑造投票的信息含量，而这两种力量可能相互冲突。当利益一致时，投票选择权能够改善信息聚合效率并提升投资者福利；然而，在偏好异质性或信息成本存在的情况下，该机制可能因削弱知情投票而降低投资者福利。（JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, K22）</jats:p>
10.1093/rfs/hhag065.title: Voting Choice

10.1111/1467-8489.70128.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the influence of gender on the adoption of Climate‐Smart Agriculture (CSA) practices in West Africa. An exogenous switching treatment effect regression model with the Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition method is used in the study. Data were collected from the 2018/2019 Harmonized Household Living Conditions Survey across five West African countries. The results indicate that if female plot managers had the same characteristics as their male counterparts, their likelihood of adopting CSA practices would increase, yet it would still be lower than that of men. The decomposition analysis shows a significant gender gap favouring men in Burkina Faso and Senegal, unlike in Ivory Coast and Togo. These gender differences are mainly due to structural factors such as household size, education, access to credit, commercialisation, income, livestock ownership, family labour, pesticide use, soil fertility and the availability of agricultural extension agents and cooperatives. To effectively address gender disparities in CSA adoption, policies could focus on improving these structural conditions rather than solely on ensuring equal access to production resources. This approach would enhance policy effectiveness and empower women to better utilise their agricultural resources.
10.1111/1467-8489.70128.abstract_zh: 本文考察了性别对西非气候智慧型农业（CSA）实践采纳的影响。研究采用外生转换处理效应回归模型与奥克萨卡-布林德分解方法，数据来源于2018/2019年五个西非国家的统一家庭生活条件调查。结果表明，若女性地块管理者具备与男性相同的特征，其采纳CSA实践的可能性将有所提升，但仍低于男性。分解分析显示，布基纳法索和塞内加尔存在显著偏向男性的性别差距，而科特迪瓦和多哥则未出现此类差异。这些性别差异主要源于结构性因素，包括家庭规模、教育水平、信贷获取、商业化程度、收入、牲畜所有权、家庭劳动力、农药使用、土壤肥力以及农业推广人员和合作社的可及性。为有效解决CSA采纳中的性别差异，政策应侧重于改善这些结构性条件，而非仅关注生产资源的平等获取。这一方法将提升政策有效性，并增强女性利用农业资源的能力。
10.1111/1467-8489.70128.title: Gender and Adoption of Climate‐Smart Agricultural Practices in Developing Countries: Evidence From West African Countries

10.1111/1467-8489.70130.abstract: ABSTRACT Conservation on working agricultural lands is increasingly recognised as a critical strategy for enhancing the resilience of food systems in the face of climate change. Despite the growing funding worldwide for climate‐smart agriculture and forestry (CSAF) practices, we lack a comprehensive assessment of their economic impacts. Focusing on the impacts of CSAF practices on agricultural productivity and resilience in the United States, we estimate the effects of payments under the Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP) for CSAF on county‐level yields, land rent and measures of production losses for corn, soybean and winter wheat. We also account for the potential confounding effects of land retirement through the Conservation Reserve Program (CRP). Our findings suggest that EQIP payments for CSAF practices are associated with reductions in county‐level corn production losses. In contrast, payments for non‐CSAF practices may increase loss measures. These findings highlight the importance of targeted conservation investments in improving agricultural resilience.
10.1111/1467-8489.70130.abstract_zh: 摘要 在应对气候变化的背景下，农业用地上的保护措施日益被视为增强粮食系统韧性的关键策略。尽管全球对气候智慧型农业与林业（CSAF）实践的资助不断增加，但对其经济影响的全面评估仍显不足。本研究聚焦美国CSAF实践对农业生产力和韧性的影响，通过估算环境质量激励计划（EQIP）中CSAF相关补贴对县级玉米、大豆和冬小麦的产量、地租及生产损失指标的作用，同时考虑保护储备计划（CRP）中土地休耕可能带来的混杂效应。研究结果表明，针对CSAF实践的EQIP补贴与县级玉米生产损失减少存在关联；相反，非CSAF实践的补贴可能加剧损失指标。这些发现凸显了定向保护投资在提升农业韧性方面的重要性。

Economic Impacts of Climate‐Smart Agriculture and Forestry Practices: Evidence From the
                    USDA

10.1111/1467-8489.70132.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the short‐ and long‐run effects of the 2015 Nepal Earthquake on paddy production using a difference‐in‐differences framework and district‐level panel data spanning 2010–2019. We document a 10.95% decline in paddy production and a 6.94% decline in yield in earthquake‐affected districts in the short run, with effects fully dissipating over the long run. Decomposing production losses into intensive and extensive margins reveals that the intensive margin explains the majority of losses. Heterogeneity analysis shows that production losses scale with seismic intensity while yield losses operate as a common behavioural shock uniformly across affected districts. Household survey evidence confirms two reinforcing channels: a contraction in agricultural labour supply during the critical planting season and a reallocation of household resources toward reconstruction of damaged dwellings.
10.1111/1467-8489.70132.abstract_zh: 本文采用双重差分框架及2010–2019年区级面板数据，考察2015年尼泊尔地震对水稻生产的短期与长期影响。研究发现，地震受灾地区的水稻产量在短期内下降10.95%，单产下降6.94%，但长期来看这些影响完全消散。将产量损失分解为集约边际与广延边际后发现，集约边际解释了大部分损失。异质性分析表明，产量损失随地震烈度递增，而单产损失则表现为受灾地区普遍存在的共同行为冲击。家户调查证据证实了两种相互强化的传导渠道：关键播种季节农业劳动力供给的收缩，以及家户资源向受损房屋重建的重新配置。

10.1111/1467-8489.70138.abstract: ABSTRACT This special issue examines the economics of greenhouse gas (GHG) mitigation in agriculture. The papers in the issue study agricultural mitigation from three broad perspectives: the design of mitigation incentives, the economic benefits of mitigation practices and programmes, and the adoption and behavioural responses by producers, consumers and other stakeholders. The papers span a wide range of countries, production systems and policy contexts, and collectively show that translating mitigation potential into mitigation outcomes depends critically on incentive design, measurement and the actions across producers, consumers, regulators and supply‐chain actors.

<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study examines whether household tap water access affects income‐generating work time among employed rural adults in China. While existing studies have mainly examined the effects of improved water access on employment participation, off‐farm transition and household income, this paper focuses on the intensive margin of labour supply within existing livelihood activities. Drawing on household production and time allocation theory, household tap water access is conceptualised as reducing the time cost of routine domestic production, thereby releasing time that may be reallocated to income‐generating work and other household activities. Using rural panel data from the China Family Panel Studies from 2014 to 2022, the analysis applies individual fixed‐effects models and instrumental variables fixed‐effects (IV‐FE) estimates. The fixed effects results show that household tap water access is associated with approximately one additional hour of income‐generating work per week among employed rural adults. Under the IV identifying assumptions, the IV‐FE estimates suggest a larger positive effect. Additional time‐use analysis indicates that household tap water access reduces daily housework time by about 0.29 h and modestly increases midday nap duration, while no statistically significant changes are found for television watching or leisure reading. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that the increase in work time is concentrated among agricultural workers, self‐employed individuals, prime‐age adults and individuals living in households without young children.</jats:p>
10.1111/1467-8489.70142.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了家庭自来水供应是否影响中国农村就业成年人的创收工作时间。现有研究主要关注改善水资源获取对就业参与、非农转移和家庭收入的影响，而本文聚焦于现有生计活动中劳动力供给的集约边际。基于家庭生产与时间分配理论，家庭自来水供应被概念化为降低日常家务生产的时间成本，从而释放出可能重新分配至创收工作及其他家庭活动的时间。利用2014年至2022年中国家庭追踪调查的农村面板数据，本文采用个体固定效应模型和工具变量固定效应估计。固定效应结果显示，家庭自来水供应与农村就业成年人每周约增加一小时的创收工作时间相关。在工具变量识别假设下，工具变量固定效应估计表明存在更大的正向效应。额外的时间使用分析显示，家庭自来水供应使每日家务时间减少约0.29小时，并适度增加午睡时长，而看电视或休闲阅读的时间未发现统计显著变化。异质性分析表明，工作时间的增加主要集中在农业劳动者、自雇者、壮年成年人以及无幼儿家庭中的个体。

10.1111/1756-2171.70057.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study the optimal design of a monopoly platform that interacts with heterogeneous firms and consumers who face uncertainty about product values and prices. Consumers search randomly among firms recommended by the platform. The platform designs a menu of contracts tailored to different firm types and allocates consumer visits across these firms. We show that the optimal platform design creates a “superstar effect,” whereby high‐type firms capture a disproportionately large market share, and improves consumer welfare relative to the no‐design benchmark.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70057.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个垄断平台的最优设计问题，该平台与异质性企业以及面临产品价值和价格不确定性的消费者进行互动。消费者在平台推荐的企业中进行随机搜索。平台针对不同类型的企业设计了一套定制化合同菜单，并将消费者访问量分配给这些企业。研究表明，最优平台设计会产生“超级明星效应”，即高类型企业获得不成比例的巨大市场份额，并且与无设计基准相比，该设计能够改善消费者福利。
10.1111/1756-2171.70057.title: Consumer Search, Firm Heterogeneity, and Platform Design
10.1111/1756-2171.70057.title_zh: 消费者搜索、企业异质性与平台设计

10.1111/1756-2171.70058.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This article studies price discrimination by a seller who uses data on observables that buyers can control (or manipulate) at a cost. If the seller's discriminatory prices are offered covertly, equilibrium market segmentation is always coarse, resulting in limited price discrimination. In contrast, if prices must be transparently posted, every buyer pays a personalized price in equilibrium, though this does not always reduce buyer or social welfare. The analysis sheds new light on calls for transparency in how sellers utilize consumer data to customize prices and highlights potential issues with assessing welfare using (only) observed prices, pricing conduct, and market coverage.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70058.abstract_zh: 本文研究卖方利用买方可以控制（或操纵）的可观测数据进行价格歧视的行为。若卖方的歧视性定价以隐蔽方式提供，均衡市场分割始终较为粗糙，导致有限的价格歧视。相反，若价格必须透明公示，则均衡状态下每位买方均需支付个性化价格，但这并不总能降低买方福利或社会福利。该分析为要求卖方透明化利用消费者数据定制价格的呼声提供了新视角，并揭示了仅依据观测价格、定价行为及市场覆盖率评估福利时可能存在的问题。
10.1111/1756-2171.70058.title: Price Discrimination With Manipulable Observables

10.1111/1756-2171.70059.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This article provides a full characterization of the competitive effects of horizontal mergers in the Cournot model with heterogeneous firms and constant marginal costs. We show that price effects depend only on the smaller merging firm's market share and the number of firms but are independent of the distribution of market shares among other firms. Standard concentration measures, instead, are often misleading. We also provide simple—yet general—closed‐form solutions for merger effects based on pre‐merger parameters. Moreover, we extend the model to study the combination of output and input market power and relate our results to the Merger Guidelines.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70059.abstract_zh: 本文全面刻画了异质性企业且边际成本恒定条件下古诺模型中横向合并的竞争效应。研究表明，价格效应仅取决于规模较小合并企业的市场份额及企业数量，而与其他企业的市场份额分布无关。相比之下，标准集中度指标往往具有误导性。我们基于合并前参数，为合并效应提供了简洁而通用的闭式解。此外，我们将模型拓展至产出市场与投入市场势力的联合分析，并将研究结论与《合并指南》相关联。
10.1111/1756-2171.70059.title: The Competitive Effects of Mergers with Cournot Competition
10.1111/1756-2171.70059.title_zh: 古诺竞争下并购的竞争效应

10.1111/1756-2171.70060.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study the market effects of sponsored search auctions for advertising space on searches for brands. In our model,  firms simultaneously choose the price of their product and the bids for the advertising auctions triggered by their own and rivals' brand keywords search. In any symmetric equilibrium, each firm wins its own keyword auction, and relative to a no‐ads benchmark, online advertising raises the winning brand's marginal cost and ultimately market prices. Only in an environment with strong initial asymmetries do we find that brand advertising might be beneficial.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70060.abstract_zh: 我们研究了品牌搜索中赞助搜索广告拍卖的市场效应。在模型中，企业同时选择产品价格以及针对自身和竞争对手品牌关键词搜索触发的广告拍卖出价。在任何对称均衡中，每家企业都能赢得自身关键词拍卖；与无广告基准相比，在线广告提高了获胜品牌的边际成本，并最终推高了市场价格。仅在初始不对称性较强的环境中，我们才发现品牌广告可能是有益的。
10.1111/1756-2171.70060.title: Market Effects of Brand Search Advertising

10.1111/1756-2171.70061.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study oligopolistic competition by firms practicing second‐degree price discrimination. In line with the literature on demand estimation, our theory allows consumers' propensity to switch brands to vary with tastes for product quality. If low‐type consumers are sufficiently more (respectively, less) prone to switch brands than are high types, (i) quality provision is inefficiently low at the bottom (respectively, high at the top) of the product line, and (ii) informational rents are positive (respectively, negative) for high types and negative (respectively, positive) for low types. Interestingly, we show that an increase in the number of competing firms may decrease welfare (by tightening incentive constraints), so much so that monopoly may be welfare superior to oligopoly. Pure‐strategy equilibria fail to exist, resulting in price‐quality dispersion across firms, whenever the propensity to switch brands is sufficiently different across consumers types.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70061.abstract_zh: 我们研究了实施二级价格歧视的企业在寡头竞争中的行为。与需求估计文献一致，我们的理论允许消费者转换品牌的倾向随其对产品质量的偏好而变化。若低类型消费者比高类型消费者更易（或更不易）转换品牌，则：（i）产品线底端（或顶端）的质量供给将出现低效不足（或过高）；（ii）高类型消费者获得正（或负）信息租金，而低类型消费者获得负（或正）信息租金。有趣的是，我们发现竞争企业数量的增加可能降低社会福利（通过强化激励约束），以至于垄断可能比寡头更有利于社会福利。当不同消费者类型的品牌转换倾向差异足够大时，纯策略均衡将不存在，导致企业间出现价格-质量离散现象。
10.1111/1756-2171.70061.title: Nonlinear Pricing in Oligopoly: How Brand Preferences Shape Market Outcomes
10.1111/1756-2171.70061.title_zh: 寡头市场中的非线性定价：品牌偏好如何塑造市场结果

10.1111/1756-2171.70062.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We adopt a dynamic mechanism design approach to study how a revenue‐maximizing seller should sell an indivisible object when a buyer with a private value can search for an outside option with continuous‐intensity choices. We find that lowering the buyer's search cost definitely reduces the seller's revenue when the buyer's search decision is binary, as in Armstrong and Zhou (2016). In contrast, with continuous search intensity, a counterintuitive effect may arise: lowering the buyer's search cost function can, under mild conditions, actually increase the seller's revenue.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70062.abstract_zh: 我们采用动态机制设计方法，研究当具有私人价值的买方能够通过连续强度选择搜索外部选项时，追求收益最大化的卖方应如何销售不可分割商品。研究发现，当买方搜索决策为二元选择时（如Armstrong与Zhou 2016年所述），降低买方搜索成本必然减少卖方收益。然而在连续搜索强度下，可能产生反直觉效应：在温和条件下，降低买方搜索成本函数反而可能增加卖方收益。
10.1111/1756-2171.70062.title: Buyer's Hidden Search With Continuous Intensity: The Seller‐Optimal Mechanism and a Perverse Effect
10.1111/1756-2171.70062.title_zh: 连续强度下买方的隐藏搜索：卖方最优机制与一种反常效应

10.1111/1756-2171.70064.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>The energy transition from coal to gas is reshaping the power sector to rely more on gas generation, which is cleaner but has more variable input costs. Using counterfactual analysis, I study the competitive effects of this transition, by considering several transition paths that differ in the types of firms involved in retiring coal plants and investing in gas plants. I show that the variable nature of the marginal cost of gas generation creates an environment in which market power could increase after the transition. However, the transition's impact on competition depends on the characteristics of the firms investing in new gas generation; the adverse impact is mitigated under a well‐planned transition that leads to a more competitive industry structure.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70064.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>从煤炭向天然气的能源转型正重塑电力行业，使其更加依赖天然气发电——这种发电方式更清洁，但投入成本波动性更大。通过反事实分析，本文研究了这一转型的竞争效应，考虑了若干种不同的转型路径，这些路径在参与退役燃煤电厂和投资天然气电厂的企业类型上存在差异。研究表明，天然气发电边际成本的波动性特征创造了一种环境，使得转型后市场势力可能增强。然而，转型对竞争的影响取决于投资新建天然气发电企业的特征；在精心规划的转型路径下，这种不利影响会得到缓解，从而形成更具竞争性的行业结构。</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70064.title: Cleaner but Volatile Energy? The Effect of Coal Plant Retirement on Market Competition in the Wholesale Electricity Market

10.1111/1756-2171.70067.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study a two‐period learning model where a sequentially rational regulator builds a reputation for strict enforcement and self‐interested firms test the regulator's enforcement propensity through their misconduct. In the transparent setting, where misconduct and enforcement are observable between the firms, the regulator's reputation concern endogenously creates positive or negative enforcement externalities between the firms. When the reputation concern is strong, the enforcement externalities are negative and dominate the information externalities, encouraging misconduct. Otherwise, both externalities are positive and deter misconduct. Although a strong reputation always benefits the regulator in the opaque setting, it often backfires in a transparent setting.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70067.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个两期学习模型，其中具有序贯理性特征的监管者致力于建立严格执法的声誉，而自利的企业则通过其不当行为来试探监管者的执法倾向。在透明环境下（企业间可观察到不当行为与执法行为），监管者的声誉关切会内生地在企业间产生正向或负向的执法外部性。当声誉关切较强时，执法外部性为负向且主导信息外部性，从而助长不当行为；反之，两种外部性均为正向，能够抑制不当行为。尽管在非透明环境下，强大的声誉始终有利于监管者，但在透明环境下，这种声誉往往会产生适得其反的效果。
10.1111/1756-2171.70067.title: Peer Learning, Enforcement, and Reputation

10.1111/1756-2171.70068.abstract: ABSTRACT Firms in decentralized markets often trade using quantity contracts, agreements specifying quantity prior to the point of sale. These contracts are valuable because they provide quantity assurance, as trading frictions could prevent a buyer and seller from matching in the spot market. However, quantity contracts prevent sellers from optimally allocating production across buyers after market conditions realize. Using proprietary invoice data, we estimate a model of quantity contracts in the pulp and paper industry. The average value of a quantity contract is 10% of profits, but would be 55% larger if sellers could optimally allocate production after market conditions realize.
10.1111/1756-2171.70068.abstract_zh: 摘要 在分散市场中，企业常采用数量合同进行交易，即在销售前约定具体数量的协议。此类合同因能提供数量保障而具有价值——交易摩擦可能导致买卖双方在现货市场中无法匹配。然而，数量合同会阻碍卖方在市场条件实现后，将生产在买方之间进行最优配置。我们利用专有发票数据，对纸浆与造纸行业中的数量合同模型进行了估计。数量合同的平均价值相当于利润的10%，但若卖方能在市场条件实现后实现生产的最优配置，该价值将提升55%。
10.1111/1756-2171.70068.title: Pulp Friction: The Value of Quantity Contracts in Decentralized Markets
10.1111/1756-2171.70068.title_zh: 纸浆摩擦：分散市场中数量合约的价值

10.1111/1756-2171.70069.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In this article, we examine the importance of individual physicians in explaining the significant variation in prescription drug spending in Medicare Part D. By tracking prescribing behavior before and after physician relocations, we find that movers' prescribing converges toward the average of their new location. However, this convergence is far from complete, highlighting the importance of idiosyncratic physician‐specific factors. Overall, these physician‐specific factors explain about 60 to 70 percent of the cross‐sectional variation in prescription drug spending, suggesting that physicians are one of the most important supply‐side determinants of this variation. We investigate several potential mechanisms behind this partial convergence.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70069.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文探讨了在医疗保险D部分处方药支出显著差异中，个体医生的重要性。通过追踪医生迁移前后的处方行为，我们发现迁移者的处方模式会逐渐趋近于新地区的平均水平。然而，这种趋同远未完全实现，凸显了医生个体特有因素的关键作用。总体而言，这些医生特有因素解释了处方药支出横截面差异的60%至70%，表明医生是导致这种差异的最重要供给侧决定因素之一。我们进一步研究了这种部分趋同背后的若干潜在机制。
10.1111/1756-2171.70069.title: What Causes Geographic Variation in Drug Prescribing? Evidence from Physician Migration
10.1111/1756-2171.70069.title_zh: 医生迁移视角下药品处方地理差异的成因分析

10.1111/1756-2171.70070.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In the presence of adverse selection, mergers can increase welfare through a reduction in inefficient sorting. I characterize the sorting externality internalized between merging firms in a tractable discrete choice model. Mergers benefit consumers when the firms are small, willingness to pay is moderately increasing in cost, and consumer costs are skewed. Applying the model to the non‐group health insurance market, 13% of potential mergers would improve consumer surplus. In markets where the sorting distortion exceeds $5 per person, nearly one‐third of mergers improve consumer surplus, highlighting the importance of considering adverse selection in merger evaluation.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70070.abstract_zh: 在逆向选择存在的情况下，并购可以通过减少低效分类来提高福利。我在一个易于处理的离散选择模型中刻画了并购企业之间内部化的分类外部性。当企业规模较小、支付意愿随成本适度递增且消费者成本呈偏态分布时，并购对消费者有利。将该模型应用于非团体健康保险市场，13%的潜在并购将改善消费者剩余。在分类扭曲超过每人5美元的市场中，近三分之一的并购会提升消费者剩余，这凸显了在并购评估中考虑逆向选择的重要性。
10.1111/1756-2171.70070.title: Mergers in the Presence of Adverse Selection
10.1111/1756-2171.70070.title_zh: 逆向选择下的企业并购

10.1111/1756-2171.70071.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>A coarse certification provides simple but incomplete information. Its rationale is to help consumers trade off dimensions of quality that are complex and lack salience. In imperfectly competitive markets, it may induce excess bunching at the certification requirement, crowd out quality, and facilitate price discrimination. Who will ultimately benefit from a coarse certification thus depends on the degree of market power firms can exercise as well as on consumers' sophistication in responding to such information. I use a structural econometric model of the U.S. appliance market to illustrate these insights using the ENERGY STAR certification as a case study.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70071.abstract_zh: 粗放型认证提供简单但不完整的信息。其基本原理是帮助消费者权衡复杂且缺乏显著性的质量维度。在不完全竞争市场中，这种认证可能导致企业在认证要求处过度聚集、挤占质量提升空间，并促进价格歧视。因此，粗放型认证的最终受益者取决于企业能够行使的市场势力程度，以及消费者对此类信息的反应成熟度。本文以能源之星认证为案例，运用美国家电市场的结构计量经济学模型来阐释上述见解。
10.1111/1756-2171.70071.title: The Incidence of Coarse Certification: Evidence From the ENERGY STAR Program
10.1111/1756-2171.70071.title_zh: 粗略认证的影响：来自能源之星计划的证据

10.1111/1756-2171.70073.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This article examines the welfare consequences of a trade association in an exporting country on consumers in destination countries. We estimate a structural model of the Chilean Salmon exporting industry that endogenizes firms' pricing and export decisions. Our results show that the trade association has a positive effect on consumer utility and involves higher marginal costs of production, consistent with higher quality products. Reduced form analysis estimates price effects associated with trade association membership of 3 to 8 percent. Our counterfactual analysis reveals that eliminating the trade association would reduce consumer welfare by 1.7 billion USD in destination countries.</jats:p>
10.1111/1756-2171.70073.abstract_zh: 本文研究了出口国行业协会对目的地国家消费者的福利影响。我们构建了智利鲑鱼出口行业的结构模型，将企业的定价与出口决策内生化。研究结果表明，该行业协会对消费者效用具有正向影响，同时伴随着更高的边际生产成本，这与产品质量提升的结论一致。简化形式分析估计，行业协会成员身份带来的价格效应为3%至8%。反事实分析显示，若取消该行业协会，目的地国家的消费者福利将减少17亿美元。

10.1111/agec.70117.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Cocoa production forms the backbone of West Africa's agricultural economy, sustaining smallholder farmers whose livelihoods depend on stable yields. Critical to these yields is the provision of pollination services by a few key species, notably, the minuscule
                    <jats:italic>Forcipomyia</jats:italic>
                    spp. While many studies have modeled the effects of complete pollinator collapse, the impacts of gradual declines remain little studied. In this study, we develop an integrated ecological–economic model that links pollinator abundance with cocoa yield, incorporating the global cocoa market and an economy‐wide framework for Ghana, one of the world's major cocoa producers. We examine scenarios in which declines in pollinator populations occur at regional, national, and supranational scales. Our analysis reveals that localized declines in pollinator populations detrimentally affect cocoa farmers and Ghana's national economy, with rural communities and low‐income households bearing a disproportionate share of the welfare losses. In contrast, widespread declines across West Africa trigger a “King effect” where rising global cocoa prices partially mitigate production losses, benefiting farmers while overall consumer surplus declines. These results highlight the necessity of conserving pollinator biodiversity to safeguard cocoa production and economic welfare at multiple scales.
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/agec.70117.abstract_zh: 可可生产是西非农业经济的支柱，维系着依赖稳定产量维持生计的小农户。对产量至关重要的因素是少数关键物种提供的授粉服务，尤其是微小的蠓属（*Forcipomyia* spp.）。尽管许多研究模拟了完全授粉者崩溃的影响，但逐渐减少的影响仍鲜有研究。本研究构建了一个整合生态经济模型，将授粉者丰度与可可产量联系起来，并纳入全球可可市场以及加纳（全球主要可可生产国之一）的经济整体框架。我们考察了授粉者种群在区域、国家和超国家尺度上下降的情景。分析表明，授粉者种群的局部下降对可可农户和加纳国民经济产生不利影响，农村社区和低收入家庭承担了不成比例的福利损失。相比之下，西非地区广泛授粉者下降会触发“国王效应”，即全球可可价格上涨部分抵消了产量损失，使农户受益，而整体消费者剩余下降。这些结果凸显了保护授粉者生物多样性对于在多尺度上保障可可生产和经济福利的必要性。

10.1111/agec.70125.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Studies that analyze the transmission of food prices from international to domestic markets for large sets of countries and products assume that price relationships are time‐invariant. However, studies that look in detail at individual countries and products show that countries respond to increasing international food prices with measures that increase the insulation of their domestic markets and thus weaken international‐to‐domestic price transmission. We analyze relationships between international prices and a large set of domestic prices for wheat, yellow and white maize, and rice using a smooth‐transition error correction model. This specification relaxes the assumption of time‐invariant price transmission by allowing price relationships and domestic market insulation to vary over time depending on international price levels. The results confirm that international‐to‐domestic price transmission weakens in many countries during periods of high international prices, such as 2007/08 and 2022. Our findings highlight a collective action problem: as more countries insulate, the global trading system's capacity to buffer shocks diminishes, amplifying volatility and food security risks.</jats:p>
10.1111/agec.70125.abstract_zh: 摘要：针对大量国家和产品分析国际粮食价格向国内市场传导的研究，通常假设价格关系具有时间不变性。然而，聚焦单个国家和产品的详细研究表明，各国在面对国际粮价上涨时，会采取增强国内市场隔离度的措施，从而削弱国际价格向国内价格的传导。本文采用平滑转换误差修正模型，分析国际价格与小麦、黄玉米、白玉米及大米的大量国内价格之间的关系。该模型通过允许价格关系及国内市场隔离度随国际价格水平变化，放宽了价格传导时间不变性的假设。结果证实，在国际价格高企时期（如2007/08年度及2022年），许多国家的国际-国内价格传导效应显著减弱。研究结果揭示了一个集体行动困境：随着更多国家实施市场隔离，全球贸易体系缓冲冲击的能力下降，从而加剧价格波动与粮食安全风险。

10.1111/agec.70129.abstract: ABSTRACT This study develops a theoretical framework to examine the welfare effects of scale transition from smallholders to large farms. Taking hog farming in China as an example, this study focuses on the coexistence equilibrium with both smallholders and large farms and assesses the distributional effects on rural households (independent smallholders, employed smallholders, and quitters), urban consumers, and aggregate social welfare. The simulation findings reveal that the transition to large farms results in long‐term welfare losses for employed smallholsers, as well as rural households as a whole. This outcome is attributed to a reversed income effect, whereby the initial employment gains gradually diminish as the scale of transition progresses. Conversely, urban consumers gain substantial welfare improvements owing to lower retail pork prices, which are driven by the credit advantages and technological innovations of large farms. Additionally, aggregate social welfare improves as consumer surplus outpaces smallholder welfare losses. This research unpacks the intermediary step in the transition from smallholders to large farms and provides theoretical insights for agricultural transitions in developing economies.
10.1111/agec.70129.abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个理论框架，用以考察从小农户向大规模农场转型的福利效应。以中国生猪养殖为例，本文聚焦于小农户与大规模农场共存均衡状态，评估其对农村家庭（独立小农户、受雇小农户及退出农户）、城市消费者以及社会总福利的分配效应。模拟结果表明，向大规模农场的转型会导致受雇小农户及农村家庭整体的长期福利损失。这一结果源于反向收入效应——随着转型规模推进，初始就业收益逐渐递减。相反，由于大规模农场的信贷优势和技术创新降低了猪肉零售价格，城市消费者获得了显著的福利改善。此外，由于消费者剩余的增长超过小农户的福利损失，社会总福利得以提升。本研究揭示了从小农户向大规模农场转型的中间环节，为发展中经济体的农业转型提供了理论洞见。
10.1111/agec.70129.title: Welfare Effects of Scale Transition From Smallholders to Large Farms: A Theoretical Framework
10.1111/agec.70129.title_zh: 小农户向大规模农场转型的福利效应：一个理论框架

10.1111/agec.70130.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Demand estimates are commonly used to inform firm strategy and public policy, yet they can obscure important variation in demand across geographic space that is relevant for local business decisions and policy interventions. Prior work documents demand heterogeneity across countries, regions, states, and between coarse urban‐rural categories, but evidence on sub‐metropolitan variation is limited. This study documents within‐metro geographic heterogeneity in market shares and willingness‐to‐pay (WTP) for retail and foodservice protein products. I use nearly six years of publicly available survey data and random parameters logit models that include municipality interactions with alternative‐specific constants and price sensitivity to estimate municipality‐specific market shares and WTP in the Phoenix metropolitan area. Demand varies substantially across adjacent municipalities. Central Phoenix residents exhibit higher retail WTP for conventional beef, pork, and chicken products, while both central Phoenix and Scottsdale‐Tempe residents show consistently higher foodservice WTP. Median WTP in these municipalities is roughly 30–50% higher than in surrounding suburbs, whereas suburban groups exhibit similar valuations to one another. These within‐metro differences are large enough to affect targeted pricing and assortment strategies and to produce uneven distributional welfare effects from local price policies (e.g., taxes). The results suggest that investment in geographically refined demand analyses could better inform policy interventions and business decisions at the local level, where those decisions are often made.</jats:p>
10.1111/agec.70130.abstract_zh: 需求估计通常用于指导企业战略和公共政策，但可能掩盖地理空间上需求的重要差异，而这些差异与地方商业决策和政策干预密切相关。已有研究记录了国家、地区、州以及城乡粗分类之间的需求异质性，但关于大都市内部子区域差异的证据有限。本研究揭示了凤凰城大都市区内零售和餐饮服务蛋白质产品市场份额及支付意愿（WTP）的地理异质性。我利用近六年的公开调查数据，并采用包含城市固定效应与替代特定常数及价格敏感度交互项的随机参数Logit模型，估算凤凰城大都市区各城市的特定市场份额和支付意愿。结果显示，相邻城市间的需求存在显著差异。凤凰城市中心居民对传统牛肉、猪肉和鸡肉产品的零售支付意愿较高，而凤凰城市中心及斯科茨代尔-坦佩居民的餐饮服务支付意愿持续偏高。这些城市的支付意愿中位数比周边郊区高出约30-50%，而郊区群体之间的估值则较为接近。这种大都市内部差异足以影响针对性的定价和产品组合策略，并导致地方价格政策（如税收）产生不均等的分配福利效应。研究结果表明，投资于地理精细化需求分析能更好地为地方层面的政策干预和商业决策提供信息，而这些决策通常正是在地方层面制定的。
10.1111/agec.70130.title: Beyond Metropolitan Averages: Food Demand Across Local Markets
10.1111/agec.70130.title_zh: 超越都市均值：地方市场的食品需求

10.1111/agec.70131.abstract: ABSTRACT This study examined the effect of the West‐to‐East Electricity Transmission Project in China on agricultural productivity. The project transmits electricity from the resource‐rich west to the consumer‐dense east. Using a Difference‐in‐Differences approach, we found that the project increased county‐level agricultural productivity by about USD 509.5 per person. This increase results from advances in agricultural technological progress and the development of the agricultural industry. Farmer adaptation to improved electricity supply also contributed, such as expanded irrigation, greater land allocation to water‐intensive crops, higher replanting indices, and larger‐scale operations. The project has also raised grain yields and farmers’ disposable incomes, while reducing the agricultural labor force. Only electricity transmission, not natural gas or oil, had a positive and significant effect on agricultural productivity. These results support compelling evidence for investing in large‐scale transregional electricity transmission infrastructure worldwide.
10.1111/agec.70131.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国“西电东送”工程对农业生产率的影响。该工程将电力从资源丰富的西部地区输送至人口密集的东部地区。采用双重差分法，我们发现该工程使县级农业生产率人均提高了约509.5美元。这一增长源于农业技术进步和农业产业发展。农民对电力供应改善的适应性调整也起到了促进作用，例如扩大灌溉面积、增加高耗水作物的土地配置、提高复种指数以及扩大经营规模。该工程还提高了粮食产量和农民可支配收入，同时减少了农业劳动力。只有电力传输（而非天然气或石油）对农业生产率产生了显著的正向影响。这些结果为全球范围内投资大规模跨区域电力传输基础设施提供了有力证据。
10.1111/agec.70131.title: Long‐Distance Electricity Transmission and Agricultural Productivity Growth: Evidence From China
10.1111/agec.70131.title_zh: 远距离输电与农业生产力增长：来自中国的证据

10.1111/agec.70132.abstract: ABSTRACT Viticulture is a key economic sector in Europe, but responsible for vast amounts of fungicide use. Fungus‐resistant grapevine varieties are less susceptible to fungal diseases, reducing fungicide use by up to 80%. However, their adoption remains limited, despite their economic and environmental advantages. We develop a bio‐economic simulation model with a real options investment perspective to analyze farmers’ decisions to adopt resistant varieties, accounting for different risk factors (e.g., production, market, policy). We apply the model to the case of Swiss viticulture. Results indicate that in the short‐term, adoption barriers persist for the majority of farmers, with replanting occurring only when favorable conditions are met, such as low discount rates, high disease pressure, and available price premia. Conversely, we find that in the long‐term, as vines reach replacement age, resistant varieties are favored over traditional ones. Our findings further indicate that increases in disease pressure, for example, due to climate change, are likely to accelerate the early adoption of fungus‐resistant varieties. We highlight potential avenues for improving current support for replanting in Switzerland, for example, through market access and information provision. By integrating risk and managerial flexibility into a dynamic, real options decision‐making framework, this study provides new insights for designing effective policies to promote sustainable pest management in viticulture.
10.1111/agec.70132.abstract_zh: 摘要：葡萄栽培是欧洲重要的经济部门，但也是大量杀菌剂使用的来源。抗真菌葡萄品种对真菌病害的敏感性较低，可将杀菌剂使用量减少高达80%。然而，尽管具有经济和环境优势，其采用率仍然有限。我们构建了一个结合实物期权投资视角的生物经济模拟模型，用于分析农户采纳抗性品种的决策，并考虑了不同风险因素（如生产、市场、政策）。我们将该模型应用于瑞士葡萄栽培案例。结果表明，短期内，大多数农户仍面临采用障碍，只有在满足低贴现率、高病害压力和可获得溢价等有利条件时才会进行重新种植。相反，我们发现长期来看，当葡萄藤达到更新树龄时，抗性品种比传统品种更受青睐。我们的研究进一步表明，病害压力的增加（例如因气候变化所致）可能加速抗真菌品种的早期采用。我们指出了改善瑞士当前重新种植支持政策的潜在途径，例如通过市场准入和信息提供。通过将风险和管理灵活性纳入动态的实物期权决策框架，本研究为设计促进葡萄栽培可持续病虫害管理的有效政策提供了新见解。

10.1111/caje.70057.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study the competition and welfare effects of upstream partial ownerships (UPO) in a framework with two competing supply chains and downstream firms choosing their product positionings strategically. We find that UPO reduces downstream product differentiation and thus intensifies downstream competition. Unlike the standard results of Bertrand competition, we find that downstream prices can be strategic substitutes even when downstream firms compete in Bertrand fashion. More importantly, we show that UPO increases consumer surplus and social welfare, even when double marginalization increases downstream prices. The competition and welfare results from downstream partial ownerships (DPO) are just the opposite to those from UPO. Our findings have clear managerial and policy implications.</jats:p>
10.1111/caje.70057.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文研究了上游部分所有权（UPO）在两条竞争性供应链框架下的竞争与福利效应，其中下游企业战略性选择产品定位。研究发现，UPO会降低下游产品差异化程度，从而加剧下游竞争。与伯特兰竞争的标准结论不同，我们发现即使下游企业以伯特兰方式竞争，下游价格仍可能呈现战略替代性。更重要的是，我们证明即使双重边际化推高了下游价格，UPO仍能提升消费者剩余和社会福利。下游部分所有权（DPO）的竞争与福利效应则与UPO完全相反。本研究具有明确的管理与政策启示。
10.1111/caje.70057.title: Supply chain competition and the welfare effects of partial ownership
10.1111/caje.70057.title_zh: 供应链竞争与部分所有权的福利效应

10.1111/caje.70058.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper uses linked Census records from 1871 to 1901 to compute intergenerational mobility for Canadian regions and census divisions. The results reveal sharp differences in mobility over space: Ontario featured high relative and absolute mobility, Quebec low relative and absolute mobility and the Maritimes low absolute mobility. Local differences in human capital endowments and labour market inequality are correlated with division mobility patterns but do not account for regional differences, where migration and structural change toward industry and services appear important. Comparing spatial patterns of Canadian mobility in the 19th century to today shows substantial changes for Quebec districts.</jats:p>
10.1111/caje.70058.abstract_zh: 本文利用1871年至1901年的关联人口普查记录，计算了加拿大各地区及普查分区的代际流动性。结果显示，不同地区的流动性存在显著差异：安大略省具有较高的相对流动性和绝对流动性，魁北克省则表现出较低的相对流动性和绝对流动性，而滨海省份的绝对流动性较低。地方人力资本禀赋和劳动力市场不平等与分区流动性模式相关，但无法解释区域差异，其中向工业和服务业的迁移及结构转型似乎更为重要。将19世纪加拿大流动性的空间格局与当今对比，发现魁北克地区发生了显著变化。
10.1111/caje.70058.title: The geography of economic mobility in 19th‐century Canada
10.1111/caje.70058.title_zh: 19世纪加拿大经济流动性的地理分布

10.1111/caje.70060.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>As far back as 1755, Richard Cantillon analyzed how changes in the money supply affected relative prices in the economy. In times of monetary infusion, prices of certain types of goods and services could be expected to rise, depending upon the initial distribution of the money and therefore initial spending. Cantillon emphasized the case of new money falling into the hands of wealthy agents, driving up spending on luxuries, such as artworks (as well as financial assets), and causing their relative prices to increase. We present new evidence on the “Cantillon effect” as a potential explanation for movements in the prices of Canadian and Australian paintings since the mid‐1970s. We econometrically analyze the relationship between time series of the money supply and art prices in each country. Both countries represent peripheral art markets dominated by domestic private and corporate collectors, and they should thus be more responsive to domestic rather than international economic and monetary conditions. For both markets, we distinguish and separately analyze different tiers of the market, separating the very top from a lower segment. We find that prices for top Canadian artists follow the money supply relatively well over the long term, with a similar but slightly weaker result for the top Australian segment; notably, Australian middlebrow prices move more in line with the Consumer Price Index. These results suggest that national art markets are not homogeneous and that segmenting them for analytical purposes may be useful. Specifically, we find stronger evidence of a Cantillon effect in the upper end of the market, while prices of lower‐prestige paintings move more in line with consumer goods prices.</jats:p>
10.1111/caje.70060.abstract_zh: 早在1755年，理查德·坎蒂隆就分析了货币供给变化如何影响经济中的相对价格。在货币注入时期，某些商品和服务的价格预计会上涨，具体取决于货币的初始分配及由此产生的初始支出。坎蒂隆强调，当新增货币落入富裕阶层手中时，会推高奢侈品（如艺术品及金融资产）的支出，导致其相对价格上升。我们提供了关于“坎蒂隆效应”的新证据，将其作为自20世纪70年代中期以来加拿大和澳大利亚绘画价格变动的潜在解释。我们运用计量经济学方法，分析了各国货币供给时间序列与艺术品价格之间的关系。这两个国家均属于由国内私人及企业收藏家主导的边缘艺术市场，因此它们对国内而非国际经济与货币状况的反应更为敏感。针对这两个市场，我们区分并分别分析了不同市场层级，将顶级市场与较低层级市场分开。研究发现，长期来看，加拿大顶级艺术家的价格与货币供给的走势相对吻合，澳大利亚顶级市场的结果类似但略弱；值得注意的是，澳大利亚中端市场价格与消费者价格指数的变动更为一致。这些结果表明，国家艺术市场并非同质化，按分析目的对其进行分层可能具有价值。具体而言，我们在市场高端发现了更强的坎蒂隆效应证据，而低声望画作的价格则更贴近消费品价格的变动。
10.1111/caje.70060.title: Comparative Cantillon effects in the Canadian and Australian art markets
10.1111/caje.70060.title_zh: 加拿大与澳大利亚艺术市场中的比较康替龙效应

10.1111/caje.70061.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper generalizes the original Brander and Taylor model of open‐access renewable resource use and trade to address three common critiques. First, I introduce heterogeneity across agents in harvesting productivity to smooth out the model's extreme specialization patterns while maintaining its Ricardian structure and tractability. Second, I move beyond the original assumption of open access by constructing a policy stringency function allowing for partial, first‐best, and endogenous resource policy. Third, by exploiting the smooth substitution possibilities generated by agent heterogeneity and the insight that policy stringency functions are likely to vary across countries, I show how the model's core predictions can be evaluated using empirical methods related to those in growth econometrics.</jats:p>
10.1111/caje.70061.abstract_zh: 本文对Brander和Taylor关于开放获取可再生资源利用与贸易的原始模型进行了推广，以回应三项常见批评。首先，我在采掘生产率方面引入主体异质性，在保持模型李嘉图结构与可处理性的同时，平滑了其极端专业化模式。其次，通过构建一个允许部分最优、第一最优及内生资源政策的政策严格度函数，我突破了原始模型对开放获取的假设。第三，利用主体异质性产生的平滑替代可能性以及政策严格度函数可能因国家而异的洞见，我展示了如何运用增长计量经济学相关的实证方法来评估模型的核心预测。
10.1111/caje.70061.title: Is free trade good for renewable resources? Brander and Taylor redux
10.1111/caje.70061.title_zh: 自由贸易对可再生资源有益吗？布兰德与泰勒再探
