10.1111/caje.70067.abstract: Abstract This paper investigates the hypothesis that lower trade policy uncertainty (TPU) reduces the share of intrafirm trade in total trade. A significant change in US‐China TPU occurred in 2001 when China joined the WTO, providing a natural experiment to test this hypothesis. Using a difference‐in‐differences approach with industry‐level US data, I examine the trade effects of this change. The results indicate that the reduction in TPU between the US and China led to a significant increase in both US arm's‐length and intrafirm imports from China compared to pre‐WTO levels. Notably, the effect of TPU on arm's‐length trade is approximately twice that on intrafirm trade, with the disparity largely attributed to sunk costs. A simple model of production location and ownership choice under policy uncertainty provides a conceptual framework for understanding these findings.
10.1111/caje.70067.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了贸易政策不确定性（TPU）降低会减少公司内贸易在总贸易中占比这一假说。2001年中国加入WTO使美中贸易政策不确定性发生显著变化，为检验该假说提供了自然实验。本文采用双重差分法，基于美国行业层面数据，考察了这一变化带来的贸易效应。结果表明，相较于入世前水平，美中贸易政策不确定性的降低显著增加了美国从中国的独立企业间贸易和公司内进口。值得注意的是，贸易政策不确定性对独立企业间贸易的影响约为公司内贸易的两倍，这一差异主要归因于沉没成本。一个关于政策不确定性下生产区位与所有权选择的简单模型，为理解上述发现提供了概念框架。
10.1111/caje.70067.title: Trade policy uncertainty, organization of firms, and the form of international trade
10.1111/caje.70067.title_zh: 贸易政策不确定性、企业组织与国际贸易形式

10.1111/caje.70068.abstract: Abstract China's overseas patents grew rapidly in the past two decades at the same time as China became the world's largest exporter of merchandise goods. This paper investigates the effects of overseas patents on the volume and prices of Chinese firms' exports. We consider two channels. First, patents prevent imitation and rival entry, leading to higher quantities and prices. Second, patents reduce the likelihood of litigation and can allow firms to price more aggressively if they are keeping prices high to deter potential litigation in the export market. We find evidence of both. Both channels predict a higher quantity of exports, and we find evidence of that in the data. We also compile evidence consistent with patents allowing Chinese firms to price more aggressively (lower prices).
10.1111/caje.70068.abstract_zh: 摘要 过去二十年，中国海外专利数量快速增长，与此同时，中国成为全球最大的商品出口国。本文研究海外专利对中国企业出口规模与价格的影响。我们考虑两种作用机制：其一，专利阻止模仿与竞争者进入，从而提升出口数量与价格；其二，专利降低诉讼风险，若企业为规避出口市场潜在诉讼而维持高价，则专利可使其采取更激进的定价策略。实证结果支持两种机制的存在。两种机制均预测出口数量增加，数据验证了这一结论。此外，我们发现的证据表明，专利使中国企业能够采取更激进的定价策略（即降低价格）。
10.1111/caje.70068.title: Market expansion and litigation deterrence effects of patents: Evidence from Chinese exporters
10.1111/caje.70068.title_zh: 专利的市场扩张与诉讼威慑效应：来自中国出口企业的证据

10.1111/caje.70072.abstract: Abstract The global success of online search and social media stems from free access and high quality—both enabled by a business model that monetizes personal data through targeted advertising. But does this model yield socially desirable outcomes? We examine how a global monopoly platform chooses privacy protection and service quality. Under a free‐service model, it overexploits data and underprovides quality relative to a global planner. Yet, even with distortions on both margins, stronger privacy protection alone can improve global welfare—and may even boost quality. When privacy policy is set nationally, large countries often align with global interests due to a “Brussels Effect,” where platform responses to one country's policy spill over globally. This alignment reduces the need for privacy rules in trade agreements. In contrast, ad tech taxes create “beggar‐thy‐neighbour” incentives, making them a clear case for international cooperation.
10.1111/caje.70072.abstract_zh: 摘要 在线搜索与社交媒体的全球成功源于免费访问与高质量服务——这两者均得益于通过定向广告将个人数据货币化的商业模式。但这一模式能否产生符合社会期望的结果？我们研究了一家全球垄断平台在隐私保护与服务质量之间的权衡选择。在免费服务模式下，相较于全球规划者，该平台过度利用数据且服务质量不足。然而，即便在这两个维度均存在扭曲，仅加强隐私保护本身就能改善全球福利——甚至可能提升服务质量。当隐私政策由国家层面制定时，大国往往因"布鲁塞尔效应"与全球利益趋同，即平台对一国政策的反应会产生全球溢出效应。这种趋同降低了贸易协定中隐私规则的必要性。相比之下，广告技术税会催生"以邻为壑"的激励，使其成为国际合作的明确案例。
10.1111/caje.70072.title: e‐Globalization and trade agreements

10.1111/cjag.70017.title: Facilitating sugar taxes with top‐down and bottom‐up information: A combined approach for improved tax efficacy
10.1111/cjag.70017.title_zh: 自上而下与自下而上信息促进糖税：提升税收效力的综合方法

10.1111/cjag.70018.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study expands the framework for analyzing the interplay of agricultural area and crop diversity on agroecosystem services by incorporating the species‐area relationship concept from biology. We estimate panel fixed effects models that include both agricultural area and crop diversity, along with their interaction term. This approach allows us to derive a crop diversity threshold‐the point at which agricultural land no longer exerts a negative marginal effect on water quality, driven by adjustments along the intensive margin rather than the extensive margin. By replicating well‐established water quality models from the literature and conducting robustness checks, we validate this framework. Our results empirically demonstrate that crop diversity can mitigate the adverse impact of agricultural land on water quality, aligning with the goals of conservation programs. This framework provides a more comprehensive understanding of agriculture's non‐unidirectional contributions to water quality, rather than only negative impacts, which are pervasive in the literature. Moreover, the thresholds identified in this study provide valuable insights for prioritizing regions for landscape‐based, crop diversity‐driven conservation strategies and policy design.</jats:p>
10.1111/cjag.70018.abstract_zh: 本研究通过引入生物学中的物种-面积关系概念，拓展了分析农业面积与作物多样性对农业生态系统服务交互作用的框架。我们估计了包含农业面积、作物多样性及其交互项的面板固定效应模型。这一方法使我们能够推导出作物多样性阈值——即农业用地通过集约边际调整而非粗放边际调整，不再对水质产生负面边际效应的临界点。通过复现文献中成熟的水质模型并进行稳健性检验，我们验证了这一框架的有效性。实证结果表明，作物多样性能够缓解农业用地对水质的负面影响，这与保护项目的目标一致。该框架有助于更全面地理解农业对水质的非单向贡献（而非文献中普遍强调的单一负面影响）。此外，本研究识别的阈值可为优先区域划定提供依据，助力基于景观格局、以作物多样性为导向的保护策略与政策设计。
10.1111/cjag.70018.title: Interplay of crop diversity and agricultural area in agroecosystem services: Analytical and empirical study on local water quality
10.1111/cjag.70018.title_zh: 作物多样性与农业面积在农业生态系统服务中的相互作用：基于地方水质的分析与实证研究

10.1111/cjag.70019.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Conventional price indexes partially address product heterogeneity. This paper considers the variety and quality of products in each market, the combination of region and year, and constructs panel price indexes using household scanner data on non‐alcoholic beverages in urban China. By comparing our panel price indexes to a conventional one, we find that ignoring product heterogeneity could largely underestimate the cross‐market price differences for non‐alcoholic beverages. We also find that product variety increases with urban population and income per capita, but that quality decreases with urban population, suggesting that wealthier provincial urban markets tend to have higher consumer welfare.</jats:p>
10.1111/cjag.70019.abstract_zh: 传统价格指数仅部分解决了产品异质性问题。本文考虑每个市场（地区与年份的组合）中产品的多样性和质量，利用中国城市非酒精饮料的家庭扫描数据构建了面板价格指数。通过将我们的面板价格指数与传统价格指数进行比较，我们发现忽略产品异质性可能会严重低估非酒精饮料的跨市场价格差异。研究还发现，产品多样性随城市人口和人均收入增加而上升，但产品质量随城市人口增加而下降，这表明更富裕的省级城市市场往往具有更高的消费者福利。
10.1111/cjag.70019.title: Product heterogeneity, price index bias, and their link to provincial urban size: Evidence from urban China's beverage market
10.1111/cjag.70019.title_zh: 产品异质性、价格指数偏差及其与省级城市规模的关联：来自中国城市饮料市场的证据

10.1111/cjag.70020.abstract: Abstract This study utilizes nationally representative panel data on rural Chinese households to investigate the interrelationship between smallholders’ participation in land rental markets and their agricultural commercialization while also evaluating the interactive effects of these market‐oriented farming practices on agricultural land and labor productivity. We adopted a bivariate Tobit model, fixed effects models, and instrumental variable methods to address the endogeneity problems. Results reveal a mutually reinforcing relationship between farm households’ land rental area and commercialization decisions. Furthermore, renting farmland is associated with improved agricultural labor productivity and reduced land productivity. Agricultural commercialization shows a positive correlation with the productivity of both land and labor for farm households. Finally, commercialization could positively moderate the association between land renting and agricultural productivity. Policymakers should design policies and strategies to promote the development of the land rental market and the commercialization of farmers, which could improve labor and land productivity.
10.1111/cjag.70020.abstract_zh: 本研究利用具有全国代表性的中国农村家庭面板数据，探讨小农户参与土地租赁市场与其农业商业化之间的相互关系，同时评估这些市场化农业实践对农业土地和劳动生产率的交互效应。我们采用双变量Tobit模型、固定效应模型和工具变量方法来解决内生性问题。结果显示，农户土地租赁面积与商业化决策之间存在相互促进的关系。此外，租赁耕地与农业劳动生产率提高和土地生产率下降相关。农业商业化与农户土地和劳动生产率均呈正相关。最后，商业化能够正向调节土地租赁与农业生产率之间的关系。政策制定者应设计促进土地租赁市场发展和农民商业化的政策与策略，从而提升劳动和土地生产率。

10.1111/ecca.70062.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Pathogen‐stress and terror‐management theories predict that lethal epidemics heighten parochial cooperation. We test this prediction experimentally in two nationally representative US samples surveyed before and at the onset of the COVID‐19 pandemic. We compare trust and expected trustworthiness across the two waves in monetarily incentivized trust games involving non‐Hispanic Whites, African Americans and Hispanics. We find significant ingroup favouritism in both waves. However, the aggregate ingroup premium fell by about one‐half between waves. This decline was concentrated among left‐leaning and moderate respondents. While non‐Hispanic Whites tended to reduce their ingroup bias in expected trustworthiness, the opposite was found for African Americans. Respondents more exposed to COVID‐19 displayed higher intergroup trust, altruism and expected trustworthiness than others. These results contradict the hypothesis that lethal epidemics intensify parochialism, also suggesting that the response may be diversified across groups.</jats:p>
10.1111/ecca.70062.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>病原体应激与恐怖管理理论预测，致命性流行病会加剧群体内合作。我们通过两项具有全国代表性的美国样本（分别在COVID-19疫情爆发前后进行调查）对这一预测进行了实验检验。我们比较了涉及非西班牙裔白人、非洲裔美国人和西班牙裔的货币激励信任博弈中两轮调查的信任与预期可信度。研究发现两轮调查均存在显著的群体内偏袒现象。然而，群体内溢价的总量在两轮调查间下降了约一半，这一下降主要集中在左倾和温和派受访者中。非西班牙裔白人倾向于降低其在预期可信度方面的群体内偏见，而非洲裔美国人则呈现相反趋势。相较于其他受访者，更易接触COVID-19的受访者表现出更高的群体间信任、利他主义和预期可信度。这些结果与致命性流行病会加剧群体内偏见的假设相矛盾，同时表明不同群体的反应可能存在差异。</jats:p>
10.1111/ecca.70062.title: Did the outbreak of COVID‐19 and individual exposure to it increase ingroup bias in the USA? An experimental investigation of interethnic trust
10.1111/ecca.70062.title_zh: COVID-19疫情爆发及个体暴露程度是否加剧了美国的内群体偏见？一项关于族裔间信任的实验研究

10.1111/ecca.70063.abstract: Abstract Meritocratic systems are commonly understood as those that assign tasks to individuals who can best perform them. But future performance is not known prior to assignment, and must be inferred from other traits. We consider a model in which performance depends on two attributes—ability and training—where ability is endowed and unobserved, and training is acquired and observed. The potential to acquire training depends on ability and resource access, so ability affects performance through two channels: indirectly through training, and directly through the performance function. The population consists of two groups, each with the same ability distribution, but with differential access to resources. We show that performance‐maximizing allocations are not necessarily group‐blind or monotonic in training, and can involve greater representation of groups with lower resource access than would arise if the only criteria for selection were past performance. If policies are constrained to be monotonic due to the possibility of strategic applicant behaviour, then these representation effects can be mitigated or amplified, depending on the fraction of the population that is selected.
10.1111/ecca.70063.abstract_zh: 摘要 精英体制通常被理解为将任务分配给最能胜任者的制度。但未来表现无法在分配前预知，必须通过其他特征推断。我们构建了一个模型，其中表现取决于两种属性——能力与训练——能力是先天赋予且不可观测的，训练是后天获得且可观测的。获得训练的潜力取决于能力与资源获取渠道，因此能力通过两条渠道影响表现：间接通过训练，直接通过表现函数。人口由两个群体组成，每个群体具有相同的能力分布，但资源获取渠道存在差异。研究表明，表现最大化分配未必是群体盲视的或关于训练单调的，且可能使资源获取较少的群体获得比仅以过往表现为唯一选拔标准时更高的代表性。若因策略性申请者行为的存在而需对政策施加单调性约束，则这些代表性效应可能被削弱或放大，具体取决于被选拔人口的比例。
10.1111/ecca.70063.title: Meritocracy in the face of group inequality
10.1111/ecca.70063.title_zh: 群体不平等面前的精英统治

10.1111/ecca.70064.abstract: Abstract We estimate the trade and income effects of regulatory developments concerning standard‐like non‐tariff measures (NTMs) over 2012–2017 combining structural gravity estimates and general equilibrium projections. The trade cost effects of regulatory changes vary at the country‐pair level and across sectors. Overall, NTM‐related regulatory changes over 2012–2017 increased trade costs in goods, which reduced global trade by 1.2%. The majority of this reduction corresponds to a decline in goods trade equivalent to about 40% of the actual worldwide decrease of nominal goods trade over this period. Yet the implied reduction of real income is small. We highlight significant variation of these effects at the country and sector level, and show that excluding pair‐specific trade frictions and third‐country effects introduces omitted variable bias. Our findings imply that advances in international coordination of technical regulation can further reduce trade frictions and enhance trade and real income.
10.1111/ecca.70064.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文结合结构引力估计与一般均衡预测，评估了2012–2017年间标准类非关税措施监管变化对贸易和收入的影响。监管变化的贸易成本效应在国家-行业层面存在异质性。总体而言，2012–2017年间与非关税措施相关的监管变化提高了商品贸易成本，导致全球贸易下降1.2%。这一降幅中，大部分对应商品贸易的减少量，约占同期全球名义商品贸易实际下降幅度的40%。然而，由此导致的实际收入下降幅度较小。我们强调这些效应在国家与行业层面存在显著差异，并表明忽略国家-行业特定贸易摩擦及第三国效应会引入遗漏变量偏误。研究结果表明，技术监管国际协调的进展可进一步减少贸易摩擦，促进贸易与实际收入增长。

10.1111/ecca.70064.title_zh: 技术性非关税措施的一般均衡效应：基于双边贸易成本估计的证据

10.1111/ecca.70065.abstract: Abstract This paper examines the implications of the EU–UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement (TCA) using a dynamic spatial general equilibrium model. Unlike previous studies that primarily projected potential impacts of Brexit based on uncertain scenarios, this analysis introduces new estimates of tariffs and non‐tariff measures specified by the TCA. The findings show that while the TCA will necessitate substantial adjustments for some sectors, Brexit will not fundamentally alter the overall structure of the UK economy. However, the main impacts will manifest as significant hits to real wages and productivity, exacerbating the long‐standing economic challenges faced by the UK.
10.1111/ecca.70065.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文运用动态空间一般均衡模型，评估了欧盟-英国贸易与合作协定（TCA）的经济影响。与以往主要基于不确定情景预测英国脱欧潜在影响的研究不同，本文引入了TCA所规定的关税与非关税措施的最新估算。研究结果表明，尽管TCA将迫使部分行业进行重大调整，但英国脱欧并不会从根本上改变英国经济的整体结构。然而，其主要影响将体现为实际工资与生产率的显著下降，从而加剧英国长期面临的经济挑战。

10.1111/ecca.70066.abstract: <jats:p>We examine the unintended effects of gender‐based hiring quotas on task allocation and organizational performance using a controlled laboratory experiment designed to mirror team formation and delegation decisions. Participants in the role of employers selected workers and assigned them to either simple or challenging tasks, where performance determined firm earnings. In the absence of quotas, high‐ability women were less likely than their male counterparts to be hired or assigned to high‐responsibility tasks. Imposing a 50% gender quota increased overall female representation and their access to complex tasks, but did not improve outcomes for high‐performing women, who remain relatively less likely to be assigned to high‐responsibility tasks compared to comparable men. Moreover, firm performance declined under the quota due to weaker alignment between worker ability and task assignment. These findings suggest that while quotas enhance representational equity, they may unintentionally reduce efficiency when organizational processes fail to support merit‐based allocation—offering important implications for the design of equity‐enhancing labour market policies.</jats:p>
10.1111/ecca.70066.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项受控实验室实验，研究了基于性别的招聘配额对任务分配和组织绩效的非预期影响。该实验旨在模拟团队组建和授权决策。扮演雇主的参与者选择工人，并将其分配到简单或具有挑战性的任务中，任务表现决定企业收益。在没有配额的情况下，高能力女性被雇佣或分配到高责任任务的可能性低于同等能力的男性。实施50%的性别配额提高了女性的整体代表性及其接触复杂任务的机会，但并未改善高绩效女性的结果——与同等能力的男性相比，她们被分配到高责任任务的可能性仍然相对较低。此外，由于工人能力与任务分配之间的匹配度减弱，配额下的企业绩效出现下降。这些发现表明，虽然配额增强了代表性公平，但当组织流程未能支持基于能力的分配时，它们可能无意中降低效率——这对设计促进公平的劳动力市场政策具有重要启示。

10.1111/ecin.70070.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper studies the impact of proxy advisors on shareholder decision‐making. We posit two assumptions: (i) the board is at least as well informed as any individual shareholder; (ii) shareholders can condition their information acquisition on the proxy advisor's (PA) recommendation. If only (i) holds, shareholders optimally rubber‐stamp the board's proposal and do not invest in private research. If (ii) additionally holds, disagreement between the board and the PA can trigger private information acquisition by some shareholders. We identify the conditions under which this mechanism restores value‐of‐information logic and improves the informational quality of shareholder voting outcomes.</jats:p>
10.1111/ecin.70070.abstract_zh:
<jats:title>摘要</jats:title>
<jats:p>本文研究代理顾问对股东决策的影响。我们提出两个假设：（i）董事会至少与任何单个股东拥有同等信息；（ii）股东可根据代理顾问（PA）的建议调整其信息获取行为。若仅满足假设（i），股东最优策略是盲目批准董事会提案，且不投入私人研究。若同时满足假设（ii），董事会与代理顾问之间的分歧可能触发部分股东获取私人信息。我们识别了该机制恢复信息价值逻辑并提升股东投票结果信息质量的条件。</jats:p>
10.1111/ecin.70070.title: When do proxy advisors improve corporate decisions?
10.1111/ecin.70070.title_zh: 代理顾问何时改善公司决策？

10.1111/ecin.70071.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper investigates how supply disruptions and economic slack affect the responsiveness of inflation to changes in aggregate demand. We propose and estimate a nonlinear Phillips curve, whereby the sensitivity of inflation to changes in demand varies with supply conditions and the amount of slack in the economy. We find evidence that supply disruptions and low unemployment both steepen the Phillips curve, thereby amplifying the inflationary effects of increased demand. Our results suggest that the effects of fiscal policy on inflation depend on the prevailing supply conditions and the level of unemployment in the economy.</jats:p>
10.1111/ecin.70071.abstract_zh: 本文研究了供给中断与经济松弛如何影响通胀对总需求变化的响应程度。我们提出并估计了一个非线性菲利普斯曲线，其中通胀对需求变化的敏感度随供给状况和经济中的松弛程度而变化。研究发现，供给中断和低失业率均会使菲利普斯曲线陡峭化，从而放大需求增加带来的通胀效应。结果表明，财政政策对通胀的影响取决于经济中当前的供给状况和失业水平。

10.1111/ecin.70071.title_zh: 供给中断、经济疲软与状态依赖型菲利普斯曲线

10.1111/ecin.70072.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We characterize the spillover effects of helicopter drops and optimal monetary policy in a tractable two‐country overlapping generations model with incomplete markets. As helicopter drops can affect the distribution of income across countries, they create room for redistribution policies which are particularly relevant when agents are heterogeneous and markets are incomplete. Under cooperation, central banks can implement the conditionally Pareto optimal allocation using helicopter drops (and suctions) to “lean against the wind.” In a non‐cooperative setting, helicopter drops exacerbate the incomplete markets' friction by making income more volatile. This paves the way for gains from cooperation.</jats:p>
10.1111/ecin.70072.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文在一个可处理的两国世代交叠模型（含不完全市场）中，刻画了直升机撒钱的溢出效应及最优货币政策。由于直升机撒钱可能影响国家间的收入分配，这为再分配政策创造了空间——当经济主体存在异质性且市场不完全时，此类政策尤为重要。在合作框架下，央行可通过直升机撒钱（及抽钱）实施条件帕累托最优配置，实现“逆风干预”。在非合作框架下，直升机撒钱会加剧收入波动，从而放大不完全市场的摩擦，这为合作收益的产生奠定了基础。

10.1111/ecin.70075.abstract: Abstract Zoning reform is increasingly advocated to redress unaffordable housing, but few real‐world examples demonstrate its efficacy. However, Auckland recently upzoned approximately three‐quarters of its residential land, precipitating a housing construction boom. We investigate whether the reform reduced housing costs, adopting a synthetic control method to estimate rental prices in Auckland under the counterfactual of no zoning change. Eight years after the reform, the synthetic control under our preferred empirical specification implies that rents decreased by 23% due to the reform. These findings are robust across a range of specifications and support the proposition that widespread upzoning can enhance housing affordability.

10.1111/ehr.70131.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Using newly collected discount rate data for six Swiss cities from 1846 to 1893, we find no evidence of increasing integration during a 30‐year period of lightly regulated free banking. We attribute this to two structural issues: banks had incentives to ward off competitors by protecting their local monopolies or forming cartels, and there was always a risk (which varied across banks) that banknotes were not accepted or converted at par. We use a novel counterfactual to show that these issues increased discount rate dispersion, and argue that as a result, public regulation of payments infrastructure was necessary for money market integration.</jats:p>
10.1111/ehr.70131.abstract_zh: 摘要：利用1846至1893年间瑞士六座城市新收集的贴现率数据，我们发现在30年轻度监管的自由银行时期，市场一体化程度并未增强。我们将此归因于两个结构性问题：银行有动机通过保护本地垄断或组建卡特尔来抵御竞争对手，且始终存在银行券不被按面值接受或兑换的风险（该风险因银行而异）。我们采用新颖的反事实分析方法表明，这些问题加剧了贴现率离散程度，并据此论证：支付基础设施的公共监管对于货币市场一体化具有必要性。

10.1111/ehr.70133.abstract: Abstract Using existing and new price data sets, we provide the first estimates of market integration across England over the entire 200 years of the industrial revolution. We document a significant, though not huge, integration improvement for markets furthest from London. Full integration was achieved by the 1830s. Our price data sets vary in quality (type of average, price rounding, frequency of stale prices). We show that this severely biases some standard statistical tests of market integration, and we develop and implement new techniques to ensure valid inference. We discuss the application of these techniques to other historical data sets.
10.1111/ehr.70133.abstract_zh: 摘要 利用现有及新增的价格数据集，我们首次估算了工业革命整个200年间英格兰市场的整合程度。研究发现，距离伦敦最远的市场在整合方面取得了显著（尽管并非巨大）的改善。到19世纪30年代，市场已实现完全整合。我们的价格数据集在质量上存在差异（包括平均值类型、价格取整、陈旧价格频率）。我们证明，这些差异严重扭曲了某些市场整合的标准统计检验，并开发并实施了新技术以确保推断的有效性。我们还讨论了这些技术在其他历史数据集中的应用。
10.1111/ehr.70133.title: The big impact of small change: Fresh estimates of English wheat market integration, 1693–1893
10.1111/ehr.70133.title_zh: 小变化的巨大影响：英国小麦市场整合的新估计，1693–1893

10.1111/ehr.70134.abstract: Abstract Between 1807 and 1815, US imports of manufactured goods were slashed dramatically by a trade embargo, non‐importation measures, and the War of 1812. These disruptions are commonly believed to have promoted the growth of nascent domestic manufacturers and thereby spurred early US industrialization. This paper uses disaggregated data on US industrial production to investigate how this interruption of foreign competition affected domestic manufacturing. On balance, the trade disruptions did not accelerate US industrialization, as trend growth in industrial output was little changed over this period. However, the disruptions may have played a role in shifting resources, at least temporarily, from trade‐dependent industries (such as shipbuilding) to domestic infant industries (such as cotton textiles).
10.1111/ehr.70134.abstract_zh: 摘要 1807年至1815年间，贸易禁运、非进口措施及1812年战争导致美国制成品进口大幅削减。这些贸易中断通常被认为促进了新兴国内制造业的发展，从而推动了美国早期工业化。本文利用美国工业生产的细分数据，研究外国竞争的中断如何影响国内制造业。总体而言，贸易中断并未加速美国工业化，因为这一时期工业产出的趋势性增长几乎没有变化。然而，这些中断可能至少在短期内促使资源从依赖贸易的行业（如造船业）转向国内新兴行业（如棉纺织业）。
10.1111/ehr.70134.title: Trade disruptions and early US industrialization

10.1111/iere.70085.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper rationalizes the adoption of a complementary currency (CC) in a small, local economy. A local money shortage occurs when the supply of official currency, determined endogenously by trade with a larger economy, falls short of the liquidity needed for first‐best activity. A CC then supplements liquidity and boosts local trade at the expense of external trade; the welfare‐maximizing CC supply is strictly positive. A calibration to coca‐growing villages in Colombia, where coca‐base circulates as a local CC, suggests its liquidity role raises local trade by roughly a third.</jats:p>
10.1111/iere.70085.abstract_zh: 本文对小型地方经济中采用补充货币（CC）的行为进行了理性阐释。当由与较大经济体贸易内生决定的官方货币供给，不足以支撑最优经济活动所需的流动性时，便会出现地方性货币短缺。此时，补充货币可补充流动性，并在减少外部贸易的同时促进地方贸易；福利最大化的补充货币供给严格为正。通过对哥伦比亚古柯种植村庄（当地以古柯碱作为补充货币流通）进行校准分析，结果表明其流动性作用使地方贸易额提升了约三分之一。
10.1111/iere.70085.title: Money Shortages and Complementary Currencies in Small Local Economies
10.1111/iere.70085.title_zh: 小型地方经济中的货币短缺与补充货币

10.1111/iere.70086.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We quantify the role of heterogeneity in households' financial constraints in explaining the link between the decline in aggregate consumption and the decline in house values between 2006 and 2009 using individual‐level data. Constraints that are triggered by a decline in house values, and a small fraction of consumers facing particularly severe constraints prior to the decline in house values explain 76% of the aggregate response. Local general equilibrium feedback and a decline in bank credit to consumers make up the remaining 24%. We find no contribution of a pure wealth effect in explaining the consumption decline.</jats:p>
10.1111/iere.70086.abstract_zh: 我们利用个体层面数据，量化了家庭金融约束异质性在解释2006年至2009年间总消费下降与房屋价值下降之间关联中的作用。由房屋价值下降触发的约束，以及在房屋价值下降前已面临特别严重约束的一小部分消费者，解释了总消费反应的76%。局部一般均衡反馈和银行对消费者信贷的下降构成了剩余的24%。我们发现，纯财富效应在解释消费下降中并无贡献。
10.1111/iere.70086.title: Housing Wealth and Consumption: The Role of Heterogeneous Credit Constraints
10.1111/iere.70086.title_zh: 住房财富与消费：异质性信贷约束的作用

10.1111/iere.70087.abstract: ABSTRACT The gender gap in non‐agricultural employment in developing countries is concentrated among rural married workers. Within‐family specialization is central: Married women spend more time on home production, work fewer market hours, and are less likely to incur fixed costs of entering non‐agriculture. We develop a general equilibrium Roy model with joint household decisions, sector‐neutral gender labor wedges, and entry barriers. Calibrated to China in 2010, the model reproduces the observed gender employment gap. Gender labor wedges explain about 80% of it, amplified by within‐family specialization, while changing entry barriers account for its widening from 2000 to 2010.
10.1111/iere.70087.abstract_zh: 摘要 发展中国家非农就业中的性别差距主要集中在农村已婚劳动者群体。家庭内部分工是核心因素：已婚女性在家务劳动上投入更多时间，市场工作时间更少，且更不愿承担进入非农部门所需的固定成本。我们构建了一个包含联合家庭决策、部门中性性别劳动楔子及进入壁垒的一般均衡罗伊模型。基于2010年中国数据的校准结果显示，该模型能够复现观测到的性别就业差距。其中，性别劳动楔子解释了约80%的差距，并通过家庭内部分工机制被放大；而进入壁垒的变化则解释了2000年至2010年间该差距的扩大趋势。
10.1111/iere.70087.title: Home Production and Gender Gap in Structural Change
10.1111/iere.70087.title_zh: 家庭生产与结构变迁中的性别差距

10.1111/iere.70088.abstract: ABSTRACT We explore implications of social status concerns for redistribution, income inequality, and growth in a political economy framework. Salience of such concerns leads to a propagation mechanism, whereby initial income inequality and reduced willingness to redistribute income reinforce each other, potentially giving rise to multiple steady states. An extension illustrates the possibility of a high redistribution cum low inequality steady state resulting in a higher steady‐state income level. Some of the model features are shown to be consistent with empirical regularities as reflected in survey data on social status attitudes.
10.1111/iere.70088.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文在政治经济学框架下探讨社会地位关注对再分配、收入不平等及经济增长的影响。此类关注的显著性会引发一种传导机制，其中初始收入不平等与再分配意愿的降低相互强化，可能形成多重稳态。扩展分析表明，高再分配与低不平等并存的稳态可能导致更高的稳态收入水平。模型的部分特征与社会地位态度调查数据所反映的实证规律具有一致性。
10.1111/iere.70088.title: Social Status, Inequality, and Redistribution
10.1111/iere.70088.title_zh: 社会地位、不平等与再分配

10.1111/jems.70037.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We investigate input price discrimination under secret contracting between a manufacturer and competing retailers, whose investment activities exhibit retail effort spillovers. We show that the economic effects of input price discrimination vary with the sign and magnitude of retail effort spillovers according to the contractual structure, namely, linear or two‐part tariffs. Retail effort spillovers and product differentiation affect the pass‐through of input price to retail quantity, which is defined under each contractual structure. Our analysis provides novel insights into the role of retail effort spillovers and into the evaluation of quantity pass‐through in the antitrust scrutiny of input price discrimination.</jats:p>
10.1111/jems.70037.abstract_zh: 摘要：本文研究了制造商与竞争性零售商之间秘密合同下的投入品价格歧视问题，其中零售商的投资活动存在零售努力溢出效应。研究表明，投入品价格歧视的经济效应随零售努力溢出的正负及大小而变化，且这种变化取决于合同结构（线性关税或两部收费制）。零售努力溢出与产品差异化会影响投入品价格向零售数量的传导效应，该传导效应在不同合同结构下具有不同定义。本文分析为理解零售努力溢出的作用机制，以及反垄断审查中评估数量传导效应对投入品价格歧视的影响提供了全新视角。

10.1111/jems.70039.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    This study empirically examines the effects of High Involvement Management (
                    <jats:italic>HIM</jats:italic>
                    ) on establishment productivity. To achieve this it draws on a large‐scale panel data set representative of the German economy. The identification strategy exploits the bracketing property of fixed effects and lagged dependent variable models and supplements this with a selection‐on‐observables approach to estimate causal effects. Descriptive evidence indicates that decision makers value the joint implementation of the pillars of HIM (
                    <jats:italic>Knowledge</jats:italic>
                    ,
                    <jats:italic>Power</jats:italic>
                    ,
                    <jats:italic>Information</jats:italic>
                    , and
                    <jats:italic>Rewards</jats:italic>
                    ), as they tend to cluster and factor analysis confirms that the included management practices reflect a single underlying management orientation. The causal analysis reveals significant productivity gains from
                    <jats:italic>HIM</jats:italic>
                    and each of its four pillars. These effects materialize for
                    <jats:italic>HIM</jats:italic>
                    adoption,
                    <jats:italic>HIM</jats:italic>
                    intensification and the presence of a
                    <jats:italic>HIM</jats:italic>
                    philosophy. While the results are in line with a monotonically increasing effect as additional pillars are adopted, no synergies between the pillars or underlying practices emerge. Finally, the findings reveal no meaningful differences in the effectiveness of
                    <jats:italic>HIM</jats:italic>
                    across establishment size, sector, knowledge intensity, or innovation strategy, suggesting that its impact is broadly consistent across organizational contexts.
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/jems.70039.abstract_zh: 本研究利用代表德国经济的大型面板数据集，实证检验了高参与管理（HIM）对机构生产率的影响。识别策略利用固定效应和滞后因变量模型的区间估计特性，并辅以基于可观测变量的选择方法以估计因果效应。描述性证据表明，决策者重视HIM四大支柱（知识、权力、信息与奖励）的协同实施——这些支柱往往呈现聚类特征，且因子分析证实所涵盖的管理实践反映单一潜在管理导向。因果分析揭示HIM及其四大支柱均能带来显著的生产率提升。这些效应体现在HIM的采纳、强化以及HIM理念的存在性上。研究结果与“随支柱采纳数量增加而单调递增”的效应模式一致，但未发现支柱间或基础实践间存在协同效应。最后，研究发现HIM的有效性在机构规模、行业类型、知识密集度或创新战略维度上均无显著差异，表明其影响在不同组织情境中具有广泛一致性。

10.1111/jmcb.70072.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    This paper argues that lower government debt issuance is equivalent to a central bank–operated asset purchase program, commonly known as quantitative easing (QE), as both reduce anticipated future bond supply. However, as it involves neither asset purchases nor associated reserves creation, it is labeled
                    <jats:italic>passive</jats:italic>
                    QE. A novel classification scheme of central bank balance sheet policies ranks passive QE as stimulative. Supportive evidence from a temporary lowering of government debt issuance in Denmark suggests that declines in long‐term yields reflected both reduced term premia, consistent with supply‐induced portfolio balance effects, and increased safety premia, consistent with safe assets scarcity effects.
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/jmcb.70072.abstract_zh: 本文认为，政府债务发行减少与央行操作的资产购买计划（即通常所称的量化宽松，QE）具有等效性，因为两者均会降低预期的未来债券供给。然而，由于该过程既不涉及资产购买，也不产生相应的准备金创造，因此被称为**被动型**量化宽松。本文提出了一种新的央行资产负债表政策分类框架，将被动型量化宽松归类为具有刺激效应的政策。来自丹麦临时性降低政府债务发行的实证证据表明，长期收益率下降既反映了期限溢价的降低（与供给驱动的投资组合平衡效应一致），也反映了安全溢价的上升（与安全资产稀缺效应一致）。
10.1111/jmcb.70072.title: Passive Quantitative Easing: Bond Supply Effects through Lower Debt Issuance
10.1111/jmcb.70072.title_zh: 被动量化宽松：通过降低债务发行实现的债券供给效应

10.1111/jmcb.70073.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study investigates the impact of central bank transparency (CBT) on foreign exchange market vulnerability, measured by exchange market pressure (EMP). Using panel autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) analysis on a sample of 32 countries, the results show that greater CBT significantly reduces EMP. The findings remain robust after controlling for U.S. monetary policy uncertainty, economic policy uncertainty, and financial development. However, no evidence is found that CBT becomes more effective during periods of heightened uncertainty. Further analysis indicates that exchange rate flexibility and financial integration strengthen the mitigating effect of CBT on EMP in emerging markets but not in developed markets.</jats:p>

10.1111/jofi.70058.abstract: ABSTRACT We examine optimal capital requirements in a quantitative general equilibrium model with banks exposed to nondiversifiable borrower default risk. Contrary to standard models of bank default risk, our framework captures the limited upside, but significant downside risk of loan portfolio returns. This helps to reproduce the frequency and severity of twin defaults : simultaneously high firm and bank defaults. Hence, the optimal bank capital requirement, which trades off a lower frequency of twin defaults against restricting credit provision, is higher than under default risk models which underestimate the impact of borrower default on bank solvency.

10.1111/joie.70034.abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the joint role of strategic timing, asymmetric private demand and cost information, and common ownership in shaping equilibrium outcomes in oligopolistic markets. We develop a three‐firm model and study Cournot and Stackelberg competition. The main results are as follows. (1) Mover advantages are determined by relative signal precision: the leader benefits most when the second mover has a more precise signal, the second mover benefits most when the last mover has high signal precision, and the last mover benefits when both followers have sufficiently noisy signals. (2) Cournot competition generates greater consumer and total surplus and lower total profits than Stackelberg competition if neither follower has significantly higher signal precision than the leader. (3) Common ownership increases consumer and total surplus but reduces total profits in Stackelberg competition if and only if the last mover is not substantially better informed than the leader. These findings have implications for contests, partnership, network, public good, common resource, and gas emission games with altruistic preferences. Since total profit in oligopoly models can be interpreted as aggregate welfare in these environments, the welfare rankings are reversed.
10.1111/joie.70034.abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了战略时机、非对称私有需求与成本信息以及共同所有权在寡头垄断市场均衡结果中的联合作用。我们构建了一个三企业模型，并分析了古诺竞争与斯塔克伯格竞争。主要结论如下：（1）先动优势取决于相对信号精度：当后动者拥有更精确的信号时，先动者获益最大；当最后动者信号精度较高时，第二动者获益最大；当两个追随者的信号均足够模糊时，最后动者获益最大。（2）若任一追随者的信号精度未显著高于先动者，古诺竞争比斯塔克伯格竞争能带来更高的消费者剩余与总剩余，但总利润更低。（3）在斯塔克伯格竞争中，当且仅当最后动者的信息优势未显著超过先动者时，共同所有权会提升消费者剩余与总剩余，但降低总利润。这些发现对存在利他偏好的竞赛、合伙、网络、公共品、公共资源及气体排放博弈具有启示意义。由于寡头模型中的总利润可被解释为这些环境中的总福利，福利排序将发生逆转。

10.1111/joie.70035.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    We study how a blockholder who controls a firm should acquire a minority stake in a rival: directly, creating
                    <jats:italic>common ownership</jats:italic>
                    , or indirectly through the controlled firm, creating
                    <jats:italic>cross‐ownership</jats:italic>
                    . Common ownership generates stronger internalization of competitive externalities and allows the blockholder to capture the resulting gains without sharing them with dispersed shareholders. However, it may also create conflicts of interest with minority shareholders that can lead to a loss of control. Cross‐ownership avoids this governance risk but internalizes competition less effectively. We characterize how the optimal acquisition mode depends on the nature of product market competition and the strength of corporate governance.
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/joie.70035.abstract_zh: 我们研究控制一家公司的大股东应如何获取竞争对手的少数股权：是直接获取（形成共同所有权），还是通过所控制的公司间接获取（形成交叉所有权）。共同所有权能更有效地内化竞争外部性，并使大股东在不与分散股东分享收益的情况下获取由此产生的收益。然而，这可能会与少数股东产生利益冲突，进而导致控制权丧失。交叉所有权可规避这种治理风险，但内化竞争的效果较差。我们刻画了最优收购模式如何取决于产品市场竞争的性质以及公司治理的强度。

10.1111/sjoe.70031.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the 2025 Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel to Philippe Aghion, Peter Howitt, and Joel Mokyr “for having explained innovation‐driven economic growth”. This paper examines their contributions in the context of the development process as a whole. Aghion and Howitt established the centrality of creative destruction in the growth process of advanced economies, identifying the displacement of existing technologies by superseding ones as a key mechanism in sustaining economic growth. Mokyr highlighted the role of a tightening link between theoretical knowledge and practical application during the Scientific Revolution and the Enlightenment in fostering technological progress in Western Europe on the eve of the Industrial Revolution. These frontier‐centered perspectives transformed our understanding of the causes and consequences of innovation‐driven growth in advanced economies operating near the technological frontier. Yet, throughout much of the development process, the central challenge to growth has depended less on the creation of new technologies than on the emergence of fundamental conditions conducive to skill formation, fertility decline, and societal adaptation, which have shaped the timing of the transition to modern growth, the pace of economic growth thereafter, and the contemporary inequality in the wealth of nations. A comprehensive account of sustained growth and contemporary inequality across societies requires anchoring the growth process in its broader historical arc.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70031.abstract_zh: 瑞典皇家科学院将2025年瑞典中央银行纪念阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔经济学奖授予菲利普·阿吉翁、彼得·豪伊特和乔尔·莫基尔，以表彰他们“解释了创新驱动的经济增长”。本文从整体发展进程的角度审视了他们的贡献。阿吉翁和豪伊特确立了创造性破坏在发达经济体增长过程中的核心地位，指出新兴技术对现有技术的替代是维持经济增长的关键机制。莫基尔则强调了科学革命和启蒙运动期间理论知识与应用实践之间日益紧密的联系，在工业革命前夕推动西欧技术进步中所发挥的作用。这些以技术前沿为中心的视角，深刻改变了我们对接近技术前沿的发达经济体中创新驱动增长的成因与后果的理解。然而，在整个发展进程中，增长面临的核心挑战与其说取决于新技术的创造，不如说取决于有利于技能形成、生育率下降和社会适应性的基本条件的出现——这些条件塑造了向现代增长转型的时机、此后经济增长的速度，以及当代国家间财富的不平等。要全面解释社会间持续增长与当代不平等现象，就必须将增长进程置于更广阔的历史脉络之中。
10.1111/sjoe.70031.title: Engines of growth and inequality in the wealth of nations
10.1111/sjoe.70031.title_zh: 国家财富增长与不平等的引擎

10.1111/sjoe.70033.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Among economists, the analysis of social mobility and the role of parental background is largely carried out in two separate strands of research. The intergenerational mobility literature estimates parent–child persistence in some outcome of interest, such as income. In contrast, the equality of opportunity literature is rooted in a normative framework, and has only more recently started generating empirical evidence. Intergenerational mobility regressions are relatively straightforward to estimate, but their normative implications are less obvious. Measures of equality of opportunity have a policy‐relevant interpretation, but are very data‐demanding, requiring a large set of observable determinants of socioeconomic status for large samples. But maybe the two approaches capture similar dynamics? We compare the approaches by estimating both equality of opportunity and intergenerational mobility measures – as well as sibling correlations – across 16 birth cohorts and 126 Swedish local labor markets. Using these estimates, we find that the different measures correlate strongly, suggesting that (variation in) intergenerational mobility is indeed informative about equality of opportunity.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70033.abstract_zh: 摘要：在经济学界，对社会流动性和父母背景作用的分析主要分为两个独立的研究方向。代际流动性文献估计了父母与子女在收入等特定结果变量上的持续性关联。相比之下，机会平等文献植根于规范性框架，直到近期才开始产生实证证据。代际流动性回归的估计相对直接，但其规范性含义却不甚明确。机会平等指标具有政策相关的解释意义，但对数据要求极高，需要大样本中大量可观测的社会经济地位决定因素。然而，这两种方法是否捕捉到了相似的动态特征？我们通过估算16个出生队列和126个瑞典地方劳动力市场的机会平等指标、代际流动性指标以及同胞相关性，对这两种方法进行了比较。基于这些估计，我们发现不同指标之间存在强相关性，这表明代际流动性的（变化）确实能够反映机会平等状况。
10.1111/sjoe.70033.title: The relationship between intergenerational mobility and equality of opportunity
10.1111/sjoe.70033.title_zh: 代际流动与机会平等之间的关系

10.1111/sjoe.70034.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In this paper, we investigate changes in time allocated to routine housework around four life events – cohabitation, marriage, first birth, and divorce – to explore the influence of social norms on gendered housework patterns. Using data from the German Socio‐Economic Panel (1991–2019), a timing‐based event study design reveals that gender differences intensify with cohabitation and parenthood. Women's housework hours increase significantly with the first child, while men's decrease. Marriage has no additional impact beyond cohabitation, and divorce leads to a rise in men's and a reduction in women's housework. Couples with higher‐earning women and those in East Germany show weaker adherence to these social roles.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70034.abstract_zh: 本文通过考察同居、结婚、生育第一个子女和离婚四个人生事件前后日常家务劳动时间的变化，探究社会规范对性别化家务分工模式的影响。基于德国社会经济面板数据（1991-2019年）的时间事件研究设计显示，性别差异在同居和成为父母后加剧。女性家务劳动时间在生育第一个子女后显著增加，而男性则减少。婚姻对家务时间的影响未超出同居效应，离婚则导致男性家务时间上升、女性家务时间下降。女性收入较高的夫妻以及东德地区的夫妻，对社会角色的遵循程度较弱。

10.1111/sjoe.70035.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper examines the impact of importer dispersion on exchange rate pass‐through. Theoretically, we demonstrate that greater importer dispersion – characterized by larger variations in import size across importers – leads to higher demand elasticity and lower exporter markups, thereby resulting in greater exchange rate pass‐through. Using transaction‐level customs data from Colombia, we provide robust empirical evidence supporting this prediction. The quantitative effect of importer dispersion on exchange rate pass‐through is significant: the importer dispersion channel is at least as important as the traditional exporter heterogeneity channel. Our results are robust to various empirical specifications and become even stronger in the context of the dominant currency paradigm.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70035.abstract_zh: 本文研究了进口商分散度对汇率传递的影响。理论上，我们证明进口商分散度越高——即各进口商进口规模差异越大——会导致需求弹性上升和出口商加成率下降，从而增强汇率传递效应。基于哥伦比亚交易级海关数据，我们提供了支持这一预测的稳健实证证据。进口商分散度对汇率传递的量化影响显著：该渠道的重要性至少与传统出口商异质性渠道相当。研究结果在多种实证设定下保持稳健，且在主导货币范式背景下效应更为显著。
