10.1111/sjoe.70036.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We investigate the existence of a middle‐income trap using finite state Markov chains, constant growth thresholds, and mean first passage times. As well as studying output per head, we examine the dynamics of its proximate determinants: total factor productivity (TFP), the capital–output ratio, and human capital. We find upward mobility in the relative capital–output ratio and human capital, but not in relative TFP. The persistence of relative TFP differences, particularly from intermediate income levels, implies slower progression toward frontier income. A middle‐income trap may therefore reflect asymmetric convergence dynamics near the frontier rather than a universal growth slowdown.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70036.abstract_zh: 我们利用有限状态马尔可夫链、恒定增长阈值和平均首次通过时间，研究了中等收入陷阱的存在性。除了考察人均产出外，我们还分析了其直接决定因素的动态变化：全要素生产率（TFP）、资本产出比和人力资本。研究发现，相对资本产出比和人力资本呈现向上流动性，但相对全要素生产率并未如此。相对全要素生产率差异的持续性，尤其是从中等收入水平来看，意味着向前沿收入水平的进展更为缓慢。因此，中等收入陷阱可能反映了靠近前沿水平时的不对称趋同动态，而非普遍的增长放缓。
10.1111/sjoe.70036.title: At the threshold: the increasing relevance of the middle‐income trap
10.1111/sjoe.70036.title_zh: 在门槛处：中等收入陷阱日益凸显的相关性

10.1111/sjoe.70037.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences awarded the 2025 Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel to Joel Mokyr, Philippe Aghion, and Peter Howitt “for having explained innovation‐driven economic growth”. Mokyr's work explains why sustained growth was historically rare: prosperity required societies capable of generating, diffusing, and applying useful knowledge. The theory of creative destruction established by Aghion and Howitt explains why economic progress is inherently disruptive, as new technologies continuously replace older technologies, firms, and rents. In this paper, I argue that these ideas moved innovation from the periphery to the center of growth economics and recast growth theory as a dynamic process driven by experimentation, rivalry, entry, and reallocation. Recent research has extended these insights in numerous directions, including heterogeneous firms, business dynamism, talent allocation, artificial intelligence, and green innovation. I conclude by arguing that the central challenge of modern growth policy is not simply to accelerate innovation, but to sustain institutions that keep economies open to creative destruction while preserving competition, broad opportunity, and political support for technological change.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70037.abstract_zh: 瑞典皇家科学院将2025年瑞典中央银行纪念阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔经济学奖授予乔尔·莫基尔、菲利普·阿吉翁和彼得·霍伊特，以表彰他们“解释了创新驱动的经济增长”。莫基尔的研究解释了为何持续增长在历史上极为罕见：繁荣需要社会具备生成、传播和应用有用知识的能力。阿吉翁与霍伊特建立的创造性破坏理论则阐明，经济进步本质上具有颠覆性，因为新技术不断取代旧技术、旧企业和旧租金。本文认为，这些思想将创新从增长经济学的边缘推向核心，并将增长理论重塑为由实验、竞争、进入和重新配置驱动的动态过程。近期研究已将这些洞见拓展至多个方向，包括异质性企业、商业活力、人才配置、人工智能和绿色创新。最后，本文指出现代增长政策的核心挑战并非简单加速创新，而是维持那些使经济对创造性破坏保持开放的制度，同时保护竞争、广泛机遇以及技术变革的政治支持。

10.1111/sjoe.70038.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In this paper, we analyze the impact of public dental care coverage – universal versus targeted – on access, pricing, and public spending in a model with two competing dental practices and heterogeneous patient income groups. We evaluate two types of reimbursement schemes: fixed subsidies and cost sharing. Our findings show that public coverage improves access for low‐income patients but increases producer prices due to reduced price elasticity of demand. Targeted coverage provides greater access at lower public cost compared with universal coverage, especially under cost‐sharing schemes. With fixed subsidies, both schemes achieve similar access, but targeted coverage remains more cost‐efficient. The policy that maximizes utilitarian welfare is targeted coverage with a fixed subsidy, balancing improved access for low‐income patients against higher prices for high‐income patients. This trade‐off highlights challenges in implementing targeted policies but provides insights for designing efficient and equitable public dental care systems.</jats:p>
10.1111/sjoe.70038.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建包含两家竞争性牙科诊所与异质性患者收入群体的模型，分析了公共牙科保险覆盖（全民覆盖与定向覆盖）对可及性、定价及公共支出的影响。我们评估了两种报销机制：固定补贴与成本分摊。研究结果表明：公共覆盖改善了低收入患者的可及性，但因需求价格弹性降低导致生产者价格上涨；相较于全民覆盖，定向覆盖能以更低的公共成本实现更高的可及性，尤其在成本分摊机制下更为显著。在固定补贴机制下，两种覆盖方案的可及性效果相近，但定向覆盖仍更具成本效率。实现功利主义福利最大化的政策方案是采用固定补贴的定向覆盖，该方案在改善低收入患者可及性与抑制高收入患者价格上涨之间取得平衡。这一权衡凸显了实施定向政策面临的挑战，但为设计高效且公平的公共牙科医疗体系提供了重要启示。
10.1111/sjoe.70038.title: Public coverage of dental care: universal or targeted?
10.1111/sjoe.70038.title_zh: 牙科护理的公共覆盖：全民还是定向？

10.1111/sjoe.70039.abstract: Abstract This paper studies the anchoring of inflation expectations at the individual forecaster level. It proposes a novel measure of anchoring based on both point and density forecasts, and uses data from the European Central Bank Survey of Professional Forecasters to examine its co‐movement with expectations about monetary policy and key cost‐push factors. The anchoring measure is constructed for each forecaster and regressed on expectations regarding the European Central Bank policy rate, crude oil prices, the US dollar/euro exchange rate, and unit labor costs. Although the cross‐sectional mean of long‐term inflation expectations appears largely stable, substantial heterogeneity emerges during periods of heightened macroeconomic uncertainty, with some forecasters exhibiting signs of de‐anchoring. The results show that individual anchoring is systematically related to expectations about future policy rates and unit labor cost changes. In addition, these relationships have strengthened since 2020 and display asymmetries depending on whether inflation expectations lie above or below the target.
10.1111/sjoe.70039.abstract_zh: 摘要  本文从个体预测者层面研究通胀预期的锚定情况。本文提出了一种基于点预测和密度预测的新型锚定度量方法，并利用欧洲央行专业预测者调查数据，考察其与货币政策预期及关键成本推动因素之间的协同变动关系。该锚定度量针对每位预测者构建，并基于其对欧洲央行政策利率、原油价格、美元/欧元汇率及单位劳动力成本的预期进行回归分析。尽管长期通胀预期的截面均值总体保持稳定，但在宏观经济不确定性加剧时期，预测者之间呈现出显著异质性，部分预测者表现出脱锚迹象。结果表明，个体锚定程度与未来政策利率及单位劳动力成本变化的预期存在系统性关联。此外，自2020年以来，这些关联性有所增强，且根据通胀预期高于或低于目标水平而呈现非对称特征。
10.1111/sjoe.70039.title: Anchoring of inflation expectations and the role of monetary policy and cost‐push factors
10.1111/sjoe.70039.title_zh: 通胀预期的锚定及货币政策与成本推动因素的作用

10.1111/twec.70091.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Chinese state‐owned enterprises (SOEs) serve as critical institutional anchors in supply chains. Utilising panel data from 1076 Chinese A‐share listed firms during the period of 2008–2016, this study examines the impact of SOEs on global value chain (GVC) participation of their suppliers. The empirical results from difference‐in‐differences method demonstrate that SOEs significantly enhance their suppliers' GVC participation. Mechanism tests reveal that SOEs boost their suppliers' GVC participation through operational enhancements, supply chain efficiency and FDI attraction improvements. In addition, this study identifies that resource misallocation and coordination costs negatively moderate the effect of SOEs on their suppliers' GVC participation. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the positive effects of SOEs are stronger for large suppliers and those suppliers without micro and small enterprises (MSEs) as major customers. Notably, SOEs enhance the intensive‐margin of GVCs but have a negligible effect on the extensive‐margin. These findings position SOEs as catalysts for GVC participation, offering policy insights for other economies with SOEs.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70091.abstract_zh: 中国国有企业在供应链中扮演着关键的制度锚点角色。本研究利用2008-2016年间1076家中国A股上市公司的面板数据，考察国有企业对其供应商全球价值链参与度的影响。基于双重差分法的实证结果表明，国有企业显著提升了其供应商的全球价值链参与度。机制检验显示，国有企业通过运营优化、供应链效率提升以及外商直接投资吸引力增强等途径，促进了供应商的全球价值链参与。此外，本研究发现资源错配与协调成本会负向调节国有企业对供应商全球价值链参与度的促进作用。异质性分析表明，对于大型供应商以及不以微型和小型企业为主要客户的供应商而言，国有企业的正向效应更为显著。值得注意的是，国有企业主要强化了全球价值链的集约边际，而对扩展边际的影响微乎其微。这些发现将国有企业定位为全球价值链参与的催化剂，为其他拥有国有企业的经济体提供了政策启示。
10.1111/twec.70091.title: Do China's State‐Owned Enterprises Promote Their Suppliers' Participation in Global Value Chains?
10.1111/twec.70091.title_zh: 中国国有企业是否促进了其供应商参与全球价值链？

10.1111/twec.70096.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In this paper, we analyse the determinants of maritime connections, with a special focus on the importance of foreign direct investments (FDI) in improving maritime transportation networks and in restructuring them. We are also interested in how China, in particular, impacts countries' integration to global supply chains through maritime transportation. We work on a heterogeneous panel of bilateral maritime connections as measured by UNCTAD's bilateral liner shipping connectivity index, and we find that FDIs between two partner countries do not significantly impact their maritime connection. However, we do find that Chinese FDIs in countries concerned by the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) reinforce bilateral maritime connections between countries, in general, be they BRI countries or not. The Chinese influence is also significant via their maritime presence: maritime connections between two countries are significantly higher when host countries have strong maritime ties to China. A deeper analysis through several interaction effects also shows the Chinese influence is conditional on host countries' attributes. For instance, a maritime connection with China is more beneficial to developing/poorer host countries, who see their connection to origin countries increase more as compared to developed/richer host countries.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70096.abstract_zh: 本文分析了海上连接的决定因素，特别关注外国直接投资在改善海上运输网络及其结构调整中的重要性。我们还重点研究了中国如何通过海上运输影响各国融入全球供应链。基于联合国贸发会议双边班轮航运连接指数衡量的异质性双边海上连接面板数据，我们发现两国之间的外国直接投资并未显著影响其海上连接。然而，中国在“一带一路”倡议相关国家的直接投资普遍加强了各国（无论是否为“一带一路”国家）之间的双边海上连接。中国的海上存在也产生了显著影响：当东道国与中国有紧密的海上联系时，两国之间的海上连接显著更高。通过多种交互效应的深入分析表明，中国的影响取决于东道国的特征。例如，与中国建立海上连接对发展中国家/较贫穷的东道国更为有利，这些国家与来源国的连接提升幅度大于发达国家/较富裕的东道国。
10.1111/twec.70096.title: Foreign Direct Investment and Maritime Transportation Infrastructure: Competition Effects Under the Belt and Road Initiative
10.1111/twec.70096.title_zh: 外商直接投资与海上交通基础设施：“一带一路”倡议下的竞争效应

10.1111/twec.70106.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Rising deglobalization has increased external uncertainty for the global economy. This paper develops a China–US Trade Equilibrium (CUTE) model that integrates monetary mechanisms and Hicksian welfare decomposition to examine the effects of U.S. tariff hikes on China and the U.S., as well as China's policy responses. A key contribution is the comparison of policy responses under identical policy costs. The results show that the direct macroeconomic impact of U.S. tariffs on China is modest, reflecting limited trade exposure and strong substitution effects, while broad tariffs generate larger welfare losses for the America through price increases and real income erosion. The reaction directly supporting household income and consumption yield substantially higher welfare returns than trade retaliation, government spending or monetary easing, as tariffs reduce real purchasing power. We suggest within the institutional settings considered, prioritizing household‐based demand support is a more effective response to external tariff shocks than retaliatory trade measures.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70106.abstract_zh: 去全球化趋势加剧了全球经济的外部不确定性。本文构建了一个整合货币机制与希克斯福利分解的中美贸易均衡（CUTE）模型，用以考察美国加征关税对中国和美国的影响，以及中国的政策应对。本文的关键贡献在于，在相同政策成本条件下比较了不同政策应对的效果。研究结果表明，美国关税对中国的直接宏观经济影响较为温和，这反映了有限的贸易敞口和较强的替代效应；而广泛性关税则通过价格上涨和实际收入侵蚀，给美国带来更大的福利损失。相较于贸易报复、政府支出或货币宽松政策，直接支持家庭收入和消费的应对措施能产生显著更高的福利回报，原因在于关税削弱了实际购买力。我们建议，在所考虑的体制环境下，优先采取基于家庭的需求支持政策，是应对外部关税冲击比报复性贸易措施更为有效的策略。
10.1111/twec.70106.title: Domestic Demand or Trade Retaliation? China's Policy Responses to U.S. Tariff Hikes
10.1111/twec.70106.title_zh: 国内需求还是贸易报复？中国对美国加征关税的政策回应

10.1111/twec.70107.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>U.S. overseas military deployments, as a strategic instrument for maintaining hegemony, structurally reconfigure international capital flows through a security‐economy nexus. While prior studies focus on host‐country perspectives, the third‐party economic spillovers of such deployments remain underexplored. This study investigates how they affect Chinese multinationals' foreign direct investment. The findings reveal a significant negative impact of U.S. military presence on Chinese FDI in host countries. Mechanism tests identify two channels: (1) institutional erosion—U.S. security patronage undermines host‐state governance, elevating political risk premiums that deter Chinese investment; (2) strategic anchoring—military presence strains host countries' relations with China, coupled with deep U.S. economic entrenchment, crowds out Chinese capital through both political and market channels. Heterogeneity analysis reinforces this logic. At the micro level, U.S. deployments heighten Chinese managers' perception of geopolitical risk, reshaping their attention allocation and subsequent investment decisions. These findings suggest that U.S. military retrenchment may reshape the strategic calculus of China's outward investment. By extending traditional FDI risk theory, this paper contributes to a nuanced understanding of the spillover effects of U.S. foreign military strategy amid great‐power competition, offering critical insights into the strategic value of the Belt and Road Initiative and guidance for Chinese firms seeking to reposition their global investment footprint.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70107.abstract_zh: 美国海外军事部署作为维护霸权的战略工具，通过安全-经济联动机制结构性重塑国际资本流动。现有研究多聚焦东道国视角，但此类部署的第三方经济溢出效应仍待深入探究。本文考察美国军事部署如何影响中国跨国企业对外直接投资，发现美国军事存在显著抑制中国对东道国的直接投资。机制检验识别出两条传导路径：（1）制度侵蚀效应——美国安全庇护削弱东道国治理能力，抬升政治风险溢价，抑制中国投资；（2）战略锚定效应——军事部署加剧东道国对华关系紧张，叠加美国深度经济嵌入，通过政治与市场双重渠道挤出中国资本。异质性分析进一步印证该逻辑。微观层面，美国军事部署强化中国管理者对地缘政治风险的感知，重塑其注意力配置与后续投资决策。研究表明，美国军事收缩可能重构中国对外投资的战略考量。本文通过拓展传统FDI风险理论，为理解大国竞争背景下美国海外军事战略的溢出效应提供新视角，同时揭示"一带一路"倡议的战略价值，为中国企业优化全球投资布局提供决策参考。
10.1111/twec.70107.title: Military Presence and Risk Mitigation: The Impact of U.S. Overseas Deployments on Chinese Firms' Foreign Direct Investment
10.1111/twec.70107.title_zh: 军事存在与风险缓解：美国海外部署对中国企业对外直接投资的影响

10.1111/twec.70110.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This article examines the impact of the European Union's post‐March 2014 and post‐February 2022 sanctions episodes against Russia on trade between Russia and the Visegrad countries (Czechia, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia) over 2013–2024. Changes are analysed at both the aggregate level and—based on an original identification of EU sanction coverage—across selected sanctioned product chapters and non‐sanctioned reference groups. The empirical framework combines descriptive statistics on the distribution of the selected product groups with two complementary econometric approaches: a gravity‐based Poisson pseudo‐maximum likelihood model (PPML) with fixed effects, estimated in a difference‐in‐differences design relative to control markets, and a PPML interrupted time‐series model used as a robustness check to identify structural breaks and post‐intervention trends. Empirically, the effects of EU sanctions on Visegrad exports to Russia were strongly negative already under the post‐March 2014 sanctions regime, particularly for highly sanctioned manufactured product groups such as machinery and electrical equipment, and intensified further following the substantial expansion of sanctions after February 2022. Import effects were initially weaker but intensified markedly from 2022 onward, most notably for energy sources. The findings point to episode‐specific trade responses, pronounced heterogeneity across product groups, and a clear asymmetry between export and import adjustments.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70110.abstract_zh: 本文考察了2013—2024年间，欧盟在2014年3月后及2022年2月后对俄罗斯实施的两轮制裁对俄罗斯与维谢格拉德国家（捷克、匈牙利、波兰和斯洛伐克）之间贸易的影响。分析涵盖总体层面，并基于对欧盟制裁覆盖范围的原创识别，在选定的受制裁产品章节和未受制裁参考组之间展开。实证框架结合了所选产品组分布的描述性统计与两种互补的计量经济学方法：一是基于引力模型的泊松伪最大似然估计（PPML）固定效应模型，采用双重差分设计相对于对照市场进行估计；二是作为稳健性检验的PPML中断时间序列模型，用于识别结构断点和干预后趋势。实证结果显示，早在2014年3月后的制裁体制下，欧盟制裁对维谢格拉德国家向俄罗斯的出口已产生强烈负面影响，尤其对机械和电气设备等受高度制裁的制成品组影响显著，并在2022年2月后制裁大幅扩展后进一步加剧。进口影响最初较弱，但从2022年起显著增强，最突出的是能源类产品。研究结果揭示了针对不同制裁事件的贸易反应差异、产品组间的显著异质性，以及出口与进口调整之间的明显不对称性。
10.1111/twec.70110.title:
Trade Effects of
                    EU
                    Sanctions Against Russia: Evidence From the Visegrad Group
10.1111/twec.70110.title_zh: 欧盟对俄制裁的贸易效应：来自维谢格拉德集团的证据

10.1111/twec.70112.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>During China's transformation from a quantity‐oriented to a quality‐oriented trading nation, industrial policy consistency (IPC) between central and local governments has been an important driving force for firm exports. We investigate this IPC by extracting information on the preferential industries mentioned in the Chinese 10th to 12th Five‐Year Plans (FYPs) and empirically analyze the relationship between IPC and firm exports on the basis of Chinese firm‐level data from 2001 to 2015. The results indicate that IPC expands the firms' export scales but reduces the quality of products exported. This phenomenon is driven primarily by increasing subsidy reliance, intensifying excessive market competition and weakening innovation incentives. The heterogeneity analysis indicates that IPC has a more profound effect on the export outcomes of state‐owned enterprises, large firms, pillar industries and regions facing high levels of official promotion pressure. We further find that comparative advantages can relatively mitigate the decline in quality caused by policy consistency. Our findings have important policy implications for coordinating regional industrial policies and improving export competitiveness.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70112.abstract_zh: 在中国从数量导向型贸易大国向质量导向型贸易大国转型过程中，中央与地方政府间的产业政策一致性（IPC）已成为推动企业出口的重要驱动力。本文通过提取中国第十至第十二个五年规划中提及的优先发展产业信息，基于2001-2015年中国企业层面数据，实证分析了产业政策一致性与企业出口之间的关系。研究结果表明，产业政策一致性扩大了企业出口规模，但降低了出口产品质量。这一现象主要源于补贴依赖度上升、过度市场竞争加剧以及创新激励弱化。异质性分析显示，产业政策一致性对国有企业、大型企业、支柱产业以及面临较高官员晋升压力地区的出口表现影响更为显著。进一步研究发现，比较优势能够相对缓解政策一致性导致的质量下降。本研究对协调区域产业政策、提升出口竞争力具有重要政策启示。
10.1111/twec.70112.title: Policy Catering or Market Choice: Industrial Policy Consistency and Firm Exports
10.1111/twec.70112.title_zh: 政策迎合还是市场选择：产业政策一致性与企业出口

10.1111/twec.70113.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>The link between environment and trade has long been the subject of intense policy debate. This study reviews the existing literature and addresses key gaps. We develop a unified framework that incorporates environmental externalities (local versus global), abatement, political competition, and trade. The model shows how producer and consumer/environmentalist lobbying incentives over pollution stringency interact, and how these incentives vary with the nature and magnitude of environmental externalities, the structure of environmental agreements (unilateral versus multilateral), and trade regimes. It also highlights the roles of abatement and terms‐of‐trade effects in shaping the equilibrium outcomes. In a large open economy, cooperative policy internalises the costs of emission leakage induced by lobbying, making it more welfare‐improving than noncooperative policy. Producer and consumer lobbying generally exert countervailing pressures, with their relative influence determined by the weights the government assigns to each group.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70113.abstract_zh: 环境与贸易之间的联系长期以来一直是政策辩论的焦点。本研究回顾了现有文献，并填补了关键空白。我们构建了一个统一的分析框架，将环境外部性（本地与全球）、减排措施、政治竞争和贸易纳入其中。该模型揭示了生产者和消费者/环保主义者围绕污染严格程度的游说激励如何相互作用，以及这些激励如何随环境外部性的性质与规模、环境协议的结构（单边与多边）以及贸易体制而变化。模型还强调了减排效应和贸易条件效应在塑造均衡结果中的作用。在大型开放经济体中，合作性政策内化了游说引发的排放泄漏成本，因此比非合作性政策更能提升福利。生产者和消费者的游说通常产生相互抵消的压力，其相对影响力取决于政府赋予各群体的权重。
10.1111/twec.70113.title: Political Economy of Environmental Policy Under Trade
10.1111/twec.70113.title_zh: 贸易条件下环境政策的政治经济学

10.1111/twec.70114.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study examines how Eco‐industrial Parks (EIPs) in China shape firm green innovation and, furthermore, explores its implications for trade competitiveness. We find that EIPs significantly boost green patent applications, particularly substantive innovations. This effect is stronger in cleaner industries, environmentally stringent cities and firms with high media exposure. Mechanisms include eased financing constraints, and increased R&D investment. Extending the analysis to the trade domain, we further show that EIP‐induced green innovation enhances firms' performance in green exports. Thus, EIPs serve as a pivotal policy that fosters green innovation and cultivates competitive advantages in global green markets.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70114.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国生态工业园区（EIPs）如何影响企业绿色创新，并进一步探讨其对贸易竞争力的启示。我们发现，生态工业园区显著促进了绿色专利申请，尤其是实质性创新。这一效应在清洁行业、环境规制严格的城市以及媒体曝光度高的企业中更为显著。其作用机制包括缓解融资约束和增加研发投入。将分析拓展至贸易领域后，我们进一步表明，生态工业园区引致的绿色创新提升了企业在绿色出口方面的绩效。因此，生态工业园区作为一项关键政策，能够促进绿色创新，并在全球绿色市场中培育竞争优势。
10.1111/twec.70114.title: Eco‐Industrial Parks, Green Innovation and Green Export Performance: Evidence From China
10.1111/twec.70114.title_zh: 生态工业园区、绿色创新与绿色出口绩效：来自中国的证据

10.1111/twec.70116.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>The study focuses on the analysis of neutral states' exports to the Russian Federation via SDID and their comparison with more diligent enforcers of European sanctions, emphasising thus the changes that took place after the Russian invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. The investigation seeks to identify if the invasion and its subsequent repercussions resulted in significant changes in the commodity structure of trade of the neutral states, indicating their engagement in sanction‐busting behaviour. The research is based on 13 synthetic difference‐in‐difference panel data models for each sampled state using data from the UN Comtrade database. The results highlight an increase in the value of sanctioned commodities exported to Russia in all nine instances, where a significant change occurred solely in Kazakhstan and Türkiye. The findings of the study are consistent with the existing literature, and they reveal several directions for future research.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70116.abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于中立国通过SDID向俄罗斯联邦的出口情况，并将其与更严格执行欧洲制裁的国家进行对比，重点分析了2022年2月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后发生的变化。研究旨在探究此次入侵及其后续影响是否导致中立国贸易商品结构发生显著变化，从而揭示其参与规避制裁的行为。研究基于联合国商品贸易统计数据库的数据，为每个样本国家构建了13个合成双重差分面板数据模型。结果显示，在所有9个案例中，向俄罗斯出口的受制裁商品价值均有所增加，其中仅哈萨克斯坦和土耳其出现了显著变化。研究结论与现有文献一致，并为未来研究指明了若干方向。
10.1111/twec.70116.title: Friend or Foe? Analysing Neutral States' Exports to the Russian Federation Using Synthetic Difference‐In‐Differences
10.1111/twec.70116.title_zh: 朋友还是敌人？利用合成双重差分法分析中立国对俄罗斯联邦的出口

10.1111/twec.70117.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In recent years, the acceleration of de‐globalization has reconfigured global supply chains. Using listed firm‐level global supplier‐customer relationship data from the FactSet Revere database spanning January 2017 to December 2019, this paper examines whether and how firm‐supplier relationships change after the U.S.–China trade tensions. Our findings indicate that the U.S.–China trade tensions are followed by a significant relative decline in U.S. listed firms' reliance on direct Chinese suppliers. This phenomenon is pronounced in the manufacturing and information industries, especially in high‐tech industries. Mechanism analysis suggests that, following the trade frictions, U.S. firms appear to reduce their reliance on direct Chinese suppliers by diversifying and shortening contracts, while also taking adjustment costs into account. The extended analysis explicitly shows that U.S. firms continue to rely on China indirectly—via upstream inputs embedded in domestic suppliers and through third‐country firms closely tied to Chinese production networks. Additionally, U.S. firms tend to increase supplier links with countries that have higher institutional quality, consistent with a search for greater supply chain ‘security’.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70117.abstract_zh: 近年来，去全球化进程加速，全球供应链格局随之重构。本文利用FactSet Revere数据库2017年1月至2019年12月期间美国上市公司层面的全球供应商-客户关系数据，考察中美贸易摩擦是否以及如何改变企业-供应商关系。研究发现，中美贸易摩擦后，美国上市公司对中国直接供应商的依赖程度出现显著相对下降。这一现象在制造业与信息行业尤为突出，特别是高科技领域。机制分析表明，贸易摩擦发生后，美国企业通过多元化供应商选择与缩短合同期限来降低对中国直接供应商的依赖，同时兼顾调整成本。拓展分析进一步揭示，美国企业仍通过嵌入国内供应商的上游投入品以及与华生产网络紧密关联的第三国企业，间接依赖中国。此外，美国企业倾向于增加与制度质量较高国家的供应商联系，这与寻求更高供应链"安全性"的行为一致。
10.1111/twec.70117.title: Trade Tensions and the Reconfiguration of Supply Chain Linkages: Evidence From U.S. Listed Firms
10.1111/twec.70117.title_zh: 贸易紧张与供应链关联重构：来自美国上市公司的证据

10.1111/twec.70118.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper examines the effects of economic sanctions on the taxation of natural resources in targeted countries, distinguishing between de jure and de facto measures of the average effective tax rate (AETR) on resource rents. The analysis relies on a sample of 20 African countries for the de jure AETR and a global panel of 75 developing and developed countries for the de facto AETR over the period 2000–2020. Using a Spatial Durbin Model that accounts for spatial spillovers in both taxation and sanctions, we document three main results. First, both resource taxation (de jure and de facto) and economic sanctions exhibit significant spatial dependence across neighbouring countries. Second, economic sanctions affect de jure rent capture, while their impact on de facto AETR is limited and operates mainly through indirect and spillover channels rather than through a direct strengthening of effective tax enforcement. Third, the effects vary by the type and origin of sanctions, with financial sanctions exerting stronger effects than trade sanctions, and UN and US sanctions proving more influential than EU sanctions. The results are robust to alternative measures of sanction intensity, proxied by the number of sanctions imposed, as well as to alternative estimation strategies addressing endogeneity, and dynamic treatment effects. These findings suggest that sanctioned countries adjust formal tax policy in response to sanctions, which contribute to limit the adverse effect of sanctions on their de facto taxation of the resource rent.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70118.abstract_zh: 本文考察了经济制裁对目标国自然资源税收的影响，区分了资源租金平均有效税率（AETR）的法律规定与实际执行指标。分析基于2000-2020年期间两个样本：20个非洲国家的法律规定AETR，以及75个发达国家与发展中国家组成的全球面板数据的实际执行AETR。采用考虑税收与制裁空间溢出效应的空间杜宾模型，我们得出三项主要结论。第一，资源税收（包括法律规定与实际执行）和经济制裁在邻国间均呈现显著的空间依赖性。第二，经济制裁影响法律规定的租金获取，但对实际执行AETR的影响有限，且主要通过间接和溢出渠道发挥作用，而非直接强化有效税收执法。第三，制裁效果因类型和来源而异：金融制裁的影响强于贸易制裁，联合国和美国制裁的影响力超过欧盟制裁。上述结果在采用制裁数量作为制裁强度替代指标、处理内生性的替代估计策略以及动态处理效应检验中均保持稳健。这些发现表明，受制裁国会根据制裁调整正式税收政策，这有助于限制制裁对其资源租金实际征税的不利影响。
10.1111/twec.70118.title: Economic Sanctions and Taxation of Natural Resource Rent: Evidence From Spatial Analysis
10.1111/twec.70118.title_zh: 经济制裁与自然资源租金征税：来自空间分析的证据

10.1111/twec.70121.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This paper examines the environmental consequences of capital goods imports, employing China's subsidy policy as a natural experiment. The policy, which provides reimbursement to firms for the cost of imported capital, has an unintended impact on the environmental outcomes of firms. We employ the difference‐in‐differences methodology to distinguish between firms highly expose to the policy as the treatment group and less exposed ones as the control group. The results indicate that the subsidy policy significantly reduces firms' total chemical oxygen demand emissions by 21.2% and their emission intensity by 21.8%, revealing notable unanticipated environmental benefits of the policy. The reduction in emissions is primarily attributable to improvements in the production process rather than post‐production abatement. State‐owned firms and firms with a higher proportion of skilled workers exhibit more pronounced reductions. Additionally, our findings suggest that the import of capital goods fosters green innovation, a crucial mechanism through which the subsidy policy exerts an influence on emission reductions. This study offers insights into the environmental consequences of trade policies and the combined effects of production and innovation strategies in response to non‐environmental incentives.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70121.abstract_zh: 本文考察了资本品进口的环境后果，以中国的补贴政策作为自然实验。该政策为企业进口资本成本提供报销，却意外影响了企业的环境表现。我们采用双重差分法，将受政策影响较大的企业作为处理组，影响较小的企业作为对照组。结果表明，补贴政策显著降低了企业化学需氧量总排放量21.2%，排放强度下降21.8%，揭示了该政策显著且未预期的环境效益。排放减少主要归因于生产过程的改进，而非生产后的末端治理。国有企业及高技能工人比例较高的企业表现出更显著的减排效果。此外，我们的发现表明，资本品进口促进了绿色创新，这是补贴政策影响减排的关键机制。本研究为贸易政策的环境后果以及企业在非环境激励下生产与创新策略的联合效应提供了洞见。
10.1111/twec.70121.title: Unintended Environmental Consequences of Capital Goods Imports: Evidence From China
10.1111/twec.70121.title_zh: 资本品进口的非预期环境后果：来自中国的证据

10.1111/twec.70123.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study analyses weekly port calls from 2019 to 2026 to evaluate the Russia–Ukraine war's impact on maritime trade. The data reveals clear structural shifts that Ukrainian traffic moved from high‐risk areas like Odesa to safer Danube River ports. On the other hand, Russia sustained its maritime activity by navigating sanctions and redirecting exports to Asian markets. The Black Sea Grain Initiative also improved navigation conditions for both countries. Overall, the war caused domestic port substitution within Ukraine and a broader logistical reorganization for Russia.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70123.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了2019年至2026年的周度港口停靠数据，以评估俄乌战争对海上贸易的影响。数据揭示了明显的结构性转变：乌克兰的航运从敖德萨等高危地区转移至更安全的多瑙河港口。另一方面，俄罗斯通过规避制裁并将出口转向亚洲市场，维持了其海上活动。黑海谷物倡议也改善了两国的航行条件。总体而言，战争导致了乌克兰国内港口的替代效应，并引发了俄罗斯更广泛的物流重组。
10.1111/twec.70123.title: The Impact of Russia–Ukraine War in Maritime Data
10.1111/twec.70123.title_zh: 俄乌战争对海事数据的影响

10.1111/twec.70124.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Information and communication technology (ICT) goods are central to digital transformation, technological upgrading and participation in global production networks. Yet relatively little is known about whether immigrant networks shape international trade in these knowledge‐intensive goods. Using bilateral panel data for 172 countries over the 2000–2021 period, we estimate gravity‐based specifications, Tobit models and linear fixed‐effects models for ICT goods trade. The results show a positive and statistically significant relationship between immigrant networks and ICT goods trade, especially exports. The export relationship remains positive after controlling for productive capacity, while the import relationship weakens. Interaction models further show that immigrant networks are more strongly related to ICT goods trade when immigrants' home countries have greater ICT export capacity. Marginal‐effect estimates indicate that the relationship operates through both the extensive and intensive margins of trade. The findings suggest that immigrant networks are especially relevant for ICT goods trade when cross‐border social and commercial ties connect destination markets to technologically capable home countries.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70124.abstract_zh: 信息与通信技术（ICT）产品是数字化转型、技术升级及参与全球生产网络的核心要素。然而，关于移民网络是否影响这类知识密集型产品的国际贸易，学界认知仍相对有限。本研究基于2000—2021年间172个国家的双边面板数据，采用引力模型设定、Tobit模型及线性固定效应模型对ICT产品贸易进行估计。结果显示，移民网络与ICT产品贸易（尤其是出口）之间存在显著正向统计关系。在控制生产能力后，出口关系仍保持正向，而进口关系则有所减弱。交互模型进一步表明，当移民母国具备更强的ICT出口能力时，移民网络与ICT产品贸易的关联性更为显著。边际效应估计显示，该关系通过贸易的扩展边际与集约边际共同发挥作用。研究结论表明，当跨境社会与商业联系将目的地市场与技术能力较强的母国相连接时，移民网络对ICT产品贸易具有特殊重要性。
10.1111/twec.70124.title:
Immigrant Networks, Productive Capacity and Trade in
                    ICT
                    Goods
10.1111/twec.70124.title_zh: 移民网络、生产能力与ICT产品贸易

10.1111/twec.70125.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>As globalization faces headwinds from rising geopolitical tensions, the interaction between international politics and trade has become increasingly complex. Moving beyond static gravity models, this paper examines the dynamic co‐evolution of international political relations and the global trade network. Using a Stochastic Actor‐Oriented Model (SAOM) on a dataset of 139 economies from 1996 to 2023, we model the global trade network as an endogenous and evolving system rather than a set of independent dyads. The results show that diplomatic proximity significantly increases the likelihood of trade‐tie formation, and that this effect strengthens markedly after 2016, approaching the explanatory importance of geographic distance. The estimates also reveal strong reciprocity and triadic closure in the trade network, indicating that trade ties emerge within clustered and path‐dependent structures. Overall, the findings suggest that the contemporary trade system is increasingly shaped by the interaction between geopolitical affinity and network embeddedness.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70125.abstract_zh: 随着地缘政治紧张局势加剧，全球化面临阻力，国际政治与贸易之间的互动日益复杂。本文超越静态引力模型，考察国际政治关系与全球贸易网络的动态共同演化。基于1996年至2023年139个经济体的数据集，采用随机行动者导向模型（SAOM），我们将全球贸易网络建模为一个内生且不断演化的系统，而非一组独立的双边关系。结果表明，外交亲近度显著提升了贸易联系形成的可能性，且这一效应在2016年后明显增强，其解释力接近地理距离。估计结果还揭示了贸易网络中强烈的互惠性和三角闭合性，表明贸易联系出现在具有聚类和路径依赖特征的结构中。总体而言，研究结果表明，当代贸易体系日益受到地缘政治亲和性与网络嵌入性之间互动的影响。
10.1111/twec.70125.title: The Dynamic Co‐Evolution of International Politics and the Global Trade Network: Evidence From a Stochastic Actor‐Oriented Model
10.1111/twec.70125.title_zh: 国际政治与全球贸易网络的动态共演化：来自随机行动者导向模型的证据

10.1111/twec.70126.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We study the impact of global value chain (GVC) participation on firms' innovation, productivity, and other indicators of technical change. Our dataset encompasses heterogeneous firms from 144 countries at different income levels over the period 2006–2025. Using difference‐in‐differences and matching strategies, we find that GVC participation leads to increased innovation and other technological improvements, with gains driven primarily at the extensive margin and by importing rather than exporting activities. Among innovation types, product innovation responds more strongly than process innovation. Importantly, the nature of innovation differs systematically across development levels: GVC participants in lower‐income countries benefit from access to foreign technology, while those operating in more advanced economies engage more in formal, R&D‐intensive innovation.</jats:p>
                  <jats:p>
                    <jats:bold>JEL Classification</jats:bold>
                    : C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70126.abstract_zh:
我们研究了全球价值链（GVC）参与对企业创新、生产率及其他技术变革指标的影响。数据集涵盖2006–2025年间来自144个不同收入水平国家的异质性企业。通过双重差分法和匹配策略，我们发现GVC参与促进了创新及其他技术进步，其收益主要源于集约边际，且进口活动的作用强于出口活动。在创新类型中，产品创新的响应程度强于流程创新。重要的是，创新性质在不同发展水平上呈现系统性差异：低收入国家的GVC参与者受益于外国技术获取，而发达经济体的企业则更多从事正式的、研发密集型创新。

JEL分类：C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
10.1111/twec.70126.title: Technical Change Through Global Value Chains: Evidence From Firms Worldwide
10.1111/twec.70126.title_zh: 全球价值链中的技术变革：来自全球企业的证据

10.1111/twec.70127.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Utilising microdata from Chinese A‐share listed firms matched to the China Customs Database over the period 2007–2016, this paper exploits a quasi‐natural experiment based on Google's exit from mainland China and constructs a difference‐in‐differences (DID) model to systematically examine the impact of information access barriers on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness. The results indicate that information access barriers have a significant negative effect on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness, primarily reflected in narrowing export product scope, reducing export technological sophistication and weakening their centrality in the export trade network. Mechanism analyses reveal that information access barriers suppress firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness through multiple channels, including increasing transaction costs, constraining technological innovation, weakening capital investment, reducing productivity and aggravating financial constraints. Moreover, heterogeneity tests reveal that the impact of information access barriers on firms' multi‐dimensional export competitiveness varies significantly across regions, industries and firm types. Extending the scope beyond export performance, further analysis shows that restricted information access significantly impairs firms' short‐term profitability and long‐term market valuation. Taken together, this study underscores the critical role of information access barriers in firms' export competitiveness and upgrading, offering important insights for better leveraging information technology to improve export patterns.</jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70127.abstract_zh: 利用2007–2016年中国A股上市公司与海关数据库匹配的微观数据，本文以谷歌退出中国大陆为准自然实验，构建双重差分模型系统考察信息获取壁垒对企业多维出口竞争力的影响。结果表明，信息获取壁垒对企业多维出口竞争力具有显著负向效应，主要表现为缩小出口产品范围、降低出口技术复杂度、削弱其在出口贸易网络中的中心度。机制分析显示，信息获取壁垒通过增加交易成本、抑制技术创新、削弱资本投入、降低生产率及加剧融资约束等多重渠道抑制企业多维出口竞争力。异质性检验表明，信息获取壁垒对不同地区、行业及类型企业的多维出口竞争力影响存在显著差异。将研究范畴拓展至出口绩效之外，进一步分析发现，信息获取受限显著损害企业短期盈利能力和长期市场估值。综上，本研究揭示了信息获取壁垒在企业出口竞争力与升级中的关键作用，为更好利用信息技术优化出口格局提供了重要启示。

10.1111/twec.70130.abstract: ABSTRACT This study aims to explore the relationship between trade sophistication and economic development stages, including in the context of digitalization. We employ nonparametric, semiparametric, and parametric methods, covering the period from 2003 to 2024 across 119 countries, categorized into three income groups. Our findings show that GDP per capita has a positive but diminishing relationship with export and import sophistication, suggesting that trade sophistication grows rapidly at lower levels of economic development but slows down as economies become more economically advanced. The evolution patterns of export and import sophistication are relatively similar throughout the stages of economic development; however, the level of export sophistication consistently exceeds that of import sophistication across all income groups. In the context of digital transformation, digitalization is found to positively affect trade sophistication in high and middle‐income countries, while GDP per capita remains positively associated with trade sophistication, but with diminishing marginal effects. For low‐income countries, GDP per capita is the primary driver of increased trade sophistication, while in high‐income countries, digitalization stands out as the dominant factor. These findings remain robust after controlling for human capital, FDI, and institutional quality, highlighting the importance of formulating stage‐specific economic policies to enhance trade sophistication in the rapidly evolving digital era.
10.1111/twec.70130.abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究旨在探讨贸易复杂度与经济发展阶段之间的关系，并纳入数字化背景进行分析。我们采用非参数、半参数及参数方法，覆盖2003年至2024年间119个国家，并将其划分为三个收入组别。研究结果表明，人均GDP与出口及进口复杂度呈正向但边际递减的关系，即贸易复杂度在经济发展水平较低阶段增长较快，但随着经济体日趋成熟而增速放缓。出口与进口复杂度的演变模式在经济发展各阶段相对相似；然而，在所有收入组别中，出口复杂度水平始终高于进口复杂度。在数字化转型背景下，数字化对高收入及中等收入国家的贸易复杂度具有正向影响，而人均GDP仍与贸易复杂度保持正向关联，但边际效应递减。对于低收入国家，人均GDP是提升贸易复杂度的主要驱动力；而在高收入国家，数字化则成为主导因素。在控制人力资本、外商直接投资及制度质量后，上述结论依然稳健，凸显了在快速演变的数字时代制定分阶段经济政策以提升贸易复杂度的重要性。

<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    In the current confrontational geopolitical climate, countries have intensified the use of selective trade restrictions to exert economic coercion. This paper introduces
                    <jats:italic>targeted</jats:italic>
                    trade restrictions between a US‐centric bloc and a China‐centric bloc into a general equilibrium trade model that features nonlinear adjustments and input–output connections. We study how micro‐level restrictions—based on data identifying high‐weaponization‐potential products—affect welfare and the macroeconomic structure of global value chains (GVCs). Our findings reveal that while global economic integration is marginally affected, its topology changes: chains become more regional and rely more on non‐aligned countries acting as connectors between opposing blocs, in ways that may be hard to detect in standard trade data.
                  </jats:p>
10.1111/twec.70131.abstract_zh: 在当前对抗性地缘政治气候下，各国强化了选择性贸易限制手段以实施经济胁迫。本文将美国主导集团与中国主导集团之间的针对性贸易限制引入具有非线性调整特征和投入产出关联的一般均衡贸易模型。基于识别高武器化潜力产品的微观数据，我们研究了微观层面的限制措施如何影响福利与全球价值链的宏观经济结构。研究结果表明，尽管全球经济一体化受到轻微影响，但其拓扑结构发生了改变：价值链呈现区域化趋势，并更依赖不结盟国家作为对立集团之间的连接枢纽——这种变化在标准贸易数据中可能难以察觉。

10.1111/twec.70132.abstract: ABSTRACT Oil is the lifeblood of industry, serving as the core source of power for the operation of industrial machinery. Ensuring its stable supply is crucial for the smooth production process, which in turn is a key determinant in enhancing the quality of export products for enterprises. This study empirically examines the impact of energy supply on the quality of export products and the mechanism of its effect by using a staggered difference‐in‐differences (DID) method with the implementation of China's West‐to‐East Oil Transportation Project as a quasi‐natural experiment. The empirical results show that a dependable energy supply substantially boosts the quality of goods produced for export by various companies. The mechanism analysis shows that energy supply improves export product quality through enterprise performance improvement effects, industry agglomeration effects and supply chain stabilization effects, and it mainly improves export product quality in energy‐importing regions, technology‐intensive industries, private enterprises, and general trade enterprises. Further analysis reveals that a stable supply of energy helps enhance the sustainability of enterprise exports while helping enterprises realize value chain upgrading, helping China get rid of the curse of locking the bottom of the export value chain. The findings of this study help clarify the intrinsic mechanism between energy supply and export product quality and provide an empirical basis for the cross‐regional energy dispatch strategy to help China's export value chain upgrade.
10.1111/twec.70132.abstract_zh: 摘要 石油是工业的血液，是工业机械运转的核心动力来源。确保其稳定供应对于生产过程的顺利进行至关重要，而这又是提升企业出口产品质量的关键决定因素。本研究以中国“西油东送”工程实施为准自然实验，采用交错双重差分法实证检验了能源供应对出口产品质量的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，可靠的能源供应显著提升了各类企业的出口产品质量。机制分析显示，能源供应通过企业绩效提升效应、产业集聚效应和供应链稳定效应改善了出口产品质量，并且主要提升了能源输入地区、技术密集型行业、民营企业和一般贸易企业的出口产品质量。进一步分析发现，稳定的能源供应有助于增强企业出口的可持续性，同时帮助企业实现价值链升级，助力中国摆脱出口价值链低端锁定的困境。本研究结论有助于厘清能源供应与出口产品质量之间的内在机理，并为跨区域能源调度策略助力中国出口价值链升级提供经验依据。

10.1257/aer.20220264.abstract: Most organizations rely on managers to identify talented workers. However, managers who are evaluated on team performance have an incentive to hoard workers. This study provides the first empirical evidence of talent hoarding using personnel records and survey evidence from a large firm. Talent hoarding is self-reported by three-fourths of managers, is detectable in manager ratings of worker talent, and occurs more frequently under stronger hoarding incentives, proxied by performance-related pay, team size, and talent visibility. Using quasi-random exposure to talent hoarding, I show that hoarding deters internal job applications, inhibiting career progression and altering talent allocation in the firm.
10.1257/aer.20220264.abstract_zh: 大多数组织依赖管理者识别有才能的员工。然而，那些以团队绩效为考核标准的管理者，有动机囤积人才。本研究首次利用一家大型企业的人事档案和调查证据，提供了人才囤积的实证依据。四分之三的管理者自报存在人才囤积行为，这一现象在管理者对员工才能的评分中可被察觉，并且在囤积动机更强时（以绩效薪酬、团队规模和人才可见度为衡量指标）更为频繁。通过准随机暴露于人才囤积情境，本研究表明，囤积行为会抑制内部工作申请，阻碍职业发展，并改变企业内的人才配置。

10.1257/aer.20230242.abstract: <jats:p>We show that, depending on how the impact of omitted variables is measured, it can be substantially easier for omitted variables to flip coefficient signs than to drive them to zero. This behavior occurs with “Oster's delta” (Oster 2019a), a widely reported robustness measure. Consequently, any time this measure is large—suggesting omitted variables may be unimportant—a much smaller value reverses the sign of the parameter of interest. We propose a modified measure of robustness to address this concern. We illustrate our results in four empirical applications and two meta-analyses. We implement our methods in the companion Stata module “regsensitivity.” (JEL C18, C21, C52)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20230242.abstract_zh: 我们证明，根据遗漏变量影响的衡量方式不同，遗漏变量翻转系数符号的难度可能远低于将其驱至零值的难度。这一现象出现在广泛使用的稳健性指标“奥斯特德尔塔”（Oster 2019a）中。因此，每当该指标数值较大（表明遗漏变量可能不重要）时，一个更小的数值即可使关注参数的符号发生反转。我们提出了一种修正的稳健性度量方法以解决此问题。我们在四项实证应用和两项元分析中展示了研究结果，并在配套的Stata模块“regsensitivity”中实现了相关方法。（JEL C18, C21, C52）

10.1257/aer.20230344.abstract: <jats:p>I study how firm market power and worker bargaining power shape wages and welfare. Using French micro-data, I document patterns linking wages and firm market power that existing models cannot explain. A model in which firms produce vertically differentiated goods and share profits with workers explains those patterns. The model (i) reveals new challenges in estimating monopsony and bargaining power, proposing an alternative approach; (ii) shows that the passthrough of firm-specific shocks to wages depends on the type of shock; (iii) explains how markups shape firm wage premia; and (iv) formalizes how strengthening worker bargaining power affects wages and welfare. (JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20230344.abstract_zh: 本文研究了企业市场势力与工人议价能力如何共同决定工资与福利。基于法国微观数据，我发现了现有模型无法解释的工资与企业市场势力之间的关联模式。通过构建一个企业生产垂直差异化产品并与工人分享利润的模型，这些模式得以解释。该模型：（i）揭示了估算买方垄断势力与议价能力面临的新挑战，并提出替代性方法；（ii）表明企业特定冲击向工资的传导效应取决于冲击类型；（iii）解释了加成率如何塑造企业工资溢价；（iv）形式化分析了增强工人议价能力对工资与福利的影响。（JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22）
10.1257/aer.20230344.title: Understanding High-Wage Firms: Monopoly, Monopsony, and Bargaining Power
10.1257/aer.20230344.title_zh: 理解高工资企业：垄断、买方垄断与议价能力

10.1257/aer.20230376.title: Quota versus Quality? Long-Term Gains from an Unusual Gender Quota
10.1257/aer.20230376.title_zh: 配额还是质量？一项特殊性别配额的长期收益

10.1257/aer.20230448.abstract: This paper studies the economic impacts of carbon pricing. Exploiting institutional features of the European carbon market and high-frequency data, I identify carbon policy shocks and trace their dynamic effects. A restrictive carbon policy shock raises energy prices, reduces emissions, spurs green innovation, but decreases economic activity—disproportionately burdening poorer households. Not only are the poor more affected because of their higher energy spending, but they also experience larger income losses. These indirect, general-equilibrium effects via income and employment play an important role in the transmission of carbon pricing policies, accounting for about two-thirds of the aggregate consumption response.
10.1257/aer.20230448.abstract_zh: 本文研究碳定价的经济影响。利用欧洲碳市场的制度特征与高频数据，我识别出碳政策冲击并追踪其动态效应。限制性碳政策冲击推高能源价格、减少排放、刺激绿色创新，但会抑制经济活动——且对贫困家庭造成不成比例的负担。贫困家庭不仅因能源支出占比更高而受到更大影响，其收入损失也更为显著。这些通过收入与就业渠道传导的间接一般均衡效应，在碳定价政策的传导机制中发挥重要作用，约占总体消费反应的三分之二。
10.1257/aer.20230448.title: The Unequal Economic Consequences of Carbon Pricing
10.1257/aer.20230448.title_zh: 碳定价的不平等经济后果

10.1257/aer.20230541.title: The Private Provision of Public Services: Evidence from Random Assignment in Medicaid
10.1257/aer.20230541.title_zh: 公共服务的私人提供：来自医疗补助随机分配的证据

10.1257/aer.20230766.title: Quality Adjustment at Scale: Hedonic versus Exact Demand-Based Price Indices
10.1257/aer.20230766.title_zh: 大规模质量调整：享乐指数与精确需求价格指数

10.1257/aer.20230768.abstract: Designing public transport networks involves trade-offs between coverage, service frequency, and direct service. We use the expansion of the bus system in Jakarta, Indonesia, to study these trade-offs. We analyze how new direct connections, changes in bus travel time, and wait time reductions affect bus ridership and aggregate flows, and estimate a transit network demand model by matching the route launch events. Commuters in Jakarta are 2-3 times more sensitive to wait time than bus time, and inattentive to long routes. We develop a flexible framework to characterize optimal networks. A less concentrated network would increase ridership and commuter welfare.
10.1257/aer.20230768.abstract_zh: 设计公共交通网络需要在覆盖范围、服务频率与直达服务之间进行权衡。我们以印度尼西亚雅加达公交系统的扩张为例，研究这些权衡关系。通过分析新增直达线路、公交出行时间变化以及等待时间缩短对公交客流量和总体客流的影响，并利用线路开通事件匹配数据估算交通网络需求模型。研究发现：雅加达通勤者对等待时间的敏感度是公交行驶时间的2-3倍，且对长距离线路关注度较低。我们构建了一个灵活的分析框架来刻画最优网络特征，结果表明：降低网络集中度将有助于提升客流量与通勤者福利。
10.1257/aer.20230768.title: Optimal Public Transportation Networks: Evidence from the World’s Largest Bus Rapid Transit System in Jakarta
10.1257/aer.20230768.title_zh: 最优公共交通网络：来自雅加达全球最大快速公交系统的证据

10.1257/aer.20230802.title: Elite Universities and the Intergenerational Transmission of Human and Social Capital
10.1257/aer.20230802.title_zh: 精英大学与人力资本和社会资本的代际传递

10.1257/aer.20230849.abstract: <jats:p>We use firm-level data to document that private businesses experience large fluctuations in their profit shares. These are due to large, fat-tailed, and transitory changes in output that are not fully accompanied by changes in their inputs. We interpret this evidence using a model of entrepreneurial dynamics. Because firms can limit their exposure to risk by operating at a smaller scale, our model predicts large macroeconomic losses from uninsurable business risk, much larger than those stemming from credit constraints. While self-financing allows entrepreneurs to quickly overcome credit constraints, even wealthy entrepreneurs remain considerably exposed to risk. (JEL D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20230849.abstract_zh: 我们利用企业层面数据证明，私营企业的利润份额存在大幅波动。这种波动源于产出的大规模、厚尾且暂时性的变化，而这些变化并未完全伴随投入要素的同步调整。我们通过构建企业家动态模型来解释这一现象。由于企业可通过缩小经营规模来限制风险敞口，模型预测不可保商业风险将导致巨大的宏观经济损失——其规模远超信贷约束造成的损失。虽然自我融资能使企业家快速克服信贷约束，但即便是富裕的企业家仍面临显著的风险敞口。（JEL分类号：D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26）
10.1257/aer.20230849.title: The Aggregate Costs of Uninsurable Business Risk
10.1257/aer.20230849.title_zh: 不可保险商业风险的总体成本

10.1257/aer.20231368.abstract: We study racial disparities in promotions in a setting in which promotions are formulaic: the US patent office. Using detailed administrative data that allow us to observe who is eligible for promotion when, we document that Black patent examiners experience delays in promotions they are entitled to, slowing their climb to the top of the career ladder by a year and reducing career earnings by 2.9%. Institutional features rule out statistical discrimination with accurate priors. Slow promotions even under Black supervisors argue against taste-based animus. Instead, the patterns fit models of belief-based discrimination.
10.1257/aer.20231368.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在晋升流程高度程式化的情境——美国专利局——中存在的种族晋升差异。利用详尽的行政数据，我们得以观察特定时间点符合晋升条件的群体，发现黑人专利审查员在应得晋升中遭遇延迟，导致其职业阶梯顶端晋升速度放缓一年，职业生涯收入减少2.9%。制度特征排除了基于准确先验信息的统计性歧视。即使在黑人主管领导下仍存在晋升缓慢现象，这否定了基于偏好的歧视解释。相反，这些模式符合基于信念的歧视模型。
10.1257/aer.20231368.title: Racial Promotion Gaps

10.1257/aer.20231414.abstract: Relative to remote work, working downtown facilitates valuable interactions with other in-office workers, but entails commuting costs. The resulting coordination mechanism can lead to multiple stationary equilibria with varying levels of remote work. Temporary reductions in commuters, as in the COVID-19 pandemic, can then lead to persistently large fractions of remote workers. Cellphone- based mobility data for the U.S. shows that commuting trips in the largest cities, which are more likely to exhibit multiplicity, have stabilized at only 60% of pre-pandemic levels, while they are fully back in smaller cities. Cities with permanently low commuting experience average welfare losses of 2.3%.
10.1257/aer.20231414.abstract_zh: 相较于远程办公，市中心工作虽能促进与其他在岗员工的有价值互动，但需承担通勤成本。由此产生的协调机制可能导致远程办公比例不同的多重稳态均衡。如同新冠疫情期间出现的通勤者暂时性减少，可能引发远程工作者比例持续高企的现象。基于美国手机信令数据的流动性研究表明，更易呈现多重均衡特征的大型城市通勤出行量仅恢复至疫情前水平的60%，而小型城市已完全恢复。通勤量持续低迷的城市平均福利损失达2.3%。
10.1257/aer.20231414.title: Remote Work and City Structure

10.1257/aer.20231415.abstract: <jats:p>Moretti (2021) reports a positive elasticity between technology cluster size and patenting, and uses an event study and instrumental variables regressions to justify a causal interpretation. The event study does not use the variation generated by inventors moving across cities, and the instrument is constructed incorrectly due to a coding error. I run a corrected event study and fix the coding error, and find null effects. The reported elasticity may not be causal. (JEL J24, L60, O31, O34, R32)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20231415.abstract_zh: Moretti（2021）报告了技术集群规模与专利产出之间的正向弹性，并通过事件研究和工具变量回归论证了因果解释。然而，该事件研究未利用发明人在城市间流动产生的变异，且由于编码错误导致工具变量构建有误。我重新进行了修正的事件研究并纠正了编码错误，发现效应为零。因此，所报告的弹性可能并非因果关系。（JEL J24, L60, O31, O34, R32）
10.1257/aer.20231415.title: The Effect of High-Tech Clusters on the Productivity of Top Inventors: Comment
10.1257/aer.20231415.title_zh: 高科技集群对顶尖发明者生产率的影响：评论

10.1257/aer.20231486.abstract: In general, finding the optimal combination among N items requires evaluating all 2^N possibilities. We develop a method applicable whenever items are complements or substitutes that uses this structure to discard suboptimal combinations without evaluation and extends to heterogeneous-agent environments. In a calibrated general equilibrium model of multinational firms choosing interdependent production locations, we show the method is orders of magnitude faster than incumbent approaches and avoids error from discretizing firm heterogeneity. Quantitatively, whether production locations are complements or substitutes determines whether welfare gains from multinational production concentrate in the most productive countries or accrue more broadly.
10.1257/aer.20231486.abstract_zh: 一般而言，从N个选项中寻找最优组合需要评估全部2^N种可能性。我们提出了一种适用于互补品或替代品情形的方法，该方法利用这种结构在不进行评估的情况下剔除次优组合，并可推广至异质性主体环境。在跨国企业选择相互依赖的生产地点的校准一般均衡模型中，我们证明该方法比现有方法快数个数量级，且避免了因离散化企业异质性而产生的误差。从定量角度看，生产地点是互补品还是替代品，决定了跨国生产带来的福利收益是集中于最具生产力的国家，还是更广泛地惠及各国。
10.1257/aer.20231486.title: Combinatorial Discrete Choice: Theory and Application to Multinational Production
10.1257/aer.20231486.title_zh: 组合离散选择：理论与跨国生产中的应用

10.1257/aer.20231521.abstract: <jats:p>Preschool-aged children get sick frequently and spread disease to other family members. Despite the universality of this experience, there is limited causal evidence on the magnitudes and consequences of these externalities, especially for infant siblings with developing immune systems and brains. We show in Danish administrative data that during infancy, younger siblings have two to three times higher hospitalization rates for respiratory conditions than older siblings. We combine birth order and within-municipality variation in respiratory disease prevalence among young children, finding lasting differential impacts of early-life respiratory disease exposure on younger siblings' earnings, educational attainment, chronic respiratory health, and mental health-related outcomes. (JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20231521.abstract_zh: 学龄前儿童易患疾病，并会将疾病传播给其他家庭成员。尽管这一经历具有普遍性，但关于这些外部性的程度和后果的因果证据仍然有限，尤其是对于免疫系统和大脑正在发育的婴儿兄弟姐妹而言。我们利用丹麦行政数据发现，在婴儿期，弟弟妹妹因呼吸系统疾病的住院率是哥哥姐姐的两到三倍。我们结合出生顺序以及学龄前儿童呼吸系统疾病患病率的市内差异，发现早期呼吸系统疾病暴露对弟弟妹妹的收入、教育程度、慢性呼吸系统健康以及心理健康相关结果产生了持久的差异化影响。（JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31）
10.1257/aer.20231521.title: Germs in the Family: The Short- and Long-Term Consequences of Intrahousehold Disease Spread
10.1257/aer.20231521.title_zh: 家庭中的病菌：家庭内部疾病传播的短期与长期后果

10.1257/aer.20231613.abstract: <jats:p>Lack of market transparency can impair the liquidity provision of nonstandard liquidity suppliers and make liquidity demand increasing in illiquidity. This can yield strategic complementarities and induce multiple equilibria. Then an initial dearth of liquidity may degenerate into a liquidity rout (as in a “flash crash”), and traders faced with the largest cost of trading are those trading more intensely at equilibrium. An increase in order flow transparency and/or in the mass of dealers who are in the market at all times has a positive impact on total welfare. (JEL G12, G14, G41)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20231613.abstract_zh: 市场透明度不足会削弱非标准化流动性供应商的流动性供给能力，并导致流动性需求随非流动性程度上升而增加。这可能产生策略互补性并引发多重均衡。此时，初始流动性匮乏可能恶化为流动性崩溃（如"闪崩"现象），而均衡状态下交易最频繁的交易者反而面临最高的交易成本。提高订单流透明度和/或增加始终活跃于市场的交易商数量，将对总福利产生积极影响。（JEL分类号：G12, G14, G41）
10.1257/aer.20231613.title: Market Opacity and Fragility: Why Liquidity Evaporates When It Is Most Needed
10.1257/aer.20231613.title_zh: 市场不透明性与脆弱性：为何流动性在最需要时消失

10.1257/aer.20231696.abstract: We study how public sector workers balance their professional motivations with private economic concerns, focusing on police arrests. Arrests made near the end of an officer's shift typically require overtime work, and officers respond by reducing arrest frequency but increasing arrest quality. Days in which an officer works a second job after their police shift have higher opportunity cost, also reducing late-shift arrests. Combining our estimates in a dynamic model identifies officer preferences over workplace activity and overtime work. Our results indicate that officers' private costs of arrests have a first-order impact on the quantity and quality of enforcement.
10.1257/aer.20231696.abstract_zh: 我们研究公共部门工作人员如何在职业动机与个人经济考量之间取得平衡，重点关注警察逮捕行为。在警官轮班临近结束时进行的逮捕通常需要加班，而警官对此的应对方式是降低逮捕频率但提高逮捕质量。当警官在警察轮班后还需从事第二份工作的日子里，机会成本更高，这同样减少了轮班末段的逮捕数量。通过将我们的估计结果纳入动态模型，可以识别出警官对工作场所活动及加班工作的偏好。研究结果表明，警官的私人逮捕成本对执法的数量与质量具有首要影响。
10.1257/aer.20231696.title: Professional Motivations in the Public Sector: Evidence from Police Officers
10.1257/aer.20231696.title_zh: 公共部门的职业动机：来自警察的证据

10.1257/aer.20231699.title: Spatial Spillovers of Conflict in Somalia
10.1257/aer.20231699.title_zh: 索马里冲突的空间溢出效应

10.1257/aer.20240056.abstract: This paper studies how managers plan under uncertainty. In a new panel survey of German manufacturing firms, we observe both forecasts of sales growth and a quantitative measure of subjective uncertainty. We show that subjective uncertainty reflects change experienced by firms: it is high when growth is either unusually low or unusually high. Subjective uncertainty is more than conditional volatility: while more volatile firms are typically more uncertain, experienced change alone increases uncertainty, consistent with a model of learning. Uncertainty over our sample is mostly idiosyncratic but varies substantially over time and leads managers to plan lower employment and prices.
10.1257/aer.20240056.abstract_zh: 本文研究管理者如何在不确定性下进行规划。基于一项针对德国制造业企业的新面板调查，我们同时观测到销售增长预测与主观不确定性的量化指标。研究表明，主观不确定性反映了企业经历的变化：当增长率异常低或异常高时，不确定性均会上升。主观不确定性不仅体现为条件波动性：尽管波动性较高的企业通常面临更大不确定性，但仅凭经历的变化本身就会加剧不确定性，这与学习模型的理论预测一致。样本期间的不确定性主要呈现异质性特征，但随时间显著波动，并促使管理者制定更低的就业与价格计划。
10.1257/aer.20240056.title: Uncertainty and Change: Survey Evidence of Firms’ Subjective Beliefs
10.1257/aer.20240056.title_zh: 不确定性与变化：企业主观信念的调查证据

10.1257/aer.20240094.abstract: Natural gas has replaced coal as the dominant fuel for U.S. electricity generation. However, utilities in regulated U.S. states have retired coal more slowly than others. We build a structural model of rate-of-return regulation during an energy transition where utilities face tradeoffs between lowering costs and maintaining and using legacy capacity. A regulated utility facing carbon taxes lowers short-run coal generation 48% as much as a cost minimizer would. Thirty years after a sudden energy transition, a cost minimizer has retired 71% more coal capacity than the regulated utility. Alternative regulations may jeopardize affordability and reliability goals during energy transitions.
10.1257/aer.20240094.abstract_zh: 天然气已取代煤炭成为美国发电的主要燃料。然而，受监管的美国各州公用事业公司淘汰煤炭的速度慢于其他地区。我们构建了一个能源转型期间回报率监管的结构模型，其中公用事业公司在降低成本与维持及使用遗留产能之间面临权衡。面对碳税的受监管公用事业公司，其短期煤炭发电量降幅仅为成本最小化公司的48%。在突发能源转型30年后，成本最小化公司淘汰的煤炭产能比受监管公用事业公司多71%。替代性监管措施可能在能源转型期间危及可负担性与可靠性目标。
10.1257/aer.20240094.title: Energy Transitions in Regulated Markets
10.1257/aer.20240094.title_zh: 监管市场中的能源转型

10.1257/aer.20240179.abstract: We study residential segregation and access to public services across 1.5 million urban and rural neighborhoods in India. Muslim and Scheduled Caste segregation in India is high by global standards, and only slightly lower than Black-White segregation in the United States. Within cities, public facilities and infrastructure are systematically less available in Muslim and Scheduled Caste neighborhoods. Nearly all regressive allocation is across neighborhoods within cities—at the most informal and least studied form of government. These inequalities are not visible in the aggregate data typically used for research and policy.
10.1257/aer.20240179.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了印度150万个城乡社区中的居住隔离与公共服务获取情况。按全球标准衡量，印度穆斯林与表列种姓的居住隔离程度较高，仅略低于美国的黑白种族隔离。在城市内部，穆斯林与表列种姓社区的公共设施和基础设施系统性匮乏。几乎所有倒退性资源分配都发生在城市内部的社区之间——这属于最非正式且研究最少的政府层级。这些不平等现象在通常用于研究与政策制定的汇总数据中无法显现。
10.1257/aer.20240179.title: Residential Segregation and Unequal Access to Local Public Services in India: Evidence from 1.5 Million Neighborhoods
10.1257/aer.20240179.title_zh: 印度居住隔离与地方公共服务获取不平等：来自150万邻里的证据

10.1257/aer.20240393.abstract: We establish a link between labor scarcity and the adoption of labor-saving technology in industrializing England. During the Napoleonic Wars, more than 10 percent of the male population served in the armed forces. Where recruitment was heavy, more machines economizing on labor were adopted. Naval recruitment, instrumented by warships’ coastal access, provides exogenous variation in labor scarcity and suggests that the link between labor shortages and adoption is causal. Where mechanical skills were abundant, the impact of labor scarcity on adoption appears to be larger.
10.1257/aer.20240393.abstract_zh: 我们建立了劳动力稀缺性与工业化英格兰采用节省劳动力技术之间的联系。在拿破仑战争期间，超过10%的男性人口在武装部队服役。在征兵力度较大的地区，更多节省劳动力的机器被采用。以军舰沿海通道为工具变量的海军征兵，提供了劳动力稀缺性的外生变化，表明劳动力短缺与采用之间存在因果关系。在机械技能丰富的地区，劳动力稀缺性对技术采用的影响似乎更大。
10.1257/aer.20240393.title: Fighting for Growth: Labor Scarcity and Technological Progress During the British Industrial Revolution
10.1257/aer.20240393.title_zh: 为增长而战：英国工业革命时期的劳动力稀缺与技术进步

10.1257/aer.20240404.abstract: We study the effects of the largest corporate income tax cut in U.S. history on firms and workers. To identify causal effects, we use employer-employee matched tax records and event studies comparing similarly sized firms in the same industry that faced divergent tax changes due to their pre-existing legal status. Tax cuts cause increases in firms’ investment, sales, profits, employment, and payrolls, with earnings gains concentrated among highly paid workers. In the short-run, 87% of private income gains flow to the top 10% of the income distribution.
10.1257/aer.20240404.abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国历史上最大规模的企业所得税削减对企业和工人的影响。为识别因果效应，我们使用了雇主-雇员匹配的税务记录，并通过事件研究法比较同一行业中规模相近但因既有法律地位不同而面临不同税收变化的企业。减税导致企业投资、销售额、利润、就业和工资总额增加，但收入增长主要集中在高薪工人群体。短期内，私人收入增长的87%流向了收入分布前10%的人群。
10.1257/aer.20240404.title: Corporate Tax Cuts, Firm Growth, and Workers’ Earnings
10.1257/aer.20240404.title_zh: 企业减税、企业增长与工人收入

10.1257/aer.20240497.abstract: We document the effects of a comprehensive set of mergers of US consumer packaged goods manufacturers on prices, quantities, and product assortment. Across specifications, we find a small average price effect of mergers (-0.5% to 1.1%) but substantial heterogeneity in effects, with a standard deviation between 3.9–7.6 pp. Through a model of enforcement, we find that agencies act as if they challenge mergers they expect would increase prices more than 4.8–6.3%. Increases in stringency would reduce prices and the prevalence of completed price-increasing mergers, with minimal impacts on blocked price-decreasing mergers, at a significantly greater agency burden.
10.1257/aer.20240497.abstract_zh: 本文记录了一组美国消费品制造商全面并购对价格、数量及产品组合的影响。在多种实证设定下，我们发现并购的平均价格效应较小（-0.5%至1.1%），但效应存在显著异质性，标准差介于3.9至7.6个百分点之间。通过执法模型分析，我们发现监管机构的行为模式表明，它们倾向于挑战预期价格涨幅超过4.8%至6.3%的并购。提高执法严格程度将降低价格水平及已完成的价格上涨型并购的普遍性，同时对被阻止的价格下降型并购影响甚微，但会显著增加监管机构的负担。
10.1257/aer.20240497.title: Merger Effects and Antitrust Enforcement: Evidence from US Consumer Packaged Goods
10.1257/aer.20240497.title_zh: 并购效应与反垄断执法：来自美国包装消费品行业的证据

10.1257/aer.20240576.abstract: A designer employs a dynamic protocol to elicit private information. Protocols produce a set of contextual privacy violations— information learned that may be superfluous given the context. A protocol is maximally contextually private if there is no protocol that produces a proper subset of the violations it produces, while implementing the choice rule. Contextual privacy violations arise when a choice rule makes some agents collectively, but not individually, pivotal. In auctions, designing for contextual privacy requires choosing an initial question posed to each agent and the order for querying agents. Ascending-join protocols are maximally contextually private for k-item Vickrey auctions.
10.1257/aer.20240576.abstract_zh: 设计者采用动态协议来获取私人信息。协议会产生一系列情境性隐私侵犯——即在特定情境下可能属于多余的信息被获知。若不存在其他协议能在实现选择规则的同时，产生该协议所引发侵犯行为的真子集，则该协议具有最大情境隐私性。当选择规则使某些代理人集体成为关键角色（而非个体关键角色）时，便会产生情境性隐私侵犯。在拍卖中，实现情境隐私性设计需要确定向每位代理人提出的初始问题及询问代理人的顺序。对于k物品维克里拍卖而言，升序接入协议具有最大情境隐私性。
10.1257/aer.20240576.title: Contextually Private Mechanisms

10.1257/aer.20240617.abstract: We study the problem of designing a dynamic reassignment mechanism when agents’ preferences over objects change over time. In the context of Norway’s system for (re)assigning patients to general practitioners (GPs), we provide direct evidence of misallocation under the current mechanism—patients waiting for each others’ GPs, but who cannot trade—and estimate a structural model of GP switching behavior to evaluate alternatives. Introducing Top Trading Cycles (TTC) would, on average, reduce waiting times and increase patient welfare. However, patients endowed with less desirable GPs would be harmed. Prioritizing these patients can avoid these harms while preserving most of the gains from TTC.
10.1257/aer.20240617.abstract_zh: 本文研究当主体对对象的偏好随时间变化时，如何设计动态再分配机制。以挪威全科医生（GP）患者（重新）分配系统为背景，我们提供了当前机制下资源错配的直接证据——患者相互等待对方的全科医生却无法进行交换——并估计了全科医生转换行为的结构模型以评估替代方案。引入顶级交易循环（TTC）机制平均而言将缩短等待时间并提高患者福利。然而，被分配到较不理想全科医生的患者将受到损害。优先考虑这些患者可以避免此类损害，同时保留TTC机制的大部分收益。
10.1257/aer.20240617.title: Designing Dynamic Reassignment Mechanisms: Evidence from GP Allocation
10.1257/aer.20240617.title_zh: 设计动态再分配机制：来自全科医生分配的实证证据

10.1257/aer.20240642.abstract: <jats:p>We show that in heterogeneous agent New Keynesian (HANK) economies with countercyclical risk, the natural interest rate is endogenous and co-moves with output, leaving the economy susceptible to self-fulfilling fluctuations. Unlike in representative agent New Keynesian models, the Taylor principle is not sufficient to guarantee uniqueness of equilibrium in HANK if risk is even mildly countercyclical: Multiple bounded equilibria exist, no matter how strongly monetary policy responds to changes in inflation. For an active monetary policy to eliminate self-fulfilling fluctuations, it must stabilize the endogenous natural rate fluctuations. Alternatively, a passive monetary and active fiscal regime can also eliminate equilibrium multiplicity. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20240642.abstract_zh: 我们证明，在具有逆周期风险的异质性代理人新凯恩斯（HANK）经济体中，自然利率是内生的，并与产出共同变动，从而使经济容易受到自我实现的波动影响。与代表性代理人新凯恩斯模型不同，如果风险即使只是轻微逆周期，泰勒原理不足以保证HANK中均衡的唯一性：无论货币政策对通胀变化的反应有多强烈，都存在多个有界均衡。要使积极的货币政策消除自我实现的波动，必须稳定内生的自然利率波动。或者，被动的货币政策和积极的财政政策体制也能消除均衡的多重性。（JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62）
10.1257/aer.20240642.title: Self-Fulfilling Fluctuations in HANK Economies
10.1257/aer.20240642.title_zh: HANK经济中的自我实现波动

10.1257/aer.20240651.abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model of the attention economy featuring two interlinked markets: a product market, where consumers have limited awareness of firms, and an attention market, where platforms attract attention by investing in free services (e.g., social media, streaming, podcasts) and sell targeted ads using data on consumer preferences. The model provides a tractable framework in which platform investment, ad-driven discovery, product demand, and ad revenue are jointly determined. The effects of data and interoperability policies can reverse over time, platform quality may be inefficiently high or low, and the rise of data-rich digital advertising can coincide with a declining ad revenue-to-GDP ratio.
10.1257/aer.20240651.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个注意力经济的动态模型，该模型包含两个相互关联的市场：产品市场（消费者对企业的认知有限）和注意力市场（平台通过投资免费服务（如社交媒体、流媒体、播客）吸引注意力，并利用消费者偏好数据销售定向广告）。该模型提供了一个易于处理的框架，其中平台投资、广告驱动的发现、产品需求和广告收入是共同决定的。数据与互操作性政策的效果可能随时间逆转，平台质量可能处于低效的高或低水平，而数据丰富的数字广告的兴起可能与广告收入占GDP比重的下降同时发生。
10.1257/aer.20240651.title: A Model of the Attention Economy: Data, Platforms, and Discovery
10.1257/aer.20240651.title_zh: 注意力经济模型：数据、平台与发现

10.1257/aer.20240664.abstract: Efficient risk-sharing implies a simple factor structure for marginal utilities of expenditure (MUEs): Pareto weights divided by a common price. The standard approach infers MUEs from total expenditures, implicitly assuming homothetic preferences, unitary income elasticities, and identical price elasticities. Risk-sharing tests using total expenditures work for idiosyncratic shocks (budgets change, but not prices), but not “covariate” shocks (prices change). We describe all preferences which permit one to infer MUEs from expenditures, and estimate nonhomothetic MUEs to test whether covariate shocks are shared efficiently in Uganda. This delivers sensible results; the standard approach suggests that droughts, floods, and pests are beneficial.
10.1257/aer.20240664.abstract_zh: 有效风险分担意味着支出边际效用（MUEs）存在一个简单的因子结构：帕累托权重除以共同价格。标准方法通过总支出推断MUEs，隐含假设了同质性偏好、单位收入弹性以及相同的价格弹性。基于总支出的风险分担检验适用于异质性冲击（预算变化，但价格不变），但不适用于“协变量”冲击（价格变化）。我们描述了所有允许从支出推断MUEs的偏好类型，并估计了非同质性MUEs，以检验乌干达的协变量冲击是否得到有效分担。这一方法得出了合理的结果；而标准方法则暗示干旱、洪水和虫害是有益的。
10.1257/aer.20240664.title: Risk Sharing Tests and Covariate Shocks: Drought, Floods, and Pests in Uganda
10.1257/aer.20240664.title_zh: 风险分担检验与协变量冲击：乌干达的干旱、洪涝与虫害

10.1257/aer.20240666.abstract: Durables represent a large share of households’ marginal propensity to spend (MPX). We develop a quantitative model of spending that takes durables into account and matches a rich set of empirical regularities simultaneously. Scaling the response of non-durables provides a poor approximation of the MPX on durables when it comes to its distribution in the population, its persistence over time, and its cyclicality. As an application, we study how the MPX varies with the size of stimulus checks and find that it declines more slowly compared to a model of purely non-durable spending.
10.1257/aer.20240666.abstract_zh: 耐用品在家庭边际消费倾向（MPX）中占据较大份额。我们构建了一个考虑耐用品的定量支出模型，该模型同时匹配了丰富的经验规律。在人口分布、时间持续性及周期性方面，仅通过非耐用品反应的缩放来近似耐用品的MPX效果不佳。作为应用，我们研究了MPX如何随刺激支票金额变化，发现其下降速度比纯非耐用品支出模型更慢。
10.1257/aer.20240666.title: Durables and the Marginal Propensity to Spend
10.1257/aer.20240666.title_zh: 耐用品与边际消费倾向

10.1257/aer.20240673.abstract: <jats:p>The implementation of evidence-based policies hinges on the dissemination of evidence to policymakers, a process influenced by the attributes of the sender. We conducted a nationwide RCT with ideologically opposite think tanks, major newspapers, and a research institution with nonsalient ideology to communicate a nonideological, cost-effective policy to local policymakers. Results show a 65 percent increase in policy adoption when informing institutions align ideologically with policymakers. We compare the impact of think tanks versus media outlets on implementation, finding both equally effective when ideologically aligned. We explore three actions where ideology may influence adoption: information exposure, belief updating and implementation. (JEL C93, D72, D78, D83, I23)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20240673.abstract_zh: 循证政策的实施依赖于将证据传递给政策制定者，这一过程受到信息发送方特征的影响。我们开展了一项全国性随机对照试验，由意识形态对立的智库、主流报纸以及一家意识形态不显著的研究机构，向地方政策制定者传达一项非意识形态、具有成本效益的政策。结果显示，当信息传递机构与政策制定者的意识形态一致时，政策采纳率提高了65%。我们比较了智库与媒体机构对政策实施的影响，发现两者在意识形态一致时效果相当。我们探讨了意识形态可能影响政策采纳的三个环节：信息暴露、信念更新与实施。（JEL C93, D72, D78, D83, I23）
10.1257/aer.20240673.title: Ideological Alignment and Evidence-Based Policy Adoption
10.1257/aer.20240673.title_zh: 意识形态一致性对循证政策采纳的影响

10.1257/aer.20240701.abstract: We document how deepening resource scarcity results in rationing on the basis of race in a highstakes setting: health care. Using detailed, time-stamped data on 107,000 inpatient admissions to a large health system, we find that in-hospital mortality increases for Black, but not White, patients as hospitals reach capacity. These findings are not explained by differential patient selection. We identify rationing by wait times as a mechanism, documenting that sicker Black patients wait longer for care than healthier White patients at almost all capacity levels. Text analysis of unstructured clinical notes reveals rationing of provider effort as another mechanism.
10.1257/aer.20240701.abstract_zh: 我们记录了资源稀缺加剧如何在高风险场景——医疗保健中——导致基于种族的配给。利用涵盖某大型医疗系统107,000例住院患者的详细时间戳数据，我们发现当医院达到容量上限时，黑人患者的院内死亡率上升，而白人患者则未出现此现象。这些发现无法通过患者选择的差异来解释。我们识别出等待时间配给机制，并记录到在几乎所有容量水平下，病情更重的黑人患者比病情较轻的白人患者等待更长时间。对非结构化临床记录的文本分析揭示了医护人员努力程度的配给是另一机制。
10.1257/aer.20240701.title: Rationing by Race

10.1257/aer.20240712.abstract: The random utility model (RUM), a cornerstone in economics, is typically studied under the assumption that choice frequencies of all alternatives are observable. In practice, however, some alternatives have unobservable choice frequencies and are commonly aggregated into a single category called an outside option. We study RUM in such environments and derive a finite, nonredundant system of inequality constraints on observed choice frequencies that characterizes RU-rationalizability. We show that the conventional practice of aggregating unobserved alternatives can miss key information leading to incorrect conclusions such as that observed choices are rationalizable, even when no RUM is consistent with them.
10.1257/aer.20240712.abstract_zh: 随机效用模型（RUM）作为经济学的重要基石，通常在假设所有备选方案的选择频率均可观测的条件下进行研究。然而在实践中，部分备选方案的选择频率无法观测，通常被合并为单一类别，即外部选项。我们在此类环境下研究RUM，推导出关于可观测选择频率的有限且无冗余的不等式约束系统，该系统刻画了RU可理性化的特征。研究表明，将不可观测备选方案进行合并的传统做法可能遗漏关键信息，导致即使不存在任何RUM与观测数据一致时，仍会得出观测选择具有可理性化的错误结论。
10.1257/aer.20240712.title: Random Utility with Unobservable Alternatives
10.1257/aer.20240712.title_zh: 不可观测选项下的随机效用

10.1257/aer.20240756.abstract: Digital platforms reduce geographic frictions, enabling better matching between service providers and users. I quantify reallocation gains in Swedish online healthcare, using nationwide time-conditional random assignment between patients and physicians. Matching high-risk patients with doctors effective at reducing Emergency Room visits lowers such visits by 4.4% (s.e. 1.3); reallocations also reduce counter-guideline antibiotics by 3.1% (1.4). I find limited trade-offs in matching: horizontal differentiation among doctors and varied patient needs allow improvement in multiple outcomes simultaneously. Efficiency-enhancing reallocations also affect equity. The findings highlight the potential for care reorganization aligning provider heterogeneity with patient needs when geographic constraints are lifted.
10.1257/aer.20240756.abstract_zh: 数字平台降低了地理摩擦，使服务提供者与用户之间的匹配更加高效。本文利用瑞典在线医疗中全国范围内基于时间的条件随机分配机制，量化了患者与医生重新匹配带来的收益。将高风险患者与能有效降低急诊就诊次数的医生匹配后，急诊就诊次数减少了4.4%（标准误1.3）；此类重新匹配还使违反指南的抗生素使用减少了3.1%（标准误1.4）。研究发现匹配中的权衡有限：医生间的横向差异化与患者需求的多样性使得多项指标可同时改善。提升效率的重新匹配也会影响公平性。研究结果凸显了在地理约束消除后，根据患者需求调整医疗服务提供者异质性的组织重组潜力。
10.1257/aer.20240756.title: Defying Distance? The Provision of Medical Services in the Digital Age
10.1257/aer.20240756.title_zh: 超越距离？数字时代的医疗服务供给

10.1257/aer.20240766.abstract: This paper studies how collective bargaining affects wages and amenities. By merging collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) to linked employer-employee data in Brazil, I combine rich contracted amenities with wage information. I implement a difference-in-difference strategy that exploits a court ruling enforcing CBA continuation (i.e., ultractivity) to estimate the effects of union bargaining power. Strengthening unions raises wages and amenities without reducing employment—increasing retention despite some labor-labor substitution. A revealed preference approach shows that amenities account for 45% of total compensation gains. These findings suggest that collective bargaining can offset monopsony power, but employers retain the right-tomanage workforce composition.
10.1257/aer.20240766.abstract_zh: 本文研究集体谈判如何影响工资与福利。通过将集体谈判协议与巴西雇主-雇员关联数据匹配，我整合了丰富的合同约定福利与工资信息。采用双重差分策略，利用法院关于强制延续集体谈判协议（即超期效力）的裁决，估计工会谈判力量的影响。强化工会力量在未减少就业的情况下提高了工资与福利——尽管存在部分劳动力替代效应，但员工留存率有所提升。基于显示性偏好方法的研究表明，福利占薪酬总增长的45%。这些发现表明，集体谈判可抵消买方垄断势力，但雇主仍保留管理劳动力构成的权利。
10.1257/aer.20240766.title: Union Bargaining Power and the Amenity-Wage Tradeoff
10.1257/aer.20240766.title_zh: 工会谈判力与舒适性-工资权衡

10.1257/aer.20241001.abstract: We provide experimental evidence on the intergenerational impacts of secondary education subsidies in a low-income context, leveraging a randomized controlled trial and 15-year longitudinal follow-up. Secondary school scholarships delay fertility, reduce unwanted pregnancies and change partner selection. Under-one mortality is reduced by half. We also document cognitive development gains of 0.24 standard deviations of test scores by age 5 among children of female scholarship recipients. Means-tested secondary school scholarships are a high return investment, with a conservatively estimated $4.1 in benefits for each $1 the policy would cost the government in the long-run.
10.1257/aer.20241001.abstract_zh: 我们基于随机对照试验和15年纵向追踪数据，提供了低收入环境下中等教育补贴代际影响的实验证据。中学奖学金推迟了生育年龄，减少了意外怀孕并改变了伴侣选择。一岁以下儿童死亡率降低了一半。我们还发现，女性奖学金获得者子女在5岁时的认知发展测试得分提高了0.24个标准差。经经济状况调查的中学奖学金是一项高回报投资，保守估计每1美元政策长期成本可为政府带来4.1美元收益。
10.1257/aer.20241001.title: Intergenerational Impacts of Secondary Education: Experimental Evidence from Ghana
10.1257/aer.20241001.title_zh: 中等教育的代际影响：来自加纳的实验证据

10.1257/aer.20241007.abstract: This paper studies the productivity of nurse practitioners (NPs) and physicians, two professions performing overlapping tasks but with starkly different backgrounds, training, and pay. Using quasi-experimental variation in patient assignment to NPs versus physicians in Veterans Health Administration emergency departments, we find that, on average, NPs use more resources and exhibit a higher 30-day preventable hospitalization rate than physicians. However, the NP-physician performance difference varies by case complexity and severity. Importantly, even larger productivity variation exists within each profession, leading to substantial overlap between the productivity distributions of the two professions; NPs outperform physicians in 38 percent of random pairs.
10.1257/aer.20241007.abstract_zh: 本文研究了执业护士与医生这两类职业的生产力差异。二者虽承担重叠性工作任务，但背景、培训经历及薪酬水平存在显著差异。利用退伍军人健康管理局急诊科患者随机分配至执业护士或医生的准实验变异，我们发现：平均而言，执业护士消耗更多医疗资源，且30天内可预防住院率高于医生。然而，执业护士与医生的绩效差异随病例复杂程度和严重程度而变化。值得注意的是，两类职业内部的生产力差异更为显著，导致二者生产力分布存在大量重叠——在38%的随机配对中，执业护士的表现优于医生。
10.1257/aer.20241007.title: The Productivity of Professions: Evidence from the Emergency Department
10.1257/aer.20241007.title_zh: 职业的生产力：来自急诊科的证据

10.1257/aer.20241087.abstract: An increasing number of decisions are guided by machine learning algorithms. But when consequential decisions are encoded in algorithms, individuals may strategically alter their behavior to achieve desired outcomes. This paper develops an empirical approach that adjusts decision algorithms to anticipate manipulation. By explicitly modeling incentives to manipulate, our approach produces decision rules that are stable under manipulation, even when the rules are fully transparent. We stress test this approach through a large field experiment in Kenya. When implemented, linear strategy-robust decision rules outperform standard linear models such as LASSO.
10.1257/aer.20241087.abstract_zh: 越来越多的决策由机器学习算法指导。然而，当具有重大影响的决策被编码为算法时，个体可能会策略性地改变自身行为以达成预期结果。本文开发了一种实证方法，通过调整决策算法来预判操纵行为。通过明确建模操纵动机，我们的方法能够产生即使在完全透明规则下也能在操纵中保持稳定的决策规则。我们通过在肯尼亚开展的大规模实地实验对该方法进行了压力测试。实施结果表明，线性策略稳健决策规则的表现优于LASSO等标准线性模型。
10.1257/aer.20241087.title: Manipulation-Robust Prediction

10.1257/aer.20241404.abstract: We study cultural integration as an equilibrium outcome of marital matching along cultural and education lines and intra-household investment decisions regarding fertility and cultural socialization. Our model allows us to identify cultural-ethnic group specific investment parameters and spousal preferences for marital matching.
