Structural estimates reveal a strong demand to preserve cultural identity on the part of immigrants and limited acceptance of the immigrants’ cultural diversity on the part of natives. Furthermore, these estimates reveal a substantial heterogeneity of the parental value of children’s education across cultures. Nonetheless, our estimates simulate substantial - though heterogeneous- cultural integration rates across immigrant groups.
10.1257/aer.20241404.abstract_zh: 我们将文化融合视为婚姻匹配在文化与教育维度上的均衡结果，以及家庭内部关于生育与文化社会化的投资决策。我们的模型能够识别特定文化族群的投资参数及配偶对婚姻匹配的偏好。结构估计显示，移民群体对保持文化身份具有强烈诉求，而本土居民对移民文化多样性的接纳程度有限。此外，这些估计揭示了不同文化背景下父母对子女教育价值的显著异质性。尽管如此，我们的模拟结果表明，各移民群体间存在显著但具有异质性的文化融合率。
10.1257/aer.20241404.title: Marriage, Fertility, and Cultural Integration in Italy
10.1257/aer.20241404.title_zh: 意大利的婚姻、生育与文化融合

10.1257/aer.20241561.abstract: How do majority groups respond to narrowing inequality in racially polarized environments? We study this by examining the Freedmen’s Bureau, an agency created after the US Civil War to aid former slaves and launch institutional reform in the South. Using new historical records and an event-study approach, we estimate the Bureau’s impact on political, social, and economic outcomes. Vote shares for Democrats, the party that previously championed slavery and opposed Black civil rights, initially eroded in Bureau counties, but these impacts faded as federal oversight weakened. Racial backlash emerged rapidly and persisted, suggesting White majorities sought to offset Black progress.
10.1257/aer.20241561.abstract_zh: 在种族极化环境中，多数群体如何应对日益缩小的不平等？我们通过研究美国内战后为援助前奴隶并在南方推行制度改革而设立的“自由民局”来探讨这一问题。利用新历史记录和事件研究方法，我们估算了该局对政治、社会和经济结果的影响。在自由民局覆盖的县，民主党（此前支持奴隶制并反对黑人公民权利的政党）的得票率最初有所下降，但随着联邦监督的减弱，这些影响逐渐消失。种族反弹迅速出现并持续存在，表明白人多数群体试图抵消黑人的进步。
10.1257/aer.20241561.title: Inequality and Racial Backlash: Evidence from the Reconstruction Era and the Freedmen’s Bureau
10.1257/aer.20241561.title_zh: 不平等与种族反弹：来自重建时期与自由民局的证据

10.1257/aer.20241596.abstract: Using administrative data from Scandinavian countries, we provide evidence on international migration responses to wealth taxes and evaluate their aggregate economic implications. We find significant migration responses among the wealthy: a 1pp increase in the top wealth tax rate decreases the stock of wealthy taxpayers by about 2%. A large fraction of the wealthy are business owners, and their businesses are negatively affected by owner out-migration. The aggregate effects are nevertheless modest: the migration responses to a 1pp increase in the top wealth tax rate reduce employment by 0.02%, investments by 0.07%, and value-added by 0.10%.
10.1257/aer.20241596.abstract_zh: 利用斯堪的纳维亚国家的行政数据，我们提供了关于国际移民对财富税反应的证据，并评估了其总体经济影响。我们发现富裕群体存在显著的移民反应：最高财富税率每提高1个百分点，富裕纳税人存量约减少2%。大部分富裕群体为企业主，其企业因所有者外迁而受到负面影响。然而，总体效应较为温和：最高财富税率每提高1个百分点所引发的移民反应，导致就业减少0.02%，投资减少0.07%，增加值减少0.10%。
10.1257/aer.20241596.title: Taxing Top Wealth: Migration Responses and their Aggregate Economic Implications
10.1257/aer.20241596.title_zh: 对顶层财富征税：迁移反应及其总体经济影响

10.1257/aer.20241765.abstract: We study the relationship between corporate income taxation and carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions in the U.S. We show that CO2-intensive firms benefit more from the tax advantage of debt, and pay lower income taxes on their capital income. Building on these new facts, we provide evidence that a cut in the corporate income tax rate leads to a larger expansion of clean firms. We develop a multi-sector general equilibrium model that accounts for our evidence and quantify the impact of corporate tax reforms on aggregate emissions. A policy that eliminates the tax advantage of debt could reduce aggregate emissions without affecting GDP.
10.1257/aer.20241765.abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国企业所得税与二氧化碳排放之间的关系。研究表明，二氧化碳密集型企业在债务税收优惠中获益更多，且其资本收入缴纳的所得税更低。基于这些新发现，我们提供了证据表明企业所得税税率下调会促使清洁企业实现更大规模的扩张。我们构建了一个多部门一般均衡模型来解释这一现象，并量化了企业税制改革对总排放量的影响。一项消除债务税收优惠的政策可在不影响GDP的情况下减少总排放量。
10.1257/aer.20241765.title: The Environmental Bias of Corporate Income Taxation
10.1257/aer.20241765.title_zh: 企业所得税的环境偏向

10.1257/aer.20241925.abstract: <jats:p>This paper studies the implications of central bank credibility for long-run inflation and inflation dynamics. We introduce central bank lack of commitment into a standard nonlinear New Keynesian economy with sticky-price monopolistically competitive firms. Inflation is driven by the interaction of lack of commitment and the economic environment. We show that long-run inflation increases following an unanticipated permanent increase in the labor wedge or decrease in the elasticity of substitution across varieties. In the transition, inflation overshoots and then gradually declines. Quantitatively, inflation overshooting is persistent, and the welfare loss from lack of commitment relative to inflation targeting is large. (JEL D43, E12, E23, E24, E31, E52, E58)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20241925.abstract_zh: 本文研究了央行可信度对长期通胀及通胀动态的影响。我们将央行缺乏承诺引入一个具有粘性价格垄断竞争企业的标准非线性新凯恩斯经济体中。通胀由缺乏承诺与经济环境之间的相互作用驱动。研究表明，当劳动楔子出现未预期的永久性上升或品种间替代弹性下降时，长期通胀将上升。在过渡期内，通胀先过度上升，随后逐渐回落。从量化角度看，通胀过度上升具有持续性，且相较于通胀目标制，缺乏承诺导致的福利损失较大。（JEL D43, E12, E23, E24, E31, E52, E58）
10.1257/aer.20241925.title: Monetary Policy without Commitment

10.1257/aer.20250064.abstract: <jats:p>What is the optimal response of a resource exporter when a price cap is imposed on its main export? This paper develops a dynamic framework incorporating stochastic prices, financial frictions, and market power to study this novel tool of statecraft. With the right design, a price cap can incentivize increased extraction, stabilizing prices in the global market. But the stabilizing effects diminish when there is leakage outside the cap. Consequently, weak enforcement of the policy worsens the trade-off faced by the sanctioning policymaker. We provide a systematic approach to setting and enforcing an optimal cap level in these circumstances. (JEL F12, F14, F51, L71, P28, P33, Q35)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20250064.abstract_zh: 当资源出口国的主要出口产品被施加价格上限时，其最优应对策略是什么？本文构建了一个包含随机价格、金融摩擦和市场势力的动态框架，以研究这一新型国家治理工具。若设计得当，价格上限可激励增加开采量，从而稳定全球市场价格。但当存在上限之外的泄漏时，这种稳定效应会减弱。因此，制裁政策制定者面临的政策执行不力将加剧其权衡困境。我们为在此类情形下设定并执行最优上限水平提供了系统性方法。（JEL分类号：F12, F14, F51, L71, P28, P33, Q35）
10.1257/aer.20250064.title: A Theory of Price Caps on Nonrenewable Resources
10.1257/aer.20250064.title_zh: 非可再生资源价格上限理论

10.1257/aer.20250115.abstract: Americans rarely marry outside their race or class group, a pattern with well-documented implications for inequality and intergenerational mobility. Limited exposure may partly explain these low intergroup marriage rates. We instrument for exposure using variation in childhood neighborhoods based on whether other race and class groups had more opposite-sex children of similar age. Exposure increases interclass (high- and low-parent-income) marriage but has no detectable effect on interracial (White and Black) marriage. A spatial marriage model predicts that residential segregation—one of many forms of exposure—accounts for more than one third of marital sorting by class but less than 5 percent by race.
10.1257/aer.20250115.abstract_zh: 美国人很少跨种族或跨阶层通婚，这一模式对不平等和代际流动性具有充分论证的影响。有限的接触机会可能部分解释了这些低群体间通婚率。我们利用童年居住社区的差异——基于其他种族和阶层群体中是否有更多同龄异性儿童——作为接触机会的工具变量。接触机会增加了跨阶层（高收入与低收入父母家庭）通婚，但对跨种族（白人与黑人）通婚未产生可检测的影响。空间婚姻模型预测，居住隔离（接触机会的多种形式之一）解释了超过三分之一的阶层婚姻匹配，但仅解释了不到5%的种族婚姻匹配。
10.1257/aer.20250115.title: Who Marries Whom? The Role of Segregation by Race and Class
10.1257/aer.20250115.title_zh: 谁与谁结婚？种族与阶级隔离的作用

10.1257/aer.20250166.abstract: <jats:p>We study the welfare impacts of 96 climate-related tax and spending policies. We extend and apply the marginal value of public funds (MVPF) framework, most notably providing a new method for incorporating learning-by-doing spillovers. We find subsidies for the production of clean energy (such as wind production tax credits) have higher MVPFs than all other subsidies in our sample, including EV subsidies. Conservation nudges have large MVPFs when targeting regions with dirty grids. Fuel taxes and cap-and-trade policies are highly efficient means of raising revenue. We also construct traditional cost-per-ton estimates and compare and contrast the lessons they provide. (JEL D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58)</jats:p>
10.1257/aer.20250166.abstract_zh: 我们研究了96项与气候相关的税收和支出政策的福利影响。我们对公共资金边际价值（MVPF）框架进行了扩展和应用，尤其提出了一种纳入干中学溢出效应的新方法。研究发现，清洁能源生产补贴（如风电生产税收抵免）的MVPF高于样本中所有其他补贴，包括电动汽车补贴。针对高污染电网地区实施的节能引导政策具有较高的MVPF。燃油税和总量控制与交易政策是高效的财政收入筹集手段。我们还构建了传统的每吨成本估算，并比较了这些估算所提供的政策启示。（JEL D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58）
10.1257/aer.20250166.title: A Welfare Analysis of Policies Impacting Climate Change
10.1257/aer.20250166.title_zh: 气候变化政策的福利分析

10.1257/aer.20250206.title: Screening and Segmenting: A Consumer Surplus Perspective
10.1257/aer.20250206.title_zh: 筛选与细分：消费者剩余视角

10.1257/aer.20250295.abstract: Mechanisms that aim to reduce environmental degradation at low cost can be undermined when participants’ conservation actions are not marginal to the incentive — or “additional” — as the lowest-cost participants may not be the highest social value. We investigate this challenge in the Conservation Reserve Program’s auction mechanism for ecosystem services, linking bids to satellite-derived land use. Three-quarters of marginal auction winners are not additional. The heterogeneity in counterfactual land use introduces adverse selection. We develop a model of bidding and additionality to quantify welfare implications. Alternative auctions increase efficiency by using scoring rules that incorporate expected land use impacts.
10.1257/aer.20250295.abstract_zh: 旨在以低成本减少环境退化的机制，当参与者的保护行为并非激励的边际效应——即“额外性”——时，可能会被削弱，因为成本最低的参与者可能并非社会价值最高的。我们在保护储备计划的生态系统服务拍卖机制中研究这一挑战，将投标与卫星衍生的土地利用联系起来。四分之三的边际拍卖获胜者不具备额外性。反事实土地利用的异质性引入了逆向选择。我们构建了一个投标与额外性模型，以量化福利影响。替代性拍卖通过采用纳入预期土地利用影响的评分规则来提高效率。
10.1257/aer.20250295.title: Additionality and Asymmetric Information in Environmental Markets: Evidence from Conservation Auctions
10.1257/aer.20250295.title_zh: 环境市场中的额外性与信息不对称：来自保护拍卖的证据

10.1257/aer.20250305.abstract: We study the role of victim reporting in the production of public safety. We examine the Secure Communities program, a crime-reduction policy that involved police in detecting unauthorized immigrants and increased deportation fears in immigrant communities. We find that the policy reduced the likelihood that Hispanic victims report crimes to police and increased offending against Hispanics. The number of reported crimes is unchanged, masking these opposing effects. We show that reduced reporting drives the offending increase and provide the first elasticity of offending to victim reporting in the literature, calculating that a 10% decline in reporting increases offending by 7.9%.
10.1257/aer.20250305.abstract_zh: 本文研究了受害者报案在公共安全产出中的作用。我们考察了“安全社区”计划——一项涉及警方识别非法移民并加剧移民社区驱逐恐惧的犯罪防控政策。研究发现，该政策降低了西班牙裔受害者向警方报案的意愿，并导致针对西班牙裔的犯罪增加。报案犯罪总数未发生变化，掩盖了上述相反效应。我们证明报案减少是犯罪增加的原因，并在文献中首次提供了犯罪对受害者报案的弹性系数，计算得出报案率每下降10%，犯罪率上升7.9%。
10.1257/aer.20250305.title: Community Engagement and Public Safety: Evidence from Crime Enforcement Targeting Immigrants
10.1257/aer.20250305.title_zh: 社区参与与公共安全：针对移民的犯罪执法证据

10.1257/aeri.20240193.abstract: We develop a method for delineating prime locations—ultra-dense clusters of economic activity—within cities and apply it to comprehensive establishment data covering all US metropolitan areas. We further use big data to extend the analysis to a global context where administrative data are sparse. Many cities in the US and around the world are dominated by a small number of prime locations that can concentrate up to one-half of tradable services jobs on tiny shares of land and are dominant centers of economic gravity. In cities with fewer prime locations, a larger tradable services share concentrates in them.
10.1257/aeri.20240193.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在城市内部划定核心区位（即经济活动超密集集群）的方法，并将其应用于覆盖美国全部大都市区的综合性企业数据。进一步利用大数据将分析扩展至行政数据稀缺的全球范围。美国及全球众多城市的核心区位数量有限，这些区域能以极小比例的土地集中高达一半的可贸易服务业岗位，并成为主导性的经济引力中心。在核心区位较少的城市中，可贸易服务业岗位的集中度更高。
10.1257/aeri.20240193.title: Prime Locations

10.1257/aeri.20240285.abstract: We introduce a model in which a benevolent news outlet decides whether to report the realization of a state to a consumer, who pays a cost to receive it. A simple statistical rule, called a proper scoring rule, describes when the outlet should be more likely to report the realization. Using data from the US television news, we show that a particular scoring rule successfully predicts many salient features of news reporting. We show how to use this rule as a control variable to discipline tests of reporting bias, and we show that controlling for it matters in our applications.
10.1257/aeri.20240285.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中一家秉持善意的新闻机构决定是否向消费者报告某一状态的实现情况，而消费者需为此支付接收成本。一种被称为"恰当评分规则"的简单统计准则，描述了新闻机构在何种情况下更可能报告该实现结果。基于美国电视新闻数据，我们证明该特定评分规则能够成功预测新闻报道的诸多显著特征。我们展示了如何将该规则作为控制变量来约束报道偏误检验，并证实了在应用场景中控制该变量的重要性。
10.1257/aeri.20240285.title: What is Newsworthy? Theory and Evidence
10.1257/aeri.20240285.title_zh: 什么是值得报道的新闻？理论与证据

10.1257/aeri.20240391.title: Different Paths to College Success: The Impact of Massachusetts’s Charter Schools on College Trajectories
10.1257/aeri.20240391.title_zh: 通往大学成功的不同路径：马萨诸塞州特许学校对大学轨迹的影响

10.1257/aeri.20240436.abstract: This paper studies Markov perfect equilibria in a repeated duopoly model where sellers choose algorithms. An algorithm is a mapping from the competitor’s price to own price. Once set, the algorithms respond quickly. Customers arrive randomly and sellers can periodically revise their algorithms. The main results are that (i) for the simple two-price model with standard profit functions, monopoly pricing is the unique equilibrium outcome, and (ii) for any general finite price grid, all equilibrium outcomes feature supra-competitive pricing. Sustenance of such collusion seems outside the scope of current antitrust laws for it does not involve any direct communication.
10.1257/aeri.20240436.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个重复双寡头模型中的马尔可夫完美均衡，其中卖方选择算法。算法是从竞争对手价格到自身价格的映射。一旦设定，算法会快速响应。顾客随机到达，卖方可以定期修改其算法。主要结论是：（i）对于具有标准利润函数的简单两价格模型，垄断定价是唯一的均衡结果；（ii）对于任何一般有限价格网格，所有均衡结果均呈现超竞争定价。这种合谋的维持似乎超出了现行反垄断法的适用范围，因为它不涉及任何直接沟通。
10.1257/aeri.20240436.title: Pricing with Algorithms

10.1257/aeri.20240538.title: Work from Home and Disability Employment
10.1257/aeri.20240538.title_zh: 居家办公与残疾人就业

10.1257/aeri.20240634.title: Taxing the Wealth of the Poor:Evidence from the Danish Old-Age Support Asset Test
10.1257/aeri.20240634.title_zh: 对穷人财富征税：来自丹麦老年支持资产审查的证据

10.1257/aeri.20240649.abstract: As urban populations grow, more people face extreme heat, increasing demand for natural cooling. Urban trees offer various amenities, including cooling benefits, yet their economic value is hard to quantify. This paper estimates the implicit value of urban trees by exploiting the Emerald Ash Borer infestation caused by an invasive beetle that kills ash trees in Toronto as an exogenous shock. We find that a onepercentage- point increase in a postcode’s tree cover raises property prices by 1.13% and reduces exposure to extreme heat, pollution, and energy consumption. These findings underscore trees as a cost-effective, practical strategy for mitigating urban warming.
10.1257/aeri.20240649.abstract_zh: 随着城市人口的增长，越来越多的人面临极端高温，对自然降温的需求也随之增加。城市树木提供了多种便利，包括降温效益，但其经济价值难以量化。本文利用一种入侵性甲虫引发的翡翠灰螟虫害（该虫害导致多伦多的白蜡树死亡）作为外生冲击，估算了城市树木的隐性价值。研究发现，邮政编码区域的树木覆盖率每提高一个百分点，房产价格上升1.13%，同时减少极端高温暴露、污染和能源消耗。这些发现凸显了树木作为缓解城市变暖的经济有效且实用的策略。
10.1257/aeri.20240649.title: Cool Cities: The Value of Urban Trees
10.1257/aeri.20240649.title_zh: 凉爽城市：城市树木的价值

10.1257/aeri.20240698.title: An Evolutionary Perspective on Updating Risk and Ambiguity Preferences
10.1257/aeri.20240698.title_zh: 风险与模糊偏好更新的演化视角

10.1257/aeri.20240722.title: The Impact of Unions on the Wage Distribution: Evidence from Higher Education
10.1257/aeri.20240722.title_zh: 工会对工资分布的影响：来自高等教育的证据

10.1257/aeri.20250006.title: Survivors’ Mental Health and the Protective Role of Income Stability
10.1257/aeri.20250006.title_zh: 幸存者心理健康与收入稳定性的保护作用

10.1257/aeri.20250071.abstract: The movement of labor out of the agricultural sector is a central feature of the development process. A long-held belief is that successful development requires that much of the labor released from agriculture be allocated to manufacturing rather than services. Rodrik’s (2013) finding of unconditional convergence for manufacturing productivity using data from UNIDO provided empirical support for this view. We argue that the UNIDO data are ill–suited to study cross-country productivity dynamics. We use recently released data from the GGDC that was developed especially to study cross-country sectoral productivity dynamics to revisit this issue. We find no evidence of unconditional convergence in manufacturing productivity over the period 1990–2018.
10.1257/aeri.20250071.abstract_zh: 劳动力从农业部门转移是发展进程的核心特征。长期以来，人们普遍认为成功的发展需要将农业释放的大部分劳动力配置到制造业而非服务业。Rodrik（2013）基于联合国工业发展组织（UNIDO）数据发现的制造业生产率无条件趋同现象，为这一观点提供了实证支持。我们认为UNIDO数据并不适用于研究跨国生产率动态。本文采用GGDC最新发布的、专为研究跨国部门生产率动态而开发的数据集重新审视该问题。研究发现，1990-2018年期间不存在制造业生产率无条件趋同的证据。
10.1257/aeri.20250071.title: Unconditional Convergence in Manufacturing: A Reassessment
10.1257/aeri.20250071.title_zh: 制造业的无条件收敛：一个再评估

10.1257/aeri.20250149.abstract: Using data obtained from human resources consulting firms, we document the cost to large firms of hiring managers and business professionals in 146 countries worldwide. The average pay in the poorest decile of countries is $18,000 per year, which is 9.7 times GDP per worker. In contrast, in the richest decile of countries, large firms pay managers and business professionals only 0.8 times GDP per worker. We use an appropriate technology model to show that the cost of management could be an important deterrent to the expansion of the modern sector in developing countries.
10.1257/aeri.20250149.abstract_zh: 利用从人力资源咨询公司获取的数据，我们记录了全球146个国家大型企业招聘管理人员和商务专业人士的成本。在收入最低的十分位国家中，平均年薪为18,000美元，是人均GDP的9.7倍。相比之下，在收入最高的十分位国家中，大型企业支付给管理人员和商务专业人士的薪酬仅为人均GDP的0.8倍。我们采用适宜技术模型表明，管理成本可能是阻碍发展中国家现代部门扩张的重要因素。
10.1257/aeri.20250149.title: The Missing Middle Managers: Labor Costs, Firm Structure, and Development
10.1257/aeri.20250149.title_zh: 缺失的中层管理者：劳动力成本、企业结构与发展

10.1257/aeri.20250173.abstract: We show that the equilibrium loan-to-value (LTV) distribution in the US mortgage market has been remarkably stable over the last quarter century, both in aggregate and region-by-region, despite large, cross-sectionally heterogeneous house price cycles. While high-LTV mortgages changed from being explicitly government backed to privately securitized and back, their overall fraction re- mained unchanged. A repeat-sales methodology and an analysis of loan performance confirm that this stability in the distribution of LTVs holds even within subgroups of the population. These findings are inconsistent with models of credit cycles that use changes in collateral constraints to generate boom-bust dynamics in house prices.
10.1257/aeri.20250173.abstract_zh: 我们证明，美国抵押贷款市场的均衡贷款价值比分布在过去25年中保持显著稳定，无论是在总体层面还是区域层面，尽管房价周期存在显著的横截面异质性。高贷款价值比抵押贷款从明确由政府支持转变为私人证券化，再回归政府支持，但其总体占比始终未变。重复销售方法及贷款表现分析进一步证实，即使在人口子群体内部，贷款价值比分布的稳定性依然成立。这些发现与利用抵押品约束变化生成房价繁荣-萧条动态的信贷周期模型不一致。
10.1257/aeri.20250173.title: The Missing Loan-to-Value Cycle
10.1257/aeri.20250173.title_zh: 缺失的贷款价值比周期

10.1257/aeri.20250175.abstract: To examine the potential role of a nonlinear Phillips curve in explaining recent US inflation, we combine evidence from both crosscity variation and aggregate time series data. A central challenge relates to how best to control for the potential confounding effect of inflation expectations. The paper explores several options. Our findings place into question the robustness that tight labour markets, due to a nonlinear Phillips curve, played a very important role in the recent inflation episode.
10.1257/aeri.20250175.abstract_zh: 为探究非线性菲利普斯曲线在解释近期美国通胀中的潜在作用，我们结合了跨城市差异与总体时间序列数据的证据。核心挑战在于如何最优地控制通胀预期可能产生的混杂效应。本文探讨了多种解决方案。研究结果表明，由于非线性菲利普斯曲线的存在，劳动力市场紧张在近期通胀事件中发挥重要作用的结论缺乏稳健性。
10.1257/aeri.20250175.title: Did Recent Inflation Reflect a Nonlinear Phillips Curve?
10.1257/aeri.20250175.title_zh: 近期通胀是否反映了非线性的菲利普斯曲线？

10.1257/aeri.20250177.abstract: We analyze data from one elite institution and find that test score optional policies harm the likelihood of admission for high achieving applicants from disadvantaged backgrounds. Under test optional policies, these applicants submit test scores at too low a rate; they more than double their admissions probability (from 2.9 percent to 7.2 percent) by reporting scores. Our findings suggest that, more than commonly understood, elite institutions interpret test scores in the context of an applicant’s background. Thus, availability of test scores on an application can promote rather than hinder social mobility.
10.1257/aeri.20250177.abstract_zh: 我们分析了一所精英院校的数据，发现考试分数可选政策损害了来自弱势背景的高成就申请者的录取机会。在考试分数可选政策下，这些申请者提交分数的比例过低；若提交分数，其录取概率将提升一倍以上（从2.9%升至7.2%）。我们的研究结果表明，精英院校在解读考试分数时，比普遍认知更注重申请者的背景信息。因此，申请材料中提供考试分数反而能促进而非阻碍社会流动性。
10.1257/aeri.20250177.title: How Test Optional Policies in College Admissions Disproportionately Harm High Achieving Applicants from Disadvantaged Backgrounds
10.1257/aeri.20250177.title_zh: 大学招生中的可选考试政策如何不成比例地损害来自弱势背景的高成就申请者

10.1257/aeri.20250233.abstract: We propose an equilibrium theory of data-driven antitrust oversight in which regu- lators launch investigations on the basis of suspicious bidding patterns and cartels can adapt to the statistical screens used by regulators. Our main result establishes that screening for collusion using tests with a low false-positive rate (safe tests) is a robust improvement over laissez-faire. Safe tests do not create new collusive equilibria, and do not hurt competitive industries. In addition, safe tests can have strict bite, including unraveling all collusive equilibria in some settings.
10.1257/aeri.20250233.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种数据驱动反垄断监管的均衡理论，其中监管机构基于可疑投标模式发起调查，而卡特尔组织能够适应监管机构使用的统计筛查手段。我们的主要结论表明，采用低误报率（安全检验）的合谋筛查方法，相较于自由放任政策具有稳健的改进效果。安全检验既不会催生新的合谋均衡，也不会损害竞争性行业。此外，安全检验具有严格约束力，在某些情境下甚至能瓦解所有合谋均衡。
10.1257/aeri.20250233.title: Screening Adaptive Cartels

10.1257/aeri.20250253.abstract: We use close parliamentary elections as natural experiments to estimate the debt sensitivity of interest rates. Relative to an election in which one party barely secures a majority, an election in which no party achieves a majority causes the debt-to-GDP ratio to increase by 17 percentage points, while real interest rates rise by 99 basis points. If elections only impact real rates via debt, our results imply that a one percentage point increase in the debt-to-GDP ratio causes a 5.8 basis point increase in real rates, larger than most previous estimates.
10.1257/aeri.20250253.abstract_zh: 我们以议会选举结果接近的选举作为自然实验，估算利率对债务的敏感度。与某一政党勉强获得多数席位的选举相比，无政党获得多数席位的选举会导致债务与GDP之比上升17个百分点，同时实际利率上升99个基点。若选举仅通过债务影响实际利率，我们的结果表明，债务与GDP之比每上升1个百分点，实际利率将上升5.8个基点，这一数值高于以往多数估计结果。
10.1257/aeri.20250253.title: Public Debt Levels and Real Interest Rates: Causal Evidence from Parliamentary Elections
10.1257/aeri.20250253.title_zh: 公共债务水平与实际利率：来自议会选举的因果证据

10.1257/aeri.20250275.abstract: We present evidence from a field experiment across 66 firms and 7,137 knowledge workers. Workers were randomly selected to access a generative AI tool integrated into applications they already used at work for email, meetings, and writing. In the second half of the 6-month experiment, the 80% of treated workers who used the tool spent two fewer hours on email each week and reduced their time working outside of regular hours. Apart from these individual time savings, we do not detect shifts in the quantity or composition of workers’ tasks resulting from individual-level AI provision.
10.1257/aeri.20250275.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项涵盖66家企业和7,137名知识工作者的实地实验提供了证据。部分工作者被随机选中，获得一项生成式人工智能工具的访问权限，该工具已集成到他们工作中已使用的电子邮件、会议和写作应用程序中。在为期6个月的实验后半段，使用该工具的80%受试工作者每周在电子邮件上花费的时间减少了两个小时，并且减少了在常规工作时间之外的工作时长。除了这些个人时间节省外，我们未发现因个体层面提供人工智能而导致工作者任务数量或构成发生变化。
10.1257/aeri.20250275.title: Shifting Work Patterns with Generative AI
10.1257/aeri.20250275.title_zh: 生成式AI带来的工作模式转变

10.1257/aeri.20250281.abstract: A consequence of Mendel’s First Law is that siblings' genetic relatedness varies randomly (with a mean of 50%). We use molecular genetic data to compute the genetic relatedness of ~80,000 sib pairs. We then compare the pairs' genetic relatedness to their similarity on 15 socioeconomic and health outcomes to estimate the relative importance of genetic (i.e., heritability) and family environmental influences on each outcome. We find evidence of sizeable genetic influences on many outcomes, including cognitive performance, fertility, risk tolerance, smoking, and subjective wellbeing, and of more limited genetic influences on educational attainment and income.
10.1257/aeri.20250281.abstract_zh: 孟德尔第一定律的一个推论是，兄弟姐妹的遗传相关性随机变化（平均值为50%）。我们利用分子遗传学数据计算了约8万对兄弟姐妹的遗传相关性，随后比较这些配对在15项社会经济与健康结果上的相似性，以估算遗传（即遗传力）和家庭环境因素对每项结果的相对重要性。研究发现，许多结果（包括认知表现、生育能力、风险承受力、吸烟行为及主观幸福感）受到显著的遗传影响，而教育成就和收入受遗传影响的程度则较为有限。
10.1257/aeri.20250281.title: Nature, Nurture, and Socioeconomic Outcomes: New Evidence from Sib Pairs and Molecular Genetic Data
10.1257/aeri.20250281.title_zh: 自然、教养与社会经济结果：来自兄弟姐妹对与分子遗传数据的新证据

10.1257/aeri.20250286.abstract: Conditionality can exclude poor households from receiving transfers. Reanalyzing five randomized evaluations of conditional cash transfers (CCTs), we find that 9–37 percent of eligible recipients fail to meet conditions, and they typically have lower baseline consumption. We assess the welfare implications of budget-neutral shifts from CCTs to unconditional cash transfers. Conditionality exacerbating inequality among eligible recipients can be quantitatively important for welfare impacts. We quantify how large conditionality-induced human capital gains must be for the welfare benefits of CCTs to outweigh the inequality costs generated by conditionality.
10.1257/aeri.20250286.abstract_zh: 条件性可能导致贫困家庭无法获得转移支付。通过对五项有条件现金转移支付（CCTs）的随机评估进行再分析，我们发现9%至37%的合格受助者未能满足条件，且这些家庭通常基线消费水平较低。我们评估了从有条件现金转移支付转向无条件现金转移支付的预算中性调整对福利的影响。条件性加剧合格受助者之间的不平等，可能对福利效应产生显著的量化影响。我们量化了条件性带来的人力资本增益需达到何种程度，才能使有条件现金转移支付的福利收益超过条件性所产生的不平等成本。
10.1257/aeri.20250286.title: Conditioning Out the Poor? Consumption Inequality and the Design of Cash Transfer Programs
10.1257/aeri.20250286.title_zh: 排除穷人？消费不平等与现金转移计划的设计

10.1257/aeri.20250406.abstract: We introduce dynamic incentive contracts into a model of unemployment fluctuations. Our main result is that wage cyclicality from incentives does not affect the response of unemployment to productivity shocks. The response of unemployment is the same, to a first-order, in two economies: one with flexible incentive pay, and another with exogenously fixed wages. This equivalence is due to movements in effort. Under the optimal incentive contract, firms’ profits do not change when wages fall, because the effort of the worker falls too.
10.1257/aeri.20250406.abstract_zh: 我们将动态激励合同引入失业波动模型。主要结论是，由激励产生的工资周期性变化不会影响失业对生产率冲击的反应。在一阶近似下，两个经济体的失业反应相同：一个采用灵活的激励薪酬，另一个采用外生固定的工资。这种等价性源于努力程度的变化。在最优激励合同下，当工资下降时，企业利润不会发生变化，因为工人的努力程度也随之下降。
10.1257/aeri.20250406.title: Bonus Question: How Does Flexible Incentive Pay Affect Unemployment Dynamics?
10.1257/aeri.20250406.title_zh: 附加题：弹性激励薪酬如何影响失业动态？

10.1257/aeri.20250418.abstract: Big data and AI invert classical adverse selection: insurers can now infer statistical correlations that consumers cannot, overturning the traditional informational advantage. We study insurance contracting where a two-dimensional state determines risk, the agent privately knows one dimension, and the insurer privately knows how the two correlate. The insurer faces a trade-off between obfuscation and price discrimination: Fine-tuned contracts enable better screening but may reveal her statistical advantage. The optimal policy exhibits a bang-bang structure: pooling on a statistical model that renders the agent’s information worthless, and full disclosure elsewhere. Profits increase substantially when agents fail to perform Bayesian inference.
10.1257/aeri.20250418.abstract_zh: 大数据与人工智能颠覆了经典逆向选择：保险公司如今能够推断出消费者无法获知的统计相关性，从而扭转了传统的信息优势。本文研究了一种保险契约模型，其中风险由二维状态决定，代理人私下知晓其中一个维度，而保险人私下知晓这两个维度之间的相关性。保险人面临模糊化与价格歧视之间的权衡：精细调整的契约有助于更好地筛选，但可能暴露其统计优势。最优策略呈现“砰-砰”结构：在使代理人信息失效的统计模型上实行混同，而在其他情况下实行完全披露。当代理人未能进行贝叶斯推断时，利润显著增加。
10.1257/aeri.20250418.title: Inverse Selection

10.1257/aeri.20250426.abstract: This paper provides the first experimental evidence on the long-term effects of work-study programs, leveraging a randomized lottery design from a national program in Uruguay. Participation leads to a persistent 11 percent increase in formal labor earnings seven years after the program, driven by a 4 percent increase in the monthly probability of being employed and a 6 percent increase in monthly wages. Effects are significantly larger for men, while remaining positive for women. The program is highly cost-effective, outperforming most job training programs and reaching levels comparable to early childhood investments.
10.1257/aeri.20250426.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于工读项目长期效果的首个实验证据，利用乌拉圭一项全国性项目的随机抽签设计。参与该项目七年后，正规劳动收入持续增长11%，其驱动因素为月就业概率提高4%和月工资增长6%。男性参与者的效果显著更大，而女性参与者的效果仍为正向。该项目具有极高的成本效益，优于大多数职业培训项目，其效果水平可与早期儿童投资相媲美。
10.1257/aeri.20250426.title: The Lasting Effects of Working while in School: A Long-Term Follow-Up
10.1257/aeri.20250426.title_zh: 在校期间兼职的持久影响：一项长期追踪研究

10.1257/aeri.20250429.abstract: Prevailing methods for measuring sensitive outcomes confront researchers with an inherent bias-variance trade-off: direct questioning is prone to a sensitivity bias, while indirect methods such as list experiments are substantially less precise. We test the ballot-bag, a novel technique that relaxes this trade-off by mitigating bias in direct questioning while improving precision over indirect methods. In an experiment in Egypt, where direct questions on irregular migration are biased, ballot-bag estimates are not statistically different from those from a list experiment but exhibit significantly lower variance. Consequently, treatment effects are highly significant via the ballot-bag and not via the list experiment.
10.1257/aeri.20250429.abstract_zh: 当前测量敏感结果的主流方法使研究者面临固有的偏差-方差权衡：直接提问易产生敏感性偏差，而列举实验等间接方法则精度显著不足。我们测试了"投票袋"这一新技术，该技术通过减轻直接提问中的偏差并提升间接方法的精度来缓解这一权衡。在埃及的一项实验中，针对非正规移民的直接提问存在偏差，而投票袋估计值与列举实验的结果无统计差异，但方差显著更低。因此，通过投票袋方法得出的处理效应高度显著，而列举实验则未呈现此结果。
10.1257/aeri.20250429.title: Measuring Sensitive Outcomes through Ballot-Bag Surveys
10.1257/aeri.20250429.title_zh: 通过投票袋调查测量敏感结果

10.1257/aeri.20250461.abstract: This paper shows that effective reskilling substantially reduces antidepressant use among injured workers and their partners. Exploiting institutional variation in access to higher education following work accidents in Denmark, we find that reskilling prevents antidepressant use for one in three participants, with partner spillovers of comparable magnitude. These effects emerge while workers are in school—prior to any income gains—and coincide with increased partner employment. Assuming a one-to-one mapping between prescriptions and depressive episodes, the value of these health improvements adds 50% to the direct labor earnings gains from reskilling; partner earnings gains add another 33%.
10.1257/aeri.20250461.abstract_zh: 本文表明，有效的技能重塑显著降低了工伤工人及其伴侣的抗抑郁药物使用。利用丹麦工伤事故后高等教育机会的制度差异，我们发现技能重塑使每三名参与者中有一人避免了抗抑郁药物使用，且伴侣的溢出效应规模相当。这些效应在工人仍在学期间——即在任何收入增长之前——便已显现，并与伴侣就业增加同步发生。假设处方与抑郁发作之间存在一一对应关系，这些健康改善的价值使技能重塑带来的直接劳动收入增益增加了50%；伴侣收入增益则额外增加了33%。
10.1257/aeri.20250461.title: Reskilling and Resilience

10.1257/aeri.20250474.title: Rules versus Discretion without Common Knowledge
10.1257/aeri.20250474.title_zh: 规则与自由裁量权：无共同知识下的比较

10.1257/aeri.20250476.abstract: Population censuses constitute the basis of public resource allocation and political representation globally. This paper shows that census forms commonly generate incentives for enumerators to disproportionately omit members of larger households. Using microdata from 254 censuses, we estimate that this leads to undercounting in at least 60% of censuses. Omission is concentrated in poor countries where 0.6% of the population is missing. Within countries, poor households are missing three times as many members as rich ones, leading to larger undercounts in poorer regions. We illustrate how this translates into systematic underfunding of public services and political underrepresentation in poor regions.
10.1257/aeri.20250476.abstract_zh: 人口普查是全球公共资源分配和政治代表权的基础。本文表明，普查表格通常会使普查员产生不成比例地遗漏较大规模住户成员的动机。利用254次普查的微观数据，我们估计至少60%的普查中存在此类漏报现象。漏报集中在贫困国家，这些国家有0.6%的人口未被统计。在国家内部，贫困家庭被遗漏的成员数量是富裕家庭的三倍，导致贫困地区的漏报率更高。我们阐释了这种漏报如何转化为贫困地区公共服务资金的系统性不足和政治代表权的缺失。
10.1257/aeri.20250476.title: The Missing Poor

10.1257/aeri.20250560.abstract: We evaluate the effects of teaching negotiation skills to adolescent girls in economically vulnerable communities in Lusaka, Zambia ten years later. Treated participants complete 0.23 more years of education. Consistent with greater relational empowerment, they also begin sexual activity later, have smaller age gaps with their husbands, and express less traditional gender attitudes. Using a surrogate approach, social benefits and costs from increased education alone suggest the intervention generated 7.6 dollars for every dollar spent and had a very high marginal value of public funds of 10.5.
10.1257/aeri.20250560.abstract_zh: 我们评估了在赞比亚卢萨卡经济脆弱社区中，向青春期女孩教授谈判技巧十年后的效果。接受干预的参与者多完成了0.23年的教育。与更强的关系赋权相一致，她们还更晚开始性行为，与丈夫的年龄差距更小，并表现出更少的传统性别态度。采用替代方法，仅从教育增加带来的社会效益和成本来看，该干预措施每花费1美元产生7.6美元的回报，且公共资金的边际价值高达10.5。
10.1257/aeri.20250560.title: Ten Years of Relational Power: The Long-Run Effects of Teaching Negotiation Skills to Adolescent Girls
10.1257/aeri.20250560.title_zh: 关系权力的十年：教授青少年女孩谈判技能的长期影响

10.1257/aeri.20250600.abstract: We propose a model of endogenous economic growth with “weak” scale effects and diminishing returns to innovation at the micro level. In our model, entrants introduce new technologies through research and incumbents incrementally improve them through development. Over time, further improvement becomes harder such that firms ultimately run out of ideas and exit, paving the way for entrants that discover new technologies with further room for improvement. This turnover gives rise to a continuous stream of (temporary) opportunities for technological improvements that sustain economic growth. In a stationary equilibrium, the longrun growth rate is constant and endogenous to market incentives.
10.1257/aeri.20250600.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个具有“弱”规模效应和微观层面创新收益递减特征的内生经济增长模型。在该模型中，市场进入者通过研发引入新技术，而在位企业则通过开发活动对技术进行渐进式改进。随着时间推移，技术改进难度逐渐增大，企业最终因创新空间枯竭而退出市场，这为能够发现具有更大改进空间新技术的进入者创造了条件。这种企业更替机制产生了持续不断的（暂时性）技术改进机会，从而支撑经济长期增长。在稳态均衡中，长期增长率保持恒定，且内生于市场激励。
10.1257/aeri.20250600.title: Resetting the Innovation Clock: Endogenous Growth through Technological Turnover
10.1257/aeri.20250600.title_zh: 重置创新时钟：技术更替驱动的内生增长

10.1257/aeri.20250664.abstract: Cost-of-living shocks can have large and unequal effects, but causal evidence on households’ adaptive responses is scarce. Using Finnish administrative microdata from the 2022 energy crisis, we exploit variation in electricity contract expirations to identify behavioral responses in electricity use, labor earnings, financial distress, and residual consumption and savings. We find notable heterogeneity in responses that shape the final incidence: high-income households primarily reduced electricity consumption, while low-income households reduced consumption less, responding instead through increased labor supply, more payment defaults, and cutbacks in spending and savings. Longer anticipation softens but does not eliminate these impacts.
10.1257/aeri.20250664.abstract_zh: 生活成本冲击可能产生巨大且不均等的影响，但关于家庭适应性反应的因果证据却十分匮乏。利用2022年能源危机期间芬兰的行政微观数据，我们借助电力合同到期时间的差异，识别出家庭在电力使用、劳动收入、财务困境、剩余消费及储蓄方面的行为反应。研究发现，影响最终冲击分布的反应存在显著异质性：高收入家庭主要减少电力消费，而低收入家庭减少电力的幅度较小，转而通过增加劳动供给、更多支付违约以及削减支出和储蓄来应对。更长的预期时间能缓解但无法消除这些影响。
10.1257/aeri.20250664.title: Household-Level Responses to the European Energy Crisis
10.1257/aeri.20250664.title_zh: 家庭层面应对欧洲能源危机的反应

10.1257/app.20210064.abstract: We investigate the long-term effects of cash assistance on beneficiaries and their children among participants in the Seattle-Denver Income Maintenance Experiment. Treated families in this randomized experiment received thousands of dollars in extra government benefits for three or five years in the 1970s. We match experimental records to Social Security Administration data using a novel algorithm, finding that treatment decreased adults’ post-experimental annual earnings by $1,800, and increased their disability benefit applications. Effects were strongest around retirement age; evidence suggests possible occupational mechanisms. In contrast, children experienced no significant effects on earnings or interaction with the disability system.
10.1257/app.20210064.abstract_zh: 我们研究了西雅图-丹佛收入维持实验中现金援助对受益者及其子女的长期影响。在该随机实验中，受助家庭在20世纪70年代额外获得了为期三年或五年的数千美元政府补助。我们采用新型算法将实验记录与社会保障管理局数据进行匹配，发现实验干预使成年受助者在实验后的年收入减少1800美元，并增加了其残疾福利申请。影响在退休年龄前后最为显著；证据表明可能存在职业层面的作用机制。相比之下，子女在收入或与残疾系统的互动方面未受到显著影响。
10.1257/app.20210064.title: The Long-Term Effects of Cash Assistance

10.1257/app.20210798.abstract: Hundreds of thousands of children grow up in the US foster care system every year and are at high risk of experiencing negative outcomes such as incarceration and homelessness. This paper documents how the placement of foster children into families rather than congregate care improves their outcomes using the exits of other children from families as an instrument for their placement setting. Policies that change which children are matched to families can achieve a large percentage of the gains from policies that add families to the foster care system due to heterogeneity in treatment effects.
10.1257/app.20210798.abstract_zh: 每年有数十万儿童在美国寄养系统中成长，他们面临监禁、无家可归等负面结果的高风险。本文利用其他儿童离开家庭作为其安置环境的工具变量，记录了将寄养儿童安置于家庭而非集体照料机构如何改善其结局。由于处理效应的异质性，改变儿童与家庭匹配方式的政策，能够实现通过向寄养系统增加家庭的政策所带来收益的很大一部分。
10.1257/app.20210798.title: Who Gets a Family? The Consequences of Family and Congregate Care Allocation for Child Outcomes
10.1257/app.20210798.title_zh: 谁拥有家庭？家庭与集体照料分配对儿童结局的影响

10.1257/app.20220595.abstract: Intercollegiate amateur athletics in the US have historically prevented student-athletes from receiving market wages, creating substantial economic rents that are primarily generated by men’s football and basketball programs. Using financial data from college athletic departments, we estimate rent-sharing elasticities to measure how rents flow to women’s sports and other men’s sports and lead to increased spending on athletic facilities and coaches’ salaries. Using player-level data, we find that the rent-sharing transfers spending away from students who are more likely to be Black and come from poor neighborhoods towards students more likely to be White and come from higher-income neighborhoods.
10.1257/app.20220595.abstract_zh: 美国高校业余体育历来禁止学生运动员获得市场工资，由此产生了主要由男子橄榄球和篮球项目创造的大量经济租金。利用高校体育部门的财务数据，我们估算了租金分享弹性，以衡量租金如何流向女子体育及其他男子体育项目，并导致体育设施和教练薪资支出增加。基于运动员个体数据，我们发现租金分享将支出从更可能是黑人和来自贫困社区的学生，转移至更可能是白人和来自高收入社区的学生。
10.1257/app.20220595.title: Who Profits from Amateurism? Rent-Sharing in Modern College Sports
10.1257/app.20220595.title_zh: 谁从业余主义中获利？现代大学体育中的租金分享

10.1257/app.20230034.abstract: <jats:p>Little is known about the evolution and persistence of the effects of one-time cash transfers, especially in rural agricultural settings with limited productive investment opportunities. We use bimonthly phone surveys to estimate dynamic impacts for cash transfer recipients in Liberia and Malawi. We find immediate increases in food security that attenuate over time but do not entirely dissipate even 1.5–2 years later, driven by increased farm investments and production. We find increases in farm profits, reductions in casual off-farm labor, improvements in psychological well-being, and, in Liberia, a reduction in intimate partner violence (IPV). (JEL I31, I32, J43, O12, O13, Q12)</jats:p>
10.1257/app.20230034.abstract_zh: 关于一次性现金转移效应的演变与持续性，尤其是在农村农业环境中有限的生产性投资机会下，我们知之甚少。我们利用双月电话调查，估算利比里亚和马拉维现金转移接受者的动态影响。研究发现，粮食安全立即改善，但随时间推移逐渐减弱，即使在1.5至2年后也未完全消失，这主要源于农业投资和生产的增加。我们还观察到农业利润上升、非农临时劳动减少、心理健康改善，以及在利比里亚，亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）减少。（JEL I31, I32, J43, O12, O13, Q12）
10.1257/app.20230034.title: The Dynamic Effects of Cash Transfers to Agricultural Households
10.1257/app.20230034.title_zh: 现金转移对农业家庭动态效应

10.1257/app.20230048.abstract: Lipscomb, Mobarak, and Barham (2013) document large positive effects of electrification in Brazil due to broad-based improvements in labor productivity. They instrument electrification by simulating a hypothetical power grid roll-out driven solely by geographic factors. Their estimates are not robust to repeated runs of the simulation, which in most cases lead to weak instruments. Furthermore, removing coding errors turns the main outcomes and most originally identified mechanisms statistically insignificant in most of the repeated runs, even when using a specification proposed in a corrigendum published by the original authors.
10.1257/app.20230048.abstract_zh: Lipscomb、Mobarak和Barham（2013）的研究表明，巴西电气化因劳动生产率的广泛提升而产生了显著的正面效应。他们通过模拟仅由地理因素驱动的假设性电网扩展来对电气化进行工具变量估计。然而，其估计结果在重复模拟中并不稳健，多数情况下会导致弱工具变量问题。此外，即使采用原作者在勘误中提出的设定，修正编码错误后，在大多数重复模拟中，主要结果及最初识别的多数机制在统计上均不再显著。
10.1257/app.20230048.title: Comment on “Development Effects of Electrification: Evidence from the Topographic Placement of Hydropower Plants in Brazil”
10.1257/app.20230048.title_zh: 对“电气化的发展效应：来自巴西水电站地形选址的证据”的评论

10.1257/app.20230126.abstract: Networks play a key role in information diffusion. Yet, the impact of information on network formation is not well understood. We conducted a randomized experiment in Malawian boarding secondary schools, providing one fifth of students with exclusive access to an online information source. Using a complete panel of detailed network data, we show that changes in information access affect network structure, as students form and maintain strategic links. At the endline, treated students are more well-connected than control students. We calibrate and simulate a model of strategic network formation to demonstrate implications for network-based targeting, information diffusion, academic welfare and inequality.
10.1257/app.20230126.abstract_zh: 网络在信息扩散中扮演关键角色。然而，信息对网络形成的影响尚未得到充分理解。我们在马拉维寄宿制中学开展了一项随机实验，为五分之一的学生提供独家在线信息源。通过使用完整的详细网络数据面板，我们发现信息获取的变化会影响网络结构，因为学生会建立并维持战略性联系。在终期评估中，受干预学生比对照组学生拥有更广泛的社交网络。我们校准并模拟了一个战略性网络形成模型，以展示其对基于网络的定向干预、信息扩散、学业福利及不平等现象的影响。
10.1257/app.20230126.title: Who Knows? Information Access and Endogenous Network Formation
10.1257/app.20230126.title_zh: 谁知道？信息获取与内生网络形成

10.1257/app.20230301.abstract: <jats:p>We study the link between regional capitals and urban development. We exploit new global data on hundreds of first-order administrative and capital city reforms from 1987 until 2018 to estimate the capital city premium. Gaining capital status increases city growth in the medium term, spilling over to nearby cities. The capital premium varies with the size of the territory governed by the city, and political status complements favorable economic fundamentals. We document two mechanisms: migration of educated individuals to capital cities and heightened public and private investment, with private investment favoring capital cities with stronger economic fundamentals. (JEL D72, E22, H54, O18, R11, R12, R58)</jats:p>
10.1257/app.20230301.abstract_zh: 我们研究了区域首府与城市发展之间的联系。利用1987年至2018年间全球数百个一级行政区和首府城市改革的新数据，我们估算了首府城市溢价。获得首府地位会在中期内促进城市增长，并产生溢出效应，惠及邻近城市。首府溢价因城市所辖领土规模而异，且政治地位与有利的经济基本面形成互补。我们记录了两个机制：受过教育的个体向首府城市迁移，以及公共和私人投资的增加，其中私人投资更倾向于经济基本面较强的首府城市。（JEL D72, E22, H54, O18, R11, R12, R58）
10.1257/app.20230301.title: The Political Geography of Cities

10.1257/app.20230505.abstract: This paper considers how tax policy affects supply chains in a developing economy. Using administrative panel data on firms and transactions between them, we document substantial segmentation of supply chains between firms paying Value-Added Taxes (VAT) and non-VAT-paying firms. We then develop a model of firms' sourcing and tax decisions within supply chains to understand how tax policy interacts with supply networks. Finally, we test the model's predictions using variations over time within firm and within supplier-client pairs. We find that the tax system distorts firms' sourcing decisions, and evidence of strategic complementarities in firms' tax choices within supplier networks.
10.1257/app.20230505.abstract_zh: 本文探讨税收政策如何影响发展中国家的供应链。利用企业及其交易往来的行政面板数据，我们记录了增值税纳税企业与非增值税纳税企业之间供应链的显著分割现象。随后，我们构建了一个关于企业在供应链中采购与税务决策的模型，以理解税收政策如何与供应网络相互作用。最后，我们利用企业层面及供应商-客户配对层面的时间变化来检验模型的预测。研究发现，税收体系扭曲了企业的采购决策，并揭示了供应商网络中企业税务选择存在战略互补性的证据。
10.1257/app.20230505.title: Taxation and Supplier Networks: Evidence from India
10.1257/app.20230505.title_zh: 税收与供应商网络：来自印度的证据

10.1257/app.20230525.abstract: <jats:p>We evaluate a nationwide zero-cost intervention to reduce teacher sorting, where lower-income students are more likely to attend understaffed schools with less qualified teachers. Our approach was grounded in an insight from behavioral economics known as order effects. In the treatment arm, the teacher job application platform showed hard-to-staff schools first, while, in the control group, schools were displayed alphabetically. Treated teachers were more likely to apply to hard-to-staff schools, ranking them their highest priority. Inattentive or less qualified teachers did not influence the results. The intervention helped to reduce the unequal distribution of qualified teachers across schools. (JEL D91, I23, I24, J28, J45, O15)</jats:p>
10.1257/app.20230525.abstract_zh: 我们评估了一项全国性的零成本干预措施，旨在减少教师分配不均问题——低收入家庭学生更可能就读于师资短缺、教师资质较差的学校。该干预措施基于行为经济学中的“顺序效应”洞见。在实验组中，教师求职平台优先展示师资紧缺学校，而对照组则按字母顺序排列学校。受干预的教师更倾向于申请师资紧缺学校，并将其列为最高优先级。注意力不集中或资质较差的教师并未影响结果。该干预措施有助于缩小合格教师在学校间的不均衡分布。（JEL分类号：D91, I23, I24, J28, J45, O15）
10.1257/app.20230525.title: Order Effects and Teacher Labor Supply: A Nationwide RCT in Ecuador
10.1257/app.20230525.title_zh: 顺序效应与教师劳动力供给：厄瓜多尔的一项全国性随机对照试验

10.1257/app.20240009.abstract: <jats:p>Changes in political boundaries aimed at devolving power to local governments are common across many countries. We examine the economic impacts of government unit creation through splitting. Exploiting reforms that led to sharp increases in the number of municipalities in Brazil, we show that voluntary splitting enlarges the public sector, enhances public service delivery, and stimulates long-term economic activity in new local governments. These gains are not offset by losses elsewhere and are stronger in peripheral, remote, and underdeveloped areas neglected by parent governments. Higher fiscal revenues and decentralized decision-making contribute to the positive effects on local economic activity. (JEL D72, H41, H75, H76, H77, Q53, R51)</jats:p>
10.1257/app.20240009.abstract_zh: 旨在将权力下放至地方政府而进行的政治边界调整在许多国家都很常见。本文通过分析政府单位拆分创建的影响，考察其经济效应。利用导致巴西城市数量急剧增加的改革，我们发现自愿拆分扩大了公共部门规模，提升了公共服务供给，并刺激了新地方政府长期的经济活动。这些收益并未被其他地区的损失所抵消，且在那些被原属政府忽视的边缘、偏远及欠发达地区更为显著。更高的财政收入与分散化决策对地方经济活动的积极效应起到了推动作用。（JEL D72, H41, H75, H76, H77, Q53, R51）
10.1257/app.20240009.title: Decentralizing Development: The Economic Impacts of Government Splits
10.1257/app.20240009.title_zh: 分散化发展：政府分裂的经济影响

10.1257/app.20240026.abstract: This paper develops a pseudo-event study approach for estimating child penalties using cross-sectional data. The approach produces estimates that align closely with those obtained from true event studies using panel data and is statistically more precise. This allows for providing more granular evidence and study mechanisms. The paper presents a detailed investigation of the variation in child penalties across time, geography, and demographic/cultural groups in the US. There is large variation in these dimensions. Using a variety of approaches—including epidemiological studies of movers and immigrants—the paper finds that gender norms have sizable effects on child penalties.
10.1257/app.20240026.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于横截面数据估计子女惩罚的伪事件研究方法。该方法得出的估计值与使用面板数据的真实事件研究结果高度一致，且统计精度更高。这为提供更细粒度的证据和研究机制创造了条件。本文详细考察了美国不同时期、不同地区以及不同人口/文化群体中子女惩罚的差异。这些维度上存在显著差异。通过多种方法——包括针对迁移者和移民的流行病学研究——本文发现，性别规范对子女惩罚具有显著影响。
10.1257/app.20240026.title: The Geography of Child Penalties and Gender Norms: A Pseudo-Event Study Approach
10.1257/app.20240026.title_zh: 儿童惩罚的地理分布与性别规范：一项伪事件研究法分析

10.1257/app.20240041.abstract: Community contribution requirements are a ubiquitous but un- derstudied feature of projects to provide local public goods in de- veloping countries. A randomized experiment in rural Bangladesh shows that cash contribution requirements strongly reduce take-up and impact of safe drinking water infrastructure projects, compared to a contribution waiver. Labour contribution requirements do not, despite having similar value when priced at the market wage, be- cause most households value their time below the market wage and because labour contributions appear less costly to coordinate. Nei- ther contribution requirement increases cost-effectiveness once we account for coordination and monitoring costs, undermining a cen- tral rationale for their imposition.
10.1257/app.20240041.abstract_zh: 社区贡献要求是发展中国家地方公共品项目中普遍存在但研究不足的特征。在孟加拉国农村地区开展的一项随机实验表明，与免除贡献要求相比，现金贡献要求显著降低了安全饮用水基础设施项目的参与率和影响效果。而劳动贡献要求并未产生类似影响——尽管按市场工资计价时其价值与现金贡献相当——这是因为大多数家庭对其时间的估值低于市场工资，且劳动贡献的协调成本似乎更低。在考虑协调与监督成本后，两种贡献要求均未提升成本效益，这动摇了实施此类要求的核心依据。
10.1257/app.20240041.title: Time Is Not Money: An Experiment with Community Contribution Requirements in Cash and Labour
10.1257/app.20240041.title_zh: 时间不是金钱：现金与劳动社区贡献要求的实验研究

10.1257/app.20240092.abstract: This paper studies whether more skilled physicians improve birth outcomes. We exploit a natural experiment in Colombia, where newly graduated physicians were randomly assigned to Local Health Centers (LHCs), to estimate the causal effect of being treated by a more skilled physician—measured using medical graduation exam scores—on newborn health. We find that mothers treated at LHCs assigned physicians with exam scores one standard deviation higher were 9.14 percent less likely to give birth to an unhealthy newborn. Suggestive evidence indicates that more skilled physicians achieve these results by better targeting prenatal care toward high-risk mothers without reducing care for others.
10.1257/app.20240092.abstract_zh: 本文研究技能更高的医生是否能改善新生儿健康结局。我们利用哥伦比亚的一项自然实验——新毕业医生被随机分配到地方健康中心（LHCs）——来估计由技能更高医生（以医学毕业考试成绩衡量）接诊对新生儿健康的因果效应。研究发现，在分配了考试成绩高一个标准差的医生的LHCs就诊的母亲，其分娩不健康新生儿的概率降低9.14%。初步证据表明，技能更高的医生通过更精准地将产前护理资源向高风险母亲倾斜（同时不减少对其他母亲的护理）来实现这些结果。
10.1257/app.20240092.title: Luck of the Draw: The Causal Effect of Physicians on Birth Outcomes
10.1257/app.20240092.title_zh: 抽签的运气：医生对分娩结果的因果效应

10.1257/app.20240153.abstract: <jats:p>We conduct a large-scale field experiment in the Swedish pension system to examine to what extent information and search frictions explain dominated high-fee index fund choices. Three findings stand out: (i) Letters that increase awareness of a dominated choice and reduce search costs of finding the dominating alternative improve savers’ investment choices. (ii) While the average effects are positive, a majority of investors are unresponsive to information that essentially removes search costs. The inertia holds across expected gains, rejecting models with fixed adjustment costs. (iii) Lack of awareness and search costs account for at most 45 percent of dominated choices. (JEL C93, D83, G23, G51, G53, J32)</jats:p>
10.1257/app.20240153.abstract_zh: 我们在瑞典养老金系统中开展了一项大规模实地实验，以探究信息和搜索摩擦在多大程度上解释了被高费率指数基金主导的劣质选择。三个主要发现如下：（i）提高对劣质选择认知度并降低寻找更优替代方案搜索成本的函件，改善了储蓄者的投资选择。（ii）尽管平均效应为正，但大多数投资者对实质上消除了搜索成本的信息无动于衷。这种惯性在预期收益范围内普遍存在，从而否定了固定调整成本模型。（iii）认知缺失和搜索成本最多只能解释45%的劣质选择。（JEL分类号：C93, D83, G23, G51, G53, J32）
10.1257/app.20240153.title: Dominated Pension Investments: The Role of Search Frictions and Unawareness
10.1257/app.20240153.title_zh: 受支配的养老金投资：搜索摩擦与认知缺失的作用

10.1257/app.20240181.abstract: <jats:p>Received wisdom holds that income rank matters for life satisfaction, but causal evidence on the nature and impact of income comparisons is limited. We randomize individuals from a representative sample of mid-career Finns to receive personal rank information from one of several reference groups. We find strong evidence of the effect of rank information on income satisfaction, but weaker effects on life satisfaction, and some evidence of real effects in experimental and administrative data. Effects are strong in narrow reference groups and weak and insignificant in the national one. Finally, we discuss the implications for income transparency policies. (JEL D31, D63, D83, D91, I31)</jats:p>
10.1257/app.20240181.abstract_zh: 普遍观点认为，收入排名对生活满意度至关重要，但关于收入比较的性质及其影响的因果证据仍然有限。我们随机选取芬兰职业生涯中期人群的代表性样本，向其提供来自多个参照组之一的个人排名信息。研究发现，排名信息对收入满意度具有显著影响，但对生活满意度的影响较弱；实验数据与行政数据均显示存在部分实际效应。该效应在狭窄参照组中表现强烈，而在全国性参照组中则微弱且不显著。最后，我们探讨了该发现对收入透明度政策的启示。（JEL分类号：D31, D63, D83, D91, I31）
10.1257/app.20240181.title: Which Reference Groups Matter and How? A Relative Income Information Experiment with Administrative Data
10.1257/app.20240181.title_zh: 哪些参照群体重要以及如何重要？基于行政数据的相对收入信息实验

10.1257/app.20240203.abstract: <jats:p>We analyze welfare under reference-dependent preferences. We decompose the first-order welfare effects of reference point and price changes into direct and behavioral effects. The sign of these effects depends on the form of reference-dependent payoffs; which effects are welfare relevant depends on whether reference dependence reflects a bias. We characterize corresponding social welfare effects in terms of estimable reduced-form parameters and normative judgments. We apply our framework to reference dependence in German workers’ retirement decisions. We find positive welfare effects of local increases in the normal retirement age (NRA) but ambiguous effects of financial incentives to postpone retirement. (JEL D91, H55, J26, J32)</jats:p>
10.1257/app.20240203.abstract_zh: 我们分析了参照依赖偏好下的福利效应。将参照点与价格变化的一阶福利效应分解为直接效应和行为效应。这些效应的符号取决于参照依赖收益的具体形式；而哪些效应具有福利相关性则取决于参照依赖是否反映了某种偏差。我们通过可估计的简化形式参数和规范性判断来刻画相应的社会福利效应。将分析框架应用于德国工人退休决策中的参照依赖现象，研究发现：当地正常退休年龄（NRA）的提高带来正向福利效应，但延迟退休的财务激励措施产生的福利效应则具有不确定性。（JEL分类号：D91, H55, J26, J32）
10.1257/app.20240203.title: The Welfare Economics of Reference Dependence
10.1257/app.20240203.title_zh: 参考依赖的福利经济学

10.1257/app.20240232.abstract: We develop a method for detecting cartels in multistage auctions. Our approach allows firms to act collusively against cartel members yet competitively otherwise. In these auctions, bidders submit initial bids and can later revise them downward. As initial bids are shaded, close initial bids indicate similar costs and thus create strong incentives to undercut rivals. We classify firm pairs as collusive if they ignore this incentive by failing to update bids against each other, relative to other pairs with similarly close initial bids. Our algorithm predicts Ukraine’s Antimonopoly Committee sanctions: classified pairs are nine times more likely to be sanctioned.
10.1257/app.20240232.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在多阶段拍卖中检测卡特尔的方法。该方法允许企业在针对卡特尔成员时采取合谋行为，而在其他情况下则保持竞争。在这类拍卖中，竞标者提交初始报价，随后可向下调整报价。由于初始报价存在折价，相近的初始报价表明成本相似，从而产生强烈的降价竞争动机。我们将那些相对于其他初始报价相近的配对而言，未能针对彼此更新报价、从而忽视这一动机的企业配对判定为合谋。我们的算法预测了乌克兰反垄断委员会的制裁结果：被判定为合谋的配对受到制裁的可能性是其他配对的九倍。
10.1257/app.20240232.title: Detection of Collusive Networks in Multistage Auctions
10.1257/app.20240232.title_zh: 多阶段拍卖中共谋网络的检测

10.1257/app.20240364.abstract: We evaluate a large-scale public preschool construction program in deprived rural communities in Mozambique using a randomized control trial. The program increased preschool enrollment from 2% to 75%, improved primary school enrollment and progression, and led treated children to score higher in cognitive and social-emotional skills tests. Impacts were strongest among children of illiterate parents, in less poor households, and living near the preschools. We provide evidence that preschool construction mediates later educational success at primary school-age. We also detect increased parental investment in children and higher preschool enrollment for younger siblings. Finally, we estimate the program was implemented cost-effectively.
10.1257/app.20240364.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，评估了莫桑比克贫困农村社区大规模公立幼儿园建设项目。该项目使幼儿园入学率从2%提升至75%，改善了小学入学率与学业进展，并促使受助儿童在认知与社会情感技能测试中取得更高分数。影响在父母为文盲、家庭贫困程度较低且居住地邻近幼儿园的儿童中最为显著。我们提供了证据表明，幼儿园建设通过中介效应促进了儿童在小学阶段的教育成就。同时，研究还发现该项目增加了父母对子女的投入，并提高了弟弟妹妹的幼儿园入学率。最后，我们估算该项目的实施具有成本效益。
10.1257/app.20240364.title: From Access to Achievement: The Primary School-Age Impacts of an At-Scale Preschool Construction Program in Highly Deprived Communities
10.1257/app.20240364.title_zh: 从入学到成就：高度贫困社区大规模学前教育建设项目的学龄儿童影响

10.1257/app.20240370.abstract: Using itinerary-level global air traffic data, this paper proposes a novel instrumental variable to estimate the effect of in-person interactions on bilateral trade. By exploiting exogenous variations in air connectivity that are driven by third-country connecting capacities, we show that increased air connections boost trade, especially for complex industries and new products. Online interactions appear to be a limited substitute for in-person contact. These findings confirm the role of in-person communications in reducing information-sharing barriers. Our estimation approach also provides a useful tool for evaluating the social and economic impacts of a complex transport network.
10.1257/app.20240370.abstract_zh: 本文利用航线层面的全球航空交通数据，提出了一种新颖的工具变量，用以估计面对面交流对双边贸易的影响。通过利用由第三国中转能力驱动的航空连通性外生变化，我们发现航空联系的增加促进了贸易增长，尤其是在复杂行业和新产品领域。在线互动似乎难以有效替代面对面接触。这些发现证实了面对面交流在降低信息共享障碍方面的作用。我们的估计方法也为评估复杂交通网络的社会经济影响提供了有效工具。
10.1257/app.20240370.title: All Roads Lead to Rome: Global Air Connectivity and Bilateral Trade
10.1257/app.20240370.title_zh: 条条大路通罗马：全球航空连通性与双边贸易

10.1257/app.20240377.abstract: <jats:p>We examine the effect of intergroup competition on within-group violent conflict in Indonesia. Using a triple-differences design, we find that higher competition for national government transfers between villages reduces within-village conflict. These effects persist regardless of the competition’s outcome, are stronger in ethnically fractionalized and segregated villages, and are accompanied by higher attendance in village meetings. Our results are consistent with external competition favoring participation and cooperation within otherwise divided communities, suggesting that economic incentives to compete with out-groups combined with forms of civic engagement can be important mechanisms to reduce violence within communities. (JEL D74, H70, O15, O17, O18, Z13)</jats:p>
10.1257/app.20240377.abstract_zh: 我们研究了群体间竞争对印度尼西亚群体内部暴力冲突的影响。采用三重差分设计，我们发现村庄间对中央政府转移支付的更高竞争减少了村庄内部冲突。无论竞争结果如何，这些效应均持续存在，在种族分化且隔离的村庄中更为显著，并且伴随着村庄会议出席率的提高。我们的结果与外部竞争促进原本分裂社区内的参与和合作这一观点一致，表明与外群体竞争的经济激励结合公民参与形式，可能是减少社区内部暴力的重要机制。（JEL D74, H70, O15, O17, O18, Z13）
10.1257/app.20240377.title: Fostering Cooperation: The Conflict-Reducing Effects of Intervillage Competition for Government Transfers
10.1257/app.20240377.title_zh: 促进合作：村际竞争政府转移支付的冲突缓解效应

10.1257/app.20240450.abstract: We quantify the role of firms in intergenerational mobility using administrative data from Israel. We decompose the intergenerational elasticity of earnings (IGE) into an individual-IGE and a firm-IGE using an AKM framework. The firm-IGE—reflecting the sorting of children from higher-income families into better-paying firms—accounts for 23 percent of the IGE.We then explore underlying mechanisms. While skill transmission explains part of the firm- IGE, roughly half cannot be accounted for by skill differences. Moreover, sector-level sorting explains a large share of the firm-IGE, indicating that structural barriers across sectors—rather than firm-level discrimination— are a key driver of intergenerational sorting.
10.1257/app.20240450.abstract_zh: 我们利用以色列行政数据量化了企业在代际流动中的作用。通过AKM框架，我们将代际收入弹性（IGE）分解为个体IGE和企业IGE。企业IGE——反映高收入家庭子女进入高薪酬企业的分类效应——解释了IGE的23%。随后我们探究了潜在机制。尽管技能传递解释了部分企业IGE，但约一半无法由技能差异解释。此外，行业层面的分类效应解释了企业IGE的很大份额，这表明跨行业的结构性壁垒——而非企业层面的歧视——是代际分类的关键驱动因素。
10.1257/app.20240450.title: Quantifying the Role of Firms in Intergenerational Mobility
10.1257/app.20240450.title_zh: 量化企业在代际流动中的作用

10.1257/app.20240477.abstract: We conduct survey experiments to test how the design of scientific grants— the money and time awarded—can be used to manage researchers. On average, researchers are relatively unwilling to trade o! money for time when choosing among grants. However, there is significant heterogeneity in researchers’ preferences. Conditional on receiving a grant, di!erent designs cause only minor changes in researchers’ plans for how they would use the funding. Marginal changes in grant design are more relevant for selection e!ects (funders’ ability to attract certain researchers) than treatment e!ects (funders’ ability to change researchers’ strategies).
10.1257/app.20240477.abstract_zh: 我们通过调查实验检验科研资助的设计——即所授予的资金与时间——如何用于管理研究人员。平均而言，研究人员在选择资助时相对不愿以金钱换取时间。然而，研究人员的偏好存在显著异质性。在获得资助的条件下，不同的设计仅对研究人员如何使用资金的计划产生微小变化。资助设计的边际变化对选择效应（资助方吸引特定研究人员的能力）的影响大于处理效应（资助方改变研究人员策略的能力）。
10.1257/app.20240477.title: Money, Time, and Grant Design

10.1257/app.20240564.abstract: Many people are impatient. We introduce domain-specific discounting to a contracting model and test a prediction for how to make incentives work well when people are im- patient over effort: implement time-bundled contracts that make the payment for future effort increase in current effort. Using a randomized evaluation of an exercise incentive program among diabetics in India, we find that time-bundled contracts generate equiv- alent e ort to time-separable contracts at 15% lower cost. Moreover, they perform 30% better among individuals with above-median effort impatience. Pooled across contracts, incentives increase steps by 20% and improve blood sugar relative to a control group.
10.1257/app.20240564.abstract_zh: 许多人缺乏耐心。我们将领域特定贴现引入契约模型，并检验一项关于如何在人们对努力缺乏耐心时有效设计激励措施的预测：实施时间捆绑契约，使未来努力的报酬随当前努力增加而递增。通过对印度糖尿病患者运动激励项目的随机评估，我们发现时间捆绑契约能以比时间可分离契约低15%的成本产生同等努力水平。此外，在努力耐心程度高于中位数的个体中，其效果提升30%。综合各类契约来看，与对照组相比，激励措施使步数增加20%，并改善血糖水平。
10.1257/app.20240564.title: Designing Incentives for Impatient People: An RCT Promoting Exercise to Manage Diabetes
10.1257/app.20240564.title_zh: 为缺乏耐心者设计激励措施：一项促进运动管理糖尿病的随机对照试验

10.1257/app.20240586.abstract: We study contemporaneous and post-program impacts of a public works program, which provides urban youth seven months of employment at the formal minimum wage with complementary training on entrepreneurship or job search. During the program, we find limited impacts on employment, but a shift toward wage jobs, higher earnings and savings, as well as positive changes in work habits, behaviors, and well-being. After the program, we find no lasting impact on employment or behaviors, with only limited gains in earnings stemming from independent activities. Using machine learning to analyze heterogeneity, we show that alternative targeting approaches can substantially improve welfare.
10.1257/app.20240586.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一项公共工程项目在实施期间及结束后的影响。该项目为城市青年提供为期七个月的正式最低工资就业，并辅以创业或求职培训。在项目实施期间，我们发现其对就业的影响有限，但促使就业向工资性工作转移，提高了收入和储蓄，并在工作习惯、行为及福祉方面产生了积极变化。项目结束后，就业或行为方面未发现持久影响，仅从独立活动中获得有限的收入增长。通过机器学习分析异质性，我们表明替代性的目标定位方法可以显著改善福利。
10.1257/app.20240586.title: Do Workfare Programs Live Up to Their Promises? Experimental Evidence from Côte d’Ivoire
10.1257/app.20240586.title_zh: 工作福利计划是否兑现了承诺？来自科特迪瓦的实验证据

10.1257/app.20240589.abstract: <jats:p>Firms often exploit weaknesses in government contracts to boost revenues, yet little is known about how they allocate these funds. We study how hospitals allocated $3 billion obtained from gaming a Medicare loophole. The average gaming hospital increased Medicare and total revenue by around 10 percent, implying large spillovers on other payers. Nonprofit hospitals deployed most funds toward operating costs. For-profits—driven by a large chain—deducted funds off their balance sheets, distributing them to executives and shareholders. Accordingly, we detect reductions in mortality only at nonprofits. Our results imply that the consequences of engineered windfalls vary substantially by hospital ownership. (JEL D86, H51, I11, I12, I18, L31)</jats:p>
10.1257/app.20240589.abstract_zh: 企业常利用政府合同漏洞增加收入，但关于这些资金如何分配的研究甚少。本文研究了医院如何分配通过利用医疗保险制度漏洞获得的30亿美元。平均而言，利用漏洞的医院将医疗保险收入和总收入提高了约10%，这意味着对其他支付方产生了巨大的溢出效应。非营利性医院将大部分资金用于运营成本。营利性医院——由大型连锁医院驱动——则将资金从资产负债表中扣除，分配给高管和股东。相应地，我们仅在非营利性医院中观察到死亡率下降。研究结果表明，意外收益的后果因医院所有权性质而显著不同。（JEL D86, H51, I11, I12, I18, L31）
10.1257/app.20240589.title: Turbocharging Profits? Contract Gaming and Revenue Allocation in Healthcare
10.1257/app.20240589.title_zh: 涡轮增压利润？医疗保健中的合同博弈与收入分配

10.1257/app.20240737.abstract: We study a Force-down/Shoot-down intervention in Brazil that led cocaine traffickers to shift from air to river routes. Using data on cocaine production, homicides, and the network of rivers in the Amazon, we provide evidence that violence increased in municipalities along river routes originating from Andean producing countries after the policy. We also show that, during the same period, violence in these municipalities became more responsive to cocaine production in origin countries. We document an instance of crime displacement over the three-dimensional space, involving sophisticated adaptations from criminals regarding transportation technologies, with dramatic side-effects for local populations.
10.1257/app.20240737.abstract_zh: 我们研究了巴西的“迫降/击落”干预政策，该政策导致可卡因贩运者从空中路线转向河流路线。利用可卡因产量、凶杀案数据以及亚马逊河流网络，我们提供了证据表明，在该政策实施后，源自安第斯生产国的河流沿线城市的暴力事件有所增加。我们还发现，在同一时期，这些城市的暴力事件对原产国可卡因产量的反应变得更加敏感。我们记录了一个三维空间内犯罪转移的案例，涉及犯罪分子在运输技术上的复杂适应，并对当地居民产生了严重的副作用。
10.1257/app.20240737.title: Landing on Water: Air Interdiction, Drug-Trafficking Displacement, and Violence in the Brazilian Amazon
10.1257/app.20240737.title_zh: 水上着陆：空中拦截、毒品贩运转移与巴西亚马逊地区的暴力问题

10.1257/app.20240746.abstract: This paper builds and analyzes a new global macro-historical database of effective tax rates on capital and labor in 154 countries. We establish a new stylized fact: while effective capital tax rates fell in developed countries between 1965 and 2018, they rose in developing countries since 1990. Multiple research designs at the country, sector and firm-level suggest that trade openness contributed to this rise, by increasing the share of output produced in corporations and larger firms, where effective capital taxation is higher. In contrast to a common view, globalization appears in many countries to have supported governments’ ability to tax capital.
10.1257/app.20240746.abstract_zh: 本文构建并分析了涵盖154个国家资本与劳动有效税率的新型全球宏观历史数据库。我们揭示了一个新的典型事实：1965年至2018年间，发达国家的有效资本税率呈下降趋势，而发展中国家自1990年以来却呈现上升态势。基于国家、行业和企业层面的多重研究设计表明，贸易开放通过提升公司制企业及大型企业的产出占比（这些企业的有效资本税率更高）推动了这一上升趋势。与普遍认知相反，全球化在许多国家反而增强了政府对资本征税的能力。
10.1257/app.20240746.title: Globalization, Capital Taxation, and Development: Evidence from a Macro-Historical Database
10.1257/app.20240746.title_zh: 全球化、资本税与发展：基于宏观历史数据库的证据

10.1257/app.20240759.abstract: Natural disasters displace millions of people a year, but their economic impacts are difficult to study when the affected population becomes dispersed. This paper estimates the longrun impacts of six landslides in Uganda on nearly the full affected population. The analysis exploits the sharp boundaries between households residing in a landslide path and those on the same slopes but outside the path. Years after the landslides, affected households earn 50% less income and are 18 percentage points less likely to report being satisfied with their lives. Further analysis points to social capital as a determinant of successful post-disaster recovery.
10.1257/app.20240759.abstract_zh: 自然灾害每年导致数百万人流离失所，但当受灾人口分散时，其经济影响难以研究。本文估算了乌干达六次山体滑坡对几乎全部受灾人口的长期影响。分析利用了滑坡路径内住户与同处同一山坡但位于路径外住户之间的清晰边界。滑坡发生数年后，受灾家庭收入减少50%，对生活表示满意的可能性降低18个百分点。进一步分析表明，社会资本是灾后成功恢复的决定性因素。
10.1257/app.20240759.title: Disastrous Displacement: The Long-Run Impacts of Landslides
10.1257/app.20240759.title_zh: 灾难性迁移：山体滑坡的长期影响

10.1257/app.20240791.abstract: We update the results of Lipscomb et al 2013 to improve the stability of the instrument, to reconcile differences in definitions of the Amazon used in controls, and to update the standard errors based on the Lee et al 2022 tF procedure. We show that the instrument remains strong in the revised specification. The impact of electricity access is positive and important in magnitude though smaller and less precisely estimated than originally estimated in Lipscomb et al 2013.
10.1257/app.20240791.abstract_zh: 我们更新了Lipscomb等人（2013）的研究结果，以提升工具变量的稳定性，协调控制变量中亚马逊定义差异，并基于Lee等人（2022）的tF程序更新标准误。研究表明，在修订后的设定中，工具变量依然有效。电力接入的影响在量级上显著为正，但相较于Lipscomb等人（2013）的原始估计，其影响更小且估计精度较低。
10.1257/app.20240791.title: Reply to “Comment on “Development Effects of Electrification: Evidence from the Topographic Placement of Hydropower Plants in Brazil”
10.1257/app.20240791.title_zh: 回复“关于《电气化的发展效应：来自巴西水电站地形选址的证据》的评论

10.1257/app.20240804.abstract: Proponents of labor mobility restrictions argue that innovation incentives more than offset harm to workers. Yet the causal effect of such policies on innovation is an open empirical question. Leveraging plausibly exogenous state-level changes in the enforceability of noncompete agreements, we find a significant negative effect on innovation. This effect is even larger for the most novel and innovative patents and firms. Further analysis shows that these negative effects on innovation cannot be explained by entry alone and instead likely result from reduced knowledge flows. Our findings suggest that labor mobility plays a crucial role in spreading knowledge across firms.
10.1257/app.20240804.abstract_zh: 劳动力流动限制的支持者认为，创新激励足以抵消对工人的损害。然而，此类政策对创新的因果效应仍是一个悬而未决的实证问题。利用各州竞业禁止协议可执行性看似外生的变化，我们发现其对创新产生了显著的负面影响。对于最具新颖性和创新性的专利及企业而言，这种负面效应甚至更大。进一步分析表明，这些对创新的负面影响无法仅用市场进入来解释，而更可能源于知识流动的减少。我们的研究结果表明，劳动力流动在跨企业知识传播中发挥着关键作用。
10.1257/app.20240804.title: Innovation through Inventor Mobility: Evidence from Non-Compete Agreements
10.1257/app.20240804.title_zh: 发明人流动性与创新：基于竞业禁止协议的证据

10.1257/app.20240816.abstract: We examine long-run differences in intergenerational occupational mobility between Black and White Americans using linked censuses and survey data from 1850 to 2021. We document two main results. First, shifts in mobility dynamics, most notably for the 1940–1950 cohort, reshaped occupational structures and reduced racial segregation. Second, new measures of intergenerational persistence reveal both bottlenecks and the enduring memory in the mobility system, offering new perspectives on the role of mobility in explaining the lack of convergence in Black-White occupational outcomes.
10.1257/app.20240816.abstract_zh: 我们利用1850年至2021年的关联人口普查与调查数据，考察了美国黑人与白人在代际职业流动性方面的长期差异。研究得出两个主要结论：第一，流动性动态的变化（尤以1940-1950年出生队列最为显著）重塑了职业结构并降低了种族隔离程度；第二，代际持续性的新测度揭示了流动性体系中的瓶颈效应与持久记忆，为理解流动性在解释黑人与白人职业结果缺乏趋同现象中的作用提供了新视角。
10.1257/app.20240816.title: The Evolution of Black-White Differences in Occupational Mobility Across Post-Civil War America
10.1257/app.20240816.title_zh: 美国内战后黑人与白人在职业流动性差异上的演变

10.1257/app.20240822.abstract: We provide new evidence of forward-looking labor supply responses to changes in pension wealth. We exploit a 2014 German reform that increased pension wealth for mothers by an average of 4.4% per child born before January 1, 1992. Using administrative data on the universe of working histories, we implement a difference-in-differences design comparing women who had their first child before versus after January 1, 1992. We document significant reductions in labor earnings, driven by intensive margin responses. Our estimates imply that, on average, an extra euro of pension wealth reduces unconditional labor earnings by 54 cents.
10.1257/app.20240822.abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于养老金财富变化对前瞻性劳动供给影响的新证据。利用2014年德国一项改革，该改革使1992年1月1日前生育子女的母亲人均养老金财富增加4.4%。基于涵盖全体工作历史的行政数据，我们采用双重差分法，比较首次生育时间在1992年1月1日前后女性的差异。研究发现劳动收入显著下降，主要源于集约边际调整。估算结果表明，平均每增加1欧元养老金财富，无条件劳动收入将减少54欧分。
10.1257/app.20240822.title: Forward-Looking Labor Supply Responses to Changes in Pension Wealth: Evidence from Germany
10.1257/app.20240822.title_zh: 前瞻性劳动供给对养老金财富变化的反应：来自德国的证据

10.1257/app.20250044.abstract: Zoning regulations drive rising regional housing costs and residential segregation in the United States. In response, governments are passing laws to override local regulations that limit housing density, despite entrenched opposition from incumbent residents. We study how residents living near housing permitted under one such law, Massachusetts’ Chapter 40B, are affected by and respond to this new, denser housing. Exploiting hyperlocal variation in proximity to 40B developments, we find that the average development does not affect these residents’ property values (95% CI: [–0.4%, 2.4%]). For larger developments that do decrease values, outmigration and political responses are small or non-existent.
10.1257/app.20250044.abstract_zh: 美国的分区法规推高了地区住房成本并加剧了居住隔离。为此，各州政府正通过立法来推翻限制住房密度的地方法规，尽管面临现有居民的强烈反对。我们研究了在马萨诸塞州《第40B章》这类法律许可下，居住在新建高密度住房附近的居民如何受到这些住房的影响并作出反应。通过利用与40B开发项目邻近程度的超本地化差异，我们发现平均而言，这些开发项目并未影响周边居民的房产价值（95%置信区间：[–0.4%, 2.4%]）。对于确实导致价值下降的大型开发项目，居民的迁出和政治回应微乎其微甚至不存在。
10.1257/app.20250044.title: There Goes the Neighborhood? The Local Impacts of State Policies that Override Municipal Zoning
10.1257/app.20250044.title_zh: 邻里何去何从？州政策超越市镇区划的地方影响

10.1257/app.20250049.abstract: <jats:p>US firms hiring foreign workers in low-skill nonfarm jobs face a binding quota on the “H-2B” visa, allocated in part through a randomized lottery. We evaluate the quota’s marginal impact using the lottery, a novel firm survey, and a pre-analysis plan. Firms exogenously employing more H-2B workers in low-skill jobs increase production (elasticity 0.20–0.22), investment (1.5–2.1), and profits (0.15). The elasticity of substitution between H-2B and US workers is very low (0.8–2.2). Thus, the effect on US employment is zero or positive overall, and positive in rural areas. Forensic analysis suggests similarly low substitutability of black-market labor. (JEL J15, J24, J46, J61, J82, K37)</jats:p>
10.1257/app.20250049.abstract_zh: 美国企业在低技能非农岗位雇佣外籍工人时，面临“H-2B”签证的约束性配额，该配额部分通过随机抽签分配。我们利用抽签机制、一项新颖的企业调查以及预分析计划，评估了该配额的边际影响。在低技能岗位中因外生因素雇佣更多H-2B工人的企业，其产量（弹性0.20–0.22）、投资（1.5–2.1）和利润（0.15）均有所提升。H-2B工人与美国工人之间的替代弹性极低（0.8–2.2）。因此，该配额对美国就业的整体影响为零或为正，且在乡村地区呈现正向效应。法证分析表明，黑市劳动力的可替代性同样较低。（JEL J15, J24, J46, J61, J82, K37）
10.1257/app.20250049.title: The Effect of Low-Skill Immigration Restrictions on US Firms and Workers: Evidence from a Randomized Lottery
10.1257/app.20250049.title_zh: 低技能移民限制对美国企业与工人的影响：来自随机抽签的证据

10.1257/app.20250070.abstract: We study how the legacy of WWI deaths affected British communities and the next generation of soldiers. Our instrumental-variable estimates show that servicemen from localities that suffered heavier losses in WWI were considerably more likely to die or win gallantry medals in WW2. To contextualise these findings, we show that the mortality shock increased communities’ inter-war civic capital as demonstrated by the creation of war memorials, veterans’ associations and charities, and increases in pro-social participation. Our results highlight the importance of past conflicts in fostering pro-social behaviours which, in turn, can shape the motivation of soldiers in future wars.
10.1257/app.20250070.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一战死亡遗留问题如何影响英国社区及下一代士兵。工具变量估计表明，来自一战损失更惨重地区的军人在二战中阵亡或获得英勇勋章的可能性显著更高。为阐释这些发现，我们证明死亡率冲击通过战争纪念碑、退伍军人协会和慈善机构的建立，以及亲社会参与度的提升，增强了社区在两次世界大战间的公民资本。研究结果凸显了过往冲突在培育亲社会行为中的重要性，而这种行为反过来可能塑造未来战争中士兵的动机。
10.1257/app.20250070.title: Scars of War: The Legacy of WWI Deaths on Civic Capital and Combat Motivation
10.1257/app.20250070.title_zh: 战争伤痕：一战死亡对公民资本与战斗动机的遗留影响

10.1257/app.20250146.abstract: We develop a revealed preference approach to measure the value of workplace amenities by analyzing how variation in non-wage job attributes affects excess mass in the earnings distribution at budget discontinuities. The approach formalizes the idea that workers respond less to monetary incentives when amenities constitute a larger share of total compensation. Applying this method to workplace safety during COVID-19 waves, we find that workers are willing to sacrifice 9% of their earnings to reduce weekly fatality risks by one in 100,000. The findings suggest that conventional hedonic regressions substantially underestimate the value of workplace safety.
10.1257/app.20250146.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种揭示性偏好方法，通过分析非工资性工作属性变化如何影响预算断点处收入分布的超额聚集程度，来测算工作场所福利的价值。该方法将以下理念形式化：当福利在总薪酬中占比更大时，劳动者对货币激励的反应会减弱。将该方法应用于新冠疫情浪潮期间的工作场所安全研究，我们发现劳动者愿意牺牲9%的收入，以将每周十万分之一的死亡风险降低一个单位。研究结果表明，传统特征回归方法会显著低估工作场所安全的价值。
10.1257/app.20250146.title: Willingness to Pay for Workplace Amenities
10.1257/app.20250146.title_zh: 工作场所便利设施的支付意愿

10.1257/app.20250329.abstract: This paper provides the first evidence on the impact of exposure to international students on the long-term outcomes of native students. I combine unique survey and administrative data from the Netherlands covering one million students across three decades and employ an across-cohort design. I find that exposure to international students leads natives to (i) form social ties with non-natives, (ii) hold more positive attitudes towards migration and learning about other cultures, and (iii) seek opportunities abroad. Notably, I find precisely estimated zero effects on employment, income, entrepreneurship, and the share of international co-workers up to 25 years after university entry.
10.1257/app.20250329.abstract_zh: 本文首次提供了接触国际学生对本土学生长期结果影响的证据。我结合了荷兰覆盖三十年、涉及一百万学生的独特调查与行政数据，并采用跨队列设计。研究发现，接触国际学生使本土学生：（i）与非本土学生建立社会联系，（ii）对移民及了解其他文化持有更积极的态度，以及（iii）寻求海外机会。值得注意的是，在进入大学后的25年内，我发现对就业、收入、创业以及国际同事比例的影响精确估计为零。
10.1257/app.20250329.title: University as a Melting Pot: Long-term Effects of Internationalization
10.1257/app.20250329.title_zh: 大学作为大熔炉：国际化的长期效应

10.1257/app.20250342.abstract: We propose a simple model of the evolution of institutional strength, where leaders' actions have a persistent effect by shaping the norms of the institutions they lead. This leads to different long-run behaviors even for institutions with the same formal rules. The early history of leaders plays a crucial role in determining which outcome prevails. Every period, a leader decides to respect or abuse their position. Respect strengthens the institutions; abuse weakens them. Leader's type and institutional strength determine both the benefit/cost of abusing the position and the replacement probability. We elucidate democratic backsliding and corporate-board capturing.
10.1257/app.20250342.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个关于制度强度演化的简单模型，其中领导者的行为通过塑造其领导机构的规范而产生持久影响。即使正式规则相同的制度，也会因此产生不同的长期行为。领导者的早期经历在决定最终结果中起着关键作用。每个时期，领导者都会决定是尊重还是滥用其职位。尊重会强化制度，滥用则会削弱制度。领导者的类型和制度强度共同决定了滥用职位的收益/成本以及被替换的概率。我们阐释了民主倒退和公司董事会俘获现象。
10.1257/app.20250342.title: Shaping Institutions

10.1257/app.20250397.abstract: We study class disparities in highway patrol traffic stops. Low-income motorists are more likely to be searched for contraband, less likely to be found with contraband when searched, and more likely to be stopped for infractions associated with pretext stops. To measure class-based discrimination, we leverage motorists stopped in multiple vehicles conveying different class signals. Motorists are more likely to be searched when stopped in a low-status vehicle, and evidence suggests that they are also more likely to be stopped when driving one. Marginal searches triggered by vehicle status are less likely to yield contraband when the motorist is low-income.
10.1257/app.20250397.abstract_zh: 我们研究了高速公路巡警交通拦截中的阶层差异。低收入驾驶者更可能因违禁品被搜查，搜查时被发现携带违禁品的概率更低，且更可能因与借口性拦截相关的违规行为被拦停。为衡量基于阶层的歧视，我们利用了驾驶不同阶层信号车辆的驾驶者被拦截的数据。驾驶低地位车辆时，驾驶者更可能被搜查，且有证据表明他们驾驶此类车辆时也更可能被拦停。由车辆地位引发的边际搜查中，若驾驶者为低收入群体，查获违禁品的可能性更低。
10.1257/app.20250397.title: Class Disparities and Discrimination in Traffic Stops and Searches
10.1257/app.20250397.title_zh: 交通拦截与搜查中的阶级差异与歧视

10.1257/app.20250414.abstract: We analyze mandatory retirement in Sweden which eliminates entirely employment protection at age 67.
