The benchmark measures how well AI systems can explain contemporaneous stock returns around earnings announcements using only information available at announcement time, including the text of the announcement itself. Applying this benchmark to a range of agentic AI systems — which extract structured signals from earnings call transcripts and optimize over those signals — we find that the best-optimized systems more than double the explained variation in returns relative to standard benchmarks (R2 increasing from 8% to close to 20%). We show that AI-based optimization can deliver efficiency gains relative to traditional machine learning methods while also improving interpretability as our approach produces human-readable economic mechanisms that explain price movements. These learned rules can be compared to the drivers of realized returns in existing asset pricing models to identify missing sources of variation in a data-driven, self-evolving way that integrates empirical learning with economic structure. We release an SDK for researchers to improve on our results. Saturating this benchmark would represent fundamental progress in understanding how capital markets process firm-level information.
10.3386/w35431.abstract_zh: 评估针对资产定价优化的AI系统存在两个根本性困难。首先，模型基于全部数据训练，这意味着任何使用历史数据的回测或分析都存在前瞻性偏差。其次，市场具有反身性——当投资者采用AI时，价格会随之调整——这可能会削弱AI系统原本训练利用的模式。我们引入了一个实时、样本外的基准测试，旨在规避这两个问题。该基准测试衡量AI系统仅利用公告发布时可获取的信息（包括公告文本本身）来解释盈余公告期间同期股票收益的能力。将该基准应用于一系列智能体AI系统（这些系统从财报电话会议记录中提取结构化信号并对其进行优化），我们发现最优化的系统相比标准基准，对收益变动的解释力提升了一倍以上（R²从8%提升至接近20%）。我们证明，基于AI的优化相比传统机器学习方法能够实现效率提升，同时增强可解释性——因为我们的方法能生成解释价格变动的人类可读经济机制。这些学习到的规则可与现有资产定价模型中已实现收益的驱动因素进行比较，以数据驱动、自我演进的方式识别缺失的变动来源，将经验学习与经济结构相融合。我们发布了SDK供研究者改进我们的结果。饱和该基准测试将标志着在理解资本市场如何处理公司层面信息方面取得根本性进展。
10.3386/w35431.title: Assessing the Benefits of Optimized Agentic AI Systems for Asset Pricing
10.3386/w35431.title_zh: 评估优化智能体AI系统对资产定价的益处

10.3386/w35432.abstract: This study explores the effects of COVID-19 school closures on labor market outcomes of Canadian parents of school-aged children. Using newly collected data on grade-level-specific school closures across 141 Canadian cities along with individual-level panel data from the Labour Force Survey, difference-in-differences estimates provide robust evidence that restrictions on in-person schooling reduced employment among partnered mothers of school-aged children by approximately 2 percentage points. For fathers, labor supply adjustments are much weaker and concentrated on single fathers. Finally, auxiliary analyses using administrative tax records provide suggestive evidence that school closures increased public benefit receipt among single parents.
10.3386/w35432.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了新冠疫情导致的学校关闭对加拿大适龄儿童父母劳动力市场结果的影响。利用新收集的涵盖141个加拿大城市年级层面学校关闭数据，结合劳动力调查中的个体层面面板数据，双重差分估计提供了稳健证据：限制线下教学使有伴侣的学龄儿童母亲就业率下降约2个百分点。对父亲而言，劳动力供给调整幅度显著较弱，且集中于单亲父亲群体。最后，基于行政税务记录的辅助分析提供了提示性证据：学校关闭增加了单亲家庭公共福利领取率。
10.3386/w35432.title: The Effect of School Disruptions on Parental Labor Supply: Evidence from Canadian Panel Data
10.3386/w35432.title_zh: 学校停课对父母劳动供给的影响：基于加拿大面板数据的证据

10.3386/w35433.abstract: This paper examines the labor market effects of overtime coverage in the United States, where salaried workers are covered for overtime if their base pay falls below a legislated salary threshold. Using an event-study design with administrative payroll data and state-level threshold changes from 2014-2021, I find evidence against conventional models of overtime. Contrary to the historical intent of policymakers, firms do not increase employment by substituting more workers for fewer hours. However, contrary to compensating differential models, firms also do not offset the costs of overtime by lowering workers' base pays. Instead, employers raised salaries above the threshold to keep workers exempt from overtime, indicating that monitoring and adjusting workers' hours is costly for firms. Taken together, these results suggest that expanding overtime coverage increases workers' earnings without negatively impacting employment.
10.3386/w35433.abstract_zh: 本文研究了美国加班覆盖政策对劳动力市场的影响。在该政策下，若受薪工人的基本工资低于法定工资门槛，则其享有加班费保障。基于2014-2021年行政工资数据与州级门槛变动，采用事件研究法设计，本文发现了与传统加班理论相悖的证据。与政策制定者的历史意图相反，企业并未通过以更多工人替代更少工时的方式增加就业；同时，与补偿性工资差异模型相反，企业也未通过降低工人基本工资来抵消加班成本。相反，雇主将工资提高至门槛以上以维持工人免于加班覆盖，这表明监控和调整工人工时对企业而言成本高昂。综合来看，这些结果表明扩大加班覆盖范围能提高工人收入，且不会对就业产生负面影响。
10.3386/w35433.title: The Labor Market Effects of Expanding Overtime Coverage
10.3386/w35433.title_zh: 扩大加班覆盖范围对劳动力市场的影响

10.3386/w35434.abstract: Earnings inequality among college graduates has grown, and returns to a bachelor's degree (BA) vary substantially across colleges. We experimentally evaluate a program that shifted high-achieving, low-income students into higher-quality colleges. Students randomly offered a guarantee of four years of tuition and fees at the University of Michigan were 21 percentage points more likely to enroll at a UM campus. The offer shifted students across colleges rather than into college: most compliers would otherwise have attended less-selective four-year colleges. HAIL increased four-year BA completion by 4 percentage points, but had no effect on attainment after six years. It substantially increased degree quality: students offered the scholarship were 12 percentage points more likely to earn a bachelor's degree from a highly or most selective college. IV estimates indicate that students induced to attend a University of Michigan campus were 56 percentage points more likely to earn such a degree. The increase in college quality predicts earnings gains of 18 to 25 percent. Faster degree completion adds about another 1 percent to the present discounted value of lifetime earnings.
10.3386/w35434.abstract_zh: 大学毕业生收入不平等加剧，且不同院校的学士学位回报率差异显著。我们通过实验评估了一项将高成就低收入学生引导至更优质大学的项目。随机获得密歇根大学四年学费及杂费保障的学生，其入读密歇根大学校区的概率提高了21个百分点。该资助促使学生在不同院校间流动而非单纯进入大学：大多数受助者原本会进入选择性较低的四年制大学。HAIL项目使四年制学士学位完成率提升4个百分点，但对六年后的学业成就无显著影响。该项目显著提升了学位质量：获得奖学金的学生从高选择性或最高选择性大学获得学士学位的概率提高12个百分点。工具变量估计表明，被引导入读密歇根大学校区的学生获得此类学位的概率提高56个百分点。大学质量的提升预计可带来18%至25%的收入增长。更快的学位完成速度将使终身收入的现值额外增加约1%。
10.3386/w35434.title: Degrees of Mobility: Shifting Low-Income Students to Higher Quality Colleges
10.3386/w35434.title_zh: 流动性程度：将低收入学生转入更优质高校

10.3386/w35435.abstract: The persistent surge in U.S. inflation that began in 2021 caught forecasters and policymakers by surprise. The 2021 inflation shocks were viewed as transitory, not persistent, leading to large forecast errors in late 2021 and 2022. This paper asks whether time series models – using only data on current and past inflation, but incorporating stochastic volatility and exhibiting time-varying persistence – performed better. Univariate models, using real-time data, did not. Multivariate models, incorporating sectoral inflation measures, did.
10.3386/w35435.abstract_zh: 美国自2021年开始的持续通胀飙升令预测者和政策制定者措手不及。2021年的通胀冲击被视为暂时性而非持续性，导致2021年末和2022年出现较大预测误差。本文探究仅使用当前及历史通胀数据、但纳入随机波动性并呈现时变持续性的时间序列模型是否表现更优。基于实时数据的单变量模型未能改善预测，而纳入行业通胀指标的多变量模型则表现更佳。
10.3386/w35435.title: Forecasting the Covid Surge in Inflation
10.3386/w35435.title_zh: 预测新冠疫情引发的通胀飙升

10.3386/w35436.abstract: We study whether information frictions about the relative effectiveness of study methods distort students’ effort allocation. Standard models treat effort as a single input whose level, rather than composition, determines outcomes. We instead model effort as an allocation across methods with heterogeneous effectiveness. Combining panel surveys, administrative records, digital activity logs, and a randomized information intervention with over 2,000 undergraduates, we test whether imperfect information leads to effort misallocation and quantify consequences for performance. At baseline, students hold divergent beliefs, and many devote time to passive strategies such as rereading, despite evidence that active retrieval is more effective; these choices predict lower performance and larger self-assessment errors. We randomize treated students into general-feedback and personalized-feedback arms, benchmarking habits against peers in the latter. General feedback has little effect. Personalized feedback widens the perceived effectiveness gap between active and passive methods by 42 percent, shifts time toward effective practices, and raises exam scores by 0.05–0.08 standard deviations. A dynamic model with learning-by-doing and convex allocation costs shows that, for students with the weakest baseline beliefs, personalized feedback is equivalent to a 16.5 percent reduction in adoption costs. These results identify information frictions about multidimensional effort as a determinant of academic performance.
10.3386/w35436.abstract_zh: 本文研究关于学习方法相对有效性的信息摩擦是否会扭曲学生的努力分配。标准模型将努力视为单一投入，其水平而非构成决定结果。我们则将努力建模为在不同有效性方法间的分配。结合面板调查、行政记录、数字活动日志以及对2000多名本科生进行的随机信息干预实验，我们检验不完全信息是否导致努力错配，并量化其对学业表现的影响。在基线期，学生持有不同的信念，许多人将时间投入被动策略（如重读），尽管有证据表明主动检索更为有效；这些选择预测了较低的学业表现和更大的自我评估误差。我们将受试学生随机分为一般反馈组和个性化反馈组，后者以同龄人为基准对标学习习惯。一般反馈效果甚微。个性化反馈将主动与被动方法之间的感知有效性差距扩大了42%，促使时间向有效实践转移，并将考试成绩提高了0.05–0.08个标准差。一个包含干中学和凸性分配成本的动态模型表明，对于基线信念最弱的学生而言，个性化反馈相当于降低了16.5%的采纳成本。这些结果揭示了关于多维努力的信息摩擦是学业表现的一个决定因素。
10.3386/w35436.title: The Role of Information Frictions in Study Habit Choice and Academic Performance
10.3386/w35436.title_zh: 信息摩擦在学习习惯选择与学业表现中的作用

10.3386/w35437.abstract: Artificial intelligence will probably generate major changes in the US economy, although the nature, timing, and magnitude of those changes are highly uncertain. We analyze a set of long-term scenarios involving different combinations of faster productivity growth, greater income inequality, job displacement, and a higher capital share of income. For each scenario, we assess the implications for federal debt and potential policy responses related to faster economic growth, the distribution of income, support for workers who are laid off, and taxation and ownership of capital. Given the uncertainty surrounding AI’s economic effects, policies that are robust to different scenarios would be especially valuable.
10.3386/w35437.abstract_zh: 人工智能可能会对美国经济产生重大变革，尽管这些变革的性质、时机和规模存在高度不确定性。我们分析了一系列长期情景，涉及生产率增长加快、收入不平等加剧、岗位替代以及资本收入份额上升等不同组合。针对每种情景，我们评估了其对联邦债务的影响，以及可能采取的政策应对措施，包括加快经济增长、调节收入分配、支持失业工人，以及资本税收与所有权问题。鉴于人工智能经济影响的不确定性，能够适应不同情景的稳健政策将尤为宝贵。
10.3386/w35437.title: How Might Fiscal Policy Respond to the Rise of Artificial Intelligence?
10.3386/w35437.title_zh: 财政政策如何应对人工智能的崛起？

10.3386/w35438.abstract: The central trade-off for designing Disability Insurance (DI) is between providing insurance to those in need while maintaining incentives to work. This paper develops a novel revealed-preference approach to identify the insurance value of DI benefits. We show that comparing the DI take-up response to a change in benefits versus a change in wages identifies the insurance value. Implementing our framework in Canada, we estimate that increasing DI benefits by $1 creates an additional disincentive cost of $0.60 but creates an insurance value of $2.20. Thus, our approach suggests that DI benefits are not overly generous in the Canadian context.
10.3386/w35438.abstract_zh: 设计残疾保险（DI）的核心权衡在于：既要为有需要者提供保障，又要维持工作激励。本文提出一种新颖的显示性偏好方法，用以识别DI福利的保险价值。研究表明，通过比较DI参保率对福利变化与工资变化的反应差异，即可识别其保险价值。在加拿大应用该框架后，我们估算出：每增加1美元DI福利，会产生0.60美元的额外抑制成本，但能创造2.20美元的保险价值。因此，我们的方法表明，在加拿大背景下，DI福利并未过度慷慨。
10.3386/w35438.title: Measuring the Value of Disability Insurance from Take-Up Decisions
10.3386/w35438.title_zh: 从参保决策衡量伤残保险的价值

10.3386/w35439.abstract: We harmonize survey data on interest rates paid by approximately 15,000 small and medium enterprises across 125 firm surveys and 285,000 households across 83 household surveys spanning developing and rich countries to study the relationship between monetary policy rates and borrowing costs faced by SMEs and households. Using within-country variation in policy rates over time, we find that pass-through to firm and household borrowing rates is stronger in richer countries than in poorer ones.
10.3386/w35439.abstract_zh: 我们整合了来自125项企业调查中约15,000家中小企业以及83项家庭调查中285,000户家庭（涵盖发展中国家与富裕国家）的利率调查数据，以研究货币政策利率与中小企业及家庭借贷成本之间的关系。通过利用各国政策利率随时间变化的内部差异，我们发现政策利率向企业和家庭借贷利率的传导效应在富裕国家比在贫困国家更为显著。
10.3386/w35439.title: Do Monetary Policy Rates Reach Borrowers? Evidence from Household and Firm Loans in 96 Countries
10.3386/w35439.title_zh: 货币政策利率能否传导至借款人？来自96个国家家庭与企业贷款的证据

10.3386/w35440.abstract: This paper examines the choice between public and private healthcare systems among elderly veterans, who are dually eligible to obtain care through the publicly operated Veterans Health Administration (VA) and through private providers financed by Medicare. We analyze health system choice among veterans who move across areas with differing rates of VA utilization to quantify the relative importance of individual-specific factors (e.g., preferences, income, health) and place-specific factors (e.g., local access, quality, and convenience). Our estimates indicate that 50–60% of geographic variation in VA use is attributable to demand-side individual factors, with the remainder explained by place-based factors. We also document important heterogeneity across types of care, with place-based factors playing a larger role for inpatient and emergency care than for outpatient and primary care. Additional analysis suggests that the supply-side features emphasized in recent legislation—distance to VA facilities and wait times—explain only a small share of estimated place effects. These findings highlight the importance of individual factors in health system choice and have implications for policies aimed at reducing geographic disparities in VA utilization.
10.3386/w35440.abstract_zh: 本文研究了老年退伍军人在公共与私营医疗体系之间的选择问题。这些退伍军人有资格通过公立的退伍军人健康管理局（VA）以及由医疗保险资助的私营医疗机构获得医疗服务。我们分析了在不同VA使用率地区间迁移的退伍军人的医疗体系选择，以量化个体特定因素（如偏好、收入、健康状况）和地区特定因素（如当地可及性、质量及便利性）的相对重要性。估算结果表明，VA使用的地理差异中50%–60%可归因于需求侧的个体因素，其余部分则由地区因素解释。我们还发现不同医疗类型之间存在显著异质性：地区因素对住院和急诊服务的影响大于对门诊和初级保健服务的影响。进一步分析表明，近期立法强调的供给侧特征——与VA机构的距离及等待时间——仅能解释地区效应的一小部分。这些发现凸显了个体因素在医疗体系选择中的重要性，并对旨在减少VA使用地理差异的政策具有启示意义。
10.3386/w35440.title: Choice Between Public and Private Healthcare Systems: Evidence from Veterans
10.3386/w35440.title_zh: 公共与私人医疗体系的选择：来自退伍军人的证据

10.3386/w35442.abstract: Japan has the world’s oldest population and a universal Long-Term Care Insurance (LTCI) system, yet how care use and costs differ between cognitive and physical impairment remains underexamined. Using the nationally representative Comprehensive Survey of Living Conditions (2016 and 2019 waves; 324,466 adults aged 65 and older), we compare the utilization, intensity, and cost of long-term care across three groups: those with a dementia diagnosis (defined as regularly receiving medical treatment for dementia), those with physical (ADL) limitations but no dementia, and those with neither. A dementia diagnosis is associated with dramatically higher care use—75.3% receive some care, versus 5.3% of the unimpaired reference group. In models adjusting for demographic and socioeconomic characteristics, dementia raises the probability of receiving formal care by 55 percentage points and informal care by 52 percentage points—roughly double the effects of ADL limitations—and, conditional on use, is associated with about 113 additional hours of formal care per month (some 60% more than physical limitations alone). We estimate formal-care costs at 1.07–4.03% of GDP (depending on the valuation method) and co-residing informal-care costs at 0.79% of GDP. Per-capita formal-care costs are substantially higher for those with dementia (about 3.5 versus 2.0 million JPY annually under the self-reported approach), whereas informal-care costs are nearly uniform across impairment types—underscoring the intensive, and largely invisible, contribution of family caregivers. With the dementia and mild-cognitive-impairment population projected to reach roughly 12 million by 2040, these findings point to mounting fiscal and family-care pressures from cognitive impairment in Japan.
10.3386/w35442.abstract_zh: 日本拥有全球最老龄人口及全民长期护理保险（LTCI）体系，但认知障碍与身体功能障碍在护理使用及成本方面的差异尚未得到充分研究。基于全国代表性数据《综合生活状况调查》（2016年与2019年两轮调查；涵盖324,466名65岁及以上老年人），我们比较了三类群体的长期护理使用率、强度及成本：确诊痴呆症群体（定义为定期接受痴呆症医学治疗者）、存在身体活动能力（ADL）限制但无痴呆症群体，以及无上述两类问题的群体。痴呆症诊断与显著更高的护理使用率相关——75.3%的该群体接受某种形式的护理，而参照组（无功能障碍者）仅为5.3%。在调整人口与社会经济特征的模型中，痴呆症使接受正式护理的概率提高55个百分点，接受非正式护理的概率提高52个百分点——约为ADL限制效应的两倍；且在已使用护理的条件下，每月正式护理时长增加约113小时（较单纯身体功能障碍群体高出约60%）。我们估算正式护理成本占GDP的1.07%-4.03%（取决于估值方法），同住非正式护理成本占GDP的0.79%。按人均计算，痴呆症群体的正式护理成本显著更高（自报法下年均约350万日元 vs. 200万日元），而非正式护理成本在不同功能障碍类型间近乎一致——凸显家庭照护者密集且近乎隐形的贡献。鉴于痴呆症及轻度认知障碍人口预计到2040年将达约1200万，这些发现表明日本因认知障碍面临日益加剧的财政与家庭照护压力。
10.3386/w35442.title: Cognitive versus Physical Impairment and the Use and Cost of Long-Term Care in Japan
10.3386/w35442.title_zh: 认知障碍与身体障碍对日本长期护理使用及成本的影响

10.3386/w35443.abstract: We develop a model of aberrant behavior by Bitcoin miners and test it with a new 2017-2025 dataset. Miners’ rewards, comprised partly of user fees, exhibit variability across blocks of transactions. When large reward disparities exist between adjacent blocks, miners have incentives to attempt alternative versions of prior blocks and claim other miners’ rewards for themselves. Regression analysis shows that fee differentials are associated with these attacks and longer waiting times between blocks. These patterns imply potential destabilization of the Bitcoin blockchain as future mining rewards become more volatile due to gradual withdrawal of fixed block subsidies.
10.3386/w35443.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个比特币矿工异常行为模型，并利用2017-2025年的新数据集进行检验。矿工收益部分来源于用户手续费，在不同交易区块间呈现波动性。当相邻区块间存在较大收益差异时，矿工有动机尝试篡改先前区块的替代版本，从而侵占其他矿工的收益。回归分析表明，手续费差异与这类攻击行为及区块间更长的等待时间存在关联。这些模式意味着，随着固定区块补贴逐步退出导致未来挖矿收益波动加剧，比特币区块链可能面临潜在的不稳定性风险。
10.3386/w35443.title: Unruly by Design: Fee Volatility and Strategic Attacks in Bitcoin Mining
10.3386/w35443.title_zh: 设计失序：比特币挖矿中的费用波动与策略性攻击

10.3386/w35444.abstract: I study insurance markets in which scalable prediction, like AI, designs residual risk rather than merely classifies fixed risk. A complete-contracting benchmark shows that if prevention is observable, contractible, competitively supplied, and fully priced, it does not matter whether consumers, insurers, or vendors supply it. Adverse selection breaks such irrelevance. When high-risk consumers are more "AI-treatable," efficient prevention makes low-risk contracts attractive to them. A contract intended for low-risk consumers faces a risk-design trilemma: separate, prevent efficiently, or avoid cross-subsidy, but not all three. The result extends Rothschild-Stiglitz from distorted coverage to distorted risk-control technology and offers market design insights of AI in insurance markets.
10.3386/w35444.abstract_zh: 本文研究保险市场中可扩展预测（如人工智能）如何设计残余风险，而非仅仅对固定风险进行分类。一个完全契约基准表明，若预防行为可观测、可契约化、由竞争性市场提供且完全定价，则无论由消费者、保险公司还是供应商提供预防，其结果均无差异。逆向选择打破了这种无关性。当高风险消费者更具“人工智能可治疗性”时，有效预防会使低风险契约对其产生吸引力。针对低风险消费者的契约面临风险设计的三难困境：分离、有效预防或避免交叉补贴，但三者不可兼得。该结论将罗斯柴尔德-斯蒂格利茨模型从扭曲的保险覆盖范围扩展至扭曲的风险控制技术，并为人工智能在保险市场中的市场设计提供了洞见。
10.3386/w35444.title: Risk Design: AI and Prediction Beyond Screening in Insurance Markets
10.3386/w35444.title_zh: 风险设计：保险市场中超越筛选的人工智能与预测

10.3386/w35445.abstract: Misaligned incentives within organizations may explain why firms fail to adopt or fully benefit from productive technologies. We conducted a randomized controlled trial in Indian garment factories in which units received an anonymous worker-management communication technology, this technology paired with incentives for HR managers to communicate effectively with workers, or neither (control). We find that the technology alone had no impacts relative to control. But pairing the technology with HR incentives increased productivity by 5%, reduced absenteeism by 13%, and raised worker earnings by 3%. Impacts were driven by greater HR responsiveness and increased worker reporting of production-related issues.
10.3386/w35445.abstract_zh: 组织内部的激励错位可能解释了企业为何未能采纳或充分受益于高效技术。我们在印度服装工厂开展了一项随机对照试验，其中部分工厂获得匿名员工-管理层沟通技术，部分工厂在技术基础上附加对人力资源经理有效沟通的激励措施，其余工厂则未获得任何干预（对照组）。研究发现，仅提供技术本身相较于对照组未产生显著影响。但将技术与人力资源激励相结合后，生产率提升5%，缺勤率降低13%，工人收入增加3%。这些影响源于人力资源响应度的提高以及工人对生产相关问题报告频率的增加。
10.3386/w35445.title: Organizational Incentives and the Returns to Technology Adoption
10.3386/w35445.title_zh: 组织激励与技术采纳的回报

10.3386/w35446.abstract: Industrial zones are a widely used industrial policy tool, yet their effects vary enormously. Matching the timing and location of zone establishment to firm-level data in Vietnam, we estimate that a new zone raises formal employment by 2,000 workers within seven years. This average masks extreme skewness: a handful of zones generate the gains while the rest produce almost none. Zones near major trade hubs account for most of the effect, driven by export-oriented foreign manufacturers. Accounting for spillovers, domestic firms face agglomeration shadows nearby but gain farther out, while foreign manufacturers operate as enclaves, generating few local linkages.
10.3386/w35446.abstract_zh: 工业区是一种广泛使用的产业政策工具，但其效果差异巨大。通过将越南工业区设立的时间与地点与企业层面数据进行匹配，我们估算出新建工业区在七年内可使正规就业增加2000人。这一平均值掩盖了极端偏态分布：少数工业区贡献了全部增长，其余工业区几乎毫无成效。靠近主要贸易枢纽的工业区贡献了大部分效应，其驱动力来自出口导向型外资制造商。考虑溢出效应后，国内企业在邻近区域面临集聚阴影，但在更远距离处获益；而外资制造商以飞地模式运营，几乎未产生本地关联。
10.3386/w35446.title: The Uneven Impact of Industrial Zones on Formal Job Creation in Vietnam
10.3386/w35446.title_zh: 越南工业区对正规就业创造的不均衡影响

10.3386/w35447.abstract: The federal government appropriated $189.5 billion in pandemic aid to school districts through the Elementary and Secondary School Emergency Relief (ESSER) fund. We evaluate their impact on schools with district poverty shares near 5%, where a threshold-driven increase in funds enables us to implement a difference-in-discontinuities design. Federal funds were passed on to residents through reductions in local revenue collections, including property taxes, and did not result in increased per-pupil expenditures by school districts. We find no evidence that additional funds mitigated the declines in test scores. We provide suggestive evidence that political engagement, especially from parents, increased in districts that qualified for additional funds. This combination of engagement and reduced taxation may explain the greater enrollment and faster reopening we observe in such districts.
10.3386/w35447.abstract_zh: 联邦政府通过《中小学紧急救援基金》（ESSER）拨款1895亿美元用于学区疫情援助。我们利用学区贫困率接近5%的门槛效应，通过断点回归设计评估其影响。联邦资金通过减少地方财政收入（包括财产税）转移给居民，并未导致学区生均支出增加。我们未发现额外资金缓解考试成绩下降的证据。初步证据表明，获得额外资金的学区政治参与度（尤其是家长参与）有所提升。这种参与度提高与税收减少的组合效应，或可解释此类学区入学率上升及复课速度加快的现象。
10.3386/w35447.title: Intergovernmental Grants to School Districts and Educational Outcomes During the COVID-19 Pandemic
10.3386/w35447.title_zh: 新冠疫情期间政府间对学区的拨款与教育成果

10.3386/w35448.abstract: We show that incorporating uninsurable countercyclical income risk into a standard international RBC model can qualitatively and quantitatively account for the quantity puzzles in open-economy macro, namely (i) the Backus-Smith puzzle, (ii) the Backus-Kehoe-Kydland puzzle and (iii) the weak correlation between the trade balance and the exchange rate. We also show that our model can simultaneously account for the Fama puzzle and the evidence that high interest rate countries have stronger currencies—which representative-agents models that rely only on financial or demand shocks cannot jointly account for. Crucially, our model resolves all these puzzles while relying solely on productivity shocks, and thus generates the observed domestic and cross-country macroeconomic comovement.
10.3386/w35448.abstract_zh: 我们证明，将不可保险的反周期收入风险纳入标准国际实际经济周期模型，能够从定性和定量两方面解释开放经济宏观经济学中的数量谜题，即：（i）巴克斯-史密斯谜题、（ii）巴克斯-基欧-基德兰德谜题以及（iii）贸易余额与汇率之间的弱相关性。我们还证明，该模型能同时解释法玛谜题以及高利率国家拥有更强货币的证据——而仅依赖金融或需求冲击的代表性主体模型无法共同解释这些现象。关键在于，我们的模型仅依靠生产率冲击就解决了所有谜题，从而生成了观察到的国内及跨国宏观经济协同波动。
10.3386/w35448.title: The International RBC Model Finally Works!
10.3386/w35448.title_zh: 国际实际经济周期模型终于奏效了！

10.3386/w35449.abstract: Maritime transport remains the backbone of global trade, yet the port and shipping network that carries it has been transformed by containerization and related technological advances. Drawing on newly available granular data---digitized historical shipping records, georeferenced ship movements, and shipment-level routing information---we present five stylized facts on the structure and evolution of the maritime network. Global shipping activity is highly concentrated among a changing lineup of dominant top ports even as lower-ranked ports disperse, while state-owned Chinese port terminal operators increasingly account for these global volumes, boosting overall port operations while delivering efficiency gains mostly to Chinese vessels. We use these facts to organize a synthesis of a fast-growing literature: containerization reshaped which port cities could expand, reinforced hub-and-spoke concentration that yields large but localized welfare gains, embedded ports in multimodal networks that amplify the returns to infrastructure, and generated market power, congestion, and environmental costs. Together, this evidence shows how evolving maritime technologies simultaneously deepen global integration and heighten the economic and geopolitical importance of critical nodes in the transport network---and of who controls them.
10.3386/w35449.abstract_zh: 海上运输仍是全球贸易的支柱，但承载这一运输体系的港口与航运网络已因集装箱化及相关技术进步而发生深刻变革。基于新获取的颗粒化数据——数字化历史航运记录、地理参照船舶轨迹及单次货运路径信息——我们归纳出关于海运网络结构与演变的五个典型事实。全球航运活动高度集中于排名动态变化的头部港口，而低层级港口则呈现分散化趋势；与此同时，中国国有港口码头运营商在全球吞吐量中的占比持续攀升，在提升整体港口运营效率的同时，其效率增益主要惠及中国籍船舶。我们借助这些事实对快速增长的文献进行系统整合：集装箱化重塑了港口城市的扩张空间，强化了枢纽-辐条式集中格局并带来巨大但局部化的福利收益，将港口嵌入多式联运网络从而放大基础设施回报，同时催生了市场势力、拥堵与环境成本。这些证据共同表明，不断演进的海运技术在深化全球一体化的同时，也加剧了运输网络关键节点及其控制者的经济与地缘政治重要性。
10.3386/w35449.title: Ports, Technology and Inter-City Trade: The Economics and Geopolitics of Evolving Maritime Transport Networks
10.3386/w35449.title_zh: 港口、技术与城市间贸易：演变中的海上运输网络的经济学与地缘政治

10.3386/w35450.abstract: In the canonical view of over-the-counter markets, dealers intermediate single-asset trades one at a time. We study a complementary role: when investors trade several assets at once, dealers absorb the joint position into inventory, insuring against execution risk. Using data on the near-universe of Canadian fixed-income trades, we find that bundled transactions account for 20 percent of investor volume. We develop a simple model of why, when, where, and at what prices investors bundle, and use it to explain three patterns. Switches—a purchase paired with a sale—transact at a discount, while uni-directional bundles—all buys or sells—transact at a premium, because a switch’s legs hedge within the dealer’s book while a uni-directional bundle’s compound. Bundling rises with volatility, when insurance against execution risk is most valuable, and the two types sort asymmetrically across bilateral and electronic venues. Together, these patterns reveal a dimension of intermediation the single-asset view overlooks, and one likely to grow in importance.
10.3386/w35450.abstract_zh: 在场外交易市场的经典视角中，交易商一次仅中介单一资产交易。我们研究了一个互补性角色：当投资者同时交易多种资产时，交易商将联合头寸纳入库存，以此对冲执行风险。利用加拿大固定收益市场近乎全量交易数据，我们发现捆绑交易占投资者交易量的20%。我们构建了一个简约模型，解释投资者为何、何时、何地以及以何种价格进行捆绑交易，并以此阐明三种模式。配对交易（买入与卖出组合）以折价成交，而单向捆绑（全买或全卖）则以溢价成交，原因在于配对交易的各腿在交易商账簿内对冲风险，而单向捆绑的各腿则叠加风险。当执行风险对冲价值最高时，捆绑交易随波动率上升而增加，且两类交易在双边与电子交易平台间呈现非对称分布。这些模式共同揭示了单一资产视角所忽视的中介维度，且该维度的重要性预计将持续增长。
10.3386/w35450.title: Bundling Trades In Over-The-Counter Markets
10.3386/w35450.title_zh: 场外交易市场中的捆绑交易

10.3386/w35451.abstract: Using 380 trillion tokens of realized AI consumption across more than four hundred large language models from the licensed proprietary OpenRouter dataset covering approximately 2 percent of current global monthly AI token consumption, we analyze how AI affects firms, markets, and workers. Leveraging the unprecedented size, scope and granularity of this data, we construct the AI Factor from growth in tokens, dollars, and users, estimate firm-level AI Betas from stock return comovement, and characterize the AI Premium. First, we build a high-frequency AI factor and decompose it into salient components. Second, we show that firms whose returns covary more positively with the AI factor—high AI beta firms—earn higher subsequent returns, and the AI premium is large and heterogeneous. A value-weighted longshort strategy earns 64.1 basis points per week, and the premium is large for loadings on the intensive, frontier-oriented margin of AI consumption—closed-source models, paying and seasoned users, and long prompts—but not on casual or open-weight use. Third, the premium reaches beyond technology firms into consumer-facing and capital-heavy parts of the economy, but is absent in emerging markets, including China. Fourth, the AI exposure is more positive in nonroutine interactive work and more negative in analytical, scientific, and operations-control skills—an occupation one standard deviation higher in interaction-and-communication content has 0.36-standard-deviation higher market-implied AI exposure. Additionally, we provide early evidence of the rise of the agentic economy.
10.3386/w35451.abstract_zh: 基于来自授权专有OpenRouter数据集的超过四百个大语言模型的380万亿个实际AI消费token（该数据集覆盖当前全球月度AI token消费量的约2%），我们分析了AI如何影响企业、市场与劳动者。借助该数据前所未有的规模、范围与粒度，我们通过token、美元与用户增长构建了AI因子，从股票收益联动中估计了企业层面的AI贝塔系数，并刻画了AI溢价。首先，我们构建了一个高频AI因子并将其分解为显著成分。其次，我们发现收益与AI因子协方差更正向的企业（高AI贝塔企业）获得更高的后续收益，且AI溢价规模较大且具有异质性。市值加权多空策略每周获得64.1个基点的收益，该溢价在集约型、前沿导向的AI消费边际（闭源模型、付费及资深用户、长提示词）上表现显著，但在随意或开源权重使用中不显著。第三，该溢价不仅存在于科技企业，还延伸至面向消费者和资本密集型经济领域，但在包括中国在内的新兴市场中缺失。第四，AI暴露在非常规互动性工作中更为正向，在分析性、科学性和运营控制技能中更为负向——互动与沟通内容高一个标准差职业的市场隐含AI暴露度高0.36个标准差。此外，我们提供了智能体经济崛起的早期证据。
10.3386/w35451.title: AI Premium

10.3386/w35452.abstract: This scoping review curates empirical research on economic well-being among Latino households in peer reviewed journals from 1990 to 2025, following PRISMA guidelines and a preregistered search strategy. The search yielded more than 5,000 studies revealing a greater than five-fold increase since the early 2000s. The majority of studies examined Medicaid and health insurance and approximately half examined government benefit programs, particularly with respect to eligibility criteria and benefit receipt. Few studies examined the employment outcomes of Latinos in the context of government benefit availability and even fewer focus on Latinos and income support. A deeper content review revealed that studies examining Hispanics are typically through comparative analyses with other racial and ethnic groups. These studies find higher poverty and material hardship, and lower receipt of government benefits, among Latino families relative to non-Latino White households. Fewer studies consider heterogeneity within Hispanic populations. Research on economic well-being among Latino households, as distinct from more general investigations regarding immigrants, expanded in tandem with growth in the Latino population and shifts in social policy. Key policy-relevant open topics of research that affect Latinos include those related to tax credits, benefit generosity, employment, and considerations of mixed-citizen status households.
10.3386/w35452.abstract_zh: 本范围综述遵循PRISMA指南及预注册搜索策略，梳理了1990年至2025年间同行评审期刊中关于拉美裔家庭经济福祉的实证研究。检索共获得5000余项研究，显示自21世纪初以来相关文献数量增长超过五倍。多数研究聚焦医疗补助与健康保险，约半数研究涉及政府福利项目，尤其关注资格标准与福利领取情况。探讨政府福利可及性背景下拉美裔就业结果的研究较少，聚焦拉美裔与收入支持的研究更为稀缺。深入内容审查表明，针对西班牙裔群体的研究通常采用与其他种族/族裔群体的比较分析。这些研究发现，相较于非拉美裔白人家庭，拉美裔家庭面临更高的贫困率和物质匮乏程度，且政府福利领取率较低。考虑西班牙裔群体内部异质性的研究较少。区别于针对移民的普遍性研究，关于拉美裔家庭经济福祉的研究随拉美裔人口增长及社会政策变迁而同步扩展。影响拉美裔群体的关键政策相关开放研究议题包括：税收抵免、福利慷慨度、就业问题及混合公民身份家庭的考量。
10.3386/w35452.title: Economic Well-Being of Latino Households in the U.S.: a Scoping Review of Research on Poverty, the Safety Net, and Family Supports
10.3386/w35452.title_zh: 美国拉丁裔家庭的经济福祉：贫困、安全网与家庭支持研究的范围综述

10.3386/w35453.abstract: Financial sanctions are widely viewed as a powerful tool of economic statecraft, yet direct evidence on their effects remains limited. We study how sanctions affect access to global payment networks using data on correspondent banking relationships, which link banks across countries and currencies to enable cross-border transactions. We first show that the dollar and euro networks offer the broadest global connectivity, supported by a small number of key hubs in the U.S. and Europe. Sanctions that restrict access to these hubs are therefore potentially powerful. We then show how financial sanctions imposed during 2021-2025 – a period of rapid growth in sanctions – reduced targeted banks' access to major-currency networks by severing correspondent relationships. Sanctioned institutions often retained access but only through longer, indirect, and more fragile chains of intermediaries. Finally, in countries where sanctions expanded sharply, non-sanctioned banks also lost connectivity to Western networks, likely reflecting de-risking. These banks reoriented toward alternatives, particularly the Chinese yuan. Outside these heavily sanctioned economies, shifts away from the dollar and toward the yuan remain minimal on average.
10.3386/w35453.abstract_zh: 金融制裁被广泛视为经济治国方略的有力工具，但其影响的直接证据仍然有限。我们利用代理行关系数据研究制裁如何影响全球支付网络的接入——这些关系将不同国家和货币的银行连接起来，以实现跨境交易。我们首先发现，美元和欧元网络提供了最广泛的全球连通性，这得益于美国和欧洲少数关键枢纽的支持。因此，限制这些枢纽接入的制裁具有潜在强大效力。随后，我们展示了2021-2025年间（制裁快速扩张时期）实施的金融制裁如何通过切断代理行关系，削弱目标银行对主要货币网络的接入。受制裁机构往往仍能保留接入渠道，但只能通过更长、间接且更脆弱的中间链条实现。最后，在制裁急剧扩大的国家，未受制裁的银行也失去了与西方网络的连通性，这很可能反映了去风险化行为。这些银行转向替代方案，尤其是人民币。而在这些受严重制裁的经济体之外，从美元转向人民币的总体变化仍微乎其微。
10.3386/w35453.title: Financial Sanctions and the Global Payments Network
10.3386/w35453.title_zh: 金融制裁与全球支付网络

10.3386/w35454.abstract: We examine a choice between bonus contracts offered to dealers of a U.S. auto manufacturer. In our data, dealers select the non-profit-maximizing option in 20 percent of observations, costing the mistaken dealers $18,453 per year on average. We examine how the propensity to make this mistake varies with competition, identified both cross-sectionally and within dealers over time. Both analyses show that greater competition substantially lowers the rate of mistakes. However, even in the most competitive markets, consequential mistakes persist. Our results suggest that competition disciplines mainly through within-dealer changes in behavior rather than entry and exit.
10.3386/w35454.abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国一家汽车制造商向其经销商提供的奖金合同选择。数据显示，在20%的观测中，经销商选择了非利润最大化的选项，平均每年给犯错的经销商造成18,453美元的损失。我们考察了犯错倾向如何随竞争程度变化，这一关系通过截面数据以及经销商随时间变化的内部数据共同识别。两项分析均表明，更激烈的竞争显著降低了错误率。然而，即使在竞争最激烈的市场中，重大错误依然存在。我们的结果表明，竞争主要通过经销商内部行为变化而非市场进入与退出机制发挥约束作用。
10.3386/w35454.title: Competition and Anomalies Redux: Evidence from U.S. Auto Dealers
10.3386/w35454.title_zh: 竞争与异常再探：来自美国汽车经销商的证据

10.3386/w35455.abstract: We study how residential-commercial zoning affects the allocation of urban space. Using property-level data from Taipei and 34 U.S. metropolitan areas, we infer neighborhood-level zoning wedges from the allocation of residents, workers, and floor space. We find substantially greater dispersion in these wedges in U.S. cities than in Taipei, where mixed-use development is pervasive. The inferred wedges increase neighborhood specialization and reduce welfare. We then evaluate whether zoning is aligned with the neighborhood characteristics that would justify intervention. Although zoning is systematically related to comparative advantage, comparative advantage explains only a small fraction of the variation in zoning. The dominant effect of zoning in American cities is therefore not to promote efficient land use, but to increase the segregation of residential and commercial activity across neighborhoods.
10.3386/w35455.abstract_zh: 本文研究住宅-商业分区如何影响城市空间的配置。利用台北及美国34个大都市区的房产层面数据，我们从居民、劳动者及楼面空间的配置中推断出社区层面的分区楔子。研究发现，美国城市中这些楔子的离散程度显著高于混合用途开发普遍存在的台北。推断出的楔子加剧了社区专业化并降低了社会福利。随后，我们评估分区是否与可证明干预合理性的社区特征相一致。尽管分区与比较优势存在系统性关联，但比较优势仅能解释分区变化的极小部分。因此，美国城市中分区的主导作用并非促进土地高效利用，而是加剧了住宅与商业活动在社区间的隔离。
10.3386/w35455.title: Zoning: Externalities or Misallocation?
10.3386/w35455.title_zh: 分区：外部性还是资源错配？

10.3386/w35456.abstract: Both historically and today, support of aging parents has largely taken the form of in-kind transfers that require physical proximity, such as housing and caregiving. If Social Security substitutes for such support, it can relax constraints on where recipients' children live and work. We investigate the long-run intergenerational effects of the early Social Security program, exploiting within-occupation, cross-industry differences in coverage and a new dataset linking parents to their children's later-life outcomes. We find that sons whose parents had greater predicted coverage moved farther from their childhood homes, earned more, and lived in better neighborhoods late in life. We find no such effects for daughters, who tended to provide forms of support less easily replaced by Social Security. The gains considerably exceeded the associated Social Security benefits for the average family, with migration to better-matched labor markets a likely key driver. We propose that the early program enabled families to realize gains from migration that were back-loaded, uncertain, and difficult to contract on.
10.3386/w35456.abstract_zh: 无论历史上还是当今，赡养年迈父母主要采取需要物理邻近性的实物转移形式，例如提供住房和照料。若社会保障制度替代了此类支持，则可缓解对受赡养者子女居住地和工作地点的约束。我们利用早期社会保障计划在职业内部、行业之间的覆盖差异，并结合将父母与其子女晚年生活状况相关联的新数据集，研究了该计划的长期代际效应。研究发现，父母预期保障覆盖率较高的家庭中，儿子成年后远离童年居住地、收入更高且晚年居住社区条件更优。但此类效应对女儿并不显著——女儿往往提供更难以被社会保障替代的支持形式。对普通家庭而言，这些收益远超其获得的社会保障福利，而迁移至更匹配的劳动力市场很可能是关键驱动因素。我们认为，早期计划使家庭能够实现迁移带来的滞后性、不确定且难以契约化的收益。
10.3386/w35456.title: Long-Run Intergenerational Effects of Social Security
10.3386/w35456.title_zh: 社会保障的长期代际效应

10.3386/w35457.abstract: Discrete choice experiments are widely used to estimate workers’ willingness to pay (WTP) for job amenities under the assumption that varying an attribute does not change workers’ beliefs about other job attributes. We test this assumption by embedding an amenity with a known market price—a popular monthly public transport pass—in a largescale discrete choice experiment with German workers. Many workers, including public transport users, overvalue the ticket by more than 100%, despite WTP for other attributes aligning with the literature. A complementary belief-elicitation experiment shows that advertising an amenity, such as the pass but also common amenities like work from home, causally shifts beliefs about unlisted attributes of the job. Posted wages similarly signal unlisted attributes so that wage variation, the money metric for WTP calculation, is itself contaminated by belief spillovers—such as higher pay signaling heightened stress. These spillovers imply that discrete choice estimates capture perceived bundles rather than isolated attributes, and distort current estimates of non-wage compensation and monopsony power.
10.3386/w35457.abstract_zh: 离散选择实验被广泛用于估算工人对工作福利的支付意愿，其前提假设是改变某一属性不会改变工人对其他工作属性的信念。我们通过将一项具有已知市场价格的福利——德国广受欢迎的月度公共交通通票——嵌入针对德国工人的大规模离散选择实验来检验这一假设。结果显示，许多工人（包括公共交通使用者）对该通票的估值高出实际价值100%以上，尽管对其他属性的支付意愿与现有文献一致。一项补充性的信念诱导实验表明，宣传某项福利（如通票，也包括居家办公等常见福利）会因果性地改变工人对工作未列明属性的信念。同样，公布的工资水平也会传递未列明属性的信号，因此作为支付意愿计算货币尺度的工资变动本身也受到信念溢出效应的影响——例如高薪可能意味着更高的工作压力。这些溢出效应意味着离散选择实验的估计结果捕捉到的是感知到的福利组合而非孤立属性，从而扭曲了当前对非工资补偿和买方垄断势力的估算。
10.3386/w35457.title: Job Ads as Signals: Evidence from a Priced Amenity and Worker Beliefs
10.3386/w35457.title_zh: 职位广告作为信号：来自定价福利与工人信念的证据

10.3386/w35458.abstract: Firms often rebrand to counter negative shocks, but can it work? Using a historical natural experiment, we analyze a large sample of companies from the same industry (banking) that shared very similar names, but overwhelmingly decided to change them in response to a common, negative news shock. U.S. entry into World War I in 1917 created a sudden anti-German backlash against anything that invoked an association with the now enemy. The shock itself was thus orthogonal to bank fundamentals and pre-existing trends, but pushed banks to reconsider their brands. After 1917, the few German-named banks that kept their tainted names saw significant declines in assets, deposits, and market share relative to other banks. However, German-named banks that rebranded mitigated much of the negative shock. Specifically, German-named banks that adopted a new non-ethnic brand name avoided between 75% and 85% of the anti-German effect, and those that adopted a new patriotic brand name were able to neutralize it completely. Overall, we find that “crisis rebranding” paid off in our historical setting regardless of the chosen brand, with patriotic rebranding proving the most effective at offsetting the exogenous shock.
10.3386/w35458.abstract_zh: 企业常通过品牌重塑应对负面冲击，但这一策略是否有效？借助历史自然实验，我们分析了同一行业（银行业）中大量名称高度相似的公司样本，这些公司因共同遭遇负面新闻冲击而普遍决定更名。1917年美国加入第一次世界大战，引发针对一切与敌国关联事物的突发性反德浪潮。该冲击本身与银行基本面及既有趋势正交，却迫使银行重新审视其品牌。1917年后，少数保留污名化德文名称的银行，其资产、存款及市场份额相较于其他银行显著下滑。然而，实施品牌重塑的德文名称银行有效缓解了大部分负面冲击：采用非族裔新品牌的银行规避了75%至85%的反德效应，而采用爱国新品牌的银行则完全抵消了这一冲击。总体而言，无论选择何种品牌，历史情境下的"危机品牌重塑"均取得成效，其中爱国品牌重塑在抵消外生冲击方面效果最为显著。
10.3386/w35458.title: Banking on a Corporate Rebrand

10.3386/w35459.abstract: We revisit fiscal sustainability through the lens of the government’s budget constraint. What constrains fiscal policy is not the stock of outstanding liabilities per se, but the fiscal cost of servicing debt. Using two centuries of U.S. fiscal data (1800–2023) and a long-run panel of advanced economies, we show that primary surpluses are systematically more closely associated with debt-service burdens, while debt ratios lose explanatory power when debt service is taken into account. Fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate, specifically when the interest-growth differential is positive. We rationalize these findings using a simple flow-based framework in which debt stabilization depends on the responsiveness of fiscal surpluses to financing pressures. The results suggest that fiscal sustainability depends less on debt thresholds than on financing regimes and governments’ ability to absorb debt-service burdens.
10.3386/w35459.abstract_zh: 我们通过政府预算约束的视角重新审视财政可持续性问题。制约财政政策的并非未偿债务存量本身，而是偿债的财政成本。基于美国两个世纪（1800-2023年）的财政数据以及发达经济体的长期面板数据，我们表明：基本盈余与偿债负担之间存在系统性更强的关联，而当考虑偿债成本时，债务比率对财政行为的解释力显著下降。当融资条件恶化时——特别是当利率-增长率差值为正时——财政响应会显著增强。我们通过一个基于流量分析的简单框架对这些发现进行理论解释：在该框架中，债务稳定取决于财政盈余对融资压力的响应程度。研究结果表明，财政可持续性更多取决于融资机制及政府吸收偿债负担的能力，而非债务阈值本身。
10.3386/w35459.title: From Stocks to Flows: Debt Service and Fiscal Sustainability
10.3386/w35459.title_zh: 从存量到流量：债务服务与财政可持续性

10.3386/w35460.abstract: We analyze collaborative experimentation across multiple independent domains. Each domain contains infinitely many potential projects with asymmetric benefits. In each period and in each domain, two players can idle, jointly explore a new project, or jointly exploit a known one, with voluntary transfers. For intermediate discount factors, treating domains as independent during experimentation is suboptimal. The optimal experimentation policy exhibits common features of collaborative experimentation: lengthy exploration, temporary project exploitation, recall of past projects, and inefficient initial or terminal idling within certain domains. We connect these findings to research on buyer-supplier dynamics and persistent productivity differences.
10.3386/w35460.abstract_zh: 我们分析了跨多个独立领域的协作实验。每个领域包含无限多个具有不对称收益的潜在项目。在每个时期和每个领域，两名参与者可以选择闲置、共同探索新项目或共同利用已知项目，并允许自愿转移。对于中等折现因子，在实验过程中将各领域视为独立是次优的。最优实验策略展现出协作实验的共同特征：长时间的探索、临时性的项目利用、对过往项目的回溯，以及某些领域内低效的初始或终端闲置。我们将这些发现与买方-供应商动态及持续生产率差异的研究联系起来。
10.3386/w35460.title: Multi-Project Collaborations

10.3386/w35461.abstract: We develop a simple and intuitive Pigouvian perspective on optimal trade policy. Our approach unifies a wide range of rationales for taxing trade, from the classical optimal tariff argument to contemporary debates about global carbon emissions and geopolitics. We also clarify when trade policy intervention is warranted and when alternative domestic instruments should be used instead.
10.3386/w35461.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种简单直观的庇古视角下的最优贸易政策。该方法统一了从经典最优关税理论到当代关于全球碳排放与地缘政治辩论的广泛贸易征税理由。同时，我们阐明了何时应实施贸易政策干预，以及何时应改用其他国内政策工具。
10.3386/w35461.title: Should We Tax Trade? A Pigouvian Perspective
10.3386/w35461.title_zh: 我们是否应该对贸易征税？庇古视角

10.3386/w35462.abstract: We investigate the short- and long-run impacts of unexpected mortality on psychosocial health in the context of a large-scale high-mortality natural disaster, the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami. The effects of the tsunami-related mortality measured at the community level are contrasted with the effects of individual-specific loss of close kin using population-representative longitudinal survey data from the Study of the Tsunami Aftermath and Recovery. In the short-run, two years post-tsunami, both community and individual-level mortality exposures are significant predictors of elevated depression and post-traumatic stress symtoms. In the longer-run, ten years post-tsunami, individual-level exposures are slightly attenuated but remain significant predictors of both psychosocial health measures; in contrast, community-level mortality predicts post-traumatic stress but not depression symptoms. Mortality is linked to smaller household sizes in the short- and long-run and to less social support in the long-run, although the latter effect differs substantially for males and females. The estimates adjust for other tsunami exposure measures and, in the individual-level analyses, we compare people living in the same community at the time of the tsunami who were exposed to the same community-level mortality rate.
10.3386/w35462.abstract_zh: 本文以2004年印度洋地震海啸这一大规模高死亡率自然灾害为背景，考察意外死亡对心理社会健康的短期与长期影响。通过使用"海啸后果与恢复研究"中具有人口代表性的纵向调查数据，我们将社区层面测量的海啸相关死亡率影响与个体层面近亲丧失的影响进行对比。在短期（海啸后两年）内，社区与个体层面的死亡暴露均是抑郁症状与创伤后应激症状加剧的显著预测因子。在长期（海啸后十年）内，个体层面暴露的影响虽略有减弱，但仍对两项心理健康指标具有显著预测作用；相比之下，社区层面死亡率仅能预测创伤后应激症状，而非抑郁症状。死亡率与短期及长期的家庭规模缩小相关，并与长期的社会支持减少相关，但后者在男女性别间存在显著差异。本研究在估计中调整了其他海啸暴露指标，并在个体层面分析中，比较了海啸发生时居住于同一社区且面临相同社区死亡率的居民。
10.3386/w35462.title: Psychosocial Health and Well-Being After A Mortality Shock
10.3386/w35462.title_zh: 死亡率冲击后的社会心理健康与福祉

10.3386/w35463.abstract: Emerging market economies (EMEs) have historically been vulnerable to external shocks. Recently the global economy has experienced several major shocks yet EMEs have been remarkably resilient. Some of this improved performance can be attributed to prudent policies and stronger economic fundamentals, but the existing literature points to an overperformance mystery by some EMEs with weaker fundamentals. We evaluate an alternative measure of vulnerability based on the concept of a natural level of capital flows (KF*). Specifically, we hypothesize that EMEs are more vulnerable when prior to a large global shock capital flows—portfolio inflows, to be specific—exceed KF*. Results indicate that for major global shocks over the past two decades the pre-shock gap between actual portfolio and KF* has substantial predictive power for the post-shock performance of EMEs.
10.3386/w35463.abstract_zh: 新兴市场经济体（EMEs）历来易受外部冲击影响。近年来全球经济经历多次重大冲击，但新兴市场经济体展现出显著韧性。这种表现的改善部分可归因于审慎的政策和更坚实的经济基本面，但现有文献指出，部分基本面较弱的新兴市场经济体存在"表现超常之谜"。我们基于资本流动自然水平（KF*）概念，评估了一种替代性脆弱性指标。具体而言，我们假设当重大全球冲击发生前，资本流动（特别是证券投资流入）超过KF*时，新兴市场经济体将更为脆弱。研究结果表明，过去二十年间的重大全球冲击中，冲击前实际证券投资与KF*之间的缺口，对新兴市场经济体冲击后的表现具有显著预测能力。
10.3386/w35463.title: Mind the KF* Gap: EME Vulnerabilities to Global Shocks
10.3386/w35463.title_zh: 注意KF*缺口：新兴市场经济体对全球冲击的脆弱性

10.3386/w35464.abstract: The growing prevalence of cognitive impairment (CI) is one of the main drivers of age-related demand for health and long-term care (LTC). In Spain, CI is estimated to affect 18.5% of Spaniards over 65, and 45.3% in those aged 85 and above. This paper draws on a pooled pre-COVID data from a longitudinal sample of individuals aged 65+ to examine the effect of CI and physical limitations on health and long-term care utilisation, estimates its costs, and financial burden. We report four sets of findings. First, we find that socioeconomic status at older age to be the strongest predictor of CI. Second, while both CI and physical limitations increase health and care adult care use, physical impairment is a stronger predictor of overall care utilisation (73% versus 55% for CI alone) and nursing home residence (2.0% versus 0.9%). Third, informal caregiving constitutes the overwhelming majority of dementia costs, accounting for 69–81% of the total. Finally, we estimate that the replacement cost of informal care would exhaust the full budget of Spain’s LTC system (SAAD).
10.3386/w35464.abstract_zh: 认知障碍（CI）患病率的持续上升是老龄化相关健康与长期护理（LTC）需求的主要驱动因素之一。在西班牙，65岁以上人群的CI患病率估计为18.5%，85岁以上人群则高达45.3%。本文利用新冠疫情前65岁以上个体纵向追踪样本的合并数据，考察认知障碍与身体机能限制对健康及长期护理服务利用的影响，并估算其成本与经济负担。研究得出四组发现：第一，老年阶段的社会经济地位是认知障碍的最强预测因子；第二，尽管认知障碍与身体机能限制均会增加健康与成人护理服务的使用，但身体机能受损对整体护理服务利用（单纯CI组为55%，身体受损组为73%）及养老院入住率（0.9%对比2.0%）的预测效力更强；第三，非正式照护构成痴呆症护理成本的绝对主体，占总成本的69%-81%；第四，我们估算非正式照护的替代成本将耗尽西班牙长期护理体系（SAAD）的全部预算。
10.3386/w35464.title: Long Term Care and Cognitive Impairment in Spain
10.3386/w35464.title_zh: 西班牙长期护理与认知障碍

10.3386/w35465.abstract: This paper studies social insurance with imperfect eligibility screening, focusing on Unemployment Insurance (UI) during its expansion in 2020 and 2021. We study the extent of imperfect screening by identifying anomalous payments using administrative tax data and UI policies, finding $214 billion in potentially-improper payments—concentrated in the Pandemic Unemployment Assistance (PUA) program—with approximately half detectable ex-ante through improved federal-state data sharing. There is substantial geographic variation, and a border design shows this is partly due to policy decisions made by states. To assess the implications for optimal policy, we first conduct simulations that replace PUA with means-tested, lump-sum transfers, finding that these transfers would have better insured against income losses at lower administrative cost. Second, we develop a model of opt-in versus automatic transfers that shows the targeting advantage of opt-in programs can reverse when ineligible recipients pass the benefit screen. Calibrated to 2020 UI, the model implies that shifting toward automatic transfers would have increased social welfare.
10.3386/w35465.abstract_zh: 本文研究了资格筛查不完善条件下的社会保险问题，重点关注2020至2021年失业保险（UI）扩张期间的情况。我们通过利用行政税务数据和失业保险政策识别异常支付，探究了筛查不完善的程度，发现存在2140亿美元的潜在不当支付——主要集中在疫情失业援助（PUA）项目中——其中约半数可通过改进联邦与州之间的数据共享实现事前检测。这些支付存在显著的地域差异，而边界设计分析表明，这在一定程度上源于各州制定的政策决策。为评估最优政策的影响，我们首先进行模拟，用基于经济状况调查的定额转移支付替代PUA项目，发现这些转移支付能以更低的行政成本更好地保障收入损失。其次，我们构建了一个选择性加入与自动转移支付模型，表明当不合格受助者通过福利筛查时，选择性加入项目的瞄准优势可能发生逆转。基于2020年失业保险数据的校准结果显示，转向自动转移支付本可提升社会福利。
10.3386/w35465.title: Social Insurance with Imperfect Eligibility Screening: Theory and Evidence from Pandemic UI
10.3386/w35465.title_zh: 不完全资格筛查下的社会保险：理论与来自疫情失业救济的证据

10.3386/w35466.abstract: We interpret exchange rate and yield curve responses to the April 2, 2025 U.S. tariff announcement through the lens of an equilibrium model capturing the portfolio balance mechanism. Disciplined by price elasticities from QE announcements, a 3-12% decline in the demand for dollar bonds (relative to annual U.S. GDP) accounts for the dollar depreciation and rise in dollar yields during this episode. News of a gradual rebalancing out of dollar bonds is consistent with immediate price impact since asset prices are forward-looking. Lower dollar bond demand was accompanied by higher risk aversion, which explains the cross-section of responses across currencies.
10.3386/w35466.abstract_zh: 我们通过一个捕捉投资组合平衡机制的均衡模型，解读2025年4月2日美国关税公告对汇率和收益率曲线的影响。基于量化宽松公告中的价格弹性约束，美元债券需求（相对于美国年度GDP）下降3%-12%，解释了这一时期美元贬值和美元收益率上升的现象。由于资产价格具有前瞻性，美元债券逐步再平衡的消息与即期价格冲击效应一致。美元债券需求下降伴随着风险厌恶情绪上升，这解释了不同货币之间反应的截面差异。
10.3386/w35466.title: What Do Asset Prices in April 2025 Say About Demand for the Dollar?
10.3386/w35466.title_zh: 2025年4月资产价格对美元需求的启示

10.3386/w35467.abstract: We provide descriptive evidence on women's experiences in platform-based driving and delivery work using survey and administrative data from India and Indonesia. Partnering with major two-wheeler platforms, we study representative samples of drivers, oversampling women to examine gender differences (India: 404 women, 2,153 men; Indonesia: 892 women, 2,114 men). Female participation is extremely low -- 0.8% in India and 1.5% in Indonesia -- consistent with barriers related to safety concerns, cultural norms, and limited access to required assets. Among women who do enter, platform work is used differently than by men: women work fewer hours, are more likely to log in during free time, and place greater value on flexibility and supplemental earnings. Women earn less per hour than men -- by 6-8% in India and 8-22% in Indonesia -- differences that align with gendered choices over working times, locations, and service types, likely shaped by safety and domestic constraints. Women also face distinct challenges: higher reported harassment in both countries and, in Indonesia, widespread customer discrimination and higher accident rates. At the same time, a disproportionate share of women were unemployed before joining the platform, and women are more likely than men to report higher current earnings relative to prior work. Together, the evidence highlights how flexibility coexists with persistent gender-specific risks, constraints, and unequal returns in location-based platform work in low- and middle-income country contexts.
10.3386/w35467.abstract_zh: 我们利用印度和印度尼西亚的调查与行政数据，提供了关于女性在平台化驾驶和配送工作中经历的描述性证据。通过与主要两轮车平台合作，我们研究了具有代表性的司机样本，并超额抽样女性以考察性别差异（印度：404名女性，2,153名男性；印度尼西亚：892名女性，2,114名男性）。女性参与率极低——印度为0.8%，印度尼西亚为1.5%——这与安全顾虑、文化规范以及所需资产获取受限等障碍一致。在已进入该行业的女性中，她们对平台工作的使用方式与男性不同：女性工作时间更短，更倾向于在空闲时间登录，并更重视灵活性和补充性收入。女性每小时收入低于男性——印度低6-8%，印度尼西亚低8-22%——这些差异与性别化的工作时间、地点和服务类型选择相一致，这些选择很可能受到安全和家庭约束的影响。女性还面临独特的挑战：两国均报告了更高的骚扰发生率，而在印度尼西亚，还存在普遍的客户歧视和更高的事故率。与此同时，加入平台前失业的女性比例过高，且与男性相比，女性更倾向于报告当前收入高于先前工作。综合来看，这些证据凸显了在中低收入国家的基于位置的平台工作中，灵活性如何与持续存在的性别特定风险、约束及不平等回报并存。
10.3386/w35467.title: Women in the Platform Economy: Descriptive Evidence from Drivers in India and Indonesia
10.3386/w35467.title_zh: 平台经济中的女性：来自印度和印尼司机的描述性证据

10.3386/w35468.abstract: We revisit the classic identification problem of separating supply and demand for a homogeneous good using data from multiple markets. We allow markets to be heterogeneous according to unobservables, a feature that arises if there are unobservable differences in consumer preferences or firm technology. We develop a new identification analysis based on hypothetical market types. We use this analysis to show how nonparametric, economically motivated assumptions carry empirical restrictions for a wide range of target parameters, including elasticities, but also welfare parameters, such as consumer surplus. Then, we develop computationally tractable methods for implementing partially identified linear random coefficients models in which the slopes of supply and demand are heterogeneous. We apply these methods to estimate the welfare impact and incidence of sales taxes in the United States.
10.3386/w35468.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了利用多市场数据分离同质商品供给与需求的经典识别问题。我们允许市场根据不可观测因素存在异质性——当消费者偏好或企业技术存在不可观测差异时便会产生这一特征。基于假设性市场类型，我们发展出新的识别分析方法。通过该方法，我们展示了非参数化、具有经济学动机的假设如何对包括弹性在内的广泛目标参数，以及消费者剩余等福利参数施加经验约束。随后，我们开发了计算可操作的方法，用于实现供给与需求斜率存在异质性的部分识别线性随机系数模型。我们应用这些方法估算了美国销售税的福利影响与归宿。
10.3386/w35468.title: Supply and Demand with Market Heterogeneity
10.3386/w35468.title_zh: 市场异质性下的供给与需求

10.3982/ecta20506.abstract: <jats:p>Customs data reveal the heterogeneity and granularity of relationships among buyers and sellers, showing how more exports to a destination break down into more firms selling there and more buyers per exporter. We develop a quantitative general equilibrium model of firm‐to‐firm matching that builds on this insight to separate the roles of iceberg costs and matching frictions in gravity. In the cross section, we find matching frictions as important as iceberg costs in impeding trade, and more sensitive to distance. Because domestic and imported intermediates compete directly with labor in performing production tasks, our model also fits the heterogeneity of labor shares across French producers. Applying the framework to the 2004 expansion of the European Union, reduced iceberg costs and reduced matching frictions contributed equally to the increase in French exports to the new members. While workers benefited overall, those competing most directly with imports gained less, even losing in some countries entering the EU.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta20506.abstract_zh: 海关数据揭示了买卖双方关系的异质性和颗粒度，显示对某一目的地的出口增长如何分解为更多企业在该地销售以及每个出口商拥有更多买家。我们构建了一个企业间匹配的量化一般均衡模型，基于这一洞察，将冰山成本与匹配摩擦在引力模型中的作用分离开来。在横截面分析中，我们发现匹配摩擦在阻碍贸易方面与冰山成本同等重要，且对距离更为敏感。由于国内和进口中间品在生产任务中直接与劳动力竞争，我们的模型也拟合了法国各企业劳动份额的异质性。将该框架应用于2004年欧盟扩张，冰山成本的降低与匹配摩擦的减少对法国向新成员国出口增长的贡献相当。尽管工人整体受益，但与进口竞争最直接的工人获益较少，甚至在部分加入欧盟的国家中遭受损失。
10.3982/ecta20506.title: Firm‐to‐Firm Trade: Imports, Exports, and the Labor Market
10.3982/ecta20506.title_zh: 企业间贸易：进口、出口与劳动力市场

10.3982/ecta21839.abstract: <jats:p>This paper explores the impact of information design on the auctioneer's revenue in the U.S. offshore oil/gas lease auctions where, post‐auction, the winner decides whether to explore the auctioned tract and must pay the government a royalty on its production value. I first document that there is a positive correlation between the exploration rate and publicly observed losing bids. This suggests that the winning bidder uses the rivals' bids to infer their private information about the tract's potential. I then characterize the equilibrium bidding strategy when the auctioneer designs and commits to how to reveal information on losing bids to the winning bidder. Counterfactual exercises reveal that alternative bid disclosure policies significantly improve auctioneer revenue.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta21839.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了信息设计对美国海上油气租赁拍卖中拍卖方收益的影响。在拍卖结束后，中标者需决定是否对拍卖地块进行勘探，并须按其生产价值向政府支付特许权使用费。我首先发现，勘探率与公开观察到的未中标报价之间存在正相关关系。这表明，中标者利用竞争对手的报价来推断其关于地块潜力的私人信息。随后，我刻画了当拍卖方设计并承诺如何向中标者披露未中标报价信息时的均衡投标策略。反事实分析表明，替代性的报价披露政策能够显著提高拍卖方收益。
10.3982/ecta21839.title: Information Design in Common Value Auction With Moral Hazard: Application to OCS Leasing Auctions
10.3982/ecta21839.title_zh: 道德风险下的共同价值拍卖信息设计：在OCS租赁拍卖中的应用

10.3982/ecta21926.abstract: <jats:p>Personalizing policies can theoretically increase their effectiveness. However, personalization is difficult when individual types are unobservable and the preferences of policymakers and individuals are not aligned, which could cause individuals to misreport their type. Mechanism design offers a strategy to overcome this issue: offer an “incentive‐compatible” menu of policy choices designed to induce participants to select the variant intended for their type. Using a field experiment that personalized incentives for exercise among 6,800 adults with diabetes and hypertension in urban India, we show that personalizing with an incentive‐compatible choice menu substantially improves program performance, increasing the treatment effect of incentives on exercise by 80% without increasing incentive costs relative to a one‐size‐fits‐all benchmark. Offering choice achieves similar performance to personalizing with an extensive set of observable variables, but without the same data requirements.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta21926.abstract_zh: 个性化政策在理论上可以提升其有效性。然而，当个体类型不可观测，且政策制定者与个体的偏好不一致时，个性化难以实现，因为这可能导致个体虚报其类型。机制设计提供了一种解决该问题的策略：提供一份“激励相容”的政策选择菜单，旨在引导参与者选择针对其类型设计的方案。通过在印度城市地区对6800名患有糖尿病和高血压的成年人进行一项实地实验，我们证明，采用激励相容的选择菜单进行个性化激励，能显著提升项目绩效：与一刀切的基准方案相比，在不增加激励成本的情况下，将激励对锻炼的处理效应提高了80%。提供选择菜单所达到的效果，与利用大量可观测变量进行个性化处理的效果相当，但无需相同的数据要求。
10.3982/ecta21926.title: Mechanism Design for Personalized Policy: A Field Experiment Incentivizing Exercise
10.3982/ecta21926.title_zh: 个性化政策的机制设计：一项激励运动的实地实验

10.3982/ecta22110.abstract: <jats:p>I document that the right tail of the firm size distribution systematically thickens with economic development. To rationalize this fact, I develop a parsimonious idea search model in which both aggregate growth and the firm size distribution are endogenously determined. The model features an asymptotic balanced growth path along which Gibrat's law holds at each date, and the right tail of the firm size distribution thickens monotonically toward Zipf's law. The model also implies that policies favoring large firms can improve welfare by better utilizing the diffusion externalities arising from idea search.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta22110.abstract_zh: 本文发现，企业规模分布的右尾随经济发展系统性增厚。为解释这一事实，我构建了一个简约的思想搜寻模型，其中总量增长与企业规模分布均为内生决定。该模型具有渐进平衡增长路径特征，在此路径上各期均满足吉布拉定律，且企业规模分布的右尾单调增厚直至趋近齐普夫定律。模型还表明，偏好大企业的政策可通过更充分利用思想搜寻产生的扩散外部性来提升社会福利。
10.3982/ecta22110.title: Economic Growth and the Rise of Large Firms
10.3982/ecta22110.title_zh: 经济增长与大型企业的崛起

10.3982/ecta22451.abstract: <jats:p>We construct a dynamic integrated assessment model of climate and the economy with very high geographic resolution. Migration is free within, but not allowed across, countries. The model parameterization uses a wealth of data, including the distribution of output, population, energy sources and use, and estimates of the local damages from climate change. It implies very large geographic dispersion in damages from warming. We conduct three kinds of policy experiments. In one, we note that a modest, uniform carbon tax limits global warming and damages around the world substantially. In a second experiment, we let the poorest countries not tax carbon, while the rest compensate by setting higher taxes; the efficiency losses are large. In a final experiment, we find that fast green technology growth alone is a poor substitute for carbon taxes, whether globally available or not.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta22451.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个具有极高地理分辨率的动态气候与经济综合评估模型。模型设定中，人口可在国家内部自由迁移，但禁止跨国流动。模型参数化过程运用了丰富的数据集，包括产出分布、人口分布、能源来源与使用情况，以及气候变化对各地造成的损失估算。该模型揭示了全球变暖损失在地理分布上的巨大差异性。我们开展了三类政策实验：其一，适度的统一碳税能够显著抑制全球变暖并大幅降低全球损失；其二，若允许最贫困国家免征碳税，而其他国家通过提高税率进行补偿，则会产生巨大的效率损失；其三，我们发现，无论绿色技术是否实现全球普及，仅靠其快速增长都无法有效替代碳税政策。
10.3982/ecta22451.title: Walras–Bowley Lecture: Climate Policy in the Wide World
10.3982/ecta22451.title_zh: 瓦尔拉斯-鲍利讲座：广阔世界中的气候政策

10.3982/ecta22542.abstract: <jats:p>This paper develops a macroeconomic model that combines an incomplete‐markets overlapping‐generations economy with a job ladder featuring sequential wage bargaining, endogenous search effort of employed and non‐employed workers, and differences in match quality. With these ingredients, our model provides a joint microfoundation for the three main inputs in aggregate production: capital, employment, and labor efficiency. The calibrated model offers a good fit to the empirical age profiles of search activity, job‐finding rates, wages, and savings. We use the model to analyze the impact of tax and transfer policies for labor market dynamics and aggregate economic activity via capital, employment, and labor efficiency channels. Lower unemployment benefits and a less progressive tax schedule bring about welfare losses for a newborn worker which are mainly driven by higher consumption risk and costlier search effort; both policies have differential effects along the age, income, and wealth dimensions.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta22542.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个宏观经济学模型，该模型将不完全市场的世代交叠经济与包含序贯工资谈判、就业与非就业工人内生搜寻努力以及匹配质量差异的工作阶梯相结合。基于这些要素，我们的模型为总生产中的三个主要投入——资本、就业和劳动效率——提供了统一的微观基础。校准后的模型较好地拟合了搜寻活动、工作找到率、工资和储蓄的年龄分布经验特征。我们利用该模型分析税收与转移支付政策通过资本、就业和劳动效率渠道对劳动力市场动态及总体经济活动的影响。降低失业救济金和减少税收累进性会给新生工人带来福利损失，这主要源于更高的消费风险和更昂贵的搜寻努力；这两种政策在年龄、收入和财富维度上具有差异化效应。
10.3982/ecta22542.title: Job Ladder and Wealth Dynamics in General Equilibrium
10.3982/ecta22542.title_zh: 一般均衡中的职业阶梯与财富动态

10.3982/ecta22979.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    The U.S. Supreme Court's 2010 decision in
                    <jats:italic>Citizens United v. Federal Election Commission</jats:italic>
                    deregulated campaign finance, enabling the rise of a new political action committee (the Super PAC) with broad freedom to raise and spend money. This led to an unprecedented surge in spending in primary and general elections. To evaluate the impact of Super PACs, I estimate a multistage model of political competition using data from U.S. Congressional elections between 2010 and 2020. I find that Super PAC spending by both sides prompts offsetting responses, resulting in limited net equilibrium effects. However, by amplifying the role of donors, Super PACs still have the potential to reshape the electoral landscape.
                  </jats:p>
10.3982/ecta22979.abstract_zh: 美国最高法院2010年就"联合公民诉联邦选举委员会案"作出的裁决放松了对竞选资金的监管，催生了一种新型政治行动委员会（超级政治行动委员会），使其在筹款和支出方面拥有广泛自由。这导致初选和大选中的支出出现前所未有的激增。为评估超级政治行动委员会的影响，我利用2010年至2020年美国国会选举数据，估计了一个多阶段政治竞争模型。研究发现，双方超级政治行动委员会的支出会引发对冲性反应，导致均衡效应有限。然而，通过放大捐赠者的作用，超级政治行动委员会仍有可能重塑选举格局。
10.3982/ecta22979.title: The Equilibrium Effects of Campaign Finance Deregulation on U.S. Elections
10.3982/ecta22979.title_zh: 竞选财务放松管制对美国选举的均衡效应

10.3982/ecta23049.abstract: <jats:p>We consider a dynamic buyer–seller interaction. Instead of the buyer's valuation, it is the frequency with which he needs to trade that is the buyer's private information. The difference matters. With commitment, full surplus extraction is possible, for instance via limited‐time offers. Without commitment, ratcheting is mitigated, as not buying is not necessarily a sign of strength. Because time is informative, the seller learns and may adjust her behavior over time. When finding a suitable alternative seller is easy, she starts with a pooling offer before permanently switching to a screening offer. When finding a suitable alternative seller takes time, she starts with a pooling offer before occasionally experimenting with separating offers.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23049.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种动态的买卖双方互动关系。与买方估值不同，买方需要交易的频率才是其私人信息。这一差异至关重要。在有承诺的情况下，完全剩余提取是可能的，例如通过限时报价。在没有承诺的情况下，棘轮效应得到缓解，因为不购买并不一定意味着买方处于强势地位。由于时间具有信息价值，卖方会随着时间推移学习并可能调整其行为。当寻找合适的替代卖方较为容易时，她会先提出混合报价，然后永久转向筛选报价。当寻找合适的替代卖方需要时间时，她会先提出混合报价，然后偶尔尝试分离报价。
10.3982/ecta23049.title: Dynamic Screening of Buyers With Heterogeneous Purchase Frequency
10.3982/ecta23049.title_zh: 异质性购买频率下买家的动态筛选

10.3982/ecta23174.abstract: <jats:p>We study instrumental variables models characterized by: (i) Unobserved heterogeneity consisting of potential outcomes and response types that describe how the instrument determines treatment choice; (ii) Conditional independence of the instrument and the unobserved heterogeneity; and (iii) Convex restrictions on the distribution of unobserved heterogeneity. We show certain causal parameters are identified in these models if and only if a version of the kappa of Abadie (2003) exists. Our identification results are constructive in yielding estimating moment conditions. Focusing on a leading special case, we develop asymptotically normal estimators based on a doubly robust version of these moment conditions.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23174.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有以下特征的工具变量模型：（i）未观测异质性由潜在结果和描述工具如何决定处理选择的响应类型构成；（ii）工具与未观测异质性条件独立；（iii）未观测异质性分布满足凸性约束。我们证明，当且仅当Abadie（2003）的kappa统计量存在时，这些模型中的某些因果参数可被识别。我们的识别结果是建设性的，能够导出估计矩条件。聚焦于一个主要特例，我们基于这些矩条件的双重稳健版本开发了渐近正态估计量。
10.3982/ecta23174.title: Identification in Instrumental Variables Models: The Central Role of Abadie's Kappa
10.3982/ecta23174.title_zh: 工具变量模型中的识别：Abadie's Kappa的核心作用

10.3982/ecta23334.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    Evidence from the laboratory and the field has uncovered both underreaction and overreaction to new information. We provide new experimental evidence on the underlying mechanisms of under‐ and overreaction by comparing how people make inferences
                    <jats:italic>and</jats:italic>
                    revise forecasts in the same information environment. Participants underreact to signals when inferring about underlying states, but overreact to the same signals when revising forecasts about future outcomes—a phenomenon we term “the inference‐forecast gap.” We show that this gap is largely driven by different simplifying heuristics used in the two tasks. Additional treatments suggest that the choice of heuristics is affected by the similarity between statistics in the information environment and the statistic elicited by the belief‐updating problem.
                  </jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23334.abstract_zh: 来自实验室和现场的证据揭示了人们对新信息既存在反应不足也存在反应过度。我们通过比较人们在相同信息环境下如何进行推断和修正预测，提供了关于反应不足与反应过度内在机制的新实验证据。参与者在推断潜在状态时对信号反应不足，但在修正对未来结果的预测时却对相同信号反应过度——我们将这一现象称为“推断-预测差距”。研究表明，这一差距主要由两项任务中使用的不同简化启发式策略驱动。额外实验处理表明，启发式策略的选择受到信息环境中的统计量与信念更新问题所引发的统计量之间相似性的影响。
10.3982/ecta23334.title: The Inference‐Forecast Gap in Belief Updating
10.3982/ecta23334.title_zh: 信念更新中的推断-预测差距

10.3982/ecta23345.abstract: <jats:p>We consider impulse response inference in a locally misspecified vector autoregression (VAR) model. The conventional local projection (LP) confidence interval has correct coverage even when the misspecification is so large that it can be detected with probability approaching 1. This result follows from a “double robustness” property analogous to that of popular partially linear regression estimators. By contrast, the conventional VAR confidence interval with short‐to‐moderate lag length can severely undercover for misspecification that is small, difficult to detect statistically, and cannot be ruled out based on economic theory. The VAR confidence interval has robust coverage if, and only if, the lag length is so large that the interval is as wide as the LP interval.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23345.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在局部误设定的向量自回归（VAR）模型中脉冲响应推断的问题。传统的局部投影（LP）置信区间即使在误设定程度大到能以趋近于1的概率被检测到时，仍能保持正确的覆盖率。这一结果源于一种与流行的部分线性回归估计量相似的“双重稳健性”性质。相比之下，采用短至中等滞后长度的传统VAR置信区间，在面对较小、难以从统计上检测且无法基于经济理论排除的误设定时，可能严重低估覆盖率。VAR置信区间只有在滞后长度足够大，使其区间宽度与LP区间相当时，才具有稳健的覆盖率。
10.3982/ecta23345.title: Double Robustness of Local Projections and Some Unpleasant VARithmetic
10.3982/ecta23345.title_zh: 局部投影的双重稳健性与一些令人不快的VAR算术

10.3982/ecta23358.abstract: <jats:p>Unlike gender or race, class background is rarely a focus of research on career progression, or of DEI efforts in elite occupations. Should it be? In this paper, we document a large class gap in career progression in one occupation—U.S. tenure‐track academia—using parental education to proxy for class background. First‐generation college graduates are 10% less likely to be tenured at an R1, are tenured at institutions ranked 11% lower, earn 3% less, and report 5% lower job satisfaction, than their former PhD classmates (from the same institution and field) with a parent with a non‐PhD graduate degree. Neither selection out of academia nor different preferences explain this gap; differential research productivity also plays little role. Instead, likely drivers are differences in cultural and social capital. We also find a class gap in career progression for PhDs who work in industry, suggesting this phenomenon generalizes outside academia.</jats:p>
10.3982/ecta23358.abstract_zh: 与性别或种族不同，阶级背景很少成为职业发展研究或精英职业领域多元化、公平与包容（DEI）举措的关注焦点。那么，它是否应该被重视？本文以美国终身教职制学术界这一职业为例，利用父母教育程度作为阶级背景的代理变量，揭示了职业发展中的显著阶级差距。与父母拥有非博士研究生学位的同届博士同学（来自同一院校和领域）相比，第一代大学毕业生在R1研究型大学获得终身教职的可能性低10%，其任职院校排名低11%，收入少3%，且工作满意度低5%。这一差距既非源于学术界的选择性退出，也非偏好差异所致；研究生产力的差异同样作用甚微。相反，文化资本和社会资本的差异是可能的驱动因素。此外，我们发现在产业界工作的博士群体中也存在职业发展的阶级差距，这表明该现象具有超越学术界的普遍性。
10.3982/ecta23358.title: The Class Gap in Career Progression: Evidence From U.S. Academia
10.3982/ecta23358.title_zh: 职业晋升中的阶级差距：来自美国学术界的证据
