10.3982/qe2385.abstract: <jats:p>We study the binary choice problem in a data‐rich environment with asymmetric loss functions. The econometrics literature covers nonparametric binary choice problems but does not offer computationally attractive solutions in data‐rich environments. The machine learning literature has many algorithms but is focused mostly on loss functions that are independent of covariates. We show that theoretically valid decisions on binary outcomes with general loss functions can be achieved via a very simple loss‐based reweighting of logistic regression or state‐of‐the‐art machine learning techniques. We apply our analysis to algorithmic fairness in pretrial detentions.</jats:p>
10.3982/qe2385.abstract_zh: 我们研究在数据丰富环境下具有非对称损失函数的二元选择问题。计量经济学文献涵盖了非参数二元选择问题，但未提供在数据丰富环境中具有计算吸引力的解决方案。机器学习文献包含许多算法，但主要关注与协变量无关的损失函数。我们证明，通过基于损失的简单重新加权逻辑回归或最先进的机器学习技术，可以在一般损失函数下实现对二元结果的理论有效决策。我们将分析应用于审前羁押中的算法公平性。
10.3982/qe2385.title: Binary choice under asymmetric loss in a data‐rich environment: Theory and an application to algorithmic fairness
10.3982/qe2385.title_zh: 数据丰富环境下非对称损失下的二元选择：理论与算法公平性应用

10.3982/qe2442.abstract: <jats:p>Using a heterogeneous agent model calibrated to match spending dynamics over four years following an income shock (Fagereng, Holm, and Natvik (2021)), we assess the effectiveness of three fiscal stimulus policies implemented during recent recessions. Unemployment insurance (UI) extensions are the “bang for the buck” winner when the metric is effectiveness in boosting utility. Stimulus checks are second‐best and have two advantages (over UI): they arrive faster, and are scalable. A temporary (two‐year) cut in wage taxation is considerably less effective than the other policies and has negligible effects in the version of our model without a multiplier.</jats:p>
10.3982/qe2442.abstract_zh: 基于一个异质性主体模型（该模型校准后能复现收入冲击后四年内的支出动态，参见Fagereng, Holm, and Natvik (2021)），我们评估了近期经济衰退期间实施的三项财政刺激政策的有效性。以提升效用的有效性为衡量标准，失业保险（UI）延期是“性价比”最高的政策。刺激性支票次之，并具有两大优势（相对于失业保险）：到账更快且具有可扩展性。临时性（两年期）工资税削减的效果远不及其他政策，且在我们模型的无乘数版本中，其影响微乎其微。
10.3982/qe2442.title: Welfare and spending effects of consumption stimulus policies
10.3982/qe2442.title_zh: 消费刺激政策的福利与支出效应

10.3982/qe2529.abstract: <jats:p>Large VARs are increasingly used in structural analysis as a unified framework to study the impacts of multiple structural shocks simultaneously. However, the concurrent identification of multiple shocks using sign and ranking restrictions poses significant practical challenges to the point where existing algorithms cannot be used with such large VARs. To address this, we introduce a new numerically efficient algorithm that facilitates the estimation of impulse responses and related measures in large structural VARs identified with a large number of structural restrictions on impulse responses. The methodology is illustrated using a 35‐variable VAR with over 100 sign and ranking restrictions to identify 8 structural shocks.</jats:p>
10.3982/qe2529.abstract_zh: 大型VAR模型越来越多地被用于结构分析，作为同时研究多种结构性冲击影响的统一框架。然而，利用符号约束和排序约束同时识别多种冲击，在实际操作中面临重大挑战，以至于现有算法无法应用于此类大型VAR模型。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的数值高效算法，该算法有助于在大型结构VAR模型中估计脉冲响应及相关指标，这些模型通过大量关于脉冲响应的结构性约束进行识别。该方法通过一个包含35个变量、超过100个符号约束和排序约束的VAR模型进行说明，用于识别8种结构性冲击。
10.3982/qe2529.title: Large structural VARs with multiple sign and ranking restrictions
10.3982/qe2529.title_zh: 具有多重符号与排序约束的大型结构向量自回归模型

10.3982/qe2638.abstract: <jats:p>In density forecasts, respondents are asked to assign probabilities to a response scale with pre‐specified ranges of inflation. In two large‐scale experiments, one conducted in the US and one in Germany, we show how the specifics of the response scale determine the results: Shifting, compressing, or expanding the scale leads to shifted, compressed, and expanded forecasts. Quantifying this effect using the scale most widely used among central banks, we find that mean forecast, uncertainty, and disagreement can vary by several percentage points. Density forecasts may severely misestimate the “true” inflation expectations, and may generate spurious changes in reported inflation uncertainty. The analysis suggests several ways to reduce this bias.</jats:p>
10.3982/qe2638.abstract_zh: 在密度预测中，受访者需将概率分配给具有预设通胀区间的响应量表。通过在美国和德国开展的两项大规模实验，我们展示了响应量表的具体特征如何决定预测结果：移动、压缩或扩展量表会导致预测值相应移动、压缩或扩展。采用央行最广泛使用的量表量化这一效应后，我们发现平均预测值、不确定性和分歧程度可能相差数个百分点。密度预测可能严重误估"真实"通胀预期，并导致报告的通胀不确定性出现虚假变化。分析表明，可通过多种方式减少这一偏差。
10.3982/qe2638.title: Measuring inflation expectations: How the response scale shapes density forecasts
10.3982/qe2638.title_zh: 衡量通胀预期：响应量表如何塑造密度预测

10.3982/qe2674.abstract: <jats:p>Seasonal migration is a common strategy to mitigate rural seasonal deprivation, but migrants need to remit money during the lean season to family members facing food shortages. We observe counterintuitively low remittances in rural Nepal during periods of seasonal hunger, and migrants return with remittances later during harvest when food is relatively abundant. To indirectly overcome this apparent constraint in remittance timing, we provide a $90 consumption loan to randomly selected rural households during the pre‐harvest lean season. Loan‐recipient households increase pre‐harvest investments in fertilizer and time spent working on their own farm, smooth consumption, and save more of their migration income to bring it back home. Food security, subjective well‐being, rice harvest, and revenues improve. Ninety‐eight percent of beneficiaries repay the loan with the increased harvest‐period remittance. In a two‐period model of household decision making, we show that remittance frictions—a market failure—are necessary to qualitatively match our experimental results.</jats:p>
10.3982/qe2674.abstract_zh: 季节性迁移是缓解农村季节性匮乏的常见策略，但迁移者需在食物短缺的淡季向家人汇款。我们在尼泊尔农村观察到，在季节性饥饿期间汇款额异常低，而迁移者往往在收获季节食物相对充裕时才携带汇款返乡。为间接克服这一汇款时间上的明显约束，我们在收获前淡季向随机选取的农村家庭提供90美元消费贷款。获得贷款的家庭增加了淡季的化肥投资和自有农场劳动时间，平滑了消费，并将更多迁移收入储蓄后带回。粮食安全、主观幸福感、稻谷收成和收入均得到改善。98%的受益者用增加的收获期汇款偿还贷款。在家庭决策的两期模型中，我们证明汇款摩擦（一种市场失灵）是定性匹配实验结果所必需的。
10.3982/qe2674.title: Remittance frictions and seasonal poverty
10.3982/qe2674.title_zh: 汇款摩擦与季节性贫困

10.3982/qe2681.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    An easy‐to‐interpret rule for the optimal risk‐adjusted social cost of carbon is derived using perturbation analysis. This rule internalizes the adverse effects of global warming on the risk of recurring climate‐related disasters, the risk of irreversible cascading climate tipping points, and the usual effect on total factor productivity. It and its three components approximate the true numerical optimum well, especially if the small parameters (i.e., the share of damages in GDP, the sensitivity of the risk of disasters to temperature and the risk of climate tipping) are small enough and the discount rate is not too small. The rule is also accurate if applied to AK models with a different supply side, for example, with ongoing technical progress in fossil‐fuel production or multiple economic sectors. With a growth‐adjusted discount rate of 2%/year, the SCC is $172/tCO
                    <jats:sub>2</jats:sub>
                    , 70% of which is due to recurring climate disasters and 9% to climate tipping risk.
                  </jats:p>
10.3982/qe2681.abstract_zh: 本文通过扰动分析推导出一个易于解释的最优风险调整社会碳成本规则。该规则内化了全球变暖对气候相关灾害复发风险、不可逆级联气候临界点风险以及对全要素生产率的常规影响。该规则及其三个组成部分能够很好地逼近真实数值最优解，尤其是当小参数（即损害占GDP的比重、灾害风险对温度的敏感度以及气候临界点风险）足够小且贴现率不太低时。该规则同样适用于供给侧不同的AK模型，例如化石燃料生产持续技术进步或多经济部门模型。在增长调整贴现率为每年2%的情况下，社会碳成本为172美元/吨二氧化碳，其中70%源于气候灾害复发风险，9%源于气候临界点风险。
10.3982/qe2681.title: Three reasons to price carbon under uncertainty: Accuracy of simple rules
10.3982/qe2681.title_zh: 不确定性下碳定价的三个理由：简单规则的准确性

10.3982/qe2719.abstract: <jats:p>We provide a complete description of the set of all solutions to a vector autoregressive law of motion. Every solution is shown to be the sum of three components, each corresponding to a directed flow of time. One component flows forward from the arbitrarily distant past, one flows backward from the arbitrarily distant future, and one flows outward from time zero. The three components are obtained by applying three complementary spectral projections to the solution, these corresponding to a separation of the eigenvalues of the autoregressive coefficient matrix according to whether they are inside, outside, or on the unit circle. We establish a one‐to‐one correspondence between the set of all solutions and a finite‐dimensional space of initial conditions.</jats:p>
10.3982/qe2719.abstract_zh: 我们完整描述了向量自回归运动方程所有解集的构成。每个解均可分解为三个分量之和，分别对应三种定向时间流：一个分量从任意遥远的过去向前流动，一个分量从任意遥远的未来向后流动，一个分量从零时刻向外流动。这三个分量通过将三种互补谱投影应用于解而获得，其依据是自回归系数矩阵的特征值是否位于单位圆内、外或圆上。我们建立了所有解集与有限维初始条件空间之间的一一对应关系。
10.3982/qe2719.title: The general solution to an autoregressive law of motion
10.3982/qe2719.title_zh: 自回归运动定律的通解

10.3982/qe2768.abstract: <jats:p>The theory of infinitely repeated games may lack predictive power due to its insensitivity to, for example, changes in some game parameters, the timing of players' moves, and communication possibilities. We propose a new approach by studying an infinitely repeated prisoner's dilemma game and its variants where preferences for cooperation are heterogeneous, and strategic risk arises from incomplete information about opponents' preferences. Our model generates a rich set of comparative static predictions in a variety of settings. We show that, unlike standard theory and other existing models, our approach organizes the findings of a host of experiments including our novel experiments.</jats:p>
10.3982/qe2768.abstract_zh: 无限重复博弈理论可能因对某些博弈参数变化、玩家行动时机及沟通可能性等因素不敏感而缺乏预测力。我们通过研究无限重复囚徒困境博弈及其变体提出新方法，其中合作偏好存在异质性，且战略风险源于对手偏好的不完全信息。我们的模型在多种情境下生成丰富的比较静态预测。研究表明，与标准理论及其他现有模型不同，我们的方法系统性地解释了包括我们新实验在内的一系列实验结果。
10.3982/qe2768.title: A new approach to the analysis of cooperation under the shadow of the future: Theory and experimental evidence
10.3982/qe2768.title_zh: 未来阴影下合作分析的新方法：理论与实验证据

10.3982/te6170.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    We study the welfare effects of ambiguous product information for a buyer with
                    <jats:italic>α</jats:italic>
                    ‐max‐min preferences and a price‐setting seller. The buyer privately receives information about her valuation. We show that both the seller and the buyer can benefit when this information is ambiguous, and we characterize all possible combinations of producer and consumer surplus, as evaluated under ambiguity‐sensitive preferences. Ambiguity concerning the valuation perceived by the buyer when making the purchase decision can induce the seller to change the price. Before receiving information, ambiguity concerning the purchase decision can make the buyer optimistic about buying only for high valuations, which relaxes the participation constraint.
                  </jats:p>
10.3982/te6170.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有α-最大最小偏好的买方与定价卖方之间，模糊产品信息对福利的影响。买方私下获取关于其估值的信号。研究表明，当该信息具有模糊性时，买卖双方均可能获益，并刻画了在模糊敏感偏好下评估的所有可能的生产者剩余与消费者剩余组合。买方在做出购买决策时所感知的估值模糊性，可能促使卖方调整价格。在获取信息之前，购买决策的模糊性可能使买方对仅在高估值时购买持乐观态度，从而放宽了参与约束。
10.3982/te6170.title: Benefits and challenges of ambiguous product information
10.3982/te6170.title_zh: 模糊产品信息的益处与挑战

10.3982/te6187.abstract: <jats:p>In the context of Krugman's (1979) canonical new trade model, we demonstrate that a country is better off in autarky than in free and costless trade when the productivity of its trading partner is sufficiently low.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6187.abstract_zh: 在克鲁格曼（1979）经典新贸易模型的框架下，我们证明：当贸易伙伴的生产率足够低时，一国在自给自足状态下的福利水平优于无成本自由贸易。
10.3982/te6187.title: When autarky trumps free and costless trade
10.3982/te6187.title_zh: 当自给自足胜过自由且零成本的贸易

10.3982/te6224.abstract: <jats:p>Nonpartisan voters can become polarized not because of ideology but because it is optimal for them to remain uninformed and cancel out the votes of uninformed voters on “the other side.” Indeed, when stuck in such a state of polarization, it is socially optimal to do so. Dynamics can lead an otherwise well‐functioning assembly into irreversible polarization. Reputation effects might only make things worse.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6224.abstract_zh: 无党派选民可能走向极化，并非源于意识形态，而是因为保持信息闭塞、抵消“对立阵营”中信息闭塞选民的选票对其而言是最优选择。事实上，当陷入这种极化状态时，从社会整体来看，这样做也是最优的。动态过程可能使原本运作良好的议会陷入不可逆转的极化。声誉效应可能只会让情况雪上加霜。
10.3982/te6224.title: Ruth, Anthony, and Clarence

10.3982/te6338.abstract: <jats:p>I study the impact of consumer reviews on the incentives for firms to participate in the market. I develop a model of endogenous entry in which firms produce goods of heterogeneous, unknown quality. Consumers engage in directed search, and prices are exogenously fixed. A rater uses consumer reviews to construct firm‐specific ratings that are informative of quality and help consumers direct their search. The main insight of the paper is that suppressing the reviews of highly‐rated firms strengthens entry incentives and improves consumer welfare.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6338.abstract_zh: 本文研究了消费者评价对企业参与市场激励的影响。我构建了一个内生进入模型，其中企业生产异质性且质量未知的商品。消费者进行定向搜索，价格外生给定。评分者利用消费者评价构建企业特定评分，这些评分能反映质量信息并帮助消费者引导搜索。本文的主要发现是：抑制高评分企业的评价会增强企业进入市场的激励，并提升消费者福利。
10.3982/te6338.title: Ratings design and barriers to entry

10.3982/te6424.abstract: <jats:p>We present a model in which news media shape beliefs by providing information (signals about an exogenous state) and narratives (models of what determines outcomes). To amplify consumers' engagement, the media maximize their anticipatory utility. We characterize the optimal monopolistic media strategy, highlighting the synergy between false narratives and biased information. Consumer heterogeneity gives rise to a novel menu‐design problem due to an “equilibrium data externality” among consumers. The optimal menu includes false narratives, and can generate polarized beliefs and choices without any information transmission. False narratives and polarization also feature in a competitive version of our model, albeit coupled with complete information. Nevertheless, competition can make some consumers objectively worse off.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6424.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中新闻媒体通过提供信息（关于外生状态的信号）和叙事（解释结果决定因素的模型）来塑造信念。为提升消费者参与度，媒体最大化其预期效用。我们刻画了最优垄断媒体策略，揭示了虚假叙事与有偏信息之间的协同效应。消费者异质性引致了一个新颖的菜单设计问题，其根源在于消费者间的“均衡数据外部性”。最优菜单包含虚假叙事，且能在无任何信息传递的情况下催生极化信念与选择。在竞争性版本模型中，尽管伴随完全信息，虚假叙事与极化现象依然存在。然而，竞争可能使部分消费者的客观福利恶化。
10.3982/te6424.title: News media as suppliers of narratives (and information)
10.3982/te6424.title_zh: 新闻媒体作为叙事（及信息）的提供者

10.3982/te6439.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    A decision‐maker faces uncertainty governed by a data‐generating process (DGP), which is only known to belong to a set of sequences of independent but possibly non‐identical distributions. A robust decision maximizes the expected payoff against the worst possible DGP in this set. This paper characterizes when and how such robust decisions can be
                    <jats:italic>objectively</jats:italic>
                    improved with data; that is, can yield higher expected payoffs under the true DGP regardless of which DGP is the truth. It further develops simple and novel inference procedures that achieve such improvement, while common methods (e.g., maximum likelihood) may fail to do so.
                  </jats:p>
10.3982/te6439.abstract_zh: 决策者面临由数据生成过程（DGP）主导的不确定性，该过程仅已知属于一组独立但可能非同分布序列的集合。稳健决策旨在最大化该集合中最差可能DGP下的期望收益。本文刻画了何时以及如何利用数据实现此类稳健决策的**客观**改进——即无论真实DGP为何，均能在真实DGP下获得更高的期望收益。本文进一步开发了实现此类改进的简洁新颖推断程序，而常见方法（如极大似然法）可能无法达成此目标。
10.3982/te6439.title: Improving robust decisions with data
10.3982/te6439.title_zh: 利用数据改进稳健决策

10.3982/te6479.abstract: <jats:p>This paper compares digital and physical currency, focusing on a single intrinsic difference: digital, unlike physical currency, allows the monetary authority to trace the monetary flows in and out of the accounts. We show that this technological advance in recordkeeping can be used by the monetary authority to improve upon physical currency and achieve efficiency in a wide range of circumstances.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6479.abstract_zh: 本文比较了数字货币与实物货币，聚焦于一个本质区别：与实物货币不同，数字货币使货币当局能够追踪账户中的资金流入与流出。我们证明，货币当局可利用这一记账技术的进步，在实物货币基础上实现改进，并在广泛情境下达到效率最优。
10.3982/te6479.title: Physical versus digital currency A difference that makes a difference
10.3982/te6479.title_zh: 实物货币与数字货币：一种产生差异的差异

10.3982/te6567.abstract: <jats:p>We investigate the management of information provision to maximize user engagement. A principal sequentially reveals signals to an agent who has a limited amount of information processing capacity and can choose to exit at any time. We identify a “dilution” strategy—sending rare but highly informative signals—that maximizes user engagement. The platform's engagement metric shapes the direction and magnitude of biases in provided information relative to a user‐optimal benchmark. Even without intertemporal commitment, the platform replicates full‐commitment revenue by inducing the user's belief to remain “as uncertain as” the prior until the rare, decisive signal arrives and induces stopping. We apply our results to two contexts: an ad‐supported internet media platform and a teacher attempting to engage test‐motivated students.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6567.abstract_zh: 我们研究了信息提供管理以最大化用户参与度的问题。一位委托人向具有有限信息处理能力且可随时选择退出的代理人顺序揭示信号。我们识别出一种“稀释”策略——发送罕见但信息量大的信号——以最大化用户参与度。平台的参与度指标决定了所提供信息相对于用户最优基准的偏差方向和幅度。即使没有跨期承诺，平台也能通过使用户信念保持“与先验一样不确定”，直到罕见的关键信号到来并引发停止，从而复制完全承诺下的收益。我们将研究结果应用于两个场景：一个广告支持的互联网媒体平台，以及一位试图吸引考试驱动型学生的教师。
10.3982/te6567.title: Engagement maximization

10.3982/te6575.abstract: <jats:p>This paper develops a general theory to recover the inverse welfare function that rationalizes a given tax schedule as optimal. Our theory allows for complex environments including the presence of multidimensional tax schedules, bunching/jumping behavior, optimization frictions, general equilibrium effects, and externalities. We show that inverse welfare functions can be used to test for Pareto efficiency, construct Pareto improving reforms, and characterize the set of welfare improving local reforms, thereby extending previous results to more general environments. We show numerically that allowing for such generalities can have meaningful impacts on inverse welfare functions.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6575.abstract_zh: 本文发展了一个一般性理论，用于恢复将给定税收计划视为最优的逆福利函数。该理论适用于复杂环境，包括多维税收计划的存在、聚集/跳跃行为、优化摩擦、一般均衡效应以及外部性。我们证明，逆福利函数可用于检验帕累托效率、构建帕累托改进改革，并刻画福利改进局部改革的集合，从而将先前的研究结果扩展到更一般的环境中。数值分析表明，考虑这些一般性因素会对逆福利函数产生显著影响。
10.3982/te6575.title: A general theory of inverse welfare functions
10.3982/te6575.title_zh: 逆福利函数的一般理论

10.3982/te6786.abstract: <jats:p>We study markets where heterogeneous agents first make investment decisions and then engage in a costly search to form productive matches. The trading process is a random search and bargaining with explicit search costs. Despite potential hold‐up and matching problems, we prove that the constrained efficient allocation is an equilibrium: the agents' private incentives to invest and to accept/reject potential partners as they search are perfectly aligned with the social benefit. Furthermore, we establish a new sorting result for two‐sided markets, equilibrium existence, and conditions for uniqueness.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6786.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个市场，其中异质性主体首先进行投资决策，随后通过成本高昂的搜索来形成生产性匹配。交易过程涉及随机搜索和带有明确搜索成本的讨价还价。尽管存在潜在的敲竹杠和匹配问题，我们证明了受约束的有效配置是一种均衡：主体在投资以及搜索过程中接受或拒绝潜在合作伙伴时的私人激励与社会福利完全一致。此外，我们为双边市场建立了一个新的分类结果，证明了均衡的存在性，并给出了唯一性的条件。
10.3982/te6786.title: Efficient investment, search, and sorting in matching markets
10.3982/te6786.title_zh: 匹配市场中的有效投资、搜寻与分类

10.3982/te6816.abstract: <jats:p>We compare the degree of coalitional manipulability across stable school‐choice mechanisms. Although no stable mechanism is group strategy‐proof for all school choice contexts, we show that the student‐optimal stable mechanism is the least manipulable by coalitions, whereas the school‐optimal stable mechanism is the most coalitionally manipulable. These results still hold when students can only report truncated preferences, when the set of coalitions is limited, or when schools cannot be declared unacceptable as long as there are more available seats than students. In contrast, if there is a shortage of seats and students have no outside options, the school‐optimal stable mechanism can be less manipulable by coalitions than the student‐optimal stable mechanism.</jats:p>
10.3982/te6816.abstract_zh: 我们比较了不同稳定择校机制在联盟操纵性上的差异。尽管没有任何稳定机制在所有择校情境下都满足群体策略防操纵性，但我们发现：学生最优稳定机制是联盟操纵性最低的机制，而学校最优稳定机制则是联盟操纵性最高的机制。即使学生只能报告截断偏好、联盟集合受到限制，或当可用学额多于学生数时学校不能被声明为不可接受，这些结论依然成立。相反，若学额短缺且学生没有外部选择，学校最优稳定机制可能比学生最优稳定机制具有更低的联盟操纵性。
10.3982/te6816.title: Coalitional manipulability in school choice
10.3982/te6816.title_zh: 学校选择中的联盟可操纵性

url:00e4b50bdedae2d9.abstract: We analyze consumer surplus when a monopolist can adjust both prices and product qualities across segments, engaging in second- and third-degree price discrimination simultaneously. We characterize the consumer-optimal segmentation and show that it has a striking structure: consumers with the same value receive the same quality in every segment, though prices differ. Under mild conditions, any segmentation harms consumers if and only if demand is sufficiently more elastic than supply. Hence, potential benefits for consumers depend critically on demand and supply elasticities. These findings have implications for regulatory policy regarding price discrimination and market segmentation.
url:00e4b50bdedae2d9.abstract_zh: 本文分析了垄断者在不同细分市场中同时调整价格与产品质量、实施二级与三级价格歧视时的消费者剩余。我们刻画了消费者最优细分结构，并揭示其具有显著特征：在每一细分市场中，具有相同价值的消费者获得相同质量，但价格存在差异。在温和条件下，当且仅当需求弹性显著大于供给弹性时，任何细分都会损害消费者利益。因此，消费者潜在收益关键取决于需求与供给弹性。这些发现对价格歧视与市场细分的监管政策具有启示意义。

url:0160c10a0c468d64.abstract: As demand for critical minerals accelerates with the energy transition, artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) has emerged as a key but poorly understood source of supply. We construct the first continental-scale panel of mining activity in Sub-Saharan Africa by applying supervised deep-learning methods to satellite imagery, identifying over 50,000 mining sites across 39 countries and reconstructing monthly activity from 2000 to 2019. We document three main findings. First, mining location follows strong market-access gradients with pronounced non-linearities: proximity to ports raises mining probability within 200 km, but this premium reverses at intermediate distances and re-emerges only in the most remote areas -- consistent with distance from urban centers proxying for weaker state reach and lower monitoring of informal activity. Second, entry responds rapidly to commodity price shocks, indicating that ASM operates as an elastic margin of mineral supply; over time, however, its relationship with industrial mining shifts from complementarity to a reallocation of artisanal activity away from industrial sites. Third, agricultural shocks induce entry into ASM, but spatial labor mobility attenuates local responses, pointing to strong congestion effects. Together, these results position ASM as a central yet spatially constrained adjustment margin in global critical mineral supply.
url:0160c10a0c468d64.abstract_zh: 随着能源转型加速对关键矿产的需求，手工和小规模采矿（ASM）已成为重要但认知不足的供应来源。我们通过将监督式深度学习方法应用于卫星图像，构建了首个撒哈拉以南非洲大陆尺度的采矿活动面板数据，识别出39个国家的5万多个采矿点，并重建了2000年至2019年的月度活动数据。研究得出三项主要发现：第一，采矿选址遵循显著的非线性市场可达性梯度——靠近港口在200公里范围内提高采矿概率，但这一优势在中等距离处逆转，仅在偏远地区重新显现，这与远离城市中心反映国家管控薄弱、非正规活动监管较少的情况一致。第二，采矿进入对大宗商品价格冲击反应迅速，表明ASM作为矿产供应的弹性边际发挥作用；但随时间推移，其与工业采矿的关系从互补转向手工活动从工业场地的重新配置。第三，农业冲击促使劳动力进入ASM，但空间劳动力流动削弱了局部响应，表明存在显著的拥挤效应。综合来看，这些结论将ASM定位为全球关键矿产供应中核心但受空间约束的调整边际。

url:01adcb4eb72ffeb5.abstract: Individuals may fail to recall and use information they already know when making decisions. We empirically investigate whether such "retrieval failures" distort consumption smoothing behavior among Zambian farmers, who derive their income from one annual harvest and then spend it down over the course of the year. We document that individuals underestimate upcoming spending by 50%, creating scope for under-saving. In order to improve recall, we randomize an intervention that prompts individuals to think through their future expenses associatively in categories---without providing any external information or guidance. Treated individuals increase "remembered" expenses by 36-60%; as predicted by the memory literature, effects are concentrated among small, irregular, and stochastic items. Immediate spending drops and, six weeks after the intervention, treated households hold 15% higher savings. They subsequently enter the hungry season---the final months of the year when consumption typically declines sharply---with one additional month of savings, leading to a flatter spending profile over the year. Households use the increased savings to self-finance additional farm investment, resulting in a 9% increase in the next year's crop revenue. We replicate the intervention's impact on beliefs among low-income Americans, suggesting that retrieval failures generalize across settings and populations.
url:01adcb4eb72ffeb5.abstract_zh: 个体在决策时可能无法回忆并使用已知信息。我们通过实证研究考察这种"检索失败"是否扭曲了赞比亚农民的消费平滑行为——这些农民的收入来源于每年一次收获，随后在全年逐步消耗。研究发现，个体对未来支出的低估幅度达50%，这为储蓄不足创造了空间。为改善信息回忆，我们随机实施了一项干预措施：引导个体通过类别联想的方式梳理未来支出（不提供任何外部信息或指导）。受干预群体"被回忆起的"支出增加了36-60%；正如记忆文献所预测，该效应集中于小额、非规律性及随机性支出项目。即时消费有所下降，干预六周后，受干预家庭的储蓄水平高出15%。随后他们进入饥饿季（通常消费急剧下降的年末月份）时，额外拥有一个月的储蓄，使得全年消费曲线更为平缓。家庭将增加的储蓄用于农业投资自融资，使次年作物收入提升9%。我们还在美国低收入群体中复制了该干预对信念的影响，表明检索失败现象具有跨情境和跨人群的普遍性。

url:0293c30adbc5d382.abstract: Within narrowly defined industries, the most productive firms produce far more than the least productive from the same inputs, and this dispersion widens in downturns. We build a tractable representative-agent model in which financial frictions—adverse selection and moral hazard—make firms sort endogenously into lenders, strategic defaulters, and producers. As credit conditions vary, the resulting misallocation gives aggregate total factor productivity (TFP) an endogenous component that accounts for about 30 percent of the variance of TFP at business-cycle frequencies, a third of it from strategic default. We show that our tractable model can match key features of the observed distribution of productivity across firms and its co-movement with output growth and credit conditions in the data.
url:0293c30adbc5d382.abstract_zh: 在狭义定义的行业中，最具生产力的企业使用相同投入的产出远高于最低生产力企业，且这种差距在经济下行期进一步扩大。我们构建了一个易于处理的代表性主体模型，其中金融摩擦——逆向选择与道德风险——使企业内生地分化为贷款方、策略性违约方与生产方。随着信贷条件变化，由此产生的资源错配使全要素生产率（TFP）具有内生性成分，该成分解释了商业周期频率下约30%的TFP波动，其中三分之一源于策略性违约。研究表明，我们的可处理模型能够匹配观测到的企业间生产率分布的关键特征，及其与产出增长和信贷条件在数据中的协同变动关系。

url:03d1d810c42bf069.abstract: Building on queuing theory, we develop and empirically validate a novel theoretical model of residential mortgage supply. Our model gives insight into how the stochastic arrival and sequential servicing of loan applications affect mortgage origination. The model provides closed-form predictions for lenders’ optimal response to changes in the level and price elasticity of mortgage demand. Using confidential HMDA data, we estimate that a one standard deviation increase in mortgage demand raises mortgage rate spreads by 3 to 8 basis points, loan quantities by 20 to 32 percent, and application processing times by 3 to 5 days. We also provide empirical evidence for the model prediction that a higher elasticity of mortgage demand moderates price increases due to demand shocks, which can limit lenders’ exploitation of their market power.
url:03d1d810c42bf069.abstract_zh: 基于排队理论，我们构建并实证验证了一个关于住宅抵押贷款供给的新型理论模型。该模型揭示了贷款申请的随机到达与顺序处理如何影响抵押贷款发放。模型为贷款机构应对抵押贷款需求水平及价格弹性变化的最优反应提供了闭式解。利用保密的HMDA数据，我们估计抵押贷款需求每增加一个标准差，抵押贷款利率价差将上升3至8个基点，贷款数量增加20%至32%，申请处理时间延长3至5天。我们还为模型预测提供了实证证据：更高的抵押贷款需求弹性会抑制需求冲击导致的价格上涨，从而限制贷款机构对其市场势力的利用。

url:03fc823dca5dc978.abstract: This paper complements and extends Doldi, Frittelli and Maggis, Collective completeness and pricing-hedging duality, Math. Finan. Econ. 19, 757-784 (2025), by studying collective pricing and hedging when admissible risk exchanges form a finitely generated convex cone. The collective First Fundamental Theorem of Asset Pricing and the collective pricing-hedging duality are extended to this setting. A key contribution is a closedness result showing that no collective arbitrage implies the closedness of the aggregate feasibility cone combining infinite-dimensional trading opportunities with finite-dimensional exchanges. The paper also proves that no-collective-arbitrage prices for vectors of contingent claims form a relatively open convex set. Finally, strong collective replicability is introduced and shown to be equivalent to price uniqueness. This leads to an enhanced collective Second Fundamental Theorem of Asset Pricing, providing equivalent characterizations of collective completeness and strong collective completeness in terms of the uniqueness of the collective equivalent martingale measure. We highlight that several core aspects of the theory are substantially altered when exchanges belong to a convex cone rather than a vector space.
url:03fc823dca5dc978.abstract_zh: 本文对Doldi、Frittelli与Maggis的《集体完备性与定价-对冲对偶》（Math. Finan. Econ. 19, 757-784 (2025)）进行了补充与拓展，研究了当可接受风险交换构成有限生成凸锥时的集体定价与对冲问题。本文将集体资产定价第一基本定理及集体定价-对冲对偶推广至该设定。核心贡献在于一项闭性结论：无集体套利意味着聚合可行性锥的闭性，该锥结合了无限维交易机会与有限维交换。本文还证明了无集体套利条件下未定权益向量的价格构成相对开凸集。最后，本文引入强集体可复制性概念，并证明其等价于价格唯一性。由此推导出增强的集体资产定价第二基本定理，以集体等价鞅测度的唯一性为条件，给出了集体完备性与强集体完备性的等价刻画。我们强调，当交换属于凸锥而非向量空间时，该理论的若干核心方面会发生实质性改变。
url:03fc823dca5dc978.title: Collective completeness and pricing-hedging duality II

url:03fe0a1a8c482f3e.abstract: This paper provides new micro-level evidence on how labor taxation shapes firm behavior, exploiting an EU-mandated payroll tax reform in Norway. Combining administrative and survey data, we find that firms facing larger tax increases sharply cut employment but also increased R&D spending, implemented labor cost-saving innovations, and adopted more automation. While these responses led to improvements in labor and total factor productivity within the firm, the firm’s labor share fell. These effects persisted even after the tax hike was unexpectedly reversed three years later, suggesting a lasting shift toward more capital-intensive production in response to higher labor costs.
url:03fe0a1a8c482f3e.abstract_zh: 本文利用挪威一项欧盟强制实施的工资税改革，提供了关于劳动税收如何影响企业行为的新微观证据。结合行政与调查数据，我们发现，面临较大税负增加的企业大幅削减了就业，但同时增加了研发支出，实施了节约劳动力成本的创新，并采用了更多自动化措施。尽管这些反应带来了企业内部劳动生产率和全要素生产率的提升，但企业的劳动份额却下降了。这些效应在三年后税负意外逆转时依然持续存在，表明企业为应对更高的劳动力成本，已向更资本密集型生产方式发生了持久性转变。

url:065905ede47cfaeb.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of natural disasters on the domestic sovereign yield curve, shedding light on their distinct transmission channels. Using a sample of 72 developing countries during the period 2000-20, and leveraging a newly compiled dataset on domestic treasury bill and bond yields, the findings from the fixed-effects and the local projection difference in difference estimations point to a disaster premium in the pricing of domestic government securities. While natural disasters significantly steepen the yield curve, their effects are confined to short-term maturity debts. In constrast, a worsening in climate vulnerability shifts upward the entire yield curve. Heightened fiscal stress and monetary policy stance emerge as the main transmission channels. These results underscore the importance of integrating resilience building into debt management and fiscal policy frameworks.
url:065905ede47cfaeb.abstract_zh: 本文研究了自然灾害对国内主权收益率曲线的影响，揭示了其独特的传导渠道。基于2000-20年间72个发展中国家的样本，并利用新编制的国内国库券和债券收益率数据集，固定效应模型与局部投影双重差分估计的结果表明，国内政府证券定价中存在“灾害溢价”。自然灾害显著陡化了收益率曲线，但其影响仅限于短期债务。相比之下，气候脆弱性的恶化则使整条收益率曲线上移。财政压力加剧与货币政策立场成为主要传导渠道。这些结果凸显了将韧性建设纳入债务管理与财政政策框架的重要性。

url:067386a3c139b712.abstract: We provide the first evidence of forward-looking reference points in investor behavior. Combining administrative data on option traders with a stacked difference-in-differences design, we show that investors' propensity to sell options spikes precisely when the underlying asset crosses the strike price, which retail investors frequently select to match their target price. The effect is difficult to explain using the standard disposition effect, nominal returns, salience, option Greeks, or complex option trading strategies. Moreover, the effect is present only for options bought out of the money, for which the strike price acts as a natural target, but absent for options bought in the money, for which it does not. The evidence is most consistent with investors evaluating gains and losses relative to a forward-looking target, in sharp contrast with the backward-looking purchase price widely used in the disposition effect literature. Our findings suggest that standard tests of reference dependence in selling decisions are misspecified when investors evaluate outcomes relative to reference points other than the purchase price.
url:067386a3c139b712.abstract_zh: 我们首次提供了投资者行为中存在前瞻性参考点的证据。通过将期权交易者的行政数据与堆叠双重差分设计相结合，我们发现，当标的资产恰好突破行权价时，投资者出售期权的倾向会急剧上升，而散户投资者经常选择该行权价以匹配其目标价格。这一效应难以用标准的处置效应、名义收益、显著性、期权希腊字母或复杂期权交易策略来解释。此外，该效应仅存在于价外买入的期权中（此时行权价充当自然目标），而在价内买入的期权中则不存在（此时行权价不构成目标）。这一证据最符合投资者基于前瞻性目标评估损益的行为，与处置效应文献中广泛使用的后顾式买入价格形成鲜明对比。我们的发现表明，当投资者以买入价以外的参考点评估结果时，关于卖出决策中参考依赖的标准检验存在设定偏误。
url:067386a3c139b712.title: Investment Targets as Reference Points

url:068984e7d4df417e.abstract: States are major international financiers, but their role is poorly understood. We study state-driven cross-border lending over two centuries using a new database covering 1.2 million official loans and grants by 134 governments and 70 multilateral institutions since 1790. We document a dual, state-contingent structure of international credit. In normal times, private creditors dominate cross-border lending. In adverse states of the world, such as wars and financial crises, official creditors step in, at times on a massive scale. These official flows are driven by great powers, are highly subsidized, and are largely absent from canonical models in international macroeconomics.
url:068984e7d4df417e.abstract_zh: 国家是主要的国际融资方，但其作用尚未得到充分理解。我们利用涵盖1790年以来134个政府和70个多边机构120万笔官方贷款与赠款的新数据库，研究两个世纪以来国家驱动的跨境贷款。我们揭示了国际信贷的双重、国家依存结构。在正常时期，私人债权人主导跨境贷款。而在战争和金融危机等不利世界状态下，官方债权人会介入，有时规模巨大。这些官方资金流动由大国驱动，享有高额补贴，且在国际宏观经济学的经典模型中基本缺失。

url:0872b52a2be728b2.abstract: After decades in the making, Brazil’s landmark VAT reform was approved in 2023. The primary objective of the reform is to eliminate distortions and reduce the complexity of the current consumption tax system while maintaining revenue neutrality. In addition, specific design features were included to alleviate the VAT’s inherent regressivity and improve the equity of the Brazilian tax system. This paper assesses the reform’s expected equity print leveraging a microstatic model based on household data and simulates policy options to further improve distributional outcomes. While the new VAT achieves a fairly equal distribution of the tax burden across most income groups, the poorest still carry a heavier load in terms of their disposable income. Dissecting the impact by policy instrument, the reform’s approved reduced rates aggravate regressivity, while zero rates and the new cashback lower the tax burden for poorer households, under the revenue neutrality assumption. Overall, the combined use of these measures dampens the reform’s equity outcomes somewhat as a higher VAT reference rate is required on all other items to maintain revenue neutrality. The paper also shows that some equity improvements stem from the reform’s implied pivot towards taxing services. Finally, simulations show that focusing on and expanding the cashback could amplify equity gains by raising the poorest disposable income by 25 percent via reductions in their tax liability.
url:0872b52a2be728b2.abstract_zh: 历经数十年酝酿，巴西里程碑式的增值税改革于2023年获批。此次改革的首要目标是在保持税收中性前提下，消除现行消费税体系的扭曲效应并降低其复杂性。此外，改革还纳入了特定设计特征，以缓解增值税固有的累退性，提升巴西税收体系的公平性。本文基于家庭数据的微观静态模型评估了改革预期的公平性影响，并模拟了进一步改善分配结果的备选政策方案。尽管新增值税制在多数收入群体间实现了较为均衡的税负分配，但最贫困群体在可支配收入层面仍承担着更重的负担。按政策工具分解影响可见：在税收中性假设下，改革批准的优惠税率加剧了累退性，而零税率与新推行的现金返还机制则降低了贫困家庭的税负。总体而言，这些措施的联合使用在一定程度上削弱了改革的公平性效果——为维持税收中性，所有其他商品需适用更高的增值税基准税率。本文还表明，部分公平性改善源于改革隐含的服务业征税重心转移。最后，模拟结果显示，聚焦并扩大现金返还机制可通过减少贫困群体税负使其可支配收入提升25%，从而放大公平性收益。

url:08dae84490b01235.abstract: We develop a tractable quantitative model of international trade in which agents make bilateral investments in resilience under general equilibrium uncertainty. Under both complete and incomplete financial markets, we show that these bilateral investments solve a portfolio problem of choosing trade partners. Countries’ risk profiles become determinants of trade flows, income and welfare, whose first moments are affected by the second moments of productivity and trade costs. Changes in global economic uncertainty have heterogeneous effects across countries, depending on how they affect real hedging opportunities. The opening of trade can raise or reduce income volatility, but is revealed-preferred to autarky.
url:08dae84490b01235.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个可量化的国际贸易模型，其中经济主体在一般均衡不确定性下对韧性进行双边投资。在完全金融市场与不完全金融市场两种情形下，我们证明这些双边投资可归结为选择贸易伙伴的投资组合问题。国家的风险特征成为贸易流量、收入与福利的决定因素，而这些变量的第一矩受生产率与贸易成本第二矩的影响。全球经济不确定性的变化对不同国家产生异质性影响，其作用方向取决于这些变化如何影响实际对冲机会。贸易开放可能提高或降低收入波动性，但通过显示性偏好优于自给自足状态。

url:090fae4ab7f54eaf.abstract: Assessing the real-world economic value of weather forecasts remains challenging, particularly in the context of high-impact extreme events. Although meteorological skill has improved substantially in recent years—driven by steady advances in physics-based models and impressive breakthroughs in artificial intelligence-based forecasting—operational evaluations still focus primarily on standard skill metrics, with limited consideration of how improvements in meteorological skill translate into economic value. This study proposes a flexible framework to assess the economic value of weather forecasts, with penalty functions that explicitly account for compounding losses as well as declining user trust in cases of repeated false alarms. In addition, the framework allows for varying cost—loss ratios to represent heterogeneous prevention costs and vulnerability structures. The framework is applied to cities exposed to weather-related natural hazards, comparing the relative economic value of leading physics-based and data-driven forecasting systems from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts. The value of forecasts is highly sensitive to assumptions about compounding losses, penalty structures, and prevention costs, which often substantially alter conclusions drawn from meteorological skill alone. For instance, in some cities in Southern Europe, the higher sensitivity of the physics-based Integrated Forecast System high-resolution model (IFS HRES) makes it better suited when protection costs are small relative to potential losses, while the higher specificity of the data-driven Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System (AIFS) makes it better when protection costs are higher. These findings underscore the importance of evaluating economic value under realistic risk scenarios to ensure that improvements in predictive accuracy translate into meaningful societal and economic benefits.
url:090fae4ab7f54eaf.abstract_zh: 评估天气预报的真实经济价值仍具挑战性，尤其是在高影响极端事件的背景下。尽管近年来气象预报技能显著提升——得益于基于物理模型的稳步改进和基于人工智能预报的突破性进展——但业务评估仍主要聚焦于标准技能指标，对气象技能提升如何转化为经济价值的考量十分有限。本研究提出一个灵活框架来评估天气预报的经济价值，其惩罚函数明确考虑了复合损失以及重复误报情况下用户信任度下降的影响。此外，该框架允许成本-损失比变化，以表征异质性预防成本和脆弱性结构。将该框架应用于面临天气相关自然灾害的城市，比较了欧洲中期天气预报中心领先的基于物理模型和数据驱动预报系统的相对经济价值。预报价值对复合损失、惩罚结构和预防成本的假设高度敏感，这些因素往往显著改变仅基于气象技能得出的结论。例如，在南欧部分城市，当保护成本相对于潜在损失较小时，基于物理模型的综合预报系统高分辨率模式（IFS HRES）因其更高灵敏度而更适用；而当保护成本较高时，数据驱动的人工智能预报系统（AIFS）因其更高特异性而表现更优。这些发现强调了在现实风险情景下评估经济价值的重要性，以确保预报精度的提升转化为有意义的社会经济效益。

url:09b2753420918138.abstract: We study how politically polarized television news shapes household inflation expectations in Turkey. We combine new household panel data with transcript-based measures of channel-level inflation coverage during prime-time news and a large-scale randomized information experiment. Inflation coverage differs sharply across politically aligned channels, and viewers sort into outlets consistent with their political affiliations. Within-person estimates show that greater coverage on a respondent’s initially preferred channel leads to higher inflation expectations, with effects concentrated among viewers of politically neutral channels. Experimental evidence indicates that belief updating depends on prior anchoring as well as on source credibility and reveals the political costs of rising inflation expectations.
url:09b2753420918138.abstract_zh: 本文研究政治极化电视新闻如何影响土耳其家庭通胀预期。我们结合新的家庭面板数据、基于文本分析的黄金时段新闻频道通胀报道指标，以及大规模随机信息实验。不同政治倾向频道的通胀报道存在显著差异，观众会根据自身政治立场选择观看渠道。个体内估计显示，受访者初始偏好频道对通胀的报道越多，其通胀预期越高，且该效应集中于观看政治中立频道的观众群体。实验证据表明，信念更新既取决于先验锚定效应，也受信息来源可信度影响，并揭示了通胀预期上升的政治成本。

url:0a097f2ffe108349.abstract: We develop a state-space framework that jointly estimates central bank credibility as a scalar latent variable and the associated time-varying monetary policy reaction function. The Kalman filter extracts an unobservable credibility index from observed inflation expectations, while Recursive Least Squares continuously updates the reaction function coefficients using the Kalman innovations sequence, ensuring that parameter estimation operates on long-run trend components rather than transitory fluctuations. Under standard regularity conditions, we establish consistency of the credibility estimator and show that the reaction function coefficients attain the Cramer-Rao bound when the innovation variance is constant; a GLS variant achieves efficiency in the heteroskedastic case. url:0c75d766671b84c4.abstract: Valuation losses can build quickly in response to higher interest rates, as demonstrated by the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank. This column shows that Italian banks do hedge against interest rate risk and, crucially, increase hedging when rates rise. This suggests banks actively adjust hedging intensity through derivatives, consistent with a state-dependent model of risk management. Institutions with lower capital ratios, a larger share of wholesale funding, and a smaller deposit base hedge more aggressively. These findings highlight the importance of considering derivative exposure in stress-testing frameworks, as derivatives are a key channel through which banks absorb shocks.

url:0d910368a6b8cd64.abstract: What role do firms play in geographic wage disparities? This paper exploits establishment mobility as a novel source of identification to separate firm sorting from location treatment effects, i.e., the local wage premium for a given worker at a given firm (due to, e.g., geography, infrastructure, amenities). Using data from France and the U.S., we first document key facts about establishment relocation: 4% of establishments move each year, retaining their activity and structure while adjusting their workforce and wages. Combining establishment and worker mobility in France, we estimate a model that decomposes wage variation due to workers, firms, and locations. Spatial wage differences are primarily driven by sorting: worker composition accounts for 30%, firm composition for 17%, and their co-location for 34%. Residual location effects explain only 2–4%. Establishment sorting also accounts for most of the urban wage premium and the higher wage growth in larger cities.
url:0d910368a6b8cd64.abstract_zh: 企业在地区工资差异中扮演何种角色？本文利用企业迁移作为新的识别来源，将企业分类效应与区位处理效应（即给定工人和给定企业在特定地点获得的工资溢价，例如由地理、基础设施、便利设施等因素导致）分离开来。基于法国和美国的数据，我们首先记录了企业迁移的关键事实：每年有4%的企业迁移，它们在保留自身活动和结构的同时调整员工队伍和工资水平。结合法国企业和工人的流动性，我们估计了一个分解工人、企业和地点对工资变化影响的模型。空间工资差异主要由分类效应驱动：工人构成解释30%，企业构成解释17%，两者共同定位解释34%。残余的区位效应仅解释2-4%。企业分类效应还解释了大部分城市工资溢价以及大城市中更高的工资增长。

url:0e57bac241ebf977.abstract: How does terrorism affect labor markets in developing countries? We combine georeferenced data on terrorist incidents with nationally representative employment data from Nigeria to examine this question. Exploiting within-location variation in exposure to terrorist attacks over time, we show that terrorism reduces employment. A one standard deviation increase in exposure lowers the probability of employment by 0.7 percentage points, or roughly 1 percent of average employment, with substantially larger effects for women. Beyond reducing employment, terrorism shifts workers away from regular and cash-paying jobs and lowers employment in sales, services, and unskilled manual occupations. The findings identify labor market disruption as an important economic cost of insecurity in developing countries.
url:0e57bac241ebf977.abstract_zh: 恐怖主义如何影响发展中国家的劳动力市场？我们将恐怖袭击的地理参照数据与尼日利亚具有全国代表性的就业数据相结合来研究这一问题。通过利用同一地区在不同时期遭受恐怖袭击暴露程度的差异，我们发现恐怖主义会降低就业水平。恐怖袭击暴露程度每增加一个标准差，就业概率将下降0.7个百分点（约占平均就业率的1%），且对女性的影响显著更大。除减少就业外，恐怖主义还促使劳动者从正规就业和现金支付岗位转移，并导致销售、服务业及非熟练体力劳动岗位的就业下降。研究结果表明，劳动力市场紊乱是发展中国家不安全局势的重要经济代价。

url:0f62f6ba54cb5b26.abstract: This paper studies the macroeconomic dynamics of climate policy in a multi-sector dynamic general equilibrium model with renewable and non-renewable energy, sector-specific capital adjustment frictions, household energy demand, and endogenous fossil resource dynamics. The central mechanism is that decarbonization requires reallocating energy use and installed capital: fossil energy demand can contract immediately, while renewable capacity and abatement adjust only gradually. The analysis delivers four results. First, gradual policy implementation sharply reduces transition costs: relative to immediate implementation, gradual emissions caps improve welfare by 2.26 percentage points under comprehensive regulation and by 5.06 percentage points under firm-only regulation. Second, renewable energy subsidies and non-renewable energy taxes support renewable capital accumulation and reduce, but do not eliminate, the welfare cost of front-loaded tightening. Third, sectoral coverage changes the welfare ranking across implementation speeds. Firm-only regulation performs better under gradual implementation because it shields utility-relevant household energy services, but becomes nearly as costly as the carbon-price-only transition under immediate implementation. Fourth, endogenous fossil exploration and stock-dependent extraction costs transmit climate policy into lower extraction, fewer discoveries, and a declining shadow value of reserves, providing a structural mechanism for stranded fossil assets. The results show that deep decarbonization can be achieved at substantially lower macroeconomic cost when policy manages the speed and incidence of energy-capital reallocation.
url:0f62f6ba54cb5b26.abstract_zh: 本文在多部门动态一般均衡模型中研究气候政策的宏观经济动态，该模型包含可再生能源与不可再生能源、部门特定的资本调整摩擦、家庭能源需求以及内生的化石资源动态。核心机制在于：脱碳需要重新配置能源使用和已安装资本——化石能源需求可立即收缩，而可再生能源产能与减排措施仅能逐步调整。分析得出四项结论。第一，渐进式政策实施能显著降低转型成本：相较于立即实施，在全面监管下渐进式排放上限可使福利提升2.26个百分点，在企业单独监管下则提升5.06个百分点。第二，可再生能源补贴与不可再生能源税有助于促进可再生能源资本积累，并降低（但无法消除）前置收紧带来的福利成本。第三，部门覆盖范围会改变不同实施速度下的福利排序。渐进式实施中企业单独监管表现更优，因其保护了与效用相关的家庭能源服务，但在立即实施下其成本几乎与仅依赖碳价格的转型相当。第四，内生的化石能源勘探与储量依赖型开采成本使气候政策传导为开采量下降、发现量减少及储量影子价值降低，为化石资产搁浅提供了结构性机制。研究结果表明，当政策能够管理能源-资本重新配置的速度与影响范围时，深度脱碳可在显著降低宏观经济成本的条件下实现。

url:0fd9f776952ff8d4.abstract: We present a new constraint on the size of the Fed’s balance sheet: repo market capacity. Calibrating a structural model to the recent monetary tightening cycle, we show that repo market capacity—driven by money market fund liquidity supply—is the binding constraint on the Fed’s balance sheet, not bank reserve demand, which was highlighted in the events of September 2019. We also demonstrate a novel complementarity between interest rate and balance sheet policies: higher policy rates expand repo capacity, allowing the central bank to operate with a smaller balance sheet.
url:0fd9f776952ff8d4.abstract_zh: 我们提出了美联储资产负债表规模的新约束条件：回购市场容量。通过将结构性模型校准至近期的货币紧缩周期，我们表明，由货币市场基金流动性供给驱动的回购市场容量才是美联储资产负债表的约束性条件，而非2019年9月事件中凸显的银行准备金需求。我们还揭示了利率政策与资产负债表政策之间一种新颖的互补关系：更高的政策利率会扩大回购市场容量，从而使央行能够以更小的资产负债表规模运作。

url:10206a09b764f828.abstract: This study examines the macroeconomic drivers of corporate investment in the United Kingdom using a multivariate time-series framework. Focusing on five key variables-interest rates, inflation, GDP growth, exchange rates, and corporate profits-the analysis investigates their combined effects on aggregate corporate investment using annual data from 1990 to 2022. By concentrating on macroeconomic determinants rather than firm-level factors, the study provides evidence on how monetary and real-sector conditions shape investment behavior in a mature, market-based economy. The contribution of this study lies in integrating long-run macroeconomic trends within a multivariate econometric framework that captures interactions between corporate profits, inflation, and exchange-rate movements in the UK over three decades of evolving policy regimes. Given the mixed order of integration among the variables, the study employs an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) bounds testing approach to examine long-run relationships and short-run adjustment dynamics. OLS and Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS) estimates are retained as benchmark and robustness checks. The results indicate that higher interest rates exert a significant positive effect on corporate investment, consistent with the endogenous and pro-cyclical nature of UK monetary policy. Corporate profits have a strong positive influence, highlighting the importance of internal finance. Inflation exhibits a negative and significant impact, while GDP growth shows a weak accelerator effect and exchange-rate movements are statistically insignificant. These findings underscore the dominance of profitability and policy credibility in driving UK investment and offer relevant insights for sustaining long-term capital formation.
url:10206a09b764f828.abstract_zh: 本研究采用多元时间序列框架，考察英国企业投资的宏观经济驱动因素。聚焦利率、通胀、GDP增长、汇率及企业利润五大关键变量，基于1990年至2022年的年度数据，分析其对总体企业投资的综合影响。通过聚焦宏观层面而非企业层面的决定因素，本研究揭示了货币与实体部门条件如何塑造成熟市场经济体的投资行为。本研究的贡献在于，将长期宏观经济趋势整合至多元计量框架中，捕捉英国三十年间政策体制演变下企业利润、通胀与汇率波动之间的交互作用。鉴于变量间存在混合阶数整合特征，研究采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）边界检验法，考察长期关系与短期调整动态。同时保留普通最小二乘法（OLS）与两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）的估计结果，作为基准检验与稳健性验证。结果表明：利率上升对企业投资具有显著正向效应，这与英国货币政策的内生性与顺周期性特征一致；企业利润呈现强正向影响，凸显内部融资的重要性；通胀具有显著负向影响，而GDP增长仅呈现微弱加速效应，汇率波动则无统计显著性。这些发现强调了盈利能力与政策可信度对英国投资的主导作用，为维持长期资本形成提供了相关启示。

url:102dcdb11572cf15.abstract: The effectiveness of many interventions depends on implementer quality; as programs scale and the pool of implementers broadens, average quality falls. Conversation-based interventions, such as counseling or peer mentoring, are particularly sensitive to implementer skill. LLMs offer a natural way out: they can hold personalized exchanges at zero marginal cost and uniform quality. Whether AI can replicate, or even improve on, the human skills thought to make such interventions effective remains an open question. We run a nationwide experiment in Chile (N=41,000) comparing an AI-powered chatbot, Kai, with trained human counselors. Both arms reach high school seniors via WhatsApp and aim to motivate them toward teaching careers, addressing future teacher shortages. Among students with baseline interest in teaching (the main target of the intervention) Kai significantly increases the probability of ranking an education major first as well as the share of education majors in students' choice sets; estimates in the human arm are smaller and not statistically significant. We use text analysis to characterize conversational attributes and test mechanisms. Both arms cover a comparable breadth of topics, but Kai concentrates on factual content while human counselors lean on subjective, socioemotional material. Kai's exchanges are substantially faster and more dynamic, with near-instantaneous responses and shorter student gaps, and more semantically coherent on both sides. Human counselors, in turn, score substantially higher on motivation and empathy. We interpret these results as evidence that AI relaxes the implementer-quality constraint in conversation-based interventions at scale.
url:102dcdb11572cf15.abstract_zh: 许多干预措施的有效性取决于实施者的素质；随着项目规模扩大和实施者群体拓宽，平均素质会下降。基于对话的干预措施（如咨询或同伴指导）对实施者的技能尤为敏感。大语言模型提供了一种自然的解决方案：它们能够以零边际成本和统一质量进行个性化交流。人工智能能否复制甚至提升被认为使此类干预措施有效的人类技能，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们在智利开展了一项全国性实验（样本量N=41,000），将人工智能驱动的聊天机器人Kai与受过培训的人类咨询师进行对比。两组干预均通过WhatsApp联系高中毕业生，旨在激励他们选择教师职业，以应对未来教师短缺问题。在基线阶段对教学职业感兴趣的学生（干预的主要目标群体）中，Kai显著提高了他们将教育专业列为第一志愿的概率，以及教育专业在学生选择组合中的占比；而人类咨询师组的估计值较小且未达到统计显著性。我们通过文本分析来刻画对话特征并检验作用机制。两组干预覆盖的话题广度相当，但Kai侧重于事实性内容，而人类咨询师更依赖主观的社会情感素材。Kai的对话速度更快、互动性更强，表现为近乎即时的回复和更短的学生回应间隔，且双方对话的语义连贯性更高。相比之下，人类咨询师在动机激发和共情能力方面得分显著更高。我们将这些结果解读为：人工智能在规模化实施基于对话的干预措施时，能够缓解实施者素质这一约束条件。

url:1144b5923afa68db.abstract: Since the 1990s, the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) has reported much more rapid growth in U.S. private sector employer establishments than has the Census Bureau – the gap reached roughly 1.6 million by 2023. These discrepancies substantially affect the measured establishment size distribution and quantitative policy analysis.
url:1144b5923afa68db.abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，美国劳工统计局（BLS）报告的私营部门雇主机构数量增速远超人口普查局——截至2023年，两者差距已达约160万家。通过关联BLS与人口普查局的微观数据，我们揭示了两大驱动因素：其一，为老年人和残障人士提供服务的雇主机构中，有大量且持续增长的机构属于BLS统计框架范围，但未被纳入人口普查局框架；其二，许多企业在BLS框架中显示的机构数量显著更多。这些差异对测度的机构规模分布及量化政策分析产生了实质性影响。

url:1223ef23a75d452b.abstract: The EU’s fiscal governance framework was built to contribute to overall macroeconomic stability through compliance with fiscal rules and the commitment not to bail-out countries in trouble. Yet successive crises have revealed vulnerabilities under systemic stress: countries with a propensity to run deficits push frugal ones into ex-post bail-out arrangements to avert collapse, thus undermining the ex-ante credibility of the framework. The absence of a permanent, preventive instrument forces the Union to oscillate between leniency and emergency intervention. A permanent RRF-like mechanism - linking EU funds to reform and investment projects - offers an incentive compatible solution and a possible bridge to a larger EU budget.
url:1223ef23a75d452b.abstract_zh: 欧盟的财政治理框架旨在通过遵守财政规则以及不救助陷入困境国家的承诺，促进整体宏观经济稳定。然而，接连不断的危机揭示了系统性压力下的脆弱性：倾向于赤字运行的国家迫使节俭国家在事后采取救助安排以避免崩溃，从而削弱了该框架的事前可信度。由于缺乏永久性的预防工具，欧盟不得不在宽松政策与紧急干预之间摇摆。一个类似复苏与韧性基金的永久性机制——将欧盟资金与改革和投资项目挂钩——提供了一种激励相容的解决方案，并可能成为迈向更大规模欧盟预算的桥梁。

url:1475186647063c42.abstract: Circulation into and out of the top one percent is pronounced in the U.S. One third exit after a year and two-thirds exit after a decade. This mobility lowers top income shares when shifting from annual to multi-year income measures. Intragenerational mobility over two decades lowers recent top one percent fiscal income shares by over 10 percent. Two-decade mobility reduces top 0.1% shares by over 20 percent, top 0.01% shares by 30 percent, and top 0.001% shares by 40 percent. Effects of variability on wealth inequality are similar in magnitude, although more modest as a share of top wealth inequality.
url:1475186647063c42.abstract_zh: 美国收入前1%群体的流入与流出变动显著：一年后三分之一退出，十年后三分之二退出。这种流动性在将收入衡量周期从年度扩展至多年时，会降低顶层收入份额。二十年的代内流动性使近期前1%的财政总收入份额下降超过10%，前0.1%份额下降超过20%，前0.01%份额下降30%，前0.001%份额下降40%。收入波动对财富不平等的影响幅度与之相似，但就顶层财富不平等占比而言更为温和。

url:14d1cd210b6f6451.abstract: How households behave in an environment with deposit rates below zero is important for monetary transmission, but the literature is scant. This column studies household behaviour in the context of a major episode of negative interest rates in Denmark. This authors find that the negative deposit rates led to a strong decrease in deposits. Households appear to react more sharply when interest rates below zero are cut compared to when rates are positive. As depositors seem to consume more rather than hold more cash, policy rate cuts in negative territory may have particularly strong consumption effects.
url:14d1cd210b6f6451.abstract_zh: 家庭在存款利率为负的环境中的行为对货币传导至关重要，但相关文献较为匮乏。本文以丹麦负利率重大事件为背景，研究家庭行为。作者发现，负存款利率导致存款大幅减少。与正利率时期相比，当利率降至负值区间时，家庭反应更为剧烈。由于储户似乎更倾向于增加消费而非持有更多现金，负利率区间的政策利率下调可能对消费产生尤为显著的影响。

url:166f28b2ae37bbc1.abstract: We study how macroeconomic developments affect asset prices by analyzing the response of equity yields to a well-identified long-run growth shock. Using synthetic equity yield data from Giglio et al. (2024), we show that a positive long-run shock steepens the equity yield curve by increasing expected dividend growth while leaving discount rates largely unchanged. We examine how the investment driving this growth is financed and how yields respond across value and growth firms. Growth-firm yields respond more strongly than value-firm yields, reflecting larger changes in expected dividend growth. Ai et al. (2018)'s model, modified to separate cash dividends from total payout, best matches these responses relative to benchmark equity term structure models.
url:166f28b2ae37bbc1.abstract_zh: 本文通过分析股票收益率对明确识别的长期增长冲击的反应，研究宏观经济变化如何影响资产价格。利用Giglio等人（2024）的合成股票收益率数据，我们发现正向长期冲击通过提高预期股息增长率使股票收益率曲线陡峭化，而贴现率基本保持不变。我们考察了驱动这一增长的投资融资方式，以及价值型与成长型公司收益率的差异化反应。成长型公司收益率对冲击的反应强于价值型公司，这反映了其预期股息增长率的更大变化。相较于基准股票期限结构模型，Ai等人（2018）的模型（经修正以分离现金股息与总派息）最能匹配这些反应特征。
url:166f28b2ae37bbc1.title: The Response of Equity Yields to a Long-Run Shock

url:16761602fd1236ec.abstract: Did globalisation benefit consumers in poor countries? Using data on trade in goods for 138 countries, we measure the welfare gains from wider variety and higher quality of imported goods over the past quarter-century. The variety gains are large, a median 19 percent fall in the cost of living, and strongly pro-poor: poorer countries gained twice as much as richer ones. Because they derive from falling trade costs, variety gains made poor countries richer in real consumption even in the absence of income growth. Quality, by contrast, tracks income, and because income barely converged, neither did quality.

url:17e8f02258720842.abstract: More frequent large macroeconomic shocks since the global financial crisis have entrenched uncertainty, particularly in Europe. This has increased the premium on central bank communication in guiding expectations and strengthening macroeconomic resilience. European central banks have responded by adapting their communication toolkits and styles. This study provides a systematic assessment of recent central bank communication across advanced and emerging European economies, combining a survey of institutional communication frameworks with novel text-miningbased indicators on monetary policy guidance in these economies over 2009-2025. While communication toolkits are broadly similar, their intensity and transparency differ markedly, with central banks in advanced economies making greater use of forward-looking tools. Central banks in both groups respond primarily to inflation uncertainty. However, communication strategies diverge, as central banks in advanced economies increasingly shift toward forward-looking language, whereas those in emerging markets shift toward more backward-looking communication. These patterns highlight credibility and institutional capacity as key determinants of central bank communication under uncertainty.
url:17e8f02258720842.abstract_zh: 自全球金融危机以来，频繁发生的宏观经济冲击加剧了不确定性，尤其是在欧洲地区。这提升了央行沟通在引导预期和增强宏观经济韧性方面的价值。欧洲各国央行通过调整其沟通工具包和风格予以应对。本研究结合对机构沟通框架的调查，以及基于文本挖掘技术构建的2009-2025年欧洲发达与新兴经济体货币政策指引新指标，系统评估了近期欧洲各国央行的沟通实践。尽管沟通工具包大致相似，但其使用强度和透明度存在显著差异——发达经济体央行更频繁运用前瞻性工具。两组央行均主要对通胀不确定性作出反应，但沟通策略呈现分化：发达经济体央行日益转向前瞻性表述，而新兴市场央行则更多采用后顾式沟通。这些模式凸显了在不确定性环境下，可信度与制度能力是决定央行沟通策略的关键因素。

url:184352110b1e8216.abstract: This paper develops a framework for identification, estimation, and inference on the causal mechanisms driving endogenous social network formation. Identification is challenging because of unobserved confounders and reverse causality; inference is complicated by questions of equilibrium and sampling. We leverage repeated observations of a network over time and random variation in initial ties to address challenges to causal identification. Our design-based approach sidesteps questions of sampling and asymptotics by treating both the set of nodes (individuals) and potential outcomes as non-random. We apply our approach to data from a large professional services firm, where new hires are randomly assigned to project teams within offices. We estimate the causal effect on tie formation of indirect ties, network degree, and local network density. Indirect ties have a strong and significant positive effect on tie formation, while the effects of degree and density are smaller and less robust.
url:184352110b1e8216.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个用于识别、估计和推断内生社交网络形成因果机制的分析框架。由于存在未观测到的混杂因素和反向因果关系，识别过程面临挑战；而均衡与抽样问题则使推断变得复杂。我们利用网络随时间推移的重复观测数据以及初始联系的随机变异，以应对因果识别中的挑战。这种基于设计的方法将节点（个体）集合与潜在结果均视为非随机变量，从而规避了抽样与渐近性问题。我们将该方法应用于一家大型专业服务公司的数据——该公司新员工被随机分配到办公室内的项目团队中。我们估算了间接联系、网络度数及局部网络密度对联系形成的因果效应。结果表明，间接联系对联系形成具有显著且稳健的正向影响，而网络度数与密度的效应则相对较小且不够稳健。

url:19142e1092ff4356.abstract: Central bank independence is a major area of study, but the economic literature has been characterized by numerous misstatements regarding how U.S. monetary policy independence has operated over time. Against this backdrop, this paper lays out major elements of the practice of central bank independence in the United States in the period from 1951 to 2006—a time span that encompasses the William McChesney Martin, Jr., through Alan Greenspan tenures as the head of the Federal Reserve. Many documentary materials and policymaker quotations not considered in previous research on U.S. monetary policy are highlighted. The analysis covers both institutional aspects (statutory objectives, formalities of Federal Reserve structure, and conventions followed in regularizing the central bank’s interactions with the legislative and executive branches) and the conceptual basis for independence, as expressed by leading Federal Reserve officials, particularly Chairs. It is shown—with heavy reliance on their own words—how Federal Reserve Chairs have characterized the position of the central bank within the governmental structure of the United States and how they have set out the case for monetary policy independence. What emerges is that successive Chairs over the decades made essentially the same, three-part, economic case for independence. This case does not rely on the arguments associated with economic research on time inconsistency.
url:19142e1092ff4356.abstract_zh: 中央银行独立性是一个重要的研究领域，但关于美国货币政策独立性如何随时间运作的经济学文献中，存在诸多不准确表述。在此背景下，本文梳理了1951年至2006年间美国中央银行独立性的实践要素——这一时期涵盖小威廉·麦克切斯尼·马丁至艾伦·格林斯潘担任美联储主席的任期。本文重点引用了此前美国货币政策研究中未涉及的诸多文献资料与政策制定者言论。分析涵盖制度层面（法定目标、美联储组织架构形式、规范央行与立法及行政部门互动的惯例）以及美联储主要官员（尤其是主席）所阐述的独立性概念基础。通过大量引用其原话，本文展示了美联储主席如何界定央行在美国政府架构中的地位，以及如何论证货币政策独立性的必要性。研究表明，数十年来历任主席实质上提出了相同的、由三部分构成的经济独立性论证。这一论证并不依赖于与时间不一致性相关的经济学研究论点。

url:19e5dbe5b66798fe.abstract: This study examines how fluctuations in firm-level uncertainty arise over the business cycle and how they influence aggregate economic activity. To do so, it develops a general equilibrium incomplete-markets model in which heterogeneous, risk-averse firms face idiosyncratic demand uncertainty and aggregate shocks to consumer credit conditions. A change in aggregate credit affects not only the expected level of firm demand, but also the cross-sectional dispersion of sales per worker by shifting the probability that firms operate at capacity. Thus, first-moment shocks give rise to endogenous second-moment effects. The model is disciplined using U.S. Compustat data on firm sales and employment and proprietary customer traffic data. The calibrated economy reproduces key cross-sectional moments and business-cycle comovements, including countercyclical dispersion in firm outcomes. Quantitatively, endogenous uncertainty accounts for roughly one quarter of the output response and one third of the employment response to aggregate credit shocks. The results suggest that uncertainty is not only an independent source of aggregate fluctuations, but also an endogenous propagation mechanism through which changes in demand conditions amplify business cycles.
url:19e5dbe5b66798fe.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨企业层面不确定性如何随经济周期波动，以及这种波动如何影响总体经济活动。为此，构建了一个一般均衡不完全市场模型，其中异质性风险厌恶企业面临异质性需求不确定性和消费者信贷条件的总体冲击。总体信贷变化不仅影响企业需求的预期水平，还通过改变企业产能利用率概率，导致人均销售额的横截面离散度发生变化。因此，一阶矩冲击会引发内生性二阶矩效应。该模型采用美国Compustat数据库的企业销售与就业数据以及专有客流量数据进行校准。校准后的经济模型再现了关键横截面矩特征与经济周期联动性，包括企业绩效的反周期离散度。定量分析表明，内生不确定性解释了总体信贷冲击对产出响应的约四分之一，以及对就业响应的约三分之一。研究结果表明，不确定性不仅是总体经济波动的独立来源，更是需求条件变化放大经济周期的内生传导机制。

url:19fb7ffdb808b25d.abstract: Timely assessment of economic activity is crucial for effective policymaking at the national, regional, and global levels. However, many economies still do not publish GDP data at a quarterly basis, creating persistent information gaps. In 2025, 34% of economies publish only annual GDP statistics. This lack of higher-frequency and timely data is particularly restrictive for emerging market and developing economies, where economic volatility and spillover risks are often highest. The problem is more severe for historical data: only 42% of economies have quarterly GDP estimates for a period longer than 20 years. To address these gaps, this paper develops a model that estimates missing quarterly GDP series by leveraging global and regional economic interconnections. The method transforms sparse annual data into quarterly estimates by exploiting higher-frequency information from the rest of the world, enabling real-time policymaking in both data-scarce economies and in global-level discussions. Moreover, this method ensures internally consistent estimates of regional and global economic activity, allowing both top-down and bottom-up scenario analyses.
url:19fb7ffdb808b25d.abstract_zh: 及时评估经济活动对于国家、区域及全球层面的有效政策制定至关重要。然而，许多经济体仍未按季度发布GDP数据，导致持续存在信息缺口。2025年，34%的经济体仅发布年度GDP统计数据。这种高频及时数据的缺失对新兴市场和发展中经济体尤为不利，这些地区的经济波动和溢出风险往往最高。历史数据问题更为严峻：仅有42%的经济体拥有超过20年的季度GDP估算数据。为弥补这些缺口，本文构建了一个模型，通过利用全球和区域经济相互关联性来估算缺失的季度GDP序列。该方法借助世界其他地区的高频信息，将稀疏的年度数据转化为季度估算值，从而支持数据稀缺经济体及全球层面的实时政策制定。此外，该方法能确保区域和全球经济活动估算的内部一致性，支持自上而下与自下而上的情景分析。

url:1a86208b93671e28.abstract: Does a more persistent demand shock always generate a larger output response? Conventional wisdom says yes: forward-looking agents front-load spending in anticipation of higher lifetime resources, and the more lasting the shock, the stronger the expansion. This paper shows that this logic fails in New Keynesian models with an active monetary policy. The interplay between persistence and monetary policy stance governs a fundamental trade-off between two opposing forces: a permanent income channel that amplifies output, and a real interest rate channel that dampens it. Their balance generates three monetary policy regimes. In the empirically relevant intermediate regime, the output multiplier is hump-shaped in persistence.
url:1a86208b93671e28.abstract_zh: 更持久的需求冲击是否总会带来更大的产出响应？传统观点认为如此：前瞻性主体会因预期到终身资源增加而提前支出，且冲击持续时间越长，扩张效应越强。本文证明，在实施积极货币政策的凯恩斯模型中，这一逻辑并不成立。冲击持久性与货币政策立场之间的相互作用，主导着两种对立力量之间的根本权衡：放大产出的永久收入渠道与抑制产出的实际利率渠道。两者的平衡产生了三种货币政策体制。在具有经验相关性的中间体制中，产出乘数随持久性呈现驼峰形变化。
url:1a86208b93671e28.title: The Power of Persistence: How Demand Shocks and Monetary Policy Shape Macroeconomic Outcomes

url:1aad2201cc074b42.abstract: Firm-level geoeconomic risk can affect even broadly diversified mutual fund portfolios. We study U.S. export controls that restrict sales of cutting-edge technology to selected Chinese firms for national security reasons. The stock prices of affected domestic suppliers drop immediately after the policy introduction. Mutual funds holding these stocks experience increased volatility and lower returns. Fund managers respond by selling stocks of exporters to China, buying lottery-like stocks, and increasing portfolio concentration. While stock-picking and market-timing skills do not help, specialist and high-fee funds are better at navigating geoeconomic risk.

url:1c01f8a293a05489.abstract: Europe is under attack from the US, and under a different kind of attack from China. That is Olivier Blanchard's diagnosis. Blanchard (MIT, Paris School of Economics, Peterson Institute) is one of four economists leading Europe 2050, a new CEPR initiative asking where Europe wants to be in 25 years, and how it gets there. Blanchard's overriding principle: a vision without plumbing goes nowhere, and plumbing without vision is just reacting to the next tweet. Who can combine the vision and the plumbing, and produce ideas that we haven't seen before? Europe might be short of solutions to its current malaise, but it is not short of people with ideas: the project sent out 50 invitations for policy papers. Blanchard expected 30 replies. He got 48.
url:1c01f8a293a05489.abstract_zh: 欧洲正遭受来自美国的攻击，以及来自中国的另一种形式的攻击。这是奥利维尔·布兰查德（Olivier Blanchard）的诊断。布兰查德（麻省理工学院、巴黎经济学院、彼得森国际经济研究所）是领导"欧洲2050"项目的四位经济学家之一。这是CEPR发起的一项新倡议，探讨欧洲25年后应处于何种位置，以及如何实现这一目标。布兰查德的首要原则是：缺乏具体规划的愿景将寸步难行，而缺乏愿景的具体规划只会沦为对下一个推文的被动回应。谁能将愿景与具体规划相结合，并产生前所未有的创意？欧洲或许缺乏解决当前困境的方案，但绝不缺乏有想法的人才：该项目发出了50份政策论文邀请函。布兰查德预计会收到30份回复，结果收到了48份。

url:1d45de7bf6d5ddb7.abstract: We study whether AI methods applied to large-scale portfolio holdings data can improve macroprudential financial regulation. We build a graph-based deep learning model tailored to security-level data on the holdings of financial intermediaries. The architecture incorporates economic priors and learns latent representations of both assets and investors from the network structure of portfolio positions. Applied to the universe of non-bank financial intermediaries, covering nearly $40 trillion in wealth, the model substantially outperforms existing approaches in out-of-sample forecasts of intermediary trading behavior, including in crisis episodes. The model has more than ten times the explanatory power for the cross-sectional variation in asset returns during stress events compared to traditional approaches, and it outperforms existing systemic risk metrics at the institution level. Its learned representations show that the holdings network encodes rich, economically interpretable information about fire- sale vulnerability. The architecture is fully inductive, producing informative estimates even when entire asset classes or investors are withheld from training. We embed our empirical approach into a macroprudential optimal policy framework to formalize why these objects matter for policy and welfare. We show that even in an equilibrium environment subject to the Lucas critique, the predictive information from the model improves welfare by sharpening the cross-sectional targeting of policy interventions, and we demonstrate a complementarity between prediction and structural knowledge.
url:1d45de7bf6d5ddb7.abstract_zh: 本文研究人工智能方法应用于大规模投资组合持仓数据能否改善宏观审慎金融监管。我们构建了一个基于图的深度学习模型，专门针对金融中介机构持有的证券级数据。该架构融合了经济先验知识，通过投资组合持仓的网络结构学习资产与投资者的潜在表征。将该模型应用于覆盖近40万亿美元财富的非银行金融中介机构整体数据时，其在预测中介交易行为（包括危机时期）的样本外表现显著优于现有方法。在压力事件期间，该模型对资产收益截面变异的解释力是传统方法的十倍以上，且在机构层面优于现有系统性风险指标。模型习得的表征表明，持仓网络编码了关于火线抛售脆弱性的丰富且具有经济可解释性的信息。该架构具有完全归纳能力，即使将整个资产类别或投资者排除在训练集之外，仍能产生具有信息量的估计结果。我们将实证方法嵌入宏观审慎最优政策框架，以形式化说明这些变量对政策与福利的重要性。研究表明，即使在面临卢卡斯批判的均衡环境中，该模型的预测信息通过强化政策干预的截面精准度提升了社会福利，并揭示了预测能力与结构性知识之间的互补关系。
url:1d45de7bf6d5ddb7.title: The Optimal Use of AI in Financial Regulation
url:1d45de7bf6d5ddb7.title_zh: 人工智能在金融监管中的最优应用

url:1d7ee391c193c2ea.abstract: Making informed policy decisions is contingent upon the availability of reliable and timely data. The use of non-traditional data has been shown to be a powerful tool for enabling policymakers to conduct robust nowcasting—the practice of estimating the current period’s economic indicator(s), ahead of official releases, using a wide range of macroeconomic and high-frequency data. This paper showcases how different types of non-traditional data, such as indices extracted from satellite imagery, Google Trends, and flight tracking information, can be leveraged to complement official statistics and monitor economic activity, and how these timely signals can be incorporated into nowcasting models to provide early estimates of key macroeconomic variables in Morocco. The approach is applied to agricultural gross value added, tourism revenues, and the unemployment rate. The results demonstrate that non-traditional data substantially improves nowcasting models by enhancing predictive accuracy and enabling the rapid generation of nowcast estimates prior to the release of official data.
url:1d7ee391c193c2ea.abstract_zh: 制定明智的政策决策依赖于可靠且及时的数据。非传统数据的运用已被证明是强有力的工具，能够帮助政策制定者进行稳健的即时预测——即在官方数据发布前，利用广泛的宏观经济和高频数据估算当前时期的经济指标。本文展示了如何利用不同类型的非传统数据（如从卫星图像、谷歌趋势和航班追踪信息中提取的指数）来补充官方统计数据并监测经济活动，以及如何将这些及时信号纳入即时预测模型，为摩洛哥的关键宏观经济变量提供早期估算。该方法应用于农业总增加值、旅游收入和失业率。结果表明，非传统数据通过提高预测准确性，并能够在官方数据发布前快速生成即时预测估算，显著改进了即时预测模型。
url:1d7ee391c193c2ea.title: Leveraging Non-traditional Data for Macroeconomic Nowcasting: The Case of Morocco

url:1ee263e966d10b7d.abstract: China cannot sell as much as it used to in the United States. That trade has to go somewhere, and somewhere might be Europe. In this week's VoxTalk, Tim Phillips asks Pol Antràs (Harvard) and Beata Javorcik (EBRD, Oxford) what this means for European producers and consumers. Antràs and Andrea Presbitero have mapped which countries and sectors face the sharpest competition from redirected Chinese exports, and which stand to gain. Does cheap Chinese tech ease Europe's energy cost crisis, or squeeze European manufacturers of wind turbines and electric cars? If Europe decides to take the gains where consumers and firms can get them, and compensate the producers who are legitimately hurt, how do they go about it? And can raising tariffs in a world of global value chains protecting one sector without damaging others? New episode, recorded at the PSE-CEPR Policy Forum 2026 in Paris.
url:1ee263e966d10b7d.abstract_zh: 中国对美出口规模已不如往昔，这部分贸易必须另寻出路，而欧洲可能成为其目的地。在本期VoxTalk中，蒂姆·菲利普斯邀请哈佛大学的波尔·安特拉斯与欧洲复兴开发银行及牛津大学的贝娅塔·亚沃奇克，共同探讨这一趋势对欧洲生产者和消费者的影响。安特拉斯与安德烈亚·普雷斯特罗绘制了地图，标明哪些国家与行业将面临中国出口转向带来的最激烈竞争，以及哪些国家与行业可能从中获益。廉价的中国技术究竟是缓解了欧洲的能源成本危机，还是挤压了欧洲风力涡轮机和电动汽车制造商的生存空间？如果欧洲决定让消费者和企业从中获益，并对确实受损的生产者进行补偿，那么该如何具体实施？在全球价值链背景下提高关税，能否在不损害其他行业的前提下保护特定行业？本期节目录制于2026年巴黎PSE-CEPR政策论坛。
url:1ee263e966d10b7d.title: Europe in the Middle

url:1f1022daa4945882.abstract: The use of sanctions has grown steadily over the past seven decades, with well-documented effects on bilateral trade. This column analyses the effects of sanctions on cross-border mergers and acquisitions from sanctioning to target countries over the period 2006-2023. It finds that sanctions reduce the number of deals by around 50%, with stronger effects as time passes. The impact is stronger in the mining, manufacturing, and energy sector than in the services sector. The results reinforce the broad-based potential effects of sanctions on private sector economic activity.

url:204a6a1cf1a1f83b.abstract: Does an exchange rate depreciation depress trading partners’ output? I address this question through the lens of a classic episode: from 1931 to 1936, the largest economies in the world successively devalued their currency. In theory, the effect is ambiguous for countries that had not devalued: expenditure switching can lower their output, but the monetary stimulus to foreign demand might raise it. Newly constructed high-frequency devaluation shocks and a multi-country model disciplined by cross-sectional evidence concur. Contrary to the popular narrative in modern policy debates, devaluation did not dramatically lower the output of trading partners in this context. Meanwhile, devaluation substantially raised the output of the devaluing country itself: it was a potent stimulus, not a zero-sum game.
url:204a6a1cf1a1f83b.abstract_zh: 汇率贬值是否会抑制贸易伙伴的产出？本文通过一个经典历史案例来探讨这一问题：1931年至1936年间，全球主要经济体相继实施货币贬值。理论上，对于未贬值国家而言，其影响具有不确定性：支出转换效应可能降低其产出，但外国需求受到的货币刺激则可能提升产出。基于新构建的高频贬值冲击数据以及受横截面证据约束的多国模型，研究结果趋于一致。与现代政策辩论中的流行叙事相反，在此背景下，贬值并未显著降低贸易伙伴的产出。与此同时，贬值大幅提升了贬值国自身的产出：这是一剂强有力的经济刺激措施，而非零和博弈。

url:204e600effb4bfa6.abstract: State honours are designed as symbols of merit and public recognition. But they may also convey information with economic value. This column explores the market value of the Légion d’honneur. When corporate directors of French listed firms receive the honour, their companies’ share prices rise. This market reaction is concentrated among directors without a publicly observable educational link to members of the incumbent government before the award. The pattern suggests that state distinctions can provide investors with new information about a director’s potential access to policymakers.
url:204e600effb4bfa6.abstract_zh: 国家荣誉旨在作为功绩和公众认可的象征，但它们也可能传递具有经济价值的信息。本文探讨了荣誉军团勋章的市场价值。当法国上市公司的董事获得该荣誉时，其所在公司的股价会上涨。这种市场反应主要集中在那些在获奖前与现任政府成员没有公开可观察的教育关联的董事身上。这一模式表明，国家荣誉能够为投资者提供关于董事接触政策制定者可能性的新信息。

url:213189c2722807cc.abstract: We study the relationship between health and social status in China using genealogical data from the 14th to 19th centuries. The data covers broad segments of the population linking husbands, wives, and sons, allowing us to examine whether status was associated with survival not only for adult men but also across households and generations. In a sample centered on the early 1700s, the typical lifespan of married men is 52, but varies widely. High-status men have a 22 percent higher probability of living past 50 than low-status men, resulting in a lifespan advantage of seven years. High status is also associated with significant survival advantages for wives and children. The lifespan premium of the wife of a high-status man over the wife of a commoner exceeds 10 years, and the chance that the son of a high-status man dies before reaching 10 years is less than half that of a low-status man’s son. Up to the 17th century the lifespan advantage is largely confined to those with top status, while the healthstatus gradient across all status levels emerges during the 18th century. The findings provide new evidence on health-status inequality in a less-studied setting, and suggest that health-status inequality is usefully analyzed from a family and intergenerational perspective.
url:213189c2722807cc.abstract_zh: 本文利用14至19世纪中国的家谱数据，研究健康与社会地位之间的关系。数据覆盖了广泛的社会阶层，将丈夫、妻子和儿子联系起来，使我们能够考察地位是否不仅与成年男性的生存状况相关，还涉及家庭内部及代际之间的影响。在以18世纪初为中心的样本中，已婚男性的典型寿命为52岁，但个体差异显著。高地位男性活过50岁的概率比低地位男性高22%，寿命优势达七年。高地位还与妻子和子女的显著生存优势相关：高地位男性妻子的寿命比平民妻子长超过10年，而高地位男性之子在10岁前死亡的概率不到低地位男性之子的一半。直至17世纪，寿命优势主要局限于顶级地位群体，而18世纪期间，所有地位层级之间均出现了健康-地位梯度。这些发现为较少被研究的背景下的健康-地位不平等提供了新证据，并表明从家庭和代际视角分析健康-地位不平等具有重要价值。

url:21b04bbf19e1c063.abstract: We study how behavioral economics and machine learning can jointly construct effective treatment-targeting rules. In a large field experiment at an online fashion retailer with approximately 500,000 consumers, we test a loss-framed discount message. We elicit individual loss aversion in a nested incentivized behavioral measurement experiment (N=582) and use machine learning to impute it from digital footprints. Targeting based on scaled behavioral measurement yields statistically significant revenue gains and outperforms causal forests. The results show how scaling behavioral measurement can improve algorithmic treatment assignment relative to purely data-driven approaches, especially when pilot data are unavailable, noisy, or costly.
url:21b04bbf19e1c063.abstract_zh: 我们研究行为经济学与机器学习如何共同构建有效的处理目标规则。在一项涉及约50万名消费者的在线时尚零售商大规模实地实验中，我们测试了一种损失框架折扣信息。我们在嵌套的激励性行为测量实验（N=582）中测量了个体损失厌恶程度，并利用机器学习从数字足迹中对其进行插补。基于规模化行为测量的目标定位带来了统计上显著的收益增长，且表现优于因果森林。研究结果表明，相较于纯粹的数据驱动方法，规模化行为测量能够改进算法处理分配，尤其是在缺乏试点数据、数据存在噪声或成本高昂的情况下。

url:21c04e459a62e7fe.abstract: Previous studies have shown that banks avoid passing negative monetary policy rates through to depositors, implying losses in deposit taking that erode equity and eventually have a negative impact on the lending of capital constrained banks. This paper shows that unconstrained banks respond differently, increasing loan supply even more with a deposit zero lower bound (D-ZLB) than without it. As a result, rate cuts below zero can be more stimulative than in positive territory, provided enough banks are unconstrained. A calibrated dynamic model finds this effect substantial, increasing aggregate loan supply by about 9% despite equity erosion pressures.
url:21c04e459a62e7fe.abstract_zh: 以往研究表明，银行会避免将负利率货币政策传导至存款人，这导致存款业务亏损侵蚀资本，并最终对资本受限银行的贷款产生负面影响。本文发现，不受约束的银行对此反应不同：在存款零下限（D-ZLB）环境下，其贷款供给增幅甚至超过无此约束时的水平。因此，只要存在足够多的不受约束银行，负利率政策下的降息可能比正利率区间更具刺激效应。经校准的动态模型显示，尽管存在资本侵蚀压力，该效应仍使总贷款供给增加约9%。
