url:2215e772023b58ad.abstract: Central bank communications frequently contain information about financial-market backstops that affect monetary policy transmission. We identify these transmission protection surprises in the euro area, alongside policy stance and central bank information surprises, by exploiting heteroskedasticity in minute-by-minute asset price movements. Unlike standard factor models, our approach allows active policy dimensions and their impacts to vary across events. Event-specific decompositions quantify the narrative record and reveal substantial heterogeneity of effects across announcements. We show that transmission protection is a distinct dimension of central bank announcements, with financial-market effects separate from both policy stance and information shocks.
url:2215e772023b58ad.abstract_zh: 央行沟通中频繁包含影响货币政策传导的金融市场兜底信息。我们利用欧元区资产价格分钟级波动的异方差性，在识别政策立场与央行信息冲击的同时，识别出这些传导保护意外。与标准因子模型不同，我们的方法允许政策维度及其影响在不同事件中动态变化。基于事件特定分解的量化叙事记录显示，不同公告的影响存在显著异质性。研究表明，传导保护是央行公告的独立维度，其金融市场效应与政策立场冲击及信息冲击均存在差异。

url:22466d410c9258ab.abstract: We study the political economy of carbon taxes when neoclassical consumers take all other agents' emissions as given and socially responsible consumers internalize damages in a group-rule-utilitarian way, taking neoclassical consumers' behavior as given. We characterize political equilibrium taxes with a focus on deviations from first-best Pigouvian taxation. Welfare falls further if arguments on moral obligations to reduce carbon footprints polarize the debate in society. Finally, we present survey evidence that supports our theory: social responsibility correlates with lower consumption of brown goods, higher preferred carbon taxes, and support for moral arguments.
url:22466d410c9258ab.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在两类消费者并存情境下碳税的政治经济学：新古典消费者将其他行为主体的排放视为既定，而具有社会责任感的消费者则以群体规则功利主义方式内化损害，并将新古典消费者的行为视为既定。我们刻画了政治均衡税收的特征，重点关注其与最优庇古税的偏离。若关于减少碳足迹的道德义务论据加剧社会辩论的两极分化，社会福利将进一步下降。最后，我们提供的调查证据支持了理论：社会责任感与棕色商品消费减少、更高碳税偏好及对道德论据的支持呈正相关。

url:22ec02177e268c9d.abstract: The changing global economic landscape is likely to expose the Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan (MENAP) and Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA) regions to more frequent external shocks, putting a premium on resilient and flexible macroeconomic policy frameworks. By using empirical analysis and model-based scenarios, this paper highlights the important roles of policy frameworks in stabilizing MENAP and CCA economies against adverse global shocks. Two messages stand out from the analysis. First, as countries make progress toward diversifying their exports and deepening domestic financial markets, credible inflation-targeting monetary policy regimes that allow greater exchange rate flexibility could enable faster adjustment to adverse global shocks. Second, adopting strong fiscal rules could help better anchor long-term expectations, reduce risk premiums, and help support countercyclical fiscal responses.
url:22ec02177e268c9d.abstract_zh: 不断变化的全球经济格局可能使中东、北非和巴基斯坦（MENAP）以及高加索和中亚（CCA）地区面临更频繁的外部冲击，从而凸显了具有韧性和灵活性的宏观经济政策框架的重要性。通过实证分析和基于模型的场景模拟，本文强调了政策框架在稳定MENAP和CCA经济体以应对不利全球冲击中的关键作用。分析得出两个核心结论：第一，随着各国在出口多元化和深化国内金融市场方面取得进展，采用可信的通胀目标制货币政策框架并允许更大汇率灵活性，能够加速对不利全球冲击的调整；第二，实施强有力的财政规则有助于更好地锚定长期预期、降低风险溢价，并支持逆周期财政应对措施。

url:24c483c6b977aec2.abstract: Stochastic debt sustainability analysis (SDSA) is a key tool for assessing risks in modern fiscal policymaking. Yet, designing and calibrating these models poses significant challenges. Using a panel of up to 24 OECD countries with data spanning from 1980, this paper argues that pooling data across countries provides a more representative reflection of fiscal risks, effectively extends sample periods, and a trend-cycle approach better accounts for structural changes. The choice of calibration method is policy relevant as it substantially alters the required primary balance adjustments to stabilise the debt ratio implied by the models. Given that real-time macroeconomic risks are skewed to the downside during economic upswings, the paper proposes a state-contingent (SC-SDSA) approach conditioned on contemporaneous output gap estimates. This suggests that risks are greater during economic booms than conventional approaches and that larger structural primary balances are required than in normal times to ensure adequate fiscal buffers.
url:24c483c6b977aec2.abstract_zh: 随机债务可持续性分析（SDSA）是现代财政政策制定中评估风险的关键工具。然而，此类模型的设计与校准面临重大挑战。本文基于24个OECD国家自1980年以来的面板数据，论证了跨国家数据整合能更全面地反映财政风险，有效延长样本周期，且趋势-周期方法能更好地解释结构性变化。校准方法的选择具有政策相关性，因为它会显著改变模型隐含的稳定债务比率所需的基本收支调整幅度。鉴于经济上行期实时宏观经济风险倾向于下行，本文提出一种基于当期产出缺口估计的状态依存（SC-SDSA）方法。这表明经济繁荣期的风险高于传统方法所揭示的水平，且需要比正常时期更大的结构性基本收支盈余，以确保充足的财政缓冲。

url:252e163d8f4945ec.abstract: The effects of the bank levy in Poland on the broadly defined credit market (including on loan rates and volumes) appear to be well documented, with the use of the standard difference-in-differences (DID) method. However, as, for example, Borusyak et al. (2024) note, in a setting with staggered treatment (as in the case of the bank levy in Poland), and different effects of the treatment in time and between cross-sections, the method might provide biased estimates. None of the studies to date used the heterogenous DID method that addresses this drawback. In this research note I use the heterogenous DID method to estimate the consequences of the bank levy. I also discuss other methodological choices. Among other things, I find that the bank levy has lowered deposit rates, raised rates on loans for house purchases, and changed the composition and the level of bank assets. However, I find no longer-term crowding out of credit by government bond securities (while the latter did increase, the former did not increase) or effects on bank profitability. The use of a more advised method did not lead to results in stark contrast with the earlier literature applying methods for causal inference.
url:252e163d8f4945ec.abstract_zh: 波兰银行税对广义信贷市场（包括贷款利率和规模）的影响已有充分文献记载，且普遍采用标准双重差分法（DID）进行分析。然而，正如Borusyak等人（2024）所指出的，在交错处理情境下（如波兰银行税案例），若处理效应在时间维度与截面维度存在异质性，该方法可能产生有偏估计。现有研究均未采用能解决此缺陷的异质性双重差分法。本研究采用异质性双重差分法评估银行税的经济后果，并探讨其他方法论选择。研究发现：银行税降低了存款利率，提高了购房贷款利率，并改变了银行资产的构成与规模。但未发现政府债券对信贷存在长期挤出效应（尽管债券规模上升，信贷规模并未下降），也未发现银行税对盈利能力产生显著影响。采用更优方法所得结论与早期运用因果推断方法的研究并无显著差异。

url:265115cc7bb350c3.abstract: Climate disasters tend to be associated with increased sovereign default risk. Countries face an “impossible trilemma”: scale up adaptation investment, keep debt sustainable amidst high borrowing costs and avoid the higher risk of default from delayed adaptation. Using a global panel of disaster event-level shocks, we find that a 1pp increase in disaster related losses as a share of GDP raises the odds of sovereign default by approximately 2-3 percent. An additional US$1 billion in cumulative Official Development Assistance (ODA) is associated with a 0.13 point gain in a country’s adaptive capacity. Using average marginal effects and our predicted margins we then map concessional ODA finance to default probability and translate these relationships into a practical budgeting yardstick for calibrating needed ODA to sovereign default risk reduction targets. In a context of declining ODA, our findings highlight the crucial role of well-designed support in climate adaptation policies.
url:265115cc7bb350c3.abstract_zh: 气候灾害往往与主权违约风险上升相关。各国面临一个"不可能三角"：扩大适应投资规模、在高借贷成本下维持债务可持续性、以及避免因延迟适应而导致的更高违约风险。基于全球灾害事件冲击层面的面板数据，我们发现灾害相关损失占GDP比重每增加1个百分点，主权违约概率将上升约2-3%。累计官方发展援助每增加10亿美元，与一国适应能力提升0.13个点相关。通过运用平均边际效应与预测边际值，我们将优惠性官方发展援助资金映射至违约概率，并将这些关系转化为实用的预算标尺，用于校准实现主权违约风险降低目标所需的官方发展援助。在官方发展援助持续缩减的背景下，我们的研究凸显了精心设计的支持在气候适应政策中的关键作用。

url:269f72d8dcece17b.abstract: How do labor demand shocks affect workforce diversity in the absence of targeted diversity policies? A conceptual framework illustrates the potential trade-off between the demographic and quality composition of a workforce when there is a positive labor demand shock. Exploiting the German reunification as a natural experiment, we analyze the academic labor market where nearly all social sciences professors in East Germany were replaced while STEM faculty remained largely unchanged. Using administrative data and a regional difference-in-differences design, we find increased dispersion in the institutional quality of hires, indicating that the new hires came from less select departments. At the same time, female representation did not increase despite qualified women in the pipeline. Instead, East German hiring patterns converged to those in West Germany in terms of gender composition. In simulations, we investigate implied losses: Under conservative assumptions, we show that, considering the pipeline of qualified applicants, the marginal female hire’s quality is approximately half a standard deviation higher than the marginal male hire’s quality.
url:269f72d8dcece17b.abstract_zh: 在缺乏针对性多元化政策的情况下，劳动力需求冲击如何影响劳动力多样性？一个概念框架揭示了正向劳动力需求冲击下，劳动力人口结构与质量构成之间可能存在的权衡关系。以德国统一作为自然实验，我们分析了学术劳动力市场——东德几乎所有社会科学教授均被替换，而STEM领域教职基本保持不变。基于行政数据与区域双重差分设计，我们发现新聘人员的机构质量离散度上升，表明新入职者来自学术选拔性较低的院系。与此同时，尽管具备资质的女性候选人储备充足，女性代表性并未提升。相反，东德在性别构成上的招聘模式逐渐趋同于西德。通过模拟分析，我们探究了隐含损失：在保守假设下，考虑合格申请者储备池时，边际女性新聘人员的质量比边际男性新聘人员高出约半个标准差。

url:2720f5d810ca042e.abstract: This paper provides new evidence on the prevalence and potential effects of non-compete and related clauses in Canada using OECD surveys of workers and firms. It finds that these clauses are widespread, increasingly used, and often applied beyond roles where they are most justified. Many appear overly broad and legally weak, yet a substantial share of workers report having been prevented from changing jobs or starting a business. Their impact is reinforced by behavioural factors, including reputational and ethical concerns. The findings also bring into closer focus the use of (firm-to-firm) no-poaching and wage fixing agreements that restrict labour market competition and, thus, raise broader concerns for the Canadian Competition Bureau.
url:2720f5d810ca042e.abstract_zh: 本文利用经合组织（OECD）对劳动者和企业的调查，为加拿大竞业限制及相关条款的普遍性及其潜在影响提供了新证据。研究发现，这些条款广泛存在、使用日益频繁，且常被应用于最缺乏合理性的岗位。许多条款过于宽泛且法律效力薄弱，但仍有相当比例的劳动者表示，这些条款阻碍了其更换工作或创业。其影响因声誉和道德关切等行为因素而进一步强化。研究结果还更聚焦于（企业间）互不挖角协议和薪资固定协议的使用，这些协议限制了劳动力市场竞争，从而引发了加拿大竞争局的更广泛担忧。

url:2845e750492565e9.abstract: Focus Exuberance about new technologies often brings about investment booms. The race among firms to capture a share of the revenues can result in excessive investment that makes the boom prone to a disruptive end. The boom-bust cycle recurs across history, from the canal and railway manias of the 19th century to the dotcom boom of the 1990s. The current artificial intelligence (AI) build-out ranks among the largest technology-driven investment booms in US history. Could it share the same fate as prior episodes?
url:2845e750492565e9.abstract_zh: 对新技术的狂热关注常常引发投资热潮。企业为争夺收入份额而展开的竞争可能导致过度投资，使热潮容易以破坏性结局收场。从19世纪的运河与铁路狂热到20世纪90年代的互联网泡沫，繁荣-萧条周期在历史上反复出现。当前的人工智能基础设施建设规模，堪称美国历史上规模最大的技术驱动型投资热潮之一。它是否会重蹈此前历次热潮的覆辙？

url:29831aeff41b4806.abstract: Firms often rebrand to counter negative shocks, but can it work? Using a historical natural experiment, we analyze a large sample of companies from the same industry (banking) that shared very similar names, but overwhelmingly decided to change them in response to a common, negative news shock. U.S. entry into World War I in 1917 created a sudden anti-German backlash against anything that invoked an association with the now enemy. The shock itself was thus orthogonal to bank fundamentals and pre-existing trends, but pushed banks to reconsider their brands. After 1917, the few German-named banks that kept their tainted names saw significant declines in assets, deposits, and market share relative to other banks. However, German-named banks that rebranded mitigated much of the negative shock. Specifically, German-named banks that adopted a new non-ethnic brand name avoided between 75% and 85% of the anti-German effect, and those that adopted a new patriotic brand name were able to neutralize it completely. Overall, we find that "crisis rebranding" paid off in our historical setting regardless of the chosen brand, with patriotic rebranding proving the most effective at offsetting the exogenous shock.
url:29831aeff41b4806.abstract_zh: 企业常通过品牌重塑应对负面冲击，但这一策略是否有效？借助历史自然实验，我们分析了同一行业（银行业）中大量名称高度相似的公司样本，这些公司在面临共同负面新闻冲击时，绝大多数选择更改名称。1917年美国加入第一次世界大战，引发了对任何与敌国（德国）相关事物的突然反德情绪。这一冲击本身与银行基本面及既有趋势正交，却促使银行重新审视其品牌。1917年后，少数保留受污名化德文名称的银行，其资产、存款及市场份额相较于其他银行显著下滑。然而，进行品牌重塑的德文名称银行在很大程度上缓解了负面冲击。具体而言，采用非族裔新品牌名称的德文名称银行避免了75%至85%的反德效应，而采用爱国新品牌名称的银行则完全抵消了这一影响。总体而言，我们发现无论选择何种品牌，历史情境下的“危机品牌重塑”均取得了成效，其中爱国品牌重塑在抵消外生冲击方面最为有效。

url:29bb043b9e0bf7d8.abstract: Trade networks underpinning the energy transition are endogenous economic objects, and their structure is a source of market power. Using bilateral trade data for thirteen electrification metals over 1995–2023, we show that trade in these materials has reorganised into a hub-and-spoke system centred on China, in sharp contrast to the diffuse, multilateral structure of fossil fuels. This centrality did not follow from resource endowments: China holds few of the underlying reserves. It was built through processing investment, industrial policy, and commodity-targeted development finance—an equilibrium outcome rather than a geographical accident. We formalise this in a stylised model in which a country chooses how central to become, and show that centrality maps into pricing power: the world price response to a strategic supply cut is stronger when the network is more concentrated and downstream demand and fringe supply are more inelastic. Constructing text-based, commodity-specific supply shocks and estimating local projections, we find that supply contractions in critical metals raise US and EU consumer prices by roughly twice as much as comparable fossil-fuel shocks, and more persistently. Centrality is therefore not merely descriptive: it creates leverage over global prices. The green transition reduces strategic dependence on hydrocarbon exporters but reconstitutes it around mineral supply chains. That's 200 words. Main cuts: removed the redundant "response to a strategic supply cut" phrasing fix (corrected the original "price...response" agreement), trimmed the closing "architecture of," and compressed a few connectors without losing any substantive claim.Please provide a short description (less than 180 characters) of the paper's findings. TThought processThought processCritical-mineral trade has concentrated into a China-centred hub-and-spoke network, giving pricing power: supply shocks raise US/EU prices twice as much as fossil-fuel shocks.
url:29bb043b9e0bf7d8.abstract_zh: 支撑能源转型的贸易网络是内生的经济对象，其结构构成市场势力的来源。利用1995-2023年间十三种电气化金属的双边贸易数据，我们发现这些材料的贸易已重组为以中国为中心的轴辐式体系，与化石燃料分散的多边结构形成鲜明对比。这种中心地位并非源于资源禀赋——中国持有的基础储量很少，而是通过加工投资、产业政策和针对特定商品的发展融资构建而成，是均衡结果而非地理偶然。我们通过一个简约模型将这一过程形式化，其中一国选择其中心化程度，并证明中心度映射为定价权：当网络更集中、下游需求和边缘供给更缺乏弹性时，战略性供给削减对世界价格的冲击更强。通过构建基于文本的特定商品供给冲击并估计局部投影，我们发现关键金属的供给收缩使美国和欧盟消费者价格涨幅约为可比化石燃料冲击的两倍，且持续性更强。因此，中心度不仅是描述性概念，更创造了影响全球价格的杠杆。绿色转型减少了对碳氢化合物出口国的战略依赖，但将其重构于矿产供应链之上。

url:2a3cf0a01e14b207.abstract: We show that the optimal monetary policy and exchange rate framework depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions may vary with the commodity cycle, and we compute the welfare-optimal policy in the presence of price and wage rigidities. Stabilizing domestic prices is welfare-optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But for economies that use commodities as inputs in production, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ the direct and indirect effects of commodity shocks on domestic prices; this contrasts with some earlier findings and policy practice (which only ‘looks through’ the direct effect). Exchange-rate pegs increase welfare for commodity importers because they stabilize wages and employment, though it is not a robustly optimal policy. In emerging and developing economies, where financial conditions are more tied to the commodity cycle, trade-offs are starker and implementing the optimal policy may be challenging, since it requires enough credibility to keep inflation expectations anchored amidst greater volatility in some nominal variables.
url:2a3cf0a01e14b207.abstract_zh: 我们证明，最优货币政策与汇率框架的关键取决于经济体的商品敞口程度。我们构建了一个兼具灵活性与可操作性的模型经济体，该模型包含商品进出口部门，且国际金融条件可能随商品周期变化，并在存在价格与工资粘性的条件下计算了福利最优政策。对于商品出口国而言，稳定国内价格是福利最优选择，这与标准开放经济政策建议一致。但对于将商品作为生产投入的经济体，最优政策在很大程度上会"忽略"商品冲击对国内价格的直接与间接影响——这与部分早期研究发现及政策实践（仅"忽略"直接影响）形成对比。对商品进口国而言，钉住汇率制度能提升福利水平，因其可稳定工资与就业，但这并非稳健的最优政策。在新兴市场与发展中经济体，金融条件与商品周期的关联更为紧密，政策权衡更为严峻，实施最优政策可能面临挑战——这要求政策具备足够公信力，以便在部分名义变量波动加剧时仍能锚定通胀预期。

url:2ab79988688ba071.abstract: Using novel data from the Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking, we examine how labor market tightness affects workers’ job quality. We estimate that a 10 percent increase in job vacancies not only increases the probability of changing jobs, it yields an 11–18 percent increase in the (unconditional) probability of switching to a better job overall, and one with greater pay and benefits, interest in the work, and advancement opportunities. Because tight labor markets improve both worker pay and job amenities in roughly the same proportion, their benefits to workers are underestimated when based on pay alone.
url:2ab79988688ba071.abstract_zh: 利用来自家庭经济与决策调查的新数据，我们研究了劳动力市场紧张程度如何影响工人的工作质量。我们估计，职位空缺每增加10%，不仅会提高工人更换工作的概率，还会使工人（无条件）转向整体更优工作的概率提升11%至18%，这类工作通常伴随更高的薪酬与福利、更强的工作兴趣以及更多的晋升机会。由于紧张的劳动力市场在提升工人薪酬与工作环境舒适度方面大致保持相同比例，仅基于薪酬评估会低估其对工人的整体益处。

url:2b082036b33c58b6.abstract: Despite unprecedented access to information in the digital age, young citizens face growing challenges related to news consumption and misinformation. This large-scale randomized controlled trial examines the impact of two complementary interventions designed to foster media literacy and the consumption of high-quality news among high-school students, implemented in France over the 2024-25 academic year. The study involves 243 high schools (for a total number of 9,628 students), randomly assigned to a control group or to receive one or both of the following interventions: (i) a one-year free digital subscription to the leading national newspaper, and (ii) media education modules implemented by teachers. Exploiting unique data on students' actual online news consumption, we document a very large uptake of the free subscription, which translates into persistent and large increases in news consumption (+0.49 to 0.60 sd) and demand for future news, including an 8pp increase in paid subscriptions nearly a year after the intervention. We also observe a 0.20 to 0.31 sd increase in news knowledge for students enrolled in deprived schools, reducing baseline information inequality by 45-70%. Finally, we show that both free news access and media education improve media literacy skills (+0.08 to 0.26 sd), with larger effects among students taught by teachers with prior experience in media education.
url:2b082036b33c58b6.abstract_zh: 尽管数字时代信息获取空前便捷，但年轻公民在新闻消费与应对虚假信息方面仍面临日益严峻的挑战。本项大规模随机对照试验考察了两项互补性干预措施的效果——旨在培养高中生媒介素养并促进高质量新闻消费，于2024-25学年在法国实施。研究涵盖243所高中（共计9,628名学生），随机分配至对照组或接受以下一项或两项干预：（i）为期一年的全国性主流报纸免费数字订阅；（ii）由教师实施的媒介教育模块。通过利用学生实际在线新闻消费的独特数据，我们发现免费订阅的采纳率极高，这转化为新闻消费的持续大幅增长（效应量0.49至0.60个标准差）及未来新闻需求的提升，包括干预实施近一年后付费订阅率增加8个百分点。在贫困学校就读的学生中，我们还观察到新闻知识水平提升0.20至0.31个标准差，使基线信息不平等程度降低45-70%。最后，研究表明免费新闻获取与媒介教育均能提升媒介素养技能（效应量0.08至0.26个标准差），且对由具备媒介教育经验的教师授课的学生影响更大。

url:2c3d8e326fef9053.abstract: Labour force participation among prime-aged American men has fallen for over half a century, and standard explanations leave much of the decline unaccounted for. This column combines panel and survey data to show that the labour markets these men experienced while growing up shaped their willingness to work decades later. These effects survive childhood moves across states and likely operate through men’s beliefs about whether work will pay off. If temporary downturns in labour demand can persistently influence labour supply, anchoring expectations about employment, not just inflation, may have a place in macroeconomic policy.
url:2c3d8e326fef9053.abstract_zh: 美国壮年男性劳动力参与率已持续下降逾半个世纪，而标准解释未能完全说明这一下降的原因。本专栏结合面板数据与调查数据表明，这些男性在成长过程中经历的劳动力市场状况，会影响他们数十年后的工作意愿。即便在童年跨州迁移的情况下，这种影响依然存在，且很可能通过男性对工作是否值得付出的信念发挥作用。如果劳动力需求的暂时低迷能够持续影响劳动力供给，那么锚定就业预期（而不仅仅是通胀预期）或许应在宏观经济政策中占有一席之地。

url:2ce494145e0cae43.abstract: Frontier Market (FM) status serves as a steppingstone for Low-Income Countries (LICs) aspiring to become Emerging Markets (EMs). Since the concept first emerged over three decades ago, FMs have gained substantial investment appeal, particularly after the 2008 Global Financial Crisis. At the same time, the recent series of global shocks starting with the COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the countries’ persistent vulnerabilities. This paper seeks to deepen our understanding of FMs by offering new analysis on the determinants of frontier market status and, using a dynamic country sample, examining the factors that help LICs attain and lose FM status. It finds that building robust macroeconomic fundamentals and ensuring good governance are critical for becoming an FM. In addition, the paper identifies flexible exchange rates, substantial official reserve buffers, and relatively low public debt and deficit levels as key contributors to lessening the sensitivity of FMs’ sovereign spreads to changes in global financial conditions.
url:2ce494145e0cae43.abstract_zh: 前沿市场（FM）地位是低收入国家（LICs）迈向新兴市场（EMs）的跳板。自三十多年前这一概念首次提出以来，FM已获得显著的投资吸引力，尤其是在2008年全球金融危机之后。与此同时，从新冠疫情开始的一系列近期全球冲击凸显了这些国家持续存在的脆弱性。本文旨在通过提供关于前沿市场地位决定因素的新分析，并利用动态国家样本，考察帮助低收入国家获得和失去FM地位的因素，从而加深我们对FM的理解。研究发现，构建稳健的宏观经济基本面并确保良好的治理是成为FM的关键。此外，本文指出，灵活的汇率制度、充足的外汇储备缓冲、以及相对较低的公共债务和赤字水平，是降低FM主权利差对全球金融状况变化敏感性的关键因素。

url:2d46f6cca7591c96.abstract: Cross-cultural databases are bounded by expert coding and missing observations. The Ethnographic Atlas (EA) codes 1,265 societies on 104 variables, with about 960 societies observed per variable on average, and the Standard Cross-Cultural Sample (SCCS) codes 186 societies on 1,717 variables, with about 105 observed per variable. I use a large language model and the 2,564-motif Berezkin catalogue to extract coverage, what motifs discuss, and stance, what positions they take. Stance, what a motif says, is strongest. Across 26 researcher-designed dimensions, stance is multidimensional (leading component 15.1%, matching ethnographic data) and largely independent of the coverage complexity gradient. On the two dimensions with direct human benchmarks, stance agrees on whether challenged characters succeed (kappa = 0.64) and whether antisocial behavior succeeds or is punished (kappa = 0.49), near the strongest available human benchmark of kappa about 0.57. Among 20 dimensions with no database equivalent, 18 have reliable group-level stance ratios across three runs (ICC >= 0.5$). Nine stance-outcome links survive continent fixed effects, false-discovery correction, and a complexity control, led by outsiders contact for lower GDP and emotional expression for higher female labor participation. Coverage succeeds differently. Across 1,805 usable codebook concepts, coverage predicts 65 of 88 EA variables and detects signal in 35 of 46 pooled SCCS domains, but this information concentrates in one factor. The first principal component explains 43% of score variance versus 15% in EA data, and the resulting complexity index predicts GDP within continents (R^2 = 0.55). Folklore measurement is one-dimensional only when the question is coverage. Researcher-defined concepts become measurable across 958 societies for $0.03 to $1.70.
url:2d46f6cca7591c96.abstract_zh: 跨文化数据库受限于专家编码与观测缺失。《民族志图谱》（EA）对1265个社会的104个变量进行编码，平均每个变量约960个观测值；《标准跨文化样本》（SCCS）对186个社会的1717个变量进行编码，平均每个变量约105个观测值。我利用大语言模型与包含2564个母题的别列兹金目录，提取了覆盖范围（即母题讨论的内容）与立场（即母题所持的立场）。其中，立场（即母题表述的内容）最为显著。在26个研究者设计的维度中，立场呈现多维性（主成分解释方差15.1%，与民族志数据匹配），且基本独立于覆盖范围的复杂度梯度。在具有直接人类基准的两个维度上，立场在受挑战角色是否成功（kappa=0.64）以及反社会行为是否成功或受惩罚（kappa=0.49）上达成一致，接近现有最强人类基准（kappa约0.57）。在20个无数据库对应维度的维度中，18个维度在三次运行中具有可靠的群体层面立场比率（ICC≥0.5）。九个立场-结果关联在控制大陆固定效应、错误发现率校正及复杂度控制后依然显著，其中外部接触与较低GDP、情感表达与较高女性劳动参与率关联最强。覆盖范围则以不同方式发挥作用。在1805个可用编码手册概念中，覆盖范围预测了88个EA变量中的65个，并在46个合并SCCS领域中的35个中检测到信号，但这一信息集中于单一因子。第一主成分解释43%的得分方差（EA数据中为15%），由此产生的复杂度指数可预测大陆内部的GDP（R²=0.55）。只有当问题聚焦于覆盖范围时，民俗测量才呈现单维性。研究者定义的概念可在958个社会中以0.03至1.70美元的成本实现可测量性。

url:2d61ad738c392f0f.abstract: This paper analyses U.S. secured repo spreads by jointly looking into reserves, dealer balance-sheet usage, hedge fund leverage, and Treasury issuance. Using a quantile regression framework, the results show that repo market dynamics are strongly state-dependent. Higher level of reserves consistently compress repo spreads to the Federal Reserve’s overninght reverse repo offering rate and remain the primary stabilizing force, particularly in tighter funding conditions. Hedge fund activity appears to amplify dealer balance-sheet pressures in lower quantiles, reflecting the impact of leveraged demand in normal markets. As spreads rise, this effect weakens. Instead, heavier Treasury issuance appears to weigh on repo spreads via its stronger effect on dealer balance sheet pressures. Overall, U.S. repo spreads are affected by the supply of central bank liquidity, demand for leverage, Treasury issuance and intermediary capacity. Crucially, these drivers are not equally relevant across the distribution of funding conditions.
url:2d61ad738c392f0f.abstract_zh: 本文通过联合考察准备金、交易商资产负债表使用情况、对冲基金杠杆率及国债发行，分析了美国有担保回购利差。基于分位数回归框架的研究结果表明，回购市场动态具有显著的状态依赖性。较高的准备金水平持续压缩回购利差至美联储隔夜逆回购利率，并始终是主要的稳定力量，尤其在融资条件趋紧时更为显著。对冲基金活动在较低分位数上会放大交易商资产负债表压力，反映出正常市场中杠杆需求的影响。随着利差上升，这一效应逐渐减弱。相反，国债发行增加通过加剧交易商资产负债表压力，对回购利差产生更大影响。总体而言，美国回购利差受到央行流动性供给、杠杆需求、国债发行及中介能力的共同影响。关键在于，这些驱动因素在融资条件分布的不同区间内并非同等重要。

url:2e17a80e08e9fd9e.abstract: Probably not, at least for meta-analyses in economics. In a pre-registered, identity-masked, within-paper experiment, the authors of 44 meta-analyses ranked three AI reports on their own paper by usefulness for improving it: a single pass by a frontier model against two multi-agent debate tools we built and expected to win. All reports were held to a common length and template. The authors preferred the single pass, by 0.66 rank points over mad-research (95% CI 0.32 to 1.00) and 0.57 over paper-workshop (0.16 to 0.95), though paper-workshop spent roughly thirty times the tokens. Authors who recalled their journal referee report usually placed it first and never last; in a separate exercise, three AI judges almost always placed the real journal referee report last. Among the three AI reports, Gemini (the judge whose model family wrote none of the reports) would have ranked paper-workshop first in the authors' place, reversing the single-pass preference. The reversal warns against substituting an AI judge for the author. We measure perceived usefulness for finished papers; whether AI should referee papers is a separate question.
url:2e17a80e08e9fd9e.abstract_zh: 或许不会，至少对经济学领域的元分析而言如此。在一项预先注册、身份隐匿的论文内实验中，44篇元分析的作者对其自身论文的三份AI报告按改进价值进行排序：一份由前沿模型单次生成，另两份来自我们构建并预期胜出的多智能体辩论工具。所有报告均遵循统一长度与模板。作者更偏好单次生成报告，其排名比mad-research高出0.66个位次（95%置信区间0.32至1.00），比paper-workshop高出0.57个位次（0.16至0.95），尽管paper-workshop消耗的令牌数约为前者的三十倍。曾回忆过期刊审稿报告的作者通常将其列为首位且从未置于末位；在另一项独立测试中，三位AI评审几乎始终将真实期刊审稿报告排在末位。在三份AI报告中，Gemini（其模型家族未参与任何报告撰写的评审）若替代作者排序，会将paper-workshop列为首位，与单次生成偏好形成反转。这一反转警示不应以AI评审替代作者。我们衡量的是对已完成论文的感知有用性；AI是否应担任论文评审则是另一独立问题。

url:2e9b3d5f5d77b605.abstract: We study how partisan newspaper ownership shapes news content, media demand, and policy preferences. Our setting is the 2010 takeover of the Basler Zeitung, a leading Swiss regional daily, by owners affiliated with the conservative Swiss People's Party (SVP), and its 2018 sale to a nonpartisan media group. We combine over three million articles from six German-language Swiss newspapers with municipality-level circulation data and outcomes from 160 federal referendums over twenty years. Using difference-in-differences designs that compare the Basler Zeitung to control-group newspapers and exploit cross-municipality variation in pre-takeover penetration, we trace the effects of ownership along the full chain from content to readership and voting. Partisan ownership shifts coverage toward the SVP platform, especially before referendum votes and on party-sponsored proposals. Circulation declines by 28.8 percent during partisan ownership. Losses are largest in historically left-aligned municipalities, but exposure to the newspaper remains substantial even there. At mean pre-takeover penetration, partisan ownership increases SVP-aligned vote shares by 0.34 percentage points across all referendums, implying a persuasion rate of 14.6 percent among retained, persuadable readers, with larger effects for referendums closely tied to the party platform. Overall, ownership induces both ideological sorting in media demand and persuasion among voters who remain exposed, with political effects concentrated in local environments where SVP positions are more prevalent or less strongly opposed.
url:2e9b3d5f5d77b605.abstract_zh: 本文研究党派报纸所有权如何塑造新闻内容、媒体需求及政策偏好。研究背景为2010年瑞士主要地区日报《巴塞尔报》被与保守派瑞士人民党有关联的所有者收购，以及2018年该报被出售给无党派媒体集团。我们整合了六家德语瑞士报纸的三百余万篇文章、市级发行量数据及二十年间160次联邦公投结果。通过双重差分设计（将《巴塞尔报》与对照组报纸比较，并利用收购前渗透率的跨市差异），我们追踪了所有权从内容到读者群再到投票行为的完整影响链条。党派所有权使报道向瑞士人民党纲领倾斜，尤其在公投投票前及政党提案相关议题上。党派所有权期间发行量下降28.8%，历史上左倾市镇的损失最大，但即使在这些地区，报纸曝光度仍保持较高水平。在收购前平均渗透率条件下，党派所有权使所有公投中支持瑞士人民党的投票比例增加0.34个百分点，这意味着在保留的可说服读者中说服率为14.6%，且对与政党纲领紧密相关的公投影响更大。总体而言，所有权既引发媒体需求中的意识形态分化，也对持续接触信息的选民产生说服效应，其政治影响集中于瑞士人民党立场更普遍或反对力度较弱的本地环境。

url:2eb92b1cd0105847.abstract: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) investment has moved in less than a decade from dominant paradigm to contested terrain. This paper examines the rise and recent retreat of ESG in corporate governance and financial markets. We document a marked decline in ESG engagement across corporate commitments, investor coalitions, and corporate communications. While the backlash is most visible in the United States, similar patterns appear globally, indicating deeper structural weaknesses in the ESG model. ESG relied heavily on voluntary coordination and the promise that firms could “do well by doing good”—claims that proved fragile under political and market pressure. We argue that sustainability efforts should refocus on environmental risk through a narrower framework: Transition, Emissions, and Resource Risk Accountability (TERRA).
url:2eb92b1cd0105847.abstract_zh: 环境、社会和治理（ESG）投资在不到十年间从主导范式转变为争议领域。本文考察了ESG在公司治理与金融市场中的兴起与近期退潮。我们记录了ESG在企业承诺、投资者联盟及企业沟通中的显著衰退。尽管这一反弹在美国最为明显，但全球范围内也出现了类似模式，表明ESG模式存在更深层次的结构性缺陷。ESG高度依赖自愿协调以及企业能够"行善获利"的承诺——这些主张在政治与市场压力下被证明是脆弱的。我们认为，可持续发展努力应通过更聚焦的框架重新聚焦于环境风险：转型、排放与资源风险问责（TERRA）。
url:2eb92b1cd0105847.title: ESG is Dead, They Say. Long Live TERRA

url:2ed055719a544139.abstract: The 2026 IranWar has raised the question of how exposed the U.S. economy is to geopolitical oil supply disruptions. It is widely believed that the U.S. economy has become less vulnerable to such disruptions as it has reduced its dependence on oil and changed from a major net oil importer to a net oil exporter. We develop a two-country model of the global economy with large geopolitical oil supply disruptions that distinguishes between the U.S. economy and the rest of the world. We find that the response of U.S. real GDP growth to the disruption in global oil supplies today is only one-twentieth of what it would have been in 1980. Moreover, the response of U.S. real GDP growth today is only one-sixth of the decline in the rest of the world.
url:2ed055719a544139.abstract_zh: 2026年伊朗战争引发了美国经济对地缘政治石油供应中断的脆弱性问题。普遍观点认为，随着美国降低对石油的依赖并从主要石油净进口国转变为净出口国，其经济对此类中断的脆弱性已有所降低。我们构建了一个包含大规模地缘政治石油供应中断的全球经济两国模型，将美国经济与世界其他地区加以区分。研究发现，当前全球石油供应中断对美国实际GDP增长的影响仅为1980年时的二十分之一。此外，当前美国实际GDP增长率的下降幅度仅为世界其他地区下降幅度的六分之一。
url:2ed055719a544139.title: DP21650 How Times Have Changed: The Impact of the 2026 Iran War on the U.S. Economy

url:31cd9889dd50bef2.abstract: Literacy and numeracy unarguably are at the heart of human and economic development and, as a result, have received widespread attention in recent decades. Yet, there are still issues related to the effective strategies of creating such basic skills. In this paper, I show how a free compulsory universal basic education (FCUBE) policy in Ghana helped improve skills attainment. I employ a difference-in-differences strategy to assess the long-term causal impact of FCUBE using the Ghana Living Standard Survey 2012-2017. Overall, I find that FCUBE increased literacy and numeracy by 4.6 and 3.0 p.p respectively, but had a larger effect for urban and less disadvantaged students, thereby exacerbating inequality in skills attainment. Additionally, my results show that only the lower secondary education, and not primary education, was sufficient to guarantee skills attainment.
url:31cd9889dd50bef2.abstract_zh: 毋庸置疑，识字与算术能力是人类与经济发展的核心，因此近几十年来受到广泛关注。然而，如何有效培养这些基本技能仍存在诸多问题。本文展示了加纳免费义务普及基础教育政策如何促进技能提升。我采用双重差分法，利用2012-2017年加纳生活水平调查数据，评估该政策的长期因果效应。总体而言，研究发现该政策使识字率与算术能力分别提升4.6和3.0个百分点，但对城市及弱势程度较低的学生影响更大，从而加剧了技能获取的不平等。此外，研究结果表明，仅初中教育而非小学教育足以保障技能习得。

url:31e33f7d8a748019.abstract: Why did U.S. manufacturing productivity stop growing after 2010? Productivity growth disappeared, evaporating from an annual rate of +3.3 percent during 1987-2010 to -0.3 percent from 2010 to 2023. This paper shifts attention from 2010 as the start of the puzzle to a decade earlier when output stopped growing. This cessation of output growth in 2000 is attributed to the invasion of imports that closed domestic plants, destroyed jobs, and squeezed profits. Then followed a chain of causation that ultimately undermined productivity growth – from falling capacity utilization, to lower investment in fixed capital and R&D, and to an erosion of innovation. Beyond the import invasion, the paper identifies a set of handicaps ranging from self-inflicted wounds to short-sighted government policy. Corporate funds were diverted from productive investment to share buybacks. Investment was distorted by environmental, health, safety, and fuel economy regulations. Other issues with government policy include a substantial reduction in public R&D and a failure to develop training programs to alleviate a decades-long shortage of skilled labor.
url:31e33f7d8a748019.abstract_zh: 为何2010年后美国制造业生产率增长停滞？生产率增长消失殆尽，从1987-2010年间年均3.3%的增速骤降至2010-2023年间的-0.3%。本文将研究焦点从2010年这一谜题起点前移至产出停止增长的十年前。2000年产出增长停滞归因于进口冲击——进口产品涌入导致国内工厂关闭、就业岗位消失、利润空间被挤压。由此引发连锁因果链，最终侵蚀生产率增长：从产能利用率下降，到固定资本与研发投资减少，再到创新能力削弱。除进口冲击外，本文还识别出一系列制约因素，涵盖企业自损行为与短视政府政策：企业资金从生产性投资转向股票回购；环境、健康、安全及燃油经济性法规扭曲投资结构；政府政策问题包括公共研发投入大幅削减，以及未能制定培训计划以缓解持续数十年的技能劳动力短缺。

url:33066b183749da9a.abstract: An unexpected increase in energy costs raises inflation directly through flexibly-set prices. Whether that shock amplifies to a larger and persistent rise in inflation depends on its transmission through the economy. This paper examines four channels of transmission of the Iran conflict to inflation in the EA, UK, and the US. The first is the transmission to the sticky prices in core sectors. Recent advances in menu cost models predict that inflation will rise faster than usual and monetary policy is less powerful to curb it. The second is transmission to spending, wages, and nominal returns through higher expected inflation. The empirical literature on household and firm inflation expectations points to some evidence for this amplification. The third channel is through other aggregate demand policies, especially fiscal policy. The IMF reassessments of the fiscal outlook provide some guarded grounds for optimism. The fourth mechanism is through an erosion in the credibility of the long-run inflation target. Data from market prices indicates that the inflation anchor has not moved. All combined, the data as of May 2026 suggests that the Iran war shock will have a significant impact on inflation that persists into 2027, but that is smaller and more short-lived than the 2021--24 inflation disaster.
url:33066b183749da9a.abstract_zh: 能源成本的意外上升会通过灵活定价直接推高通胀。这种冲击是否会放大为更大规模且持续的通胀上升，取决于其在经济中的传导机制。本文考察了伊朗冲突对欧元区、英国和美国通胀的四种传导渠道。第一种是向核心部门粘性价格的传导。菜单成本模型的最新进展预测，通胀将以快于往常的速度上升，而货币政策抑制通胀的效果将减弱。第二种是通过更高的通胀预期向支出、工资和名义回报的传导。关于家庭和企业通胀预期的实证研究为这种放大效应提供了一定证据。第三种渠道是通过其他总需求政策，尤其是财政政策。国际货币基金组织对财政前景的重新评估为乐观情绪提供了审慎依据。第四种机制是通过侵蚀长期通胀目标的公信力。市场价格数据显示，通胀锚并未发生偏移。综合来看，截至2026年5月的数据表明，伊朗战争冲击将对通胀产生显著影响，并持续至2027年，但其影响程度小于2021-2024年的通胀灾难，且持续时间更短。

url:34637558449de3b1.abstract: Households often report inflation perceptions and expectations that differ markedly from official measures. This column proposes a new measure of perceived inflation, which uses disaggregated inflation data with indicators for household attention to capture the prices that people actually notice. The difference between perceived and official inflation varies over time and becomes particularly pronounced during periods of economic stress. Heightened attention to inflation is persistent and can remain elevated even after official inflation measures improve. As central banks recognise the importance of household beliefs for macroeconomic outcomes, it becomes important to also understand the gap between measured and perceived inflation.
url:34637558449de3b1.abstract_zh: 家庭通常报告的通货膨胀感知和预期与官方指标存在显著差异。本文提出了一种新的感知通胀衡量方法，该方法利用分类通胀数据及家庭关注度指标，以捕捉人们实际注意到的价格变化。感知通胀与官方通胀之间的差异随时间推移而变化，在经济压力时期尤为显著。对通胀的高度关注具有持续性，即使在官方通胀指标改善后仍可能保持高位。随着央行认识到家庭信念对宏观经济结果的重要性，理解衡量通胀与感知通胀之间的差距也变得至关重要。

url:364c85eac3884884.abstract: During the 19th century, colonial empires expanded substantially, with at their heart flourishing trade relationships between the imperial power and its colonies. Notably, imperial powers adopted distinct commercial strategies: while some pursued an ``open door'' policy, others implemented preferential tariff regimes. This paper introduces the first comprehensive dataset documenting the trade policies of the major colonial empires from 1815 to 1960. We develop a theoretical framework that identifies three central determinants of these policies: inter--imperial competition, the progressive extension of the franchise in the imperial power and variation in imperial institutional structure. We then evaluate the model's predictions using the newly assembled dataset, and find robust empirical support for its key implications.
url:364c85eac3884884.abstract_zh: 19世纪，殖民帝国大幅扩张，其核心是帝国与其殖民地之间繁荣的贸易关系。值得注意的是，帝国列强采取了截然不同的商业策略：一些国家奉行“门户开放”政策，而另一些则实施特惠关税制度。本文首次构建了涵盖1815年至1960年主要殖民帝国贸易政策的全面数据集。我们提出了一个理论框架，识别出这些政策的三个核心决定因素：帝国间竞争、帝国本土选举权的逐步扩大以及帝国制度结构的差异。随后，我们利用新整理的数据集评估了模型的预测，并发现其关键推论得到了稳健的实证支持。

url:37dc1d2082d13926.abstract: This paper develops a framework to analyze partial population experiments, a generalization of the cluster experimental design where clusters are assigned to different treatment intensities. The framework allows for heterogeneity in cluster sizes and outcome distributions. The paper studies the large-sample behavior of OLS estimators and cluster-robust variance estimators and shows that (i) ignoring cluster heterogeneity may result in severely underpowered experiments and (ii) the cluster-robust variance estimator may be upward-biased when clusters are heterogeneous. The paper derives formulas for power, minimum detectable effects, and optimal cluster assignment probabilities. All the results apply to cluster experiments, a particular case of the framework. The paper sets up a potential outcomes framework to interpret the OLS estimands as causal effects. It implements the methods in a large-scale experiment to estimate the direct and spillover effects of a communication campaign on property tax compliance. The analysis reveals an increase in tax compliance among individuals directly targeted with the mailing, as well as compliance spillovers on untreated individuals in clusters with a high proportion of treated taxpayers.
url:37dc1d2082d13926.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析部分总体实验的框架，这是对聚类实验设计的一种推广，其中聚类被分配至不同的处理强度。该框架允许聚类规模与结果分布存在异质性。本文研究了OLS估计量及聚类稳健方差估计量的大样本性质，并表明：（i）忽略聚类异质性可能导致实验统计功效严重不足；（ii）当聚类存在异质性时，聚类稳健方差估计量可能存在向上偏误。本文推导了统计功效、最小可检测效应及最优聚类分配概率的公式。所有结论均适用于聚类实验（该框架的一个特例）。本文构建了一个潜在结果框架，将OLS估计量解释为因果效应。通过一项大规模实验实施该方法，用以估计通信宣传对财产税合规性的直接效应与溢出效应。分析显示，直接收到邮件的个体税收合规性有所提升，且在受处理纳税人比例较高的聚类中，未受处理的个体也出现了合规性溢出效应。

url:3ad9c2747c7bfa3e.abstract: We document market power in U.S. equity securities lending and examine its origins and consequences. We develop a dynamic model of securities lending and estimate it on the cross-section of U.S. equities, showing that the dominant custodian-intermediated market structure emerges as a response to short sellers’ information-leakage concerns. Short sellers prefer this opaque market structure over a centralized alternative, particularly for smaller stocks, despite the associated non-competitive fees. This is because their trading strategies become unprofitable if information leaks prematurely. Thus, unlike in standard product markets, the demand side in securities lending values opacity, which is important for regulatory design.
url:3ad9c2747c7bfa3e.abstract_zh: 我们记录了美国股票证券借贷中的市场势力，并考察了其起源与后果。我们构建了一个证券借贷的动态模型，并基于美国股票截面数据进行了估计，结果表明，以托管机构为中介的主导型市场结构是对卖空者信息泄露担忧的回应。尽管这种不透明的市场结构伴随着非竞争性费用，但卖空者仍偏好于此，而非集中化的替代方案，尤其是对于小盘股而言。这是因为，如果信息过早泄露，他们的交易策略将变得无利可图。因此，与标准产品市场不同，证券借贷的需求方看重不透明性，这对监管设计具有重要意义。

url:3b7a9d654be5c945.abstract: Discrete choice experiments are widely used to estimate workers' willingness to pay (WTP) for job amenities under the assumption that varying an attribute does not change workers' beliefs about other job attributes. We test this assumption by embedding an amenity with a known market price, a popular monthly public transport pass, in a large-scale discrete choice experiment with German workers. Many workers, including public transport users, overvalue the ticket by more than 100%, despite WTP for other attributes aligning with the literature. A complementary belief-elicitation experiment shows that advertising an amenity, such as the pass but also common amenities like work from home, causally shifts beliefs about unlisted attributes of the job. Posted wages similarly signal unlisted attributes so that wage variation, the money metric for WTP calculation, is itself contaminated by belief spillovers---such as higher pay signaling heightened stress. These spillovers imply that discrete choice estimates capture perceived bundles rather than isolated attributes, and distort current estimates of non-wage compensation and monopsony power.
url:3b7a9d654be5c945.abstract_zh: 离散选择实验被广泛用于估算工人对工作福利的支付意愿，其前提假设是改变某一属性不会改变工人对其他工作属性的信念。我们通过将一项具有已知市场价格的工作福利——德国广受欢迎的月度公共交通通票——嵌入一项针对德国工人的大规模离散选择实验来检验这一假设。许多工人（包括公共交通使用者）对该通票的估值高出实际价格100%以上，尽管对其他属性的支付意愿与现有文献一致。一项补充性的信念诱导实验表明，宣传某项工作福利（如通票，以及居家办公等常见福利）会因果性地改变工人对工作未列明属性的信念。公布的工资同样会传递未列明属性的信号，因此作为支付意愿计算货币度量的工资变动本身也受到信念溢出效应的影响——例如，高薪可能意味着更高的工作压力。这些溢出效应意味着离散选择实验的估计值反映的是工人感知到的福利组合，而非孤立的属性，并扭曲了当前对非工资补偿和买方垄断势力的估算。

url:3bb16a9e526fe858.abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model where loan securitization is an endogenous outcome in a credit market where information asymmetries lead to adverse selection across financial intermediaries. Securitization occurs when the resources saved by investors acquiring limited information about the risk-class of some borrowers outweigh the cost of being selected against by loan originators. This results in a time-varying market share of individually risk-priced loans held by banks, and of securitized loans held by the secondary market. We analyze the impact of conventional monetary policies and credit market policies in response to an increase in default risk, and discuss its welfare implications. Overall securitization allows more efficient funding of loans, at the expense of increased volatility in risky interest rates, consumption, and inflation over the business cycle.
url:3bb16a9e526fe858.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中贷款证券化是信贷市场中信息不对称导致金融中介之间逆向选择的内生结果。当投资者获取部分借款人风险等级信息所节省的资源超过其因贷款发起人逆向选择而承担的成本时，证券化便会产生。这导致银行持有的个别风险定价贷款与二级市场持有的证券化贷款的市场份额随时间动态变化。我们分析了常规货币政策与信贷市场政策在应对违约风险上升时的效果，并探讨其福利影响。总体而言，证券化能够更高效地为贷款提供资金，但代价是加剧了经济周期中风险利率、消费和通胀的波动性。

url:3c6f3b4959927eaf.abstract: Focus We examine what happens when investors question fiscal sustainability and demand higher sovereign bond yields as compensation for higher risk. We call these episodes fiscal risk shocks. Such shocks can arise, for example, from a government announcing new spending or tax cuts, or from news that worsens its budget outlook. We develop a new method to identify these shocks from daily movements in bond yields. When fiscal concerns intensify, investors retreat from government bonds and shift towards the safest corporate bonds, resulting in negative co-movement in the yields of these bonds. Exploiting this relationship, we extract fiscal risk shocks for 12 economies. We then trace how these shocks propagate through exchange rates, equity markets, inflation and output.
url:3c6f3b4959927eaf.abstract_zh: 焦点  本文研究当投资者质疑财政可持续性并要求更高的主权债券收益率以补偿更高风险时会发生什么。我们将此类事件称为财政风险冲击。例如，此类冲击可能源于政府宣布新增支出或减税，或源于恶化其预算前景的消息。我们开发了一种新方法，通过债券收益率的日常变动来识别这些冲击。当财政担忧加剧时，投资者会从政府债券中撤出，转向最安全的公司债券，导致这些债券收益率出现负向联动。利用这一关系，我们提取了12个经济体的财政风险冲击。随后，我们追踪这些冲击如何通过汇率、股票市场、通胀和产出进行传导。

url:3c8375040290a973.abstract: We construct postwar U.S. patent time series by funding source and ownership. In local projections with rich macroeconomic controls, disciplined by external instruments and information-set tests, unanticipated filings serve as source-specific technology-shock proxies. Government-funded but privately owned patents are two percent of filings, yet explain about one-fifth of medium-run fluctuations in TFP and GDP. Responses propagate through private R&D and investment, with model-implied social returns to public R&D about twice those to private R&D. Effects concentrate in science-based patents supported by NIH and NSF or assigned to universities, research institutes, and start-ups. Government-owned patents have weak average effects but a consequential upper tail.
url:3c8375040290a973.abstract_zh: 我们按资金来源和所有权构建了战后美国专利时间序列。在包含丰富宏观经济控制变量的局部投影中，通过外部工具变量和信息集检验的约束，未预期的专利申请作为特定来源的技术冲击代理变量。政府资助但私人拥有的专利占申请量的2%，却解释了约五分之一的中期全要素生产率与GDP波动。其影响通过私人研发与投资传导，模型隐含的公共研发社会回报率约为私人研发的两倍。效应集中于由美国国立卫生研究院和国家科学基金会资助、或分配给大学、研究机构及初创企业的科学型专利。政府拥有的专利平均效应较弱，但存在显著的上尾分布。

url:3cd8be2fe818bedf.abstract: This paper studies how financial conditions affect research and development (R&D) by firms specialized in green innovation. Using U.S. patent data matched with Compustat, we identify “green innovators” as firms with a high cumulative share of green patents. Although they account for a small share of total green patenting, these firms occupy central positions in the green-innovation ecosystem. Estimating firm-level impulse responses to exogenous changes in broad financial conditions, we find that tightening has a disproportionately large and persistent negative effect on the R&D of specialized green innovators. In contrast, R&D by diversified innovators and non-innovators responds only weakly. Green innovators are younger, smaller, and more dependent on external finance, suggesting that financial tightening introduces a systematic bias against upstream green technological development.
url:3cd8be2fe818bedf.abstract_zh: 本文研究金融状况如何影响专注于绿色创新的企业的研发活动。通过将美国专利数据与Compustat数据库匹配，我们将“绿色创新者”定义为绿色专利累计占比高的企业。尽管这些企业在绿色专利总量中占比很小，但它们处于绿色创新生态系统的核心位置。通过估计企业对外生广义金融状况变化的脉冲响应，我们发现金融紧缩对专业化绿色创新企业的研发产生了不成比例的大幅且持续的负面影响。相比之下，多元化创新者和非创新者的研发反应较弱。绿色创新者通常更年轻、规模更小且更依赖外部融资，这表明金融紧缩对上游绿色技术发展产生了系统性偏见。

url:3d03c3302c3e4116.abstract: I use data on values to challenge the belief that women produce art of lower value. Using occupational data in the European Social Survey (ESS) and OLS regressions, I show that women are more likely to be artists in more gender-equal countries, a pattern consistent with greater barriers to artistic careers for women than for men. Using data on Schwartz human values in the ESS, I then show that women artists, particularly those with children, appear to have more exceptional artistic value profiles than their male counterparts. These findings highlight the risks of equating market price with artistic value and underscore the importance of investing in women’s art and women artists. An analysis of curators’ values suggests that market-based strategies alone—such as art collecting—are insufficient to address art-market inequality. Instead, they must be complemented by cultural policies that dismantle structural barriers, including mistaken beliefs.
url:3d03c3302c3e4116.abstract_zh: 我利用价值观数据挑战了“女性创作的艺术价值较低”这一观念。基于欧洲社会调查（ESS）中的职业数据及OLS回归分析，研究表明，在性别更平等的国家中，女性更有可能成为艺术家，这一模式与女性在艺术职业中面临比男性更大障碍的现状相符。随后，通过分析ESS中施瓦茨人类价值观数据，我发现女性艺术家（尤其是有子女的女性）比男性同行展现出更独特的艺术价值特征。这些发现揭示了将市场价格等同于艺术价值的风险，并强调了投资女性艺术及女性艺术家的重要性。对策展人价值观的分析表明，仅依靠市场策略（如艺术收藏）不足以解决艺术市场的不平等问题，必须辅以消除结构性障碍（包括错误观念）的文化政策。

url:3d59cbe0d6d669fa.abstract: We study the consequences of investment fraud victimization using unique administrative data on Ponzi scheme investors. A matched control event-study design shows that the victims experience a six percent annual labor income loss. Income first declines when an investor joins the scheme, consistent with distorted beliefs lowering labor supply. The scheme’s collapse triggers a further decrease, which we attribute to financial stress. Investors also face higher indebtedness and tilt their portfolios away from delegated investments. The income loss persists in the long run, equals twice the direct investment loss, and substantially adds to the social cost of fraud.
url:3d59cbe0d6d669fa.abstract_zh: 我们利用庞氏骗局投资者的独特行政数据，研究了投资欺诈受害的经济后果。采用匹配控制事件研究设计发现，受害者每年劳动收入损失达6%。收入在投资者加入骗局时首次下降，这与扭曲信念降低劳动供给的结论一致。骗局崩溃引发进一步收入下降，我们将其归因于财务压力。投资者还面临更高的负债率，并调整投资组合减少委托投资。收入损失长期持续，相当于直接投资损失的两倍，显著增加了欺诈的社会成本。

url:3d99921aa68bdd6a.abstract: We introduce When Alpha Disappears, a paired evaluation benchmark for diagnosing decision-time leakage in financial machine-learning backtests. Rather than treating leakage as a binary property, the benchmark estimates protocol-induced inflation by toggling one evaluation convention at a time around a clean $t{+}1$-open reference, while holding the data panel, walk-forward split, model family, horizon, portfolio rule, and cost convention fixed. Across two daily-OHLCV equity panels, six model families, and yearly tests from 2016--2024, we find that inflation is highly selective: centered temporal features and same-day-open execution with post-open daily-bar information cause large and stable increases in both predictive and trading metrics, whereas global normalization, future-informed graph structure, and same-day-close execution are weak in most settings. The benchmark is diagnostic rather than a claim of tradable alpha, and is intended to make evaluation assumptions, failure modes, and protocol fragility directly measurable.
url:3d99921aa68bdd6a.abstract_zh: 我们提出“当阿尔法消失时”这一配对评估基准，用于诊断金融机器学习回测中的决策时点信息泄露。该基准并非将信息泄露视为二元属性，而是通过围绕一个干净的t+1开盘参考点，每次切换一项评估惯例，同时固定数据面板、滚动窗口划分、模型家族、预测周期、投资组合规则及成本惯例，来估计协议引发的通胀效应。基于两个日频OHLCV股票面板、六个模型家族以及2016至2024年的年度测试，我们发现通胀具有高度选择性：中心化时序特征、同日开盘执行结合开盘后日频柱信息，会导致预测指标和交易指标均出现显著且稳定的提升；而全局归一化、基于未来信息的图结构以及同日收盘执行在大多数设定下影响较弱。该基准旨在进行诊断，而非声称存在可交易的阿尔法，其目的是使评估假设、失效模式及协议脆弱性变得可直接度量。

url:3e56f31d3419eb3a.abstract: Ransomware groups vary in the types of organizations they compromise, yet little empirical work has examined whether these differences extend to the technology stacks of victims. We analyze 5,190 ransomware incidents across 151 groups, linking each victim to its observed technology stack from the SWDB Company Intelligence database. We find that some enterprise software is associated with greater ransomware risk than others, and that this association is often stronger for technologies carrying more known vulnerabilities. Next, by analyzing leaked chat logs of leading ransomware groups, we present direct evidence that some groups choose their victims based on observed technology use and revenue data gathered through opensource intelligence. Finally, examining the full population of victims, we find that some groups concentrate on particular technologies and revenue profiles, while others appear more opportunistic, with a victim profile close to the overall population.
url:3e56f31d3419eb3a.abstract_zh: 勒索软件团伙在选择攻击目标时，其针对的组织类型存在差异，但鲜有实证研究探讨这些差异是否延伸至受害者的技术栈。我们分析了151个团伙涉及的5,190起勒索软件事件，将每个受害者与SWDB公司情报数据库中观测到的技术栈进行关联。研究发现，部分企业软件面临的勒索软件风险高于其他软件，且这种关联在已知漏洞较多的技术中往往更为显著。进一步通过分析主要勒索软件团伙泄露的聊天记录，我们提供了直接证据，表明部分团伙会基于开源情报收集到的技术使用情况和收入数据来选择受害者。最后，通过对全部受害者群体的分析，我们发现部分团伙专注于特定技术和收入特征，而其他团伙则更具机会主义倾向，其受害者特征与整体群体相近。
url:3e56f31d3419eb3a.title: How do ransomware groups choose their targets? An empirical analysis
url:3e56f31d3419eb3a.title_zh: 勒索软件组织如何选择攻击目标？一项实证分析

url:3e6110ba2841ce76.abstract: This paper studies how organizations should jointly design evaluation rules and assign workers when performance depends on both effort and non-discretionary advantage. Agents choose effort in positions linked by a competition network, while their effective advantage depends on own type and spillovers through a second network. The planner chooses both the assignment and the effort weight in evaluation. Equilibrium effort rises with a position’s Katz-Bonacich centrality and falls with effective advantage. The optimal evaluation rule generally differs from true output. When effort is more important in production, the planner lowers the effort weight and uses negative assortative assignment to strengthen incentives. When advantage is more important, the planner raises the effort weight and uses positive assortative assignment to exploit spillovers. We also study a constraint requiring assignments to be pairwise stable, which creates an output loss depending on the intensity of competition.
url:3e6110ba2841ce76.abstract_zh: 本文研究当绩效同时取决于努力与非自主优势时，组织应如何联合设计评估规则并分配岗位。代理人通过竞争网络关联的岗位选择努力水平，而其有效优势则取决于自身类型及通过另一网络产生的溢出效应。规划者需同时决定岗位分配方案及评估中的努力权重。均衡状态下，努力水平随岗位的卡茨-波纳奇中心度上升而提高，随有效优势上升而下降。最优评估规则通常与真实产出存在差异。当努力在生产中更为重要时，规划者会降低努力权重并采用负向匹配分配以强化激励；当优势更为重要时，规划者会提高努力权重并采用正向匹配分配以利用溢出效应。本文还研究了要求分配满足两两稳定性的约束条件，该约束会因竞争强度差异产生产出损失。

url:3f1be2988c2e8a6c.abstract: Small open economies often anchor their exchange rate to a basket of foreign currencies, with weights typically set from trade shares or financial exposure. Such schemes ignore the heterogeneity of pass-through across currencies and the covariance structure of bilateral rates, and therefore do not minimize the volatility of imported inflation, the central bank’s mandate. This paper proposes a minimum-variance framework — formally analogous to a Markowitz portfolio problem in pass-through space — in which basket weights minimize the variance of exchange-rate-driven imported inflation, subject to a constraint that preserves the basket’s cumulative pass-through. Applied to the case of Fiji, an import-intensive island economy with a five-currency basket, the optimization reduces the variance of imported inflation by close to twenty percent, with results robust across alternative specifications.
url:3f1be2988c2e8a6c.abstract_zh: 小型开放经济体通常将本币汇率与一篮子外币挂钩，权重通常根据贸易份额或金融敞口设定。此类方案忽略了汇率传导在不同货币间的异质性以及双边汇率的协方差结构，因此无法最小化进口通胀的波动性——而这正是央行的政策目标。本文提出一个最小方差框架——在形式上类似于汇率传导空间中的马科维茨投资组合问题——在该框架下，一篮子货币的权重在保持篮子累积汇率传导效应的约束条件下，最小化汇率驱动的进口通胀方差。将该方法应用于斐济这一进口密集型岛国（其采用五货币篮子）的案例后，优化方案使进口通胀方差降低近20%，且结果在不同设定下均保持稳健。

url:3f7476dec7a00ad1.abstract: Defence policy is usually discussed as a national security issue, but its economic effects are often highly local. This column presents new evidence from 1,011 regions in 15 European countries suggesting that places hosting defence production and supply chain activity have a larger economic footprint than comparable places without such activity: they enjoy higher income levels, and the premium is especially large in more innovative regions. As Europe raises defence spending, the geography of where that money ultimately lands may matter almost as much as the total amount.
url:3f7476dec7a00ad1.abstract_zh: 国防政策通常被视为国家安全议题，但其经济效应往往具有高度地方性。本文基于15个欧洲国家1011个地区的新证据表明，承接国防生产及供应链活动的地区，其经济规模显著大于未开展此类活动的可比地区：这些地区享有更高收入水平，且在创新程度更高的地区，这种经济溢价尤为突出。随着欧洲增加国防开支，资金最终流向的地理分布可能与支出总额同等重要。

url:423a81ab9fb265b7.abstract: Real-time evidence from users can inform the current policy debates around artificial intelligence. This column reports on a survey of executives at typical US firms to reveal that AI adoption is already widespread but shallow. Executives report positive productivity effects and expect larger gains, especially in high-skill services and finance, although measured gains lag perceived productivity improvements. The gains appear to come mainly through innovation- and demand-oriented channels rather than through cost cutting. Capital deepening is low, with most AI adopters renting intangible capital from upstream providers, and near-term employment effects are small on net, with larger reductions concentrated among larger firms and a shift away from routine clerical work towards skilled technical roles.
url:423a81ab9fb265b7.abstract_zh: 来自用户的实时证据可为当前围绕人工智能的政策辩论提供参考。本专栏报告了一项针对美国典型企业高管的调查，揭示人工智能的采用已广泛但尚浅。高管们报告了积极的生产率效应，并预期将获得更大收益，尤其是在高技能服务业和金融领域，尽管实际测量到的收益落后于感知到的生产率提升。这些收益似乎主要通过创新和需求导向渠道实现，而非通过成本削减。资本深化程度较低，大多数人工智能采用者从上游供应商处租用无形资本，且短期内的净就业影响较小，较大规模的裁员集中在大型企业，同时就业结构正从常规文书工作向技能型技术岗位转变。

url:430b81abdb340152.abstract: Can intensifying competition protect social media users? The answer depends on users’ awareness of the harms of social media content. We develop a model of asymmetric competition between platforms with naive users, in which platforms choose how much to amplify harmful yet engaging content. Naive users do not internalize the adverse effects of consuming this content. Reducing a dominant platform’s competitive advantage benefits users only if the platform prioritizes attracting rational users. Otherwise, intensifying competition can backfire by inducing this platform to exploit naive users. Awareness initiatives complement competition policy by making exploitation less attractive, but may increase market concentration.
url:430b81abdb340152.abstract_zh: 加剧竞争能否保护社交媒体用户？答案取决于用户对社交媒体内容危害的认知程度。我们构建了一个存在天真用户的平台间非对称竞争模型，其中平台自主选择对有害但具吸引力的内容的放大程度。天真用户并未内化消费此类内容带来的负面影响。只有当占据主导地位的平台优先考虑吸引理性用户时，削弱其竞争优势才能惠及用户。否则，加剧竞争可能适得其反，促使该平台利用天真用户。认知提升举措通过降低剥削行为的吸引力来补充竞争政策，但可能导致市场集中度上升。

Fund managers reduced exposures to extremely high biodiversity risk without seizing low biodiversity risk as an opportunity for profit, characterizing biodiversity as downside risk factor. url:465f9355664512dd.abstract: Populist leaders often campaign against bureaucratic constraints, yet their economic performance may depend on the very institutional environment they inherit. We examine whether bureaucracy moderates the economic costs of populism using two complementary settings: cross-country synthetic-control evidence and a U.S. state-year panel spanning 1929–2023. The cross-country analysis offers suggestive evidence that the output decline following populist takeovers is attenuated in countries with stronger pre-existing bureaucratic institutions, particularly where bureaucracies are more independent. The U.S. state analysis provides sharper, within-country evidence. Leveraging LLM estimates of guberna-torial populism derived from State of the State speeches, we find that populist governors are associated with significantly lower per-capita income in states lacking an independent civil service, while no comparable penalty emerges—and the association is more than off-set—where such protections are in force. Heterogeneity-robust event-study estimates point in the same direction, with the post-entry income decline concentrated in states without civil-service reform. Together, the evidence is consistent with independent bureaucracies acting as a partial buffer against the economic costs of populist governance: the ”swamp” appears to dampen the damage populism would otherwise cause.
url:465f9355664512dd.abstract_zh: 民粹主义领导人常以反对官僚体制束缚为竞选纲领，但其经济表现可能取决于所继承的制度环境。本文通过两个互补性研究设计——跨国合成控制证据与覆盖1929-2023年的美国州级面板数据——考察官僚体制是否调节了民粹主义的经济成本。跨国分析提供初步证据表明，在既有官僚制度更健全的国家（尤其是官僚机构独立性更强的国家），民粹主义执政后的产出下降幅度有所缓和。美国州级分析则提供了更精确的国内证据。通过利用大语言模型对州情咨文中州长民粹主义倾向的估算，本研究发现：在缺乏独立公务员制度的州，民粹主义州长与人均收入显著下降相关；而在实施公务员保护制度的州，不仅未出现类似的经济惩罚效应，其关联性甚至被完全抵消。异质性稳健的事件研究估计指向相同结论——民粹主义执政后的收入下降集中在未实施公务员制度改革的州。综合证据表明，独立官僚机构可作为缓冲机制部分抵消民粹主义治理的经济成本：所谓"沼泽"反而抑制了民粹主义本可能造成的损害。

url:4790bd356db8a9ec.abstract: An organization is autonomous if it has the right or power of self-government. Self-government implies that autonomous organizations cannot rely on outside parties for contract enforcement; all contracts must be relational or self-executing. We present a model in which an autonomous organization commits to a governance structure that allocates managerial power to some members. We show that the organization faces a trilemma: the goals of autonomy, decentralization, and efficiency conflict with one another. Thus, the optimal governance structure of an autonomous organization is centralized. Centralization implies inequality in power and payoffs among members of autonomous organizations.
url:4790bd356db8a9ec.abstract_zh: 如果一个组织拥有自治权或自我治理的能力，则该组织具有自主性。自我治理意味着自主组织不能依赖外部主体执行契约；所有契约必须是关系型或自我执行的。我们构建了一个模型，其中自主组织承诺采用一种将管理权力分配给部分成员的治理结构。研究表明，该组织面临一个三难困境：自主性、去中心化与效率这三个目标相互冲突。因此，自主组织的最优治理结构是集权化的。集权化意味着自主组织成员之间在权力和收益分配上存在不平等。

url:4976863c4331deb2.abstract: Focus Historically, banks' holdings of sovereign debt have been key drivers of the co-movement between sovereign and bank risks. Recent years have seen an increase in banks' links with non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs) as well as a greater presence of NBFIs in sovereign debt markets. These developments have the potential to broaden the classical sovereign-bank nexus into a sovereign-bank-NBFI nexus. We examine the degree to which this has taken place, using European bank-level data along with global country-level data.
url:4976863c4331deb2.abstract_zh: 历史上，银行持有的主权债务一直是主权风险与银行风险联动的主要驱动因素。近年来，银行与非银行金融机构（NBFIs）的联系日益紧密，同时NBFIs在主权债务市场中的参与度显著提升。这些发展可能将传统的主权-银行关联扩展为主权-银行-NBFI三重关联。我们利用欧洲银行层面的数据及全球国家层面的数据，考察了这一转变的实现程度。

url:49d3c4e7e45d0b21.abstract: Why might persuaders favor anecdotes over aggregate statistics? We study a policy advocate choosing between them to persuade a diverse, skeptical citizenry with demographically correlated outcomes. Two forces compete: an umbrella effect, by which everyone responds more strongly to the statistic, and a wild-card effect, by which the anecdote's higher variance makes favorable realizations likelier. The anecdote prevails under sufficiently narrow consensus, so its appeal has a rational, informational basis. When breadth of aggregation is flexible, the optimal evidence is a local statistic that aggregates over a broader subpopulation than the minimal winning coalition, though almost anecdotal as consensus narrows.
url:49d3c4e7e45d0b21.abstract_zh: 为何说服者更偏爱轶事而非总体统计数据？我们研究了一位政策倡导者在两者间的选择，其目标是说服一个具有人口统计相关结果的多元化、持怀疑态度的公民群体。两种效应相互竞争：一是“伞效应”，即每个人对统计数据的反应更为强烈；二是“野牌效应”，即轶事的高方差使得有利结果更可能出现。当共识足够狭窄时，轶事占据上风，因此其吸引力具有理性的信息基础。当聚合范围灵活时，最优证据是一种局部统计量，它聚合了比最小获胜联盟更广泛的子群体，但随着共识变窄，这种统计量几乎接近于轶事。

url:4ae9a1c9f589e9c6.abstract: Firm heterogeneity in financial constraints is a quantitatively important driver of how monetary policy transmits to inflation. Using detailed microdata on Swedish public and private firms, and high-frequency monetary policy surprises around Riksbank announcements, we document that smaller, financially constrained firms adjust prices significantly less than larger firms in response to changes in monetary policy. This heterogeneous price response materially dampens the aggregate PPI inflation response to monetary policy. Models of customer markets and financial frictions can explain our findings: because the external finance premium rises after a monetary contraction, constrained firms cut prices less to preserve cash flows, sacrificing future market share. Additional evidence on heterogeneous sales, debt, marginal cost, and markup responses further supports this channel. We consider several alternative explanations, including differences in price adjustments, working capital, market share, and export share, but these cannot explain our main heterogeneity result.
url:4ae9a1c9f589e9c6.abstract_zh: 企业融资约束的异质性在货币政策向通胀传导过程中具有重要的定量意义。基于瑞典上市与非上市企业的微观数据，结合瑞典央行公告前后高频货币政策意外冲击，我们发现：相较于大型企业，规模较小且面临融资约束的企业在应对货币政策变化时，其价格调整幅度显著更低。这种异质性价格响应实质上削弱了货币政策对总体生产者价格指数（PPI）通胀的影响。客户市场模型与金融摩擦理论可解释这一发现：由于货币紧缩后外部融资溢价上升，受约束企业为维持现金流而减少降价幅度，从而牺牲未来市场份额。关于销售额、债务、边际成本及加成率异质性的额外证据进一步支持该传导渠道。我们考察了包括价格调整成本、营运资本、市场份额及出口份额在内的多种替代性解释，但这些因素均无法解释核心异质性结论。

url:4b1806829f24334a.abstract: A prominent explanation for declining labor shares is automation. We test this mechanism directly at the firm level, drawing on a central prediction of the task-based model of production: firms that automate more should see larger declines in routine employment and labor share. Using administrative data from France between 1994 and 2019, we find no support for this prediction. Changes in routine employment share are either uncorrelated or even negatively correlated with changes in labor share within firms. Our evidence shows that automation is not driving labor share dynamics in France.
url:4b1806829f24334a.abstract_zh: 关于劳动份额下降的一个主要解释是自动化。我们基于任务型生产模型的核心预测，在企业层面直接检验了这一机制：自动化程度更高的企业，其常规就业份额和劳动份额应出现更大幅度的下降。利用1994年至2019年法国的行政数据，我们发现这一预测未得到支持。在企业内部，常规就业份额的变化与劳动份额的变化要么不相关，甚至呈负相关。我们的证据表明，自动化并非法国劳动份额动态变化的驱动因素。

url:4b8e040457711778.abstract: We evaluate whether LLMs have had any discernible impact on the aggregate labor market so far. We focus on occupations that are computer programming-intensive, motivated by data showing that coding is one of the most LLM-exposed tasks. Linking O*NET to CPS we find that aggregate employment of coders has decelerated sharply since the introduction of ChatGPT. Using a novel control variable for industry-level shocks we show that the deceleration is not attributable to the exposure of coders to slowing industries, suggesting instead that coders experienced an occupation-specific shock around the introduction of ChatGPT. Coder employment has continued to grow in recent years, though much more slowly than it did pre-2022. We validate the industry-level control variable by examining historical examples of occupations that experienced either occupation-specific or industry-level shocks. We also provide statistics on the agreement rates between different measures of AI exposure.
url:4b8e040457711778.abstract_zh: 我们评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）是否对当前总体劳动力市场产生了可识别的影响。基于编码是最受LLM影响的任务之一的数据驱动，我们重点关注计算机编程密集型职业。通过将O*NET与当前人口调查（CPS）数据关联，我们发现自ChatGPT推出以来，编程人员的总体就业增速显著放缓。利用行业层面冲击的新型控制变量，我们证明这种放缓并非源于编程人员所在行业的衰退冲击，而是表明编程人员在ChatGPT推出前后经历了职业特异性冲击。近年来编程人员就业虽持续增长，但增速远低于2022年前的水平。我们通过考察历史上经历职业特异性冲击或行业层面冲击的职业案例，验证了行业层面控制变量的有效性，并提供了不同人工智能暴露度测量指标间的一致率统计。

url:4bf6f0bee1ebc164.abstract: This paper studies the aggregate implications of the geography of financial frictions faced by firms in Europe. Using proprietary data from the European Central Bank's Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises, we document three new facts. First, there is substantial regional heterogeneity in the access to external finance. Second, this heterogeneity is persistent, with only gradual convergence over time. Third, countries with tighter financial frictions are less responsive to monetary shocks. To formalize these empirical findings, we develop and calibrate a tractable New~Keynesian model of a monetary union with 22 countries that are heterogeneous in financial frictions, productivity, and size. High-friction countries are less responsive to monetary shocks because firms face a steeper marginal cost curve and a lower capital elasticity. The heterogeneity in financial frictions also shapes the output-inflation trade-off, as in high-friction countries the same output gain comes at the cost of more inflation. Convergence experiments show that financial market integration in the spirit of a European Savings and Investments Union raises the power of monetary policy, but at a potential cost to financial stability.
url:4bf6f0bee1ebc164.abstract_zh: 本文研究了欧洲企业面临的金融摩擦地理分布对宏观经济的影响。利用欧洲央行《企业融资渠道调查》的专有数据，我们揭示了三个新事实：第一，外部融资渠道存在显著的区域异质性；第二，这种异质性具有持续性，仅随时间呈现渐进式收敛；第三，金融摩擦更严重的国家对货币冲击的反应更弱。为将这些实证发现形式化，我们构建并校准了一个包含22个国家、在金融摩擦、生产率和规模方面存在异质性的可处理新凯恩斯货币联盟模型。高摩擦国家因企业面临更陡峭的边际成本曲线和更低的资本弹性，对货币冲击的反应更弱。金融摩擦的异质性还塑造了产出-通胀权衡关系——在高摩擦国家，同等产出增长需以更高通胀为代价。收敛实验表明，以欧洲储蓄与投资联盟为蓝本的金融市场一体化将增强货币政策效力，但可能以金融稳定为潜在代价。

url:4c75d693fcfc4bd5.abstract: This article revives and enhances the factor-supply approach to estimate the effects of changes in immigrant supply on wages and employment of US natives. We introduce and validate a skill-based shift-share IV for immigrants’ labor supply. We find a positive impact of immigration on natives' employment and significant imperfect substitutability between natives and immigrants. Consistent with these estimates, we find significant task complementarity and occupational upgrading of native workers in response to immigrants. Finally, we calculate that immigration over 2000-2023 increased wages of non-college-educated natives by 2.6 to 3.4%, with small effects on other groups.
url:4c75d693fcfc4bd5.abstract_zh: 本文重新激活并完善了要素供给方法，用以估算移民供给变化对美国本土劳动者工资与就业的影响。我们提出并验证了一种基于技能的偏移份额工具变量，用于衡量移民劳动力供给。研究发现，移民对本土劳动者的就业具有正向影响，且本土劳动者与移民之间存在显著的不完全替代性。与这些估计结果一致，我们还发现本土劳动者在应对移民时表现出显著的任务互补性与职业升级。最后，我们测算得出，2000年至2023年间的移民使未受过大学教育的本土劳动者工资提高了2.6%至3.4%，而对其他群体的影响较小。

url:4cf951f2f9750333.abstract: Connections appear to be helpful in many contexts such as obtaining a job, a promotion, a grant, a loan, or publishing a paper. This may be due to favoritism or to information conveyed by connections. Building on earlier work on discrimination, we propose a new method that identifies these channels using data observed at the time of promotion. The method exploits distinct implications of the two effects on the relationship between observables and success. We show that extra information on connected candidates generates excess variance in latent errors while favors yield different promotion thresholds. We characterize the conditions under which both effects are identified and operationalize these ideas econometrically within a semiparametric framework. We also derive testable restrictions of the model and show how to account for connection endogeneity. We reanalyze data on academic promotions in Spain and Italy and political promotions in China. We detect evidence of favoritism for all types of candidates and of information effects for candidates applying to junior positions. We find strong support for the model’s testable restrictions.
url:4cf951f2f9750333.abstract_zh: 人脉关系在求职、晋升、获取资助、贷款或发表论文等多种情境中似乎都大有裨益。这既可能源于偏袒行为，也可能归因于人脉所传递的信息。基于早期关于歧视问题的研究，我们提出了一种新方法，利用晋升时观测到的数据来识别上述两种渠道。该方法利用了两种效应在可观测变量与成功结果之间关系上的不同含义。我们证明，关于人脉候选人的额外信息会引发潜在误差的过度方差，而偏袒则会导致不同的晋升门槛。我们刻画了两种效应均能被识别的条件，并在半参数框架内以计量经济学方法实现了这些思想。我们还推导出模型的可检验约束条件，并展示了如何处理人脉关系的内生性问题。我们重新分析了西班牙和意大利的学术晋升数据以及中国的政治晋升数据。研究发现，所有类型的候选人均存在偏袒效应的证据，而申请初级职位的候选人则存在信息效应的证据。模型的可检验约束条件得到了强有力的支持。
url:4cf951f2f9750333.title: Promotion through Connections: Favors or Information?

url:50b8124dd6494b5a.abstract: Do central banks decide systematically how much to communicate when explaining their policy decisions? Using all U.S. Federal Open Market Committee policy statements since 1994, we measure communication effort through the change in Shannon entropy and estimate a forward-looking communication rule. We find that communication is systematic: the Federal Reserve communicates more when inflation is expected to exceed target and output is expected to fall below potential. This finding is robust across a variety of sensitivity exercises. We then develop a New Keynesian model with imperfect information showing that systematic communication acts as a second policy instrument, stabilizing expectations and complementing interest-rate policy, especially at the zero lower bound.
url:50b8124dd6494b5a.abstract_zh: 中央银行在解释其政策决策时，是否会系统性地决定沟通程度？我们利用1994年以来美国联邦公开市场委员会的所有政策声明，通过香农熵的变化衡量沟通努力程度，并估算前瞻性沟通规则。研究发现沟通具有系统性：当预期通胀将超过目标值、产出将低于潜在水平时，美联储会加强沟通。这一结论在多种敏感性检验中保持稳健。我们进一步构建包含不完全信息的新凯恩斯模型，证明系统性沟通作为第二政策工具，能够稳定预期并补充利率政策效力，尤其在零利率下限环境下效果显著。

url:52e71b839b416c7e.abstract: Standard macroeconomic data do not cleanly separate the systematic and non-systematic components of monetary policy. We show that incorporating unstructured text data into the structural estimation of a DSGE model can sharpen this distinction. We augment a standard state-space model with a non-core measurement block that links structural shocks to time series derived from FOMC transcripts, using a spike-and-slab prior to let the data select which series are informative. In a medium-scale New Keynesian model for the U.S., incorporating text improves predictive performance and materially alters structural inference: the new model estimates a lower response of the policy rate to inflation, higher price stickiness and lower price indexation, implying a flatter and less backward-looking price Phillips curve.
url:52e71b839b416c7e.abstract_zh: 标准宏观经济数据无法清晰区分货币政策的系统性与非系统性成分。我们证明，将非结构化文本数据纳入DSGE模型的结构估计能够强化这一区分。我们通过一个非核心测量模块对标准状态空间模型进行扩展，该模块将结构性冲击与源自联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）会议记录的时序数据相关联，并采用尖峰-板状先验让数据自行选择具有信息量的序列。在美国中等规模新凯恩斯模型中，引入文本数据不仅提升了预测表现，还显著改变了结构性推断：新模型估计的政策利率对通胀的响应更低，价格粘性更高且价格指数化程度更低，这意味着更平坦且更少后顾性的价格菲利普斯曲线。

url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.abstract: The macroeconomic theory that is taught in graduate schools, and used in the conduct of monetary and fiscal policy around the world today, emerged from a revolution in economics that was led by Ned Phelps. This column discusses Phelps’s theoretical contributions and how they created a micro foundation for macroeconomics.
url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.abstract_zh: 如今研究生院教授并被全球用于货币与财政政策制定的宏观经济理论，源于由内德·菲尔普斯引领的经济学革命。本文探讨了菲尔普斯的理论贡献，以及这些贡献如何为宏观经济学奠定了微观基础。
url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.title: Ned Phelps and modern macroeconomics
url:5583fbd81d8a1cb8.title_zh: 内德·菲尔普斯与现代宏观经济学

url:55907d5000df2527.abstract: Accurate stock price forecasting has consistently remained a pivotal yet challenging FinTech task that underpins quantitative trading and investment decision making. Recent efforts have been dedicated to modeling various complex relationships among stocks in the stock market toward more reliable stock price forecasting.These methods depend heavily on strong static prior assumptions by modeling either temporal dependencies within individual stocks or spatial dependencies across different stocks based on predefined structures, while the complex market dynamics that drive stock price movements remain unexplored. To alleviate this issue, we propose a novel game-theoretic modeling method that captures heterogeneous investor interactions for stock price forecasting. The core idea is to embed game-theoretic mechanisms into the heterogeneous graph structure to finely model the dynamic strategic interactions among heterogeneous investors with respect to target stocks. Additionally, temporal positional encoding is adopted to reflect the differentiated influences of each game event at different time steps within the time window on future stock price movements. Leveraging heterogeneous graph networks, we proxy the intricate dynamics of the stock market through investor games and enable real-time information propagation and node updates among all nodes. Extensive experiments conducted on two real-world benchmark dataset demonstrate that our method effectively outperforms state-of-the-art stock price forecasting methods.
url:55907d5000df2527.abstract_zh: 准确的股票价格预测一直是支撑量化交易与投资决策的关键且具有挑战性的金融科技任务。近期研究致力于建模股票市场中各类复杂关系，以实现更可靠的股价预测。这些方法高度依赖强静态先验假设，要么基于预定义结构建模单只股票的时间依赖性，要么建模不同股票间的空间依赖性，但驱动股价波动的复杂市场动态仍未被充分探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种新颖的博弈论建模方法，通过捕捉异质投资者互动来实现股价预测。其核心思想是将博弈论机制嵌入异质图结构，精细建模目标股票相关异质投资者间的动态策略互动。此外，采用时间位置编码来反映时间窗口内不同时间步的博弈事件对未来股价波动的差异化影响。借助异质图网络，我们通过投资者博弈代理股票市场的复杂动态，实现所有节点间的实时信息传播与节点更新。在两个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法有效超越了现有最优的股价预测方法。

url:55a5d3028a7d40f5.abstract: This paper examines whether regulatory liquidity buffers enable banks to support corporate borrowers during financial stress. Using confidential bank-firm credit data and handcollected Liquidity Coverage Ratio regulation (LCR) disclosures during COVID-19, we find that banks with higher LCR buffers above the regulatory minimum provided significantly more credit to firms with large undrawn credit lines in March 2020. Critically, only buffers, not overall LCR levels, matter, revealing that the regulatory minimum operates as a binding constraint during stress. The effect is concentrated among high-quality borrowers with clean credit profiles and disappears by mid-2020, confirming that LCR buffers provide selective, temporary liquidity insurance during acute stress.
url:55a5d3028a7d40f5.abstract_zh: 本文考察了监管流动性缓冲是否能使银行在金融压力时期为企业借款人提供支持。利用新冠疫情期间的机密银行-企业信贷数据及手工收集的流动性覆盖率（LCR）监管披露信息，我们发现，在2020年3月，LCR缓冲高于监管最低要求的银行，向拥有大量未提取信贷额度的企业提供了显著更多的信贷。关键在于，只有缓冲水平而非整体LCR水平产生影响，这表明监管最低要求在压力时期构成了具有约束力的限制。这一效应集中于信用记录良好的高质量借款人，并在2020年年中消失，证实了LCR缓冲在严重压力时期提供了选择性、临时性的流动性保险。

url:563c8ee2762ce798.abstract: Data centers now account for 4.4% of United States electricity demand, yet the grid-level effectiveness of the renewable energy certificates (RECs) and power purchase agreements (PPAs) hyperscalers use to claim carbon neutrality remains unclear. We develop a game-theoretic model in which a data center operator chooses among RECs, PPAs, and behind-the-meter colocation while generators make entry decisions under endogenous financing costs. The model identifies a timing wedge -- the mismatch between consumption and credited renewable generation -- as a central mechanism through which AI demand degrades reliability, raises prices, and increases emissions even when RECs cover 100% of annual consumption. Colocation with storage addresses this wedge directly and induces the greatest renewable entry by eliminating generator revenue risk. We test these predictions by exploiting the staggered release of large language models as a natural experiment, using difference-in-differences on a novel dataset linking AI activity to local grid outcomes. AI demand significantly increases fossil generation, wholesale prices (up to 25% in treated PJM zones), and outage frequency (0.5--1 additional outages per year) near data centers, with impacts scaling in model size. Data centers with on-site generation exhibit a sign reversal in power-quality effects, consistent with the model
url:563c8ee2762ce798.abstract_zh: 数据中心目前占美国电力需求的4.4%，然而，超大规模企业用于宣称碳中和的可再生能源证书（RECs）和购电协议（PPAs）在电网层面的有效性仍不明确。我们构建了一个博弈论模型，其中数据中心运营商在RECs、PPAs和表后托管之间进行选择，而发电商则在内生融资成本下做出进入决策。该模型识别出一个时间错配——即电力消费与可归因的可再生能源发电之间的时间差——作为核心机制，通过这一机制，即使RECs覆盖100%的年消费量，AI需求仍会降低可靠性、推高电价并增加排放。配备储能的表后托管直接解决了这一时间错配，并通过消除发电商的收入风险，最大程度地促进了可再生能源的进入。我们利用大语言模型的分阶段发布作为自然实验，通过双重差分法对连接AI活动与地方电网结果的新数据集进行检验，以验证这些预测。AI需求显著增加了数据中心附近化石燃料发电量、批发电价（在受影响的PJM区域最高上涨25%）以及停电频率（每年额外增加0.5至1次停电），且影响规模随模型大小递增。配备现场发电的数据中心在电能质量效应上表现出符号反转，这与模型预测一致。
