url:5644c08f5396f681.abstract: How does informality shape the impact of minimum wage policy? We study this question using evidence from Mexico’s 145% real increase in the minimum wage since 2016, together with a general equilibrium model featuring endogenous informality and household heterogeneity. Reduced-form estimates of the implemented increases indicate limited effects on employment and formalization, alongside modest wage gains at the bottom of the formal wage distribution that arguably reflect incomplete enforcement. The calibrated model reproduces these patterns but predicts that, under full enforcement, higher wage floors generate nonlinear effects: the share of firms reallocating toward informality rises sharply, lowering productivity and aggregate welfare. These losses fall disproportionately on low-skill households, who bear the brunt of the reduction in transfers caused by lower tax revenue yet, as predominantly informal workers, gain little directly from the minimum wage. The minimum wage’s effectiveness as a redistributive tool is therefore limited.
url:5644c08f5396f681.abstract_zh: 非正规性如何影响最低工资政策的效果？我们利用墨西哥自2016年以来最低工资实际增长145%的证据，结合包含内生非正规性与家庭异质性的一般均衡模型来研究这一问题。对已实施最低工资上调的简化形式估计表明，其对就业和正规化的影响有限，同时正规工资分布底端出现温和的工资增长——这在一定程度上反映了执法不完善。校准后的模型复现了这些特征，但预测在完全执法条件下，更高的工资下限会产生非线性效应：转向非正规部门的企业比例急剧上升，从而降低生产率和总体福利。这些损失不成比例地由低技能家庭承担——他们因税收减少导致的转移支付下降而首当其冲，但作为以非正规就业为主的劳动者，却几乎无法直接从最低工资中获益。因此，最低工资作为再分配工具的有效性十分有限。

url:5cc28f4442e6fa98.abstract: Investors reward reform progress. Econometric results suggest that holistic reforms, fiscal spending discipline, and monetary policy credibility are associated with a tightening of Qatar’s external sovereign credit spreads. In particular, investors may view fiscal spending discipline as an integral part of Qatar’s holistic reform and economic diversification. Greater broad-based reform progress also boosts the resilience of sovereign credit spreads to external shocks. The findings support fiscal and monetary policy reforms as part of the broader reform agenda in a holistic manner, as planned under the Third National Development Strategy.

url:5d596bcb0673cda5.abstract: Standard welfare evaluations of means-tested transfers typically treat eligibility enforcement as affecting only households directly exposed to the rule. We show that this direct-only approach is incomplete when enforcement events transmit information through workplace networks, inducing other beneficiaries to adjust formal employment and reported earnings. We study Uruguay's AFAM-PE conditional cash transfer, in which household income eligibility is verified monthly using administrative records of formal earnings and households exceeding the threshold may lose benefits, while most beneficiaries are largely unaware of the income rule. Linking program records, social security employment histories, and firm identifiers, we build workplace networks defined six months before each peer's exposure to enforcement and identify spillovers using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design that exploits quasi-random variation in whether a peer crosses the income threshold. Coworkers of peers just above the cutoff reduce registered labor earnings by 20%, and the corresponding fuzzy-RD estimate implies a decline of about one-third of baseline earnings in response to a peer's suspension. These effects emerge within two months and persist for at least 12 months. The response operates almost entirely on the extensive margin of formal employment, and most of the decline reflects transitions to informal work rather than exit from the labor force. Spillovers are concentrated in small firms and among similar coworkers, are nearly three times larger when the suspended peer actively contacted the program's support service, and are absent among non-beneficiary coworkers. This pattern is consistent with information transmission as the main channel. Incorporating these indirect responses lowers the estimated MVPF of the program as implemented with enforcement from 0.53 to 0.36. Because the same information channel operates wherever means-tested programs are enforced through records of formal earnings, evaluations that count only directly exposed households systematically understate the cost of enforcement.
url:5d596bcb0673cda5.abstract_zh: 对家计调查型转移支付的福利评估通常将资格核查视为仅影响直接受规则约束的家庭。我们证明，当核查事件通过工作场所网络传递信息，促使其他受益人调整正规就业和申报收入时，这种仅关注直接影响的评估方法是不完整的。本研究以乌拉圭AFAM-PE有条件现金转移项目为对象，该项目每月通过行政记录核实家庭收入资格，超出阈值的家庭可能失去福利，但多数受益人对收入规则知之甚少。通过关联项目记录、社保就业历史及企业标识，我们构建了每位同伴接受核查前六个月的工作场所网络，并利用同伴是否跨越收入阈值的准随机变化，采用模糊断点回归设计识别溢出效应。结果显示，略高于收入阈值的同伴的同事，其登记劳动收入下降20%；对应的模糊断点回归估计表明，同伴被暂停资格后，其同事基线收入下降约三分之一。这些影响在两个月内显现并持续至少12个月。反应几乎完全体现在正规就业的集约边际上，收入下降主要源于向非正规工作的转移而非退出劳动力市场。溢出效应集中于小型企业和相似同事群体中；当被暂停资格的同伴主动联系项目支持服务时，溢出效应扩大近三倍，而非受益同事中则无此现象。这一模式与信息传递作为主要渠道的假设一致。将间接反应纳入评估后，该项目在核查机制下的估计边际价值公共资金（MVPF）从0.53降至0.36。由于凡是通过正规收入记录执行家计调查的项目均存在相同的信息传递渠道，仅统计直接受影响家庭的评估方法会系统性低估核查成本。

url:5e50b47c6eebf8d0.abstract: This paper empirically reassesses monetary policy transmission in emerging and frontier market economies in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA EFMs). Using the identification approach of Romer and Romer (2004), we construct measures of monetary policy shocks and provide evidence on transmission mechanisms in the region. We show that monetary policy shocks pass through quickly to short-term market interest rates and lead to persistent increases in bank deposit and lending rates in most economies, indicating an operative bank-based interest rate channel. By contrast, exchange rates generally do not appreciate and, in many cases, depreciate following monetary tightening, consistent with the exchange rate puzzle—suggesting that interest rate hikes alone may be insufficient to systematically influence exchange rate movements. We also find that contractionary monetary policy reduces both output and inflation, with effects that are modest and notably weaker than in more developed economies. In addition, we find that transmission is stronger in economies that have adopted, or are transitioning toward, inflation-targeting regimes. Finally, we show that cross-country heterogeneity in transmission largely reflects differences in monetary policy transparency, financial development, and, to a lesser extent, fiscal dominance.
url:5e50b47c6eebf8d0.abstract_zh: 本文对撒哈拉以南非洲新兴及前沿市场经济体（SSA EFMs）的货币政策传导机制进行了实证再评估。采用Romer与Romer（2004）的识别方法，我们构建了货币政策冲击的度量指标，并提供了该区域传导机制的证据。研究表明，货币政策冲击能迅速传导至短期市场利率，并在多数经济体中导致银行存款利率与贷款利率持续上升，表明银行主导的利率渠道具有有效性。相比之下，汇率在货币紧缩后通常不会升值，反而在多数情况下出现贬值，这与"汇率之谜"现象一致——暗示单纯加息可能不足以系统性影响汇率变动。我们还发现，紧缩性货币政策会同时降低产出与通胀，但其影响幅度温和且显著弱于发达经济体。此外，在已采用或正转向通胀目标制的经济体中，货币政策传导效应更强。最后，研究表明跨国传导异质性主要源于货币政策透明度、金融发展水平的差异，而财政主导地位的影响相对较小。

url:5e79499a6f925eb0.abstract: We use a randomized controlled trial to examine how out-of-pocket costs affect contraceptive method choice, pregnancy, abortion, and childbirth among uninsured U.S. women. The study recruited women seeking care through Title X—a national family planning program subsidizing reproductive health services for low-income Americans—and randomized vouchers, making the full spectrum of contraception highly discounted or free. We find that subsidizing contraception has large and persistent effects on the choice of con- traceptive method, resulting in significantly fewer pregnancies and abortions at 26 months. The effects on births are inconclusive.
url:5e79499a6f925eb0.abstract_zh: 我们通过一项随机对照试验，考察自付费用如何影响美国无保险女性的避孕方法选择、怀孕、堕胎及分娩。研究招募了通过Title X（一项为低收入美国人提供生殖健康服务补贴的国家计划生育项目）寻求医疗服务的女性，并随机发放代金券，使各类避孕措施大幅降价或免费。我们发现，补贴避孕措施对避孕方法的选择产生了显著且持续的影响，在26个月时导致怀孕和堕胎数量显著减少。对分娩的影响尚无定论。

url:5ecbe62a61f91c6c.abstract: When Credit Suisse failed in March 2023, Swiss authorities, against market expectations, set aside the resolution plan and arranged a UBS takeover backed by public guarantees, sparing the bail-in bondholders who were next in line to absorb losses. This column traces how that choice reshaped investor beliefs about bail-in across Europe. Spreads on bail-in debt narrowed, the funding penalty on weaker banks shrank, and yields moved less on earnings news. Each points the same way: investors now see bail-in as less likely, a sign that its credibility has declined.
url:5ecbe62a61f91c6c.abstract_zh: 2023年3月瑞信倒闭时，瑞士当局违背市场预期，搁置处置计划并安排瑞银在公共担保支持下进行收购，使本应承担损失的保释债持有人得以幸免。本专栏追踪了这一选择如何重塑欧洲投资者对保释机制的信念。保释债利差收窄，弱势银行的融资惩罚缩小，收益率对盈利消息的反应减弱。这些现象均指向同一结论：投资者如今认为保释可能性降低，表明其可信度已然下降。
url:5ecbe62a61f91c6c.title: After Credit Suisse, markets find bail-in less credible

url:5ed862e0d3bed36d.abstract: Labor markets feature large heterogeneity in employment stability: some careers provide lifetime employment, while others involve frequent transitions in and out of work. While this heterogeneity shapes earnings dynamics and labor market risk, its implications for household saving behavior remain poorly understood. We document two new empirical facts. More stable careers (i) exhibit steeper life-cycle earnings growth and (ii) accumulate significantly more wealth per dollar of income, even within narrowly defined worker groups. To interpret these facts, we develop a life-cycle search-and-saving model with heterogeneous employment stability, job-to-job mobility, endogenous human capital accumulation, and incomplete markets. The model matches both life-cycle earnings and wealth dynamics across careers. Our central finding is that heterogeneity in employment stability reshapes the nature of saving. Stable careers generate sustained earnings growth with a focus on life-cycle saving, while unstable careers are characterized by precautionary, buffer-stock behavior that limits long-run wealth accumulation. Quantitatively, differential earnings growth accounts for about 60% of the wealth gap across careers. These microeconomic differences have important macroeconomic implications. We demonstrate that heterogeneity in employment stability amplifies wealth inequality and substantially increases the macroeconomic consumption response to unemployment shocks.
url:5ed862e0d3bed36d.abstract_zh: 劳动力市场在就业稳定性方面存在显著异质性：部分职业提供终身雇佣保障，而另一些职业则频繁经历就业与失业的转换。尽管这种异质性塑造了收入动态与劳动力市场风险，但其对家庭储蓄行为的影响仍鲜有研究。我们揭示了两项新的实证事实：稳定性较高的职业（i）具有更陡峭的生命周期收入增长曲线，且（ii）即使在严格定义的工人群体内部，每单位收入积累的财富也显著更多。为解释这些事实，我们构建了一个包含异质性就业稳定性、岗位间流动、内生人力资本积累及不完全市场的生命周期搜寻-储蓄模型。该模型能够匹配不同职业的生命周期收入与财富动态。核心发现是：就业稳定性异质性重塑了储蓄的本质。稳定职业产生持续的收入增长，聚焦于生命周期储蓄；而不稳定职业则呈现预防性缓冲库存行为，限制了长期财富积累。量化分析表明，收入增长差异解释了约60%的职业间财富差距。这些微观差异具有重要的宏观经济含义：我们证明就业稳定性异质性会加剧财富不平等，并显著放大宏观经济对失业冲击的消费响应。

url:614c30e08d7f2f25.abstract: This paper examines how tokenization and distributed ledger technology may transform Financial Market Infrastructures (FMIs) by enabling smart contracts to perform a growing share of functions traditionally undertaken by central securities depositories, central counterparties, and trade repositories. It argues that while record-keeping, settlement, collateral management, and reporting can increasingly be executed on-chain, key functions requiring legal certainty, governance, accountability, and discretion remain institutional in nature. The analysis assesses which activities across issuance, clearing, settlement, and reporting can migrate to code, where limitations persist, and how risks evolve in tokenized environments. It finds that tokenization is more likely to reconfigure than eliminate FMIs, creating new efficiencies while introducing novel operational and governance risks. The most plausible outcome is a hybrid FMI model in which technology and institutions jointly provide the trust, resilience, and oversight required for financial stability.
url:614c30e08d7f2f25.abstract_zh: 本文探讨代币化与分布式账本技术如何通过使智能合约承担中央证券存管机构、中央对手方及交易数据库等传统金融基础设施（FMIs）中日益增多的职能，从而推动其变革。研究指出，尽管记录保存、结算、抵押品管理及报告等环节可逐步迁移至链上执行，但涉及法律确定性、治理、问责及自由裁量权的关键职能仍具有制度属性。本文系统评估了发行、清算、结算及报告等环节中哪些活动可迁移至代码执行、现存局限性所在，以及代币化环境下风险演变特征。研究发现，代币化更可能重构而非消除金融基础设施，在创造新效率的同时引入新型操作与治理风险。最可能的结果是形成混合型金融基础设施模式——技术与机构共同提供金融稳定所需的信任、韧性及监管能力。

url:63377656575a5fe8.abstract: A longstanding puzzle in monetary economics is that policy tightening has stronger effects than easing. This column shows that the multiplicity of financing constraints notably dampens the transmission of expansionary monetary policy to firm borrowing and investment, while amplifying the transmission of policy tightening. This asymmetry arises because, when policy tightens, the most responsive constraint binds; whereas, when policy eases, the least responsive constraint limits the expansion of borrowing. A standard New Keynesian framework incorporating this mechanism shows that the decline in aggregate investment following contractionary monetary shocks is twice as large as the increase following equally sized expansionary shocks.
url:63377656575a5fe8.abstract_zh: 货币经济学中一个长期存在的谜题是，政策紧缩的效果强于政策宽松。本文表明，多重融资约束显著削弱了扩张性货币政策向企业借贷和投资的传导，同时放大了政策紧缩的传导效果。这种非对称性产生的原因是：当政策收紧时，最敏感的约束条件生效；而当政策宽松时，最不敏感的约束条件限制了借贷扩张。一个纳入这一机制的标准新凯恩斯框架显示，紧缩性货币冲击后总投资的下降幅度，是同等规模扩张性冲击后上升幅度的两倍。

url:6422ea421c5548f4.abstract: We revisit fiscal sustainability through the lens of the government’s budget constraint. What constrains fiscal policy is not the stock of outstanding liabilities per se, but the fiscal cost of servicing debt. Using two centuries of U.S. fiscal data (1800–2023) and a long-run panel of advanced economies, we show that primary surpluses are systematically more closely associated with debt-service burdens, while debt ratios lose explanatory power when debt service is taken into account. Fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate, specifically when the interest-growth differential is positive. We rationalize these findings using a simple flow-based framework in which debt stabilization depends on the responsiveness of fiscal surpluses to financing pressures. The results suggest that fiscal sustainability depends less on debt thresholds than on financing regimes and governments’ ability to absorb debt-service burdens.
url:6422ea421c5548f4.abstract_zh: 我们通过政府预算约束的视角重新审视财政可持续性问题。制约财政政策的并非未偿债务存量本身，而是偿债的财政成本。基于美国两个世纪（1800-2023年）的财政数据以及发达经济体的长期面板数据，我们发现：初级盈余与偿债负担之间存在系统性更强的关联，而当考虑偿债成本时，债务比率对财政行为的解释力显著下降。当融资条件恶化时——特别是当利率-增长率差值为正时——财政政策反应会显著增强。我们通过一个基于流量分析的简单框架对这些发现进行理论解释：该框架表明，债务稳定取决于财政盈余对融资压力的响应程度。研究结果表明，财政可持续性更多取决于融资机制以及政府吸收偿债负担的能力，而非债务阈值本身。

url:65a48692689f81b4.abstract: We estimate the causal impacts of GLP-1 treatment on labor market outcomes using linked Danish administrative data and a matched stacked difference-in-differences design. We compare patients who initiate GLP-1 treatment during the first two years of Semaglutide availability to observably similar patients who initiate four years later. We find that GLP-1 treatment reduces long-term sickness leave by 17.3%. We estimate total fiscal benefits of GLP-1 initiation of approximately 1.3–1.5% of annual labor income per employed individual. We do not detect statistically significant or economically meaningful impacts on income, labor force participation, or employment over four years.

url:686dd3742a1319c7.abstract: The idea of equal cumulative emissions per person is simple: every individual should have an equal claim on the atmosphere regardless of where they live. Using historical population and emissions data from 1870 onward, this column examines how the world’s remaining carbon budget could be allocated fairly across countries. European states have already consumed more than their share, whereas many developing countries retain positive claims. Allocating the remaining budget fairly can be compatible with development goals if developing countries can access cleaner technologies. Europe can start by redesigning the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism to embed explicit fairness principles.
url:686dd3742a1319c7.abstract_zh: 人均累计排放量平等的理念简洁明了：无论居住何地，每个人都应平等享有对大气资源的权利。本文基于1870年以来的历史人口与排放数据，探讨如何在全球剩余碳预算中实现国家间的公平分配。欧洲国家已超额消耗其份额，而众多发展中国家仍保有正向权益。若发展中国家能够获取清洁技术，公平分配剩余碳预算可与可持续发展目标兼容。欧洲可率先改革碳边境调节机制，将明确的公平原则嵌入其中。

url:6c0f9f090350cfb7.abstract: Europe pays for innovative medicines through 27 uncoordinated national negotiations, generating access delays, cross-country pricing externalities, and a weak position vis-à-vis both pharmaceutical firms and US trade and most-favoured nation pressure. This column argues that Europe should procure innovative on-patent medicines through a single European negotiation that fixes one wholesale price for the entire Single Market, while reintroducing equity across member states through differentiated national contributions and side transfers. Decoupling what the innovator receives from what each country pays would end the pathologies of external reference pricing and parallel trade, restore Europe's bargaining power, and guarantee simultaneous access for all European patients.
url:6c0f9f090350cfb7.abstract_zh: 欧洲通过27个缺乏协调的国家谈判为创新药物买单，导致患者获取药物延迟、跨境定价外部性，以及面对制药公司、美国贸易与最惠国待遇压力时处于弱势地位。本文认为，欧洲应通过单一欧洲谈判采购创新专利药物，为整个单一市场设定统一的批发价格，同时通过差异化的国家缴费和横向转移支付重新实现成员国间的公平。将创新者获得的报酬与各国实际支付金额脱钩，将终结外部参考定价和平行贸易的弊端，恢复欧洲的议价能力，并确保所有欧洲患者能够同步获得药物。

url:70223137b6ed321c.abstract: Trade networks underpinning the energy transition are endogenous economic objects, and their structure is a source of market power. Using bilateral trade data for thirteen electrification metals over 1995–2023, we show that trade in these materials has reorganised into a hub-and-spoke system centred on China, in sharp contrast to the diffuse, multilateral structure of fossil fuels. This centrality did not follow from resource endowments: China holds few of the underlying reserves. It was built through processing investment, industrial policy, and commodity-targeted development finance—an equilibrium outcome rather than a geographical accident. We formalise this in a stylised model in which a country chooses how central to become, and show that centrality maps into pricing power: the world price response to a strategic supply cut is stronger when the network is more concentrated and downstream demand and fringe supply are more inelastic. Constructing text-based, commodity-specific supply shocks and estimating local projections, we find that supply contractions in critical metals raise US and EU consumer prices by roughly twice as much as comparable fossil-fuel shocks, and more persistently. Centrality is therefore not merely descriptive: it creates leverage over global prices. The green transition reduces strategic dependence on hydrocarbon exporters but reconstitutes it around mineral supply chains. That's 200 words. Main cuts: removed the redundant "response to a strategic supply cut" phrasing fix (corrected the original "price...response" agreement), trimmed the closing "architecture of," and compressed a few connectors without losing any substantive claim.Please provide a short description (less than 180 characters) of the paper's findings. TThought processThought processCritical-mineral trade has concentrated into a China-centred hub-and-spoke network, giving pricing power: supply shocks raise US/EU prices twice as much as fossil-fuel shocks.
url:70223137b6ed321c.abstract_zh: 支撑能源转型的贸易网络是内生的经济对象，其结构构成市场势力的来源。利用1995-2023年间十三种电气化金属的双边贸易数据，我们发现这些材料的贸易已重组为以中国为中心的轴辐式体系，与化石燃料分散的多边结构形成鲜明对比。这种中心地位并非源于资源禀赋：中国持有的相关储量极少。它是通过加工投资、产业政策和针对特定商品的发展融资构建而成——这是均衡结果而非地理偶然。我们通过一个简约模型对此进行形式化，在该模型中，国家自主选择中心化程度，并证明中心化映射为定价权：当网络更集中、下游需求与边缘供给更缺乏弹性时，战略性供给削减对世界价格的冲击更强。通过构建基于文本的商品特定供给冲击并估计局部投影，我们发现关键金属的供给收缩使美欧消费者价格涨幅约为可比化石燃料冲击的两倍，且持续性更强。因此，中心化不仅是描述性特征：它创造了影响全球价格的杠杆。绿色转型减少了对碳氢化合物出口国的战略依赖，但将其重构于矿产供应链之上。

url:70770d5d0efec577.abstract: Understanding financial activity beyond traditional regulatory frameworks is essential for policymakers. Yet cryptocurrency mining—which offers a direct entry point into the crypto ecosystem without relying on traditional financial intermediaries—remains highly opaque. We propose a novel measurement approach using detailed customs data that tracks exports of crypto mining hardware from the world’s dominant producers. This trade-based proxy allows us to analyze the global distribution of mining hardware imports and identify their key drivers, guided by a stylized model. Empirically, mining surges respond strongly to global factors such as cryptocurrency prices and hardware costs, while domestic factors—including electricity prices and ambient temperature—shape the cross-country distribution of activity. Our findings highlight how global crypto markets, natural endowments, and policy choices jointly influence mining incentives, offering valuable insights for policymakers concerned with financial stability risks and energy subsidy misuse.
url:70770d5d0efec577.abstract_zh: 理解传统监管框架之外的金融活动对政策制定者至关重要。然而，加密货币挖矿——作为无需依赖传统金融中介即可直接进入加密生态系统的途径——仍然高度不透明。我们提出了一种新颖的测量方法，利用详细的关税数据追踪全球主要生产商出口的加密挖矿硬件。这一基于贸易的代理变量使我们能够分析挖矿硬件进口的全球分布，并借助一个简化模型识别其关键驱动因素。实证结果显示，挖矿活动激增对加密货币价格和硬件成本等全球因素反应强烈，而国内因素——包括电价和环境温度——则塑造了活动的跨国分布。我们的发现揭示了全球加密市场、自然禀赋和政策选择如何共同影响挖矿激励，为关注金融稳定风险和能源补贴滥用的政策制定者提供了宝贵见解。

url:71e16e5a5a802daa.abstract: Les distinctions d’État sont conçues comme des symboles de mérite et de reconnaissance publique. Mais elles peuvent également véhiculer des informations ayant une valeur économique. Cet article explore la valeur de marché de la Légion d’honneur. Lorsque des administrateurs de sociétés françaises cotées en bourse reçoivent cette distinction, le cours des actions de leur entreprise augmente. Cette réaction du marché concerne principalement les administrateurs qui, avant la remise de la distinction, n’avaient aucun lien scolaire observable publiquement avec des membres du gouvernement en place. Cette tendance suggère que les distinctions d’État peuvent fournir aux investisseurs de nouvelles informations sur l’accès potentiel d’un dirigeant aux décideurs politiques.
url:71e16e5a5a802daa.abstract_zh: 国家荣誉勋章被视为功绩与公众认可的象征，但它们也可能传递具有经济价值的信息。本文探讨了法国荣誉军团勋章的市场价值。当法国上市公司的董事获得这一荣誉时，其所在公司的股价会上涨。这种市场反应主要集中于那些在授勋前与现任政府成员之间不存在公开可观察的校友关系的董事。这一趋势表明，国家荣誉勋章能够为投资者提供关于企业高管接触政策制定者潜在渠道的新信息。

url:73005971f868bdfb.abstract: We investigate the systemic risk contribution of 3,500 Money Market Funds (MMFs) in normal periods and during asset price bubbles in the US from January 2004 to December 2022. Using state-of-the-art statistical techniques for bubble detection and granular fund-level data, we show that MMF characteristics significantly influence systemic risk. Large MMFs and government MMFs, which invest exclusively in US Treasury securities, are associated with reduced systemic risk, while prime MMFs contribute to higher systemic risk. MMFs denominated in US dollars but domiciled offshore exhibit no significant differences from their US-domiciled counterparts.
url:73005971f868bdfb.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2004年1月至2022年12月期间，美国3,500只货币市场基金在正常时期及资产价格泡沫期间的系统性风险贡献。采用前沿的泡沫检测统计技术与精细的基金层面数据，我们发现货币市场基金特征对系统性风险具有显著影响。大型货币市场基金及仅投资于美国国债的政府型货币市场基金与系统性风险降低相关，而优质型货币市场基金则加剧了系统性风险。以美元计价但注册于离岸市场的货币市场基金，其风险特征与在美注册基金无显著差异。

url:741535ebafe042f6.abstract: The return of inflation in Western economies has fueled the debate on its main drivers, bringing sector-specific shocks and supply chain bottlenecks to the forefront. Building on the seminal approach of Weber et al. (2024), this paper develops a method to assess the degree of exposure to these shocks in EU countries. Using inter-country input-output data stemming from the FIGARO database, we identify systemically significant sectors in four regions within the EU: Core, Southern Periphery, Eastern Periphery, and financial hubs. We also analyze exposure to foreign shocks. Two main conclusions can be drawn: on the one hand, periphery countries are more exposed to shocks originating in the EU core than the other way around; on the other hand, all EU regions are considerably exposed to price shocks originating from non-EU countries, namely Russia and China. The strategic dependencies of the block pose challenges for price stability and require targeted policies.
url:741535ebafe042f6.abstract_zh: 西方经济体通胀的回归加剧了对其主要驱动因素的争论，将行业特定冲击和供应链瓶颈推至前沿。本文基于Weber等人（2024）的开创性方法，开发了一种评估欧盟国家受这些冲击影响程度的方法。利用来自FIGARO数据库的国家间投入产出数据，我们识别了欧盟四个区域（核心区、南欧外围、东欧外围和金融中心）中具有系统重要性的行业。我们还分析了对外部冲击的暴露程度。主要得出两个结论：一方面，外围国家比核心国家更易受到源自欧盟核心区的冲击；另一方面，所有欧盟区域都显著暴露于源自非欧盟国家（即俄罗斯和中国）的价格冲击。欧盟的战略依赖性对价格稳定构成挑战，需要采取有针对性的政策。

url:78576e1279a2d20b.abstract: With the rise of new industries, often new jobs emerge. Evolutionary Economic Geography and in particular Industry Life Cycle perspectives predict that these activities first emerge in a limited number of cities to then diffuse to other locations as job descriptions become more standardized. Here, we focus on a particularly important new industry: software development, an activity that is economically important, quickly changing, and has a pronounced spatial concentration in a small number of global IT hubs. We use an online database of over 60 million questions and answers about problems in software development that yields a longitudinal dataset of 237 software skills. By geo-locating 3 million posting users at regular intervals, we link these skills to cities worldwide. We find that, in spite of its digital nature, the software industry exhibits similar spatial regularities as previously observed in more traditional sectors. First, cities diversify into skills that are related to their existing ones. Second, new skills first emerge in cities with large and diversified software sectors, and later diffuse -- mostly unhindered by geographical distance -- to smaller cities specialized in closely related skills. We find suggestive but limited support for a windows of locational opportunity account: although even brand-new skills still emerge first in cities with strong prior specialization in related skills, concentrations of related activities impact less the emergence of new skills than the diffusion of existing ones.
url:78576e1279a2d20b.abstract_zh: 随着新兴产业的崛起，新职业往往随之涌现。演化经济地理学，特别是产业生命周期理论预测，这些活动最初会在少数城市出现，随后随着职位描述日趋标准化而扩散至其他地区。本文聚焦于一个尤为重要的新兴产业——软件开发：这一经济活动具有重要经济价值、快速迭代特征，且高度集中于少数全球IT枢纽城市。我们利用一个包含超过6000万条软件开发问题与答案的在线数据库，构建了涵盖237项软件技能的纵向数据集。通过对300万用户进行定期地理定位，我们将这些技能与全球城市相关联。研究发现，尽管软件开发具有数字属性，但其空间分布规律与传统行业高度相似：首先，城市会向与其现有技能相关的领域进行多元化拓展；其次，新技能最初出现在软件产业规模庞大且多元化的城市，随后——基本不受地理距离阻碍——向专精于相近技能的小城市扩散。我们发现了支持"区位机会窗口"理论的初步证据，但该理论解释力有限：尽管全新技能仍优先出现在相关技能基础雄厚的城市，但相关活动的集聚程度对新技能涌现的影响，要弱于对现有技能扩散的影响。

url:793efedb7db52056.title: This paper explores factors driving the internationalization of Renminbi (RMB) trading, using data from the 2025 BIS Triennial Survey of global foreign exchange turnover. We analyze both short-term (three-year) trading growth and long-term RMB turnover levels across jurisdictions. Unlike recent studies that struggled to identify sizable effects of real or financial links with China, we find that financial factors, especially banking links with China, play a key role, even over short horizons. These financial links reinforce market-driven "convergence" patterns, whereby RMB trading adjusts based on its under- or over-representation in total currency trading in a given location. However, this convergence is slower than previously reported, while financial drivers have grown in importance. For the long-term geographical distribution of RMB trading, financial links with China, including policy-driven variables such as qualified investor licenses, dominate, though trade links also contribute significantly. We also find that bilateral trade effects are stronger for cross-border RMB trading, and we report new insights on the dynamics in Asian financial centers and trading in spot versus derivatives.
url:793efedb7db52056.title_zh: 本文利用2025年国际清算银行三年期全球外汇交易调查数据，探讨推动人民币交易国际化的因素。我们分析了各司法管辖区人民币交易的短期（三年）增长与长期交易规模。与近期难以发现与中国实体或金融联系具有显著影响的研究不同，我们发现金融因素（尤其是与中国的银行联系）即使在短期内也发挥关键作用。这些金融联系强化了市场驱动的“趋同”模式，即人民币交易根据其在特定地区总货币交易中的占比偏低或偏高进行调整。然而，这种趋同速度慢于此前报告，而金融驱动因素的重要性有所上升。就人民币交易的长期地理分布而言，与中国的金融联系（包括合格投资者牌照等政策驱动变量）占据主导地位，但贸易联系也贡献显著。我们还发现，双边贸易效应对跨境人民币交易更为显著，并报告了关于亚洲金融中心动态以及即期与衍生品交易的新见解。

url:79aa4d5104723474.abstract: IMF borrowers have demonstrated a very strong track record of timely repayments to the IMF since the 1990s—indeed, no new episodes of protracted overdue financial obligations (OFOs) have occurred since 2001. This represents a marked improvement from the experience of the 1980s and early 1990s. Through quantitative modeling we find that countries’ international reserves coverage of debt service due to the IMF and other creditors, external debt levels, macroeconomic conditions, and broad institutional strength played key roles in distinguishing between past cases with timely repayments and those with protracted arrears. However, we also find that policy reforms and changes in other qualitative factors since the 1990s weakened the relationship between quantitative indicators of repayment capacity and the likelihood of protracted arrears episodes. While stronger macroeconomic and institutional fundamentals of borrowers have contributed to greater timeliness of repayments, a large portion of the improvement remains unexplained by country-specific factors. The timing of this improvement is consistent with implementation of a cooperative strategy on OFOs and other policies that have incentivized cooperation and mitigated “residual” risks on IMF lending relative to the underlying fundamentals of borrowers.
url:79aa4d5104723474.abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，国际货币基金组织（IMF）借款人在按时还款方面表现出色——事实上，自2001年以来未再出现新的长期逾期债务（OFOs）事件。这与20世纪80年代及90年代初的情况相比有了显著改善。通过定量建模，我们发现，各国对IMF及其他债权人到期债务的国际储备覆盖率、外债水平、宏观经济状况以及广泛的制度实力，是区分过去按时还款案例与长期拖欠案例的关键因素。然而，我们也发现，自20世纪90年代以来的政策改革及其他定性因素的变化，削弱了还款能力的定量指标与长期拖欠事件发生概率之间的关系。尽管借款人更强的宏观经济和制度基础有助于提高还款及时性，但大部分改善仍无法用国家特定因素解释。这一改善的时间点与OFOs合作策略及其他政策的实施相吻合——这些政策激励了合作，并相对于借款人的基本面因素，降低了IMF贷款中的“残余”风险。
url:79aa4d5104723474.title: What Explains Timely Repayments to the IMF? The Roles of Policy Reforms and Borrower Fundamentals
url:79aa4d5104723474.title_zh: 国际货币基金组织及时还款的解释：政策改革与借款国基本面的作用

url:79dbc1aaaa017ed0.abstract: The sequence-space Jacobian (SSJ) method of Auclert et al. (2021a) has made heterogeneous-agent models far easier to solve, fueling an explosion of applications. But even SSJ strains against capacity constraints when state spaces grow very large, as in economies with overlapping generations of heterogeneous agents (HA-OLG). We show how to exploit the special properties of age—finite planning horizons and deterministic transitions between ages—to compute the Jacobians of a general class of HA-OLG models orders of magnitude faster. We provide rigorous proofs, age-specific Jacobians that decompose aggregate dynamics across cohorts, an application to the dynamic general-equilibrium effects of secularly declining birth rates, and an accessible cookbook for adopting our method.
url:79dbc1aaaa017ed0.abstract_zh: Auclert等人（2021a）提出的序列空间雅可比（SSJ）方法显著简化了异质性主体模型的求解过程，推动了相关应用的爆发式增长。然而，当状态空间规模极大时（例如在包含异质性主体的世代交叠（HA-OLG）经济中），SSJ方法仍面临计算容量约束。我们通过利用年龄的特殊性质——有限规划期与年龄间的确定性转移——将通用HA-OLG模型类别的雅可比矩阵计算速度提升数个数量级。本文提供严格的理论证明、可分解跨队列总体动态的年龄特异性雅可比矩阵、针对长期出生率下降的动态一般均衡效应的应用分析，以及便于采用本方法的实用指南。

url:7b6fa3766872a515.abstract: This paper studies formal employment dynamics using linked employer-employee data from eight countries spanning a wide income range from Kenya to Chile. First, we show that formality rates increase with development, both between and within countries, because more workers enter the formal sector, not because they spend more time in formal jobs. Second, formal labor market fluidity increases with development, as workers hold more formal jobs, spend less time in each job, and less time between jobs. Third, greater fluidity is associated with higher life-cycle wage growth, which is largely accounted for by within- rather than between-firm wage gains.
url:7b6fa3766872a515.abstract_zh: 本文利用涵盖从肯尼亚到智利等八个收入水平差异显著国家的关联雇主-雇员数据，研究正规就业的动态变化。首先，我们发现正规就业率随经济发展而上升，这一趋势既体现在国家间也体现在国家内部，其原因是更多劳动者进入正规部门，而非他们在正规岗位上的工作时间延长。其次，正规劳动力市场的流动性随经济发展而增强，表现为劳动者从事更多正规工作、每份工作持续时间缩短、以及工作转换间隔时间减少。第三，更高的流动性伴随着更显著的职业生涯工资增长，这主要归因于企业内部而非企业间的工资提升。

url:7d645f1a4f9e38e9.abstract: Price regulation may have unintended consequences, such as facilitating collusion or softening actual price competition by causing a reduction in the number of active firms. Observing different firms hav- ing a monopoly position in parts of a market may be the result of either intense post-entry competition and non-cooperative entry decisions, or collusive entry. This phenomenon and large price differences per pill within a market are widespread in the Swedish generic pharmaceutical market where price regulation through monthly auctions for each active ingredient–dosage form–strength–package size combination channels a large part of demand to the winner within each such substitution group. 22% of the markets are potentially collusive in having at least two firms as monopolies for different substi- tution groups at least some of the time and prices per pill in such markets are on average significantly higher. We take a structural model tailored to the Swedish circumstances to data on two markets. In one market, the entry patterns (monopoly package sizes) are suggestive of actual, in the other of attempted, collusion. Our counterfactual analysis where we induce substitution across package sizes yield savings of >50% in the first market, but lead to a modest expenditure increase in the other because intensified post-entry competition induces exit.
url:7d645f1a4f9e38e9.abstract_zh: 价格管制可能产生非预期后果，例如通过减少活跃企业数量来促进合谋或弱化实际价格竞争。观察到不同企业在市场不同部分拥有垄断地位，既可能是激烈进入后竞争与非合作进入决策的结果，也可能是合谋性进入所致。这一现象及市场内每片药物价格差异巨大的情况，在瑞典仿制药市场中普遍存在——该市场通过每月针对每种活性成分-剂型-规格-包装规格组合的拍卖实施价格管制，将大部分需求引导至各替代组内的中标企业。22%的市场存在潜在合谋特征：至少有两家企业在不同替代组中至少部分时段形成垄断，此类市场的每片药物价格平均显著更高。我们针对瑞典市场特征构建结构模型，并将其应用于两个市场的数据。其中一个市场的进入模式（垄断包装规格）暗示实际合谋，另一个市场则显示合谋企图。反事实分析表明，通过诱导跨包装规格替代，第一个市场可节省超过50%的费用，但第二个市场因进入后竞争加剧导致企业退出，反而使支出小幅增加。

url:7e3c53c7d6aace74.abstract: Inflationary shocks do not affect all workers equally. Comparing men and women, we document two facts. First, both demand- and supply-driven inflationary shocks widen the gender wage gap within industries and occupations. Because these shocks imply opposite business-cycle conditions, their common effect points to inflation as the relevant force. Second, women and men perceive the same inflationary shocks as having different labor-market consequences: women expect conditions to worsen, while men expect them to improve. This asymmetry creates an expectations channel linking inflation to unequal wage growth. We formalize this channel in a New Keynesian search-and-matching model with male and female workers, imperfect information, and gender-specific ambiguity attitudes. Common macroeconomic signals lead ambiguity-averse women to place greater weight on adverse supply-driven states. For inflationary signals, this lowers their perceived outside options and wage demands relative to men
url:7e3c53c7d6aace74.abstract_zh: 通胀冲击对不同劳动者的影响并不均等。通过对比男性和女性，我们揭示了两项事实。其一，无论是需求驱动型还是供给驱动型的通胀冲击，都会在行业和职业内部扩大性别工资差距。由于这两类冲击对应截然不同的商业周期条件，其共同效应表明通胀本身才是关键作用力。其二，面对相同的通胀冲击，女性和男性对其劳动力市场后果的感知存在差异：女性预期就业状况将恶化，而男性则预期改善。这种认知不对称形成了一种将通胀与工资不平等增长联系起来的预期传导渠道。我们通过构建包含男女劳动者、不完全信息以及性别特异性模糊态度的新凯恩斯搜寻匹配模型，对这一渠道进行了形式化分析。共同的宏观经济信号使厌恶模糊性的女性更倾向于赋予不利供给驱动状态更高权重。对于通胀信号而言，这导致她们相较于男性降低了对外部选择权与工资诉求的预期值。

url:7f74cce02eee8949.abstract: Experiments from psychology show that people associate northern locations on arbitrary maps with positive value, raising the possibility that this cognitive bias shapes real housing markets. Using parcel-level data on 1.1 million residential properties across 285 cities in the northeastern United States, we find that houses in the northern parts of cities indeed sell at higher market prices. This premium disappears once lot size is controlled for, the only housing characteristic with this property. We argue that a small psychological preference for northness, too small to register as a direct price premium yet large enough to act as a Schelling focal point, could lead to neighborhood sorting and generate these differences in housing quality between the northern and southern parts of cities.
url:7f74cce02eee8949.abstract_zh: 心理学实验表明，人们会将任意地图上的北方位置与正向价值相关联，这引发了一种可能性：这种认知偏差可能影响真实的住房市场。基于美国东北部285个城市110万套住宅的地块级数据，我们发现城市北部地区的房屋确实以更高的市场价格成交。一旦控制地块面积这一唯一具有此特性的住房属性，该溢价便消失。我们认为，一种微小的对北方的心理偏好——小到不足以直接体现为价格溢价，却足以作为谢林焦点——可能引发社区分层，并导致城市南北部之间住房质量的差异。

url:7f9cc854f330a652.abstract: We develop a flexible model of confirmation bias, in which individuals misinterpret signals as stronger evidence for the state favored by their prior than they actually are. The bias varies with the agent's current belief, nesting Rabin and Schrag (1999) as a special case. In an individual learning setting, incorrect learning arises with positive probability when the bias is severe, generalizing existing work. By contrast, in a social learning setting, correct learning obtains almost surely regardless of the severity of bias. Whereas social information typically introduces inefficiencies, here it mitigates them: social interaction overcomes bias that would otherwise generate incorrect learning.
url:7f9cc854f330a652.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个灵活的确认偏误模型，在该模型中，个体将信号错误地解读为比实际更强的证据，以支持其先验信念所偏好的状态。该偏误随行为主体当前信念的变化而变化，并将Rabin和Schrag（1999）的研究作为特例。在个体学习情境下，当偏误严重时，错误学习会以正概率发生，这扩展了现有研究。相比之下，在社会学习情境下，无论偏误严重程度如何，正确学习几乎必然实现。尽管社会信息通常会引发效率损失，但在此情境下它反而缓解了效率损失：社会互动克服了原本会导致错误学习的偏误。
url:7f9cc854f330a652.title: How Social Learning Overcomes Confirmation Bias

url:8036bf2f7378ca90.abstract: Across much of the Middle East and Central Asia (ME&CA), market competition remains weaker than in other emerging markets, holding back productivity and income growth. Using firm-level data from Orbis for 2002–2021, this paper studies the evolution of market competition in ME&CA economies and examines how trade policy and institutions shape competitive dynamics. We find that market power remains substantial and uneven across ME&CA, with particularly high markups in resource-intensive activities, selected service sectors, and—more recently—manufacturing in the Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA). Higher tariff protection is systematically associated with faster growth in markups, indicating that trade barriers weaken competitive pressure, while improvements in competition policy, anti-corruption frameworks, and property rights are linked to declining market power and hence increasing competition. Although productivity gaps remain large and persistent, stronger competition is associated with faster firm-level productivity growth and higher GDP per capita growth, with these effects particularly pronounced in CCA economies. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of policies aimed at reducing trade barriers and strengthening institutional and competition policy frameworks to foster competition, raise productivity, and support long-term income growth in the ME&CA region.
url:8036bf2f7378ca90.abstract_zh: 在中东和中亚大部分地区，市场竞争仍弱于其他新兴市场，这抑制了生产率和收入增长。本文利用Orbis数据库2002-2021年的企业层面数据，研究中东和中亚经济体的市场竞争演变，并考察贸易政策和制度如何塑造竞争动态。我们发现，中东和中亚地区的市场势力依然显著且分布不均，资源密集型活动、部分服务业以及近期高加索和中亚地区的制造业中，加成率尤其偏高。更高的关税保护与加成率的更快增长系统性相关，表明贸易壁垒削弱了竞争压力；而竞争政策、反腐败框架和产权制度的改善则与市场势力下降（即竞争增强）相关联。尽管生产率差距依然巨大且持续存在，但更强的竞争与企业层面生产率的更快增长以及更高的人均GDP增长相关，这些效应在高加索和中亚经济体中尤为显著。总体而言，研究结果强调了旨在降低贸易壁垒、加强制度和竞争政策框架的政策重要性，以促进竞争、提高生产率并支持中东和中亚地区的长期收入增长。

url:80910c858a5b6961.abstract: Governments often intervene to prevent firm closures during crises, fearing that financially constrained but viable firms may fail. We develop a firm dynamics model with incomplete financial markets and show how financial frictions generate excessive firm exit. A key statistic governing this dynamic inefficiency is the marginal propensity to exit with debt. Using confidential U.S. Census data, we estimate the relationship between debt and exit and use it to discipline the model. The calibrated model implies that eliminating financial frictions reduces firm exit from 9.3\% to 5.0\% and generates welfare gains of 3.6\% in consumption-equivalent terms. We show that the welfare costs of financial frictions rise sharply during financial crises but change little during standard productivity recessions. Finally, we compare government-guaranteed loans and grants, quantifying the trade-off between fiscal cost and effectiveness in preventing excessive exit.
url:80910c858a5b6961.abstract_zh: 政府常会在危机期间干预以防止企业倒闭，担心那些面临财务约束但具有生存能力的企业可能失败。我们构建了一个包含不完全金融市场的企业动态模型，并展示了金融摩擦如何导致企业过度退出。衡量这种动态低效率的关键统计指标是债务驱动的边际退出倾向。利用保密的美国人口普查数据，我们估算了债务与退出之间的关系，并以此校准模型。校准后的模型表明，消除金融摩擦可使企业退出率从9.3%降至5.0%，并以消费等价形式带来3.6%的福利收益。我们进一步发现，金融摩擦的福利成本在金融危机期间急剧上升，但在标准的生产率衰退期间变化甚微。最后，我们比较了政府担保贷款与直接拨款，量化了财政成本与防止过度退出有效性之间的权衡关系。
url:80910c858a5b6961.title: Firm Exit and Financial Frictions

url:8115c0e359129d33.abstract: The asset management industry is increasingly shifting toward tailored portfolios, fund proliferation, and decentralization of stewardship—trends partly driven by growing heterogeneity in investor preferences. While these developments better align investment products with investor demands, they also reshape ownership structures, potentially leading to more fragmented ownership and weaker managerial oversight. We develop a framework to evaluate these trade-offs and show that fund proliferation does not necessarily weaken governance: Stronger incentives for asset managers and concentrated portfolios of specialized funds can offset these effects, especially when investor preferences are intense. However, strong investor preferences can also induce asset managers to compete on a new margin—granting investors control by decentralizing stewardship and adopting pass-through voting—without internalizing the associated governance costs.
url:8115c0e359129d33.abstract_zh: 资产管理行业正日益转向定制化投资组合、基金数量激增以及管理权分散化——这些趋势部分源于投资者偏好的日益多样化。尽管这些发展使投资产品与投资者需求更加契合，但也重塑了所有权结构，可能导致所有权更加分散、管理层监督弱化。我们构建了一个评估这些权衡关系的分析框架，并发现基金数量激增并不必然削弱公司治理：资产管理人更强的激励机制以及专业基金集中化的投资组合能够抵消上述影响，尤其在投资者偏好强烈时更为显著。然而，强烈的投资者偏好也可能促使资产管理人在新维度展开竞争——通过分散管理权并采用传递投票机制将控制权让渡给投资者——却未将相应的治理成本内部化。

url:8253cce7ce84db7c.abstract: The secular decline in birth rates across the globe over the past seven decades has slowed population growth, raised average ages, and reshaped labor markets and the macroeconomy. Contrary to the widespread expectation that these trends hamper economic growth, we find lower birth rates are associated with higher growth in GDP per working-age adult across countries and higher wage growth across US commuting zones, with no negative impact on aggregate GDP or earnings. These patterns are not explained by educational upgrading, rising female labor force participation, the declining importance of agriculture, or neoclassical-Solow mechanisms. We argue that they reflect the endogenous, labor-saving response of technology to the scarcity of younger workers. Consistent with this interpretation, countries and regions with lower birth rates exhibit more labor-saving patents and growing high-tech activity. There is also higher TFP growth across countries and industries. Exploiting cross-country variation in WWII military and civilian deaths, we find that declines in younger population, rather than population size per se, drive our results.
url:8253cce7ce84db7c.abstract_zh: 过去七十年间全球生育率的长期下降，减缓了人口增长，提高了平均年龄，并重塑了劳动力市场与宏观经济。与普遍认为这些趋势会阻碍经济增长的预期相反，我们发现较低的生育率与各国劳动年龄人口人均GDP的更高增长以及美国通勤区工资的更高增长相关，且对总体GDP或收入无负面影响。这些模式无法通过教育水平提升、女性劳动参与率上升、农业重要性下降或新古典索洛机制来解释。我们认为，这反映了技术对年轻劳动力稀缺性的内生性、节约劳动力的响应。与这一解释一致的是，生育率较低的国家和地区拥有更多节约劳动力的专利，且高科技活动日益活跃。各国及各行业也呈现出更高的全要素生产率增长。利用二战期间各国军事与平民死亡人数的跨国差异，我们发现驱动结果的是年轻人口减少，而非人口规模本身。

url:83bae391f6125fa4.abstract: Maritime transport remains the backbone of global trade, yet the port and shipping network that carries it has been transformed by containerization and related technological advances. Drawing on newly available granular data—digitized historical shipping records, georeferenced ship movements, and shipment-level routing information—we present five stylized facts on the structure and evolution of the maritime network. Global shipping activity is highly concentrated among a changing lineup of dominant top ports even as lower-ranked ports disperse, while state-owned Chinese port terminal operators increasingly account for these global volumes, boosting overall port operations while delivering efficiency gains mostly to Chinese vessels. We use these facts to organize a synthesis of a fast-growing literature: containerization reshaped which port cities could expand, reinforced hub-and-spoke concentration that yields large but localized welfare gains, embedded ports in multimodal networks that amplify the returns to infrastructure, and generated market power, congestion, and environmental costs. Together, this evidence shows how evolving maritime technologies simultaneously deepen global integration and heighten the economic and geopolitical importance of critical nodes in the transport network—and of who controls them.
url:83bae391f6125fa4.abstract_zh: 海上运输仍是全球贸易的支柱，但承载这一运输体系的港口与航运网络已因集装箱化及相关技术进步而发生深刻变革。基于新获取的颗粒化数据——数字化历史航运记录、地理参照船舶轨迹及单次货运路径信息——我们归纳出关于海运网络结构与演进的五个典型事实：全球航运活动高度集中于排名动态变化的头部港口，而低排名港口则呈现分散化趋势；同时，中国国有港口码头运营商在全球吞吐量中的占比持续攀升，在提升整体港口运营效率的同时，其效率增益主要惠及中国籍船舶。我们以这些事实为框架，系统梳理了快速发展的相关文献：集装箱化重塑了港口城市的扩张空间，强化了枢纽-辐射式集中格局（虽带来巨大但局部化的福利增益），将港口嵌入多式联运网络（放大基础设施投资回报），并催生了市场势力、拥堵与环境成本问题。这些证据共同表明，不断演进的海运技术在深化全球一体化的同时，也加剧了运输网络关键节点及其控制者的经济与地缘政治重要性。

url:84485f9e6b5dce9d.abstract: This study uses an entropy balancing model to show that coups d’état can reduce GDP growth by around 2.3 percentage points in the same year. This is a larger effect than some previous estimates, and is found to be persistent over time, reducing cumulative GDP growth by around five percentage points over the following five years. This study goes deeper than previous research into the drivers of that impact, finding that economic sanctions are an an important reason for the observed lower growth in many cases and that the principal channel is via private consumption and investment.
url:84485f9e6b5dce9d.abstract_zh: 本研究采用熵平衡模型表明，政变可使当年GDP增长率降低约2.3个百分点。这一影响幅度大于部分既有研究估计值，且呈现持续性特征——在随后五年内累计减少约五个百分点的GDP增长。相较于既有研究，本研究更深入探究该影响的驱动因素，发现经济制裁是多数案例中增长放缓的重要成因，而其主要传导渠道为私人消费与投资。

url:87589d3680e35d55.abstract: We construct standardized climate anomalies from daily observations and carefully calibrate physical thresholds to identify storms, floods, droughts, heatwaves, and cold snaps across 196 countries over the period 1970–2023. Using a local projections framework, we estimate the contemporaneous and 2-year effects of each disaster type and collectively on real GDP growth. We find that storms, floods, droughts, and heatwaves significantly reduce growth on impact (by roughly 0.1–0.2 percentage points on average), with the largest effects observed in emerging markets and developing economies. Cold spells have no statistically significant impacts. Our estimations also indicate that the initial drop in GDP growth is often not fully offset by a quick rebound, leaving GDP below the pre-disaster trend in the subsequent two years. Severe disasters impose far larger costs. Catastrophic floods can lower growth by up to 3 percentage points (with once-in-100-year storms or heatwaves reducing growth by ~0.5pp and extreme droughts by ~1pp). By combining the estimated global coefficients with each country’s own disaster intensity, we translate the aggregate results into localized growth effects and cross-check them against estimates from a dynamic heterogenous panel model. Finally, rolling-window estimates indicate that the contemporaneous growth impact of storms and heatwaves has attenuated in recent decades, whereas droughts have become increasingly damaging, reflecting divergent adaptation or even maladaptation and vulnerability trends over time.
url:87589d3680e35d55.abstract_zh: 我们基于每日观测数据构建了标准化的气候异常指标，并仔细校准了物理阈值，以识别1970-2023年间196个国家的风暴、洪水、干旱、热浪和寒潮事件。通过局部投影框架，我们估算了每种灾害类型及其综合对实际GDP增长的当期影响和两年期效应。研究发现，风暴、洪水、干旱和热浪在冲击当期显著抑制经济增长（平均约0.1-0.2个百分点），其中新兴市场和发展中经济体的影响最为显著。寒潮则未呈现统计显著影响。我们的估算还表明，GDP增长的初始下降通常无法通过快速反弹完全弥补，导致后续两年GDP仍低于灾前趋势水平。严重灾害造成的成本远高于平均水平：灾难性洪水可使增长率下降高达3个百分点（百年一遇的风暴或热浪约降低0.5个百分点，极端干旱约降低1个百分点）。通过将全球估计系数与各国自身灾害强度相结合，我们将汇总结果转化为局部增长效应，并与动态异质性面板模型的估计结果进行交叉验证。最后，滚动窗口估计表明，近几十年来风暴和热浪的当期增长冲击有所减弱，而干旱的破坏性持续增强，这反映了随时间推移出现的适应性分化乃至适应不良与脆弱性趋势的演变。

url:87afb75323a06a97.abstract: The alpha male, associated with traditional masculinity features such as competitiveness, assertiveness, and risk tolerance, embodies a biologically grounded dimension of personality. We construct a novel dataset of political leaders' masculinity---measured by facial width-to-height ratio, an established biological marker for traditional masculine behavior driven by testosterone---for more than 2,000 national leaders across 184 countries over 150 years. Leaders’ masculinity has increased over the past 70 years in both democracies and autocracies, across rich and poor countries, and across all regions. Benchmarking against Olympic athletes, Wikipedia-notable individuals, and U.S.\ population data, we document that political leaders exhibit systematically higher masculinity than other groups, in both democracies and autocracies. Leaders' masculinity surges during periods of geopolitical uncertainty, such as the World Wars, the Cold War, and recent decades. Two empirical applications show that masculine leaders are related to democratic change and international war, and these links depend on the institutional environment.
url:87afb75323a06a97.abstract_zh: 阿尔法男性特质，如竞争性、自信和风险承受力，与传统男性气质相关，体现了一种基于生物基础的人格维度。我们构建了一个涵盖150年间184个国家2000多位国家领导人的新型数据集，以面部宽高比（一种由睾酮驱动的传统男性行为的既定生物标志）衡量其男性气质。过去70年间，无论是民主国家还是专制国家、富裕国家还是贫穷国家、以及所有地区，领导人的男性气质均有所上升。通过与奥运运动员、维基百科知名人士及美国人口数据对比，我们发现政治领导人的男性气质在民主和专制国家中均系统性高于其他群体。在地缘政治不确定时期（如两次世界大战、冷战及近几十年），领导人的男性气质显著激增。两项实证研究表明，男性气质与民主变革及国际战争存在关联，且这种关联取决于制度环境。

url:88992722fb3fc6f9.abstract: We study central bank asset purchases (APs) in bond markets where rational investors face position limits and learn from private signals and market prices. APs affect information aggregation, altering the informativeness of prices and their sensitivity to fundamentals through an information channel distinct from risk-premium effects. Consistent with this mechanism, we find that U.S. Federal Reserve APs strengthened the pass-through of labor market news to Treasury yields. Dispersed beliefs and position limits also provide a microfoundation for the optimality of APs.
url:88992722fb3fc6f9.abstract_zh: 我们研究理性投资者面临头寸限制并从私人信号和市场价格中学习的债券市场中，央行资产购买（APs）的影响。资产购买通过一个区别于风险溢价效应的信息渠道，影响信息聚合，改变价格的信息含量及其对基本面的敏感度。与这一机制一致，我们发现美联储资产购买增强了劳动力市场消息对国债收益率的传导效应。信念分散与头寸限制也为资产购买的最优性提供了微观基础。

url:88ee82b55925acee.abstract: We study the liquidity choice of a bank subject to rollover risk and support from a lender of last resort (LLR) and study the consequences for bank stability, funding costs, and liquidity regulation. The liquidity choice balances forgoing profitable yet illiquid investment with fewer panic runs and cheaper debt. A higher LLR penalty rate increases bank liquidity and has a V-shaped effect on ex-ante bank stability. Turning to normative implications, the availability of the LLR reduces welfare for a large social cost of bank failure. The anticipation of ex-post support mitigates panic runs but induces lower bank liquidity ex ante, which increases funding costs and the frequency of bank failure. Liquidity regulation aligns private with social incentives and increases the social value of LLR support.
url:88ee82b55925acee.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一家面临展期风险并接受最后贷款人（LLR）支持的银行的流动性选择，并探讨了其对银行稳定性、融资成本及流动性监管的影响。流动性选择需要在放弃盈利但缺乏流动性的投资与减少恐慌性挤兑及降低债务成本之间进行权衡。更高的LLR惩罚利率会提升银行流动性，并对事前银行稳定性产生V形效应。从规范意义上看，LLR的可得性在银行破产社会成本较高时会降低社会福利。对事后支持的预期虽能缓解恐慌性挤兑，但会降低银行事前流动性，从而增加融资成本及银行破产频率。流动性监管能够协调私人激励与社会激励，并提升LLR支持的社会价值。

url:8ac0993c13caca97.abstract: Despite documented heterogeneity in volatility dynamics across the option surface, standard implied volatility forecasting models apply homogeneous parameters throughout. We introduce a machine-learning framework that uses regression trees to partition the surface along both moneyness and maturity dimensions, identifying data-driven regions where distinct forecasting models perform best. Extending the Surface Heterogeneous Autoregressive (SHAR) framework of Dufays, Jacobs, and Rombouts (2025), we develop tree-based SHAR specifications that preserve interpretable structure while allowing model parameters to vary across the surface. Empirical analysis using S&P 500 options demonstrates that the boosted tree-based specification achieves the lowest out-of-sample forecast errors across all horizons, reducing one-month-ahead RMSE by 13 percent versus the benchmark SHAR model. The improvements are statistically significant and particularly pronounced during stress periods. The estimated tree presents economically interpretable segmentation: short-dated options exhibit higher daily persistence but lower monthly persistence than long-dated options, while deep out-of-the-money calls or puts display distinct dynamics from near-the-money contracts.
url:8ac0993c13caca97.abstract_zh: 尽管期权曲面上的波动率动态存在显著异质性，但标准隐含波动率预测模型在整个曲面上均采用同质参数。我们引入一种基于回归树的机器学习框架，沿期限与执行价两个维度对曲面进行划分，识别出不同预测模型表现最优的数据驱动区域。通过扩展Dufays、Jacobs与Rombouts（2025）提出的曲面异质自回归（SHAR）框架，我们开发了基于树的SHAR模型，在保持可解释结构的同时允许模型参数随曲面位置变化。基于标普500期权的实证分析表明，增强型树模型在所有预测期限上均实现最低的样本外预测误差，将一个月前瞻均方根误差较基准SHAR模型降低13%。该改进具有统计显著性，且在压力时期尤为突出。估计树呈现经济可解释的分段特征：短期期权较长期期权具有更高的日度持续性但更低的月度持续性，而深度虚值看涨/看跌期权则展现出与平值期权截然不同的动态特征。

url:8ee18e2580afc53a.abstract: Researchers are faced with the choice of which of the many recently developed difference-in-differences methods to use in practice. To assess these estimators' relative performance for single-unit event studies, we conduct 134,000+ state-level placebo event studies across 13 estimators. We find that no single method dominates. Performance is context-dependent, with synthetic-control-like methods sometimes outperforming and sometimes underperforming two-way-fixed-effect-like and matching methods. Performance also varies across states at least as much as it does across estimators. Our results highlight the need for practitioners to conduct placebo tests to understand the performance of methods in their research context.
url:8ee18e2580afc53a.abstract_zh: 研究者面临如何在众多新近发展的双重差分方法中做出实际选择的难题。为评估这些估计量在单单位事件研究中的相对表现，我们基于13种估计量开展了超过13.4万次州级安慰剂事件研究。研究发现，没有任何单一方法具有绝对优势。方法表现具有情境依赖性，合成控制类方法有时优于、有时劣于双向固定效应类方法和匹配方法。各州之间的表现差异至少与不同估计量之间的差异相当。研究结果强调，实践者需开展安慰剂检验以理解其研究情境下各方法的实际表现。

url:8f04e89f84ef248c.abstract: This paper develops high frequency trade estimates at the country level by applying nowcasting methodologies to satellite-based big data on vessel movements sourced from IMF PortWatch. The approach provides a timely estimate of monthly trade at the country level that can be produced and released within 7 working days. The paper validates the nowcasting trade estimates against official data for an initial wave of countries representing advanced economies, emerging markets and small island developing states: Brazil, Jamaica, Japan, Samoa, and the United States. The nowcasting methodology produces trade estimates that perform well compared to the official statistics, with the best fit for advanced economies and large emerging markets. The paper identifies key complementary information to improve the presented nowcasting methodology to develop country trade estimates. The paper also considers an application to estimates of U.S. imports during a period of elevated trade tensions.
url:8f04e89f84ef248c.abstract_zh: 本文通过将即时预测方法应用于国际货币基金组织港口观察（IMF PortWatch）提供的基于卫星的船舶移动大数据，开发了国家层面的高频贸易估算。该方法可在7个工作日内生成并发布国家层面的月度贸易及时估算。本文以首批涵盖发达经济体、新兴市场和小岛屿发展中国家的国家（巴西、牙买加、日本、萨摩亚和美国）为对象，将即时预测贸易估算与官方数据进行验证。结果表明，该即时预测方法生成的贸易估算与官方统计数据拟合良好，其中对发达经济体和大型新兴市场的拟合效果最佳。本文识别了改进现有即时预测方法以完善国家贸易估算的关键补充信息，并进一步探讨了该方法在贸易紧张局势加剧时期对美国进口估算的应用。

url:8f11d91a842ca71a.abstract: How does carbon pricing affect investment in brown firms? During the period 2000–2019, the effective cost of emitting carbon rose by about 400 percent for Swedish manufacturing firms. Despite lower operating margins, high-emission firms significantly increased both total capital investment and the share of investment dedicated to abatement. The response is concentrated among firms with strong internal financial capacity. We find no comparable investment increase in lower-emitting firms or in high-emission industries outside of Sweden. Our results show that pricing CO2 emissions at a sufficiently high level can incentivize brown firms to make green investments.
url:8f11d91a842ca71a.abstract_zh: 碳定价如何影响棕色企业的投资？在2000年至2019年间，瑞典制造业企业的有效碳排放成本上升了约400%。尽管运营利润率下降，高排放企业仍显著增加了总资本投资以及用于减排的投资份额。这一反应集中在内部财务能力较强的企业中。我们在低排放企业或瑞典以外的高排放行业中未发现类似的投资增长。研究结果表明，将二氧化碳排放定价在足够高的水平，能够激励棕色企业进行绿色投资。

url:8f4bf76b72a269c3.abstract: This paper examines the impact of voluntary and involuntary excess liquidity on monetary policy effectiveness and inflation in Kazakhstan. Consistent with first-principles predictions, we find that voluntary liquidity held for precautionary motives is (i) negatively related to the opportunity cost of holding liquid assets and to the level of mandatory reserve requirements; (ii) positively related to average liquidity outflows, proxied by transactional demand for cash; and (iii) ambiguously affected by the magnitude and volatility of the business cycle. We further show that higher voluntary liquidity weakens monetary policy transmission and increases exchange rate pass-through to inflation. In contrast, involuntary liquidity hampers monetary policy effectiveness no matter its level and it increases average inflation primarily through its influence on the formation of inflation expectations. Overall, the results suggest that reforms aimed at reducing both forms of liquidity would enhance monetary policy effectiveness and, ceteris paribus, reduce inflation.
url:8f4bf76b72a269c3.abstract_zh: 本文研究了哈萨克斯坦自愿性与非自愿性超额流动性对货币政策有效性和通货膨胀的影响。与基本原理预测一致，我们发现：出于预防性动机持有的自愿性流动性（i）与持有流动性资产的机会成本及法定准备金要求水平呈负相关；（ii）与以现金交易需求为代理变量的平均流动性流出呈正相关；（iii）受经济周期幅度和波动性的影响具有模糊性。我们进一步证明，较高的自愿性流动性会削弱货币政策传导机制，并增强汇率传递对通货膨胀的影响。相比之下，无论非自愿性流动性水平高低，其均会阻碍货币政策有效性，并主要通过影响通胀预期形成机制推高平均通胀水平。总体而言，研究结果表明，旨在减少两种形式流动性的改革将提升货币政策有效性，并在其他条件不变的情况下降低通货膨胀。

url:909357ceb6aebc8e.abstract: In a model with endogenous risk-taking, deposit insurance and limited liability may lead banks to make risky loans that are socially inefficient. Capital requirements can prevent excessive risk-taking at the cost of reducing liquidity-producing bank deposits. A policy that sets capital requirements just high enough to prevent excessive risktaking will move capital requirements pro-, counter-, or a-cyclically depending on the shock source. However, such a policy requires full knowledge of all the shocks hitting the economy and is not implementable. Simple rules that respond to cyclical conditions—in line with Basel III guidance—perform poorly, whereas a small static capital buffer can do much better.
url:909357ceb6aebc8e.abstract_zh: 在内生风险承担模型中，存款保险与有限责任可能导致银行发放社会效率低下的高风险贷款。资本充足要求能够以降低流动性创造型银行存款为代价，防止过度风险承担。若将资本充足要求设定为恰好足以遏制过度风险承担的水平，该政策将根据冲击来源呈现顺周期、逆周期或非周期特征。然而，此类政策要求完全掌握冲击经济的全部因素，实际中并不可行。符合《巴塞尔协议III》指引的周期性调节型简单规则表现欠佳，而小规模静态资本缓冲却能取得显著更优效果。

url:91bd9e43f00ef88c.abstract: We show that incorporating uninsurable countercyclical income risk into a standard international RBC model can qualitatively and quantitatively account for the quantity puzzles in open-economy macro, namely (i) the Backus-Smith puzzle, (ii) the Backus-Kehoe-Kydland puzzle and (iii) the weak correlation between the trade balance and the exchange rate. We also show that our model can simultaneously account for the Fama puzzle and the evidence that high interest rate countries have stronger currencies---which representative-agents models that rely only on financial or demand shocks cannot jointly account for. Crucially, our model resolves all these puzzles while relying solely on productivity shocks, and thus generates the observed domestic and cross-country macroeconomic comovement.
url:91bd9e43f00ef88c.abstract_zh: 我们证明，将不可保险的反周期收入风险纳入标准国际实际经济周期模型，能够从定性和定量角度解释开放经济宏观经济学中的数量谜题，即：（i）巴克斯-史密斯谜题、（ii）巴克斯-基欧-基德兰德谜题以及（iii）贸易余额与汇率之间的弱相关性。我们还证明，该模型能够同时解释法玛谜题以及高利率国家拥有更强货币的证据——而仅依赖金融或需求冲击的代表性主体模型无法共同解释这些现象。关键在于，我们的模型仅依靠生产率冲击就解决了所有这些谜题，从而生成了观察到的国内及跨国宏观经济协同波动。

url:94d371a7c418db8d.abstract: How exposed are open economies to global demand shocks? In equilibrium, foreign booms can be absorbed either by domestic consumption ("quantities") or by real exchange rate appreciation ("prices"). We show that failures of Ricardian equivalence and global financial market imperfections, two frictions popular in much recent work, have opposite effects on the split: while elevated marginal propensities to consume push towards quantities, financial frictions instead increase price adjustment. As the flexible-price equilibrium generally features a mix of quantity and price responses, policy needs to be contractionary to achieve flexible-price outcomes if the spending effect dominates, and vice-versa if financial frictions are severe. In our quantitative explorations the spending effect tends to win the race, necessitating aggressive domestic policy action.

url:96c06cde3c58345c.abstract: This paper investigates why the post-COVID inflation surge, though globally synchronized, led to widely divergent outcomes across countries. Using cross-country regressions for 130 economies and local projections methods for 70 advanced and emerging markets, we analyze the structural, institutional, and policy determinants of post-pandemic inflation dynamics. The results indicate that historical inflation and the scale of domestic energy price shocks account for most of the cross-country variation in cumulative post-COVID inflation. In contrast, many frequently cited country-specific, macroeconomic fundamentals and institutional features exhibit limited power to explain cross-country variation. The association between post-COVID inflation and domestic policy responses is also weak, although endogeneity complicates a clear causal interpretation. The analysis further reveals that pass-through from energy prices to headline inflation intensified markedly in the post-COVID period, particularly in emerging markets, in non-inflation-targeting regimes, and in countries that did not expand fossil fuel subsidies. These findings highlight the asymmetric transmission of supply shocks and underscore the importance of credibility, historical inflation experience, and energy policy design in shaping inflation persistence. Strengthening central bank credibility and anchoring expectations may be essential to bolster resilience against future global supply disruptions.
url:96c06cde3c58345c.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了为何新冠疫情后的通胀飙升虽具有全球同步性，却在各国间产生了截然不同的结果。基于对130个经济体的跨国回归分析以及对70个发达和新兴市场的局部投影方法研究，我们剖析了疫情后通胀动态的结构性、制度性及政策决定因素。结果表明，历史通胀水平与国内能源价格冲击的规模解释了新冠疫情后累计通胀的大部分跨国差异。相比之下，许多常被引用的国别特定因素、宏观经济基本面及制度特征在解释跨国差异方面能力有限。新冠疫情后通胀与国内政策响应之间的关联也较弱，尽管内生性问题使因果关系的清晰解读变得复杂。分析进一步揭示，疫情后能源价格向整体通胀的传导效应显著增强，尤其在新兴市场、非通胀目标制国家以及未扩大化石燃料补贴的经济体中。这些发现凸显了供给冲击的非对称传导机制，并强调了可信度、历史通胀经验及能源政策设计在塑造通胀持续性中的关键作用。加强央行可信度并锚定通胀预期，对于增强抵御未来全球供给中断的韧性至关重要。

url:96db08a2edd27b4b.abstract: Formulating an education production function and using estimates of student and class discipline levels, this paper seeks to identify the relations between discipline, class size, teaching quality and scholastic outcomes. The data shows both individual and class-level discipline to be a powerful predictor of the PISA math score, while variance in discipline among classmates has a strongly negative effect. Furthermore, class discipline is correlated with larger classes. As a structural simulation demonstrates, the correlations observed in the data can be well explained by how schools allocate students and teachers to classes. This analysis allows for a break-down of the contribution of educational production factors and highlights the role of individual and class discipline to student achievements.
url:96db08a2edd27b4b.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建教育生产函数，并利用学生与班级纪律水平的估计值，旨在识别纪律、班级规模、教学质量与学业成果之间的关系。数据显示，个体及班级层面的纪律水平对PISA数学成绩具有显著预测力，而同学间纪律水平的差异则产生强烈的负面效应。此外，班级纪律与较大班级规模存在相关性。结构模拟表明，数据中观察到的相关性可通过学校如何将学生与教师分配至班级得到合理解释。该分析能够分解教育生产因素的贡献，并凸显个体与班级纪律对学生学业成就的重要作用。

url:9759bb1f28c23817.abstract: We document market power in U.S. equity securities lending and examine its origins and consequences. We develop a dynamic model of securities lending and estimate it on the cross-section of U.S. equities, showing that the dominant custodian-intermediated market structure emerges as a response to short sellers’ information-leakage concerns. Short sellers prefer this opaque market structure over a centralized alternative, particularly for smaller stocks, despite the associated non-competitive fees. This is because their trading strategies become unprofitable if information leaks prematurely. Thus, unlike in standard product markets, the demand side in securities lending values opacity, which is important for regulatory design.
url:9759bb1f28c23817.abstract_zh: 我们记录了美国股票证券借贷中的市场势力，并考察了其起源与后果。我们构建了一个证券借贷的动态模型，并基于美国股票截面数据进行了估计，结果表明，以托管机构为中介的主导型市场结构是对卖空者信息泄露担忧的回应。尽管这种不透明的市场结构伴随着非竞争性费用，但卖空者仍偏好于此，而非集中化替代方案，尤其是对于小盘股而言。这是因为，如果信息过早泄露，他们的交易策略将无利可图。因此，与标准产品市场不同，证券借贷的需求方看重不透明性，这对监管设计具有重要意义。

url:98510ac540db3cb6.abstract: We study inference via heteroskedasticity in linear models commonly used for macroeconomic policy analysis, where covariate endogeneity must often be addressed with limited time and data. Our framework nests standard heteroskedasticity-based approaches, allows for new non-nested restrictions, and does not require ex-ante regime labelling. We propose an easily implementable weak-identification-robust test and derive sufficient conditions for its validity. Simulation results show good size and power properties in a wide range of settings. Empirical applications to the fuel-price passthrough in Sierra Leone, the effect of remittances on consumption in the Philippines, and exchange-rate passthroughs in many countries illustrate the versatility and scalability of our approach.
url:98510ac540db3cb6.abstract_zh: 本文研究线性模型中异方差性推断方法，该模型常用于宏观经济政策分析，其中协变量内生性问题通常需在有限时间和数据条件下加以处理。我们的框架涵盖了标准的基于异方差性的方法，允许引入新的非嵌套约束条件，且无需事先设定制度标签。我们提出了一种易于实施的弱识别稳健性检验，并推导出其有效性的充分条件。模拟结果表明，该方法在多种设定下具有良好的检验水平和检验功效。通过对塞拉利昂燃料价格传导、菲律宾汇款对消费的影响以及多国汇率传导的实证应用，展示了我们方法的通用性与可扩展性。

url:9a7c262b083404f5.abstract: This paper analyzes the effects of dividend tax reforms on tax revenues, income shifting, and earnings retention. It examines two significant policy changes in Israel during the 2010s. Using administrative tax records, we study a permanent five-percentage point increase in the dividend tax rate in 2012, and a temporary tax relief enacted in 2017. The permanent tax hike triggered an immediate surge of over 100% in reported dividend income and tax revenues. It did not generate a lasting shift in dividend flows. In contrast, the temporary relief of 2017 led to a sharp decline in dividend payments upon its expiration. Notably, firms increased earnings retention after the preferential rate ended, potentially anticipating similar future relief. We also find evidence of income shifting via wage-to-dividend conversions for tax planning. Finally, increased earnings retention after 2017 produced a 1–2 percentage point downward bias in the top 1% income share due to unreported dividend income.
url:9a7c262b083404f5.abstract_zh: 本文分析了股息税改革对税收收入、收入转移及留存收益的影响。研究聚焦于2010年代以色列两项重大政策变革。基于行政税收记录，我们考察了2012年股息税率永久性提高5个百分点，以及2017年实施的临时性税收减免政策。永久性增税导致申报股息收入及税收收入立即激增逾100%，但并未引发股息流的持续性转移。相比之下，2017年的临时性减免政策在到期后导致股息支付急剧下降。值得注意的是，企业在优惠税率终止后增加了留存收益，这可能是预期未来将出现类似减免措施。我们还发现了通过工资-股息转换进行税务筹划的收入转移证据。最后，2017年后留存收益的增加导致未申报股息收入使顶层1%收入份额产生1-2个百分点的低估偏差。

url:9b9828f82f92f765.abstract: We show that incorporating uninsurable countercyclical income risk into a standard international RBC model can qualitatively and quantitatively account for the quantity puzzles in open-economy macro, namely (i) the Backus-Smith puzzle, (ii) the Backus-Kehoe-Kydland puzzle and (iii) the weak correlation between the trade balance and the exchange rate. We also show that our model can simultaneously account for the Fama puzzle and the evidence that high interest rate countries have stronger currencies---which representative-agents models that rely only on financial or demand shocks cannot jointly account for. Crucially, our model resolves all these puzzles while relying solely on productivity shocks, and thus generates the observed domestic and cross-country macroeconomic comovement.
url:9b9828f82f92f765.abstract_zh: 我们证明，将不可保险的反周期收入风险纳入标准国际实际经济周期模型，能够从定性和定量角度解释开放经济宏观经济学中的数量谜题，即：(i) 巴克斯-史密斯谜题、(ii) 巴克斯-基欧-基德兰德谜题以及(iii) 贸易余额与汇率之间的弱相关性。我们还证明，该模型能够同时解释法玛谜题以及高利率国家拥有更强货币的证据——而仅依赖金融或需求冲击的代表性主体模型无法共同解释这些现象。关键在于，我们的模型仅依靠生产率冲击就解决了所有这些谜题，从而生成了观察到的国内及跨国宏观经济协同波动。

url:9d9982226ccde5f6.abstract: We develop an integrated framework to characterize multi-objective policymaking and apply it to the case of critical materials. The model considers that national policy decisions will be influenced by domestic agencies with different priorities and goals and be informed by actions taken by other countries pertaining to critical materials. This creates a potential basis for a group of countries to form a critical materials club to reduce the probability of supply shocks and/or their consequences. We show that in an environment with multiple policy-active governments, criticality assessments embedded in a multi-objective government with domain-specific bureaucracies and multiple instruments can rationalize divergent policy choices under similar risk environments, provide conditions under which international coordination is more or less likely and apply the model to consider the design and political economy of plurilateral arrangements for critical materials.

url:a064a33b249d82e8.abstract: Sixty-three percent of large companies worldwide had made a net zero commitment by 2023, up from close to none in 2018. But if the target date is 2050, that's several corporate lifetimes away, and the planet needs emission reductions today. What actually changes in the boardroom when a pledge is signed? Simon Dietz (LSE, CEPR) has tracked climate management practices and emissions at nearly 2,000 companies to find out. He tells Tim Phillips that the picture is not the one that either side of the debate might expect. A net zero pledge doesn't usually signify an immediate cut in emissions, but there is a clear and early shift in how companies plan for net zero that has often started before the announcement. What is left is something is harder to spot: firms making a strategic pivot, of which the public commitment is only one part.
url:a064a33b249d82e8.abstract_zh: 截至2023年，全球63%的大型企业已做出净零排放承诺，而2018年这一比例几乎为零。但若目标期限设定在2050年，这相当于跨越数个企业生命周期，而地球亟需当下的减排行动。当企业签署承诺书时，董事会层面究竟发生了哪些实质性变化？伦敦政治经济学院及经济政策研究中心的西蒙·迪茨追踪了近2000家企业的气候管理实践与排放数据，试图揭示真相。他向蒂姆·菲利普斯表示，实际情况可能出乎辩论双方的预期。净零承诺通常不会立即带来排放削减，但企业规划净零转型的方式会提前出现明显转变——这种转变往往在公开承诺前就已启动。更难以察觉的是：企业正在实施战略转向，而公开承诺仅是其中一环。
url:a064a33b249d82e8.title: Are Net Zero Commitments Greenwash?
url:a064a33b249d82e8.title_zh: 净零承诺是漂绿行为吗？

url:a0698633658cf8e0.abstract: This paper develops a tractable model of offender location choice and police resource allocation across multiple areas. Individuals differ in the cost of apprehension and choose whether to commit crime and, if so, where. Each area contains a fixed value of criminal opportunities, so offenders impose congestion on one another, while policing affects expected apprehension. For arbitrary policing levels, equilibrium sorts offenders by apprehension cost across areas ordered by policing per unit of criminal opportunity value. With a fixed police budget, welfare maximization equalizes policing-to-value ratios across all active areas. The model shows when place-based policing should target the value of criminal opportunities rather than observed crime counts alone, since observed crime may already reflect prior police allocation and offender displacement.
url:a0698633658cf8e0.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个可处理的模型，用于分析犯罪者跨区域选址行为与警力资源分配问题。个体在逮捕成本上存在差异，需决定是否实施犯罪及选择犯罪地点。每个区域拥有固定价值的犯罪机会，因此犯罪者之间会产生相互拥挤效应，而警务活动则影响预期逮捕概率。在任意警力配置水平下，均衡状态会按照单位犯罪机会价值对应的警力密度，将犯罪者按逮捕成本排序至不同区域。在警力预算固定的条件下，社会福利最大化要求所有活跃区域的警力-价值比趋于均等。该模型表明，基于地点的警务策略应瞄准犯罪机会的价值而非仅关注观测到的犯罪数量——因为后者可能已反映先前的警力配置与犯罪者转移效应。

url:a2361d6c329e90fa.abstract: How do households respond when deposit rates drop below zero? Using administrative micro data and exploiting cross-bank variation in interest rate policies, we study a major episode of negative deposit rates in Denmark affecting two thirds of household deposits. We find that households strongly reduced deposit balances when exposed to negative deposit rates, allocating funds to stock portfolios and consumption. In a large-scale survey, we document important roles for loss aversion, perceived unfairness, intertemporal substitution and return considerations in driving these responses. Our findings suggest that monetary policy can have strong consumption effects in negative territory.
url:a2361d6c329e90fa.abstract_zh: 当存款利率降至负值时，家庭会如何应对？利用行政微观数据并借助银行间利率政策的差异，我们研究了丹麦一次影响三分之二家庭存款的重大负存款利率事件。研究发现，当家庭面临负存款利率时，其存款余额显著减少，资金被重新配置至股票投资组合和消费领域。通过大规模调查，我们证实损失厌恶、感知不公、跨期替代及收益考量在驱动这些行为中发挥重要作用。研究结果表明，货币政策在负利率区间可能对消费产生显著影响。

url:a29e8845bd232209.abstract: We provide the first lender-level analysis linking two independently constructed credit supply measures: the Federal Reserve's Senior Loan Officer Opinion Survey (SLOOS) and credit card mail offers from Mintel Comperemedia. Using a matched panel of 73 banks from 2000 to 2019, we find that quarterly mail volume growth was 18 percent lower when banks reported tightening credit card lending standards, a relationship robust to including credit demand indicators. In addition, SLOOS responses on credit limits and interest rate spreads are also correlated with these terms observed in mail offers. Our findings validate both measures as informative credit supply indicators.
url:a29e8845bd232209.abstract_zh: 我们首次从银行层面出发，将两种独立构建的信贷供给指标联系起来：美联储的高级贷款官意见调查（SLOOS）与Mintel Comperemedia的信用卡邮件报价数据。基于2000年至2019年73家银行的匹配面板数据，研究发现，当银行报告收紧信用卡贷款标准时，季度邮件数量增长率降低18%，这一关系在纳入信贷需求指标后依然稳健。此外，SLOOS中关于信用额度和利差的调查结果，也与邮件报价中观察到的这些条款存在相关性。我们的发现验证了这两种指标作为有效信贷供给指标的价值。

url:a2ac32fa7805318f.abstract: This paper develops a model where cultural conflict in society and electoral competition are jointly determined. Cultural conservatives and progressives choose, ex ante, their level of tolerance in social relations in response to two sources of threat: the probability of interacting with an intolerant cultural outgroup and the risk of unfavorable cultural policy. Political parties compete on both economic and cultural dimensions. The model shows that as societies gradually shift toward less traditional values, this can, beyond a threshold, trigger endogenous backlash and increased societal intolerance. This backlash shifts political competition from economic to cultural issues, further reinforcing cultural conflict. This two-way interaction can generate multiple equilibria and self-fulfilling “culture wars."
url:a2ac32fa7805318f.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个模型，将社会中的文化冲突与选举竞争视为内生决定过程。文化保守派与进步派在事前选择其社会关系中的容忍程度，以应对两种威胁来源：与不容忍的文化外群体互动的概率，以及不利文化政策的风险。政党在经济与文化两个维度上展开竞争。模型表明，随着社会逐渐转向非传统价值观，一旦超过某个阈值，便会引发内生性反弹，导致社会不容忍程度加剧。这种反弹将政治竞争从经济议题转向文化议题，进一步强化文化冲突。这种双向互动可能产生多重均衡与自我实现的"文化战争"。
url:a2ac32fa7805318f.title: Backlash and Culture Wars: A Political Economy Model
url:a2ac32fa7805318f.title_zh: 反弹与文化战争：一个政治经济学模型

url:a2c58ba7fbacf941.abstract: Current account imbalances have re-emerged in global policy debates amid renewed widening, persistence and trade tensions. This paper reviews stylised facts on global imbalances, lessons from past rebalancing episodes, and policy implications. It shows that global imbalances remain persistent and concentrated in a few economies, are shaped more by differences in saving than in investment, and that net international investment positions are strongly influenced by valuation and nominal growth effects. Deficit narrowing is typically accompanied by export growth and higher private saving‑investment balances, especially in firms, while surplus narrowing is more often associated with higher imports and lower net lending across sectors. Larger initial imbalances – especially deficits – are associated with a higher probability of subsequent narrowing. Overall, durable rebalancing is unlikely to be achieved through trade measures or any single policy instrument. Instead, it could benefit from domestically grounded reforms, including fiscal adjustment where needed, and structural measures to reduce excess saving and support investment. Stronger prudential oversight, especially of non-bank financial institutions, would mitigate financial risks. Industrial policy may affect trade balances for individual goods but is unlikely to durably alter aggregate current account positions.
url:a2c58ba7fbacf941.abstract_zh: 经常账户失衡问题在全球政策辩论中再度凸显，其背景是失衡状况持续扩大、长期存在以及贸易紧张局势加剧。本文梳理了全球失衡的典型事实、过往再平衡调整的经验教训及政策启示。研究表明：全球失衡仍具持续性且集中于少数经济体，其形成更多源于储蓄差异而非投资差异；净国际投资头寸受估值效应和名义增长效应影响显著。赤字收窄通常伴随出口增长及私人部门（尤其是企业）储蓄-投资余额提升，而盈余收窄则更多与进口增加及各部门净借贷下降相关。初始失衡规模越大（尤其是赤字），后续收窄概率越高。总体而言，持久性再平衡难以通过贸易措施或单一政策工具实现，而更需依托国内改革——包括必要的财政调整，以及旨在减少过剩储蓄、促进投资的结构性措施。强化审慎监管（尤其针对非银行金融机构）有助于缓解金融风险。产业政策可能影响特定商品贸易差额，但难以持久改变经常账户总体格局。

url:a311de83881380d0.abstract: The EU Recovery and Resilience Facility was launched to support post-Covid recovery while accelerating structural transformation through investment and reform. This column provides a preliminary descriptive assessment of the macroeconomic impact of the facility in Italy, Greece, and Spain, three countries with large allocations. Using simple counterfactual comparisons, it presents evidence consistent with a positive impact on real GDP, and an even stronger impact on employment and investment in the three countries. The evidence also points to an expected positive impact on potential output in the years ahead.
url:a311de83881380d0.abstract_zh: 欧盟复苏与韧性基金旨在支持疫情后经济复苏，同时通过投资与改革加速结构性转型。本专栏对意大利、希腊和西班牙这三个获得大额拨款的国家的基金宏观经济影响进行了初步描述性评估。通过简单的反事实比较，研究提供了与三国实际GDP正向影响相一致的证据，且对就业和投资的促进作用更为显著。证据还表明，该基金有望在未来几年对潜在产出产生积极影响。

url:a395f6b3f06f3fe6.abstract: Housing affordability has moved to the forefront of Europe’s policy debate. While the economic literature has mostly focused on the drivers of housing unaffordability, this column examines its consequences in the EU. The authors find that increases in housing cost burdens have large adverse impacts on housing adequacy, with noticeable impacts on poverty and health. The effects on fertility and labour force participation are smaller.
url:a395f6b3f06f3fe6.abstract_zh: 住房可负担性已成为欧洲政策辩论的焦点。尽管经济学文献主要关注住房不可负担性的驱动因素，本文则探讨其在欧盟范围内的后果。作者发现，住房成本负担的增加对住房适足性产生显著的负面影响，并对贫困和健康状况造成明显冲击，而对生育率和劳动力参与率的影响则相对较小。

url:a5b448995d656cc1.abstract: This study analyzes the impact of the Romania Secondary Education Project, which was designed to improve student retention, graduation rates and pass rates on a national end-of-high-school exam for low-achievement high schools in Romania. The program was implemented in three waves, September 2017, September 2018, and September 2020, with eligible high schools randomly assigned to each. The study exploits this staggered implementation to measure the project’s causal impacts on students. The estimates indicate that the Romania Secondary Education Project had no significant impact on (i) student preferences for attending a program high school, (ii) student retention rates, (iii) high school graduation rates, (iv) enrollment in the post-high school baccalaureate exam, (v) baccalaureate exam pass rates, or (vi) baccalaureate exam scores. There was a small increase in girls’ passing rates (3 percentage points). However, there was little heterogeneity in the null effects by grant size, urban-rural status, student achievement levels, town income levels, and type of curriculum taught.
url:a5b448995d656cc1.abstract_zh: 本研究分析了罗马尼亚中等教育项目的影响，该项目旨在提高罗马尼亚低成就高中的学生保留率、毕业率及全国高中毕业会考的通过率。该项目分三批实施（2017年9月、2018年9月和2020年9月），符合条件的学校被随机分配至各批次。研究利用这一分阶段实施机制，衡量项目对学生产生的因果效应。估计结果表明，罗马尼亚中等教育项目对以下指标均无显著影响：（i）学生就读项目高中的偏好；（ii）学生保留率；（iii）高中毕业率；（iv）高中后会考注册率；（v）会考通过率；（vi）会考成绩。仅女生通过率出现小幅提升（3个百分点）。然而，按补助金额、城乡状况、学生学业水平、城镇收入水平及课程类型划分的异质性分析显示，零效应在各子样本中均未呈现显著差异。
